job.job_description:
Company Description

Hyde Perth has recently established itself as a world class employer of choice and to be part of something special. Since the hotel’s opening in March 2026, we have been bringing the signature Hyde energy to the vibrant heart of Western Australia. This bold and stylish hotel embodies the spirit of the Hyde brand: luxurious yet laidback, sophisticated with a festival soul. 

Hyde is embracing an evolved brand identity that is all about a festival vibe with music at its core. Hyde perfectly balances an elevated bohemian-chic aesthetic with a youthful, laidback ambience. The spaces are defined by vibrant colours and are designed to encourage serendipitous connections and new discoveries around every corner. Hyde is all about the freedom and personal discovery that comes with great music, time with friends and connecting with something bigger. 

Job Description

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Sales Executive, you’ll play a key role in driving revenue and market share for Hyde Perth through proactive business development, account management and MICE, group and event sales.

Working closely with the Director of Sales, Revenue, Reservations, Marketing, Food & Beverage and Hotel Operations, you’ll generate new business, grow existing accounts, convert opportunities and ensure a seamless client experience from enquiry through to event delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development

  • Prospect and qualify new Corporate, MICE and Leisure opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with corporate decision-makers, TMCs, PCOs, DMCs, event agencies and travel partners.
  • Conduct proactive sales calls, client meetings, networking, market visits, hotel inspections and client entertainment.
  • Maintain an active sales pipeline and accurately record activity in the CRM.
  • Identify competitor accounts, market opportunities and new revenue streams.

Account Management

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of Corporate and Leisure accounts.
  • Build strong relationships with key clients, bookers and decision-makers.
  • Conduct regular account reviews, sales calls and client meetings.
  • Manage RFPs, rate negotiations and account development plans.
  • Identify opportunities to increase room nights, revenue and share of wallet.
  • Develop cross-selling opportunities across accommodation, meetings, events and Food & Beverage.
  • Maintain accurate account information and monitor account production.

MICE Sales, Conversion & Event Planning

  • Manage MICE, group and event enquiries from initial enquiry through to delivery and follow-up.
  • Prepare proposals, quotations and agreements and proactively follow up to maximise conversion.
  • Conduct site inspections and negotiate rates and terms within approved parameters.
  • Work with Revenue to maximise pricing and total revenue.
  • Understand client requirements including event objectives, room layouts, menus, AV, accommodation and schedules.
  • Coordinate confirmed events and ensure all requirements are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Liaise with F&B, Kitchen, Front Office, Reservations and Operations to ensure seamless delivery.
  • Maintain accurate tentative, definite and lost-business records.
  • Where possible, meet and greet clients on event days and follow up post-event to drive repeat business.

Qualifications

You’ll be a proactive, commercially minded sales professional who enjoys prospecting, building relationships and converting opportunities. You’ll be confident on the phone and in person, highly organised and comfortable managing multiple clients, enquiries and events.

Ideally, You’ll Have

  • Experience in hotel sales, hospitality, business development, account management or events.
  • Strong prospecting, communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • MICE, group or event experience is highly regarded.
  • Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organisation and time management skills.
  • Confidence working collaboratively within a small hotel team.
  • Experience with CRM and hotel systems, including Ivvy and Opera.
  • Knowledge of the Perth Corporate, MICE or Leisure market is highly regarded.
  • A genuine passion for hospitality and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Additional Information

What Is In It For You 

  • The chance to make your mark in a fast-growing Brand. 
  • Learning opportunities to broaden your skillset and development that helps you think, make, and thrive at work. 
  • An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact. 
  • The opportunity to be yourself and collaborate with other bright minds in a relaxed, innovative culture. 
  • Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands, including Accor’s Heartist (Employee) program and related benefits. 

 Hyde is an equal opportunity employer. We endeavour to select, place, train, and promote the best qualified individuals based upon job-related factors such as ability, work quality, suitability, experience, and potential.

job.job_description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Leadership/Team Quote:

This opening is for the Content Intelligence team within the Marketplace AI department at Booking.com.

The Content Intelligence team is at the forefront of Generative AI innovation, driving solutions for travel-related chatbots, text generation and summarization applications, Q&A systems, and free-text search. Beyond this, the team is building a cutting-edge platform that processes millions of images and textual inputs daily, enriching them with ML capabilities. These enriched datasets power downstream applications, helping personalize the customer experience—for example, selecting and displaying the most relevant images and reviews as customers plan and book their next vacation.

Role Description:

As a Data Engineer, you’ll collaborate with top-notch engineers and data scientists to elevate our platform to the next level and deliver exceptional user experiences. Your primary focus will be on the data engineering aspects—ensuring the seamless flow of high-quality, relevant data to train and optimize content models, including GenAI foundation models, supervised fine-tuning, and more.

You’ll work closely with teams across the company to ensure the availability of high-quality data from ML platforms, powering decisions across all departments. With access to petabytes of data through MySQL, Snowflake, Cassandra, S3, and other platforms, your challenge will be to ensure that this data is applied even more effectively to support business decisions, train and monitor ML models and improve our products.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Rapidly developing next-generation scalable, flexible, and high-performance data pipelines.
  • Dealing with massive textual sources to train GenAI foundation models.
  • Solving issues with data and data pipelines, prioritizing based on customer impact.
  • End-to-end ownership of data quality in our core datasets and data pipelines.
  • Experimenting with new tools and technologies to meet business requirements regarding performance, scaling, and data quality.
  • Providing tools that improve Data Quality company-wide, specifically for ML scientists.
  • Providing self-organizing tools that help the analytics community discover data, assess quality, explore usage, and find peers with relevant expertise.
  • Acting as an intermediary for problems, with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Promote and drive impactful and innovative engineering solutions
  • Technical, behavioral and interpersonal competence advancement via on-the-job opportunities, experimental projects, hackathons, conferences, and active community participation
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams: Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and analysts to understand business requirements and translate them into machine learning solutions. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer or a similar role, with a consistent record of successfully delivering ML/Data solutions.
  • You have built production data pipelines in the cloud, setting up data-lake and server-less solutions; ‌ you have hands-on experience with schema design and data modeling and working with ML scientists and ML engineers to provide production level ML solutions.
  • You have experience designing systems E2E and knowledge of basic concepts (lb, db, caching, NoSQL, etc)
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python and Java.
  • Experience with big data processing frameworks such, Pyspark, Apache Flink, Snowflake or similar frameworks.
  • Demonstrable experience with MySQL, Cassandra, DynamoDB or similar relational/NoSQL database systems.
  • Experience with Data Warehousing and ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Experience in data processing for large-scale language models like GPT, BERT, or similar architectures - an advantage.
  • Proficiency in data manipulation, analysis, and visualization using tools like NumPy, pandas, and matplotlib - an advantage.
  • Experience with experimental design, A/B testing, and evaluation metrics for ML models - an advantage.
  • Experience of working on products that impact a large customer base - an advantage.
  • Excellent communication in English; written and spoken.


Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) at Booking.com:

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Application Process:

  • Let’s go places together: How we Hire
  • This role does not come with relocation assistance.


Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.

Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

job.job_description:

Travel Consultant, Corporate

This is a full time permanent position with BCD Australia

If you are based in Sydney NSW, then this role is hybrid

Do you communicate effortlessly and have customer service at heart? If so, then you may be a great fit, to work with BCD Travel’s corporate clients to support them with their travel requirements. Does this sound like you? – Read on!

As a Corporate Travel Consultant, you will

About You

  • Mid to advanced level skills in GDS Sabre – we provide dedicated training in Sabre too!
  • Willingness to flex from time to time on roster start and finish times

What We Offer You

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. About Us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

  • https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/

You’ll be offered

  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta is seeking a dynamic and experienced communications professional to shape and amplify the brand’s ground experience, day-of travel and connected onboard experience storytelling. The Communications Specialist (Grade 7) of Product Communications will report to the General Manager, Product Communications and have a direct line into the GR10 – Channels, Sync – for both ground and onboard experience continuity.

  • Thread the needle and support communications strategy for Delta's connected onboard experience and day-of-travel product portfolio, specifically ground experience and digital hard product storytelling.
  • Develop integrated communications plans for customer-facing initiatives, including announcements, milestones and product launches.
  • Partner with Airport Customer Service and other cross-functional teams to communicate innovations that make travel more seamless for customers.
  • Develop media strategies, briefing materials, key messages and proactive storytelling opportunities.
  • Develop pitch materials, lists and execute media outreach in support of all programs.
  • Create internal and external communications content, including News Hub stories, leader talking points, media materials and employee communications.
  • Provide strategic counsel to business leaders and product teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Liaise and remain flexible between the Product and Commercial GMs where needed; thread ground experience product storytelling from Delta One check-in to the Lounge and onboard.
  • Support reputation management and reactive communications as needed.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be performing satisfactorily in present position
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Strategic, solutions-oriented approach and ease working collaboratively across teams
  • Passion for measurement and analysis to gain results and prioritize work
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook is crucial
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in Corporate Communications, Public Relations and/or Marketing Communications, including day-to-day relationships with Senior Executives
  • Ability to move seamlessly between critical thinking and tactical execution and juggle competing priorities
  • Ability to act as strategic counsel to and cultivate constructive relationships with individuals at all levels
  • Ability to proactively keep work moving – building, shaping and planning against the next big announcement – as opposed to acting on a reactive basis
  • Diplomacy, positivity, keen problem-solving, critical thinking, and the ability to receive and deliver constructive criticism
  • Strong team orientation and relationship-building skills; predisposition to seek and integrate diverse viewpoints
  • Honesty, integrity, respectfulness, perseverance, and servant leadership – and the ability to foster these core Delta values and bring out the best in team members
  • Excellent verbal and writing capabilities, storytelling expertise in multiple mediums, media relations expertise

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven experience in strategic communications, media relations, and brand storytelling.
  • Communications experience in the airline industry with both external and internal audiences.
  • Experience developing and mentoring teams.
  • A natural, proven collaborator with expertise for connecting dots across the broader Global Communications team.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way.

Why You'll Love Delta

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Commercial Manager - HGI Rayong and Cluster Director of Sales - Hilton Pattaya and HGI Rayong, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. *

Primary responsibilities include delivery of high-quality reporting, analysis and insight to business leaders on financial performance and preparation of quarterly forecasts. This will involve interacting with all levels of the organization, helping drive the business forward.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the month-end reporting process on a division’s performance; delivering this to Senior Management and the wider finance team; identifying key business drivers
  • Deliver insightful analysis to identify longer term risks and opportunities to the business and maximize profitability
  • Input into the monthly Forecast process submitted to the Corporate Finance team capturing known variances to forecast and current divisional performance
  • Business partner with key stakeholders including Commercial Finance, Sales, Revenue Optimisation, Expedia Product & Technology to get in depth analysis behind P&L drivers
  • Own and co-ordinate the forecast profit and loss submission into Oracle Cloud for a division; working closely with various finance and non-finance stakeholders
  • Challenge forecast assumptions including sales, revenue margin %, commission costs to ensure a robust forecast and identify key sensitivities to the wider business
  • Evaluate and streamline existing processes where possible, ensuring buy in from various stakeholders, and working with other team members to create efficiency for all
  • Support departmental need for ad-hoc reporting and presentations when required
  • Prepare forecast summary presentations to senior management highlighting key movements
  • Utilise AI and reporting tools to increase efficiency and accuracy of data and commentary

Experience And Qualifications

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent)
  • A BA/BSc 2:1 or above (or equivalent) from an accredited university
  • Excellent experience in providing analysis and insights to key stakeholders in a fast-paced global environment; ideally in an FP&A role
  • Ability to think big and think small
  • Experience with analysis, forecasting, and management reporting
  • Strong Excel skills - working on large and complex data sets
  • Professional, “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Great time management skills – making sure deliverables are understood, met and on time – and communicated early if there is a risk
  • Desired - Experience using Oracle Cloud and Looker (or similar BI tools)

Please note that this role is only available in the following location: London, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

If you are a technical accounting expert who thrives on execution in a fast-paced, technology-centric environment and brings expertise in complex capital market transactions, we want to hear from you.

We are seeking a Principal – Capital Markets Technical Accountant to join our global Technical Accounting team, where innovation knows no borders. This team ensures financial integrity, supports critical capital transactions and provides technical accounting guidance that empowers strategic decision-making across the enterprise. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As Principal – Capital Markets Technical Accountant, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert for all capital markets activities, debt issuances, refinancings and related compliance. You will navigate complex transactions and evolving regulatory standards, translating US GAAP into actionable insights for leadership while maintaining robust accounting controls. This role requires deep technical rigor, operational agility and the confidence to guide cross-functional business partners through complex financial landscapes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical accounting research, analysis and memorandum documentation for capital markets transactions, including debt issuances, refinancings, credit facility amendments and derivative structures under ASC 470 and ASC 815.
  • Own ongoing technical accounting execution, month-end closing activities and internal controls (SOX) for debt transactions, including debt issuance cost amortization, discount/premium tracking and gain/loss on extinguishment calculations.
  • Manage technical accounting, servicer reporting and annual audit processes for Sabre's Accounts Receivable securitization facility under ASC 860, partnering with external auditors and facility sponsors.
  • Support foreign guarantor financial analysis and international statutory financial filings across foreign jurisdictions for subsidiaries guaranteeing Sabre's debt.
  • Serve as the primary technical authority for SEC reporting disclosures (10-Q/10-K), external auditor interactions and strategic advisory to Treasury, Legal, Tax and Executive Leadership.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools and automation platforms to streamline research workflows, optimize debt amortization modeling and enhance overall reporting throughput.

What You'll Bring

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting and an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license.
  • Minimum 4 years of applicable technical accounting experience, including experience within a Big 4 or professional services firm focused on capital markets, debt accounting and complex corporate finance.
  • Deep technical expertise in ASC 470 (Debt), ASC 815 (Derivatives/Hedging), ASC 860 (Transfers/Servicing) and ASC 820 (Fair Value).
  • Proven track record of documenting complex accounting treatments in defensible technical memorandums and communicating concepts to non-CPA leadership.
  • Strong operational discipline to manage high-priority transactions, SOX controls and external audits simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits That Support You

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Strong retirement planning support
  • Family-friendly benefits
  • Professional development opportunities

KAYAK is seeking a Manager, Kubernetes Operations to lead the team responsible for the reliability, scalability, and security of our container orchestration platform. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with a genuine passion for people leadership — guiding a team of platform engineers while shaping the strategy that keeps our containerized production environment running at global scale. You will be a key partner to engineering, security, and infrastructure teams, helping KAYAK move faster and more safely by building a platform your colleagues can depend on.

In This Role You Will

  • Own the technical roadmap and operational strategy for the Kubernetes platform, ensuring cluster reliability, scalability, and security across production and non-production environments.
  • Lead a team of container platform engineers, taking full responsibility for hiring, performance management, and career development to build a high-performing, inclusive team.
  • Deliver a continuously improving container platform by driving cluster lifecycle management — including version upgrades, node provisioning, capacity planning, and workload migration from legacy orchestration platforms.
  • Coach engineers on Kubernetes best practices, container security, RBAC design, and operational excellence, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous learning.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineering, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure containerized workloads are reliable, observable, and deployable with confidence.
  • Drive the adoption of infrastructure-as-code and GitOps practices for cluster configuration and application deployment, reducing manual toil and improving consistency across environments.
  • Design and enforce standards for Kubernetes observability — including metrics collection, alerting, and dashboarding — so the team can detect and resolve incidents quickly and conduct effective post-incident reviews.
  • Hold the team to a high standard of operational excellence, including on-call practices, incident response, and blameless post-mortems.
  • Collaborate with adjacent operations and engineering leaders to align the Kubernetes platform roadmap with broader infrastructure and product engineering goals.
  • Advance the team's security posture by partnering with security teams on cluster hardening, network policy enforcement, and compliance requirements.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 8+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or platform/infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • A proven track record of operating large-scale, 24/7 production Kubernetes environments, including cluster lifecycle management (upgrades, node provisioning, capacity planning) and workload migration from legacy container orchestration platforms.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Kubernetes — including RBAC design, network policy, cluster hardening, and multi-environment operations spanning on-premises and cloud infrastructure.
  • A strong technical foundation in both on premise and cloud infrastructure (GCP and/or AWS) and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Experience as a people manager with a demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and retain engineering talent, and a commitment to building inclusive, high-performing teams.
  • Solid experience with modern observability tooling — such as Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent — including alerting, dashboarding, and incident-driven tuning.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or automation language (Python, Go, or Bash) to support infrastructure-as-code workflows and reduce operational toil.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision and work effectively with cross-functional engineering, security, and product teams.
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
    • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
    • Travel Discounts
    • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more
EQUITY ELIGIBLE

Job Summary

Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives. Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Required:

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred:

  • 4 year college degree.
  • Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
  • Lodging sales experience.
  • Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

  • Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators in the market.
  • Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.
  • Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction with Regional Marketing Communications.
  • Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Reviews the Strategic Alignment Review (STAR) report, competitive shopping reports and uses other resources to maintain an awareness of the hotel’s market position.
  • Researches competitor’s sales team strategies to identify ways to grow occupancy and RevPAR and increase market share.
  • Attends sales strategy meetings to provide input on weekly and overall sales strategy.
  • Suggests innovative marketing ideas and develops deployment strategies to continue to grow market share.
  • Evaluates and supports participation and account deployment with Area Sales and Group Sales within the Sales Office.
  • Serves as the sales contact for the General Manager, property leadership team, Group Sales and Area Sales leaders.
  • Serves as the sales contact for customers; serves as the customer advocate.
  • Serves as hotel authority on sales processes and sales contracts.
  • Serves as the property sales liaison with Area Sales, Group Sales, Revenue Management, Event Management, Regional Marketing Communications and other hotel departments as appropriate.
  • Participates in sales calls with members of the Sales and Marketing team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
  • Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to augment the overall marketing communication strategy.
  • Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.
  • Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.
  • Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
  • Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g., , Marriott Hotels and Resorts (MHR) Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, Renaissance Hotels and Resorts (RHR) Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning Meeting).
  • Implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of service.
  • Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.
  • Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
  • Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through.
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase brand/product awareness.
  • Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
  • Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.
  • Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
  • Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
  • Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Leadership

  • Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue.
  • Develops sales goals and strategies and verifies alignment with the brand business strategy.
  • Executes the sales strategy in order to meet individual booking goals for both self and staff.
  • Coaches leaders of revenue generating departments in developing effective revenue strategies and setting aggressive goals that will drive the property's financial performance.
  • Verifies Sales team understands and is leveraging Marriott International (MI) demand engines to full potential.
  • Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to monitor compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.
  • Partners with Human Resources to attract, develop and retain the right people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.
  • Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management systems are in place.
  • Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership Performance Process (LPP), aligns performance and rewards, addresses performance issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.
  • Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with Human Resources (HR) to minimize lost time due to turnover.
  • Maintains an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.
  • Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning catering solutions.
  • Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.
  • Identifies, trains and mentors group sales associates; utilizes all available on the job training tools for associates.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.


Job Description

  • At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
  • A fantastic opportunity to be part of a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and engineering principles.
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide.


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide will contribute to consumer needs by architecting and delivering robust, scalable systems that power seamless digital experiences, ensuring fast, secure, and reliable services that support evolving customer expectations.


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you’ll be responsible for guiding and leading the architecture, delivery and development of the software systems that power our business unit. A hands-on, highly skilled software developer with the experience to dive into code to deliver high quality, well-designed software. You will share responsibility for the quality of the software being built, including but not limited to; achieving desired business outcomes, meeting reliability and performance expectations and safely managing security and data privacy concerns.


You’ll Have

  • 6+ years’ in a hands-on Software Engineering role
  • Strong experience building high‑traffic customer facing web applications across frontend and backend
  • Experience working with databases (e.g , PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, etc)
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript, with experience applying these skills across both UI representation and platform‑driven, rule‑based implementations
  • Proven backend experience using Node JS and Java with modern frameworks (e.g. Spring / Spring Boot) to build scalable APIs and services
  • Working knowledge of React.js, Next.js (including server-side rendering and modern rendering patterns) and modern frontend patterns to support and evolve user experiences
  • Solid understanding of cloud‑native development on platforms such as AWS, including deployment, scaling, and operational considerations
  • Experience and confidence with CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions), version control (Git), and automated testing practices
  • Experience using observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, or similar) to support production systems
  • A real passion for quality, clean code and continuous improvement
  • A strong understanding of architectural concepts and cloud-based solution design
  • Highly dedicated ethos - expected to take very real accountability for the work you're doing
  • Demonstrable ability to motivate self and others, and a passion to mentor junior developers
  • Experience working with technical and non-technical partners, with the capability to influence
  • A test and learn mindset with curiosity, collaboration and care
  • Experience writing multi-threaded, asynchronous code
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager and Adobe Edge Delivery Services desirable


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on the 5th of October


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. job.job_description:
Overview

Travel Leaders Network (www.TravelLeaders.com) , as one of the largest sellers of luxury travel, cruises and tours in the industry, is a passionate community of travel professionals focused on mutual success. Representing approximately 5,700 travel agency locations across the United States and Canada, this Network uses the power of its parent company, Internova Travel Group, to assist millions of leisure and business travelers annually.

Travel agent members who belong to Travel Leaders Network have access to meaningful supplier partnerships, innovative technology that integrates with industry-leading marketing, exclusive value-added programs and member support and training that only a company with their size and strength can offer. Travel Leaders Network gives their members everything they need to grow as a Leader and inspire more people to travel better.

Responsibilities

Serve as a key liaison between Internova and its preferred Destination and Global Tourism Board Partners, managing a diverse portfolio of mid-tier through top-tier, complex accounts. The Account Manager is responsible for end-to-end partner management, campaign execution, relationship development, and coordination across Internova business units to ensure successful delivery of partner commitments and long-term partnership value. In addition to assigned accounts, the Account Manager will support designated team-wide functions and cross-functional areas, helping facilitate communication, maintain processes and resources, and promote consistency and collaboration across the Destinations team and Internova business units.

Account & Partner Management

  • Manage a portfolio of mid-tier through top-tier destination partners, including complex, multi-faceted partnerships spanning multiple Internova business units.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day partner contact, building strong relationships and maintaining a high level of partner service and engagement.
  • Manage the full lifecycle of assigned partner agreements, from annual planning and activation through execution, reporting, renewal, and ongoing account development.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of partner objectives, contracted commitments, budgets, timelines, and performance expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen existing partnerships and support account retention, renewals, and appropriate growth in collaboration with Destination team leadership.

Campaign Management & Execution

  • Translate contracted partner plans into clear, actionable campaign timelines and oversee successful execution across B2B, B2C, events, publications, education, and other applicable channels.
  • Coordinate multiple partner campaigns and deliverables simultaneously, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with contracted commitments.
  • Partner with Creative, Marketing, Events, Analytics, and other internal teams to move campaigns from planning through execution.
  • Review campaign assets and deliverables for accuracy, partner alignment, brand standards, and contractual requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Team Support

  • Collaborate across Internova business units and functional teams to support the successful execution of Destination Partner programs and initiatives.
  • Support assigned cross-functional or team-wide areas of responsibility, helping facilitate communication, coordination, and consistent processes across the Destinations team.
  • Maintain and share relevant updates, resources, tools, and process information related to assigned functional areas.
  • Partner with fellow Account Managers to ensure information and best practices are communicated consistently across the team.
  • Contribute to team-wide initiatives, events, process improvements, and special projects as assigned.

Partner Reporting, Budget & Performance Management

  • Manage assigned partner budgets and ensure activities remain within contracted revenue and expense parameters.
  • Maintain accurate account records, campaign documentation, timelines, and partner activity.
  • Coordinate collection and analysis of campaign performance data, KPIs, and proof of performance.
  • Develop comprehensive partner recaps that demonstrate campaign delivery, results, and overall partnership value.
  • Use performance insights to inform partner conversations, renewals, and future account recommendations.
  • Proactively identify execution risks, resolve issues, and communicate changes or recommendations to partners and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, tourism, business administration, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of account management, partnership marketing, or related experience; travel, tourism, hospitality, tourism board, tour operator, consortia, or destination experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex client or partner relationships, multiple concurrent campaigns, and significant program budgets.
  • Strong relationship-management skills with the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with both external partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to coordinate complex projects across multiple teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver against deadlines with strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly organized, proactive, collaborative, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and related business tools, including document preparation, presentations, data analysis, spreadsheet management, and project-management platforms such as Smartsheet and other required technology tools
  • Ability to travel for partner meetings, industry events, and Internova programs as required.

Pay And Benefits

Our benefit offerings include choice of two medical plans and two dental plans, vision insurance, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), company-paid life insurance and AD&D, optional additional life insurance and AD&D, disability insurance, paid parental leave, paid time off, 401k Plan with company match, discounted employee travel options, access to LinkedIn Learning webinars and courses. Discounted pet insurance and auto, home, & renters insurance.

The salary range on this job posting/advertising has been developed to give applicants a wide range to comply with pay transparency laws in all states and geographical areas. Many factors, such as years of experience, geographical location, budget etc. are considered when determining the starting rate of pay. The salary range posted represents the pay range for U.S. candidates. If the job posting indicates that the role is available for international candidate consideration, the salary range will be based on the local market for the country where the candidate would be working.

This role may be eligible for an incentive, commission, bonus, or a discretionary bonus program based on the company’s financial goal achievement and individual performance.

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH bieten wir ab August 2027 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung zum Tourismuskaufmann (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reisevermittlung in einem unserer Reisebüros im Großraum Berlin an.

Wenn Du zu einem früheren Zeitpunkt starten möchtest, melde Dich gerne, gemeinsam werden wir einen Weg finden.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • mit TUI WORKWIDE bis zu 30 Tage im Ausland arbeiten
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du liebst Reisen, bist kommunikativ und möchtest anderen zu unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen verhelfen? Dann starte deine Ausbildung bei TUI! Im Reisebüro bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund*innen und unterstützt sie dabei, genau die Reise zu finden, die zu ihren Wünschen passt. Du berätst zu Reisezielen weltweit, vergleichst Angebote, organisierst individuelle Urlaubserlebnisse und stehst vor, während und nach der Reise als Ansprechpartner*in zur Seite. So wirst du Schritt für Schritt zum Reiseprofi und machst aus Reiseträumen echte Erlebnisse.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Einblicke in die Abläufe eines Reisebüros
  • Planung und Verkauf von Reiseerlebnissen
  • Kleine Teams und Zusammenarbeit mit tollen Kolleg*innen
  • Kennenlernen unserer unterschiedlichen Hotelkonzepte, Marken und Reiseprodukte
  • Übernahme eigener Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung
  • Verständnis dafür, wie aus einer Idee ein unvergessliches Urlaubserlebnis entsteht

Bei uns bekommst du vielfältige Einblicke, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum Profi der Touristikbranche.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Reiseträume wahr werden lassen möchtest.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt. 
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest. 
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt. 
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. 
  • du (Fach)Abitur oder einen erweiterten Realschulabschluss mitbringst.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade deine Bewerbung einfach online hoch: 

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt) 
  • Lebenslauf 
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnis 
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist 

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und sende uns deine Unterlagen. 
  • Zeig uns, wer du bist – im Auswahlprozess möchten wir dich und deine Stärken kennenlernen.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen – ab November laden wir dich zu unserem Bewerberauswahlverfahren ein.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot und startest im August 2027 deine Reise bei TUI. 

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
Ready to build platforms that enable product teams to put AI to work for millions of guests? We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to partner with engineering on the roadmap and requirements for IHG’s AI platform. This is an individual contributor role for someone who thinks in systems, is energized by ambiguity, and can turn messy technical problems into a clear, prioritized plan other teams can build on.

Your Day to Day

  • Ground the platform roadmap in evidence: dig into usage data and partner with product teams across IHG to surface AI needs. Then turn findings into prioritized use case recommendations that balance competing team needs into a single plan.
  • Partner with the AI Platform Engineering team to sanity-check incoming requests, partner to define what gets built and why, and track initiatives from kickoff through launch and post-launch outcomes.
  • Partner with the platform engineers and enterprise architecture on technical trade-offs (e.g. data access, security, and how AI tools should work together) weighing build vs. buy, speed, cost, and scale decisions.
  • Tailor the message for the room: technical trade-offs and platform performance for engineering, adoption and cost impact for executives. Represent the platform's technical direction in forums across the org on engineering's behalf as needed.
  • Lend supplemental AI product management support to other domain teams when they need it and your bandwidth allows without taking on ownership of their roadmap or delaying the platform work you lead.

What We Need From You

  • 3-6 years of experience as a Product Manager in a software or tech-first company. You've worked on AI platforms, machine learning, or data-driven products. If you've actually shipped one that drove measurable value, even better.
  • Working knowledge of what's running under the hood - cloud platforms like Google Cloud Platform, APIs, eval frameworks, data pipelines, agent monitoring tools - enough to have an informed, credible conversation with engineering about the platform itself.
  • The ability to explain how AI works, what its results mean, and where its limits are, in plain terms that business partners, vendors, leaders, and teammates can act on.
  • A bias toward fast validation, such as testing a quick prototype or prompt rather than guessing, paired with the judgment to know when something isn't working and the confidence to change course quickly.
  • Command of AI assistants like Copilot, Claude, Rovo or Gemini Enterprise, along with everyday tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Office 365, to get your work done efficiently day to day.

Preferred

  • Real knowledge of the hotel guest journey — booking through stay, loyalty, and beyond — with real ideas for where AI can improve the employee experiences.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset: quick to spot AI-tied opportunities, with a track record of turning them into business value cases that hold up to scrutiny.
  • The ability to lead and align people across teams even when they don’t report to you.
  • A working understanding of responsible AI, including bias, privacy, transparency, and governance, along with the judgment to apply those principles when they matter most.

Travel - 10%

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
