job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

This team sits within Expedia Groups B2B, on the Supply Marketing team. The team helps hotels, vacation-rental businesses, airlines, and more deliver better traveler and business experiences through Expedia Group. Supply Marketing turns partner and market insight into clear stories, strategies, and programs that drive product adoption, business growth, and long-term partner value.

The Connectivity team focuses on the technology that enables external partners to connect to Expedia Group through APIs and other integrations. These partners use our capabilities to access, distribute, and improve Expedia Group travel products through their own software and services. The workstream focuses on Connectivity enterprise partners, a group of technology partners that drive significant business for Expedia Group.

Make An Impact!

Director of Product Marketing Connectivity leads a PMM team and sets the GTM standard, and aligns Product, Commercial, Technical, Marketing, and Enablement teams around enterprise partner adoption. The ideal candidate is a senior PMM leader with strong enterprise-technology experience, able to translate complex APIs and platforms into compelling narratives, scalable GTM programs, and measurable business impact.

We are looking for a Director, Product Marketing — Connectivity to lead the Product Marketing team. This leader will set the standard for how we bring complex, technical products to market and drive adoption across an enterprise partner ecosystem.

You will lead a team of product marketers across Hotel and Vacation Rental space, and serve as the strategic connector across Product, commercial account teams, technical partner teams, Partner Marketing, Creative, Communications, Field Enablement, and other functions. You will turn complex product roadmaps, platform capabilities, and partner needs into compelling stories, clear positioning, and coordinated go-to-market plans.

This is a role for a strong Product Marketing leader who understands enterprise technology and can translate API and platform concepts into business value internally and externally. Product or Engineering experience is not required.

Connectivity experience is valuable, but not required. Experience in driving sophisticated go-to-market motions in SaaS, platform, developer-tools, or other partner-led technology businesses is essential for success in this role.

In this role, you will

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Connectivity Product Marketing across the product lifecycle—from discovery and pilots through launch, adoption, usage, and advocacy.
  • Establish the standards, processes, and planning rhythms that enable the team to deliver consistent, high-quality go-to-market work at scale.
  • Lead the translation of product strategy, market opportunities, partner needs, and technical roadmaps into cohesive go-to-market architecture, with clear audiences, messages, channels, timing, and success measures.
  • Lead the team that develops compelling messaging, positioning, value propositions, proof points, use cases, FAQs, and partner stories that make complex capabilities easy to understand and act on.
  • Build integrated go-to-market plans with Product, commercial account teams, technical partner teams, Partner Marketing, Creative, Communications, Field Enablement, and other stakeholders, creating one coordinated partner experience.
  • Partner with Field Enablement on reusable sales tools and with technical partner teams on accurate integration and adoption guidance.
  • Use partner insight, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to improve positioning, prioritize work, influence product direction, and measure adoption and usage.
  • Represent Connectivity Product Marketing in senior leadership forums and cross-organizational planning, communicating decisions, trade-offs, risks, and results with clarity.
  • Attract, develop, and retain a high-performing team; create clarity on priorities and ownership, coach people to do their best work, and raise Product Marketing capability across the organization.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in Product Marketing, enterprise technology, product, or a related field, with 5+ years leading and developing people.
  • A track record of leading Product Marketing for complex products, platforms, APIs, integrations, or other technology solutions with multiple audiences and stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, compelling narratives, and practical go-to-market plans; an engineering background is not required.
  • Experience building and executing enterprise go-to-market strategies that coordinate Product, Sales or Commercial, Technical Account Management, Marketing, Creative, Communications, and Enablement teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize ambiguous, cross-functional work, establish operating discipline, manage dependencies, and drive decisions in a matrixed enterprise environment.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills, including the ability to turn complex projects into simple, decision-ready stories.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, segmentation, proof points, content strategies, readiness plans, and success metrics.
  • A people-first leadership approach and a record of building high-performing, inclusive teams and developing talent.

The ideal candidate may also have

  • Experience in Connectivity, hospitality / travel technology, or other industry specific technology ecosystem.
  • Experience driving adoption and usage across a concentrated enterprise partner base as well as a long-tail segment.
  • Experience creating scalable, modular, and self-service marketing or enablement programs alongside high-touch strategic-account motions.
  • Experience representing a company with external partners, industry experts, or technology communities.

The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $193,000.00 to $270,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $309,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Content Management

Partnerships and Public Relations

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.


Job Description

  • At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
  • A fantastic opportunity to be part of a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and engineering principles.
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide.


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide will contribute to consumer needs by architecting and delivering robust, scalable systems that power seamless digital experiences, ensuring fast, secure, and reliable services that support evolving customer expectations.


As a Senior Software Engineer (Back-End), you’ll be responsible for guiding and leading the architecture, delivery and development of the software systems that power our business unit. A hands-on, highly skilled software developer with the experience to dive into code to deliver high quality, well-designed software. You will share responsibility for the quality of the software being built, including but not limited to; achieving desired business outcomes, meeting reliability and performance expectations and safely managing security and data privacy concerns.


You'll Have

  • 6+ years in a hands-on Software Engineering role
  • Strong experience building high‑traffic backend applications
  • Working experience with back-end technologies (i.e Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Node JS) and databases (e.g PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, etc)
  • Understanding of cloud‑native development on platforms such as AWS, including deployment, scaling, and operational considerations
  • Containerisation technology concepts, such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions), version control (Git), and automated testing practices
  • Experience using observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, or similar) to support production systems
  • A real passion for quality, clean code and continuous improvement
  • Strong understanding of architectural concepts and cloud-based solution design
  • Highly dedicated ethos - expected to take very real accountability for the work you're doing
  • A test and learn mindset with curiosity, collaboration and care
  • Experience writing multi-threaded, asynchronous code
  • Experience designing and building event-driven architectures, using tools such as Kafka, SNS/SQS, or EventBridge
  • Demonstrable ability to motivate self and others, and a passion to mentor junior developers


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

job.job_description:
Company Description

Hyde Perth has recently established itself as a world class employer of choice and to be part of something special. Since the hotel’s opening in March 2026, we have been bringing the signature Hyde energy to the vibrant heart of Western Australia. This bold and stylish hotel embodies the spirit of the Hyde brand: luxurious yet laidback, sophisticated with a festival soul. 

Hyde is embracing an evolved brand identity that is all about a festival vibe with music at its core. Hyde perfectly balances an elevated bohemian-chic aesthetic with a youthful, laidback ambience. The spaces are defined by vibrant colours and are designed to encourage serendipitous connections and new discoveries around every corner. Hyde is all about the freedom and personal discovery that comes with great music, time with friends and connecting with something bigger. 

Job Description

As Events Manager, you’ll take ownership of the operational delivery of events across Hyde Perth and FARRA, ensuring every event is delivered seamlessly, safely and to an exceptional standard from set-up through to pack-down.

Working closely with the Events Sales Team, F&B Operations, Restaurant and Bar teams, you’ll be the key operational lead on event days , coordinating staff, suppliers, service, beverage requirements, event spaces and last-minute operational requirements. You’ll ensure what has been sold to the client is delivered consistently, while creating memorable guest experiences that reflect the Hyde Perth and FARRA brands.

You’ll also play an important role in the planning and execution of ticketed events, activations, seasonal experiences and brand-led events, helping to bring concepts to life through strong operational planning, team leadership and attention to detail.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Overseeing the operational delivery of events across Hyde Perth and FARRA, ensuring a smooth and high-quality guest experience from set-up through to pack-down.
  • Acting as the event lead on the day, coordinating staff, suppliers, timing, service and operational requirements.
  • Coordinating and managing event staff, including rostering, briefing, training and on-the-day supervision.
  • Ensuring all event staff are appropriately trained on service standards, menus, beverages, event procedures and guest experience expectations.
  • Managing beverage requirements, including ordering, stock preparation, delivery, set-up and reconciliation.
  • Coordinating the set-up and pack-down of event spaces, ensuring rooms are presented according to the event brief and venue standards.
  • Ensuring all event equipment, furniture, glassware, bar equipment and operational items are properly maintained, accounted for and stored correctly.
  • Working closely with the Sales Team to ensure operational delivery reflects what has been sold and agreed with the client.
  • Working closely with the F&B Operations Manager, Bar Manager and Restaurant Manager to maintain consistency in service, beverage standards and operational procedures.
  • Assisting with the planning and execution of Hyde Perth / FARRA brand events, including ticketed events, activations and seasonal experiences.
  • Supporting the development of event concepts and assisting with event planning, logistics, staffing, beverage requirements and operational run sheets.
  • Leading the operational execution of ticketed events promoted by the hotel, ensuring they are delivered to brand and guest experience standards.
  • Maintaining clear communication between Events, F&B Operations, Restaurant and Bar teams before, during and after each event.
  • Monitoring event performance on the day and proactively resolving operational issues, guest concerns and last-minute changes.
  • Ensuring all events comply with RSA, safety, responsible service and hotel operational standards.
  • Maintaining high standards of organisation, cleanliness and presentation across all event spaces and storage areas.
  • Assisting with reviewing event processes and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, service and profitability.

Qualifications

You’ll be a confident and hands-on events professional who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment. You’ll bring strong operational knowledge, excellent people skills and a genuine passion for delivering exceptional events and guest experiences.

Ideally, You’ll Have

  • Proven experience in events coordination or event management, ideally within hospitality, hotels or restaurants.
  • Strong bar and beverage knowledge, including event beverage service and stock management.
  • Demonstrated people management and leadership skills, with the ability to brief, train and motivate casual event teams.
  • Current RSA (Responsible Service of Alcohol).
  • Current Managers Red Card.
  • Excellent organisation and strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work confidently with both clients and internal operational teams.
  • A hands-on approach with the confidence to take ownership of event delivery and make decisions on the day.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and public holidays depending on the event calendar.
  • Full availability during peak season (September–March) is essential, as this is the busiest period for events.

DESIRABLE

  • Basic knowledge of iVvy for event management and function operations.
  • Basic knowledge of SevenRooms for restaurant/event reservations and guest management.
  • Experience using Purchase Plus or similar purchasing and inventory systems.
  • Previous experience working within a hotel or multi-outlet F&B operation.
  • Experience delivering ticketed events, activations and branded hospitality experiences.

Additional Information

What Is In It For You 

  • The chance to make your mark in a fast-growing Brand. 
  • Learning opportunities to broaden your skillset and development that helps you think, make, and thrive at work. 
  • An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact. 
  • The opportunity to be yourself and collaborate with other bright minds in a relaxed, innovative culture. 
  • Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands, including Accor’s Heartist (Employee) program and related benefits. 

 Hyde is an equal opportunity employer. We endeavour to select, place, train, and promote the best qualified individuals based upon job-related factors such as ability, work quality, suitability, experience, and potential.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

This team sits within Expedia Groups B2B, on the Supply Marketing team. The team helps hotels, vacation-rental businesses, airlines, and more deliver better traveler and business experiences through Expedia Group. Supply Marketing turns partner and market insight into clear stories, strategies, and programs that drive product adoption, business growth, and long-term partner value.

The Connectivity team focuses on the technology that enables external partners to connect to Expedia Group through APIs and other integrations. These partners use our capabilities to access, distribute, and improve Expedia Group travel products through their own software and services. The workstream focuses on Connectivity enterprise partners, a group of technology partners that drive significant business for Expedia Group.

Make An Impact!

Director of Product Marketing Connectivity leads a PMM team and sets the GTM standard, and aligns Product, Commercial, Technical, Marketing, and Enablement teams around enterprise partner adoption. The ideal candidate is a senior PMM leader with strong enterprise-technology experience, able to translate complex APIs and platforms into compelling narratives, scalable GTM programs, and measurable business impact.

We are looking for a Director, Product Marketing — Connectivity to lead the Product Marketing team. This leader will set the standard for how we bring complex, technical products to market and drive adoption across an enterprise partner ecosystem.

You will lead a team of product marketers across Hotel and Vacation Rental space, and serve as the strategic connector across Product, commercial account teams, technical partner teams, Partner Marketing, Creative, Communications, Field Enablement, and other functions. You will turn complex product roadmaps, platform capabilities, and partner needs into compelling stories, clear positioning, and coordinated go-to-market plans.

This is a role for a strong Product Marketing leader who understands enterprise technology and can translate API and platform concepts into business value internally and externally. Product or Engineering experience is not required.

Connectivity experience is valuable, but not required. Experience in driving sophisticated go-to-market motions in SaaS, platform, developer-tools, or other partner-led technology businesses is essential for success in this role.

In this role, you will

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Connectivity Product Marketing across the product lifecycle—from discovery and pilots through launch, adoption, usage, and advocacy.
  • Establish the standards, processes, and planning rhythms that enable the team to deliver consistent, high-quality go-to-market work at scale.
  • Lead the translation of product strategy, market opportunities, partner needs, and technical roadmaps into cohesive go-to-market architecture, with clear audiences, messages, channels, timing, and success measures.
  • Lead the team that develops compelling messaging, positioning, value propositions, proof points, use cases, FAQs, and partner stories that make complex capabilities easy to understand and act on.
  • Build integrated go-to-market plans with Product, commercial account teams, technical partner teams, Partner Marketing, Creative, Communications, Field Enablement, and other stakeholders, creating one coordinated partner experience.
  • Partner with Field Enablement on reusable sales tools and with technical partner teams on accurate integration and adoption guidance.
  • Use partner insight, market intelligence, competitive context, and performance data to improve positioning, prioritize work, influence product direction, and measure adoption and usage.
  • Represent Connectivity Product Marketing in senior leadership forums and cross-organizational planning, communicating decisions, trade-offs, risks, and results with clarity.
  • Attract, develop, and retain a high-performing team; create clarity on priorities and ownership, coach people to do their best work, and raise Product Marketing capability across the organization.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in Product Marketing, enterprise technology, product, or a related field, with 5+ years leading and developing people.
  • A track record of leading Product Marketing for complex products, platforms, APIs, integrations, or other technology solutions with multiple audiences and stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value, compelling narratives, and practical go-to-market plans; an engineering background is not required.
  • Experience building and executing enterprise go-to-market strategies that coordinate Product, Sales or Commercial, Technical Account Management, Marketing, Creative, Communications, and Enablement teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to organize ambiguous, cross-functional work, establish operating discipline, manage dependencies, and drive decisions in a matrixed enterprise environment.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills, including the ability to turn complex projects into simple, decision-ready stories.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, segmentation, proof points, content strategies, readiness plans, and success metrics.
  • A people-first leadership approach and a record of building high-performing, inclusive teams and developing talent.

The ideal candidate may also have

  • Experience in Connectivity, hospitality / travel technology, or other industry specific technology ecosystem.
  • Experience driving adoption and usage across a concentrated enterprise partner base as well as a long-tail segment.
  • Experience creating scalable, modular, and self-service marketing or enablement programs alongside high-touch strategic-account motions.
  • Experience representing a company with external partners, industry experts, or technology communities.

The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $193,000.00 to $270,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $309,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Equal Opportunity

Additional Information

Job Number 26104523

Job Category Human Resources

Location Carrer de la Marina 19-21, Barcelona, Barcelona, Spain, 08005VIEW ON MAP

Schedule Full Time

Located Remotely? N

Position Type Management

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition – Premium & Select Brands is accountable for the delivery of management recruitment across Marriott's Premium & Select portfolio within an assigned geographical region or market segment across EMEA, covering red, blue and purple banded positions.

Aligned to Regional Vice Presidents (RVPs), Area Directors of Human Resources (ADHRs) and segment leadership teams, this role serves as the primary Talent Acquisition partner for Premium & Select hotels, ensuring recruitment strategies support business performance, talent succession and future growth plans.

The role owns Executive Committee (purple banded) recruitment across the Premium & Select portfolio while leading a team of Talent Acquisition Managers responsible for red and blue banded management hiring. In addition to live vacancy recruitment, the Senior Manager is responsible for building proactive talent pipelines, supporting internal mobility and driving talent attraction strategies across the segment.

Operating within a regional recruitment pod, the role collaborates closely with:

  • Talent Acquisition Managers supporting management hiring
  • Early Careers & Events partner
  • South Africa TA Hub supporting hourly hiring
  • Talent Management teams
  • Area Directors of Human Resources
  • Regional Operations leaders

The Senior Manager acts as the strategic link between the business and Talent Acquisition, ensuring recruitment priorities align with operational goals, workforce plans and talent succession strategies.

Scope

Recruitment Strategy & Business Partnership

  • Partner with RVPs, ADHRs and hotel leadership teams to develop and execute recruitment strategies across the Premium & Select portfolio
  • Lead intake discussions for Executive Committee and management positions, aligning recruitment strategies with business priorities
  • Own recruitment delivery for Executive Committee (purple banded) positions
  • Provide guidance and consultation to stakeholders on hiring decisions, talent availability and market conditions
  • Support workforce planning discussions and future talent requirements across the portfolio
  • Act as escalation point for complex recruitment matters and critical business hires

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Talent Acquisition Managers supporting red and blue banded management hiring
  • Establish service standards and drive performance against recruitment SLAs and KPIs
  • Monitor team workload, hiring demand and recruitment performance across assigned markets
  • Support capability development through coaching, training and sharing best practices
  • Foster a collaborative and high-performing recruitment culture
  • Ensure consistent recruitment delivery and stakeholder experience across the segment

Talent Pipelining & Internal Mobility

  • Build proactive talent pipelines across key hotel disciplines including Rooms, Food & Beverage, Finance, Human Resources, Engineering, Sales & Marketing and Revenue Management
  • Partner closely with Talent Management teams to identify high-potential internal talent and succession candidates
  • Promote internal mobility opportunities across the Premium & Select portfolio
  • Support succession planning discussions through talent market insights and candidate recommendations
  • Develop strategies to improve internal movement and retention of top talent
  • Ensure balanced consideration of internal and external talent pipelines

Talent Attraction & Employer Brand

  • Develop and execute attraction strategies supporting management recruitment across the portfolio
  • Partner with Employer Brand and Marketing teams to support talent attraction campaigns
  • Utilize social media, networking and sourcing strategies to strengthen candidate pipelines
  • Support recruiting events, career fairs and talent engagement activities
  • Promote Marriott's employer value proposition across all management career levels
  • Enhance awareness of career opportunities within the Premium & Select segment

Talent Intelligence & Market Insights

  • Provide talent market intelligence and hiring insights to business leaders
  • Monitor competitor activity and market trends within hospitality and service-led industries
  • Utilize recruitment analytics to support workforce planning and decision-making
  • Produce regular reporting on recruitment performance, pipeline health and hiring activity
  • Maintain strong data integrity across Talent Acquisition systems and reporting tools

Candidate Profile

Required Experience

  • 5-7 years in Human Resources or Talent Acquisition within the EMEA region (hospitality industry preferred)
  • Extensive Talent Acquisition experience within hospitality, hotels or service-led industries
  • Proven experience recruiting Executive Committee and management-level positions
  • Experience leading recruiters or managing recruitment teams
  • Experience operating across multiple countries or markets
  • Experience building proactive talent pipelines and sourcing strategies
  • Experience partnering with senior operational and Human Resources stakeholders
  • Experience working within recruitment operations, shared-service or hub models

Success Measures

  • Reduction in overall Time to Fill across red, blue and purple banded roles
  • Increased candidate satisfaction and hiring manager satisfaction throughout the recruitment lifecycle
  • Consistent achievement or outperformance of SLA targets including:
    • Time to Slate
    • Time to Interview
    • Offer Acceptance rate
  • Strong quality of hire outcomes measured through hiring manager feedback and early retention indicators
Skills And Behaviours

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability
  • Leadership and people development skills
  • Project management and operational planning capability
  • Ability to build credibility with senior business leaders
  • Strong sourcing, talent pipelining and relationship-building skills
  • Enterprise mindset and commitment to driving business outcomes
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Digitally fluent, with strong capability in using digital platforms and social media to support engagement and outreach
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen
  • High proficiency in English is required. Additional language knowledge or proficiency is desirable.

Note: This is an EMEA regional role, and regular travel across the region will be required. In addition, when not travelling, the expectation is to be based at the Local office three days a week or as needed

At the time of application, applicants must have the legal right to work in the country in which they are based within the European Union. Unfortunately, this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

  • Collaboratively create innovative customer-facing digital product experiences with an industry leader
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As the Digital Product Analyst, you will maintain the integrity of Digital Platforms and Products within the assigned portfolio. You will work with an array of stakeholders, departments and external vendors to provide subject matter expertise on product capability, the wider squads on the delivery of enhancements and manage the day-to-day operations of their respective digital products.


To be successful in this role, you will be analytical and passionate about problem solving, review incoming product queries from business units, external organisations or customers. Director, Global Compensation

The Director, Compensation influences, advises, and leads the implementation, communication, change management, and administration of global compensation programs to support the achievement of organizational objectives, consistently and transparently. This is achieved by leveraging compensation expertise, knowledge of business objectives, and collaborating effectively with business partners, and business leaders across the business units that they support.

Please note this role is based in London and follows our flexible work model, requiring a minimum of three in-office days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Serve as an expert consultant for Expedia Group’s B2B division to support business partners and leaders on compensation-related talent matters.
  • Serve as a strategic partner on variable incentive programs, using market intelligence and internal data insights.
  • Act as the global product owner for assigned compensation programs, leading end-to-end design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement. Program scope may include market pricing, pay range review, variable incentive plan terms and conditions and pax-mix governance.
  • Run detailed analysis to review, design and develop compensation programs to better align enterprise-wide compensation structures with current industry trends and business needs.
  • Act as compensation program and content expert in guiding business partners and Business Leaders through large-scale compensation events, and ensure clarity, operational excellence, and role expectations of rollout plans.
  • Propose solutions within the Total Rewards framework for ad hoc and BAU comp research, guidance, and deliverables to stakeholders including Business Partners, Geo HR, Talent Acquisition, Mobility, etc., and align on the scope and timeliness of such asks. Examples include but are not limited to new hire offers, internal transfers, international mobility, promotions, retention moves, and any off-cycle cash/salary/equity awards.
  • Regularly analyze comp external and internal trends and both educate and convey proactive short and long-term actions.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant and progressively more responsible compensation experience.
  • Deep understanding of sales incentive and variable pay plan design, including plan mechanics, measures, governance, and alignment to business goals.
  • Demonstrated success in communicating & implementing large-scale compensation programs.
  • Strong analytical capability with an ability to independently manage analysis on advanced excel.
  • Strong executive presence with excellent presentation skills and business acumen.
  • Demonstrated success in independently driving forward initiatives of broad scope & complexity (e.g. Global and/or Business unit-wide).
  • Advanced ability to build rapport and trust with client groups to positively influence decisions and actions at the highest levels of senior leadership.
  • Excellent understanding of business needs and how to leverage compensation expertise to meet those needs while demonstrating flexibility and adaptability.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

The Search Product & Optimization team at Expedia Group sits within the Marketing division and is responsible for the algorithmic intelligence behind our global marketing investments. We operate in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, participating in millions of auctions daily across Search, Metasearch and Social platforms. Our mission is to build scalable, data-driven systems that optimize how we acquire traffic. We are moving beyond manual operations to develop an autonomous bidding system that dynamically allocates investment to maximize business value.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the bidding product domain end-to-end. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Data Science, Engineering and Marketing Management, you will be the single point of accountability for the strategy, roadmap and delivery of the platforms that decide how, where and how much we bid. You will set the vision for an ecosystem that hosts decision logic and executes using self-correcting automation.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plan for Expedia Group’s bidding platform across search engine marketing, metasearch, and other performance channels.
  • Lead the development of an autonomous bidding system, prioritizing capabilities such as target-aware models, control systems, elasticity measurement, and partner connectivity to maximize long-term business value against financial goals.
  • Define how bidding decisions are made, executed, and monitored by creating transparent, auditable, and scalable product experiences that build stakeholder trust.
  • Partner closely with scientists, engineers, marketing leaders, and other cross-functional stakeholders to make thoughtful trade-offs across innovation, production stability, and platform health.
  • Establish the metrics and operating cadences that measure bidding performance, platform reliability, adoption, and operational efficiency, and turn those insights into clear product priorities.
  • Use systems thinking and clear storytelling to align leaders and partners around complex problem spaces, build feedback loops into releases and migrations, and continuously improve performance at scale.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, a quantitative field, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • You have 7+ years of product management experience owning technical or platform products end-to-end, from early concept through scaled adoption, including product strategy, roadmap development, and go-to-market planning.
  • You have an advanced understanding of machine learning and marketing technology, and you can partner credibly with scientists and engineers on optimization, experimentation, elasticity, orchestration, and algorithm-driven decision systems.
  • You are deeply data-driven and know how to define meaningful metrics, understand their relationships, and translate analysis into clear product decisions and stakeholder alignment.
  • You are a systems thinker who can work across functions to define complex problem spaces, identify the drivers of desired outcomes, and design ways to measure the impact of change across an interconnected ecosystem.
  • You are an influential communicator with a strong interest in advertising technology, bidding markets, auctions, automation, and decision systems, and you are energized by ambiguity and turning business goals into solvable product problems.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Additional Information

Job Number26119249

Job CategoryRooms & Guest Services Operations

Location77 NE Interstate 410 Loop, San Antonio, Texas, United States, 78216 VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $80,000 - $90,000

Expiration Date: 10/31/2026

Additional Information: This hotel is owned and operated by an independent franchisee, Scenic Capital Advisors. The franchisee is a separate company and a separate employer from Marriott International, Inc. The franchisee solely controls all aspects of the hotel’s employment policies and practices, including hiring, firing, discipline, staffing, compensation, benefits, and all other terms and conditions of employment. If you accept a position at this hotel, you will be employed by a franchisee and not by Marriott International, Inc.

Job Summary

Seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Director of Operations to oversee our 360 room, high-volume airport property.

Plan and manage the operations areas of the hotel to achieve customer (guests, Associates, Management Company and owners) satisfaction and quality service while meeting/exceeding financial goals.

Position is responsible for short and long-term planning and day-to-day operations of the operational areas. Recommends the area's budget and manages expenses within approved budget constraints. The major areas of responsibility/management include: revenue, front office, Great Room, and housekeeping. Participates in total hotel management as a member of the hotel executive committee.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned):

  • Implement company programs (brand and Management Company) and manage the operational departments to ensure an optimal level of quality service and hospitality are provided to the hotel customers.
  • Prepare forecasts and reports and assist in the development, implementation and monitoring of the budget to maximize revenue and minimize expenses while ensuring adequate supplies and staff are on hand to provide top quality customer service.
  • Resolve customer complaints; anticipate potential problems by reviewing and monitoring complaints, operational issues, business flow and Associate performance to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and quality.
  • Manage the human resources in the department in order to attract, retain and motivate the Associates; hire, train, develop, empower, coach and counsel, conduct performance and salary reviews, resolve problems, provide open communication vehicles, discipline and terminate, as appropriate.
  • Liaison with the sales staff to discuss and implement sales strategies to continually improve occupancy levels and revenues.
  • Implement emergency organization procedures and training to ensure appropriate protection for hotel guests, staff and company assets.
  • Serve as hotel resource in other areas as necessary based on previous experience.
  • Assumes the responsibilities of the General Manager in his/her absence.
  • Perform special projects and other responsibilities as assigned. Participate in task forces and committees as requested.
  • Maintain good working relationships and open lines of communication with all other departments.
  • Acts as liaison and consultant for leased operation to assure they meet hotel brand, ownership and guest expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Direct supervisory responsibilities for Front Desk Manager, H/K Executive, and Revenue Coordinator. Indirect supervisory responsibility for all hourly Associates that report to above listed managers.
  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
  • Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training Associates, planning, assigning, and directing work, appraising performance, rewarding and disciplining Associates, addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Qualifications

  • Requires advanced knowledge of the principles and practices within the hospitality industry. This includes experiential knowledge required for management of people and complex problems.
  • Ability to study, analyze and interpret complex activities and/or information in order to improve new practices or develop new approaches.
  • Ability to make decisions with only general policies and procedures available for guidance.
  • Supervisory/management skills.
  • Must possess communication skills in terms of the ability to negotiate, convince, sell and influence professionals and/or hotel guests.

Education And/Or Experience

  • Four year college degree or equivalent education/experience. From two to three full years of full time employment in a related position with this hotel or other hotel companies.

Language Skills

  • Excellent speech communication skills are required to communicate both in person and via telephone with guests, Associates and corporate contacts in a professional and extensive manner.
  • Excellent literacy is required. Must be able to both assimilate and generate explicit and concise documents for publication within the hotel and management company environment. Bilingual preferred.

Mathematical Skills

  • Ability to calculate amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.
  • Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

REASONING ABILITY

  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram or schedule form.
  • Must be able to use appropriate judgments as it pertains to supervisory duties.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS – Not applicable

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Practice written safety standards and rules at all times. Lifting, pushing, pulling and carrying - must be able to accomplish any task required of Associates within assigned departments.
  • Bending/kneeling - must be able to accomplish any task required of Associates within assigned departments.

HOURS

  • Due to the business demands of the hospitality industry, and the fact that the hotel provides guest services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, any Associate may be required to work rotating shifts, including weekends, night shifts, and/or overtime.

Medical, Dental, Vision, paid Holidays and Vacation and Hotel Room Discounts.

This company is an equal opportunity employer.

Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.


Job Description

  • At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
  • A fantastic opportunity to lead a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and engineering principles.
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide.


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide by ensuring consumer needs are met, guiding the development of high-quality, scalable digital solutions that deliver real customer value, leveraging deep technical expertise and strategic alignment with user-centric goals.


The Software Technical Lead oversees a technical domain and manages the engineers within it, combining deep software development expertise with leadership responsibilities. They guide teams through the full development lifecycle—from problem discovery and system design to deployment and maintenance of live code. While involved in day-to-day delivery, they also focus on strategic planning and team leadership. Collaborating closely with Product Managers, they ensure software solutions deliver strong business and customer value aligned with strategic goals. Beyond their immediate teams, they contribute to the organisation’s broader technical vision and operational effectiveness as part of the Engineering and Delivery Leadership teams, helping shape the direction of digital products and services across the enterprise. .


You’ll Have

  • 10+ years’ experience in systems development and 3+ years in technology development leadership roles
  • Strong experience building and operating high‑traffic, customer‑facing web platforms
  • Strong in Java and Node JS for backend services and APIs, with modern frameworks and patterns
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript with deep experience in React.js, Next.js and modern frontend architectures
  • Experience designing scalable, resilient distributed systems, including API‑first and event‑driven approaches
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP), including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience using observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, or similar) to support production systems
  • Passionate about clean code, quality, and continuous improvement with strong accountability
  • Ability to recommend frameworks, libraries, and tools that improve performance and scalability
  • Demonstrated ability to motivate and mentor developers, fostering team growth
  • Experienced in collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong influencing skills


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on the 5th of October


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

At Expedia Group, performance is product quality. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Performance to define and lead the strategy for improving user-perceived performance across our traveler facing experiences, while building the systems, operating model, and guardrails needed to prevent regressions before they reach travelers.

In this role, you will partner across engineering, architecture, product, UX, analytics, experimentation, and platform teams to make performance measurable, actionable, and durable. You will own the product vision and roadmap for performance across web and app, balancing near-term experience improvements with longer-term investments in instrumentation, diagnostics, release protections, and performance-by-default product development practices.

You will help Expedia Group deliver faster, more stable, and more resilient experiences for travelers by ensuring teams can understand performance, prioritize the right improvements, and prevent degradation at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for performance across web and native app experiences.
  • Establish a clear performance product vision spanning page and screen load speed, interaction responsiveness, visual stability, reliability of measurement, and degradation prevention.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to identify and prioritize platform and product investments that improve performance at scale.
  • Own the performance measurement framework across web and app, including headline metrics, driver metrics, and guardrail metrics that help teams make better prioritization decisions.
  • Lead discovery across stakeholder groups to identify root causes of poor user experience, quantify business impact, and translate findings into roadmap priorities.
  • Drive adoption of performance standards, budgets, and release guardrails that reduce regressions and improve consistency across teams.
  • Shape the operating model for performance reviews, regression triage, escalation paths, and accountability for remediation.
  • Partner with experimentation and analytics teams to evaluate how product, content, and feature changes affect performance and traveler outcomes.

  • Experience owning products through discovery, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives across multiple product, engineering, and platform teams, influencing roadmaps and driving alignment without direct authority.
  • Strong technical product management experience, with the ability to partner closely with engineering teams on complex technical challenges.
  • Deep understanding of web and/or mobile application performance, including performance measurement, observability, monitoring, diagnostics, release protections, and performance regression prevention.
  • Experience using data, analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to evaluate impact and make informed product decisions and trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups in a global organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application performance, developer productivity, platform products, infrastructure, developer tools, or similarly technical domains.
  • Experience establishing performance standards, budgets, guardrails, governance models, escalation processes, and accountability mechanisms across multiple teams.
  • Experience building frameworks, playbooks, or operating models that drive quality, reliability, and performance improvements at scale.
  • Experience working on data-intensive products and translating complex technical metrics into actionable product insights.
  • Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or prior hands-on software development experience.
  • Proven track record of taking products from concept through scaled adoption and measurable business impact.
  • Experience using experimentation and analytics to understand how product and feature changes affect customer experience and business outcomes.

Location 11 Quai de Dion Bouton, Puteaux, Hauts-de-Seine, France, 92800VIEW ON MAP

Position Type Management

Job Summary

The Vice President will oversee a small team of development executives based in Paris and will be responsible for leading the development of all Marriott’s brands in France, Belgium, Netherlands and Luxembourg as well as for the development of a strategic development/action plan for the France and Benelux markets.

Encompassing both the management of a team and working on transactions, the Vice President will oversee the identification and pursuit of new business opportunities and will coordinate a multi-disciplinary team involved in the review, approval and finalization of contracts for new hotels.

Success in the position demands a driving focus on creation of shareholder value through the pursuit of new projects, a proactive disposition, a willingness to champion new business opportunities, exemplary relationship skills, an enthusiasm for overseeing a small, focused team and a passion for the work we do.

SCOPE / BUSINESS CONTEXT

  • Full time position based at Marriott’s Paris development office.
  • The addition of new hotels is one of the principal drivers of Marriott’s earnings growth and an important element in progressing the product quality, operating excellence, distribution power and brand equity of Marriott’s lodging system. The company’s unit growth strategy in Europe focuses on management contracts and, primarily, on licensing our hotel brands to third party owners and operators under franchise agreements. The Vice President of Development performs a central, critical role in overseeing a small team responsible for identifying, generating and structuring deals and successfully closing on opportunities (newbuild, conversion and adaptive reuse) for new hotels, and building win-win relationships with new and existing hotel owners and franchisees.
  • The Vice President will be Marriott’s most senior development representative in the France and Benelux market and will be a critical ambassador for the company.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Experience

  • Ten years of business experience in the real estate or hotel industries with at least five years of hotel advisory/development or related experience.
  • Experience with managed and franchised hotel transactions in France and Benelux.
  • Strong contact base and excellent reputation in the hotel investment and development sector.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively structure and negotiate complex transactions, handle multiple projects on short timetables, and manage staff resources efficiently and effectively.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Best in class management capability, with a focus on building and maintaining a trusted relationship with the current team of France and Benelux development executives.
  • Excellent organisation, communication (verbal, listening, writing), coaching, mentoring, negotiation and mediation skills.
  • Long established working knowledge of the France and Benelux hotel market.
  • Exemplary inter-personal skills and capability of both building lasting and trusting internal/external relationships and “selling” Marriott’s brands to third parties.
  • Demonstrated track record and ability to effectively understand hotel transactions (both franchised and managed); handle multiple projects on short timetables; and manage team members and other resources efficiently.
  • Enthusiastic, energetic, proactive outlook and approach to professional life is essential.
  • An ability to work in a team environment with a small but diverse team is critical.
  • Flexibility to travel within France, Benelux and elsewhere, often at short notice.
  • Mature, professional demeanour, capable of expressing confident, independent judgment.

Education or Certification

  • University degree in Real Estate, Hotel Administration, Business Administration or similar (MBA or other advanced degree preferred but not essential).
  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken). Dutch would be a plus.

SPECIFIC DUTIES

The following are specific responsibilities and contributions critical to the successful performance of the position:

  • Manage and motivate a small team of development executives based in Paris and responsible for the growth of Marriott’s brands in Benelux.
  • Oversee the Paris development office (supplies, lease renewals, discussions with landlord etc).
  • Work closely with other groups within Marriot in order to gain the necessary internal support for the team’s projects.
  • Develop and maintain a strong network of contacts in the France/Benelux/international hotel and real estate development and investment sector.
  • Proactively identify, initiate, and assess potential owners, investors, white label operators, developers and local authorities for branding opportunities.
  • Continue to help drive the brand marketing and awareness of MI’s brands across France and Benelux to ensure Marriott’s brands are increasingly established in the marketplace over the short to mid-term.
  • Review and analyse potential hotel conversions and new build opportunities, for integration into Marriott’s brands.
  • Develop the appropriate business relationship with potential owners, capital providers and partners and local authorities, in order to build loyalty and preference for our company and brands.
  • Coordinate all aspects of the internal development process at Marriott, including presentations, site inspections, market feasibility studies, valuations, legal contract negotiations and presenting opportunities for approval by the appropriate Marriott committees.
  • Lead negotiations of management, franchise and/or other agreements with owner/owner's representatives.
  • As needed, assist owners, white label operators and developers to identify sources of financing for hotel acquisition or construction.
  • Attendance at (and presentation to) relevant hospitality events and establishment/maintenance of a high profile within the industry in France and Benelux and internationally.
  • Performs other duties as appropriate related to enhancing Marriott’s growth in France and Benelux and EMEA.

Other

  • Performs other related tasks as assigned by management.
  • Complies with Marriott International Hotels Limited Continent Office policies and procedures.

• Be a part a large-scale program of work that has high visibility across the business
  • Permanent role based at our Head Office in Mascot
  • Help shape the future of Qantas and deliver exceptional value to our customers


At Qantas, we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive. We take pride in solving complex challenges together, supporting each other, and delivering safe and reliable operations for our customers. You’ll be part of a team that values initiative, collaboration and continuous improvement.


As a Technical Product Owner, you'll drive technology transformation at the heart of our frontline operations. You'll provide a single point of accountability for the products, platforms, and services that empower our airport and cabin crew teams, from employee-facing digital experiences through to the backend systems and integrations that keep operations running seamlessly.


Working across multiple delivery teams and vendor partners, and collaborating closely with Product Owners, fellow Technical Product Owners, and business stakeholders, you'll translate strategic priorities into outcome-focused technology roadmaps that simplify processes, remove operational friction, and enable our frontline teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences.


You'll be a true business partner and technology leader, confident in communicating, influencing, and negotiating with both business stakeholders and purely technical team members to deliver products that are secure, resilient, and built for impact. You'll bring strong product management capabilities and a service delivery mindset, with accountability for service quality and operational stability, including IT risk and compliance management, continuous service improvement and innovation, and supplier performance.


You’ll Have

  • 7–10 years' experience as a senior IT business partner and/or IT manager, accountable for a portfolio of business-facing, operational applications, with end-to-end accountability across application delivery, implementation, and run.
  • Expert stakeholder management across both business and technical functions, building and maintaining trusted relationships.
  • Equally comfortable engaging software engineers on technical architecture and documentation and explaining that detail in clear, plain language to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong financial management, commercial and business acumen.


Why Qantas?

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time.


You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging for everything from motor vehicles to electronic devices.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether its learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Advertising closes on 5th October


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

The Search Product & Optimization team at Expedia Group sits within the Marketing division and is responsible for the algorithmic intelligence behind our global marketing investments. We operate in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, participating in millions of auctions daily across Search, Metasearch and Social platforms. Our mission is to build scalable, data-driven systems that optimize how we acquire traffic. We are moving beyond manual operations to develop an autonomous bidding system that dynamically allocates investment to maximize business value.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the bidding product domain end-to-end. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Data Science, Engineering and Marketing Management, you will be the single point of accountability for the strategy, roadmap and delivery of the platforms that decide how, where and how much we bid. You will set the vision for an ecosystem that hosts decision logic and executes using self-correcting automation.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market plan for Expedia Group’s bidding platform across search engine marketing, metasearch, and other performance channels.
  • Lead the development of an autonomous bidding system, prioritizing capabilities such as target-aware models, control systems, elasticity measurement, and partner connectivity to maximize long-term business value against financial goals.
  • Define how bidding decisions are made, executed, and monitored by creating transparent, auditable, and scalable product experiences that build stakeholder trust.
  • Partner closely with scientists, engineers, marketing leaders, and other cross-functional stakeholders to make thoughtful trade-offs across innovation, production stability, and platform health.
  • Establish the metrics and operating cadences that measure bidding performance, platform reliability, adoption, and operational efficiency, and turn those insights into clear product priorities.
  • Use systems thinking and clear storytelling to align leaders and partners around complex problem spaces, build feedback loops into releases and migrations, and continuously improve performance at scale.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, a quantitative field, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • You have 7+ years of product management experience owning technical or platform products end-to-end, from early concept through scaled adoption, including product strategy, roadmap development, and go-to-market planning.
  • You have an advanced understanding of machine learning and marketing technology, and you can partner credibly with scientists and engineers on optimization, experimentation, elasticity, orchestration, and algorithm-driven decision systems.
  • You are deeply data-driven and know how to define meaningful metrics, understand their relationships, and translate analysis into clear product decisions and stakeholder alignment.
  • You are a systems thinker who can work across functions to define complex problem spaces, identify the drivers of desired outcomes, and design ways to measure the impact of change across an interconnected ecosystem.
  • You are an influential communicator with a strong interest in advertising technology, bidding markets, auctions, automation, and decision systems, and you are energized by ambiguity and turning business goals into solvable product problems.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership.
