  • Permanent role based at our Head Office in Mascot
  • Help shape the future of Qantas and deliver exceptional value to our customers 

At Qantas, we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive. We take pride in solving complex challenges together, supporting each other, and delivering safe and reliable operations for our customers. You’ll be part of a team that values initiative, collaboration and continuous improvement.

As a Technical Product Owner, Airline Operations you’ll drive technology transformation at the heart of our airline operations! The role is required to lead transformation of Crew planning, rostering and tracking capabilities and data enablement for workforce planning.

The portfolio includes legacy platforms that are decades old and due for modernisation, alongside emerging AI and automation opportunities that will reshape how these business areas operate. The Technical Product Owner (TPO) role works closely with various senior business stakeholders to provide a single point of accountability across the technology lifecycle of Plan, Build and Run for an assigned set of business capabilities and products, as well as their underlying technology components. Relationships with business and external key stakeholders are fundamental to coordinating activity across multiple requirements, critical dependencies, technology imperatives, and functional outcomes.

With Technology undertaking an ambitious 5 year strategic plan, the TPO will play an essential role in developing and driving the roadmaps that will underpin the business strategy. The TPO will provide counsel to senior stakeholders, ensuring that – with technology so readily available – focus is retained on the alignment between technology and business strategies. In line with this the TPO will be pivotal in the customer product led operating model accountable for the technology products which comprises of numerous technology applications and management of suppliers.

You’ll Have

  • 7–10 years' experience as a senior IT business partner and/or IT manager, accountable for a portfolio of business-facing, operational applications, with end-to-end accountability across application delivery, implementation, and run.
  • Experience within Airline Operations preferred
  • Experience within complex legacy modernisation in critical sectors (e.g., airlines, defence, healthcare) preferred
  • Expert stakeholder management across both business and technical functions, building and maintaining trusted relationships.
  • Strong Commercial acumen, supplier management skills
  • Effective stakeholder management both across Qantas business units, and external vendors.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver excellent product outcomes, aligned with the technology strategy

Why Qantas?  

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. 

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.  

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.  

  • We love to travel: Enjoy discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.  
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.   
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging for everything from motor vehicles to electronic devices.  
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether its learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.  

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. 

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today. 

Applications will close by Sunday the 20th of Spetember

Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Associate Market Manager

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Make an impact!

As an Associate Market Manager, you will coach and support partners to be more successful on Expedia Group’s platform, increasing value through comprehensive commercial conversations and day-to-day interactions. You will begin building relationships with partners, develop your commercial and account management skills, and help partners identify opportunities to improve performance. This role will support the New Jersey seasonal markets and follows a mostly in-office hybrid schedule of three days per week in our Boston office, with one week in market per quarter. This role is ideal for someone who is energized by relationship-building, curious about partner success, and motivated to grow their commercial capabilities in a dynamic environment.

In This Role, You Will

  • Begin developing relationships with partners or their account teams, including key buyers and decision-makers
  • Assist in creating opportunities such as progress meetings and exploratory conversations to help grow partner accounts
  • Develop an understanding of partner business issues through the appropriate internal channels
  • Recommend products, services, and insights that meet partner needs
  • Complete basic account plans that outline tactics to acquire and maintain business
  • Build a basic understanding of how the department operates and how it fits into the larger organization
  • Develop awareness of the policies, practices, trends, and competitor information that impact the organization and its partners
  • Develop a basic understanding of the financial impact of decisions and solutions on the organization and its partners
  • Guide accounts to valuable insights and present findings that can benefit both the account and the organization
  • Gather data and information on potential ideas and solutions to address business needs
  • Document components of a business case for change at the direction of more senior colleagues, when needed
  • Develop a working knowledge of the company’s standard contract terms and conditions by reading product literature, contracts, and learning from peers
  • Learn when to partner with legal resources to modify or adjust standard contract terms
  • Learn the contract negotiation process and how to complete contractual arrangements
  • Exchange simple information in straightforward situations to gain the support of others
  • Proactively seek help from a manager when needed to address differences and ensure alignment among all parties
  • Assist in conducting straightforward cost, benefit, and risk analyses of possible solutions and the implications of not reaching agreement
  • Identify the key stakeholders involved in account decision-making
  • Develop understanding of standard offerings and major areas of expertise
  • Build a working knowledge of products, technologies, and offerings within scope of responsibility
  • Develop a broad understanding of competitors’ standard products and services
  • Understand the value and application of products, technologies, and offerings for accounts and the organization
  • Build rapport and maintain ongoing business relationships with colleagues and external partners
  • Learn about partner leaders and decision-makers through internal partner relationship management systems
  • Develop a basic understanding of the partner’s industry and competitive market, using company tools to access market-specific insights
  • Attend partner meetings to better understand needs and expectations
  • Learn the metrics used to assess the performance of products, services, and solutions against partner needs
  • Develop key value proposition statements, case studies, and proof points to demonstrate the value of the company’s products, services, and solutions

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 0–2 years of relevant experience
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • You are a proficient communicator who can build rapport and share information clearly, tailored to different communication styles
  • You are developing your knowledge of sales techniques and commercial conversations
  • Some account management experience is preferred
  • You are comfortable learning from data, partner interactions, and business context to identify opportunities
  • You are interested in building your understanding of contracts, negotiation, and partner success

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You enjoy building relationships and supporting partners in achieving stronger results
  • You are curious, coachable, and motivated to grow your commercial and account management skills
  • You can balance structured account support with thoughtful, partner-focused communication
  • You are comfortable learning new products, tools, and market insights and applying them in partner conversations
  • You bring a collaborative mindset and know when to ask for help to move work forward
  • You are motivated by helping partners see value in the platform and strengthen their partnership with Expedia Group

The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in Boston is $77,500.00 to $108,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $124,000.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Equal Opportunity

Job Summary

Responsible for managing and organizing the reservations department and responsible for implementing the reservation sales strategy and achieving segment revenue goals, property revenue goals and guest and employee satisfaction. Leads and manages all day-to-day activities related to the reservation sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of reservations sales objectives. Achieves personal booking goals and makes recommendations on booking goals of direct reports. Focuses on continuous improvements through the reduction of defects, increasing guest satisfaction and maximizing profitability.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Developing & Executing Sales Strategies

  • Works with sales leaders to ensure understanding of sales strategy and effective implementation of this strategy for reservations sales.
  • Develops, implements and sustains aggressive solicitation program focused on increasing business.
  • Works with management team to create and implement a sales plan addressing revenue, customers and the market for the segment led by the DOS.
  • Assists with the development and implementation of promotions, both internal and external.

Maximizing Revenue

  • Provides positive and aggressive leadership to ensure maximum revenue potential (e.g., sets example with personal booking goals).
  • Recommends booking goals for reservations sales team members.

Managing Reservations Sales Activities

  • Monitors all day to day activities of direct reports.
  • Participates in sales calls with members of reservations sales team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
  • Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
  • Ensures that the communications switchboard is attended to at all times and that sufficient staffing is present to meet the needs of daily business demands.
  • Ensures that telephone, walkie-talkie and hand phone equipment is properly managed and maintained.
  • Maintains room inventory availability and all financial aspect of room inventory.

Analyzing & Reporting on Sales and Financial Data

  • Analyzes market information by using sales systems and implements strategy to achieve property’s financial room and catering goals.
  • Assists Revenue Management with completing accurate six period projections, implementing rate restrictions, controlling of bookings, and critiquing of trends.
  • Reviews sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas of improvement.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

  • Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies customer service and creates a positive example for guest relations.
  • Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
  • Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
  • Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
  • Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of department meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ensures that a customer recognition program is in effect throughout Reservations Sales.
  • Executes and supports customer service standards and property’s brand standards.
  • Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and ensuring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
  • Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to the company.
  • Gains understanding of the property’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Develops and manages relationships with key stakeholders, both internal and external.
  • Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., , Market Sales, GSO) to ensure the property needs are being achieved and the sales efforts are complementary, not duplicative.
  • Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to ensure compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.
  • Attends customer events, trade shows and sales missions to maintain, build or develop key relationships with GSO Managers and customers.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

  • Interviews and hires management and hourly employees with the appropriate skills to meet the business needs of the operation.
  • Develops, implements and maintains a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
  • Utilizes all available on the job training tools for employees.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Shape the future of aviation by leading the procurement, trading and lifecycle strategy of one of the industry's largest and most complex fleet portfolios.
  • Influence enterprise-wide decisions at the highest level, partnering with senior executives and global aerospace leaders to deliver long-term commercial value.
  • Full-time permanent role based at Mascot, Sydney.

At Qantas, we're shaping the future of aviation through one of the most ambitious fleet renewal and growth programs in the industry. We are seeking an exceptional aviation executive to lead our aircraft procurement, fleet trading and asset lifecycle strategy across the Qantas Group.

As Head of Fleet Procurement & Aircraft Trading, you'll be responsible for driving the commercial strategy and execution of aircraft acquisition, trading, leasing and disposal activities across a fleet portfolio of approximately 340 aircraft. This is a unique opportunity to influence enterprise-wide decisions, lead negotiations with the world's largest aerospace manufacturers, and deliver significant value outcomes for one of Australia's most iconic brands.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the Group's long-term fleet procurement and aircraft trading strategy.
  • Lead the Group's acquisition, trading, leasing and fleet phase-out activities with airframe and engine OEMs, lessors and aircraft trading partners.
  • Provide strategic advice and recommendations to senior executives on fleet investment, asset valuation and commercial risks.
  • Own the full lifecycle of the Group's major airframe and engine purchase agreements – structuring, negotiating, executing and amending, as required, and managing contractual obligations and commercial outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional teams across Finance, Treasury, Engineering, Commercial, Legal and Strategy.
  • Develop high-performing teams and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability and commercial excellence.
  • Drive sustainable value creation through innovative procurement and asset management approaches.

About You

We're looking for a commercially astute leader with deep aviation industry expertise and a proven track record delivering large-scale aircraft fleet procurement and asset management outcomes.

You'll Bring

  • Extensive experience leading aircraft procurement and/or aircraft trading activities.
  • Demonstrated success structuring, negotiating and executing complex, high-value commercial transactions, including major aircraft and engine purchases.
  • Strong contract discipline with a proven track record managing major aircraft and engine purchase agreements within an airline, lessor or OEM.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including fleet economics, asset valuation and business case development.
  • Experience influencing executive stakeholders and presenting recommendations at Board or Executive level.
  • Exceptional leadership capabilities with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams.
  • Outstanding stakeholder management and relationship-building skills across global and culturally diverse environments.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Ready to shape the future of our fleet? Apply now.

Applications close: Thursday 15 October 2026

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Financial Operations Analyst, B2B Finance Operations

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services, helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

The B2B Finance Operations team supports the accurate and efficient movement of partner-related financial transactions across our marketplace. This role sits within the Financial Operations job family, which supports transactional commission payments, partner payment operations, and the resolution of financial transaction and system issues across teams and lines of business.

Make an Impact

As a Senior Financial Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring our B2B partner commission payment operations run smoothly, accurately, and at scale. You will work across internal teams and external partners to resolve complex payment issues, improve operational processes, and strengthen financial controls in support of a fast-moving global business.

In This Role, You Will

  • Manage and optimize day-to-day B2B finance operations activities related to partner payments and transaction processing
  • Investigate and resolve complex payment, reconciliation, and settlement issues across systems, teams, and external partners
  • Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps, and improvement opportunities
  • Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Partner Operations, Product, Technology, and commercial teams to improve processes and reduce friction in the partner payment experience
  • Support escalations, reporting, and operational controls to help ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance in financial transactions
  • Contribute to process documentation, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement initiatives that improve scale, quality, and partner experience

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of experience in finance operations or accounting
  • You have experience working with high-volume transactional processes, journal entries, reconciliations, exception management, and issue resolution
  • You have experience with general ledger accounting and SOX compliance
  • You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable using data to investigate issues, identify patterns, and recommend practical solutions
  • You communicate clearly and effectively with both internal stakeholders and external partners, including when managing escalations
  • You are highly organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • You have experience improving operational processes, strengthening controls, and helping teams work more efficiently
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Accounting (preferred) or Finance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior Public Accounting experience
  • You have experience supporting B2B partner payment operations in a travel, marketplace, ecommerce, or global payments environment
  • You have experience working with financial systems, reporting tools, or large transactional datasets
  • You are comfortable working across global teams and navigating ambiguity while maintaining strong judgment and accountability
  • You have experience participating in cross-functional projects involving operational change, systems enhancement, or automation

What Makes This Opportunity Exciting

This role offers the chance to work at the intersection of finance operations, partner experience, and global travel commerce. You will help power the financial operations behind Expedia Group’s B2B marketplace while influencing how we scale partner payments, solve operational challenges, and deliver a better experience for our partners around the world.

Job Summary

Functions as the strategic business leader of rooms operations and acts as General Manager in his/her absence. Areas of responsibility include Front Office, , Retail/Gift Shops, Recreation/Fitness Center, Housekeeping and Security/Loss Prevention. Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures the rooms operations meet the brand’s target customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Property Operations

  • Working with Rooms management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
  • Reviewing comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
  • Evaluating if Operations Team is meeting service needs and provides feedback to operations team.
  • Participating in public space walk-throughs with Engineering and Housekeeping to ensure guest rooms, public space and back of the house areas are well maintained and preventative maintenance processes are in place.
  • Touring building on a regular basis speaking with employees and guests to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
  • Reviewing findings from comment cards and guest satisfaction results with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
  • Working with team to put sustainable work processes and systems in place that support the execution of the strategy.
  • Reviewing reports and financial statements to determine Rooms operations performance against budget.
  • Communicating a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

Leading Operations Teams

  • Ensuring employees are treated fairly and equitably.
  • Celebrating successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
  • Fostering employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
  • Making and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

Managing Relationships with Property Stakeholders

  • Attending owners meetings and provides meaning or context to the rooms operational and financial results.
  • Establishing relationship with owner as a business partnership and supports the relationship between the General Manager and the owner.

Managing Profitability

  • Coaching and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
  • Working with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establish ways to improve the departments’ financial performance.
  • Leading cost containment efforts within Rooms operations including organizational restructuring when necessary.
  • Focusing on maintaining profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.
  • Identifying key drivers of business success and keeping Rooms leadership focused on the critical few to achieve results.

Managing The Guest Experience

  • Creating an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.
  • Championing the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the Rooms leadership teams.

job.job_description:
• At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers
  • A fantastic opportunity to lead and coach a squad to deliver world class products
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As the Product Manager, you will be responsible for designing, developing and leading the product strategy and roadmap for a specified product portfolio and ensuring the delivery of exceptional customer experience. You will be involved in analysing trends, identifying new product opportunities, and ensuring strategic alignment with commercial and customer imperatives.

As part of this role, you will synthesize customer insights and human-centred design to drive product initiatives and enhancements that improve the portfolios overall product offering and customer satisfaction.


Furthermore, you will drive collaboration and provide advice and counsel on general product portfolio strategy and customer experience to Senior Leaders from across the Qantas Group, including guidance and recommendations on the customer service proposition, revenue generation opportunities and commercial decisions.


You’ll have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with Digital experience essential.
  • Knowledge and experience in the airline industry or with booking systems is preferred.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Commerce, Technology, Marketing or relevant qualifications / experience.
  • Product Management experience and skills – including strategic thinking and analytical thinking, a customer centric mindset, familiarity with Human Centred Design, research and insights, business requirements and prioritisation, comfortable with Agile and Scrum methodologies, and Business Model Canvas framework.
  • Effective team leadership experience – you are someone who enjoys contributing to strong team dynamics and culture.
  • Experience leading an Agile software development squad, working closely with a cross-functional team of business analysts, software engineers and designers.
  • The ability to influence key stakeholders to achieve strategic outcomes.
  • Effective collaboration, communication and presentation skills to provide advice to various stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated organisational expertise, with the ability to work within a complex organisation and group policy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.


Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.


Applications close on the 5th of October

Introduction to the team

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Creative Strategist to lead the development of high-impact creative assets and channel strategies across paid social, display, programmatic, and related performance assets. This role blends creative excellence with strategic depth - not only ensuring campaigns look exceptional and drive measurable business outcomes, but also shaping how we show up on the platforms where our audiences live.

As a key connector between Integrated Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative teams, you will connect upstream business objectives and brand priorities to downstream creative output - ensuring nothing gets lost in translation between the brief and the asset. Equally important, you will partner with the Creative Director and tech platform partners to develop innovative creative programs and first-to-market opportunities that give us a competitive edge. With a strong creative strategy background, in-house experience, and the ability to manage agencies and internal designers, you'll bring structure, collaboration, and strategic ambition to our performance creative function. Above all, you'll be focused on driving creative performance results.

In This Role, You Will Focus On

Creative Strategy & Development

  • Lead creative strategy for paid performance channels including Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Display, and Paid Search - with a point of view on how each channel should be used distinctively, not interchangeably
  • Connect upstream business objectives and brand priorities to downstream creative output, ensuring nothing gets lost in translation between the brief and the asset
  • Develop channel-specific creative strategies that reflect deep platform knowledge, audience behavior, and format innovation
  • Ensure creative aligns with brand identity while meeting channel-specific performance best practices
  • Present creative strategy recommendations and performance insights to cross-functional partners and leadership

Platform Partnerships & Innovation

  • Build channel-native creative and unlock value-add innovation with platform studios - Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest - ensuring EG shows up with intention within those ecosystems
  • Proactively identify and develop creative opportunities through platform betas, funded innovation programs, creator ecosystems, and AI capabilities that accelerate EG's creative transformation
  • Represent the brand in platform conversations, bringing internal briefs and business objectives to the table and returning with bespoke opportunities that unlock value
  • Partner with Growth and Brand teams to pilot first-to-market formats, translate platform learnings into scalable playbooks, and ensure EG is consistently positioned as a preferred creative partner
  • Stay ahead of platform roadmaps, algorithm shifts, and creative product launches to influence our strategy before trends become table stakes

Creative Production

  • Collaborate with in-house designers, copywriters, and external agencies to bring ideas to life with creative excellence and performance alignment
  • Oversee end-to-end production of creative assets including static, motion, video, creator/UGC, and app store visuals
  • Maintain creative asset libraries to support efficient versioning, localization, and testing processes

Performance Optimization

  • Partner with Growth, channel platforms, and Integrated Marketing teams to analyze performance data and translate insights into creative improvements
  • Implement and manage structured creative testing frameworks (A/B, multivariate)
  • Continuously refine messaging, visuals, and formats to maximize campaign efficiency and effectiveness
  • Focus on business impact metrics such as iROAS, conversion rate, and CPA to ensure creative work contributes directly to growth goals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Integrated Marketing, Growth, Brand Studio, and other teams to ensure creative consistency across touchpoints
  • Act as the creative lead and point of contact for agency and production partners
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including platform partners

Experience And Qualifications

  • 10+ years in creative strategy, with at least 3+ years focused on performance marketing assets and channel strategy
  • Demonstrated experience working with platform partners (Meta, YouTube/Google, TikTok, Pinterest) with a track record of developing innovative, co-created, or first-to-market programs
  • Strong design or creative strategy background with a portfolio demonstrating expertise across Meta, TikTok, Google Display, DV360, App Store/Google Play, and emerging platforms
  • Proven in-house experience collaborating with cross-functional marketing teams and managing creative production
  • Expertise in writing creative briefs and managing external agencies or production partners
  • Deep understanding of the distinct creative mechanics, audience behaviors, and ad products across major paid social platforms — not just how to use them, but how to push them

Spirit is everything to us, and joining the Qantas team means bringing your spirit to ours. We have over 30,000 exceptional employees, and every year we fly millions of customers around Australia and the world – together.

We aim to give every member of the Qantas Group the support to follow their dreams, face new challenges, and let their future take flight. Ultimately, people are our priority – those who work for us and those who travel with us.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.


Job Description

  • At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers.
  • A fantastic opportunity to lead a team that focuses on cutting-edge technology and engineering principles.
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide.


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product Innovation Centre located in Adelaide by ensuring consumer needs are met, guiding the development of high-quality, scalable digital solutions that deliver real customer value, leveraging deep technical expertise and strategic alignment with user-centric goals.


The Software Technical Lead oversees a technical domain and manages the engineers within it, combining deep software development expertise with leadership responsibilities. They guide teams through the full development lifecycle, from problem discovery and system design to deployment and maintenance of live code. While involved in day-to-day delivery, they also focus on strategic planning and team leadership. Collaborating closely with Product Managers, they ensure software solutions deliver strong business and customer value aligned with strategic goals. Beyond their immediate teams, they contribute to the organisation’s broader technical vision and operational effectiveness as part of the Engineering and Delivery Leadership teams, helping shape the direction of digital products and services across the enterprise. .


You’ll Have

  • 10+ years’ experience in systems development and 3+ years in technology development leadership roles
  • Strong experience building and operating high‑traffic, customer‑facing web platforms
  • Expert in Java for backend services and APIs, with modern frameworks and patterns
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript with deep experience in React.js and modern frontend architectures
  • Experience designing scalable, resilient distributed systems, including API‑first and event‑driven approaches
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure or GCP), including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience using observability and monitoring tools (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, or similar) to support production systems
  • Passionate about clean code, quality, and continuous improvement with strong accountability
  • Ability to recommend frameworks, libraries, and tools that improve performance and scalability
  • Demonstrated ability to motivate and mentor developers, fostering team growth
  • Experienced in collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, with strong influencing skills
  • Proven experience with delivering customer facing conversational AI or chatbots will be highly regarded


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on the 5th of October


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the team

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Creative Strategist to lead the development of high-impact creative assets and channel strategies across paid social, display, programmatic, and related performance assets. This role blends creative excellence with strategic depth - not only ensuring campaigns look exceptional and drive measurable business outcomes, but also shaping how we show up on the platforms where our audiences live.

As a key connector between Integrated Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative teams, you will connect upstream business objectives and brand priorities to downstream creative output - ensuring nothing gets lost in translation between the brief and the asset. Equally important, you will partner with the Creative Director and tech platform partners to develop innovative creative programs and first-to-market opportunities that give us a competitive edge. With a strong creative strategy background, in-house experience, and the ability to manage agencies and internal designers, you'll bring structure, collaboration, and strategic ambition to our performance creative function. Above all, you'll be focused on driving creative performance results.

In This Role, You Will Focus On

Creative Strategy & Development

  • Lead creative strategy for paid performance channels including Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Display, and Paid Search - with a point of view on how each channel should be used distinctively, not interchangeably
  • Connect upstream business objectives and brand priorities to downstream creative output, ensuring nothing gets lost in translation between the brief and the asset
  • Develop channel-specific creative strategies that reflect deep platform knowledge, audience behavior, and format innovation
  • Ensure creative aligns with brand identity while meeting channel-specific performance best practices
  • Present creative strategy recommendations and performance insights to cross-functional partners and leadership

Platform Partnerships & Innovation

  • Build channel-native creative and unlock value-add innovation with platform studios - Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest - ensuring EG shows up with intention within those ecosystems
  • Proactively identify and develop creative opportunities through platform betas, funded innovation programs, creator ecosystems, and AI capabilities that accelerate EG's creative transformation
  • Represent the brand in platform conversations, bringing internal briefs and business objectives to the table and returning with bespoke opportunities that unlock value
  • Partner with Growth and Brand teams to pilot first-to-market formats, translate platform learnings into scalable playbooks, and ensure EG is consistently positioned as a preferred creative partner
  • Stay ahead of platform roadmaps, algorithm shifts, and creative product launches to influence our strategy before trends become table stakes

Creative Production

  • Collaborate with in-house designers, copywriters, and external agencies to bring ideas to life with creative excellence and performance alignment
  • Oversee end-to-end production of creative assets including static, motion, video, creator/UGC, and app store visuals
  • Maintain creative asset libraries to support efficient versioning, localization, and testing processes

Performance Optimization

  • Partner with Growth, channel platforms, and Integrated Marketing teams to analyze performance data and translate insights into creative improvements
  • Implement and manage structured creative testing frameworks (A/B, multivariate)
  • Continuously refine messaging, visuals, and formats to maximize campaign efficiency and effectiveness
  • Focus on business impact metrics such as iROAS, conversion rate, and CPA to ensure creative work contributes directly to growth goals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Integrated Marketing, Growth, Brand Studio, and other teams to ensure creative consistency across touchpoints
  • Act as the creative lead and point of contact for agency and production partners
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including platform partners

Experience And Qualifications

  • 10+ years in creative strategy, with at least 3+ years focused on performance marketing assets and channel strategy
  • Demonstrated experience working with platform partners (Meta, YouTube/Google, TikTok, Pinterest) with a track record of developing innovative, co-created, or first-to-market programs
  • Strong design or creative strategy background with a portfolio demonstrating expertise across Meta, TikTok, Google Display, DV360, App Store/Google Play, and emerging platforms
  • Proven in-house experience collaborating with cross-functional marketing teams and managing creative production
  • Expertise in writing creative briefs and managing external agencies or production partners
  • Deep understanding of the distinct creative mechanics, audience behaviors, and ad products across major paid social platforms — not just how to use them, but how to push them

The total cash range for this position in Beverly Hills is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $155,000.00 to $217,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $248,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

Inspiring travel. Powering performance. Thriving together.

Role Summary

The Early Careers & Recruitment Events Manager, Talent Acquisition, is responsible for building and nurturing a solid pipeline for early career roles.

This role is part of the EMEA Talent Acquisition team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition.

The role works closely with partners across EMEA Talent Acquisition Hub Team, HR Data & Analytics, property HR teams, local HR teams, and a range of external stakeholders, including educational institutions and youth employment partners. It represents Marriott International across the region in attracting early career talent for Internships, Apprenticeships, Voyage Graduate Leadership Development Program and direct entry roles. The Early Careers & Recruitment Events Manager role is responsible for delivering impactful recruitment events that strengthen talent pipelines, accelerate hiring outcomes, and support the successful filling of critical roles across the region.

In this dynamic role, the Early Careers & Recruitment Events Manager will drive the attraction and engagement of talent, building a strong pipeline for early careers roles. Partnering closely with internal and external stakeholders, the role represents Marriott International at scale—championing internships, apprenticeships, Voyage Graduate Leadership Development Program, and entry-level opportunities. The Early Careers & Recruitment Events Manager will also lead the end‑to‑end delivery of impactful recruitment events, elevating candidate experience while supporting the region’s talent strategy. This role is part of the EMEA Talent Acquisition team, reporting to the Senior Manager Talent Acquisition.

This role is based in France, however may also support additional counties across EMEA.

Skills and experience we will look for in the ideal candidate to join our team:

  • 3+ years in Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Event Management or Sales & Marketing (hospitality industry preferred)
  • Solid experience leading or supporting end-to-end event or program management, including planning, logistics, vendor coordination, registration, and post-event evaluation.
  • Craft and deliver compelling presentations that captivate and inspire audiences
  • Exposure to youth or early careers programs, campus engagement and recruitment events
  • Strengthened and continual nurturing of relationships with key local universities, educational institutions
  • Ability to craft and deliver compelling presentations that captivate and inspire audiences
  • Manage and collaborate with multiple stakeholders designing solutions where required to increase application volume and elevate the candidate and hiring manager experience
  • Experience in creating marketing content for events or recruitment campaigns (e.g. Canva, digital outreach)
  • Familiarity with virtual recruitment/event platforms or technology enabled engagement tools.
  • Knowledge of hospitality industry trends, early career talent, and local labor markets is a plus.
  • Strong data capability to design metrics and interpret program performance.

Skills And Behaviours

  • Project management and operational organization, planning, execution skills
  • Proactive in building and nurturing relationships
  • Stakeholder management and influencing
  • Highly effective in communication and cross functional collaboration‑functional collaboration
  • Enterprise mindset - Goal oriented and committed to driving local initiatives forward ‑oriented and
  • Passion for youth and developing innovative solutions to facilitate connecting early career talent to opportunities
  • Creative and innovative storyteller with a strong marketing mindset
  • Digitally fluent, with strong capability in using digital platforms and social media to support engagement and outreach
  • Adaptability and agility
  • Data driven decision making
  • University or professional project qualification is preferred
  • Language requirements: High proficiency in English is required. Additional language knowledge or proficiency is desirable.

Why it’s a great idea to work for Marriott International:

Marriott International has been recognized as one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For™ in 2026 by Great Place to Work®. This is a reflection of our people-first culture, commitment to wellbeing, and collaborative workplace. This accolade joins a growing list of regional honors, reinforcing our dedication to creating an exceptional environment where associates thrive

EU Remote Roles

At the time of application, applicants must have the legal right to work in the country in which they are based within the European Union. Unfortunately, this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott International is the world’s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

  • A fantastic opportunity to lead and coach a squad to deliver world class products
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the product strategy, vision and roadmap for a key part of Qantas' next-generation booking engine. You will drive the ongoing evolution of our new re-platformed booking experience, identifying opportunities to enhance the customer outcomes, improve conversion and optimise both the commercial flight and reward flight booking journeys.


As part of this role, you will leverage customer insights, data and human-centred design principles to shape product initiatives and enhancements that deliver measurable customer and commercial value while continuously improving the overall product experience.


You will work closely with cross-functional teams and provide advice and counsel on general product portfolio strategy and customer experience to Senior Leaders from across the Qantas Group. You will provide recommendations on product direction, revenue growth opportunities and key commercial decisions, helping drive the future evolution of the Qantas booking experience.


You’ll have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, with Digital experience essential/ Experience in airline, travel, e-commerce or other high-volume digital commerce environments will be highly regarded.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Commerce, Technology, Marketing or relevant qualifications / experience.
  • Product management skills, including strategic and analytical thinking; a customer-centric mindset; familiarity with human-centred design, research and insights; experience defining business requirements and prioritisation; proficiency in Agile and Scrum methodologies; and knowledge of the Business Model Canvas framework.
  • Effective team leadership experience - you are someone who enjoys contributing to strong team dynamics and culture.
  • Experience leading an Agile software development squad, working closely with a cross-functional team of business analysts, software engineers and designers.
  • The ability to influence key stakeholders to achieve strategic outcomes.
  • Effective collaboration, communication and presentation skills to provide advice to various stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated organisational expertise, with the ability to work within a complex organisation and group policy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.


Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.


Applications close on the 5th of October

job.job_description:
• Own platform strategy and delivery for a defined digital product portfolio
  • Drive platform reliability, scalability and security to enable faster, safer delivery outcomes
  • Full‑time and permanent position based at our new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide


As a Platform Manager, you will be responsible for shaping and delivering the product strategy and roadmap for an enterprise integration platform that underpins Qantas’ digital, operational and customer‑facing experiences. You will balance customer needs, commercial priorities and operational resilience to enable seamless journeys, real‑time decision making and trusted outcomes at scale, strengthening both customer experience and the Qantas brand.


Working closely with senior leaders, an engineering team of six, and cross‑functional partners, you will identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives and guide investment decisions across a shared platform with multiple consumers. You will ensure products are delivered effectively across their lifecycle, from discovery through to optimisation, while managing complex trade‑offs that impact time to market, platform sustainability and customer outcomes.


This role plays a key part in advancing modern product management practices at Qantas, embedding agile ways of working, human‑centred design and a strong safety and security mindset across the organisation, ensuring integration platforms remain reliable, scalable and fit for the future.


You’ll have

  • Proven experience managing enterprise technology platforms, systems or digital products within complex environments.
  • A strong platform-as-a-product mindset, with the ability to define value propositions, establish service boundaries and create scalable, reusable capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience owning and prioritising platform backlogs, balancing competing business priorities, technical health and operational requirements.
  • Strong judgement and decision-making skills, with the ability to navigate trade-offs between delivery outcomes, platform stability, technical debt and security risk.
  • Experience establishing and governing platform standards, guardrails and extension patterns that support long-term scalability and maintainability.
  • Strong knowledge of platform reliability, service performance, lifecycle management and operational excellence, including upgrades, releases and technical debt remediation.
  • Experience embedding security controls, access management and compliance requirements into platform operations and governance practices.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Architecture and business teams.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers, including SLA management, performance monitoring and continuous service improvement.
  • Confidence applying AI-assisted tooling to lift delivery efficiency for yourself and your team, without compromising platform rigour or security standards.
  • Experience working with a major airline Passenger Service System (PSS) - its API surface, booking/inventory model, or integration patterns - is highly regarded but not essential.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.


You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on 5th October


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.
