As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the team

Expedia Group Advertising builds the platforms and experiences that connect advertisers with millions of travelers across the globe. Our mission is to help partners reach the right traveler with the right message at the right time — through intuitive advertiser experiences, high-performance ad delivery systems, and intelligent, AI-powered optimization.

We’re seeking a Software Development Engineer III to join our Advertising Technology team. You’ll build and operate real-time ad delivery systems that power ad ranking, auctions, bidding, and budget enforcement at scale. These services sit on the critical path of ad delivery, where low latency, correctness, and reliability directly impact revenue, advertiser ROI, and traveler experience.

You’ll work with Product, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Platform teams to integrate with APIs and microservices, bring ML-driven signals into high-throughput backend services, and scale the platform as the business grows.

In This Role, You Will

  • Optimize bidding, ranking and pacing for guaranteed and non-guaranteed ad delivery to surface more relevant ads and expand advertiser reach to travelers
  • Build and scale systems that support ad serving and ad selection across Expedia Group’s advertising network
  • Apply strong software design principles, algorithms, and data structures to build scalable, low-latency, high-throughput services.
  • Work closely with Product, ML data scientists and data teams on features such as relevance optimization, targeting, and performance modeling
  • Advocate for high-quality code, automated testing, and strong observability practices
  • Participate in operational reviews and drive continuous improvement
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead design discussions, and help elevate the technical bar of the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development
  • Experience working with data-driven systems, ML-powered features, or A/B experimentation platforms
  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin
  • Experience building and deploying backend APIs (e.g. gRPC) and streaming or batch data processing services (e.g., Flink, Spark) in cloud environments
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, data flows, and operational best practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with search and retrieval systems, including relevance ranking, vector databases, embeddings, or AI/semantic search
  • Experience designing and implementing agent-to-agent (A2A) and multi-agent AI systems
  • Background in ads, marketplaces, e-commerce, or travel platforms

Location:

Please note that this role is only available in Chicago, IL, in alignment with our flexible work model, which requires employees to be in the office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including our Global Finance Org., Traveler and Partner Service Platform, Legal Team, Strategy and Corporate Development Team, and People & Places Org.

If you're an experienced employee relations (ER) professional looking to deepen your expertise and take on a broad, hands-on caseload across the UK and Ireland, we'd love to hear from you. You'll be part of a close-knit, collaborative ER team with strong regional expertise and close partnership with Legal, HR Operations, Benefits, and Payroll. You'll play a central role in how Expedia Group supports its people through employee relations, performance management, and organisational change.

You'll get exposure to complex and varied ER work, meaningful coaching oppaortunities with senior leaders, and the chance to contribute to global ER projects — all while growing your career at a global travel company.

This role is heavily focused on employee relations, covering ER casework, performance management support, and reorganisation/redundancy support, with the opportunity to contribute to broader projects and global initiatives across the ER team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Act as the central point of contact for employee relations issues across business areas in the UK and Ireland, ensuring individual employee concerns are heard, issues are addressed, and employees are treated fairly.
  • Manage a varied caseload of ER matters — including conduct, performance, grievance, and disciplinary cases — through to resolution, escalating to our in-house Legal team where appropriate.
  • Coach and support people managers and leaders on performance management topics, helping them drive performance excellence and address underperformance early.
  • Support organisational change initiatives, including reorganisations and redundancy processes, partnering with business leaders, HRBPs, and the wider ER team.
  • Keep current on UK (and Ireland, where applicable) employment law requirements and internal policy, applying this knowledge to mitigate risk and guide consistent, compliant decision-making.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with stakeholders across the business, offering pragmatic solutions aligned to business challenges and organisational goals.
  • Identify trends in ER casework and provide insights that support proactive interventions, manager coaching, and policy improvement.
  • Contribute to ER projects and global opportunities across the wider ER team, helping to improve processes, tools, and ways of working.
  • Understand key performance indicators related to your own work and the role metrics play in defining success (e.g., efficiency and effectiveness of case handling).
  • Stays curious about emerging AI tools and applies them thoughtfully to day-to-day tasks, using AI literacy to drive efficiencies, streamline case documentation and reporting, and free up time to focus on higher-value, judgement-based ER work.
  • Use regional trends, themes and case data to build a compelling narrative for the business, translating patterns into actionable insights that drive proactive interventions and targeted support before issues escalate.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have around 3–5 years of experience in HR with a meaningful focus on employee relations, ideally including case management, investigations, and performance management support.
  • You hold a Bachelor's degree in HR or a related field (Master's preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • You have a solid working knowledge of UK employment law and practice, and you're comfortable applying it in day-to-day case decisions; exposure to Irish employment law or other markets is a plus.
  • You're building your ability to manage ER cases with increasing autonomy, and you know when and how to engage our in-house Legal team on more complex or higher-risk matters.
  • You're a confident coach able to guide and influence people managers through difficult conversations and performance challenges.
  • You communicate clearly and collaboratively, with a positive, can-do attitude and a genuine desire to solve problems and remove roadblocks for the people you support.
  • You're comfortable working with data pulling together basic trend analysis and metric reporting to support your casework and stakeholder conversations.
  • You're proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for documentation, reporting, and collaboration.
  • Experience working with multi-national or remote teams is a plus.
  • Please note that this role is only available in the following location: London, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office at least three days a week

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Situé sur la presqu'île de Quiberon, l'hôtel Mercure ouvre ses portes après une rénovation totale. Cet hôtel 4* est composé de 80 chambres, d'un restaurant proposant une cuisine portée sur l'océan, d’une piscine intérieure avec jacuzzi, hammam, sauna et cabines de soins.

Venez nous rejoindre dans ce nouveau projet, nous recherchons notre futur(e) RESPONSABLE DE SALLE H/F EN CDI

Description du poste

Missions Générales

  • Garantit la satisfaction client et la qualité du service en coordonnant l'activité du personnel de salle et en contrôlant le travail des équipes
  • Contrôle l'état, la propreté et la mise en place de la salle de restaurant, du Bar et de l'Accueil
  • Assure la prestation d'accueil, de service et d'encaissement du client
  • Garantit l'application des attitudes de service définies pendant le service dont il est en charge
  • Contrôle et garantit les actions de commercialisation des produits et la relation clientèle prodiguée par ses équipes
  • Suit certains indicateurs de gestion économique
  • Contrôle l'application des procédures caisse et gère une partie de l'administratif sur le restaurant.

Principales Responsabilités

 Relation client

  • Respecte l'intimité du client lors de la réalisation de son travail
  • Tient compte des habitudes des clients en séjour régulier et/ou de longue durée
  • Conseille les clients et répond à leurs questions
  • Assure les visites de coutoisie et établit un contact personnalisé avec le client, selon les standards de l'enseigne
  • Gére les appels téléphoniques et les réservations
  • Gère les réclamations clients lorsque celles-ci n'ont pas été prises en charge par ses collaborateurs
  • Connaît la carte, les produits de l'enseigne et contrôle les connaissances de l'équipe salle
  • Contrôle la bonne présentation de la carte, des produits à mettre en avant par l'équipe salle

Technique métier / production

  • Délègue et conrôle le nettoyage du restaurant (intérieur, extérieur et locaux annexes)
  • Gère et contrôle le planning nettoyage (quotidien, hebdomadaire, mensuel et annuel)
  • Contôle l'ouverture / fermeture et mise en place de la Salle, du Bar et de l'Accueil
  • Contrôle la propreté des couverts et des tables
  • Met en place et contrôle l'approvisionnement des consoles et de l'office
  • Porte une tenue conforme aux standards de la marque
  • Intervient en direct, en fonction des situations, sur différents postes liés au service (polyvalence Salle, Bar, Accueil et espaces séminaires)
  • Répartit les tâches et activités liées au service en salle en fonction du personnel présent et la clientèle prévue
  • Répartit les activités pendant le service (rangs, bar, accueil...) à l'équipe
  • Gère les pauses, fermetures de rang et départs des collaborateurs en fonction de l'activité et des horaires de l'équipe
  • Assure la communication avec la cuisine sur les demandes et retours client

Management des équipes / implication transverse

  • Evalue au quotidien le niveau de compétence et le professionnalisme de l'équipe Salle
  • Veille à l'implication et à la motivation de son équipe en tenant compte des attentes de chacun
  • Gère le planning de travail de son équipe dans le respect de la législation sociale
  • Recrute son personnel et les extras nécessaires sous la validation de sa Direction
  • Délivre et suit les formations opérationnelles
  • Anime le briefing d'avant service et passe les consignes en prenant en compte les contraintes spécifiques
  • Prépare et anime des réunions d'équipe
  • Veille au bon comportement et à la tenue irréprochable du personnel placé sous sa responsabilité
  • Est à l'écoute, informe, consulte, implique, et responsabilise son équipe sur la vie de son établissement et du réseau.
  • Adapte l'organisation du service en fonction du volume d'activité prévue
  • Gère les conflits internes et tiens informé son responsable du climat social de l'équipe

Commercial / Vente

  • Accueille le client à son arrivée et prend congé selon les standards de l'enseigne
  • Donne les consignes de placement des clients en tenant compte du plan de salle, réservations et préférences des clients
  • Connaît la carte et les produits de l'enseigne et contrôle les connaissances de l'équipe salle
  • Contrôle la bonne présentation de la carte , des produits à mettre en avant par l'équipe salle
  • Conseille les clients et répond à leurs questions (viandes, cuissons, vins, ...)
  • Est le garant de la qualité de service, du respect en tout point de la promesse qualité de l'enseigne
  • Réalise les corrections et remises en fonction des situations

Gestion

  • Contrôle les stocks liquides
  • Contrôle et gère le coût matière liquide
  • Assure et garantit l'ouverture/fermeture du restaurant par délégation (tour de sécurité,..)
  • Participe à la gestion du matériel de salle (tenue, vaisselle, produits lessiviels, ...)
  • Applique et contrôle le respect absolu de la procédure caisse et des règles d'utilisation des systèmes d'encaissement
  • Connaît et utilise les outils de gestion internes et les indicateurs du restaurant
  • Gère les clefs du restaurant (ouverture/fermeture) par délégation
  • Utilise les outils de gestion et bureautique
  • Applique les règles de sécurisation liées à la fermeture du restaurant (alarme, porte, appareils électriques,...)

Hygiène / Sécurité des personnes / Environnement

  • Applique et contrôle l'application du PMS et HACCP
  • Applique et contrôle l'application des procédures "réflexe Hygiène"
  • Respecte les règles de sécurité inhérentes à sa fonction (tenue, accessoires, procédures,…)
  • Vérifie les frigos (PMS)

Rattachement => Direction

Profil requis

Formation / Expériences professionnelles

  • De CAP à Bac + 2, avec expérience en restauration
  • Maîtrise de l’environnement informatique
  • Maîtrise de la langue du pays et anglais professionnel

Aptitudes / Qualités

  • Animateur d’équipe, leader

The Marketplace mission is to truly understand traveller needs and behaviour across multiple verticals, design and implement common traveller-facing product experiences, steward travellers to the right vertical offering, and grow Connected Trips, where travellers not only book hotels or homes, but also flights, car rentals, rides, and local attractions with us. The long-term mission of Marketplace is to grow traveller loyalty through delivering phenomenal product experience, by evolving our customer loyalty program, and by ensuring Booking.com supports our travellers in the right way throughout their trip. Marketplace Business Unit runs the common parts of our website and app, as well as is responsible for key Booking.com-wide capabilities, such as the User Experience, Experimentation Platform, Measurement, and operational Predictive ML models.

Senior Director Engineering - Connected Trip Experience & Data

As a Senior Director Software Development, you are responsible for leading the Connected Trip Experience, Foundational capabilities and Data within the Marketplace Business Function, a department of self steering teams who develop products and constantly innovate to delight our customers.

We hire the best and the brightest professionals, and we empower them to innovate, you need to have:

  • First hand experience of building customer centric experiences at scale on AI, Mobile, and web platforms in partnership with Product
  • Experience of leading technology organisations at scale
  • Demonstrable experience of partnership with senior stakeholders in and out of technology across matrix organisations

  • Demonstrable experience at building and growing a collaborative, high trust and focused organisation
  • Demonstrable experience of leading organisations involved in data & AI products & services


Role can be based in Amsterdam or Manchester.

Your focus will be:

  • Embed Data & AI deeply into the organisation from a Customer, Builder and Platform perspective
  • Deeply embed customer centricity into the habits of your organisation
  • Highly engaged, motivated and focused organisation empowered to deliver at speed.
  • Technology thought leadership and partnership in and out of Marketplace to drive our strategy forward.
  • Ensure the technology strategy is clearly communicated and understood across the organization, and drive adoption and execution.
  • Drive alignment and buy-in from both tech and non-tech stakeholders by effectively influencing and collaborating at all levels.


B. Responsible

People & Function Leadership

  • Lead, inspire and motivate your Engineering function through leading by example and setting expectations around what success looks like, giving ownership and providing clarity when necessary

Technology, Architecture & Product Strategy

  • Lead, take ownership and shape the technology strategic objectives and roadmaps
  • Be a strategic thought partner and influence senior stakeholders across the Accommodations and the broader business to set and align the strategic direction of your function
  • Make decisions in complex and ambiguous situations, and guide others in their decision making by recognizing and challenging assumptions, introducing relevant data and multiple perspectives
  • Ensure that the Booking architecture principles and engineering practices are adhered to, and that there is direction and alignment for each product.
  • Anticipate the need for changes based on context, and set renewed courses of action to engage teams and achieve goals, while striving to make the impact clear and understandable

Job Summary

The Senior Analyst, Compensation Operations & Enablement serves as an operational partner within the Compensation function, helping connect compensation strategy, systems, data, and execution. This role partners with HR, Payroll, Talent Technology, and Compensation to strengthen compensation controls, support accurate delivery of pay programs and translate business requirements into practical workflows. The Senior Analyst helps identify operational risks, improve recurring processes, and distinguish isolated exceptions from broader process concerns. This individual contributor role reports to the Senior Director, Compensation and is well suited for a compensation professional who combines analytical rigor, strong process discipline, and sound judgment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and enhance compensation controls, processes, data routines, and system partnerships that support the execution of pay strategies and programs.
  • Strengthen the operational infrastructure supporting compensation programs (e.g., annual cycles, recurring reporting).
  • Serve as a key functional partner to Talent Technology, translating compensation and business requirements into clear specifications and practical workflows.
  • Analyze ambiguous compensation operations issues, distinguish one-time exceptions from systemic concerns, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Coordinate and execute successful completion of compensation cycles and enterprise-wide survey submissions (including ad hoc job evaluation, matching and benchmarking)
  • Build and/or maintain compensation quality-assurance routines, audit checks, validation procedures, and reconciliation processes.
  • Coordinate compensation operations for Managed Hotel associates, including pay structures, merit cycles, and pay-practice guidance
  • Review manual processes and document recommend opportunities to automate, standardize, simplify, and scale recurring work.
  • Collaborate effectively with partners across HR, Payroll, Talent Technology, and Compensation.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 4-6 years of experience in compensation, HR analytics, HR information systems, or a related environment requiring accuracy, analytical judgment, and disciplined process execution.
  • Experience supporting annual or recurring compensation cycles .
  • Working knowledge of compensation administration, including the ability to recognize when a data issue may indicate a broader process, control, or system concern.
  • Experience with audit activities, process optimization, automation, or HR technology is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting skills, including experience working with large datasets, formulas, data validation, reconciliations, and recurring reporting routines.
  • Ability to perform data quality reviews and develop or maintain controls that support accurate compensation administration.
  • Ability to translate business and compensation requirements into repeatable processes, practical workflows and/or system specifications.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • High attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, process control, and dependable execution.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to assess complex or ambiguous issues and identify practical solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills, including the ability to document decisions, manage dependencies, and coordinate recurring processes.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to identify and communicate potential risks before issues arise.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and nontechnical partners.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in compensation, human resources, HR information systems business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Relevant compensation, analytics, process improvement, audit, or project management certifications are preferred but not required.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $120,000. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

LOCATION & HYBRID WORK SCHEDULE

This role is based at Choice Hotels' headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, and follows a hybrid work model, with a combination of in-office and remote work based on business needs and team expectations.

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Data Engineer in the Performance Marketing Team you will be in charge of:

  • Architect & Deliver Scalable Data Products: Design, build, and optimize high-throughput data products and infrastructures that serve as foundation for Performance Marketing AI strategies.
  • Drive Technical Roadmap: Help define the long-term technical strategy for the Data Engineering team, ensure our infrastructure is modern, cost-efficient, resilient and aligned with industry trends in Big Data and Cloud.
  • Stakeholder Alignment & Discovery: You are skilled at navigating diverse perspectives to build technical consensus and uncover opportunities. You possess the ability to communicate technical solutions clearly to colleagues in non-technical roles.
  • Drive Business-Centric Analysis: A pply a strong analytical mindset to solve complex pipeline issues, ensuring every technical solution is designed with the intent to maximize business value.


What you need to succeed:

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team and our "AI-First" transition. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Technical Ownership & Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to build/scale and deliver engineering solutions at speed. You can demonstrate the technical depth to stay ahead of Big Data and Cloud infrastructure trends and the practical wisdom to apply them to complex business challenges.
  • Experience in Complex Data Initiatives and Data Architecture: You provide technical guidance as well as hands on development for large-scale data initiatives (ETL/ELT & Data Modeling, data applications, reverse ETL). You are capable of delivering strategic improvements to our data ecosystem that directly impact business performance.
  • Data Quality and Governance: Experience with designing and implementing solutions to mitigate data loss, implement robust data privacy standards and ensure high-level of data quality across online marketing data.
  • First experience with AI: You are able to comfortably leverage AI coding assistants to enhance the quality and delivery speed of your code.
  • Data Orchestration: Pr oven experience using data orchestrators like Airflow and Dagster.
  • End-to-End Project Delivery: You successfully deliver high-complexity data projects involving multiple stakeholders (Data Science, Product, Marketing). You are skilled at monitoring progress and mitigating timeline or technical risks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Agile Mindset: Proven experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. You are comfortable with iterative development, participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to deliver incremental value in a fast-paced setting.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: You e ffectively give and receive feedback, including code reviews and data model deep dives. You enjoy mentoring other team members, coaching them to upgrade their technical skills and grow to the next level.
  • Strategic Communication: You can communicate complex data concepts and technical architectures to both technical and business stakeholders, establishing alignment within the broader organization.
  • Analytical Mindset: You possess a strong analytical mindset, proactively using data to validate hypotheses, ensure data quality and solve intricate problems. You don't just build pipelines; you understand the business value of the data moving through them.
  • Team Player: You enjoy collaborating and sharing your skills and knowledge with others. You thrive in a multicultural environment and value diverse perspectives.
  • Language Proficiency: You are proficient in English, allowing you to work and communicate effectively in our global and diverse workspace.


Good to have

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Vertex AI or other AI-powered coding assistants e.g. CLine or Copilot, to accelerate development and debugging.
  • AI-Driven Data Solutions: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into data engineering workflows (e.g., automated data cleaning, anomaly detection, or predictive schema mapping).
  • Data Infrastructure for AI: Beyond utilizing AI productivity tools, you understand how to design data pipelines and structures optimized for AI products (e.g., via Vertex AI).
  • Experimentation Mindset: A proactive desire to test new technologies and frameworks. You view "AI-First" not just as a goal, but as a tool to enhance productivity and unlock new data capabilities.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features, LLM capabilities, and evolving data proces sing standards.


Tech Stack you will work with:

  • Transformation & Governance: dbt
  • Orchestration: Dagster
  • Cloud provider: Google Cloud
  • Compute and Storage: Kubernetes, BigQuery, Cloud SQL
  • AI/ML: Vertex AI
  • Online Marketing APIs: Google Ads API, Bing Ads API, Meta Marketing API, TikTok API, Criteo API
  • Data movement: Fivetran

Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.

job.job_description:
Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Location: United States (New York, Miami, Nevada, Phoenix preferred)


Job Description


Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centres, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 500 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.


Role Overview:


The Director, Customer Excellence & Continuous Improvement will serve as the enterprise leader responsible for driving customer-centric transformation across Fareportal. Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer, this US-based executive will create and operate an enterprise feedback and improvement system connecting customer feedback, complaints, quality findings, frontline observations, training insights, automation-adoption data, and digital journey evidence to prioritized and sustainable improvements.

This role is not responsible for day-to-day contact center operations. Instead, the focus is on identifying systemic issues, uncovering root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, and partnering with business leaders to improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and organizational effectiveness.


A key priority for this position will be leading automation and transformation and process redesign initiatives that reduce manual effort, eliminate process inefficiencies, minimize human error, and improve scalability through technology, AI, analytics, and intelligent workflow design that improve both efficiency and customer satisfaction.


What You Will Own


Strategic Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic partner in advancing Fareportal's customer experience and operational excellence agenda.
  • Establish and lead an enterprise-wide customer improvement portfolio that prioritizes high-impact customer and operational opportunities.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement through measurable and sustainable change initiatives.
  • Partner with senior leaders across Operations, Product, Technology, Analytics, Legal, Marketing, and Commercial teams to improve customer outcomes and business performance.
  • Customer Excellence & Continuous Improvement
  • Build and operate a closed-loop improvement framework connecting customer feedback, complaints, quality monitoring, employee insights, operational performance, and technology data.
  • Lead root-cause analysis efforts to identify recurring customer and operational challenges.
  • Develop corrective and preventive action plans to address systemic issues and prevent recurrence.
  • Identify customer risks proactively and implement interventions before issues escalate into complaints or service failures.
  • Drive enterprise learning through customer trends, complaint analysis, quality findings, and operational observations.


Service Excellence

  • Establish and continuously improve operational standards across Fareportal's global customer operations organization.
  • Develop a culture centered on service excellence, professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure consistent delivery of exceptional customer experiences across all customer touchpoints.


Operational Transformation & Automation

  • Lead the transformation of customer-facing processes through automation, AI, analytics, and technology-enabled solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, reduce operational risk, improve data accuracy, and minimize customer-impacting errors.
  • Partner with Product and Technology teams to build scalable solutions that automate workflows, improve process efficiency, and enhance customer experiences.
  • Champion the adoption of automation tools, AI capabilities, intelligent quality monitoring, agent assist technologies, proactive customer communications, and digital self-service solutions.
  • Monitor and validate business outcomes from automation initiatives to ensure measurable improvements in productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, and cost efficiency.


Customer Advocacy & Recovery

  • Lead proactive customer recovery strategies for customers identified through risk signals and operational trends.
  • Oversee expert resolution teams supporting complex customer issues, escalations, policy interpretation, and complaint resolution.
  • Implement processes that identify and protect potentially impacted customers when systemic failures occur.
  • Ensure regulatory complaints and customer grievances are addressed through resolution, root-cause correction, and enterprise-wide learning.


Quality, Training & Adoption

  • Establish quality frameworks, calibration processes, performance scorecards, and continuous feedback mechanisms.
  • Leverage quality monitoring programs to generate actionable business insights.
  • Ensure training initiatives are aligned to root causes and measurable performance improvements.
  • Assess and improve adoption of new processes, tools, and technologies across operations.
  • Lead global quality assurance programs across voice, chat, and digital customer interactions.
  • Identify trends and implement corrective actions that improve customer satisfaction and operational performance.


Technology & Innovation

  • Identify opportunities where AI, machine learning, automation, predictive analytics, knowledge management, and customer intelligence can improve customer experience and business performance.
  • Support the development of data-driven decision-making capabilities across customer operations.
  • Partner with technology teams to ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned with business objectives.


Team Leadership

  • Build and develop high-performing teams focused on customer excellence, quality, continuous improvement, and transformation.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and customer advocacy.
  • Mentor leaders and individual contributors while promoting data-driven problem solving and operational excellence.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required. (Computer Science preferred)
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.


Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in Customer Excellence, Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, Business Transformation, Customer Operations, or related fields.
  • Proven track record leading enterprise transformation initiatives and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience building and scaling continuous improvement and customer experience programs.
  • Demonstrated success implementing automation, technology, and process transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working across Operations, Product, Technology, Analytics, Quality, Legal, and Customer Service functions.

Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of customer experience management, process improvement methodologies, automation, AI, and analytics.
  • Experience with Voice of Customer (VoC), complaint management, customer journey optimization, and performance management frameworks.
  • Knowledge of automation technologies, workflow tools, AI-enabled service solutions, and operational analytics.

Leadership Skills

  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and executive influencing skills.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without direct operational ownership.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Customer satisfaction and service quality.
  • Reduction in recurring customer issues and complaint volumes.
  • Increase in proactive customer issue identification and resolution.
  • Measurable business value delivered through improvement initiatives.
  • Reduction in manual processes and human error through automation.
  • Increased adoption of AI, automation, and technology-enabled solutions.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency, quality, and process compliance.
  • Successful implementation and sustainment of transformation initiatives.
  • Training effectiveness and certification outcomes.
  • Adoption of AI-enabled quality and learning tools.


Benefits

  • Competitive base salary & Incentive Bonus (commensurate with experience)
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Employee Technology Trainings & Wellness Programs


Why Join Fareportal?


Opportunity to work with global teams and contribute to campaigns reaching millions of U.S. travelers. High-growth environment with a focus on innovation, technology, and customer impact.

Collaborative culture that values creativity, problem‑solving, and continuous learning.

Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Manager to join our Global Media team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Marketing, Brand, Loyalty, Regional and Digital teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

This role will manage the successful development and execution of integrated media strategies that drive brand awareness, guest acquisition, loyalty engagement and revenue growth across Hyatt’s portfolio of brands. The role leads media planning for a roster of Hyatt campaigns, ensuing media effectively reaches the right audience and delivers strong ROI. This role will partner closely with brand and regional counterparts to ensure campaigns deliver on goals and needs. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking and media expertise to deliver impactful campaigns across digital, social, custom content/partnerships, programmatic, video and emerging channels.

  • Develop integrated media strategies that support brands, regions, loyalty, B2B and partnerships.
  • Develop integrated audience strategies targeting prospective guests, loyalty members, leisure travelers, and high-value customer segments.
  • Recommend channel mix and budget allocation across paid search, paid social, programmatic, online video, audio, display, connected TV and emerging channels.
  • Partner with media agencies and platform partners to execute integrated campaigns that drive awareness, consideration, bookings, and loyalty engagement.
  • Support development of reporting and presentations that communicate media effectiveness, business impact, and optimization recommendations.
  • Manage media budgets across campaigns and monitor spend pacing, forecasting, and financial reconciliation processes.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in media planning and activation
  • Proven experience in managing multi-channel paid campaigns
  • Understanding of media analytics and performance metrics
  • Experience with media buying tools and platforms (e.g. DSPs, Meta Ads Manager, etc.)

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Media, Marketing or related field
  • Media agency experience preferred
  • Understanding of eCom and/or travel category preferred

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $98,500-$128,000. This role is also eligible for an Annual Incentive Plan.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

Associate Brand Media Manager

From search engine optimization to branding and promotions, our Marketing team is the expert at spreading the Priceline message far and wide – capturing the hearts and imaginations of customers to get them to try our services, and keep them coming back for more.

At Priceline, we pride ourselves on being the best travel deal makers in the world, all in support of our purpose to help consumers experience the moments that matter most. As a pioneer in online travel, we are on an exciting journey to reignite our brand superiority and weave Priceline into the cultural conversation.

This role, reporting to the Director of Brand Media, will be critical in executing our cross-channel media campaigns across linear TV, CTV, OLV, audio and social. You will collaborate closely with the Brand Marketing team to bring our campaign strategy to life.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

We’re looking for an Associate Brand Media Media Manager to lead campaign management, creative delivery, in-flight reporting and optimizations across Priceline’s brand media campaigns. The ideal candidate is detail oriented, data driven, operationally strong, and passionate about travel.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Manage the day-to-day execution and optimization of brand marketing campaign activities across the media ecosystem (TV, CTV, OLV, Social, Audio and other emerging platforms)
  • Partner closely with external media agency team on media workflows and prioritization, from planning through execution and optimization
  • Manage agency briefing cycles, campaign plan development and channel-level budget allocation to maximize effectiveness and impact
  • Assist with the development and maintenance of campaign deliverables such as decks, flowcharts and other materials
  • Prepare strategic presentations and campaign recaps for internal stakeholders
  • Summarize performance insights, key learnings, and opportunities for improvement in media reports
  • Lead activation workflows with agency, creative, and investment teams, including asset delivery, tagging, trafficking and monitoring
  • Track brand media budget , including campaign authorizations and invoices
  • Stay informed on new partners, product offerings and innovation opportunities that may impact campaign strategy

Who You Are

  • 4-6 years of experience in either brand or performance media planning / buying, preferably at an agency
  • An understanding of digital platforms as well as traditional media
  • Experience with campaign management including, trafficking and billing
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with multiple internal and external teams
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, accountable, and enthusiastic approach to work
  • Passion for travel coupled with strong belief in the power of brands and the role they play in changing the trajectory of a business and organization
  • Demonstrated history of living the values important to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. It’s therefore essential that you also meet our high standard of ethics, honesty, transparency and compliance
  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in advertising, marketing, communications, business, or a related field.

In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $90,000- $110,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

• Design seamless, world-class experiences that help customers discover, book and manage travel with confidence
  • Use customer insights, experimentation and design craft to improve acquisition, conversion and self-service outcomes
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As a Product Designer, you will help create intuitive, engaging and accessible digital experiences that support customers from initial travel inspiration through to post-booking management. You will be accountable for translating ambiguous customer and business problems into clear experience outcomes, design approaches and build-ready solutions that improve customer experience and business value. You'll play a key role in simplifying complex airline processes, helping customers navigate fares, ancillary products, booking changes and travel preparation through thoughtful and customer-centred design.


Operating across discovery through to delivery and continuous iteration, the Product Designer independently plans and executes research, frames problems, explores solution options and partners with Product and Engineering to deliver outcomes. This role will work autonomously on medium-complexity initiatives and may lead design for a workstream within larger programs, maintaining alignment to overarching design strategy set by senior design leadership.


To be successful in this role, you will be a strong collaborator and influencer within your squad and immediate stakeholder group. You will facilitate workshops to align teams, contribute to design system adoption and improvement, and ensure solutions meet brand, accessibility, and quality standards. You will use AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of design activities such as insight synthesis, exploration, prototyping and handover.


You’ll have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Service Design, UX, UI, CX, and/or a similar role.
  • Tertiary qualification in Design, Human-Centered Design (HCD), or a relevant field.
  • Understanding of design for native apps, conversational interfaces and other digital platforms.
  • Strategic thinking to deliver innovative outcomes aligned with brief and brand.
  • Ability to focus on objectives and deliverables at both technical and creative levels,
  • always user-centric.
  • Experience developing and promoting a product vision collaboratively.
  • Some experience in concept development, wireframing, persona creation, user stories and user testing.
  • Some experience working with and creating user interface design patterns.
  • Experience of modern frameworks and rituals: Lean, Design Thinking, Scrum, Kanban.
  • Knowledge of usability and accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.0 AA.
  • Experience using modern industry tools such as Miro, Figma, Lovable, ClaudeCode, Cursor, and Adobe Creative Suite; collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to streamline design handover to developers and generate code (e.g., Figma's AI plugins, ClaudeCode, Cursor, Lovable).
  • Demonstrated logical reasoning and sound decision-making, including numerical analysis.
  • Ability to identify and address flawed logic and resolve errors.
  • Ability to solve high-impact design challenges in large, complex organisations.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with a track record of successful outcomes.
  • Ability to communicate design concepts to stakeholders, adapting to the audience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of current digital design standards and industry trends.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.


Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

job.job_description:
Job description:

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

The Sustainability Analyst will work with the VP, Global Sustainability & ESG and Senior Manager, ESG & Organizational Effectiveness to maintain the Environmental Management System and sustainability platform; maintain, analyze, and report sustainability data and metrics, including preparation of the annual greenhouse gas inventory; and support climate risk assessments. The Analyst will support NAMER, LATAMC, EMEA, and APAC in tracking, measuring, and improving environmental performance through sustainable brand standards and sustainability framework best practices. The role supports operational efficiency, cost reduction, stakeholder engagement, and guest loyalty.

What you'll do
  • Maintain sustainability data and metrics; work with global regions and internal stakeholders to collect, validate, analyze, and interpret energy, water, waste, emissions, and other environmental data; prepare the annual greenhouse gas inventory; and coordinate with auditors on environmental data verification.
  • Track franchisee utility data sharing compliance by reviewing the completeness of hotel utility usage data shared through the company’s sustainability platform in accordance with brand standards requirements; report compliance levels, coordinate alerts or communications to non-compliant hotels, and assist hotels with data submission and platform features.
  • Support franchisees with sustainable practices required by sustainable brand standards or promoted through sustainability framework best practices, serving as the primary escalation point for the Operations Support Desk and Operations team members who provide frontline franchisee support.
  • Maintain hotel metrics within the sustainability platform by updating monthly or quarterly data sourced from internal teams, organizing and formatting data for standardized uploads, and updating the hotel portfolio monthly to provide new hotels with timely access.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to promote sustainability initiatives, integrate sustainability into business practices, and provide program training as needed.
  • Support sustainability and ESG external reporting efforts; assist with climate risk assessments by coordinating climate hazard, exposure, and vulnerability data and analyzing physical and transition risks across the hotel portfolio; and assist in analyzing ESG-related ratings, coordinating with cross-functional team members to increase transparency and disclosure where feasible.
  • Assist in the maintenance and administration of the environmental management system.
You'll be successful if you have
  • Proven analytical skills, with the ability to collect, analyze, and interpret data, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven written and verbal communications skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex information to a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize projects in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to problem solve, working independently or within a team, to analyze and solve project or process issues.
  • Knowledge, understanding and practical experience of environmental sustainability, corporate social responsibility, and wider environmental, social and governance issues within the hotel industry.
  • Passion for sustainability.
  • Knowledge of environmental data reporting and environmental management systems is a plus.
Required Qualifications/Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, environmental science, sustainability or related field.
  • 1-3 years work experience or master’s degree in Sustainability or related field.
  • Demonstrated strong computer skills to include MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word).

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

 

Job Location: Parsippany - 22 Sylvan Way, 22 Sylvan Way, Parsippany, New Jersey  07054
Employment Status: Full-time

 

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. based positions only, the expected pay range for this position is $75,000 - $85,000 annually.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation such as work location, background, experience, and performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

 

In addition to the base pay, this role is eligible to receive an incentive payment pursuant to the Annual Incentive Plan with a 10% annual target, subject to the terms of the Plan.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is committed to attracting, motivating, and retaining talented team members who align with our company’s core values. We are proud to reward our full-time team members with comprehensive benefit programs and resources which include:

  • Health insurance with HSA and FSA options
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life/AD&D insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Vacation time- Accrue 1.615 hours of paid vacation per week
  • Paid holidays- 11 Core Scheduled Paid Holidays with potential additional paid days off as business operations and the calendar permit (e.g. in 2026, there is an additional 7 days of paid company closure).
  • Paid sick leave accrued as state and local laws require
  • Additional paid time off in the form of one volunteer day, bereavement time, as well as jury duty time.  

 

Participation in any of the benefit plans and programs made available to team members is subject to satisfaction of eligibility requirements. More information can be found on Our Benefits Page.  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts reserves the right to amend or terminate any benefit plan or program at any time in accordance with applicable law.

 

We are accepting applications for this position through 11/15/2026.

job.job_description:
Key Account Manager I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Viator, a Tripadvisor company, is the leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 300,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and all the niche, interesting stuff in between)—memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier. With industry-leading flexibility and last-minute availability, it's never too late to make any day extraordinary. Viator. One app, 300,000+ travel experiences you’ll remember.

We are seeking a driven and high-performing Key Account Manager who will be responsible for the health and quality of the Viator product offering within their designated portfolio of high value accounts across various destinations. The Key Account Manager will have a deep understanding of trends, opportunities, and challenges within their accounts and work to optimize Viator’s product offering to best match the consumer demand in terms of product variety, pricing, and availability.

You are a brand ambassador that will focus on a select number of high valued accounts to ensure continued optimization and growth. You will be responsible for meeting/exceeding key performance indicators and maintaining/improving the overall commercial health of your accounts. In this role you will be working with both internal and external stakeholders to align on necessary product offerings in your set of accounts, carrying out critically important tasks to maintain and grow our competitive advantage and continually improve Viator’s catalogue of experiences.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership & Account Growth

  • Lead as the primary point of contact for high-value global accounts, forging and maintaining deep, strategic relationships.
  • Diagnose and proactively address unique business opportunities, identifying scalable solutions to deliver results.
  • Develop and execute account strategies that are directly tied to business objectives and measurable growth.

Product Excellence & Optimization

  • Elevate and maintain a best-in-class product portfolio for the assigned accounts to maximize traveller appeal.
  • Ensure product quality, availability, and optimal pricing, directly aligning the offering with evolving traveller and market demand.
  • Leverage knowledge of the online travel industry to serve as a trusted expert and deliver actionable insights to partners.

Commercial Leadership & Performance

  • Negotiate favorable commercial terms that protect and maximise Viator's profitability.
  • Proactively monitor and analyse key performance metrics, taking swift corrective actions to maintain and improve the overall commercial health of accounts.
  • Provide regular, concise performance reports and strategic updates to senior management on account status, growth forecasts, and potential business risks.

Partner Success & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Champion rapid issue resolution by collaborating seamlessly with the internal team of Destination Specialists and Support Teams to ensure an exceptional level of partner satisfaction.
  • Maintain a competitive edge by continuously monitoring industry trends, competitor strategies, and shifts in customer preferences to inform partner guidance.

Key Skills And Experience

Commercial & Results Focus

  • Entrepreneurial & Commercially Driven: Growth focused, never settle.
  • Execution & Urgency: Demonstrated ability to grow accounts with a focus on delivering results and swift execution, paired with a strong sense of urgency in a dynamic environment.
  • Negotiation: Highly skilled in securing favorable terms and maintaining relationships.
  • Account Growth: Passionate about achieving success and excellence.

Analytical & Technical Acumen

  • Analytical Mindset: Possesses a strong analytical mindset and advanced data analysis abilities.
  • Technical Background: Strong technical background to support data-driven decisions.
  • Industry Knowledge: Good understanding of the online travel landscape.

Relationship & Collaboration

  • Internal Networking: Highly skilled in leveraging professional connections, demonstrating resourcefulness and the ability to effectively use internal networks and available tools.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build rapport with both clients and internal teams.
  • Teamwork & Independence: Embraces new ideas and works well in teams while also having the ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.

Foundational Experience

  • Required Years: 5+ years in B2B Account Management or Sales.
  • Industry Experience (Plus): Online Travel Agency, operator, or travel experience is a significant plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
About Us


Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.



In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Manage daily hotel supply-side operations, ensuring core KPIs are achieved.
  • Analyze regional market data, identify business issues and opportunities, propose solutions, and drive execution independently.
  • Localize operational plans from central operations for SEA markets, providing timely feedback and insights on outcomes.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional projects, such as supply quality improvement, partner enablement, and process optimization, ensuring end-to-end delivery.
  • Collaborate effectively with central operations, product, and business development teams; serve as an independent operations-side point of contact.
  • Translate regional operational insights into actionable recommendations for product optimization and strategic initiatives.
  • Build and continuously improve SOPs and workflows tailored to the SEA market to enhance operational efficiency and standardization.
  • Prepare for future Site Leader responsibilities by developing site-level management thinking, stakeholder influence, and cross-team coordination.
  • Demonstrate the ability to independently lead complex operational initiatives without direct team support.
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, system gaps, or partner challenges.

What you'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; hospitality, tourism, business, or related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of operations experience in OTA, hotel group, or online travel platforms.
  • Experience driving cross-functional projects or operational initiatives; people management experience optional but a plus.
  • Strong ownership and commitment to task closure.
  • Adaptable to multicultural and fast-changing environments.



Why Trip.com Group


We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?



Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!



Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com



Have a good trip, and see you soon!
