job.job_description:
About The Role

It's a great time to join us at Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC)! ARC accelerates the growth of global air travel by delivering forward-looking travel data, flexible distribution services and other innovative industry solutions. We are a leading travel intelligence company with the world’s largest, most comprehensive global airline ticket dataset, including more than 15 billion passenger flights. By working here, you can contribute to solutions and expertise that strengthen economies and enrich lives. We think big, embrace challenges and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.

ARC is looking for a talented Manager, Software Engineer to join our team! You will o versee multiple concurrent large-scale projects, direct the allocation of resources, and set priorities for a team of employees and contractors who perform software engineering for the full product stack in support of ARC products and services. You will drive the development of new products within a complex multi-platform environment. You will meet challenging development and support commitments and improve upon development processes. You will help grow, develop and mentor a team of software engineers and align with operations, site reliability and the product teams. You will quickly assess team/project needs, capacity management and competency and make prioritization changes where necessary. You will provide deep technical input to products that align with ARC’s strategy and work with peers to implement a comprehensive project based planning process across all software groups and projects.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Support software engineering by providing patterns to deliver the optimal product; including communicating and constantly improving design patterns. Mentor other engineers. Provide overall technical leadership to software and site reliability engineers.
  • Partner with product owners, business SMEs and site reliability engineering to analyze the business needs and provide a supportable and sustainable, engineered solution. Ensure that the overall technical solution aligned with the business needs.
  • Drive the creation and modifications of the product portfolio components, identify and engage all technical resources necessary to contribute to the solution. Ensure the solution is consistent with ARC architecture, design and development standards.
  • Develop applications using industry best practices. Make adjustments to adopt new methodologies that provide the business with increased flexibility and agility.
  • Stay current with latest development tools, technology ideas, patterns and methodologies; share knowledge by clearly articulating results and ideas to key stakeholders. Continue to grow in people development and enterprise influence.

You'll Bring These Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field; or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years of application programming in both front end User Interfaces, server-side application and database queries
  • 3+ years of engineering leadership, managing multiple workstreams and leading blended internal / external delivery models
  • 5+ years of experience with full cycle application development (Full SDLC experience: design, development, delivery, etc.),
  • 3+ years with Agile, Scrum, DevOps, XP, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery
  • 5+ years of experience implementing modern applications using:
    • Cloud Based Solutions/Technologies (AWS, Google, Azure). AWS developer environment including, but not limited to, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, Cloudwatch
    • Implementation of modern application and infrastructure design patterns, including micro-services and containers, disposable, reactive, stateless and distributed patterns
    • Open source technologies including, but not limited to, NodeJS, OpenJDK, React, Python and NoSql DynamoDB database(s)
    • DevOps tools including, but not limited to, Terraform/Cloud formation, Jenkins pipeline, GIT, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, Sonar, Nexus, automated test and deployment tools
    • Data warehouse platforms (such as Teradata, Snowflake, Redshift). Expertise with SQL, database design/structures, ETL/ELT design patterns, datamart structures (star, snowflake schemas, etc.)
    • Experience w/Data Lake concepts and design patters (AWS S3, parquet, python, lambda, java, hadoop, Spark, noSQL mongoDB, Dynamodb, Athena, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of integrating AI and LLM APIs into production applications, with good knowledge of RAG, vector databases, LLMs, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience with AI coding tools such as GitLab Duo, GitHub Copilot, Cursor IDE, and similar tools to accelerate and improve software development workflows.
  • Proven ability to lead and mentor technical teams and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels to reliably move efforts from multiple workstreams from backlog through to production.
  • Proven ability to influence technology strategy and best practices across peer and leadership groups to support an agile development culture
  • Outstanding communication skills (verbal and written) and ability to communicate with internal and external customers and all levels of management, including communicating technical information to nontechnical audiences
  • A strong intellectual curiosity to continually challenge what exists and explore what should be changed to best meet evolving business and market
  • A strong passion to support peers to help meet timelines on larger projects
What We Can Offer You

  • Joining ARC means joining a team that is motivated, diverse, creative, collaborative and solutions-oriented. We think big, embrace challenges, and explore new ideas to lead the way for the travel industry.
  • Our employees value the hands-on learning and professional development opportunities that allow them to expand their skills and grow their career in new, dynamic ways.
  • ARC offers WorkFlex. WorkFlex is ARC’s hybrid work program which offers eligible employees the flexibility to work from home while also requiring in office workdays throughout the year to foster collaboration and connection throughout the organization. We’ve designed WorkFlex to enable employees to succeed and thrive while maintaining strong connections to one another and ARC - both of which are critical to our shared success.
  • We offer a highly competitive, comprehensive benefits package so you can worry less and focus on what truly matters. Please click here to review our benefits on our company website.
  • By joining ARC, you will partner with top minds in the industry as we use data and technology to innovate how the world travels.

EOE M/F/D/V Females and Minorities Encouraged to Apply

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

The Opportunity

Agoda is very excited to launch a new B2C fintech product

As Senior Business Analyst – New verticals, you will play a key role in defining, launching and growing the product across different markets. You'll devise, own and execute initiatives to drive acquisition, transaction growth and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to incubate and grow a new business vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

We are looking for someone who can handle ambiguity well while remaining independent in developing fast-paced initiatives across this new and interesting product.

In this Role, You Will

  • Help on defining the Product Customer Value Proposition and Go To Market (GTM) Strategy
  • Design optimization strategy for the product across the full funnel – from user across key business metrices (i.e., acquisition, activation, transaction growth, top-ups loyalty and customer engagement)

    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

    Nice to Have

    • Experience in consulting, investment banking, e-commerce, fintech or financial services, such as Travel cards, multi‑currency wallets
    • Experience launching or scaling a new product or major feature as part of a team

job.job_description:
Job Title

Principal Scrum Master - Lufthansa Digital Lab

The LHG Digital Lab supports Lufthansa Group in the design, development, and continuous evolution of its digital platforms, including the OneBooking web ecosystem and related digital services. The Lab operates within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment as part of Lufthansa Group's Digital Hangar and Agile Release Trains, working in close collaboration with Lufthansa product, design, and engineering teams.

The Lab includes teams based in Nice (France), Bad Homburg (Germany), and Istanbul (Turkey).

The Nice Digital Lab hosts cross-functional Scrum teams made up of Software Engineers, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineers, and Customer Success Engineers who deliver customer-facing, highly available digital solutions used by airline customers worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master (or Principal Scrum Master) to support Agile delivery and continuous improvement for a User Interface (UI)-focused development team operating within a complex international environment.

In this role, you will serve as the Scrum Master for one team, helping ensure the effective application of Agile principles, supporting delivery excellence, encouraging team autonomy, and driving continuous improvement. You will collaborate closely with Lufthansa Group stakeholders and Release Train Engineers (RTEs) to manage dependencies, align priorities, and support Program Increment (PI) execution.

You will also contribute to broader Agile transformation initiatives by coaching teams and stakeholders on Agile practices and supporting the continued development of Agile maturity across the organisation.

Scrum Master Leadership, Coordination and Agile Coaching

  • Serve as the Scrum Master for a User Interface (UI) development team, facilitating Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
  • Support high-performing, self-organising teams through coaching and servant leadership, while helping to remove impediments and improve team effectiveness.
  • Partner with Product Owners on backlog management, prioritisation, transparency, predictability, and sustainable delivery practices.
  • Collaborate with Lufthansa Group stakeholders and Release Train Engineers (RTEs) to manage dependencies, support Program Increment (PI) planning and execution, and coordinate delivery across teams.
  • Promote Agile values, principles, and Lean-Agile practices through coaching, mentoring, continuous learning activities, and participation in Agile communities of practice.

Ideal Candidate

  • Experience as a Scrum Master in Agile software development environments, supporting cross-functional teams and delivering complex initiatives.
  • Effective facilitation, stakeholder management, communication, and coaching skills.
  • Experience working within scaled Agile environments such as the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or equivalent frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage dependencies, risks, and coordination activities across multiple teams and organisations.
  • Collaborative servant leadership approach with a focus on continuous improvement, team development, and Agile maturity.
  • Fluent in English

Technical Stack and Environment

  • Agile framework: Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
  • Front-end technologies: Angular and Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)
  • Automated testing: Playwright
  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD): Azure DevOps
  • Environment: RefX-based User Interface (UI) applications built on the Digital Commerce Representational State Transfer Application Programming Interface (REST API)

What we can offer you?

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Customer Intelligence & Personalization organization is seeking highly motivated and data curious individuals who are excited to leverage data to improve customer experiences. This team prioritizes Delta’s enterprise customer experience (CX) initiatives, in service of our CX strategy, using insights from customer listening and associated analytics. Further, the team ensures CX initiative design leverages best practices, furthers personalization as our latest strategic competitive advantage, and delivers impact as intended.

As a co-op of the CX Intelligence & Personalization organization, you will work closely with our experienced team to gain hands-on experience in analyzing data, generating insights, and contributing to real-world projects. If you have a passion for data-driven decision-making, this position is the opportunity for you.

Customer Intelligence & Personalization co-ops will work with analytics professionals supporting one of the following functions or departments:

Customer Data & Analytics: Customer listening strategy & governance, CX data infrastructure for decision support & CX data products that drive value in support of Delta pillars.

Customer Insights & Advisory: Focused on deepening the understanding of consumers and championing their needs before, during, and after they engage with Delta including consumer research and insight, Delta’s NPS performance program, competitive benchmarking, and CX prioritization. Bringing the voice of the customer to where decisions are made by consulting, connecting, and quantifying actionable, consumer-centric insights.

Customer Strategy & Personalization: Support Delta’s CX strategy by communicating the CX narrative, managing and prioritizing the portfolio of initiatives, and connecting teams across the organization to measure and deliver impact. Manage cross-org integration forums and lead design standardization and change management Centers of Excellence. Represent the voice of the customer in designing end-to-end experiences as practitioners nested in the principles of scalability, omnichannel-thinking and a keen lens on personalization.

Customer & Marketing Technology: Transforming customer data into intelligent signals, by unifying customer data, building out process and enrichment, building intelligence and predictions, and creating activated plans for personalized experiences.

Customer Intelligence & Personalization Is Seeking Co-ops To Fulfill a Minimum Of Three Full-time Alternating Rotations Based In Atlanta, GA, In Line With The Schedule Below

  • 1st Rotation: Spring 2027
  • 2nd Rotation: Fall 2027
  • 3rd Rotation: Summer 2028

Though individual responsibilities will vary by function, some examples include:

  • Research, analyze, and interpret customer data
  • Measure KPI performance and its impact on customer satisfaction
  • Develop new reports and dashboards and/or enhancing automation of manual processes
  • Perform root-cause analysis of customer pain points
  • Work closely with stakeholders to understand data needs and provide analyses
  • Leverage and query cross-divisional data sources to answer business questions
  • Communicate and coordinate with key stakeholders across the organization to share priorities, roadmap, and key learnings
  • Develop effective presentations to share findings and recommendations to leaders

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree that has the flexibility to support a co-op role
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (i.e., Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Experience or a demonstrated interest in data analysis and coding, preferably SQL (while some roles my require specific coding skills such as Python)
  • Build strong working relationships with coworkers, partners, and company leadership
  • Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and results oriented; capable of meeting deadlines and follow-through
  • Must be available for 3 alternating co-op terms

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business/Management, Mathematics/Statistics, Economics or related quantitative field
  • Some positions may require a minimum of 30 completed semester hours
  • Experience performing statistical analysis and modeling (i.e., linear regression, segmentation, non-linear predictive regression, operations research, and/or machine learning)
  • Experience with coding software (i.e., SQL, SAS, C, Python, VBA, R, etc.)
  • Course work in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, marketing, etc.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Revenue Manager consults hotels in managing the room inventory and pricing of assigned hotels to increase revenue. They use Choice’s tools and procedures to create and implement effective strategies for selling rooms based on market demand and competition. They need to have skills in revenue management, ecommerce, sales, marketing, and distribution, and be able to make strategic and tactical decisions. They also need to have strong knowledge and skills to persuade and influence key decision makers. They handle a larger and more complex portfolio of hotels and offerings and help develop and improve the ChoiceRM program.

Note: This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversee and optimize guest room inventory and pricing strategies for assigned hotels, driving RevPAR growth through smart demand analysis, dynamic selling strategies, length of stay optimization, and strong channel parity.
  • Partner closely with hotel teams to deliver actionable insights through daily, weekly, and monthly revenue management reporting, while staying ahead of demand drivers such as groups, conventions, and citywide events.
  • Lead engaging Revenue Strategy Meetings, translating performance data, market trends, and competitive intelligence into clear, impactful recommendations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and key liaison between hotels and Choice teams, leveraging advanced enterprise systems, Salesforce, and Lanyon to align strategies with brand goals and unlock new marketing and promotional opportunities.
  • Contribute to high-visibility special projects and enterprise-wide revenue management initiatives, collaborating cross-functionally to shape and elevate Choice’s revenue strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience as a Revenue Manager, or Business or Consulting experience focused on financial analysis or revenue analytics.

Technical Skills

  • Understanding of Revenue Management principles and philosophies, tools, and reports, as well as industry standard metrics and related reports.
  • Experience with multi-property revenue management a plus.
  • Experience with Extended Stay revenue management a plus.
  • Knowledge of Choice Internet sites, Property Management Systems, Choice distribution platforms and strategies, GDS systems a plus.
  • Proficient in the use of all Microsoft office applications with high degree of demonstrated proficiency in Excel.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to evaluate data, extract actionable insights, and convert to strategic revenue opportunities.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Ability to apply critical thinking skills to understand and solve complex problems and use data as the basis for making recommendations.
  • Ability to articulate revenue strategies and deployment to achieve strategies. Presents ideas, expectations and information in a concise, well-organized way.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Good listener with strong observation skills.
  • Ability to influence decision-makers at all levels; able to convince others to act through presentation of analysis and information.
  • Ability to make measurable progress on multiple high priorities while also handling day-to-day operations.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics or relevant field of work or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Revenue Management Certification (CHRM or CRME) is required of all Choice Revenue Management team members. Candidates who are not already certified will need to become certified within the first year of employment.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $ 86,886 - 102,219. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for Revenue Management Incentive Plan.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

The Field Recruiter is a strategic Talent professional responsible for executing full-cycle recruitment across hourly and salaried positions while operating within dnata Catering USA’s centralized governance and decentralized execution recruiting model. This role serves as the primary talent advisor for the assigned business unit, partnering closely with Director of Talent, People & Culture, General Manager and other Hiring Managers to ensure workforce readiness and achieve hiring goals aligned with operational demands.


The Field Recruiter is accountable for maintaining department Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), recruiter workflows, and recruiting KPIs to ensure a consistent candidate experience and accurate reporting. This position is responsible for proactively sourcing talent, conducting interviews, facilitating orientation, and ensuring new hires are successfully onboarded and transitioned into the business. This role requires strong recruiting expertise, operational partnership, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while balancing strategic and tactical responsibilities.


EDUCATION: High School diploma required; Associate’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, preferred.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning


  • Manage the full-cycle recruitment process for hourly, salaried, and leadership positions across the assigned business unit.


  • Partner with Hiring Managers, Operations Leaders, and People & Culture to understand workforce needs and develop proactive recruiting strategies.


  • Recruit for high-volume frontline operational positions as well as professional and management-level roles.


  • Conduct intake meetings with hiring managers to align on job requirements, hiring timelines, compensation, and candidate profiles.


  • Develop talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, networking, referrals, community partnerships, and recruitment events.


  • Utilize Dayforce, Indeed, LinkedIn, social media, and other sourcing platforms to attract qualified candidates.
  • Screen, interview, and assess candidates based on technical skills, leadership capabilities, and organizational fit.


  • Present qualified candidates and provide consultative recommendations to hiring managers.


  • Coordinate interviews and ensure a positive and efficient candidate experience throughout the hiring process.


Centralized Governance & SLA Compliance


  • Operate within dnata Catering USA’s centralized Talent Acquisition governance model while supporting decentralized execution at the local unit level.


  • Maintain compliance with all Talent Acquisition Service Level Agreements (SLAs), including candidate response times, interview scheduling, dispositioning, and requisition aging standards.


Candidate Experience & Employer Branding


  • Serve as a brand ambassador for dnata Catering USA and promote the organization at recruiting events, job fairs, colleges, and community outreach initiatives.


  • Ensure candidates are informed throughout the hiring process and receive prompt updates regarding interview status and employment decisions.


Orientation & Onboarding

  • Facilitate new hire orientation and ensure employees receive a welcoming and engaging onboarding experience.


  • Partner with People & Culture and Operations to ensure employees are successfully transitioned into their new roles.


  • Monitor onboarding completion and address onboarding issues proactively.


  • Partner with Hiring Managers to ensure 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day probationary reviews are completed accurately and on time.


  • Monitor completion rates and follow up with department leadership regarding overdue reviews.


Training & Talent Development

  • Complete dnata’s Train-the-Trainer (TTT) and Master Training certifications within established timelines.


  • Assist with talent development initiatives and support local engagement activities.


  • Promote continuous learning and professional development throughout the business.


NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Other duties as assigned by management.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong understanding of full-cycle recruiting and sourcing strategies.


  • Experience operating within structured recruiting workflows and KPI-driven environments.


  • Knowledge of Talent Acquisition Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).


  • Experience with ATS systems; Dayforce experience strongly preferred.


  • Proficiency with sourcing tools including Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, and social media recruiting.


  • Strong communication skills, including sourcing, engaging, and building relationships with candidates across multiple channels.


  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.


  • Excellent time management, organization, and prioritization abilities.


  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.


  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism.


  • Train-the-Trainer (TTT) certification required within 60 days of hire.


  • Master Trainer certification required within 180 days of hire.


  • Ability to travel up to 5% as business needs require.

job.company_description:
At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Overview

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At the center of it all, our dedicated IT teams innovate, design and develop the technology that is redefining how customers rent, buy and share vehicles from our family of brands. Here, you will be part of a diverse and talented team that creates and delivers powerful technology solutions for our customers and employees across the world with the resources and support to develop in a variety of career paths.

As an Enterprise Mobility team member, we offer an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, work from home opportunities, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule, which includes the ability to work from home, while also requiring to be in person as needed at our Lakeside and/or Clayton Corporate HQ campus locations in St. Louis, Missouri.

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. Candidates should expect identity verification, video interviews, technical validation of skills, and verification of employment, education, and work authorization. Falsification of information, proxy interviewing, or misrepresentation of experience or location will result in disqualification.

Responsibilities

The ARMS (Automated Rental Management System) Department is responsible for managing the core B2B platform that automates communication, vehicle authorizations, and billing between Enterprise Mobility and its insurance, collision repair, and dealership partners. In addition to supporting these critical external integrations, the department builds, maintains, and modernizes the underlying platform to ensure reliable, scalable rental workflows and seamless partner connectivity through APIs and a modernized user interface.

This team focuses on operational support, continuous improvement, and product optimization within ARMS, directly impacting system stability and user experience across the business. The role will support production operations, partner integrations, and modernization initiatives, including API enhancements, UI improvements, and ongoing defect resolution and performance optimization. The team works closely with rental operations, product and engineering teams, and external partners to ensure efficient, accurate transactions and continuous delivery of business value.

As an Engineer 2 in the Automated Rental Management System (ARMS), you will be responsible for using your technical knowledge to solve business problems. We are looking for a talented individual who can serve as a subject matter expert in their focus area and represent their department on complex assignments. You will be responsible for evaluating technical elements of our product offerings through requirements gathering, testing, research, and investigation and make recommendations for improvements that result in increased quality. You will be required to evaluate customer needs to determine and provide high-quality solutions that align with customer expectations.

In this role on the ARMS development team, you will be responsible for designing, modifying, and developing complex code independently, within various teams using applicable technologies. You will be responsible for mentoring, driving standards, ensuring code performance, contributing to code reviews, performing unit and integration testing, and analysis and review of software requirements. This position will partner with our Production Support team to troubleshoot and resolve application issues, our business partners to implement enhancements, and our Modernization teams to support API and new technologies. You should also have a strong team orientation and a sense of leadership and ownership. This role will require you to have strong knowledge of Java, which will enable you to research and fix issues. You will also be part of after-hours “On-Call Rotation” after getting up to speed.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Must possess excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Must possess willingness and drive to learn
  • Must be able to work with minimal supervision
  • Strong teamwork abilities in a collaborative environment

Agile Coach - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

You will use your passion and expertise to help turn teams into high performing units, plus you will have a deep understanding of and experience in deploying new Agile methods, and an ability to learn and embrace new ways of helping drive increased team performance. Your success will come from your ability to help teams achieve their goals and deliver on commitments to their customers. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.


Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
  • Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As an Agile Coach in the Agile Team you will be in charge of:

  • Collaborate with other Agile Coaches to develop a unified agile strategy, create cross-area collaboration frameworks, share best practices, and ensure consistent agile evolution and collaboration across the organization.
  • Guide executives, business units, and technology teams on change management and implementing Agile principles & values, helping them to build, grow, and continuously improve a thriving agile organization at scale;
  • Empower teams to make data-driven decisions, fostering cross-collaborations, reducing complexity, improving communication to ensure clear prioritisation of initiatives to maximise impact and reach eDOs strategic goals.
  • Design and support teams in the deployment of the eDOs development approach to optimise resource allocation, development of customer-centric products and services, and ultimately deliver value;
  • Provide Agile coaching and training to Product Owners, Dev Teams, and the wider business, coaching teams in all aspects of Kanban;
  • Expose our product and technology teams to the latest innovative thinking and ideas from the Lean and Agile community to increase agility, using Lean, Kanban, and other agile thinking to encourage a culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement;
  • Create, build, and facilitate or deliver customized workshops and training sessions.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • 3+ years’ experience in technology organizations with Agile/Kanban coaching experience;
  • Deep knowledge of Agile principles and practices and the ability to transfer that understanding at all levels of the organization;
  • Results driven ability to execute and embed
  • Consulting and facilitation skills in coaching technical and business teams in the adoption and improvement of Agile methodologies;
  • Conflict management skills
  • High degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to build strong relationships across various levels of the organisation
  • Excellent presentation and training skills;
  • Fluency in English is a requirement


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Market Manager, Las Vegas

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Make an impact!

As a Market Manager in Las Vegas, you will grow a segment of the portfolio by managing accounts directly and helping deepen strategic partnerships. You will analyze business and operational performance to identify opportunities for optimization, support service delivery for active accounts, and communicate technical and operational impacts as needed. This role is ideal for someone who is energized by relationship-building, commercial conversations, data-driven decision-making, and helping partners grow in a dynamic market.

In This Role, You Will

  • Build strong relationships with partner account teams, including key buyers and decision-makers
  • Visit partners in-person in Vegas, as well as travel to partners in Reno and Atlantic City (monthly/quarterly depending on business need)
  • Assist in creating opportunities such as progress meetings and exploratory discussions to help grow partner accounts
  • Understand and communicate partner business issues through the appropriate internal channels
  • Recommend products, services, and insights that meet partner needs
  • Develop a strong understanding of how the department operates and how it fits into the larger organization
  • Build awareness of the policies, practices, trends, and competitor information that impact the organization and its partners
  • Develop a strong understanding of the financial impact of decisions and solutions on the organization and its partners
  • Document components of business cases for change at the direction of more senior colleagues, as needed
  • Build and maintain a working knowledge of financial data and the company’s standard contract terms and conditions by reading product literature, contracts, and learning from peers
  • Learn when to partner with legal resources to modify or adjust standard contract terms
  • Learn the contract negotiation process and how to complete contractual arrangements
  • Exchange nuanced information to build consensus and move work forward
  • Handle key objections effectively and proactively seek help from a manager when needed to address differences and ensure agreements among all parties
  • Conduct straightforward cost, benefit, and risk analyses of possible solutions and the implications of not reaching agreement
  • Identify and actively engage stakeholders in decision-making and strategies that benefit both the account and the organization
  • Close deals effectively while supporting broader account and portfolio goals
  • Develop understanding of standard offerings and major areas of expertise
  • Build a working knowledge of products, technologies, and offerings within scope of responsibility
  • Develop an understanding of competitors’ standard products and services
  • Demonstrate thoughtful application of products, technologies, and offerings to partner accounts
  • Build and maintain ongoing business relationships with colleagues and external partners
  • Strategically build relationships to support total portfolio and broader organization needs
  • Develop understanding of the partner’s industry and competitive market
  • Attend partner meetings to understand needs and expectations
  • Learn the metrics used to assess the performance of products, services, and solutions against partner needs and expectations
  • Develop key value proposition statements, case studies, and proof points to demonstrate the value of the company’s products, services, and solutions

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 2+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree, or 0–2 years of relevant experience with a Master’s degree
  • You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent experience
  • You are proficient in English and, where applicable, the local language of the market
  • You are an effective communicator who can build trust and influence through clear, confident conversations
  • You have proficiency in sales techniques and a consultative approach to partner conversations
  • You bring skills in portfolio management, relationship management, upselling, and cross-selling
  • You are comfortable using business and operational performance insights to identify opportunities and recommend solutions
  • You are interested in developing your commercial, contractual, and market expertise in a fast-paced environment

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You enjoy building strong partner relationships and helping accounts grow over time
  • You combine commercial thinking with a consultative, partner-focused approach
  • You are comfortable balancing multiple priorities while staying responsive to partner needs
  • You use data, market context, and business judgment to inform recommendations and decisions
  • You know how to collaborate across teams and engage the right stakeholders to move work forward
  • You are motivated by helping partners unlock more value from Expedia Group’s marketplace

The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in Las Vegas is $90,000.00 to $126,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $144,000.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

As the Senior Director, Owner Relations HUB (US & Canada), reporting to the Vice President, Owner Relations, you will lead Hilton's centralized Owner Relations HUB, providing strategic leadership for the teams responsible for supporting owners throughout the earliest stages of their Hilton journey.

You will oversee both the New to Hilton Owner Relations Team, supporting first-time owners from Franchise License Agreement execution through six months after hotel opening, and the Hilton Owner Support Team, supporting small ownership groups operating Hilton-branded hotels across the United States and Canada. Together, these organizations support approximately 2,000 ownership groups while delivering a consistent, scalable, and owner-centric experience that strengthens Hilton's relationships with owners and enables continued portfolio growth.

You will shape the future of Hilton's centralized owner support model by driving operational effectiveness, organizational capability, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement while developing exceptional leaders and teams.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Lead Hilton's centralized Owner Relations HUB, providing strategic and operational leadership for two Owner Relations verticals supporting approximately 2,000 ownership groups throughout the US and Canada.
  • Establish the vision, operating model, service standards, and performance expectations for the HUB, ensuring exceptional owner experiences while delivering scalable, sustainable support.
  • Lead a team of Directors, Senior Managers, Managers, and Analysts while building organizational capability, succession plans, and future leaders.
  • Champion an owner-first culture that delivers proactive engagement, issue resolution, and exceptional service throughout the owner lifecycle.
  • Drive operational excellence through process optimization, workflow improvements, automation, technology enablement, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop scalable support frameworks for Owner Relations processes, including owner onboarding, issue resolution, ownership transitions, enterprise programs i.e. Hilton RISE, franchise fee inquiries, and enterprise initiatives.
  • Establish key performance indicators, governance, and executive reporting that measure owner satisfaction, operational performance, service quality, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Use owner feedback, operational metrics, and business insights to identify opportunities, improve service delivery, and influence enterprise priorities.
  • Ensure seamless transitions between the New to Hilton Owner Relations Team and the Hilton Owner Support Team, creating a consistent experience throughout the owner lifecycle.
  • Be the executive point of escalation for complex owner issues requiring enterprise coordination and executive visibility.
  • Lead strategic initiatives that improve the scalability, consistency, and effectiveness of Owner Relations HUB Operations while supporting Hilton's continued growth.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Partner with Owner Relations field leadership to ensure seamless collaboration between centralized and regional owner support teams.
  • Build trusted relationships with ownership groups, management companies, and above-property stakeholders throughout the United States and Canada.
  • Collaborate with Development, Hotel Openings, Commercial Services, Revenue Management, Distribution, Brands, Brand Management, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, AD&C/PIPs, and Customer Experience teams to deliver exceptional owner support.
  • Represent the voice of Hilton owners across enterprise initiatives, ensuring owner needs are incorporated into strategic decisions and operational improvements.
  • Partner with senior leadership to develop long-term strategies that strengthen owner engagement, improve operational efficiency, and support Hilton's growth objectives.

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Leadership and continued evolution of Hilton's centralized Owner Relations HUB Operations model.
  • Strategic oversight of two Owner Relations verticals supporting approximately 2,000 ownership groups across the United States and Canada.
  • Develop and execute long-term strategies that improve owner satisfaction, operational excellence, and scalable service delivery.
  • Organizational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development across the HUB organization with the team you will manage.
  • Enterprise initiatives supporting new owner onboarding, ownership transitions, QA/RISE coordination, owner communications, and operational improvements.
  • Executive reporting, dashboards, and analytics that measure owner experience, operational performance, service quality, and business outcomes.
  • Process improvement initiatives that leverage technology, automation, and best practices to simplify owner interactions and improve organizational efficiency.
  • Governance and operational readiness that supports Hilton's expanding owner community and development pipeline.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Ten (10) years of progressive professional experience in hospitality, franchise operations, owner relations, commercial strategy, customer success, operations, or related business functions
  • Seven (7) years of leadership experience, including leading leaders within a complex, matrixed organization
  • Demonstrated experience leading operational transformation, organizational change, or enterprise-wide process improvement initiatives
  • Experience using operational data, analytics, and business insights to guide decision-making
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives across multiple partners
  • Travel up to 20%

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Experience in Owner Relations, Franchise Support, Hotel Operations, Commercial Services, or Brand Performance
  • Experience leading centralized or shared-services organizations
  • Knowledge of hotel ownership structures, franchise operations, hotel development, and owner lifecycle management
  • Experience implementing Salesforce, workflow automation, AI-enabled support tools, or enterprise technology solutions
  • Familiarity with hospitality performance metrics, including operations and commercial metrics (i.e., Stay Scores, RSI, CoStar, QA, RISE Reporting, owner Return on investment, and operational performance indicators)
  • Master's Degree or MBA

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $145,000 – $210,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Organization- Dream Nashville

Summary

Dream Nashville is looking for a highly motivated Bars and Nightlife Manager to lead a team of expertly trained professionals that execute innovative and experiential programming while driving a healthy bottom line. Bars and Nightlife Manager is expected to plan and manage the nightlight venues and related F&B operations to achieve customer (guests, employees, corporate and owners) satisfaction and quality service while meeting/exceeding financial goals. Position is responsible for oversight of the hotel’s bar/beverage program, short and long-term planning, and day-to-day operations of the nightlife venues and related areas.

Directs and assists in the development of competitive promotional plans in order to increase business levels and sales. Solid financial skills and the ability to analyze financial statements and modify operations to meet financial goals. Ability to drive strong P&L performance.

  • Assist in the development and maintenance of sales and promotion requirements. Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy. Reviews competitive set maintain an awareness of market position.
  • Required to have meaningful presence on the venue floors and out front while in operations at peak times.
  • Monitors and maintains beverage inventory levels and costs. Places orders for beverage & other supplies within cost control procedures
  • Maintains relationships with vendors and suppliers
  • Manages beverage programming throughout all nightlife venues
  • Demonstrates diplomacy by keeping all the key stake holders, including bartenders, service staff, marketing, talen, A/V, security, and nightlife operations organized and in sync.
  • Monitors month-end reports and provides verbal and written feedback to Executive Committee and ownership.
  • Works closely with hotel F&B Director.
  • Reinforces a customer service mentality and ensures all employees are focused on serving the customer at all times

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Great opportunity within our Qantas Technology – B2C, Digital & Payments Domain – AI Team
  • Challenging opportunity to innovate and drive change through technology
  • Permanent full-time position based at our Mascot Campus

At Qantas, we represent Australia to the world. Our diverse country is known for its unique spirit, mateship, and a can-do attitude. Together we’re strong and resilient, and we work hard to make sure we’re always at our best.

Technology is a big part of how we continue to pioneer our way forward. With eyes on the future, our IT team harness technology on a global scale and tailor local solutions for each of our ports. Together we’ll show you it’s possible to make an impact, and to never underestimate what you’re capable of achieving.

The Product Analyst role works with business partners, wider technology domains and external parties to act as a conduit between the business & technology. The product analyst supports and when required leads the lifecycle for designated products. Their underlying technology sub-systems and is accountable for aligning product delivery plans to enable the business to achieve their objectives & strategic outcomes – from concept through to operations. Product Analysts are to work with the organisation to help stakeholders improve their processes and systems and support the delivery of new features, enhancements and initiatives. They govern service partners to ensure product features are delivered to commitments, meets business requirements and service levels. The Product Analyst has a customer-centric mindset with a drive for continuous improvement and innovation.

The Product Analyst role within the B2C AI Team, offers a unique opportunity to help shape Qantas' AI future, working on innovative initiatives spanning Generative AI, intelligent automation, conversational experiences and AI-powered customer and employee solutions. You will play a key role in delivering capabilities that enhance customer experiences, improve operational efficiency and help establish the foundations for how AI is leveraged across the Qantas Group.

You’ll Have

  • 3+ years’ experience in the areas of Business or Systems Analysis, Product or IT Support or related disciplines
  • Degree qualified, or equivalent industry / technical experience and qualifications
  • Proven track record of operating in IT Delivery environments from concept to BAU
  • Basic to Expert (varies by desired level) understanding and use of modern delivery frameworks and their methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, lean, design thinking, human-centred design, multivariate testing, continuous improvement, test automation and others.
  • Experience in security management practices, risk management, vulnerability management and penetration testing.
  • Prior experience with, and strong comfort using, collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence to document and manage stories and other documentation
  • Experience (varies by desired level) in working with data sets to deduce accurate insights
  • Demonstrated ability to partner and collaborate across multiple functions and levels
  • Experience in IT Operations and / or working in ongoing product lifecycle
  • Demonstrated technical expertise, utilising a depth and breadth of knowledge and practical experience within a specific technical area. Stays up to date with regulatory and other change in the technical area, and understands how they apply to Qantas
  • Stakeholder engagement and management skills
  • An interest in emerging AI technologies and a willingness to learn and contribute within a rapidly evolving AI environment.

Why Qantas?  

If you’re successful in your application, you’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. 

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.  

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.  

  • We love to travel: Enjoy discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.  
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.   
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging for everything from motor vehicles to electronic devices.  
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether its learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.  

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. 

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today. 

Applications close: 29 September 2026

job.job_description:
Job overview and responsibilities

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AI agent development, Python, and modern cloud technologies. This role requires an individual who can independently design and build scalable AI automation solutions, create sophisticated agentic workflows, and contribute to architectural decisions while ensuring high-quality delivery and support.

Our Vision:

You will be responsible for creating multiple AI agents that run at scale, implementing automation workflows for customer retail intents and journeys across voice, chat, and future channels. Your work will directly contribute to eliminating wait times and giving every United customer a fast, effortless resolution.

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, or similar agent development frameworks
  • Build scalable automation solutions that handle high-volume customer retail intents and journeys, particularly during peak demand and irregular operations (IRROPS)
  • Develop conversational AI solutions and voice automation capabilities that seamlessly integrate with United's customer service channels
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code in Python, TypeScript, and .NET/C#
  • Implement and optimize AI agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns
  • Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Participate in full development life cycle including requirements analysis and design using Agile methodologies
  • Serve as technical expert on AI automation development projects
  • Write technical specifications based on conceptual design and stated business requirements
  • Support, maintain, and document AI agent functionality and automation workflows
  • Identify and evaluate new AI technologies and frameworks for implementation
  • Analyze code to find causes of errors and revise programs as needed
  • Participate in software design meetings and analyze user needs to determine technical requirements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams consisting of employees and vendor contractors in planning and execution
  • Collaborate with end users to prototype, refine, test, and debug AI agents to meet customer experience needs
  • Ensure adherence to code quality standards, security protocols, and responsible AI principles
  • Leverage cloud technologies (AWS preferred) to build and deploy AI solutions at scale
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and best practices for AI agent development

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in software design and development
  • Strong proficiency in Python programming
  • Experience with TypeScript and .NET/C# development
  • Knowledge of Object-Oriented systems design and Application Development
  • Experience implementing AWS technologies
  • Strong knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience with Cloud Automation Development Tools
  • Knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databases and Design Patterns
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • 2+ years of experience building AI agents, conversational AI, or voice automation solutions
  • Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar agent development frameworks
  • Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and prompt engineering
  • Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns and vector databases
  • Experience with AWS services including Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS, EC2, CloudWatch, Vector Databases
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing
  • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automation, and infrastructure as code
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles and AI governance
  • Experience in enterprise-scale applications
  • Airlines or travel industry experience is a plus
  • Experience with contact center or customer service technology platforms
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

The base pay range for this role is $112,480.00 to $146,540.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.


You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.
