dnata is one of the world’s largest air services providers. Established in 1959, the company ensures the aviation industry operates smoothly and efficiently in 127 airports. Offering ground handling, cargo, travel, and flight catering services in 35 countries across six continents, dnata is a trusted partner for over 300 airline customers around the world. Each day, the company handles over 1,900 flights, moves over 8,500 tons of cargo, books over 16,000 hotel stays, and uplifts over 320,000 meals.


What We Offer


Comprehensive Benefits Package: Full-time employees are eligible for 401(k) and healthcare benefits including Medical, Dental & Vision

Complimentary Daily Meals: Enjoy FREE breakfast, lunch, and dinner during your shift


Our Mission:

  • To be the word's most admired air and travel provider

Our Core Values:

  • We Are Safe
  • We Are Future Thinkers
  • We Play To Win
  • We Respect Everyone and Work As A Team

Key Responsibilities for an Account Manager for dnata Catering, your primary role is to build and maintain strong relationships with airline clients. Your main responsibility is to understand their unique needs and requirements, ensuring the seamless delivery of catering services. You will act as the main point of contact for clients, handling inquiries, resolving issues, and providing exceptional customer service. Your strong communication and negotiation skills will enable you to negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements with clients, while also collaborating with internal teams to ensure the successful execution of catering orders. Your attention to detail and ability to manage multiple accounts efficiently will be crucial in maintaining client satisfaction and loyalty. Ultimately, as an account manager, your goal is to drive revenue growth, exceed client expectations, and contribute to the overall success of the aviation catering company.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Follow up with the proper department to ensure all open issues are resolved.
  • Ensure that the day-to-day operation is on schedule, using the proper and most updated documentation.
  • Liaise with the local customer station team and follow up on all local operational related issues.
  • Maintain an on-going proactive relationship with assigned accounts and maintaining a dialog with assigned representatives.
  • Ensure equipment inventories are taken and communicated to appropriate personnel on time according to the customer schedules.
  • Support the Executive Chef in coordinating menu presentations and any special presentations. Ensure appropriate unit key personnel are invited to attend.
  • Support the Production department with all airline cycle changes. This includes holding menu meetings, coordinating purchases with the buyer, and ensuring that cycle changes are transparent.
  • Monitor and ensure that loading and billing of the customer is accurate.
  • Coordinate and participate in all kitchen evaluations; distribute evaluation feedback to department managers and ensure appropriate response is provided in a timely, detailed manner.
  • Communicate daily with department managers regarding operational issues and attend daily operations briefing.
  • Document and maintain a daily customer discrepancy log; communicate information to respective department managers; monitor follow-up on action plans to ensure customer satisfaction; follow-up with the customer to communicate actions taken to resolve issues.
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with customer safety and equipment policies/procedures!
  • Other duties as assigned.

External Relationships

  • Coordinating with airline clients and ensuring efficient delivery logistics.

Communication and Process

  • Excellent communication skills, including conflict management and resolution, with a track record in customer service.

NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Other duties as assigned.


EDUCATION: Minimum of an Associate’s Degree three (2) years in high volume hospitality preferred. Bachelor’s Degree preferred.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Must have driver’s license.
  • The ability to meet requirements necessary to obtain a Port Authority, Port ID (per TSA regulations and more specifically, 49 CFR §1542.209)
  • Must have excellent attention to detail.
  • Must be able to multi-task.
  • Must be able to read and write in English.

Intellectual/Social demands:

While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is continuously asked to multi-task under time limits. Position requires constant attention to precise details and accuracy of specified standards including following simple to complex (more than 3 steps) instructions, and concentration which frequently extends beyond 30 minutes at a time. This position also requires constant attendance and punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time. Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Takes responsibility for own actions; Completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan. Meets productivity standards; Completes work in timely manner; Strives to increase productivity; Works quickly.


Physical demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk; reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, or crouch. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 30 pounds. Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures; Reports potentially unsafe conditions; Use equipment and materials properly.


Work environment:

The essential functions of this position are performed indoors. The noise level in the work environment can range from minimal to loud.


We believe that diversity and inclusion are fundamental to creating a strong workplace and community. At dnata, we’re proud that our workforce is as diverse as the customers we serve. And we’re committed to nurturing your talent with mentoring, volunteer and professional development opportunities. We welcome everyone. Our employee resource groups are one of the many ways we champion diversity and inclusion at dnata.

Enterprise Mobility operates the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental, and Alamo car rental brands and has frequently been named one of the top places to work. Enterprise Mobility is the largest and fastest growing privately owned automotive rental and leasing company in North America and we are hiring now! The Enterprise brand of Enterprise Mobility has an exciting opportunity for a Customer Assistance Representative Sr (CAR Sr). The Customer Assistance Representative Sr (CAR Sr) will provide a high level of customer service by assisting both internal and external customers, through face-to-face interaction. The CAR Sr will gain knowledge through local training and hands-on experience to provide rental back-up, service customers and deliver administrative support in our airport location.

This position is located at our office at Islip MacArthur (ISP) Airport: 150 Arrival Ave, Ronkonkoma, NY 11779.

This is a full-time (40 hour/week) position with a flexible schedule within our operating hours of 8am-12am.

The starting rate of pay is $19.00 per hour. Employees can earn yearly merit increases based on performance.

  • Paid time off
  • Employee discount
  • Retirement savings plan
  • Extended Health Benefits (Medical, Prescription Drug, Dental and Vision)

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

We are hiring now for immediate openings. Responsibilities include:

  • Take incoming calls- reservations, rate quotes, general questions and answers, provide information and resolution for customers and other business partners

  • Maintain a regular and reliable level of attendance and punctuality

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

  • Must have at least 2 years of college and/or customer service experience combined
  • The ability to operate a motor vehicle is an essential function of this position. Applicants must have a valid, unrestricted, U.S. driver's license.

Director Of Product Management Advertiser Experience

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group Advertising (EGA) is Expedia Group's advertising business, helping travel brands connect with travelers across Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, and other EG brands throughout the traveler journey. EGA spans ad formats, marketplace and auction dynamics, targeting, and measurement — powering advertising experiences at global scale.

Our Advertiser Experience pillar owns how advertisers discover, onboard, and succeed across EGA's self-service and AI-powered tools, spanning our Sponsored Listing, Accelerator, and Display products. As Director of Product Management, Advertiser Experience, you will lead this pillar and a team of product managers, reporting into EGA Advertising Product. This is a high-impact role for a product leader who wants to shape how tens of thousands of advertisers grow their business on one of the world's largest travel platforms.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for EGA's advertiser-facing experience across Sponsored Listing, Accelerator, and Display, driving measurable improvement in onboarding completion, campaign adoption, and advertiser retention.
  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers — setting priorities, raising the bar on craft, and clearing the way for their execution.
  • Define and drive EGA's partner agentic experience strategy, turning natural-language advertiser goals into guided and automated campaign actions.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to reduce friction across campaign creation, optimization, and reporting.
  • Drive cross-sell and next-best-action strategies that grow advertiser usage across EGA's product portfolio.
  • Represent the Advertiser Experience pillar in cross-functional planning, roadmap reviews, and executive updates, translating technical tradeoffs into clear business impact.
  • Track industry trends in self-service and agentic advertising tools, and translate them into EGA's product strategy.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field, or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including owning a product area end-to-end in a high-growth or marketplace business.
  • Experience managing and developing a team of product managers.
  • Strong quantitative instincts: comfortable setting goals, reading adoption and funnel data, and prioritizing against onboarding, retention, and revenue outcomes.
  • Track record of partnering closely with engineering, design, and data science to ship complex, customer-facing products.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building self-service SaaS, advertiser or seller tooling, or AI-driven product experiences.
  • Experience shipping agentic or LLM-powered product surfaces in production.
  • Background in digital advertising, marketplaces, or two-sided platforms.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The ideal candidate is a strategic, relationship-driven sales leader with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality, a proven ability to develop high-performing teams, and a demonstrated track record of generating business across corporate, group, business and leisure markets. This individual should be equally comfortable setting long-term strategy, coaching and developing team members, cultivating high-value client relationships, and actively pursuing new business.

Responsibilities

 ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Sales Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead, direct, and oversee the hotel’s Sales team, establishing clear objectives, priorities, account strategies, and performance expectations.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive sales strategy aligned with the hotel’s overall business plan, positioning, revenue objectives, and market opportunities.
  • Establish annual and quarterly sales goals by market segment and ensure the team is focused on achieving or exceeding targets.
  • Develop strategies to increase market share, optimize business mix, strengthen account production, and drive profitable revenue.
  • Analyze market trends, competitive activity, account production, booking patterns, and business performance to identify opportunities and proactively adjust sales strategies.
  • Partner closely with the Commercial Director and Revenue Management Team to align sales strategy with overall hotel objectives.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Management to ensure sales efforts support optimal rate strategy, occupancy, profitability, and need-period objectives.
  • Establish and maintain effective account management strategies for key corporate, group, agency, and other high-value accounts.
  • Identify opportunities to diversify demand across business travel, group, leisure, catering and other priority market segments.
  • Develop and manage a strategic sales action plan, including account penetration, prospecting, solicitation, client entertainment, sales calls, trade events, and industry networking.
  • Ensure the Sales team effectively utilizes the hotel’s CRM and sales systems to track activity, pipeline, account production, and business opportunities.
  • Monitor and evaluate individual and team performance, providing regular coaching, feedback, and accountability.
  • Recruit, train, mentor, and develop Sales team members to build a high-performing, collaborative, and results-oriented culture.
  • Lead regular sales meetings, strategy sessions, account reviews, and performance discussions.
  • Foster strong communication and collaboration between Sales, Catering, Revenue Management, Marketing, Reservations, Front Office, and hotel operations.

Business Travel

  • Serve as the hotel’s primary seller for the Business Travel segment, developing and maintaining relationships with key corporate accounts, travel managers, business travel agencies, and other relevant partners.
  • Develop and execute a strategic plan to grow corporate transient production and strengthen the hotel’s position within the luxury business travel market.
  • Identify, solicit, and secure new corporate accounts and opportunities within priority industries and feeder markets.
  • Maintain active relationships with top-producing accounts through regular sales calls, client meetings, site visits, entertainment, networking, and account reviews.
  • Develop account-specific strategies to increase room nights, rate, share of wallet, and overall account value.
  • Monitor corporate account production and identify opportunities for increased penetration and retention.
  • Partner with Revenue Management on negotiated rate strategies, account pricing, and annual corporate negotiations.
  • Ensure corporate clients receive a consistent, personalized, and elevated luxury experience throughout the sales and guest journey.

Group Business

  • Maintain direct sales responsibility for a designated group market segment, to be determined based on hotel business needs and market opportunity.
  • Develop and execute a targeted strategy to generate new group business and maximize production within the assigned segment.
  • Prospect, solicit, negotiate, and close group business in accordance with hotel strategy and established financial objectives.
  • Build and maintain relationships with meeting planners, intermediaries, corporate clients, agencies, and other group decision-makers.
  • Conduct site inspections, client presentations, sales appointments, entertainment, and other relationship-building activities.
  • Collaborate with Catering, Conference Services, Revenue Management, and Operations to ensure successful conversion and execution of group business.
  • Monitor group pace, pipeline, conversion, and production within the assigned segment and proactively address opportunities or challenges.
  • Ensure group business is strategically evaluated based on profitability, displacement, total account value, and alignment with hotel objectives.

Business Development

  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective business across assigned markets.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities through market research, competitive analysis, industry relationships, and prospecting.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with key clients, industry partners, travel professionals, meeting planners, and other business influencers.
  • Develop strategic account plans for key accounts and ensure appropriate follow-up and engagement.
  • Represent the hotel at trade shows, sales missions, conferences, industry events, and other business-development opportunities.
  • Leverage relationships with the luxury travel, corporate, entertainment, technology, professional services, and other relevant business communities to generate demand.
  • Work collaboratively with Marketing to identify opportunities for partnerships, client engagement, brand exposure, and market development.

Performance

  • Monitor sales production, market performance, account activity, and pipeline against established goals.
  • Prepare and present sales forecasts, performance reports, account updates, and strategic recommendations to hotel leadership.
  • Use data and market intelligence to make informed decisions regarding account priorities, sales resources, and business opportunities.
  • Partner with Revenue Management to evaluate group and corporate opportunities based on rate, demand, displacement, profitability, and overall account value.
  • Identify and actively pursue need-period opportunities while protecting the hotel’s long-term rate and brand positioning.
  • Ensure accurate forecasting and timely communication of business trends and potential risks or opportunities.
  • Hold the Sales team accountable for achieving established revenue and production objectives.

Qualifications

 QUALIFICATION STANDARDS Experience & Relevant Skills

  • 8+ years of hotel sales experience, with demonstrated success in luxury or upper-upscale hospitality.
  • Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, and developing a sales team.
  • Demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding sales and revenue goals.
  • Strong knowledge of the business travel, corporate, and group markets, with established industry relationships preferred.
  • Experience managing key corporate accounts and negotiating corporate agreements.
  • Experience generating and closing group business; specific group segment experience to align with the hotel’s business needs.
  • Strong understanding of hotel revenue management principles, including rate strategy, displacement, profitability, and optimal business mix.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic sales plans and translate market opportunities into measurable business results.
  • Strong financial and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret production reports, forecasts, market data, and performance metrics.
  • Exceptional relationship-building, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and results-oriented with a strong business-development mindset.
  • Ability to effectively coach, influence, and hold team members accountable while fostering a collaborative and positive culture.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Professional, polished, and service-oriented demeanor appropriate for a luxury hospitality environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and hotel sales/CRM systems.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for sales missions, trade shows, client visits, and industry events.
  • Flexibility to work occasional evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt is seeking a collaborative, analytical, and execution-focused Associate Manager to join our Global B2B Marketing team. This role helps bring Hyatt's highest-priority marketing strategies to life, supporting initiatives that drive World of Hyatt acquisition and engagement among B2B audiences.

Reporting to and working closely with the Marketing Manager, you will help translate strategy into integrated marketing campaigns through strong project management, cross-functional coordination, campaign execution, and performance optimization. This role is well suited for a marketer who is a skilled executor and enjoys solving problems, improving processes, using data to uncover insights, and finding ways to make marketing more effective.

As part of Hyatt's Global B2B Marketing team, you will collaborate with colleagues across Loyalty, Brand, Digital, Creative, Sales, Marketing Operations, Events, and Paid Media while building experience across integrated marketing, customer engagement, and campaign optimization. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

As an Associate Manager, you will lead the day-to-day execution and operational coordination of integrated marketing programs that advance Hyatt's global enterprise business objectives. You will help ensure campaigns are delivered efficiently and accurately, cross-functional teams remain aligned, and marketing initiatives are continuously optimized through data, insights, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, naturally curious, collaborative, and comfortable using data and insights to improve marketing performance. Success in this role comes from executing with excellence, anticipating needs, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping teams deliver stronger business results.

Campaign Execution & Project Management

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination and execution of integrated B2B marketing campaigns across digital, paid media, events, partnerships, sales enablement, and owned marketing channels.
  • Develop and maintain project timelines, marketing calendars, and campaign documentation to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Coordinate campaign deliverables across Creative, Digital, Marketing Operations, Paid Media, Loyalty, Sales, Brand, Events, and external agency partners.
  • Monitor project progress, proactively identify risks, and help resolve execution challenges to keep initiatives on track.
  • Ensure quality assurance across campaign assets, marketing communications, and customer experiences.

Marketing Performance & Insights Support

  • Monitor campaign performance and help to maintain reporting dashboards.
  • Analyze marketing results to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Conduct competitive research, audience analysis, and industry benchmarking to support marketing planning and future campaign recommendations.
  • Support campaign recaps by documenting key insights, learnings, and optimization opportunities.
  • Provide data-informed insights and recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and customer engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships across Marketing, Sales, Loyalty, Brand, Creative, Digital, Marketing Operations, Events, and agency partners.
  • Coordinate project meetings, status updates, tracking, and cross-functional communications to ensure alignment across stakeholders.
  • Communicate project risks early and recommend practical solutions that support successful execution.
  • Support the development of presentations, marketing materials, and stakeholder communications.

Operational Excellence

  • Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes, workflows, and team efficiency.
  • Help implement best practices that improve campaign execution, collaboration, and operational effectiveness.
  • Maintain organized project documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Support testing initiatives and help measure campaign performance to inform future optimization.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 3-5 years of integrated marketing experience.
  • Experience supporting multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance and using data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships across cross-functional teams.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
  • Hospitality, travel, loyalty, or B2B marketing experience.
  • Experience supporting B2B marketing campaigns, customer engagement programs, or lifecycle marketing initiatives.
  • Experience supporting industry events or tradeshow marketing.
  • Familiarity with Workfront and Adobe Analytics, or similar project management and analytics programs.

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $78,500 - $102,000. This position is also eligible to earn an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

About The Brand

Flight Centre Travel Groups dedicated business travel experts; Flight Centre Business Travel (FCBT) specialise in corporate travel solutions for small to medium companies. FCBT provides a people-led travel management service, offering hyper-personalised support, expert advice, and unique access to extensive corporate travel products. Acting as an extension of their client's team, FCBT delivers comprehensive travel management with a personal touch, making life easier and more productive for their clients.

About The Role

As a Business Development Manager at Flight Centre Business Travel, you will manage the entire business development cycle, from identifying prospects to pitching our services and securing new client partnerships, ultimately expanding our client portfolio.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Proactively identifying and engaging potential clients: Seek out new business opportunities and initiate contact with companies that could benefit from our comprehensive travel solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships across a multitude of role types, nurturing these connections to reinforce FCBT as a preferred and reliable partner.

Understanding their needs and presenting FCBT's offering: Engage with prospects to uncover their corporate travel requirements, booking behaviours, and pain points. Showcase the benefits of FCBT’s offering, clearly articulating how our solution can streamline their travel programs, save time, reduce costs, and support their business growth.

Supporting new clients through onboarding: Facilitate a smooth onboarding process to ensure new clients are well-integrated into our system and comfortable with our services. Introduce them to their dedicated travel team for direct access to support and expert advice from the outset.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1+ year experience working in a BDM role, heavily focused on B2B Sales/Development or experience working in a Sales role within the Travel & Tourism sector
  • An individual who thrives in a sales environment, is self-motivated, driven, and has a passion for delivering sales targets and achieving KPIs
  • Experience in selling a solution across various role types and a demonstrated ability to close opportunities
  • The ability to manage external and internal stakeholders through strong communication and delivery of outcomes
  • Extra points if you're a master of networking, lead generation and have impressive communication and presentation skills


What’s in it for you?

  • Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commission and exceptional year-on-year growth opportunities!
  • Exclusive Flight Centre perks! Through our pillars of Health, Wealth, Wise, Wanderlust, and Recharge, we bring our number one philosophy, #OurPeople, to life, offering award-winning benefits designed to prioritize YOU! Learn more at: https://www.benefits.fctgl.com/country/australia


Join us for a dynamic, growth-focused journey where your success is our top priority. If you're ready for an exciting career where your efforts are celebrated, we want you on our team!

Apply now!

job.job_description:
As Rooms Division Director, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the Front Office and Housekeeping departments, ensuring an exceptional luxury guest experience while driving departmental revenue, profitability, service excellence, and colleague engagement.

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for overseeing a large, unionized workforce across the Rooms Division. You will build strong, collaborative relationships with union representatives and colleagues, ensure compliance with collective bargaining agreements and applicable employment regulations, and foster a culture of accountability, respect, inclusion, and high performance.

As a senior leader of the hotel, you will champion our service culture, develop future leaders, and work closely with hotel leadership and key stakeholders to continuously elevate the guest experience and financial performance of the property.

What You’ll Do

Leadership & People Development

  • Provide inspirational leadership to the Front Office and Housekeeping departments, overseeing a large team of unionized and non-union colleagues.
  • Lead daily operations, establish priorities, and plan and assign work to ensure appropriate staffing levels and operational coverage.
  • Partner effectively with union representatives and ensure departmental practices are consistent with collective bargaining agreements, company policies, and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Build a high-performing, inclusive team culture grounded in trust, accountability, collaboration, and exceptional service.
  • Develop colleagues through coaching, feedback, recognition, performance management, and meaningful career and development opportunities.
  • Establish clear performance and development goals and actively support colleagues in achieving them.
  • Ensure colleagues receive the training, tools, resources, and support necessary to deliver luxury service and achieve operational and revenue objectives.
  • Recommend and initiate appropriate employee relations and HR actions in partnership with Human Resources.
  • Foster strong relationships across departments and create a true one-team culture throughout the hotel.

Rooms Division Operations

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of Front Office and Housekeeping, ensuring consistently high standards of service, cleanliness, efficiency, and guest satisfaction.
  • Ensure Front Office colleagues provide prompt, professional, personalized service and create genuine moments of recognition for every guest.
  • Ensure guests are warmly welcomed upon arrival and that leadership maintains a visible presence throughout the operation.
  • Respond personally and effectively to guest concerns and complaints, resolve issues with sound judgment, and use feedback to drive continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular inspections of the Front Office, guest arrival areas, public spaces, and other areas of responsibility, taking immediate action to address deficiencies.
  • Oversee the Night Audit function and ensure accurate preparation of daily financial and operational reports.
  • Maintain rigorous procedures for the security of cash, credit and financial transactions, guest security, inventory, and hotel assets.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, security, privacy, governmental, and brand requirements.
  • Communicate effectively with all relevant departments regarding VIP arrivals, large groups, key guests, special requests, and other operational requirements.
  • Coordinate convention, group, and business activities with Sales and other hotel departments to ensure seamless delivery of contracted services.
  • Serve as Manager on Duty as required and provide senior leadership during high-volume periods, special events, and operational challenges.

Financial & Commercial Performance

  • Drive Front Office and Rooms Division revenue and profitability while maintaining luxury service standards.
  • Use hotel systems, data, and established processes to maximize occupancy, ADR, upselling opportunities, and overall rooms revenue.
  • Develop and implement strategies to increase revenue through upselling, walk-in business, room upgrades, loyalty engagement, and other guest-facing opportunities.
  • Establish and achieve individual and departmental sales and profitability goals.
  • Analyze guest satisfaction, operational, financial, and market data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare and submit statistical, performance, forecast, and other management reports as required.
  • Partner with hotel leadership to prepare departmental budgets, financial plans, forecasts, and business strategies.
  • Regularly audit financial transactions and processes to ensure accuracy and compliance with governmental regulations, company standards, and data privacy requirements.

Guest Experience & Brand Leadership

  • Champion the hotel’s luxury service standards and ensure every guest interaction reflects the property’s brand promise.
  • Leverage guest satisfaction data and feedback to develop and implement action plans that consistently improve the guest experience.
  • Develop strong relationships with key clients, VIPs, business partners, vendors, and other external contacts to strengthen loyalty and identify revenue opportunities.
  • Provide guests with thoughtful and knowledgeable recommendations regarding hotel amenities, loyalty programs, restaurants, attractions, and experiences throughout San Francisco.
  • Lead initiatives to increase guest engagement and promote hotel services, amenities, experiences, and offerings.
  • Represent the hotel as a senior ambassador within the San Francisco community, building strong relationships with business leaders, civic officials, community organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
  • Support local brand awareness and reputation through community engagement, partnerships, and outreach.
  • Serve as a hotel representative for media inquiries when appropriate and in partnership with the hotel’s leadership and communications teams.
  • Effectively communicate the hotel’s sustainability initiatives and identify opportunities to leverage the property’s environmental and social commitments to create business opportunities.

Safety, Security & Crisis Leadership

  • Act as a central communication point during emergency and crisis situations, providing calm, decisive, and effective leadership.
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with local fire, police, emergency services, and other relevant agencies.
  • Ensure departmental teams understand and consistently follow all safety, security, emergency preparedness, and compliance procedures.

Marketing & Business Development

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, and other hotel leaders to identify opportunities to improve overall hotel performance.
  • Work with advertising agencies, consultants, vendors, and other external partners to maximize the effectiveness of marketing investments and ensure all communications align with brand standards.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance marketing initiatives, guest engagement, and overall hotel sales performance.
  • Support initiatives that strengthen the hotel’s visibility, reputation, and competitive position within the San Francisco market.

Other Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with colleagues across the hotel to deliver seamless guest experiences and operational excellence.
  • Take ownership of unexpected challenges and support the team wherever needed — including those moments when everyone must come together to get the job done.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Accountability

This is the senior Rooms Division leadership position within a large, luxury, resort-style or flagship hotel, characterized by a sophisticated guest profile, extensive facilities and services, significant competitive pressures, and a high volume of VIP, group, and key guests.

The Rooms Division Director has direct and indirect responsibility for a large Front Office and Housekeeping workforce, including a significant unionized employee population, and is accountable for operational excellence, colleague engagement, guest satisfaction, financial performance, labor management, and compliance across the division.

The successful candidate will be an experienced and highly visible hotel leader who can balance commercial objectives with exceptional service, effectively lead in a union environment, and inspire a diverse team to consistently deliver an elevated luxury experience.

Who We’re Looking For

Bachelor’s degree or higher education qualification in Hotel Administration, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

Minimum of four years of progressive hotel or guest service experience, including at least two years in a Rooms Division or hotel management department-head leadership role; equivalent education and experience may be considered.

Demonstrated experience leading large-scale Front Office and Housekeeping operations, preferably within a luxury, resort, major urban, or flagship hotel environment.

Proven experience leading large unionized teams and working constructively with union representatives in a collaborative, professional manner.

Strong understanding of collective bargaining agreements, labor practices, scheduling, employee relations, and labor cost management.

Demonstrated ability to lead through a complex, high-volume operation while maintaining exceptional guest and colleague experiences.

Strong financial acumen, including experience with budgeting, forecasting, labor management, revenue optimization, and departmental profitability.

Exceptional interpersonal, communication, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.

Proven ability to develop leaders and create a culture of accountability, engagement, recognition, and continuous improvement.

Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality standards and a genuine passion for delivering personalized guest experiences.

Ability to build trusted relationships with guests, colleagues, ownership, senior leadership, vendors, community partners, and other stakeholders.

Must be able to communicate effectively in English. Additional language skills are strongly preferred.

Must be comfortable serving as a highly visible ambassador for the hotel and representing the property within the San Francisco community.

Why You'll Love Working with IHG Hotels & Resorts at InterContinental San Francisco

The salary range for this position is $130,000 to $150,000. This role is eligible for bonus pay.

We believe in taking care of our colleagues with competitive pay, outstanding benefits, and meaningful career opportunities. Eligible colleagues enjoy:

  • FREE medical coverage and heavily subsidized dental, vision, and other insurance beginning the first of the month following your hire date.
  • Complimentary chef-prepared meals in our Colleague Dining Room.

job.job_description:
• At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers
  • A fantastic opportunity to lead and coach squads to deliver world class products
  • Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide


Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.


As the Delivery Lead, you will sit across digital product streams including mobile applications, conversational AI and customer servicing. You will lead agile squads to deliver features aligned with strategic goals, while mentoring teams to improve delivery practices and agile maturity. You’ll foster a culture of autonomy, collaboration, and transparency.


Your primary responsibility is to plan and coordinate product delivery, ensuring alignment to agreed agile practices and frameworks. You’ll coach teams to improve agile maturity, foster collaboration, and remove impediments to maintain delivery flow. By driving continuous improvement, reducing waste, and optimising resource utilisation, you’ll help teams deliver value early and consistently.


This is a unique opportunity to play an instrumental role in shaping culture, ways of working and support squad ramp-up at the new Qantas Product Innovation Centre based in Adelaide.


You’ll have:

  • 3+ years as an Agile Delivery Lead or Agile Iteration Manager in a digital environment
  • Proven ability to plan and coordinate delivery from discovery through to release, optimising time to value
  • Demonstrated ability to coach individuals and squads in adopting Agile mindsets and practices, enabling high-performing teams
  • Proficient in multiple agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking, and other frameworks
  • Strong capability in risk and issue identification and management
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence and Miro


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drive success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.


Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.


Applications close on the 5th of October

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

Agoda is very excited to launch a new B2C fintech product

As Senior Business Analyst – New verticals, you will play a key role in defining, launching and growing the product across different markets. You'll devise, own and execute initiatives to drive acquisition, transaction growth and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to incubate and grow a new business vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

We are looking for someone who can handle ambiguity well while remaining independent in developing fast-paced initiatives across this new and interesting product.

In this Role, You Will

  • Help on defining the Product Customer Value Proposition and Go To Market (GTM) Strategy
  • Design optimization strategy for the product across the full funnel – from user across key business metrices (i.e., acquisition, activation, transaction growth, top-ups loyalty and customer engagement)
  • Execute the marketing strategy: e.g., 
    • Launch the different marketing channels (e.g., paid search, app campaigns, affiliates) 
    • Optimize performance campaigns across channels such as; App campaigns, KOL initiative and Paid search
    • Optimize incentives via campaigns across markets to drive business objectives while maintaining sustainable unit economics
    • Work closely with Product and Design to Shape onboarding, in-app messaging, and key user journeys
    • Collaborate with Fintech, Legal, and Compliance to ensure campaigns, claims, and messaging are accurate, compliant, and easy for customers to understand and translate regulatory constraints into clear, user‑friendly communications
    • Build and continuously improve dashboards, reporting, and processes on your respective portfolio to scale operationally over time.
    • This is a sole contributor role with strong visibility across Managers and Directors

    What You’ll Need To Succeed

    Must Have Qualifications
  • Marketing expertise: At least 3 years of experience with running strategic initiative within the e-commerce, consulting, OTA and fintech space
  • Strong analytical skills:
    • Comfortable working with data and performance metrics (CAC, LTV, activation, retention, payback, cohorts)
    • Ability to pull and analyze data using SQL and/or self‑serve BI tools
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial / builder mentality:
    • Able to operate in ambiguity, set up new processes, and “figure things out” without a playbook.
    • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently
    • Ability to think strategically, learn fast and understand new business dynamics
    • Innate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomes
    • Bias for action and experimentation
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating with multi team in multiple department 

    Nice to Have

    • Experience with Direct marketing, Performance marketing and Affiliate marketing for financial products
    • Experience in consulting, investment banking, e-commerce, fintech or financial services, such as Travel cards, multi‑currency wallets
    • Experience launching or scaling a new product or major feature as part of a team

At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Overview

Du hast Lust während deines Studiums viele praktische Erfahrung zu sammeln, wichtige Kompetenzen zu erlernen und nützliche Kontakte zu knüpfen, die deiner Karriere weiterhelfen? Dann bist du bei Enterprise genau richtig!

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und ungeahnten Aufstiegschancen. Stell dir über 1,7 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit 80.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 22,5 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns!

Responsibilities

Dein Praktikum wirst du in einer unserer 200 deutschlandweit Teams absolvieren und so unser Unternehmen von der Pike auf kennenlernen. Kaffeekochen und Kopieren steht für unsere Praktikanten nicht auf dem Programm: Vom ersten Arbeitstag an wirst du ins Tagesgeschäft mit einbezogen und erlernst so neue Kenntnisse wie Führungsqualitäten, Flexibilität und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten "on the job". Dabei erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und spannende Herausforderungen im Kundenservice, im Vertrieb, im Marketing oder im Business-Management. So zum Beispiel:

  • Verkaufsgespräche zu führen
  • Geschäftspartnerschaften aufzubauen und zu pflegen
  • Effektiv mit Kunden, Lieferanten und Kollegen zu kommunizieren und zu interagieren
  • Kostenkontrolle
  • Strategien zur Konfliktlösung
  • Flottenplanung

Bei Enterprise ist kein Tag wie der andere!

Und das Beste: Wenn du dich nach deinem Hochschulabschluss entscheidest, an unserem Management Trainee Programm teilzunehmen, dann werden dir die bereits im Praktikum erworbenen Kenntnisse angerechnet. Das verkürzt deine Zeit als Trainee und einer steilen Karriere bei Enterprise steht nichts mehr im Wege. Selbst wenn du dich nach dem Studium entscheidest, woanders zu arbeiten, so hast du doch durch dein Praktikum bei uns eine erstklassige Berufserfahrung vorzuweisen, die nicht nur auf deinem Lebenslauf gut aussieht, sondern dir in Jobinterviews und in deiner weiteren Karriere helfen wird. Ein Praktikum im Management bei Enterprise lohnt sich also wirklich! Und das auch im wörtlichen Sinne, denn alle unsere Praktika werden vergütet.

Qualifications

Unsere Praktika sind um dich herum konzipiert. Es spielt für uns keine Rolle, in welchem Semester du bist, welchen Studiengang du studierst oder wann du bei uns anfangen willst. Wie lange willst du dein Praktikum bei uns absolvieren? Das hängt ganz von dir ab. Du hast die Wahl zwischen mehrmonatigen Sommerpraktika bis hin zu ganzjährigen Praktika, die du jederzeit beginnen kannst. Und bei der großen Auswahl an unseren Filialen in Deutschland haben wir mit Sicherheit auch einen freien Praktikumsplatz an deinem Wunschort.

Wir freuen uns, wenn du motiviert bist, Eigeninitiative zeigst und Verantwortung übernehmen willst. Alles andere bringen wir dir während deines Praktikums bei. Und es werden sich für dich viele interessante Möglichkeiten und Situationen ergeben, in denen du richtig loslegen und uns zeigen kannst, was in dir steckt – egal wie lange du bei uns bleibst.

Auch Solltest Du In Deinem Gepäck Haben

  • Eine unbegrenzte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein und 1 Jahr lang Fahrpraxis.
  • Höchstens 3 Punkt im Fahreignungsregister (FAER) in Flensburg und keine Vermerke in deiner Fahrerakte aus den letzten 5 Jahren aufgrund von Alkohol- oder Drogendelikten.
  • Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

Bitte bewirb dich nur einmal, und zwar direkt auf die Stelle in der Region, in der du arbeiten möchtest. Bei deinem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiter kannst du aber gerne die möglichen Einsatzgebiete noch im Detail besprechen.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Growth & Strategic Initiatives Manager

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

We are looking for a Senior Growth & Strategic Initiatives Manager to help lead the next chapter of creator and social at Expedia Group. Creator has evolved from a marketing channel into an enterprise capability that can shape brand equity, audience growth, content efficiency, reputation, acquisition, loyalty, and revenue. Our Creator & Social team builds trust, relevance, and demand through creative ideas, strong partnerships, and a deep understanding of travelers on social.

Working across brand-level creator leads and pods, you will connect the macro business environment to brand strategies, champion the strongest work, and create the strategic center of excellence that enables greater clarity, integration, and scale.

This leader will connect business strategy, social, creators, partnerships, and emerging commercial models—identifying not simply how to activate opportunities, but which opportunities the business should pursue and why. This is not a traditional campaign execution, talent-management, influencer-sourcing, or content-calendar role. You will mobilize, integrate, scale, measure, and champion the work that makes creator and social valuable across the business.

In this role, you will

  • Determine how to win with creators and social—whether through creator, social, talent, partnership, content, affiliate, or a combination—and turn that choice into a compelling story that sells the strategy, investment, and path to impact
  • Shape the enterprise portfolio of creator and social investments—help determine which cultural, entertainment, sports, celebrity, platform, and affiliate opportunities best solve priority business problems, create distinctive audience value, and compound across brands and markets; recommend what to fund, scale, sequence, or decline based on expected impact, commercial potential, and opportunity cost
  • Own global expansion and cross-brand integration by determining what should travel across markets, what requires localization, and what should remain market-specific; scale high-quality assets and creator-led storytelling for growth and paid social channels
  • Champion and scale creator business models, including affiliate monetization, creator commerce, loyalty integration, product and content partnerships, performance economics, creator-owned audiences, and platform partnerships
  • Integrate across brand-level creator leads and up-level brand-level strategies in partnership with their owners; connect those strategies to cross-brand and enterprise opportunities while identifying shared systems, learning, investment, and amplification opportunities
  • Support measurement and use data, amplification insight, and performance signals to strengthen strategies and tell a more compelling story of impact across creator-owned, brand-owned, paid, and earned environments
  • Independently counsel senior leaders and influence across marketing, communications, media, product, loyalty, legal, finance, procurement, agencies, and geographic teams; lead agencies at the strategy and creative level; and build scalable decision frameworks, operating mechanisms, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Lead and develop a team of five or more while raising strategic standards and leadership capability across the broader creator and social community, including partnership with brand-level creator leads

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have deep, senior-level experience (10+ years) in both social strategy and creator strategy (not a social strategist who has occasionally worked with influencers, and not a creator specialist who cannot evaluate an organic social strategy)
  • You have led integrated, multi-brand or enterprise programs and can coach, develop, and up-level brand-level strategies in partnership with individual brand leads
  • You have translated business and marketing objectives into integrated social, creator, partnership, channel, and commercial strategies, then sold those strategies through compelling stories and data-backed recommendations to senior audiences
  • You have owned or led global expansion, growth-market programs, local-market adaptation, platform-funded programs, and the scaling of creator-led assets for growth and paid social channels
  • You have developed creator commercialization or emerging business models, such as affiliate platforms, social-first commerce, loyalty, product integration, performance partnerships, creator-owned audiences, or new distribution models
  • You bring a portfolio and investment mindset and can recommend what to fund, stop, or sequence—and what information is needed before deciding
  • You have executive presence and judgment, including the ability to counsel senior leaders, challenge assumptions, navigate organizational complexity, and influence without formal authority
  • You have experience with creator amplification and measurement across owned, paid, and earned channels, using data and performance signals to sharpen strategy; you also bring strategic agency leadership and celebrity, high-profile talent, or major cultural partnership experience
  • You have built and led teams, strengthened operating systems, raised talent capability beyond your direct reporting line, and are familiar with AI-enabled tools and automation
  • You are an exceptional storyteller who makes complex strategic choices clear, compelling, and actionable

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing a commercial strategy covering all segments and channels to maximize total revenue and profit performance, as well as market share penetration of the hotel. As a Commercial Director, you’re not just leading commercial strategy across multiple segments and revenue streams – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Own commercial strategy and execution: Develop and implement integrated commercial strategies across all revenue streams — including Group, Conference, and Events (GCE), Rooms, Food and Beverage, Leisure, and Spa — to drive top-line performance and market share growth
  • Maximize revenue and profitability: Partner with General Managers and Finance to ensure commercial decisions support revenue goals, optimize cost of sales, and deliver profit and margin targets
  • Lead pricing and forecasting strategy: Oversee revenue management practices, including pricing, rate strategies, demand forecasting, and business reviews, to optimize revenue across all segments
  • Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
  • Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
  • Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 8+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience leading and managing sales or commercial teams.
  • Proven experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration within matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial data to inform strategic and tactical decisions.
  • Track record of identifying and evaluating new business opportunities.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel industry operations.
  • Cross-disciplinary exposure to Marketing, E-commerce, and Finance functions.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Additional Information

Job Number 26105622

Job Category Sales & Marketing

Location Barnard's Inn 86 Fetter Lane, London, London, United Kingdom, EC4A 1ENVIEW ON MAP

Schedule Full Time

Located Remotely? N

Position Type Management

Job Summary

The Account Director, GSO London (Sports & Entertainment) manages and/or provides dedicated support to a targeted portfolio of complex GSO accounts. The position builds and maintains business relationships with key buying influences in order to achieve account market share goals across all Marriott Lodging brands. The primary focus is on opportunities to increase preference, loyalty, and improve the overall buying process by emphasizing an ‘ease of doing business with Marriott’. In the role of Account Director, GSO London (Sports & Entertainment) this position has direct accountability for sales activities within their assigned accounts.

BUSINESS CONTEXT

The role of the Account Director, GSO London (Sports & Entertainment) is to support the GSO vision and mission by leveraging Marriott’s products and services as a team leader or team member within their assigned account portfolio. By utilizing the processes of strategic account management and team-based sales, this position will be responsible for increasing Marriott’s preference, loyalty and profitable share within their assigned accounts and contribute to overall GSO success through the direct sales efforts of Revenue Generation and Value Creation.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience Preferred

  • 5+ years sales and marketing experience required.
  • Total Account Management experience preferred.
  • Hospitality sales experience preferred.
  • Strong preference for candidate who speaks English

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Account Management

  • Accurate qualification of potential accounts; re-qualification of existing accounts.
  • Establishes and maintains complete and up-to-date information on each account. This includes a thorough understanding of the account’s needs, history, plans, issues, organizational structure, strategies, existing business alliances and key competitors.
  • Interprets financial statements, e.g., P&L statements, annual reports, as appropriate, to assist in the formulation of an “account” proposal.
  • Maintains account information in SFA to ensure accurate and up-to-date account reporting.
  • Manages all resources within budgeted guidelines.
  • Proactively develop goals and objectives to support the strategic account plan.
  • Represents all brands of Marriott Lodging.
  • Responsible for proactive account or segment sales.
  • Supports data gathering, reporting & tracking functions

Revenue Generation

  • Identifies, develops, initiates and manages opportunities based on their fit with broader strategic account initiatives.
  • Identifies key purchase points and decision-makers that influence the “buy” decision.
  • Networks account teams to maximize coverage of key contacts and revenue streams.
  • Partners with HQ support for annual pricing process, requests for pricing (RFPs) and related maintenance activity.
  • Relates customer needs to product capabilities.
  • Routinely quantifies the business impact to both the customer and Marriott.
  • Works with Revenue Management to support account strategy in-market.

Value Creation

  • Anticipates and quickly seizes opportunities not obvious to others to build customer satisfaction.
  • Brings cross-functional and cross-business knowledge to bear in developing business solutions.
  • Delivers value-added products and services to create long term customer loyalty.
  • Establishes and maintains relationships with key buying influences by developing and delivering ‘ease of doing business’ solutions that create and provide unique value and positioning.
  • Positions self as “Subject Matter Expert” in terms of customer or account activity, business segment activity or market/region activity.
  • Pursues initiatives to capitalize on strengths and market opportunities, and to counter competitive threats

Customer Preference & Loyalty

  • Conducts information-oriented sessions at each level of influence within the account or customer base in order to foster and maintain commitment to Marriott as a strategic supplier/partner.
  • Counsels internal stakeholders on optimal negotiating stance.
  • Delivers value-added products and services to create long term customer preference and loyalty.
