Additional Information

Job Number26118465

Job CategoryRevenue Management

Location555 Canal St, New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, 70130 VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $102,000-$137,000 annually

Bonus Eligible: Y

Job Summary

Manages rooms and function space inventory and ensures inventory is allocated and restricted properly to maximize revenue and profits. Responsible for building all rates, packages and hotel sales strategy information in the hotel(s)’ inventory systems. The position recommends pricing and positioning of cluster properties. In addition, the position oversees the inventory management system to verify appropriateness of agreed upon selling strategies. Responsible for the analysis of revenue, profit and demand associated with hotel rooms and space inventory in a given market or cluster. Position prepares forecasts, budgets, weekly and daily projections and analyzes the progress of each. Position critiques sales strategy effectiveness and prepares historical and future analysis of revenue and profit opportunities

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 1 year experience in the revenue management, sales and marketing, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Executing Revenue Management Projects and Strategy

  • Manages room authorizations, rates and restrictions.
  • Manages function space authorizations, restrictions and rental.
  • Manages rooms inventory to maximize cluster rooms revenue.
  • Maintains the transient rooms inventory for the hotel(s) and responsible for maximizing transient revenue.
  • Releases group rooms back into general inventory and ensures clean booking windows for customers
  • Ensures that the hotel(s) sales strategies are effectively implemented in the reservation system and the inventory system.
  • Prepares sales strategy critique.
  • Monitors transient and group inventory daily to ensure straight-line availability and maximization of revenue potential for all brands.
  • Ensures that sales strategies and rate restrictions are communicated, implemented and modified as market conditions fluctuate.
  • Supports cluster selling initiatives by working with all reservation centers.
  • Uses reservations system and demand forecasting systems to determine, implement and control selling strategies.
  • Ensures property diagnostic processes (PDP) are used to maximize revenue and profits.
  • Initiates, implements and evaluates revenue tests.
  • Provides recommendations to improve effectiveness of revenue management processes.
  • Ensures compliance and participation in company promotions and eCommerce channels
  • Ensures all hotels follow brand strategies that will maintain and/or increase the hotel(s) revenue per available room (RevPAR) and revenue per available square foot (RevPAS).
  • Understands the working relationship between sales, reservations and property management systems.
  • Participates in quarterly regional reviews
  • Promotes and protects brand equity.
  • Achieves and exceeds goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
  • Attends meetings to plan, organize, prioritize, coordinate and manage activities and solutions.
  • Establishes long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them.
  • Takes a predetermined strategy and drives the execution of that strategy.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
  • Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).
  • Explores opportunities that drive profit, create value for clients, and encourage innovation; challenges existing processes/systems/products to make improvements.

Analyzing and Reporting Revenue Management Data

  • Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
  • Creates long range forecast for rooms and catering by segment and updates forecast every period.
  • Creates weekly forecast for property operations and staffing purposes
  • Conducts sales strategy analysis and refines as appropriate to increase market share for all properties.
  • Maintains accurate reservation system information.
  • Analyzes period end and other available systems data to identify trends, future need periods and obstacles to achieving goals.
  • Generates updates on transient segment each period.
  • Assists with account diagnostics process and validates conclusions.
  • Provides revenue analysis functional expertise to general managers, property leadership teams and market sales leaders.
  • Prepares forecasts of revenue, profit, demand and occupancy for rooms and function space – three-month and six month, long range and budget.
  • Prepares revenue and profit opportunity analysis.
  • Manages all revenue, profit and demand data associated with rooms and function space
  • Develops and/or uses analytical tools and systems to maximize revenues and profit.
  • Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
  • Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
  • Using computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to program, write software, set up functions, enter data, or process information.
  • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships in a proactive manner.
  • Acts as a liaison, when necessary, between property and regional/corporate systems support.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Partner with operational leaders to build leadership capability, strengthen culture and drive performance across Qantas Freight
  • Join a high-performing People team supporting a complex and nationally connected operation
  • Permanent, full-time opportunity based in Melbourne or Brisbane airport

The aviation sector doesn’t stand still. Challenged to adapt and change, we’ve responded by reinventing our customer experience, broadening our business and achieving what was thought impossible. This allows us to stand strong as the Qantas Group.

The People Manager is a critical strategic partner to the business, operating within Qantas' recently enhanced People operating model that has significantly lifted capability, influence and the impact delivered by our business partnering team. Supporting Qantas Freight, this role partners closely with terminal and operational leaders across Melbourne and Brisbane to shape and deliver people strategies that strengthen leadership capability, improve employee engagement and support a high-performing, safety-focused culture.

Working in a complex operational environment, the People Manager leads and delivers the People plan while coaching leaders, driving organisational effectiveness initiatives and supporting change across a workforce of approximately 400 employees. Partnering with stakeholders across multiple locations and industrial frameworks, this role plays a key part in building leadership capability, enhancing ways of working and creating greater alignment across the Freight operation. As part of a collaborative national People team, you'll also have the opportunity to contribute to broader strategic projects that support the future growth and success of the business.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

  • Strong HR business partnering capability with experience in an operational and industrial workforce
  • Demonstrated ability to strategically partner with business in large organisation
  • Proven ability managing change and building organisational capability
  • Strong stakeholder management ability
  • Proven ability to work in a matrixed environment with a geographically dispersed workforce
  • Commercial acumen and proven ability to understand the operation
  • Proven interpersonal and relationship development skills
  • The ability to work autonomously whilst remaining collaborative and considered as a part of a broader team  
  • Strong verbal, written and presentation skills with an ability to communicate in both technical and business language
  • Driven to succeed, self-motivated and able to work independently with limited direction or guidance
  • Tertiary qualification in HR/Business related degree or equivalent experience required

Why Qantas? 

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. 

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.  

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel. 

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including up to 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.  
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.

Applications close: Friday, 25th of September 2026

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we fly into airports around the entire world. And we need a whole team of people to keep things running in tip-top shape! From the exceptional service at the check-in counter to the departure gate, and even behind the scenes making sure your checked bags arrive with you, our Airport Operations team keeps operations at our airports running smoothly every single day.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Senior Manager will be third in command in the airport for the Customer Service department and drive safety, service delivery, operational performance, and financial goals. The Senior Manager will collaborate with the Managing Director & Director of Customer Service to develop an inclusive culture and engaged workforce comprised of union, management & administrative employees. Responsible for delivering measurable results through servant leadership, innovation, coaching, and rapid execution in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Success will require collaboration with all divisions across the hub (e.g. Flight Operations, Inflight Operations, Technical Operations, etc.), airport authorities and agencies (e.g. TSA, U.S Customs and Border Protection), vendors, and with UA union leadership to ensure correct administration of collective bargaining agreements and ongoing positive union-management relations.

  • Operations Leadership - Ensure the safe and successful execution of all Customer Service activities within budget.Identify and resolve recurring issues to improve operational metrics and the customer experience.
  • Employee Engagement - Inspire and motivate frontline and management employees to perform at the highest levels. Identify and resolve employee concerns, and foster a culture of recognition and support.
  • Project Execution - Lead and/or be an active participant in airport and enterprise-wide initiatives. Collaborate with peers in other operating divisions and with leaders in corporate support functions to make measurable improvements.
  • Leadership Development - Provide ongoing coaching and feedback to Managers, Senior Supervisors, Supervisors, and Lead Customer Service Representatives. Support efforts to attract and retain a diverse, high performing leadership team.
  • Strategic Planning - Collaborate with department and hub leaders in the development of department and airport-wide strategies.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field or 5+ years of related management experience
  • 2+ years experience analyzing metrics, identifying trends in quantitative and qualitative data, and determining root causes of key issues
  • 2+ years experience identifying and implementing measurable process improvements
  • 2+ years experience managing, coaching and developing professional employees
  • 2+ years experience managing competing priorities and executing in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • 2+ years experience independently managing projects and/or initiatives with measurable outcomes
  • Performance Management: Ability to select, assess, coach, and develop supervisors and managers
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to interpret data and develop actionable insights
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with and influence peers and stakeholders across divisions within the hub and within the Corporate Support Center (CSC)
  • Executive presence and strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to comfortably and confidently communicate with employees at all levels, including frontline employees in breakrooms and executive team members in board rooms.
  • Ability to effectively represent the company and the UA brand externally.
  • Tireless and resilient, with the ability to provide unwavering support to a 24/7/365 operation and remain calm under pressure
  • Ability to inspire and energize employees at all levels and to demonstrate empathy to employees and customers
  • Ability to innovate, fail fast, and make continuous operational improvements
  • Self-starter, with the ability to lead and execute with limited direction
  • Ability to quickly learn and develop subject matter expertise
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • MBA or Advanced Degree
  • Lean / Six Sigma certifications
  • Project Management Certification
  • Experience organizing complex and/or ambiguous challenges into structured deliverables and executing or project managing deliverables to completion
  • Previous airline, high volume manufacturing or operations experience
  • Experience leading hourly and/or unionized employees
  • Experience in hospitality or a customer-centric role
  • Experience leading large, diverse teams with 500+ employees
  • Ability to create presentations for senior leaders
  • Understanding of resource planning and labor finance
  • Understanding of business case development
  • Understanding of collective bargaining agreements
  • Proficient in data analysis fundamentals and basic statistics
  • Ability to create and execute a vision; ability to think strategically and to translate strategies into realistic action plans
  • Emotional intelligence (EQ)
  • Change management
  • Continuous Improvement

The base pay range for this role is $127,870.00 to $166,492.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

Agoda is very excited to launch a new B2C fintech product

As Senior Business Analyst – New verticals, you will play a key role in defining, launching and growing the product across different markets. You'll devise, own and execute initiatives to drive acquisition, transaction growth and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to incubate and grow a new business vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

We are looking for someone who can handle ambiguity well while remaining independent in developing fast-paced initiatives across this new and interesting product.

In this Role, You Will

  • Help on defining the Product Customer Value Proposition and Go To Market (GTM) Strategy
  • Design optimization strategy for the product across the full funnel – from user across key business metrices (i.e., acquisition, activation, transaction growth, top-ups loyalty and customer engagement)
  • Execute the marketing strategy: e.g., 
    • Launch the different marketing channels (e.g., paid search, app campaigns, affiliates) 
    • Optimize performance campaigns across channels such as; App campaigns, KOL initiative and Paid search
    • Optimize incentives via campaigns across markets to drive business objectives while maintaining sustainable unit economics
    • Work closely with Product and Design to Shape onboarding, in-app messaging, and key user journeys
    • Collaborate with Fintech, Legal, and Compliance to ensure campaigns, claims, and messaging are accurate, compliant, and easy for customers to understand and translate regulatory constraints into clear, user‑friendly communications
    • Build and continuously improve dashboards, reporting, and processes on your respective portfolio to scale operationally over time.
    • This is a sole contributor role with strong visibility across Managers and Directors

    What You’ll Need To Succeed

    Must Have Qualifications
  • Marketing expertise: At least 3 years of experience with running strategic initiative within the e-commerce, consulting, OTA and fintech space
  • Strong analytical skills:
    • Comfortable working with data and performance metrics (CAC, LTV, activation, retention, payback, cohorts)
    • Ability to pull and analyze data using SQL and/or self‑serve BI tools
  • Demonstrated entrepreneurial / builder mentality:
    • Able to operate in ambiguity, set up new processes, and “figure things out” without a playbook.
    • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to work independently
    • Ability to think strategically, learn fast and understand new business dynamics
    • Innate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomes
    • Bias for action and experimentation
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating with multi team in multiple department 

    Nice to Have

    • Experience with Direct marketing, Performance marketing and Affiliate marketing for financial products
    • Experience in consulting, investment banking, e-commerce, fintech or financial services, such as Travel cards, multi‑currency wallets
    • Experience launching or scaling a new product or major feature as part of a team

At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.

job.job_description:
Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Lead Business Development Manager, Advertising

We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Business Development Manager to grow Expedia Group Advertising’s North American business. This person will identify and develop new advertiser and agency relationships, manage complex sales cycles from prospecting through close, and expand strategic partnerships across the travel and non-travel ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines consultative selling, strong executive presence, disciplined pipeline management, and a deep understanding of digital advertising. They will translate advertiser objectives into compelling media solutions and collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Insights and Planning, Legal, Finance, and Account Management to deliver sustainable partner value.

What You Will Do

  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of direct advertisers and agency partners across North America.
  • Own the end-to-end business-development cycle: territory planning, prospecting, discovery, solution development, proposal creation, negotiation, close, and handoff.
  • Develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across marketing, media, e-commerce, partnerships, and finance organizations.
  • Lead consultative conversations that connect advertiser business objectives to Expedia Group audiences, inventory, creative capabilities, measurement, and traveler insights.
  • Create account and territory strategies for priority verticals, with an initial emphasis on financial services and other non-endemic advertisers.
  • Partner with internal specialists to develop integrated media proposals across display, sponsored listings, audience solutions, and related advertising products.
  • Prepare and deliver persuasive presentations, business cases, media plans, and executive-level recommendations.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, activity, forecast, and next-step data in Salesforce and related reporting tools.
  • Collaborate with Account Management and cross-functional partners to ensure a smooth transition from closed business to activation and long-term growth.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive offerings, advertiser needs, and agency dynamics to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Represent Expedia Group Advertising at relevant industry events, client meetings, and executive forums.
  • Share customer feedback and market insight with Product, Marketing, Insights, and leadership teams to improve our offerings and go-to-market approach.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Delivery against annual and quarterly revenue, bookings, and pipeline targets.
  • Growth in qualified pipeline coverage and conversion through the sales funnel.
  • New advertiser and agency relationships established across priority verticals.
  • Quality and predictability of forecasting, opportunity management, and Salesforce hygiene.
  • Strength of executive-level client relationships and partner satisfaction.
  • Successful cross-functional execution from prospecting through launch and handoff.
  • Contribution to repeatable sales plays, market insights, and scalable go-to-market practices.

Experience And Qualifications

  • Significant experience in business development, digital advertising sales, media partnerships, ad technology, agency sales, or a closely related commercial role.
  • A demonstrated record of exceeding revenue or pipeline goals in a complex, consultative sales environment.
  • Experience managing multi-stakeholder sales cycles with senior client and agency decision-makers.
  • Strong knowledge of digital advertising, including programmatic, display, sponsored media, audience targeting, measurement, or related solutions.
  • Excellent discovery, storytelling, negotiation, presentation, and written communication skills.
  • Ability to turn ambiguous customer needs into clear commercial strategies and actionable proposals.
  • Strong business judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort working with performance data.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and collaborate effectively across functions.
  • High standards for organization, follow-through, accountability, and CRM discipline.
  • Willingness to travel periodically for client meetings, industry events, and team collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to financial-services, fintech, insurance tech, retail, technology, travel, or other non-endemic advertisers.
  • Existing relationships with major brands, media agencies, holding companies, or agency trading desks.
  • Experience selling multi-channel or integrated media solutions.
  • Familiarity with travel audiences, destination marketing, loyalty ecosystems, or marketplace businesses.
  • Experience working with Salesforce, Tableau, or comparable sales and reporting platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in Seattle is $200,000.00 to $280,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $320,000.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount. The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in New York is $216,000.00 to $302,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $345,500.00, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Incentive plan performance above target will also earn more than the incentive target compensation amount.

Job Description

Hilton is seeking a strategic and influential leader to join our Regional Operations team as Director, Operations Support – Japan, Korea & Micronesia (JKM).

This role serves as a key member of the JKM Operations leadership team, partnering closely with the Area Vice President, General Managers, hotel owners, and regional functional leaders to drive operational excellence, business performance, strategic initiatives, and organizational capability across the portfolio.

The Director will lead and oversee priority operational projects, support the execution of regional growth and transformation strategies, and ensure alignment with Hilton's commercial objectives, brand standards, and guest experience expectations. Through effective stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration, the role will help accelerate performance, strengthen operational capabilities, and drive sustainable business results across the JKM region.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

Strategic Operations Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the Area Vice President (AVP) on operational priorities, business performance, and strategic initiatives across Japan, Korea, & Micronesia.
  • Support the development and execution of regional operational strategies that drive revenue growth, profitability, guest satisfaction, and team member engagement.
  • Identify operational opportunities and risks, providing recommendations and implementation plans to optimize portfolio performance.
  • Lead special projects and strategic initiatives on behalf of the AVP.

Portfolio Performance & Operational Excellence

  • Partner with General Managers and hotel leadership teams to improve operational effectiveness and execution of Hilton's standards and priorities.
  • Monitor performance trends across the portfolio and coordinate action plans to address key business challenges.
  • Facilitate operational reviews, performance discussions, and follow-up actions to ensure continuous improvement.
  • Champion best practice sharing and operational consistency across the region.

Owner & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with hotel ownership groups, management teams, and regional stakeholders.
  • Represent JKM Operations in owner meetings, business reviews, and strategic discussions where appropriate.
  • Support alignment between ownership priorities and Hilton's operational objectives.
  • Influence without direct authority across a complex matrix organization.

Transformation & Project Leadership

  • Lead the planning and execution of high-impact regional initiatives, including operational transformation, process improvement, capability-building programs, and strategic projects.
  • Ensure initiatives are effectively implemented, measured, and sustained across the JKM region.
  • Drive project governance, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, and change management efforts.
  • Collaborate with regional and global partners to support enterprise-wide initiatives.

Procurement & Strategic Partnerships

  • Partner with Procurement and relevant functional teams to support strategic supplier relationships, regional sourcing initiatives, and operational efficiencies.
  • Evaluate opportunities to drive value, consistency, and quality across the JKM portfolio.
  • Support contract review and implementation of approved operational partnerships and programs.

Talent Development & Capability Building

  • Champion operational learning and development initiatives across the region.
  • Lead deployment of key operational training programs and capability-building frameworks.
  • Mentor General Managers, Directors of Operations, and emerging operational leaders.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive hospitality operations experience, including significant leadership responsibility.
  • Experience as a General Manager, Director of Operations, Regional Operations leader, or comparable corporate operations role, supporting multi-property or regional hotel operations.
  • Experience working with hotel owners and asset management groups.
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional projects and transformation initiatives.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to interpret operational and financial performance metrics.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders, owners, and hotel leadership teams.
  • Exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Outstanding presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English and Japanese, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to travel within the region as required.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests - we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career — and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay - we’re a great place to work.

Park Hyatt Cancún

Ubicación: Quintana Roo

Descripción del empleo

Objetivo de la posición:

Realizar actividades de instalación, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo y diagnóstico de equipos de aire acondicionado, ventilación y refrigeración, garantizando su óptimo funcionamiento, la continuidad de la operación y el cumplimiento de las normas de seguridad y calidad establecidas por la empresa.

Experiencia y aptitudes deseadas

Responsabilidades del puesto:

  • Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos en equipos de aire acondicionado y refrigeración.
  • Diagnosticar fallas eléctricas, mecánicas y electrónicas en sistemas HVAC y de refrigeración.
  • Instalar equipos de aire acondicionado tipo mini split, paquete, fan & coil, chillers y sistemas de refrigeración comercial e industrial.
  • Realizar carga, recuperación y manejo de gases refrigerantes conforme a las normativas aplicables.
  • Verificar y reparar componentes como compresores, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansión y controles eléctricos.
  • Interpretar diagramas eléctricos, mecánicos y de refrigeración.
  • Realizar pruebas de funcionamiento y puesta en marcha de equipos.
  • Elaborar reportes de servicio y mantenimiento.
  • Mantener herramientas y equipos de trabajo en condiciones óptimas.
  • Cumplir los procedimientos de seguridad industrial y uso de equipo de protección personal.

Informar oportunamente necesidades de refacciones, materiales y equipos.

Requisitos:

  • Carrera técnica en Refrigeración y Aire Acondicionado, Electromecánica, Electricidad Industrial o afín.
  • Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en mantenimiento e instalación de equipos de aire acondicionado y refrigeración.
  • Experiencia en sistemas residenciales, comerciales o industriales.

Conocimientos Técnicos

  • Refrigeración comercial e industrial.
  • Sistemas HVAC.
  • Electricidad y controles eléctricos.
  • Lectura e interpretación de planos y diagramas.
  • Compresores herméticos, semiherméticos y scroll.
  • Chillers, unidades manejadoras de aire y minisplits.
  • Soldadura para tuberías de cobre.
  • Detección de fugas y recuperación de refrigerantes.
  • Instrumentación de medición (multímetro, manómetros, termómetros, pinza amperimétrica).
  • Normas de seguridad industrial.

The Opportunity

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle—delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Where luxury is personal.

Exceptional service begins with knowing our guests and what they value, what they need and, most importantly, what they haven’t asked for yet. As Assistant Guest Services Manager – VIP & Premium, you’ll lead the experience for our VIP, premium and loyalty guests, while playing a key role in driving guest satisfaction, Guest Love and the resort’s overall reputation.

From orchestrating flawless VIP and Private Residence arrivals to resolving complex guest concerns and turning service challenges into memorable recovery moments, you’ll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact on the guest experience. You’ll work across the resort to identify opportunities, address recurring pain points and inspire teams to deliver effortless, personalised service.

If you have a passion for luxury hospitality, an instinct for anticipating needs and a talent for problem solving and making people feel genuinely valued, this is your opportunity to help set the standard for the Hayman Island guest experience.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead the VIP, premium and loyalty guest experience, taking ownership of the guest journey from pre-arrival planning through to departure and post-stay follow-up.
  • Oversee VIP and Private Residence arrivals, ensuring preferences, amenities, special occasions and individual requirements are coordinated across all relevant resort departments.
  • Take ownership of Medallia guest feedback and social media reviews, ensuring feedback is monitored, responded to appropriately and translated into operational actions and improvements.
  • Drive Guest Love, guest satisfaction and related KPIs, identifying trends and working with operational leaders to ensure agreed performance targets are achieved.
  • Lead problem handling and service recovery, personally managing complex or escalated guest concerns and ensuring issues are resolved effectively, appropriately and with genuine ownership.
  • Analyse recurring guest feedback and service failures, identify root causes and partner with department leaders to implement sustainable improvements rather than simply resolving individual cases.
  • Anticipate guest needs and work across the resort to turn every interaction into an opportunity to exceed expectations and create memorable experiences.
  • Lead, coach and develop the Concierge and Instant Service teams, creating a proactive, accountable and high-performance culture where exceptional service comes naturally.
  • Maintain a highly visible presence throughout the resort, engaging with guests, supporting peak arrival and departure periods and proactively identifying opportunities for service recovery.
  • Identify opportunities to showcase and upsell premium experiences, dining and activities while managing departmental costs, rosters and financial performance.
  • Uphold the highest standards of privacy, confidentiality, safety and brand compliance while sharing your knowledge of Hayman Island and the Whitsundays to create genuinely personalised recommendations and memorable stays.
  • Maintain a zero-inbox approach to guest correspondence, proactively managing guest emails and ensuring enquiries, requests, complaints and follow-ups are acknowledged promptly, actioned within agreed timeframes and followed through to resolution. Anticipate opportunities to contact guests before issues escalate and ensure no guest communication is left without clear ownership or closure.

Salary rate $87,000.00 + super

See Yourself in Our Team

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build genuine connections with guests and colleagues.
  • Proven experience in guest relations, guest experience, front office or a similar leadership role within a luxury hotel or resort environment.
  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities, with experience coaching and developing high-performing guest-facing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex guest concerns, complaints and service recovery with confidence, empathy and sound judgement.
  • A strong understanding of guest satisfaction metrics, online reputation and guest feedback platforms, with the ability to turn insights into operational improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify root causes and coordinate solutions across multiple departments.
  • Fluency in English; additional language skills are advantageous.
  • Proficiency in hotel management software and guest experience systems.
  • Flexibility to work varied shifts, including evenings, weekends and public holidays.
  • A degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or a related field is preferred.

Live the Island Life

  • Join a vibrant and diverse team, making lifelong friendships, and become part of an unforgettable island community.
  • We make island living convenient and affordable with subsidised staff accommodation and meals. We also offer dedicated staff facilities - pool, beach, gym, bar, diner, laundry, and more.
  • Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, hiking, kayaking, and exploring the Whitsundays after your shift or on your days off.
  • Your commute ends in paradise, with beautiful beaches and breathtaking ocean views just moments away.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for career growth, training, and professional development.
  • Enjoy exclusive employee, friends, and family discount rates across our InterContinental Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe great hospitality starts with great people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, religions, genders, gender identities and sexual orientations. We pride ourselves on a diverse and family friendly environment, and welcome applicants with primary school aged children as our island offers a State Primary School.

If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, we're here to support you.

Ready to Work in Paradise

  • Please visit our Careers Page for all details regarding living and working on Hayman Island at: https://haymanisland.intercontinental.com/careers/ or click the ‘Apply Now’ button.
  • We also invite you to learn more by following our social channels:
    • Facebook via @ICHIRcareers and Instagram via @ihg_australia_careers
Applications close on 11 October 2026 . We will be reviewing and contacting candidates throughout the advertising period. This application will close earlier if a suitable candidate is found and the position is filled.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Challenge yourself to execute and help shape strategic sourcing solutions to mitigate commercial and operational risk and drive significant value across one of Qantas’ largest cost - Fuel
  • Category Manager role available in our Fuel Supply Chain Procurement team
  • Permanent Full-time opportunity based at our Sydney or Melbourne office

Our ability to stand the test of time has been no coincidence. We’ve come this far because we continue to evolve. It’s a challenge that never ends and drives every individual in our team to make tomorrow better than today for our customers.

Driving sustainability, our procurement and supply chain function meet the demands of the Qantas Group’s diverse portfolio, while maximising the value from our supplier related expenditure.

Group Procurement is responsible for the sourcing and ongoing commercial relationships of our suppliers including leading or supporting RFPs, supplier negotiations, contract development, contract reviews and contract executions.

Fuel procurement is responsible for leading key sourcing activities across the Qantas Group airlines covering all domestic and international fuel requirements (300+ locations).

Driving and managing supplier and internal relationships, Fuel procurement is responsible for the end-to-end procurement of Fuel to ensure the most cost-effective outcomes are achieved.

As the Category Manager your role will help shape strategic strategies for Fuel procurement to deliver value in the short, medium and longer term. You will also be responsible for the execution of those strategies and associated approvals and contracts execution. A key component of your role will also be managing and maintaining key Supplier and internal stakeholders. This will require advanced negotiation expertise as well as excellent interpersonal and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

As the Category Manager, you will lead the execution of sourcing and negotiation activity for Fuel procurement, contributing to category strategy set by the Portfolio Manager and delivering value in the short, medium and longer term. You will also be responsible for communicating outcomes, securing associated approvals and contracts execution.

A key component of your role will be managing and maintaining key stakeholder relationships both internal and supplier facing. This will require strong negotiation expertise, commercial acumen as well as excellent interpersonal and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

You’ll Have

  • 5+ years’ experience within the Fuel Industry, Strategic Sourcing or Airline Industry
  • Tertiary qualifications in Finance, Commerce, Business or Procurement
  • Accreditation from Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply desirable
  • Advanced influencing, communication and negotiation skills, demonstrating the ability to influence and build effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels
  • Commercially focused with the ability to correctly assess the impact of decisions on business outcomes
  • Experience in leading sourcing activities as a procurement specialist or similar strategic sourcing role
  • Experience working within or supporting commercial and operational environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with ability to resolve complex issues
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including natural adaptability across seniority levels, cultures and global borders
  • Proven track record of achieving KPI targets

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.

We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.

We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.

We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

If you’re ready for a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application today.

Applications close: Wednesday 30th October 2026.

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

About the Job

The Global Procurement Strategic Sourcing Manager – Fuel Services plays a key role in executing tactical and strategic procurement activities that support efficient acquisition of fuel services across the business. This position manages sourcing initiatives, supplier relationships, contract activities, and commercial negotiations while helping ensure cost effectiveness, operational reliability, and long-term value creation. The role partners closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to improve supply chain performance, support operational objectives, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and optimization.

Core Accountabilities/Key Responsibilities

  • Track market trends and supplier developments to identify sourcing opportunities, mitigate risks, and support category strategies.
  • Build cost models, financial analyses, and business cases to support supplier selection, sourcing initiatives, and negotiation strategies.
  • Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships while negotiating commercial terms that improve performance, value, and cost efficiency.
  • Manage RFQ processes, evaluate supplier capabilities, and support sourcing decisions based on quality, cost, service, compliance, and risk considerations.
  • Prepare and communicate sourcing performance reports, performance scorecards, dashboards, and key metrics for leadership review.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align sourcing strategies with business, operational, quality, compliance, and financial objectives.
  • Participate in strategic supply chain initiatives by identifying improvement opportunities, enhancing processes, and supporting scalable operational solutions.
  • Serve as a key sourcing liaison across Fuel Technical Operations, Operations, Legal, Finance, Fuel Accounting and other stakeholder groups to ensure effective execution of procurement and sourcing activities.
  • Support fuel automation, performance management, and other initiatives that improve service reliability, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Support the governing of airport fuel consortia, including coordination of voting matters, commercial negotiations, budget oversight, and stakeholder alignment.

Please note: This is a Chicago-based, hybrid role with an in-office requirement of 3 days per week.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • 2+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, contract management, or a related discipline
  • Experience managing supplier relationships, evaluating supplier performance, and negotiating commercial terms
  • Experience conducting sourcing analysis, cost modeling, financial analysis, and data-driven decision making
  • Strong knowledge of strategic sourcing, supplier management, supply chain analysis, and regulatory compliance
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience with supply chain risk management and supplier development initiatives
  • Experience designing KPIs, performance scorecards, and sourcing metrics
  • Knowledge of process automation and supply chain traceability practices
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Finance
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them for research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving.
  • Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to company policies related to responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.

The base pay range for this role is $81,795.00 to $106,602.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

United Airlines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact JobAccommodations@united.com

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration.

We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. We are a skillful, driven, and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity

As Director, Content and Product Operations, you will play a key leadership role in analyzing customer and product data to determine business value and priorities, setting the strategy, roadmap and KPIs to deliver efficient and effective operations. You will build and manage multiple large teams in a fast-paced, international environment.

You will lead your teams in execution, collaborate closely with product managers and IT on A/B experiments and reporting, and coordinate with accommodation supply, connectivity, strategic partnerships, and customer support teams to ensure operational excellence.

This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand, reporting to the VP of Product, and is open to candidates worldwide. We will assist you with visa and relocation, ensuring a smooth transition to working and living in Bangkok.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute content and product operations strategies to support Agoda’s business goals.
  • Set content and data priorities based on customer needs and business value.
  • Establish and track KPIs to measure business impact and operational performance.
  • Create and manage roadmaps and project plans for key initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Technology, and Supply, to deliver effective content solutions.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Monitor and improve content systems and processes for efficiency and quality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the content supply chain.

Experience Required

  • 10+ years of experience in driving Operations for large organizations
  • At least 6 years of direct management experience, including leading teams of 20 or more
  • Experience managing teams in the e-commerce or technology/internet space
  • Proven ability to set and execute content or operational strategy to drive business results
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making; SQL expertise a plus
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing operational workflows and resourcing, both automated and manual, to achieve business goals

job.company_description:
At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Conseiller(ère) Client (H/F) et devenez un(e) leader inspirant(e) !

Vous rêvez de devenir un(e) manager qui inspire et motive tout en développant vos compétences en service client, ventes, finances et gestion ? Le poste de Conseiller Client (H/F) est fait pour vous ! Avec notre soutien et nos conseils, vous apprendrez rapidement à gérer une entreprise florissante avec plusieurs millions d’euros de chiffre d’affaires. Nous vous offrons de nombreuses opportunités de développement, que ce soit par la formation, l’évolution de carrière, ou encore le mentoring encouragé par notre politique RH.


Pourquoi choisir Enterprise Mobility ?

Enterprise Mobility est l'un des leaders mondiaux de la mobilité avec plus de 2 millions de véhicules et plus de 10 000 agences. En rejoignant Enterprise Mobility, vous intégrez une équipe dynamique dans une entreprise internationale qui défend la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion. Chez nous, chacun(e) a sa place, indépendamment de ses origines, son genre ou encore son orientation sexuelle.


Votre Rôle Et Vos Opportunités

Chez Enterprise Mobility, nous formons en interne tous nos futurs managers car nous privilégions la promotion interne. Vous intégrerez notre agence locale en tant que Conseiller(ère) Client (H/F) en CDI et suivrez en parallèle notre cursus de formation interne. Vous évoluerez rapidement vers des postes en management, RH, ventes, marketing ou finance.


Mettez En Avant Vos Talents Commerciaux

En tant que Conseiller(ère) Client, vous jouerez aussi un rôle clé dans le démarchage et le développement commercial dans votre zone de chalandise, en identifiant et en développant de nouvelles opportunités de vente (garages, concessions, PME/PMI). Votre capacité à établir des relations solides et à comprendre les besoins des clients sera essentielle pour réussir dans ce poste.


Rémunération Et Avantages

Le package moyen d’entrée à ce poste évolutif est entre 26K€ et 32K€ brut annuel selon l’agence. Il évolue progressivement pour atteindre 40K€-50K€ grâce à l’évolution au poste de chef d’agence en moins de 2 ans. Ce poste s’accompagne également d’avantages sociaux significatifs.


Responsabilités

De façon non exhaustive, vos missions seront :

  • Assurer un service client exceptionnel en appliquant notre plan de service client.
  • Elaborer des devis, émettre des contrats et informer nos clients sur les conditions de location et les caractéristiques des véhicules.
  • Prendre en charge la vente de produits additionnels.
  • Participer au développement du point de vente par le démarchage local de clients sous la responsabilité du / de la chef.fe d’agence.
  • Participer à la gestion administrative et à la préparation des véhicules.

En parallèle, vous suivez une formation pendant 10 à 12 mois afin d'assimiler nos méthodes en relation client, vente, management, gestion d'un centre de profit, compte d'exploitation, démarchage commercial, gestion du parc automobile. Vous apprenez aussi à développer et promouvoir votre propre équipe. Cette formation est assurée par des managers qualifiés, principalement en agence mais aussi lors de formations théoriques au siège social.


Qualifications

  • Un niveau minimum bac +3 est préférable ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente.
  • Permis de conduire B français ou d'un pays de l'UE (boite manuelle), à l'exception des candidats qui ne conduisent pas en raison d'un handicap physique.
  • Vous possédez un niveau d’anglais suffisant pour échanger avec des clients anglophones.
  • Vous êtes disponible pour travailler certains week-ends.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Growth & Strategic Initiatives Manager

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

We are looking for a Senior Growth & Strategic Initiatives Manager to help lead the next chapter of creator and social at Expedia Group. Creator has evolved from a marketing channel into an enterprise capability that can shape brand equity, audience growth, content efficiency, reputation, acquisition, loyalty, and revenue. Our Creator & Social team builds trust, relevance, and demand through creative ideas, strong partnerships, and a deep understanding of travelers on social.

Working across brand-level creator leads and pods, you will connect the macro business environment to brand strategies, champion the strongest work, and create the strategic center of excellence that enables greater clarity, integration, and scale.

This leader will connect business strategy, social, creators, partnerships, and emerging commercial models—identifying not simply how to activate opportunities, but which opportunities the business should pursue and why. This is not a traditional campaign execution, talent-management, influencer-sourcing, or content-calendar role. You will mobilize, integrate, scale, measure, and champion the work that makes creator and social valuable across the business.

In this role, you will

  • Determine how to win with creators and social—whether through creator, social, talent, partnership, content, affiliate, or a combination—and turn that choice into a compelling story that sells the strategy, investment, and path to impact
  • Shape the enterprise portfolio of creator and social investments—help determine which cultural, entertainment, sports, celebrity, platform, and affiliate opportunities best solve priority business problems, create distinctive audience value, and compound across brands and markets; recommend what to fund, scale, sequence, or decline based on expected impact, commercial potential, and opportunity cost
  • Own global expansion and cross-brand integration by determining what should travel across markets, what requires localization, and what should remain market-specific; scale high-quality assets and creator-led storytelling for growth and paid social channels
  • Champion and scale creator business models, including affiliate monetization, creator commerce, loyalty integration, product and content partnerships, performance economics, creator-owned audiences, and platform partnerships
  • Integrate across brand-level creator leads and up-level brand-level strategies in partnership with their owners; connect those strategies to cross-brand and enterprise opportunities while identifying shared systems, learning, investment, and amplification opportunities
  • Support measurement and use data, amplification insight, and performance signals to strengthen strategies and tell a more compelling story of impact across creator-owned, brand-owned, paid, and earned environments
  • Independently counsel senior leaders and influence across marketing, communications, media, product, loyalty, legal, finance, procurement, agencies, and geographic teams; lead agencies at the strategy and creative level; and build scalable decision frameworks, operating mechanisms, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Lead and develop a team of five or more while raising strategic standards and leadership capability across the broader creator and social community, including partnership with brand-level creator leads

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have deep, senior-level experience (10+ years) in both social strategy and creator strategy (not a social strategist who has occasionally worked with influencers, and not a creator specialist who cannot evaluate an organic social strategy)
  • You have led integrated, multi-brand or enterprise programs and can coach, develop, and up-level brand-level strategies in partnership with individual brand leads
  • You have translated business and marketing objectives into integrated social, creator, partnership, channel, and commercial strategies, then sold those strategies through compelling stories and data-backed recommendations to senior audiences
  • You have owned or led global expansion, growth-market programs, local-market adaptation, platform-funded programs, and the scaling of creator-led assets for growth and paid social channels
  • You have developed creator commercialization or emerging business models, such as affiliate platforms, social-first commerce, loyalty, product integration, performance partnerships, creator-owned audiences, or new distribution models
  • You bring a portfolio and investment mindset and can recommend what to fund, stop, or sequence—and what information is needed before deciding
  • You have executive presence and judgment, including the ability to counsel senior leaders, challenge assumptions, navigate organizational complexity, and influence without formal authority
  • You have experience with creator amplification and measurement across owned, paid, and earned channels, using data and performance signals to sharpen strategy; you also bring strategic agency leadership and celebrity, high-profile talent, or major cultural partnership experience
  • You have built and led teams, strengthened operating systems, raised talent capability beyond your direct reporting line, and are familiar with AI-enabled tools and automation
  • You are an exceptional storyteller who makes complex strategic choices clear, compelling, and actionable

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

job.job_description:
Job Description

The stunning Forbes rated Conrad New York is looking for a Director of Outletsto join the Food and Beverage Leadership Team!

Stay inspired and join the pinnacle of luxury in the heart of Lower Manhattan, featuring 463 rooms, 30,000 square feet of banquet space, and 3 food and beverage outlets. This includes a 3-meal restaurant, rooftop bar, and in-room dining.

Want to learn more? Hotel Website , Instagram, Facebook, YouTube

In this role, you will be overseeing all day-to-day operations of the property’s food and beverage outlets. You will be reporting directly to the Director of Food & Beverage and oversee a Front-of-House team of 35-40 Team Members, including 4 leaders.

The ideal candidate will have at least three - five years of senior Food and Beverage leadership experience, ideally overseeing multiple outlets within a luxury hotel environment. We are seeking a hands-on leader with strong beverage knowledge, excellent communication and organizational skills, and a proven ability to develop high-performing teams while fostering a positive workplace culture.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Outlets, you’re not just leading operations across multiple hotel dining outlets – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Ensure seamless operations: Plan and direct all aspects of restaurant operations – including systems management, budgeting, forecasting, product quality, cost controls, and policy implementation – ensuring alignment with business goals and profitability targets
  • Shape guest satisfaction strategies: Define and implement innovative guest service standards and initiatives, monitoring trends, gathering feedback, and driving solutions to enhance the guest experience
  • Drive outlet performance: Provide leadership support to outlet managers to ensure high-quality standards are met across all food and beverage service areas, supporting daily operations and driving continuous improvements
  • Maximize revenue opportunities: Develop and implement strategies to promote restaurant food, beverages, and services in alignment with food & beverage marketing programs
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs
  • Ensure regulatory excellence: Uphold compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, fostering a culture committed to the highest standards of guest and team member wellbeing

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

As the Assistant Night Manager, at the Holiday Inn Potts Point you will manage and oversee all hotel operations in the absence of the Night Manager or designate during nights in this busy, well positioned hotel.   • Ensure all credit and financial transactions are handled in a secure manner. Maintain cashiers float, ensuring accurate daily report of all money received, performs the audit balances and prepares all works for audit in an orderly fashion
  • Oversee night audit function and preparation of daily financial reports. Work closely with our finance team to ensure the auditing and reporting process has a high level of detail overnight
  • Adhere to local regulations concerning health, safety, or other compliance requirements, as well as brand standards and local policies and procedures.

  • Champion IHG Rewards Club and ensure team are 100% compliant in their training and delivery of standards.

What We Need From You

  • Valid work visa to work unrestricted and on a permanent basis in Australia. Sponsorship is not available.
  • At least 3 years of hotel front office / guest service experience with least two years in a supervisory or assistant manager capacity.
  • Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Administration, Business Administration or an associated discipline.
  • Experience with Opera or a similar front office system.
  • Strong numeracy skills and excellent communication skills and ability to deal with people with confidence.
  • Valid Responsible Service of Alcohol in NSW
  • First Aid & CPR Certificates are required

What You Can Expect From Us

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including laundry for business attire, impressive room discounts, competitive products & services discounts program and some of the best training in the business.
