Principal Enterprise Architect, Infrastructure and Operations

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Principal Enterprise Architect for Infrastructure and Operations, you’ll set the strategy and standards that power reliability, speed, and safety across Priceline’s platforms, networks, and run-time environments.

This role raises the architectural bar for Priceline’s Infrastructure and Operations—building reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective foundations so product teams can ship quickly without chaos. You’ll unify platform engineering, SRE, networking, and multi-region cloud infrastructure into paved roads and guardrails that accelerate delivery, improve reliability, strengthen observability, reduce change-failure rate and MTTR, enable safe, scalable AI adoption, and lower total cost of ownership (TCO).

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Define and evolve the target-state Infrastructure and Operations architecture aligned to Priceline’s long-term business and technology objectives, with a pragmatic phased roadmap and measurable interim milestones.
  • Design and govern global, cloud-native platforms (e.g., Kubernetes/GKE, service mesh, data and messaging backbones, edge/CDN, identity/IAM, network architecture) that are resilient, scalable, secure, and cost-optimized—grounded in explicit trade-offs.
  • Lead platform engineering strategy—establish paved roads/golden paths, an internal developer platform (IDP), reusable reference architectures, and self-service automation that shorten idea-to-production cycles.
  • Lead architecture governance, codifying standards and guardrails, managing technical debt, ensuring compliance, and minimizing architectural risk.
  • Partner with Product and Technology leaders to design end-to-end solutions across internal and third-party systems—defining integration patterns, API/data contracts, clear ownership boundaries, and SLAs.
  • Institutionalize SRE fundamentals and advance Infrastructure as Code and GitOps.
  • Embed security and privacy by design—partner with Security/Risk to implement Zero Trust, secrets and key management, vulnerability & patch orchestration, data protection, and regulatory controls (e.g., PCI, SOX, GDPR/CCPA) across platforms and pipelines.
  • Use business criticality classification to drive resiliency, capacity, and performance engineering requirements, with automated IaC policies for topology/redundancy, data protection, observability configuration, SLOs, change management requirements, and IAM policies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, patterns, and vendors to shape strategic roadmaps—leading build/buy/partner analyses, proofs of concept, and TCO/ROI assessments to de-risk decisions.
  • Coach principal and staff engineers, uplevel engineering practices, and cultivate a culture of clarity, simplicity, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • Strategic thinker and clear communicator who can influence executives, peers, and engineers.
  • Deep experience (8+ years) across cloud infrastructure and operations—Kubernetes/container platforms, platform engineering/IDP, networking and site traffic management/edge platforms, storage, observability, incident management, DR/BCP, and modern change management.
  • Hands-on engineering background with fluency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), automation (e.g., Python/Go), GitOps/CI/CD, service mesh, and production observability.
  • Cloud-native experience—ideally GCP (e.g. GKE, Cloud Service Mesh, VPC, CloudSQL/AlloyDB/Spanner, BigQuery, Bigtable, GCE, GCS, Vertex AI, Looker) and Kafka.
  • Security-first mindset with practical knowledge of Zero Trust, IAM, secrets management, vulnerability management, security and identity protocols (PKI, TLS/mTLS, OAuth 2.0/OIDC), and privacy/compliance frameworks (e.g., PCI, SOX, GDPR/CCPA).
  • FinOps-aware—able to model and optimize cost/reliability/latency trade-offs at scale.
  • Bias for clarity and simplicity—reducing complexity and enabling teams to move faster and smarter.
  • Analytical problem-framer who reduces ambiguity into clear, actionable components.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $175,000- $220,000 USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

job.job_description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

As our Principal Engineer for Identity & Privacy, you’ll shape the technical foundations that help us earn traveller trust while safely unlocking the data and AI capabilities behind brilliant product, personalisation, experimentation and advertising experiences.

This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Setting our technical strategy: You’ll define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for identity, consent and privacy engineering, aligning it with our product strategy, traveller trust goals and data and AI ambitions.
  • Shaping identity at scale: You’ll lead our technical approach to purpose-scoped identifiers and consent-aware data processing across sessions, tracking, advertising, accounts, consent and derived identifiers.
  • Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated.
  • Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability.
  • Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against.
  • Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions.
  • Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community.

About You

  • Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners.
  • Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure.
  • An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed.
  • Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table.
  • End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest.
  • Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab.
  • Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter.

What It's Like Here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of the Learning & Development team. As Instructor Learning & Development, he/she will be responsible for courseware development, course delivery and assessments, in the domain of Aircraft Weight and Balance, Load Control and Dangerous Goods Regulations, to ensure SIA ground staff and relevant partners are certified to meet regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Delivery of Courses & Assessments:
    • Deliver instructor-led training and assessments, for courses in the domain of Aircraft Weight and Balance, Load Control and Dangerous Goods Regulations, whether it be in-person, virtual, or hybrid.
    • Ensure effective learner participation and engagement during courses, determined through an average course evaluation satisfaction score.
    • Ensure accuracy and integrity in administering and marking of assessments.


  • Develop and/or Refine Courseware:
    • Curate, design, develop, and/or refine courseware and learning materials, incorporating up-to-date and relevant information on regulations, systems, processes, or polices, partnering internal stakeholders and associate trainers as required.
    • Structure courseware and learning materials for ease of understanding, learning transfer, retention, and applicability. This includes, but is not limited to, incorporating the necessary Aircraft Weight & Balance, Load Control documentation and Dangerous Goods Regulations in accordance with regulations by IATA, CAAS, or SIA.


  • Support E-Learning Design & Development:
    • Partner the relevant internal line business units and outsourced e-learning development provider, to provide subject matter expertise and learning material(s) as required.


  • Support Learning Administration & Engagement:
    • Work with the Learner Experience Team in handling and resolving matters pertaining to learning experience as required, including but not limited to, attendance taking, communication of assessment grades / scores, dissemination of assessment scores and certificates, local transportation arrangements, or pre and post course administration.
    • Support the coaching of Associate Trainers to upskill and prepare them to deliver classes.


  • Evaluate training effectiveness:
    • Conduct post-course review to identify areas for improvement and refine programme (where appropriate) to meet the learning outcomes.
Requirements

  • Diploma in any discipline
  • Advanced Certificate in Learning and Performance (ACLP) or Advanced Certificate in Training and Assessment (ACTA) is preferred
  • Active/Current certificate in aircraft weight and balance, load control and/or Dangerous Goods.
  • Experience in delivering Dangerous Goods Competency Based Training and Assessment (CBTA) Programme for Cargo Handling, Passenger Handling and Load Control and/or Dangerous Goods Category Training.
  • Experience in delivering aircraft weight and balance and load control training programmes.
    • Experience with Amadeus Altéa Departure Control Flight Management (FM) system, or related systems, for load control optimisation.
    • Quick and accurate in performing load calculations and able to cite Dangerous Goods Regulations permitting or rejecting the carriage of a particular substance
  • Confident and articulate when speaking in front of others, able to engage people effectively.
  • Able to create a safe space for learning and have good classroom management skills
  • Believe in lifelong learning:
    • To impart knowledge, skills, and attitudes to Learners
    • To be willing to learn new system functions, business processes, or service polices/processes in times of change
    • Seek to continually improve self in delivery of courses.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills within cross-functional teams
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills:
    • To address and resolve unforeseen issues that may arise during courses
    • Answer queries or challenges posed by Learners during courses
  • Able and willing to travel overseas to deliver training.
We thank all candidates for your interest in this position, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

• Lead and drive technology and engineering standards, whilst driving AI adoption within our Product Innovation Centre.
  • A fantastic opportunity to work across cross functional teams to uplift our software engineering and quality engineering capability.
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our Adelaide Head Office.


Qantas has established a new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide, a hub that will transform how we design, build and deliver digital experiences for millions of customers. At its core is a shift to a product-led operating model: moving away from traditional project-based IT delivery toward empowered, cross-functional product teams that own outcomes end-to-end.


The Head of Engineering Chapter is accountable for the end-to-end engineering and quality engineering capability across the Product Innovation Centre, leading Chapter Leads for Mobile Engineering, Web Engineering, Backend & Integration Engineering, and Quality Engineering. Through this chapter structure, the role provides hardline leadership to all software and quality engineers, while maintaining alignment with product and platform squads where engineers contribute day-to-day delivery outcomes.


The role is responsible for defining engineering strategy, establishing technical standards, and driving the adoption of modern software engineering and AI-native development practices. It provides leadership on engineering priorities and capability development. This role ensures consistent quality, scalability, and operational excellence across the organisation.


In partnership with the Senior Manager, Applied AI, the Head of Engineering Chapter co-leads our AI-native engineering transformation. This role is accountable for embedding AI-native practices into engineering teams and ensuring sustained adoption through strong chapter leadership and accountability.


Operating across a distributed chapter structure, the role translates enterprise technology strategy into execution. Success is measured through engineering excellence, widespread adoption of AI-native ways of working and the ability to sustain consistent standards as the Centre scales beyond hundreds of engineering and quality professionals.


You’ll Have

  • 15+ years in software engineering or technology roles, including 10+ years in senior engineering leadership across multiple teams or disciplines
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on fluency in AI-assisted and agentic engineering practice
  • Enterprise-level leadership across engineering and quality engineering capability, including strategic direction setting and leading leaders through coaching and accountability.
  • Capability strategy design and maturity uplift at scale, including workforce planning across engineering and quality disciplines.
  • Governance of enterprise engineering standards across engineering, testing, security, reliability, and deployment, with genuine enforcement authority
  • Systems thinking across complex technology environments, with ownership of technical debt strategy and systemic risk management.
  • Proven ability to align Engineering, Quality Engineering, Platform, Design and Delivery practice to reduce friction and improve outcomes.
  • Executive-level influence and decision support through governance forums


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.


You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.


  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on 22nd of September


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Get your hard hat ready. We’re not just renovating the travel experience – we’re renovating our physical spaces too. And our Corporate Real Estate team is on the front lines of procuring, designing and developing spaces at all our hubs, stations and city locations across the world. From airport affairs and business services to planning and development, this team is responsible for all our leases and major construction and renovation projects, system wide.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

Responsible for leading the development and implementation of key objectives and strategies as part of United’s corporate real estate portfolio and growth plan. Manage primary relationship with key external stakeholders including but not limited to airport authorities, airlines, applicable government entities and industry organizations. This includes leading negotiations on behalf of United to achieve key business outcomes. Lead a team of professionals to drive development of strategic priorities and execute implementation of plans against defined objectives and metrics. Support other duties as assigned.

Strategy

  • Develop and maintain a strategic plan, goals and key performance indicators that support United corporate real estate portfolio and growth strategy.

Implementation

  • Manage primary relationships and drive negotiations at strategic hub airports on behalf of United with key stakeholders including but not limited to airports, airlines, and applicable public/ government entities.
  • Balance proactive and reactive approach to managing key responsibilities, inclusive of developing solutions and driving consensus through collaboration and communication.
  • Drive implementation of policies and initiatives across the corporate real estate portfolio that focus on cost and risk management, optimal real estate utilization, and enabling growth.
  • Responsible for leading engagement in exception management, conflict resolution and strategic alignment.

Leadership

  • Effectively lead teams by establishing department and individual goals.
  • Oversee the department and individual performance and improvement plans.
  • Coach, counsel, and assist employees to develop individual career development and training plans.
  • Lead effective teams using technical knowledge and experience combined with business acumen to provide thoughtful decision making and guidance in strategic implementation of United’s objectives and initiatives.
  • Demonstrate solution-oriented approach to problem-solving and a commitment to creating and sustaining a culture of continual improvement and innovation.
  • Model integrity, possess self-awareness and foster an environment of accountability.
  • Provide transparent communication to department staff, leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Represent United's programs and leadership at industry and other external events.
  • Mentor and develop a team that is empowered and engaged in the mission of the Airport Affairs Department.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Real Estate, Business or similar
  • 8+ years real estate and/or contract negotiation experience
  • 3+ years of managerial experience related to the position
  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Strong analytical skills, strategic/innovative thinking, and long-term vision
  • Ability to “scan the horizon” and apply risk/benefit approach to emerging issues
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with experience presenting to senior management and/or external audiences required
  • Able to collaborate with and influence internal and external stakeholders
  • Able to balance various corporate objectives
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position
  • This position is hybrid, with the option to be based in either Chicago, IL or the Dulles Airport area in Northern Virginia

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • Airline, airport, and/or aviation industry experience
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving.
  • Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy, and security

The base pay range for this role is $159,790.00 to $207,998.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
Job description:

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

Manager of Franchise Operations supports the overall mission of the Franchise Operations team by nurturing relationships with owners by understanding their individual goals and needs while recognizing every hotels in unique. The MFO optimizes owners’ performance by delivering innovative solutions and relevant resources using our experience and network across the organization. 

What you'll do
  • Compel owner involvement to achieve performance goals and drive franchisee satisfaction by embracing an Owner First mindset that directly aligns with our Count on Me service culture values: Being Responsive, Being Respectful and Delivering a Great Experience.
  • Develop trusted relationships with external customers in order to educate, motivate and influence adoption of tools and resources to elevate performance.
  • Execute Wyndham Hotels and Resorts initiatives, projects and related tasks. 
  • Execute a Portfolio Management strategy that improves overall performance through consistent communication, contact and touchpoints with hotels and owners.
  • Analyze data to develop and execute strategies to expand revenue generation opportunities, drive growth and performance while improving quality performance and increasing customer satisfaction with each hotel. 
  • Drive NRG through retention and development opportunities.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders. 
  • Provide accountability to the organization through documentation, follow up and system reporting. 
  • Achieve annual service, performance and KPI goals in order to impact WHR profitability.
  • Take ownership of personal and professional development.
  • Project a positive image and promote the value of Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.
  • Respond to one off requests from the business that are property specific within in indicated SLA. 
You'll be successful if you have
  • Position entails exposure to interior and exterior hotel property environments inclusive of the multilevel properties, inclement weather (i.e. stairs, onsite restaurants, pool and exercise facilities, etc.) 
  • Seamless continuation of work while traveling on company business (i.e. conduct work using mobile devices, from hotels, while at trade shows, and/or across varying time zones when necessary). 
  • 90% travel with flexible work schedule. 
  • Work under pressure with extended hours/days when required, in order to meet deadlines.
  • This position requires the ability to stand and be on your feet for approximately 50% of the day. 
  • This position requires the ability to sit and drive long distances for approximately 75% of the week. 
  • Qualified candidates must be able to lift a minimum of 10 lbs. 
  • This position requires the ability to bend, twist, squat, push/pull while inspecting properties. 
Required Qualifications/Experience
  • 2 to 4 years of progressive experience in a hotel or a related field required, preferably, property and corporate management experience. 
  • 4 year college degree (Preferred). 
  • Multi-property experience.
  •  Industry certifications (Preferred).
  • Proficient in Microsoft Suite (i.e. Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel etc.)

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

 

Job Location: Remote in the United States, Remote, Remote, Remote  00000
Employment Status: Full-time

 

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. based positions only, the expected pay range for this position is $80,000 - $105,000 annually.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation such as work location, background, experience, and performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

 

In addition to the base pay, this role is eligible to receive an incentive payment pursuant to the Franchised Development US Incentive Plan with a 15% annual target, subject to the terms of the Plan.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is committed to attracting, motivating, and retaining talented team members who align with our company’s core values. We are proud to reward our full-time team members with comprehensive benefit programs and resources which include:

Participation in any of the benefit plans and programs made available to team members is subject to satisfaction of eligibility requirements. More information can be found on Our Benefits Page.  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts reserves the right to amend or terminate any benefit plan or program at any time in accordance with applicable law.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


The Business Development Manager, Distribution will be responsible for expanding and optimising the distribution network for Trip.com’s Attractions, Tours & Activities business. This role focuses on acquiring, managing, and growing partnerships with distribution partners (OTAs, affiliates, resellers, travel agencies, and platform partners) to drive supply visibility, transaction growth, and revenue performance across global markets. Open to location in Paris, London, Frankfurt and Berlin.


In this Role, you will do the following:

Distribution Partnership Development:

  • Identify, onboard, and manage strategic distribution partners, including OTAs, affiliates, travel agencies, Meta, and other B2B channels.
  • Develop scalable distribution strategies to increase exposure and sales of Attractions, Tours & Activities products across multiple markets.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, commission structures, and partnership agreements to ensure mutual growth and profitability.

Account Management & Growth:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned distribution partners, ensuring strong relationships and long-term collaboration.
  • Drive partner performance through joint business planning, promotions, and product optimisation initiatives.
  • Monitor partner KPIs, analyse performance data, and implement action plans to improve conversion, booking volume, and revenue.

Market & Product Strategy:

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Supply, Operations team) to align distribution strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Provide market insights on competitive landscape, pricing trends, and customer behavior to inform product and distribution decisions.
  • Support the localisation and market expansion of A&T, products across key source (Global) and destination markets (Europe).

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure smooth onboarding, API or system integration, and operational readiness of distribution partners.
  • Resolve partner-related issues efficiently, including content accuracy, inventory availability, pricing discrepancies, and operational escalations.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, or Distribution, preferably within OTA, travel tech, tourism, or e-commerce industries.
  • Solid understanding of Attractions, Tours & Activities, distribution models, or B2B/B2B2C partnerships is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with channel managers or travel technology platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Strong commercial acumen with proven negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and drive business decisions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, and matrixed organisation.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus, depending on market coverage.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and highly motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Adaptable in multicultural and fast-paced environments
  • Passion for travel, experiences, and building scalable global partnerships.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.

What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?


Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!

Have a good trip, and see you soon!

We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Make an impact

The Data Scientist II, Hotel Enterprise Partnerships Analytics role sits within Expedia Group’s Supply and Marketplace Analytics organization. Our Hotel Enterprise Partnerships team helps strengthen relationships with hotel partners by turning complex data into clear insights that improve strategic margin revenue, supply quality, and commercial decision-making.

In this role, you will work with large datasets, analytics products, and cross-functional partners to explain performance, identify opportunities, and create recommendations that help Expedia Group and its partners grow. You will have the opportunity to build scalable reporting and insight solutions while developing your expertise in a global travel marketplace.

In this role, you will

  • Frame business questions as analytical problems, break them into practical tasks, and recommend approaches that balance analytical quality, effort, and time.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources using SQL and Python, R, or a similar language; create reliable datasets, reusable code, and basic data pipelines or workflows.
  • Develop data-driven insights and recommendations that support hotel partner discussions, commercial decisions, supply quality, and performance improvement.
  • Apply descriptive statistics, regression, experimentation, and causal or pre/post analysis where appropriate, clearly explaining assumptions, limitations, and results.
  • Create clear visualizations, dashboards, executive summaries, and other artifacts that help technical and non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening and what to do next.
  • Master latest AI productivity technology to revolutionize the depth and the trust in your work.
  • Collaborate transparently with analytics, product, data, engineering, and commercial partners; seek feedback early and share knowledge with teammates.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 2+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • You have demonstrated experience using SQL and Python, R, or a similar programming language to analyze, structure, transform, and visualize large datasets.
  • You efficiently leverage AI to speed-up delivery, automate and add depth to your analyses.
  • You understand probability, descriptive statistics, regression, and common experiment designs such as pre/post analysis, A/B testing, or causal impact analysis.
  • You can combine data from multiple sources, perform data quality checks, and write efficient, shareable code that can be translated into a data pipeline or reused by others.
  • You can explain analytical methods, caveats, and recommendations clearly to audiences with different levels of technical understanding, including stakeholders up to Senior Manager level.
  • You bring curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving ability, business acumen, and a collaborative approach to working through ambiguous questions.

  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers

  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

job.job_description:
The Analytics Product Owner is responsible for defining the vision and roadmap for a robust portfolio of data, analytics, and AI products within the AI and BI Center of Enablement. This role leads the discovery of business needs and translates them into actionable product backlogs that empower our internal customers. They will directly support and drive the evolution of key enterprise products, including the Self-Service Toolkit, Tableau Cloud, the Enterprise Reporting Portal, Conversational Data Intelligence, and more.

By blending technical expertise in modern data management, enterprise platform governance, and data visualization with product management discipline, this individual ensures our data products meet the evolving needs of the business—from traditional BI to emerging Generative AI efforts. This individual is a senior contributor who provides strategic guidance and contributes to the development of other professionals.

Your Day to Day

  • Product Vision & Roadmap: Responsible for identifying and analyzing gaps between current data/AI capabilities and desired business outcomes, documenting requirements for complex, cross-functional projects across our C4E product portfolio.
  • Platform Ownership & Governance: Act as the strategic owner for enterprise visualization platforms, particularly Tableau Cloud. Go beyond report development to define and enforce platform governance, site architecture, security models, user enablement, and performance optimization at scale.
  • Solution Design & Prototyping: Perform analysis of data sources, metadata frameworks, and user requirements to design and propose effective solutions spanning our reporting portals, conversational data interfaces, and self-service BI tools.
  • Deep Technical Expertise: Maintain expert knowledge of our enablement products (Self-Service Toolkit, Enterprise Reporting Portal, Conversational Data Intelligence), while balancing a deep technical understanding of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, BigQuery, and Dataplex (Knowledge Catalog).
  • Architectural Alignment: Maintain a deep technical and architectural understanding of data products and metadata management, especially at points of interface with internal systems and IHG business processes.
  • Stakeholder Empowerment: Collaborate directly with business partners and stakeholders as a trusted advisor, empowering them to successfully implement their own BI initiatives and AI/ML experiments within our governed environments.
  • Strategic Narrative: Effectively translate complex data, BI, and AI concepts into a compelling business narrative for stakeholders, and conversely, translate business requirements into clear technical specifications for the engineering and enablement teams.
  • Validation & Quality: Create and validate data quality test scripts, BI platform performance metrics, visualization accuracy scenarios, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for our portfolio of C4E products.
  • Backlog Management: Create and prioritize Features and User Stories, conveying the vision and requirements for our reporting portals, conversational data interfaces, platform governance, and AI enablement products to the development team.

What We Need From You.

  • Product Ownership Excellence: Advanced knowledge of product ownership within a data, BI, or AI context, with a proficient understanding of modern data architecture, systems, and enablement frameworks.
  • Enterprise Platform Proficiency: Strong proficiency with Tableau, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery. Must possess experience in managing, governing, and scaling Tableau Cloud as an enterprise platform, including expertise in security administration, content lifecycle management, and platform architecture.
  • Data & Metadata Expertise: Expertise in SQL for complex data analysis and a strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and metadata management/cataloging (specifically Dataplex/Knowledge Catalog).
  • AI & Emerging Tech: Familiarity with or a strong desire to support AI/ML initiatives, including Conversational Data Intelligence capabilities, Vertex AI, and Gemini Enterprise.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Ability to understand highly complex data and technical problems and build scalable, cross-functional solutions that promote self-service capabilities.
  • Storytelling & Communication: Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to craft a clear narrative that translates technical information into business-friendly language and distills business needs into technical requirements.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Ability to collaborate with Technical SMEs (Data Engineers, Cloud Architects, Platform Admins) to deliver large, cross-functional projects and initiatives.
  • Agile Proficiency: Experience working in Agile or, ideally, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environments.
  • Proven Track Record: Experience working with cloud-based data platforms is required.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's in a relevant field of work (e.g., Data Analytics, Computer Information Systems) or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • SAFe PO/PM certification preferred.
  • SAFe Agilist certification preferred.

Travel - 10%

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

The salary range for this role is $120,000 to $150,000. This role is also eligible for bonus pay. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

App Growth & Acquisition Specialist

This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

From search engine optimization to branding and promotions, our Marketing team is the expert at spreading the Priceline message far and wide – capturing the hearts and imaginations of customers to get them to try our services, and keep them coming back for more.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

We’re looking for an App Growth & Acquisition Specialist to help grow Priceline’s mobile app audience and drive high-quality installs at scale. This role sits at the heart of our performance marketing team — blending analytics, creativity, and strategy to acquire new app users. If you’re data-driven, love testing new growth tactics, and want to make a measurable impact on one of the most recognized brands in travel, this is a chance to shape how millions of travelers discover and book with Priceline.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Contribute to the end-to-end mobile app acquisition strategy across paid channels (e.g., Meta, Google ACi, Apple Search Ads, TikTok, programmatic).
  • Develop and execute ASO strategies to optimize app store visibility, conversion rates, and keyword performance.
  • Analyze performance data to uncover insights, trends, and opportunities to improve ROI and user quality.
  • Collaborate with:
    • creative teams to test and evolve ad concepts, messaging, and app store assets
    • analytics and BI teams to define success metrics, implement tracking, and ensure data accuracy.
    • Product and CRM teams to improve onboarding, retention, and LTV of acquired users
  • Oversee MMP (mobile measurement platform) relationship and manage related asks from internal stakeholders as well as external partners
  • Manage budgets, forecasts, and pacing to deliver efficient and scalable growth.
  • Optimizing web-to-app journeys: Help shape the conversion paths from web to app, improving landing experiences and increasing activation.
  • You’ll partner with Research, Product and Brand to ensure we communicate a clear and differentiated app value to new and existing users.
  • Stay current with mobile ecosystem trends, privacy updates (e.g., SKAN, ATT), and best practices.
  • Collaborate with product and CRM teams to improve onboarding, retention, and LTV of acquired users.
Who You Are

  • 3-5 years of experience in performance marketing or growth marketing, with a focus on mobile app acquisition.
  • Proven track record managing paid app install campaigns and ASO programs.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency with tools such as Appsflyer, Firebase, Adjust, Kochava, Tableau.
  • Experience with A/B testing, creative optimization, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Deep understanding of mobile attribution, tracking, and privacy frameworks.
  • Exceptional collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, product, and analytics teams.
  • Passion for travel, technology, and innovation in the mobile space.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $95,000-$120,000.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

job.job_description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Principal Engineer - Identity & Privacy to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

As our Principal Engineer for Identity & Privacy, you’ll shape the technical foundations that help us earn traveller trust while safely unlocking the data and AI capabilities behind brilliant product, personalisation, experimentation and advertising experiences.

This is a senior technical leadership role with impact right across Skyscanner. You’ll own the technical strategy and set standards for identity, consent and privacy engineering across our traveller-facing products, data platforms and operational systems — spanning web, app, backend, experimentation, analytics, advertising and machine learning.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Setting our technical strategy: You’ll define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for identity, consent and privacy engineering, aligning it with our product strategy, traveller trust goals and data and AI ambitions.
  • Shaping identity at scale: You’ll lead our technical approach to purpose-scoped identifiers and consent-aware data processing across sessions, tracking, advertising, accounts, consent and derived identifiers.
  • Connecting the dots end-to-end: You’ll establish how identity and consent state flows from web and app surfaces through backend services, event streams and data pipelines to downstream consumers — making a complicated ecosystem feel a lot less complicated.
  • Turning privacy into engineering practice: You’ll translate privacy principles and legal guidance into reusable engineering patterns, platform controls, decision frameworks and measurable standards, including clear expectations around retention, deletion, masking, access control and auditability.
  • Leading across Skyscanner: You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Governance, Data Science, Marketing, Ads and Analytics to navigate trade-offs, create clarity and turn ambiguous problems into decisions teams can deliver against.
  • Getting hands-on with the big stuff: You’ll provide technical leadership for large-scale initiatives spanning consent platform capabilities, privacy-safe experimentation, data retention and deletion, and traveller-trust features, while guiding teams towards simple, scalable, reliable and cost-effective solutions.
  • Raising the engineering bar: You’ll use observability, engineering health and incident learnings to improve how we operate, while coaching and mentoring engineers and championing high standards, constructive challenge and inclusive collaboration across our Engineering community.

About You

  • Privacy-engineering experienced: You’ve translated privacy and data-protection requirements — including GDPR, PECR, CCPA/CPRA or equivalent global frameworks — into practical engineering decisions, working effectively with Legal, Privacy, Security and Data Governance partners.
  • Built for scale: You’ve designed, built and operated large-scale distributed systems across identity, data platforms or adjacent areas such as consent, authentication, advertising technology or customer data infrastructure.
  • An influential technical leader: You’ve led significant technical change across multiple teams without direct line authority, creating clarity, alignment and momentum when ownership is distributed.
  • Strong in technical judgement: You’re comfortable making decisions where product value, traveller trust, privacy requirements, operational reliability and cost are all competing for a seat at the table.
  • End-to-end minded: You can reason confidently across client surfaces, backend services, event streams, data products, ML features, analytics, partner exports and operational tooling — and understand how a decision in one part of the system can ripple through the rest.
  • Practical about standards: You know how to turn policy into technical controls and measurable quality standards that teams can consistently use in real systems, rather than another document destined for a forgotten browser tab.
  • Clear, collaborative and credible: You can create shared engineering practices, write clear technical strategy and work effectively with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Legal, Security and Data Governance. Familiarity with privacy and consent technologies, experimentation, personalisation, advertising measurement, Databricks, OpenTelemetry or SQL is valuable but not essential — as is practical experience using AI tools to make engineering work smarter.

What It's Like Here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Leverage data, insights and AI to enhance customer outcomes
  • Uplift quality & compliance across a large-scale operation
  • Permanent opportunity based at our Mascot Head Office

Our Customer Care & Recovery (CC&R) team plays a critical role in supporting customers through disruptions, advocacy cases, and service interactions. We're looking for a Manager Business Improvement - Contact Centres to drive the quality, compliance and continuous improvement strategy that underpins every customer interaction across the function, including our Global Contact Centres.

As the Manager Business Improvement, you'll be integral to operating the CC&R Quality Assurance Program, using data, insights and AI-enabled capabilities to identify risks and opportunities, uncover trends and drive continuous improvement. Working across a multi-channel customer environment, you'll partner closely with operational leaders and stakeholders to deliver initiatives that improve the customer experience, strengthen quality outcomes and support informed decision-making.

This highly collaborative role sits at the intersection of customer experience, quality assurance and operational excellence. You'll uncover opportunities through data and analytics, influence business decisions and deliver improvement initiatives that create measurable impact. From managing quality and assurance programs to supporting innovation and performance optimisation, and emerging technologies, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of CC&R. You’ll also drive the adoption of new digital AI technology to improve the end-to-end quality & compliance practices.

You’ll Have

  • 7+ years’ experience in quality assurance, business improvement, customer experience or operational excellence within a complex environment Contact Centre environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation and customer service technologies.
  • Experience driving continuous improvement initiatives and partnering with stakeholders to deliver customer-focused outcomes
  • Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience driving business improvement, innovation, transformation and cultural change initiatives.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across a diverse stakeholder group.
  • Experience using data, technology and emerging capabilities to improve processes, performance and customer outcomes.
  • Experience within customer operations or service delivery environments.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on-the-job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

Qantas employees also get to enjoy an amazing benefits program including:

  • Travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe - both for you and your family and friends - as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • Access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll also support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer, so by coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.  

Applications close Sunday, 20 September 2026.

Please note: applications will only be considered for candidates who have the right to work in Australia / New Zealand without restriction or sponsorship.

Responsible for managing aircraft and fleet configuration setup while ensuring ongoing data integrity through continuous audits and alignment with FAA Part 121, GMM, and departmental procedures.   • Advanced knowledge of interpreting various technical documents and manuals such as: IPC, AMM, CMM, OEM manuals and Service Bulletins

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Engineering or Business management

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


The Business Development Manager, Distribution will be responsible for expanding and optimising the distribution network for Trip.com’s Attractions, Tours & Activities business. This role focuses on acquiring, managing, and growing partnerships with distribution partners (OTAs, affiliates, resellers, travel agencies, and platform partners) to drive supply visibility, transaction growth, and revenue performance across global markets. Open to location in Paris, London, Frankfurt and Berlin.


In this Role, you will do the following:

Distribution Partnership Development:

  • Identify, onboard, and manage strategic distribution partners, including OTAs, affiliates, travel agencies, Meta, and other B2B channels.
  • Develop scalable distribution strategies to increase exposure and sales of Attractions, Tours & Activities products across multiple markets.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, commission structures, and partnership agreements to ensure mutual growth and profitability.

Account Management & Growth:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned distribution partners, ensuring strong relationships and long-term collaboration.
  • Drive partner performance through joint business planning, promotions, and product optimisation initiatives.
  • Monitor partner KPIs, analyse performance data, and implement action plans to improve conversion, booking volume, and revenue.

Market & Product Strategy:

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Supply, Operations team) to align distribution strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Provide market insights on competitive landscape, pricing trends, and customer behavior to inform product and distribution decisions.
  • Support the localisation and market expansion of A&T, products across key source (Global) and destination markets (Europe).

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure smooth onboarding, API or system integration, and operational readiness of distribution partners.
  • Resolve partner-related issues efficiently, including content accuracy, inventory availability, pricing discrepancies, and operational escalations.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, or Distribution, preferably within OTA, travel tech, tourism, or e-commerce industries.
  • Solid understanding of Attractions, Tours & Activities, distribution models, or B2B/B2B2C partnerships is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with channel managers or travel technology platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Strong commercial acumen with proven negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and drive business decisions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, and matrixed organisation.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus, depending on market coverage.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and highly motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Adaptable in multicultural and fast-paced environments
  • Passion for travel, experiences, and building scalable global partnerships.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.

What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?


Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

Inspired by the relaxed glamour of the Italian Riviera, our venue comes alive from long lunches and afternoon aperitivo through to sunset Spritzes, live entertainment and energetic evening service.
