job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks a motivated and results-driven Data and AI Product Manager who is passionate about data and AI to help us build and scale the next generation of enterprise data, analytics and AI-powered products. The Product Manager is responsible for defining product vision(s) and guiding the creation of world-class products, democratizing access, accelerating algorithmically powered processes, and fostering data-driven decision making across complex business domains.

The Product Manager will partner closely with business leaders and technical teams to deliver trusted, governed, and auditable enterprise search products that make trusted enterprise knowledge easy to find, understand, and use; democratizing access, reducing time spent searching across fragmented systems and knowledge base, and improving colleague productivity and operational consistency across complex business domains, across Hyatt's global enterprise. This role will own the Enterprise Search product portfolio, working in alignment with the broader Enterprise Data Agents platform while driving a distinct roadmap for user journeys, data-sources, relevance and answer quality, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

In this role, you'll define and guide the development of business-critical, scalable, and robust enterprise data and AI products that help colleagues discover trusted data and information and complete work faster. This position will guide product research, facilitate product strategies, define user journeys and search experiences, prioritize data and data-source onboarding, and guide Hyatt's agile development and product roll-out processes. You will be part of a global data and AI community and will work in cross-functional and agile project teams alongside business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Stewards, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, Application teams, UX Designers and Researchers, Governance partners, and executives to deliver highly trusted products used globally.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the vision, roadmap, and direction for Hyatt’s Data and AI Products aligned with Hyatt’s business priorities
  • Lead product discovery, planning, scoping, and prioritization to deliver high-impact outcomes for corporate and on-property colleagues
  • Develop a deep understanding of colleague personas, search behaviors, information needs, and end-to-end user journeys through research, usage data, and continuous feedback
  • Gather requirements, determine features and their priority, write product specs, refine feedback, help write test plans, manage backlog, and ship products quickly
  • Define and prioritize the data-source onboarding roadmap based on user value, source readiness, ownership, governance, access requirements, and expected impact
  • Ensure data quality, definition, monitoring, alerts, and recourse is built into roadmap plans and engineering requirements of each data and AI initiative/product
  • Ensure new product and AI requirements follow Hyatt policies, security and privacy standards, role-based access controls, responsible AI principles, and corresponding contracts before being passed to developers
  • Define and ensure products meet business SLAs
  • Gain an intimate understanding of the current methods of building and delivering data and AI pipelines into Hyatt’s data and AI Platforms and define how this should work in the future
  • Represent the team with partners and senior company leaders to align resources and prioritization
  • Promote enterprise-wide adoption of data and AI Products
  • Educate teams on data and AI Products and use cases
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt core values

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Strong background and knowledge in production ready data and AI product lifecycle development on modern cloud data platforms will be important to this role.
  • The ideal candidate demonstrates a commitment to Hyatt core values: respect, integrity, humility, empathy, creativity, and fun.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or technical discipline, or equivalent work experience
  • Preferred: master’s degree in business (MBA), Computer Science, Engineering Management, or related field
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in guiding the strategy and lifecycle of data and AI products and its underlying data to ensure it collectively achieves business objectives, leveraging or managing data and AI products to drive business value with a proven track record of success
  • 2+ years of product experience with search, knowledge management, content discovery, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), conversational AI, or related products
  • Demonstrated understanding of search and retrieval concepts, including user intent, relevance and ranking, metadata and taxonomy, content quality, source attribution, access controls, and feedback loops
  • Experience using qualitative and quantitative research and product analytics to improve search success, answer quality, zero-result rates, click-through and adoption
  • Proven ability to navigate difficult situations with competing stakeholder needs and across multiple audiences, including individual contributors, managers, and executives
  • Excellent organization, communication, and presentation and stakeholder-management skills
  • Knowledge of modern data and AI Infrastructure and related processes, including basic cloud knowledge such as Snowflake, AWS, GCP, or similar platforms
  • 2+ years of hands of SQL development skills and experience
  • Working knowledge of agile methodologies and SCRUM

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $109,300 - $140,000

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Under your manager's guidance, work on reporting activity, ideally using PowerBI dashboards;

Collaborate on documentation of the Standard operating procedures.

Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken);

Knowledge of SQL or PowerBI a would be an advantage;

Experience in process modelling or creating and documenting procedures would be a plus;

Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Senior Sales Manager/Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
At IHG, the guest journey doesn't end at booking — that's where it begins. We're looking for a Product Manager to design and deliver digital guest products that bring our brand, loyalty, marketing, and product strategies to life.

As the Product Manager, you will coordinate among business stakeholders, software developers, technical engineers, designers, data analysts, and other functional subject matter experts to create a comprehensive and holistic roadmap that identifies key “moments of truth” along the post-booking journey that enable compelling hotel stay experiences.

This role delivers a cohesive product experience consistent with IHG goals and promises, spanning from strategy design and ideation to development, deployment and successful hotel sustainment.

Your day to day

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Lead the creation and execution of a global product strategy and roadmap that enhances stay experiences. Identify product opportunities and potential for innovation in anticipation of emerging market trends, competitive landscape, and guest expectations. Develop a roadmap of initiatives including both incremental enhancements and new product launches to meet evolving business and customer needs.
  • Guest Experience & Design: Define and design ideal guest experiences through guest journey mapping, conceptual designs, wireframes, and prototypes in collaboration with UI/UX partners & other cross-functional teams. Serve as a champion for the guest experience, ensuring all solutions meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication: Collaborate with stakeholders from Marketing, Brand Teams, Hotel Operations, and Product & Technology to align the product roadmap with business objectives. Act as the key point of contact for large-scale, cross-enterprise digital programs that touch owned product portfolio. Effectively communicate product updates, strategy, and value propositions to senior leadership and global/regional operators. Engage and influence internal and external teams, ensuring clarity of vision and alignment on key objectives.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Measurement: Create test plans and leverage data/performance insights to inform product decisions, prioritize work, and optimize product features. Establish and track key performance metrics (KPIs) to assess the value of products, measure post-launch success, and drive future enhancements. Socialize performance via dashboards and standing product business reviews.
  • Product Lifecycle Management: Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring prioritization of work delivers maximum value. Monitor product performance post-launch and develop ongoing optimization and improvement plans based on guest feedback and data analysis. Ensure product relevance by identifying and addressing potential obsolescence well in advance, staying proactive in evolving customer and business needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Execution: Lead cross-functional teams (e.g., Engineering, UX, Design) to develop and implement the product roadmap on time and within budget. Serve as the chief evangelist for assigned digital products, promoting alignment across the business and championing the adoption of digital guest experience initiatives at the hotel and regional level. Partner with external vendors and agencies as necessary to execute strategic objectives.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Business Management, Information Technology, User Experience, Customer Experience, Statistics, Business, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • 3-5+ years progressive work-related experience with demonstrated proficiency in Product Management disciplines as well as experience managing across teams in significant complex projects
  • Familiarity with guest-facing and hotel colleague-facing systems, including Property Management System, Service Optimization tools, Point of Sale system, In-Room Televisions & Technology, User-facing Mobile Apps highly desired
  • Demonstrated work related experience in creation and delivery of digital solutions with a focus on customer-facing experiences; product management experience in organizing, planning, and executing large-scale projects from conception through implementation
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding in the areas of consumer engagement, digital experience design and voice of customer insights and feedback
  • Demonstrated experience in hands-on creation and delivery of digital solutions, including knowledge of iterative delivery models and customer-centric design thinking principles
  • In depth knowledge of hotel operations, including solid understanding of key metrics within the hotel industry. Experience in managing logistically complex programs with both business and technical stakeholders
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing and presenting information to stakeholders, vendors, management and staff.

Travel - 10%

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an exception of three (3) days in the ATLANTA office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Internal Audit is a new function at GetYourGuide, built from the ground up to support the business through its next phase of growth. As one of the function's first hires, you'll help shape its audit universe, methodology, and operating model, combining hands-on business audit work with SOX and internal-control readiness, and setting the foundations for how the function operates as it scales.

Your mission

  • Help build the internal audit function from the ground up in line with IIA standards, establishing the audit universe, methodology, and cadence, and identify advisory or value-add opportunities that position the function as a trusted partner.
  • Plan and execute business audit engagements across GetYourGuide's functions, partnering with business units, clusters, finance, controls, and risk stakeholders. Conduct fraud reviews and investigations as mandated by Management, and support programme assurance workstreams to optimise outcomes.
  • Own SOX compliance work in your remit, including internal control evaluation, testing, and remediation, supported by external audit advisors. This includes assessing technology-related risk (security, cloud, AI controls) where relevant to scope; not an IT audit role, but tech and governance knowledge is expected.
  • Run audit work programmes and prepare high-quality reports, dashboards, and summaries for senior stakeholders and committee reporting, driving remediation actions to resolution and tracking progress with process owners.
  • Help shape the function's processes and tooling with an AI-first mindset, building in automation and analytics from scratch rather than inheriting legacy ways of working.
  • Build relationships across finance, controls, and risk stakeholders (project management, treasury, supplier and vendor management, brand and marketing, sustainability, marketplace fraud) and external audit partners, translating findings into clear, actionable communication.
  • Bring a proactive, detail-oriented approach and stay comfortable in a fast-paced environment where the function's structure and priorities are still evolving.

Your toolkit

  • Around 6-8 years of end-to-end internal audit experience with financial literacy in reporting and accounting in line with IFRS / PCAOB standards.
  • Proven experience building or establishing an internal audit function.
  • Strong experience with SOX and internal-controls evaluation, testing, and remediation. ERM / COSO knowledge is essential.
  • Practical, in-house audit implementation experience (not purely advisory).
  • Experience developing audit universes, methodologies, work programs, reports, dashboards, and reporting to senior finance leadership.
  • Strong background in continuous auditing and data analytics.
  • Exposure to technology-related audit areas such as security, cloud, or AI controls.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to change in a fast-paced, agile business.
  • High standards of integrity, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Fluency in English.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience across multiple businesses or internal audit client environments.
  • Marketplace or e-commerce experience.
  • A blend of consulting or Big 4 internal audit experience and in-house experience.
  • Big 4 risk assurance or risk management background involving internal audit client work.
  • CIA, ACCA, Chartered Accountant, or CPA qualification.
  • German language skills.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

KAYAK for Business (K4B) is KAYAK's corporate travel platform — built to help companies manage business travel through a modern online booking experience, AI-powered features, and a connected network of travel management partners. This Senior Account Manager role sits at the heart of our client relationships: you will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of US-based corporate clients, helping them get real value from the platform, stay on track with their travel programs, and grow with us over time. You'll work closely with a collaborative account management team and partner regularly with colleagues across Product, Support, Finance, and Implementation to deliver for your clients.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own a portfolio of assigned corporate accounts and serve as their primary day-to-day contact for platform adoption, account health, and ongoing support.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with client travel teams and program managers, with a focus on retention and satisfaction.
  • Lead regular account reviews, quarterly business reviews, and strategic performance reviews — often in coordination with travel management company (TMC) partners.
  • Monitor account health across your portfolio, identify risks early, and develop clear action plans to address them.
  • Drive adoption of platform capabilities — including AI-assisted booking, group travel features, direct content, and international expansion — by helping clients understand the value and supporting successful rollouts.
  • Coordinate with internal teams including Product, Support, Finance, and Implementation to resolve issues, close open items, and deliver on commitments made to clients.
  • Manage contract renewals and amendments; contribute to pricing discussions and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Keep account records, action logs, and renewal timelines accurate and up to date.
  • Contribute to team-wide improvements — including playbooks, templates, and scalable processes — that help the whole team work more effectively.
  • Represent the voice of your clients internally, sharing feedback and patterns that help the broader team and product organization make better decisions.

Please Apply If You Have

  • Experience in account management, client success, customer relationship management, or a related client-facing role — we value what you've accomplished and the skills you've built, not a specific number of years or a particular job title
  • A track record of managing multiple client relationships at the same time, with strong follow-through and attention to detail
  • Clear, confident communication skills — written and verbal — and comfort working with people at different levels of an organization, from day-to-day contacts to senior decision-makers
  • The ability to use data to track account performance, spot trends, and inform your conversations with clients
  • A collaborative, organized approach to work, including the ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and external partners to get things done
  • Equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills from adjacent fields (such as hospitality, operations, consulting, or customer success) are genuinely considered

Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of the Cabin Crew Rostering team within SIA’s Integrated Crew Operations & Planning Department. He/She will ensure that the Cabin Crew rosters are accurate, compliant, equitable and delivered on time, while supporting training requirements, network changes and operational resilience through effective use of crew rostering systems and data-driven analysis.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, optimise and publish monthly Cabin Crew rosters, ensuring consistent standards of fairness, accuracy, quality and timeliness. (e.g. fair and accurate distribution of flying hours/allowances).
  • Develop rostering strategies using data, scenario analysis and rule reviews to balance operational requirements with crew welfare and equity outcomes.
  • Configure, monitor and refine system parameters and logic within Crew Management and Jeppesen Crew Rostering systems to improve roster quality, efficiency and compliance.
  • Plan, support and roster regulatory and service training for existing crew and new cabin crew trainees, ensuring operational qualification across aircraft types and progression for multi-fleet capability.
  • Coordinate timely injection of new crew in support of network growth and operational needs, enabling ease of deployment and strengthening operational resilience.
  • Ensure rostering outputs comply with regulatory requirements and industrial/collective agreements, and maintain strong auditability of rostering decisions and rule application.
  • Respond quickly to network adjustments and aircraft changes to adapt to company's directives and operational requirements.
  • Partner closely with Cabin Crew Division stakeholders and the union on roster-related matters, including policy/rule interpretation, change communication and issue resolution.
  • Manage roster-related enquiries and feedback from crew, addressing concerns on roster outcomes and fairness with clear, timely explanations through crew communications or engagement sessions.
  • Manage a small team of 3 to 4 Associates (redistribution of team members might arise, depending on operational needs).

Requirements

  • A good degree, preferably in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, Engineering or Information Technology.
  • Experience in IT Projects is preferred.
  • A team player, with positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent planning and organisation skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.job_description:
Job description:

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

The Director, Technical Accounting, will be responsible for providing ongoing technical accounting guidance for transactions impacting Wyndham Hotels & Resorts.  This position will research and conclude on technical accounting matters and will document conclusions in formal accounting position papers, ensuring the proper treatment of transactions in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).  Technical accounting responsibilities will include accounting for new business initiatives, accounting and due diligence support on potential acquisitions, post-acquisition accounting and integration support, ongoing impairment reviews of intangible assets and other significant balance sheet items and assisting with the implementation of new accounting pronouncements.  The Director, Technical Accounting will also assist our External Reporting team in the preparation and review of documentation supporting our quarterly and annual SEC filings, press releases and earnings call scripts.  Finally, the Director, Technical Accounting will participate in the monthly close process on an as needed basis, particularly on matters involving technical accounting considerations, including monthly balance sheet reviews, quarterly reporting packages, internal and external audit requests and review of recurring accounting memos.

What you'll do
  1. Provide technical accounting guidance for complex and emerging accounting issues impacting Wyndham Hotels & Resorts (e.g., revenue recognition, business combinations, leases, stock-based compensation, impairments, debt / equity instruments).  Specific responsibilities will include:
    • Research and conclude on technical accounting matters and document conclusions in formal accounting position papers. 
    • Serve as a liaison with the external auditors to ensure they concur with our accounting positions.
    • Annual / ongoing asset impairment reviews. 
    • Provide technical accounting guidance to the Finance teams in our international regions.
  2. Stay current with FASB, EITF and SEC initiatives, tracking proposed changes and new accounting standards and determining the financial impact to Wyndham Hotels & Resorts when such standards are issued.  
  3. Accounting and due diligence support on all acquisitions / divestitures including documenting formal acquisition accounting memos, preparation of the opening balance sheet, partnering with external valuation specialists on valuation work, and post-acquisition accounting and integration support.
  4. Assist the External Reporting team in the quarterly external reporting process, including the preparation of documentation supporting our quarterly form 10-Qs and annual 10-K and review of SEC filings, press releases and earnings call scripts.
  5. Participate in the monthly close process on an as needed basis, particularly on matters involving technical accounting considerations, including monthly balance sheet reviews, quarterly reporting packages, internal and external audit requests and review of recurring accounting memos.
  6. Assist with ad hoc projects and internal initiatives.
You'll be successful if you have
  • Extensive experience with technical accounting research and preparation of accounting position papers with the ability to communicate complex issues clearly to senior leadership and external auditors.
  • Strong knowledge of practices and concepts associated with U.S. GAAP.
  • SEC reporting experience.
  • Proven leadership skills.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to anticipate issues and aggressively drive initiatives to achieve results. 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to interact with all levels of the organization and external contacts.
  • Demonstrated ability to work under pressure.
  • Strong collaborative skills and ability to work in a dynamic team-based environment.
  • Detail oriented, self-motivated and able to work on cross functional teams.
Required Qualifications/Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting required.
  • CPA license required.
  • 10 plus years of progressive accounting experience, including technical accounting research and SEC reporting.
  • Prior public accounting experience required, Big 4 preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of practices and concepts associated with U.S. GAAP.
  • SEC financial reporting experience. 
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel, with previous experience using Oracle preferred.

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

 

Job Location: Parsippany - 22 Sylvan Way, 22 Sylvan Way, Parsippany, New Jersey  07054
Employment Status: Full-time

 

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. based positions only, the expected pay range for this position is $170,000 - $210,000 annually.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation such as work location, background, experience, and performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

 

In addition to the base pay, this role is eligible to receive an incentive payment pursuant to the Annual Incentive Plan with a 20% annual target, subject to the terms of the Plan.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is committed to attracting, motivating, and retaining talented team members who align with our company’s core values. We are proud to reward our full-time team members with comprehensive benefit programs and resources which include:

  • Health insurance with HSA and FSA options
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life/AD&D insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Vacation time- Accrue 2.692 hours of paid vacation per week
  • Paid holidays- 11 Core Scheduled Paid Holidays with potential additional paid days off as business operations and the calendar permit (e.g. in 2026, there is an additional 7 days of paid company closure).
  • Paid sick leave accrued as state and local laws require
  • Additional paid time off in the form of one volunteer day, bereavement time, as well as jury duty time.  

 

Participation in any of the benefit plans and programs made available to team members is subject to satisfaction of eligibility requirements. More information can be found on Our Benefits Page.  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts reserves the right to amend or terminate any benefit plan or program at any time in accordance with applicable law.

 

We are accepting applications for this position through 10/01/2026.

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Company: Bókun, A Tripadvisor Company

Location: UK (Hybrid - Commutable to Oxford or London)

Contract: 6-Month Fixed-Term (Performance-based extension and growth path)

Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Quarterly Sales Incentive Plan

About Bókun

Bókun is the leading reservation system and marketing platform for the global tours and activities industry. Founded in Iceland and now a fast-growing subsidiary of Tripadvisor Inc., we offer the best of both worlds: the high-energy pace and innovation of a startup with the stable backing of the world’s largest travel guidance platform.

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Development Associate to join our team. This is not a typical cold-calling role; it is a consultative position designed for those who want to master the art of SaaS sales by working with a high percentage of warm and qualified leads.

While this role begins as a 6-month fixed-term contract, we view it as the perfect foot in the door opportunity. For a high-performer, this is a proving ground to demonstrate your ability to grow and potentially take advantage of future openings and long-term career paths within Bókun and the wider Tripadvisor ecosystem.

What You Will Do

  • Consultative Outreach: Conduct high-volume engagement with prospective customers who have already shown interest in our platform, moving beyond scripts to have meaningful business conversations.
  • Value Positioning: Clearly articulate the Bókun value proposition, identifying an operator’s pain points and demonstrating how our suite of tools (Reservation systems, Channel Managers, and Websites) can grow their revenue.
  • Business Discovery: Act as a brand ambassador for both Bókun and Tripadvisor, utilizing a consultative approach to identify business needs and solve real-world challenges for tour providers.
  • Pipeline Management: Manage your activity and lead progression within Salesforce, ensuring every opportunity is nurtured and moved through the funnel with precision to meet key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Collaborative Growth: Work closely with our Account Executives and Support teams to ensure a seamless transition as high-quality opportunities convert into long-term partners.

What You Will Bring To The Team

  • Communication Mastery: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly, tell a compelling story, and handle objections with curiosity and resilience.
  • Sales DNA: A results-driven, execution-focused mindset with a strong desire to exceed targets in a fast-paced environment.

Job overview and responsibilities

The role of a Scrum master is a pivotal role in guiding Agile teams to deliver high-quality, business-critical products. You will be instrumental in cultivating a culture of continuous improvement, empowering teams, and fostering seamless cross-functional collaboration.

    • Coach team members and product managers on Agile principles, practices, and frameworks

    • Organize and conduct training sessions to enhance team members’ skills in Agile methodologies
  • Delivery Oversight:
    • Ensure teams are delivering work in alignment with sprint goals and release timelines
    • Use Agile metrics (velocity, burndown, cycle time) to provide insight into team performance and opportunities for improvement

  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Act as a bridge between product managers, developers, QA, and stakeholders
    • Provide clear and consistent updates on team progress, risks, and delivery commitments
  • Agile Maturity & Continuous Improvement:
    • Promote and support the adoption of Agile best practices across teams and departments

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

Agoda launched Flights in 2019 and is now scaling rapidly to become a leading Flights OTA across APAC. With Singapore and Malaysia identified as a key growth market, we are expanding our commercial team to capture this opportunity.

The Opportunity:

As the Leader for Flights in Singapore and Malaysia, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Agoda’s market presence, driving partner strategy, and building the foundations for long-term success. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the intersection of commercial negotiations, strategic partnerships, and cross-functional leadership.

You’ll operate with end-to-end ownership of the Singapore and Malaysia market: identifying and closing new partnerships, optimizing performance with existing partners, and ensuring Agoda delivers unmatched value to travelers and suppliers alike. While this is an individual contributor role, you will function as Agoda’s commercial face in-market, working directly with C-level executives of our partners, supported by global teams across Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and more.

This is a rare opportunity to join a start-up within a global leader, with the autonomy to move fast, take bold bets, and directly shape Agoda’s Flights success story.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the strategy: define and execute market strategies for Singapore and Malaysia, balancing growth, profitability, and long-term competitive positioning.
  • Lead commercial negotiations: Own pricing, availability, and commercial terms with airline partners to maximize Agoda’s competitiveness.
  • Be the market voice: Act as the go-to expert on Singapore and Malaysia aviation and online travel, sharing insights with internal teams and shaping Agoda’s product and growth strategy.
  • Deliver partner success: Build deep, trusted executive-level relationships with suppliers, driving joint initiatives that enhance distribution, revenue, and customer experience.
  • Drive execution excellence: Ensure partners’ day-to-day needs are met by collaborating with Agoda’s regional supply teams, operations, and product specialists.
  • Analyze and optimize: Use data and insights to drive decision-making, identify opportunities, test solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Innovate at scale: Conceptualize and launch new commercial models, distribution initiatives, and customer-facing features that unlock growth.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in the Flights / OTA / airline industry with strong exposure to commercial negotiations, distribution, and market strategy (experience in Singapore and Malaysia highly preferred).
  • Proven track record of delivering growth through partnerships, negotiations, and strategy execution.
  • Commercial acumen with the ability to balance short-term results and long-term market building.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills in English and Mandarin; able to manage complex conversations at senior levels.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with hands-on execution capabilities and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Analytical rigor; demonstrated ability to use data to shape decisions and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and executing end-to-end business plans that cut across commercial, operational, legal, and marketing dimensions.

This role is based in Singapore. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position, and candidates are expected to have valid work authorization in Singapore.

As we seek to continuously elevate the Talent Acquisition experience the Talent Acquisition Manager will lead and support on a variety of projects contributing to the regional Talent Acquisition roadmap.

  • Creative - You enjoy collaborating with others and understand how to facilitate alignment across multiple stakeholders to ensure timely decisions, such as aligning on offer terms. Equally you are able to think strategically and plan talent attraction initiatives.
  • Agile - You are familiar in working within a fast-paced environment and can empathize when things pivot or change. You seek to understand and always assume good intent, clarifying next steps to move forward.

Overview

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance of your own financial operation at Enterprise Mobility. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

This position is located at 5821 6 St SE Calgary AB.

We offer a robust Benefits Package including , but not limited to:

  • Competitive Compensation - This position offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $54,080 with an average 40 hour work week.
  • Paid Time Off, starting with 12 days off per year
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!

We’re a family-owned, world-class portfolio of brands and leading provider of mobility solutions worldwide. Founded more than 65 years ago with a commitment to the communities that we serve, we operate a global network with 90,000 dedicated team members across nearly 100 countries, and more than 2.1 million vehicles taking our customers where they want to go. We owe our success to each and every one of our people. That's why we empower everyone on our team with opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Growth & Strategic Initiatives Manager

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

We are looking for a Senior Growth & Strategic Initiatives Manager to help lead the next chapter of creator and social at Expedia Group. Creator has evolved from a marketing channel into an enterprise capability that can shape brand equity, audience growth, content efficiency, reputation, acquisition, loyalty, and revenue. Our Creator & Social team builds trust, relevance, and demand through creative ideas, strong partnerships, and a deep understanding of travelers on social.

Working across brand-level creator leads and pods, you will connect the macro business environment to brand strategies, champion the strongest work, and create the strategic center of excellence that enables greater clarity, integration, and scale.

This leader will connect business strategy, social, creators, partnerships, and emerging commercial models—identifying not simply how to activate opportunities, but which opportunities the business should pursue and why. This is not a traditional campaign execution, talent-management, influencer-sourcing, or content-calendar role. You will mobilize, integrate, scale, measure, and champion the work that makes creator and social valuable across the business.

In this role, you will

  • Determine how to win with creators and social—whether through creator, social, talent, partnership, content, affiliate, or a combination—and turn that choice into a compelling story that sells the strategy, investment, and path to impact
  • Shape the enterprise portfolio of creator and social investments—help determine which cultural, entertainment, sports, celebrity, platform, and affiliate opportunities best solve priority business problems, create distinctive audience value, and compound across brands and markets; recommend what to fund, scale, sequence, or decline based on expected impact, commercial potential, and opportunity cost
  • Own global expansion and cross-brand integration by determining what should travel across markets, what requires localization, and what should remain market-specific; scale high-quality assets and creator-led storytelling for growth and paid social channels
  • Champion and scale creator business models, including affiliate monetization, creator commerce, loyalty integration, product and content partnerships, performance economics, creator-owned audiences, and platform partnerships
  • Integrate across brand-level creator leads and up-level brand-level strategies in partnership with their owners; connect those strategies to cross-brand and enterprise opportunities while identifying shared systems, learning, investment, and amplification opportunities
  • Support measurement and use data, amplification insight, and performance signals to strengthen strategies and tell a more compelling story of impact across creator-owned, brand-owned, paid, and earned environments
  • Independently counsel senior leaders and influence across marketing, communications, media, product, loyalty, legal, finance, procurement, agencies, and geographic teams; lead agencies at the strategy and creative level; and build scalable decision frameworks, operating mechanisms, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Lead and develop a team of five or more while raising strategic standards and leadership capability across the broader creator and social community, including partnership with brand-level creator leads

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have deep, senior-level experience (10+ years) in both social strategy and creator strategy (not a social strategist who has occasionally worked with influencers, and not a creator specialist who cannot evaluate an organic social strategy)
  • You have led integrated, multi-brand or enterprise programs and can coach, develop, and up-level brand-level strategies in partnership with individual brand leads
  • You have translated business and marketing objectives into integrated social, creator, partnership, channel, and commercial strategies, then sold those strategies through compelling stories and data-backed recommendations to senior audiences
  • You have owned or led global expansion, growth-market programs, local-market adaptation, platform-funded programs, and the scaling of creator-led assets for growth and paid social channels
  • You have developed creator commercialization or emerging business models, such as affiliate platforms, social-first commerce, loyalty, product integration, performance partnerships, creator-owned audiences, or new distribution models
  • You bring a portfolio and investment mindset and can recommend what to fund, stop, or sequence—and what information is needed before deciding
  • You have executive presence and judgment, including the ability to counsel senior leaders, challenge assumptions, navigate organizational complexity, and influence without formal authority
  • You have experience with creator amplification and measurement across owned, paid, and earned channels, using data and performance signals to sharpen strategy; you also bring strategic agency leadership and celebrity, high-profile talent, or major cultural partnership experience
  • You have built and led teams, strengthened operating systems, raised talent capability beyond your direct reporting line, and are familiar with AI-enabled tools and automation
  • You are an exceptional storyteller who makes complex strategic choices clear, compelling, and actionable

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Director, Growth Operations to join our Global Growth Operations team. In this role, you will be collaborating with the broader Global Growth Strategy & Operations team, as well as IT, Analytics, regional Growth teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

The Director, Growth Operations is responsible for the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of the centralized data environment serving Hyatt’s Growth organization. This role partners with IT, Analytics, regional Growth teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data integrity, consistent governance, and operational alignment of Growth KPI data across the organization. This role will be responsible for:

  • Data Standards and Definitions: Establishes and maintains standardized definitions, business rules, hierarchies, and calculation methodologies for GIH (“Growth Intelligence Hub”) data elements and Growth KPIs.
  • Data Quality Management: Monitors GIH data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and validity; investigates issues and coordinates corrective action with data owners and technology partners.
  • Data Stewardship: Defines data responsibilities across global and regional Growth teams and ensures stakeholders fulfill established data-management requirements.
  • Metadata and Documentation: Maintains the GIH data dictionary, source-to-report mappings, lineage documentation, transformation logic, and governance procedures to support transparency and consistent use of data.
  • Data Access and Controls: Partners with IT, Analytics, and business leaders to establish role-based access, appropriate data-use controls, and approval processes that balance business needs with confidentiality and compliance requirements.
  • Issue Resolution and Escalation: Serves as the primary business point of contact for GIH data issues, prioritizes remediation efforts, resolves ownership questions, and escalates material risks or recurring defects.
  • Release and Change Governance: Assesses the downstream impact of proposed changes to GIH data sources, structures, definitions, and reporting; coordinates stakeholder review, validation, communication, and implementation.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 7+ years of operations, technology enablement, CRM administration, analytics, business intelligence, or business systems experience.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree required; Business, Information Systems, Analytics, Finance, or related field preferred
  • Experience administering CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), reporting tools, and/or business process design
  • Strong analytical, project management, communication, and change management skills
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives in a global organization preferred
  • Growth-related corporate hospitality reporting experience strongly preferred

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The salary range for this position is $142,500 - $190,000. This position is also eligible to earn an annual bonus. The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! How We'll Help You Thrive

Introduction

Join a regional legal team where you'll partner closely with commercial, marketing, loyalty, partnerships, and technology stakeholders across Asia Pacific. This role offers a unique opportunity to provide practical, business-focused legal advice while supporting strategic initiatives across multiple markets and jurisdictions. If you're a commercially minded lawyer who enjoys balancing legal risk with business objectives, this is an excellent opportunity to broaden your regional impact and influence.

Your day to day

  • Partner with commercial, marketing, loyalty, partnerships, and technology teams across EPAC, providing practical legal guidance that supports business goals while managing legal and regulatory risk.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, supporting a high-volume contracting environment across multiple markets and stakeholders.
  • Support the execution of regional and global initiatives by providing local market legal guidance, ensuring agreements, campaigns, and partnerships are structured effectively and compliantly.
  • Monitor regulatory developments across the region, identify emerging risks, and work with subject matter experts to provide timely, practical solutions for the business.
  • Drive improvements in legal operations, contracting processes, governance, compliance, and training initiatives to enhance efficiency, consistency, and stakeholder experience.

What We Need From You

  • 5 year PQE lawyer with experience in commercial legal work, including contracts, marketing, partnerships, technology, or other business-facing legal matters.
  • Strong contract drafting, negotiation, and advisory skills, with the ability to provide clear, practical, and commercially focused legal solutions.

Job description:

We can’t wait to welcome you!
 

The Role

Prospecting and qualification of new construction La Quinta, Hawthorn Suites, ECHO Suites, Microtel and conversions for La Quinta and Hawthorn Suites in California.  Negotiation of deal terms and Property Improvement Plans.  Execution of hotel franchise agreements.  Relationship management and attendance at industry events.  Submittal of Forecasts and general reporting.

What you'll do

  • Networking/Industry Event Attendance.
  • Negotiate Terms and Execution of Contracts.
  • Manage Relationships.
  • Forecasting/Reporting.
  • Assisting other members of development team on special projects.

You'll be successful if you have
  • Extensive sales experience.
  • Hotel franchise development experience.
  • Proven achievement in sales by exceeding quotas.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.

  • Effective presentation skills.

Required Qualifications/Experience

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel franchise companies in the world by number of properties with approximately 8,400 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 869,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 25 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

 

Job Location: Remote in the United States, Remote, Remote, Remote  00000

Compensation & Benefits

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation such as work location, background, experience, and performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is committed to attracting, motivating, and retaining talented team members who align with our company’s core values. We are proud to reward our full-time team members with comprehensive benefit programs and resources which include:

As our Customer Experience & Insights Manager, you'll help ensure the voice of the customer is at the heart of business decision-making, transforming feedback and data into meaningful improvements that enhance the guest experience from inspiration through to post-holiday reflection.

This is an exciting opportunity to influence the future of the Marella Cruises customer experience, working with stakeholders across the business, onboard teams and external partners to identify opportunities, drive improvements and strengthen guest loyalty through insight-led action.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we expect a high volume of applications for this role. This may lead us to close the vacancy before the application closing date.

Applications for this role will close on 25th September. The successful candidate will work on a hybrid basis, spending one day a week in our Luton office.

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.

About The Job

  • Supporting the wider Customer Experience team, you'll contribute to customer research programmes and help manage the voice of the customer framework, including surveys, feedback tools, reporting and insight generation.

About You

job.job_description:
Business Development Manager, Partnerships | Bókun

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About Bókun

Bókun, a fast-growing subsidiary of Tripadvisor Inc., is a leading reservation system and channel management platform for tours and activities operators globally that enables them to streamline their back-end operations and connect to an ecosystem of online travel agents to grow their business. At Bókun, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that empower our clients to grow their businesses and enhance customer experiences. As a key player in travel technology, Bókun combines the agility of a startup with the stability of a publicly traded organisation.

About The Role

We're growing our Partnerships team and looking for a driven, closer-first Business Development Manager to join our existing partnerships team.

This is a sales role first. You'll build relationships and close commercial agreements with partners across Bókun's full partnerships portfolio — rather than owning one narrow programme. You'll be equally comfortable pitching and negotiating with a founder running a five-person tour operator and a director at an enterprise OTA, and confident owning a deal from first conversation through to signed contract.

Because we're a small, high-ownership team, you'll move fluidly across partnership types as priorities shift, and you'll have real input into how our wider commercial approach and partnerships process evolve — not just execute against what already exists.

Key Responsibilities

New Business & Deal-closing

  • Build and run your own pipeline of prospective partners across Bókun's partnership types, from first outreach through negotiation to signed contract.
  • Lead meetings and negotiations with partners and stakeholders at every seniority level — from founders to enterprise decision-makers — and close agreements that drive measurable value for Bókun.
  • Represent Bókun's full partnerships value proposition in every conversation: you're selling Bókun first, a specific partnership type second.

Relationship Growth (once a Deal Is Signed)

  • Maintain and grow the commercial relationships you build, ensuring partners stay engaged and continue to deliver value for Bókun.
  • Track and report your pipeline and closed business against clear sales targets.

Cross-partnership & Infrastructure

  • Flex across all partnership types as priorities shift — this is not a single-programme role.
  • Contribute to improving our commercial templates, negotiation playbook and partnerships process more broadly.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of business development / sales experience, ideally in SaaS, marketplaces, or travel technology — a proven track record of sourcing and closing your own deals, not just managing existing ones.
  • Confident and polished presenting, pitching and negotiating with stakeholders at every seniority level, from founders to C-suite/director-level executives.
  • Strong contract negotiation skills — comfortable owning commercial terms through to signature.
  • A genuine hunter: motivated by building pipeline and closing, not solely by managing what's already signed.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills, with near-native business English.
  • Nice to have: experience in the tours & activities / experiences industry.
  • Nice to have: understanding of how two-sided marketplaces work (balancing supply and demand sides) — deep reseller-programme or API/connectivity knowledge is not required and can be learned on the job.
  • Comfortable working in a small, fast-moving team where priorities shift and you'll be asked to cover ground outside your core remit.
  • Other European languages are a plus.
  • A strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities; self-motivated and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Reporting to the International Director, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic & multi-cultural team. If you are passionate about Travel, making things happen, growing new business opportunities and see yourself in the role described below, we will be happy to hear from you!

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
