Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Complex Director of Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

  • Homewood Suites by Hilton Bozeman** Nestled at the base of the Bridger Mountains and just off I-90, this all-suite extended-stay hotel offers a comfortable, lodge-inspired ambiance. With 102 studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites featuring full kitchens and separate living areas, it’s ideal for longer visits. Guests enjoy a free hot breakfast, a Wednesday evening social, indoor pool, fitness center, complimentary airport shuttle, and easy access to downtown Bozeman and Yellowstone National Park. The rustic-chic lobby—with hardwood floors, a two-story fireplace, and buffalo and elk displays—enhances the cozy, regional charm
  • Hampton Inn by Hilton Bozeman** Conveniently located nearby, the Hampton Inn offers a solid limited-service experience with local flair. Guests receive free hot breakfast, complimentary Wi-Fi, and access to an indoor pool, fitness center, and airport shuttle service. Its prime location puts guests within reach of unique local attractions like the Museum of the Rockies and outdoor adventures such as Bridger Bowl and Yellowstone. The resort emphasizes a welcoming, elevated casual style.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

job.job_description:
Here at TUI, you’ll find we’re an inclusive company with a culture of care and by joining the Retail Team as an Assistant Manager in our Tunbridge Wells store, you’ll work alongside your manager to lead, inspire, coach and develop a team to become destination experts to recommend and sell holidays, Cruise, UK Breaks and additional products whilst delivering exceptional sales and customer service. You’ll put all customers at the heart of our business by creating unforgettable holiday experiences that make us the best-loved holiday company.

As part of our dedication to delivering exceptional customer service and flexibility for our customers, you’ll enjoy a varied shift pattern each week including weekends and bank holidays, and evenings at some of our busier stores.

About Our Offer

  • TUI offers much more than just a starting salary of £13.81 per hour
  • Be rewarded for exceeding your targets with our commission scheme
  • Enjoy fantastic holiday benefits, discounts, special offers and the ability to purchase additional TUI time off
  • Benefit from our Health and Wellbeing across key areas – Financial, Health, Social, Community and Career
  • Investment in your development and career progression
  • Pension scheme and life assurance.

About The Job

  • Lead by example and role model company values to inspire your team and deliver excellent customer service
  • Personality and experience will assist you to guide, coach and develop the team to collaboratively reach high performance and standards that drive engagement
  • Assist with developing the team to be proactive and actively investigate and resolve every question or complaint. If things don’t go quite right, you’ll have the confidence to step in and take ownership
  • As technology advances so does TUI, you’ll work with a variety of systems empowering you to enhance your knowledge to actively improve our customer digital journey
  • Monitor and report on customer feedback, spot trends, improve customer satisfaction and loyalty to grow our business
  • Assist with recruiting talent, maintaining high levels of engagement and low levels of attrition.

About You

  • Proven passion for leading by example and delivering excellent customer service
  • Confident and fun motivator with a strong drive to achieve goals and sales targets
  • Skilled at balancing multiple tasks and confident to stay motivated when challenges arise
  • Flexible to embrace change and adapt easily to new ways of working
  • Trusted mentor with a fair and inclusive management style who recognises people are our most valued asset
  • An organised individual who takes pride in their work and able to communicate effectively
  • Able to work a varied shift pattern each week in-line with shop opening and closing times.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We're committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please let us know.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Locations: New York preferred, with other Expedia Group locations up for discussion – Seattle, San Francisco, Los Angeles / West Hollywood, and Chicago as potential options pending Leadership approval.

At Expedia Group, our mission is to power global travel for everyone, everywhere. Within Experience Design (XD), we bring together product design, content design, and research to craft thoughtful, human-centered experiences that connect people to the moments that matter.

About The Role

We’re seeking a Senior Product Designer to help shape the future of Membership and Identity experiences across Expedia Group brands. This space sits at the core of how travelers and partners engage with our ecosystem — spanning how users join, sign in, and manage their profiles, and how we enable seamless, personalized experiences across every touchpoint.

This role operates across both traveler and partner identity, designing experiences that connect user data, preferences, and interactions across Expedia Group’s marketplace — helping create trusted, scalable, and cohesive experiences for all sides of our platform.

You’ll work within a defined product area, partnering closely with product managers, researchers, engineers, and fellow designers to deliver intuitive, high-quality customer experiences.

You’re a strong design practitioner who thrives in complex problem spaces, connects customer needs to business outcomes, and consistently delivers polished, thoughtful solutions. You’re also growing your influence — contributing to design strategy, mentoring others, and helping elevate the craft across the team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own and deliver end-to-end product design for a defined Membership and Identity experience area across Expedia Group brands, from discovery through execution and iteration, driving clear customer and business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, researchers, and fellow designers to frame problems, explore solution spaces, and align on priorities and success metrics within your domain.
  • Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into clear, user-centered design decisions, producing flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that meet a high bar for usability and craft.
  • Contribute to the Membership and Identity experience strategy, applying systems thinking to connect your work to broader customer journeys, platform capabilities, and design systems to ensure scalable, coherent experiences.
  • Design experiences that balance trust, personalization, and usability, ensuring users can confidently manage their accounts, preferences, and interactions.
  • Facilitate design workshops and critiques, communicate design rationale clearly and persuasively to diverse stakeholders, and provide constructive feedback and informal mentorship to elevate the craft of the team.
  • Champion accessibility and inclusive design principles across Membership and Identity experiences, ensuring equitable access for a diverse global audience.
  • Build familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows, and explore how identity and behavioral signals can power intelligent, adaptive user experiences.

Role Expectations

  • Demonstrates strong competency across multiple design disciplines
  • Applies methods to frame problems and synthesize insights
  • Contributes to shaping experience vision and success metrics
  • Produces work that meets a high bar for usability and craft
  • Collaborates effectively across stakeholders
  • Applies a systems-thinking approach
  • Uses qualitative and quantitative insights to inform decisions
  • Communicates clearly and effectively

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), User Experience, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5–10 years of professional experience in product, UX, or interaction design, with a track record of shipping digital products or services at scale
  • Demonstrated ownership of end-to-end design within a product area, including effective collaboration in cross-functional teams with product, engineering, and research partners
  • Proven ability to translate research and data into user-centered solutions across multiple platforms, using modern design and prototyping tools and established design systems
  • Strong portfolio reflecting a high bar of visual craft and interaction design
  • Experience designing across platforms (web, mobile, etc.)
  • Proficiency in design tools, with strength in prototyping and shipping high-quality experiences
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing complex experiences in large or matrixed organizations, ideally in membership, identity, account systems, or customer lifecycle domains (e.g., onboarding, authentication, profile management, personalization)
  • Track record of contributing to and extending design systems, championing accessibility standards, and delivering polished interaction design that scales across platforms and brands
  • Skill in facilitating workshops, design sprints, or collaborative working sessions, and providing mentorship or guidance to other designers
  • Experience using data (behavioral analytics, experimentation, and qualitative insights) to shape design strategy, measure outcomes, and iterate on shipped experiences
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows in the design process, and the ability to apply AI/ML-enabled approaches to improve product experiences

Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness & travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. View our full list of benefits.

The total cash range for this position in New York is $187,000.00 to $261,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $299,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $161,000.00 to $225,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $257,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Beverly Hills is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in San Francisco is $187,000.00 to $261,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $299,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. job.job_description:
Reisen ist für Dich Leidenschaft und Beruf zugleich?

Du möchtest Dein eigenes Reisebüro führen und den Schritt in die Selbstständigkeit wagen, weißt aber noch nicht genau, wie? Du möchtest eigenverantwortlich arbeiten, ohne auf den Rückhalt eines starken Netzwerks zu verzichten? Du bist ein Macher, hast Freude am Verkauf und begeisterst Menschen mit Deiner Leidenschaft fürs Reisen?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Als selbstständiger Agenturpartner (m/w/d) vertrittst Du die Marke ltur, Europas Marktführer für Spontanurlaub, sowie unsere Muttergesellschaft TUI Deutschland und weitere starke Partner. Dabei führst Du Dein eigenes Reisebüro und profitierst gleichzeitig von einem etablierten Netzwerk und langjähriger touristischer Expertise.

Mehr Informationen zur Selbstständigkeit bei ltur findest Du hier.

Begeistere Kunden von unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen – und uns von Deiner Persönlichkeit!

Starte jetzt mit Deinem eigenen Reisebüro am Standort Stuttgart Flughafen.

Das Bieten Wir

  • Eine starke Marke mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung als Marktführer bei Spontanurlaub.
  • Einen komplett eingerichteten Shop an einem Top-Standort.
  • Einen Einstieg ohne Eintrittsgebühr.
  • Ein eigenes, maßgeschneidertes Buchungssystem.
  • Überschaubares Risiko.
  • Ansprechende Provisionssätze.
  • Vielfältige Marketingmöglichkeiten.
  • Eine intensive, teils webbasierte Einarbeitung und kostenlose Schulungen und Weiterbildungen.

Das Erwarten Wir

  • Du hast Berufserfahrung im Verkauf oder bist ein Naturtalent und überzeugst Kunden durch dein sympathisches, gewinnendes Auftreten. z.B.: Tourismuskauffrau / Tourismuskaufmann / Reiseverkehrskauffrau / Reiseverkehrskaufmann / Store Manager / Shopleiter / Filialleiter / Abteilungsleiter / Niederlassungsleiter (m/w/d) oder motivierte Quereinsteiger: Kundenberater / Vertriebsmitarbeiter / Bestandskundenbetreuer (m/w/d)
  • Du verkaufst mit Leidenschaft und begeisterst deine Kunden.
  • Du bist ein Macher und bereit für dein eigenes Ding.
  • Du bietest eine kundenorientierte Beratung im ltur Reise-Shop, am Telefon sowie per Chat.
  • Du agierst, statt zu reagieren und setzt deine eigenen Ideen um.
  • Du motivierst und inspirierst dein Team.
  • Du bist das „Gesicht“ der ltur in deiner Stadt.
  • Du zeigst höchstes Engagement und Kreativität.
  • Du hast gute Zielgebietskenntnisse, begeisterst dich für Menschen, fremde Länder und Kulturen und bringst ein gutes geographisches Wissen mit (von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse in MS Office sowie touristischen Informations- und Reservierungssystemen wie Iris plus und Midoco)

Interessiert an dieser Herausforderung?

Dann bewirb dich bei uns mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH bieten wir ab September 2027 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung Tourismuskaufleute (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reisevermittlung in unserem Reisebüro in Ingolstadt (Innenstadt) an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du liebst Reisen, bist kommunikativ und möchtest anderen zu unvergesslichen Urlaubserlebnissen verhelfen? Dann starte deine Ausbildung bei TUI! Im Reisebüro bist du die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kund*innen und unterstützt sie dabei, genau die Reise zu finden, die zu ihren Wünschen passt. Du berätst zu Reisezielen weltweit, vergleichst Angebote, organisierst individuelle Urlaubserlebnisse und stehst vor, während und nach der Reise als Ansprechpartner*in zur Seite. So wirst du Schritt für Schritt zum Reiseprofi und machst aus Reiseträumen echte Erlebnisse.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Einblicke in die Abläufe eines Reisebüros
  • Planung und Verkauf von Reiseerlebnissen
  • Kleine Teams und Zusammenarbeit mit tollen Kolleg*innen
  • Kennenlernen unserer unterschiedlichen Hotelkonzepte, Marken und Reiseprodukte
  • Übernahme eigener Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung
  • Verständnis dafür, wie aus einer Idee ein unvergessliches Urlaubserlebnis entsteht

Bei uns bekommst du vielfältige Einblicke, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum Profi der Touristikbranche.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Reiseträume wahr werden lassen möchtest.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt. 
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest. 
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt. 
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. 
  • du (Fach)Abitur oder einen Realschulabschluss mitbringst.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade deine Bewerbung einfach online hoch: 

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt) 
  • Lebenslauf 
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnis 
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist 

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und sende uns deine Unterlagen. 
  • Zeig uns, wer du bist – im Auswahlprozess möchten wir dich und deine Stärken kennenlernen.
  • Lerne uns persönlich bei einem Hospitationstag kennen
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot und startest im September deine Reise bei TUI. 

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

This Senior Software Developer role is part of the AI Foundations team which builds and scales reusable AI agents and an underlying agentic platform that automate high-volume engineering workflows, reduce “keep the lights on” effort, and unlock meaningful productivity gains for product and platform teams across Expedia Group. As a Senior Software Development Engineer at Expedia Group, you design, develop, and operate high-quality software solutions that deliver traveler, partner, and business value across multiple services, raising the bar on architecture, reliability, and data-driven outcomes.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and evolve scalable, resilient services and systems that power agentic AI capabilities across our platform.
  • Lead system design (including low-level design), API design, and data modeling for complex, distributed services that integrate traditional software components with AI-driven workflows.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, ensuring quality, robustness, observability, and compliance across experimentation, training, and production environments.
  • Partner with product, applied science, data, and platform teams to define technical direction, break down ambiguous problems, and deliver high-impact features that are reusable across multiple product domains.
  • Drive engineering excellence by setting standards for code quality, testing, performance, security, and reliability, and by mentoring other engineers in modern software and AI development practices.
  • Leverage familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products to design agentic orchestration, tool interfaces, and safeguards that improve developer and traveler experiences.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 6+ years of professional software development experience with a Master's degree, or 8+ years with a Bachelor's degree.
  • Proven ownership of the end-to-end lifecycle of one or more services or components, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g. Java, Kotlin, Python) and system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for scalable, reliable services.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including integrating AI/ML capabilities into user-facing or platform services.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and evolving multi-service or domain-level architectures that combine deterministic services with AI/ML or agentic components, optimizing for scalability, reliability, and cost.
  • Demonstrated track record of improving operational excellence at scale, including observability, SLOs, capacity planning, incident management, and continuous improvement of services that incorporate AI/ML behavior.
  • Hands-on experience with safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, such as model-backed APIs, retrieval-augmented systems, or workflow/agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Ability to use data and experimentation to drive technical and product decisions, including evaluating AI system performance, guardrails, and user impact across multiple product areas.
  • Deep experience with AI-driven or agentic architectures at the platform or domain level, such as building tools, connectors, or orchestration layers that allow AI agents to reliably act on complex travel or commerce systems.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500.00 to $258,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Join our Intercruises Regional Operational HUB team in Marseille, France, where you'll manage the full scope of operations for shore excursions, transfers, and cruise turnarounds. This role sits at the heart of our operations, ensuring seamless delivery from planning through to execution.

This is a fixed-term contract with a view to going permanent

The role will be published until the 2nd of October

About Our Offer

Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.

Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.

A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.

Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.

Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • You'll receive and analyse data across all verticals, loading our cruise line portfolio into the system with precision and attention to detail.
  • Working with global guidelines, you'll help us achieve standardisation while planning services and liaising with suppliers to meet operational needs.
  • The planning system will be yours to run, manage, and review on an ongoing basis, ensuring we meet operational requirements seamlessly.
  • You'll distribute operations information across the team and related business areas, keeping everyone connected and informed.
  • Monitoring changes, modifications, and cancellations is key—you'll update the planning system constantly to ensure smooth operations.
  • Cost optimisation and sales planning according to budgets will be part of your remit, helping us work smarter and more efficiently.

About You

  • Your administration and organisational skills are strong, and you're confident working with technology to get things done.
  • Previous experience in the cruise industry.
  • You can solve problems independently and aren't afraid to suggest improvements to our ways of working, embracing our digital culture.
  • Fluency in both verbal and written English and French is required, with additional languages being advantageous.

job.job_description:
Company Description

At Accor, we believe in creating meaningful experiences and vibrant workplaces where people feel welcome and valued. As one of the world’s leading hospitality groups, Accor is home to over 5,000 properties across 110 countries, united by a shared commitment to excellence, innovation, and our signature Heartist culture.

At Sydney Olympic Park, our precinct brings together three iconic brands, Pullman, Novotel, and Ibis. Each offering a distinct guest experience while sharing a unified team spirit. Whether it’s the upscale sophistication of Pullman, the modern comfort of Novotel, or the smart simplicity of Ibis, our hotels work together to deliver exceptional service in one of Sydney’s most dynamic and event-rich locations.

As part of this precinct, you’ll be joining a collaborative, high-energy that thrives on diversity, creativity, and genuine connection. We’re proud to be part of a global network while maintaining a strong local identity, where every team member is empowered to grow, contribute, and make a difference.

Job Description

Reporting to the Precinct Associate Director of Sales, the Precinct Conference & Events Executive is responsible for the end to end planning, coordination and execution of all confirmed conference, events and group accommodation business across Pullman, Novotel and ibis Sydney Olympic Park.

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining strong client relationships to ensure exceptional customer satisfaction while delivering seamless event experiences from the completion of the sales handover through to event delivery, billing and post-event follow-up. The successful candidate will take ownership of all event coordination activities, working closely with clients and hotel operational teams to ensure events are executed to the highest standard while maximising commercial opportunities and driving repeat business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Managing the end to end coordination of confirmed conference and event business, from sales handover and planning through to on-site execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with conference and event clients to drive repeat business and long-term partnerships.
  • Meeting and hosting clients before, during and after events to ensure service excellence and identify future opportunities.
  • Handling conference and event enquiries and communications professionally across phone, email and online channels.
  • Proactively identifying opportunities to maximise revenue through upselling, menu enhancements, room utilisation and value-added offerings.
  • Coordinating and hosting client site inspections, familiarisations and showcase events.
  • Maintaining ownership of BEO standards, ensuring event documentation is accurate, detailed and distributed in accordance with best practice.
  • Collaborating closely with Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Banquets, Front Office and Reservations teams to deliver seamless events.
  • Maintaining accurate client information, event details and financial records within Delphi and other hotel systems.
  • Managing event postings, invoicing and financial reconciliation to ensure revenue is accurately captured and reported.

Qualifications

What you'll bring:

  • Minimum 2 years' experience within Conference & Events, Hospitality Sales or a similar hotel-based environment.
  • Tertiary qualifications in hospitality management or similar
  • Previous experience coordinating and managing conference and event business from enquiry through to event delivery.
  • Exposure to reactive and/or proactive sales environments within hospitality.
  • Experience using Delphi, hotel property management systems or similar event management platforms (highly regarded).
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, networking and relationship-building skills.
  • A thorough understanding of the conference and events market and emerging industry trends.
  • Outstanding organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • A proactive and self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • A passion for hotel operations and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

Additional Information

Why work for Accor?

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities. With 5400+ Hotels across 110+ countries, the opportunities to grow your career are endless!

  • ALL Heartist Membership - Take advantage of discounts on accommodation and food & beverage worldwide!
  • Family & Friends Discounts - Available on a range of accommodation, services and events for those who mean the most to you
  • Accor Live Limitless (ALL) Loyalty Program - Earn status & reward points on your worldwide stays
  • Learn Your Way - Support your career development with access to Accor’s industry leading training platforms, Accor Academy and Typsy
  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide

Why Join the Sydney Olympic Park Precinct?

  • Be part of a collaborative, multi-brand precinct team in a dynamic location.
  • Enjoy exclusive staff benefits such as $5 duty meals, complimentary coffee and free parking on non major event days.
  • Be part of a vibrant, high energy precinct with Sydney's biggest events right on your doorstep.

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Architecture & Design Operations Coordinator supports the successful execution of operational activities across the Architecture team and broader Design organization. This role coordinates architectural project intake and review workflows, departmental reporting, and the on-site operations of Choice’s Design Lab, where architectural strategies, products, and prototypes are evaluated. The Coordinator partners with Development, Opening Services, Facilities, the broader Design team, Owners, franchisees, vendors, and external consulting firms to maintain timely and consistent project execution. Working closely with department leadership, this role identifies operational roadblocks, improves processes, and supports initiatives aligned with the company’s growth and strategic objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Architectural Process Coordination

  • Manage architectural project intake and allocation by assigning new projects to Architecture team members, maintaining project tracking tools, and serving as the primary coordinator throughout the intake process.
  • Coordinate architectural review workflows by routing submissions, monitoring progress and timelines, and helping ensure contractual and departmental service-level expectations are met.
  • Prepare and maintain compliance, project pipeline, review status, and other architecture-specific reports; track milestones, contractual deadlines, risks, and overall project progress.
  • Serve as a primary point of coordination for franchisees, Owners, and external architecture and design consultants by communicating review status, facilitating information exchange, and supporting timely issue resolution.
  • Maintain project portals, document-management systems, tracking tools, and workflow documentation so project information remains accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen workflow efficiency, reporting accuracy, operational consistency, and project visibility.

Design Lab Operations

  • Manage the day-to-day on-site operations of Choice’s Design Lab, keeping the space organized, functional, and prepared for product evaluations, prototype installations, and cross-functional design initiatives.
  • Coordinate prototype installation buildouts, product testing, sample logistics, material deliveries, and related activities that support design development and validation.
  • Partner with internal teams, Facilities, and external vendors to coordinate maintenance, installations, and improvements to the Design Lab.
  • Maintain Design Lab inventory, equipment, storage areas, samples, and supporting documentation so resources remain current, accessible, and operational.
  • Schedule and coordinate vendor visits, material evaluations, stakeholder meetings, executive tours, and other on-site events to support an organized and productive experience for internal and external partners.

Department Operations and Strategic Initiative Coordination

  • Support department leadership in planning, prioritizing, and executing strategic initiatives through project plans, action trackers, executive status reports, milestone tracking, and other visibility tools.
  • Coordinate cross-functional deliverables, monitor progress, identify potential roadblocks, and escalate issues as appropriate to help keep initiatives on schedule.
  • Contribute to continuous-improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to strengthen departmental workflows, operational processes, reporting, and design documentation.
  • Manage nondisclosure agreement documentation and related processes for pre-contract projects, including timely execution and appropriate recordkeeping.
  • Provide operational and administrative support to the Architecture and Design teams based on evolving departmental priorities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • 2-4 years of experience in project coordination, operations, architecture and design, construction, or a related field.
  • Experience coordinating multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively managing competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience utilizing project management and CRM platforms such as Smartsheet and Salesforce.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting architecture, interior design, hospitality development, construction, or product design teams.
  • Experience with process improvement initiatives and project management methodologies.
  • Familiarity with collaboration and workflow-management tools such as Monday.com and Miro.
  • Experience within the hospitality, architecture, or design industry.

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $75,553 - $88,886. Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

LOCATION & WORK SCHEDULE:

This role is based at our corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, and follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring regular in-office collaboration alongside remote work flexibility.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta, we connect people and cultures, power extraordinary experiences, and shape the future of travel. Here, you'll work on complex challenges on a global scale, using augmented intelligence to build emerging technologies, amplify human potential and continuously grow the skills that keep you at the forefront of what's next.

We are seeking a forward-looking Senior Software Development Engineer to design, build, and scale next-generation applications leveraging cloud-native architectures, AI/ML capabilities, and modern engineering practices.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you will lead the design, development, and optimization of complex software applications. You will mentor junior engineers and collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and implement scalable cloud-based solutions on AWS. This role offers an excellent opportunity for seasoned professionals to leverage their extensive experience, drive innovation, and make significant contributions to high-impact projects in a fast-paced and cutting-edge environment.

Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable cloud-based applications using AWS services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
  • Implement best practices for cloud architecture, security, and performance.
  • Automate deployment, monitoring, and management of cloud applications.
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in Java, Node.js, and Python as well as contribute to both front-end and back-end development as a full-stack engineer.
  • Build and integrate AI/ML-powered features into applications using AWS AI services.
  • Leverage AWS Kiro and AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate tasks, and improve code quality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and applications.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest AWS technologies and industry trends.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on cloud technologies.
  • Proficiency in AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and CloudFormation.
  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, Java, or Node.js.
  • Experienced in deploying and managing applications using Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA), leveraging its robust platform for scalable and efficient cloud solutions.
  • Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or AWS CodePipeline.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and building distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications (e.g., personalization, NLP, recommendations).
  • Experience or exposure to AWS Kiro or similar AI-powered development tools.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, or model integration patterns.
  • Experience working with generative AI or LLM-based solutions is highly desirable.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Execute with a Sense of Urgency
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related technical field is preferred.
  • Experience working in an airline technology environment is preferred.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Developer certification.
  • Experience with microservices architecture and serverless computing.
  • Understanding of networking and security principles in cloud environments
  • Solid knowledge of AI Agentic development
  • Strong knowledge of Agent Harness concepts and how they are implemented by cloud providers
  • Strong knowledge with exposure to AWS AgentCore platform

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
    • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members

  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together

job.job_description:
About us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, models, or experiments. We’re the thrill of discovering a hidden attraction. The ease of catching the right flight. The confidence of seamless ground transport. Through our products, partners, and people, we empower everyone to experience the world.

Role Description

This role is based in Manchester, UK. Our Trips marketplace spans attractions, flights, and ground transport, and we are investing heavily in Data & AI to unlock the next generation of customer and partner value across these verticals.

Data & AI powers many of Booking.com’s most impactful machine-learning capabilities. As a Senior Product Manager, you will play a critical role in expanding the impact of our Data & AI products across the Trips domain. You will define strategy and long-term vision for ML-powered capabilities that enable Trips product teams to move faster, make better decisions, and deliver step-change improvements in customer experience and marketplace performance.

You will act as the primary liaison between Data & AI and the Trips product organization, serving as a trusted partner to senior product and business leaders. You will bring deep ML domain expertise, consult closely with product teams, and collaborate on identifying and shaping high-impact AI-driven opportunities across attractions, flights, and ground transport.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will be expected to operate with high autonomy, drive strategy and alignment at scale, and influence without direct people management.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Defining the 1–3 year ML product vision, KPIs and strategy for Trips ML capabilities in collaboration with senior product managers in the Trips verticals.
  • Acting as the primary ML & AI partner to Trips product teams, ensuring ML capabilities are aligned with customer needs and business objectives.
  • Identifying, shaping, and prioritizing high-impact ML and AI opportunities across attractions, flights, and ground transport.
  • Providing ML domain expertise and advisory support to product and business leaders, including feasibility assessment and solution design.
  • Consulting and brainstorming with product teams to co-create ML-powered product improvements and new experiences.
  • Driving stakeholder alignment across Marketplace Data & AI, Trips, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams.
  • Educating stakeholders on the capabilities, trade-offs, and responsible use of ML and AI.
  • Mentoring and coaching (Senior) Product Managers on ML strategy, problem framing, and ML-driven product thinking.
  • Analyzing outcomes, sharing learnings, and building a strong knowledge base to inform future product decisions.


Qualifications & skills:

  • 7+ years of product management experience working on complex, high-scale digital products.
  • Strong experience with Machine Learning, personalization, recommendation systems, and applied AI.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes without direct ownership of delivery teams or P&L.
  • Strong technical understanding and systems thinking.
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering, data science, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong data literacy and experience making data-informed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and strategic storytelling skills.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for solving real user problems.


Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

  • Opportunity to shape the ML strategy for Trips at global scale, impacting millions of travelers.
  • A high-impact principal IC role with visibility, autonomy, and strategic influence.
  • Competitive compensation, bonuses, and stock potential.
  • Flexible hybrid working, generous leave, and world-class learning opportunities.
  • A beautiful sustainable Campus in Manchester, that offers on-site meals, coffee, and snacks, multi-faith and breastfeeding rooms at the office
  • Discounts & Wallet credits to spend on our products, upgrade to Booking.com Genius Level 3, and friends & family Booking.com discount vouchers
  • Free access to online learning platforms, development and mentorship programs
  • Global Employee Assistance Program, free Headspace membership

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just create a unique workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone.”

Application Process

Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. job.job_description:
Job Purpose

A winner of more than 500 international awards, Emirates operates one of the aviation world’s youngest, most environmentally friendly and technologically advanced-fleet of over 250 aircraft.

Its rapidly expanding network spans 145 destinations in Europe, North America, South America, the Middle East, Africa, the Indian subcontinent and Asia Pacific. The airline is an employee-focused company with a commitment to providing staff with excellent working conditions and competitive salaries.

Our services span almost every aspect of our industry. Behind it all are more than 70,000 colleagues from over 200 nationalities across our 50 business units and associated firms, making us one of the biggest employers in the region.

Joining us you will experience a fast-paced multicultural environment where your ideas and expertise will help shape the future of aviation. Here, you will grow alongside professionals from diverse backgrounds, contributing to our shared success and making your mark on a global stage

What Will I Be Doing

You will be responsible for performing the accounting tasks for Emirates Holidays (EKH) in multiple countries, including UK&IE, Germany and Scandinavia.

Accounts Payable

  • Review and reconcile supplier accounts, statements, and invoices, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely resolution of queries or discrepancies.
  • Oversee the accounts payable payment process, ensuring payments are accurate, appropriately authorised, made within agreed terms, and properly recorded and reconciled.
  • Maintain supplier master data and supporting documentation, ensuring compliance with internal controls and providing professional support in responding to supplier enquiries.
  • Review accounts payable ledger balances, reconciliations, Cash Management, and journal entries to ensure accuracy and completeness throughout the month-end and year-end close processes.

Revenue & Accounts Receivable

  • Perform revenue recognition activities and ensure accurate and timely recording of revenue, cost of sales, and related income in accordance with accounting standards and company policies.
  • Monitor and manage customer and trade accounts, prepare and consolidate aged receivables reports, and support credit control activities by proactively following up on overdue balances, maintaining effective customer relationships, and creating proposals for the write-off of unrecoverable balances.
  • Review and reconcile accounts receivable ledger balances, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and outstanding issues are investigated and resolved promptly.
  • Support month-end and year-end close processes through the review of accounts receivable balances, reconciliations, and related financial reporting activities.

General Ledger

  • Train and provide on the job guidance to direct reports and conduct staff performance review in line with Performance matters i.e. setting objectives and discussing development plans for direct reports.
  • Prepare management accounts and financial reporting packs, providing insightful analysis and commentary on financial performance, trends, and variances against budgets and forecasts.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow planning processes, preparing financial information for internal and external stakeholders to support effective decision-making.
  • Assist with statutory and regulatory reporting requirements, ensuring financial information is accurate, timely, and compliant with relevant standards and regulations.
  • Support tax compliance activities, including the review of tax calculations, preparation of supporting documentation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders to ensure adherence to local tax regulations.

General

  • Train and provide on the job guidance to direct reports on the use of efficient processes, automation features and financial accounting systems to improve the effectiveness of the financial unit. Conduct staff performance review in line with Performance matters i.e. setting objectives and discussing development plans for direct reports.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.

Your mission

As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.

We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.

What You'll Do

  • Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.
  • Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.
  • Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.
  • Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.
  • Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.
  • Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of experience in product management, with at least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.
  • A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.
  • Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.
  • Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.
  • Bonus: Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or travel business.
  • Bonus: A background in engineering or data science — particularly valuable given the technical architecture nature of this role.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

And more…

job.job_description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on: trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions. And we're embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, pairing decades of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that weren't possible before.

Travel moves the world, and we move travel. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:



The People & Culture Advisor blends hands-on P&C operational delivery with genuine business partnering: you will be a visible, trusted first point of contact for managers across OAG, coaching them through everyday people matters, guiding them on policy and employee relations, and helping them lead their teams with confidence.

Reporting to the Head of P&C Operations and working closely with the wider P&C team, you will keep core people processes running smoothly worldwide while building the kind of manager relationships that let you spot issues early, advise with credibility and shape better outcomes. Based in Luton or Lithuania, with regular travel across all OAG locations, you will work with increasing autonomy, contribute to process improvements and help build a globally aligned, employee-centred people function. It is an ideal opportunity for an HR professional who wants to develop real partnering skills alongside a broad, internationally grounded operational foundation, and to progress towards a Business Partner career path.

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract providing maternity cover.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



  • Partner with managers as their first point of P&C contact, coaching and advising them on policies, procedures, performance and employment matters so they can handle people situations well, and escalating complex cases to senior colleagues where needed.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with managers and employees across all OAG locations, getting to know each team's context so your advice is practical and grounded, and helping create a consistent employee experience worldwide.
  • Support managers through employee relations casework: preparing documentation, coordinating meetings, guiding them on fair process and maintaining clear records, contributing to consistent outcomes that reflect OAG's values.
  • Deliver core P&C operational processes globally, including onboarding, offboarding, contract administration and employee lifecycle changes, ensuring accuracy, consistency and compliance at every stage.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date employee data across P&C systems, supporting payroll inputs and ensuring compliance with GDPR and data privacy standards across all jurisdictions.
  • Contribute to P&C projects and improvement initiatives, using what you hear from managers to identify opportunities to improve processes, and supporting the implementation of policy updates and employee experience programmes.
  • Support compliance with employment legislation across multiple jurisdictions, flagging emerging risks to managers and the P&C team and helping keep documentation and policies up to date.
  • Travel regularly between the UK (Luton and London) and Lithuania, building face-to-face relationships with managers and applying processes consistently and sensitively across different cultural contexts.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • A genuine partnering mindset: you enjoy working alongside managers, want to understand their teams and challenges, and see your role as making them better people leaders, not just answering their queries.
  • An advisory approach and growing HR knowledge, with the confidence to guide managers on policy interpretation, employee relations and day-to-day people matters, and the judgement to know when to escalate.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, able to build trust quickly with managers and colleagues across different cultures, locations and seniority levels.
  • International awareness and cultural sensitivity, with the ability to work effectively across multiple geographies and a willingness to travel regularly between the UK and Lithuania.
  • Attention to detail and process orientation, able to manage multiple operational tasks accurately and maintain data integrity across P&C systems.
  • A high degree of integrity and discretion, handling sensitive employee information confidentially and in line with GDPR and local data protection requirements.
  • Curiosity and initiative: comfortable working with minimal guidance, proactively identifying improvements, and developing both operational and business partnering capabilities over time.

IF YOU HAVE THE FOLLOWING THAT WOULD BE GREAT:

  • A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with P&C platforms such as Hibob, BambooHR or Rippling, or exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment law or payroll contexts.
  • Experience working in or with an international organisation supporting employees across multiple countries, or a strong interest in developing global HR capability.

If you don't meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we'd still love to hear from you.



WE WILL OFFER YOU:

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility.

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust.

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month. Plus the option to purchase up to an additional 10 days leave.

⚡ Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

MEDIA PLANNER

Job Summary

The Media Planner owns day-to-day media planning, campaign strategy, vendor management, pacing, optimization, and reporting across channels. This role translates client goals, audience insights, and performance data into actionable media strategies and independently makes recommendations to improve campaign performance and support measurable client outcomes. The Media Planner also serves as a key point of coordination across internal teams, vendors, and junior planning staff.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Insight-driven planner who translates audience behavior, performance data, and client goals into effective media strategies
  • Clear communicator who confidently articulates recommendations, rationale, trade-offs, and performance insights
  • Organized operator who independently manages multiple planning workflows, priorities, and deadlines
  • Analytical problem-solver who identifies performance issues and determines appropriate optimization strategies
  • Confident collaborator who builds strong relationships with clients, vendors, and cross-functional teams
  • Supportive mentor who helps develop Associate Media Planners and provides day-to-day guidance

Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage media plans grounded in client objectives, audience insights, budgets, and channel performance
  • Recommend channel mix, placements, investment levels, and other planning approaches based on campaign strategy and available data
  • Own day-to-day vendor relationships, including evaluating opportunities, managing placements, resolving issues, and coordinating timelines and deliverables
  • Monitor campaign pacing, budgets, and performance; independently identify issues and develop optimization recommendations within client strategy and campaign parameters
  • Analyze campaign results and translate data into clear insights, strategic recommendations, and next-step guidance
  • Lead preparation of reporting deliverables and ensure performance narratives accurately reflect campaign results, learnings, and opportunities
  • Partner with Ad Ops, Analytics, Creative, Account, and other cross-functional teams to guide integrated campaign planning and activation
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and mentorship to Associate Media Planners, including reviewing work, supporting problem-solving, and developing planning skills
  • Maintain accurate media plans, budgets, planning documentation, and campaign records, resolving discrepancies and ensuring alignment across stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, campaign performance, and overall media approach

Requirements

  • 2–4+ years of experience in media planning, buying, or a related discipline
  • Strong working knowledge of digital, social, and programmatic media channels
  • Demonstrated ability to develop media recommendations based on client goals, audience insights, budgets, and performance data
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance, identify trends and issues, and recommend appropriate actions
  • Experience managing vendors and coordinating complex campaign workflows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain recommendations and performance insights clearly
  • Experience with media planning tools, analytics platforms, spreadsheets, and media systems
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

LOCATION:

  • This is a remote position. We are open to a remote candidate located anywhere in the US or an in-office candidate based in our Sarasota, FL/Lakewood, CO office.

COMPENSATION: $65,000 - $75,000 DOE

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision
  • 401k matching contribution
  • Generous paid time off compensation
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Paid volunteer opportunities and company supported charitable events
  • Collaborative, creative and fun team environment with professional growth opportunities

Our Commitment To Culture

At Miles Partnership, we are driven by our commitment to actively evolve inclusive marketing industry practices, drive innovation within the company and empower our team, our clients and the communities we serve. We will make intentional actions to build a work culture where our team members are always heard, empowered and valued. We will provide a culture of service where we enable our teams and clients to meaningfully engage with their communities, share and tell their stories through travel, and lead a movement across the broader tourism industry to influence social change and ensure open access to travel for all.
