job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: 2 days in-office

Principal Enterprise Architect, Infrastructure and Operations

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Principal Enterprise Architect for Infrastructure and Operations, you’ll set the strategy and standards that power reliability, speed, and safety across Priceline’s platforms, networks, and run-time environments.

This role raises the architectural bar for Priceline’s Infrastructure and Operations—building reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective foundations so product teams can ship quickly without chaos. You’ll unify platform engineering, SRE, networking, and multi-region cloud infrastructure into paved roads and guardrails that accelerate delivery, improve reliability, strengthen observability, reduce change-failure rate and MTTR, enable safe, scalable AI adoption, and lower total cost of ownership (TCO).

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Define and evolve the target-state Infrastructure and Operations architecture aligned to Priceline’s long-term business and technology objectives, with a pragmatic phased roadmap and measurable interim milestones.
  • Design and govern global, cloud-native platforms (e.g., Kubernetes/GKE, service mesh, data and messaging backbones, edge/CDN, identity/IAM, network architecture) that are resilient, scalable, secure, and cost-optimized—grounded in explicit trade-offs.
  • Lead platform engineering strategy—establish paved roads/golden paths, an internal developer platform (IDP), reusable reference architectures, and self-service automation that shorten idea-to-production cycles.
  • Lead architecture governance, codifying standards and guardrails, managing technical debt, ensuring compliance, and minimizing architectural risk.
  • Partner with Product and Technology leaders to design end-to-end solutions across internal and third-party systems—defining integration patterns, API/data contracts, clear ownership boundaries, and SLAs.
  • Institutionalize SRE fundamentals and advance Infrastructure as Code and GitOps.
  • Embed security and privacy by design—partner with Security/Risk to implement Zero Trust, secrets and key management, vulnerability & patch orchestration, data protection, and regulatory controls (e.g., PCI, SOX, GDPR/CCPA) across platforms and pipelines.
  • Use business criticality classification to drive resiliency, capacity, and performance engineering requirements, with automated IaC policies for topology/redundancy, data protection, observability configuration, SLOs, change management requirements, and IAM policies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, patterns, and vendors to shape strategic roadmaps—leading build/buy/partner analyses, proofs of concept, and TCO/ROI assessments to de-risk decisions.

Compliance Analyst I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The Compliance Lead ensures that Service Operations delivered to our customers by our service associates adheres to our operating processes and procedures, in relation to refunds, promotion/coupons and gestures of goodwill. They are responsible for the overall spend ensuring we are always customer first in our approach, aligned with regional customer regulations.

Regular audit of our statement of work to ensure vendors deliver under our contractual obligations across our marketplace operations, for traveler, operator and partners. Identify opportunities to leverage AI technology and automate processes used within Contact Centers to adhere to operational and financial processes. Mitigate risk by conducting audits, mitigation planning, internal/external employee knowledge assessment, training and implementing security procedures.

Operating in our fast-moving, and highly competitive environment, we advocate for our customers in our behaviour and decision making. At Tripadvisor we are Traveler first in all our decision making.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

Audit and Monitoring

  • Performing regular audits of external BPO and internal Resolution/Experience Recovery (EcR) processes.
  • Monitoring of AI and Human compliance in handling of refunds, promotions and Gesture of GoodWill processes.

Risk Mitigation

  • Investigate potential compliance breaches or complaints, report findings to CS Management
  • Identify BPO process gaps, assess risks, and implement corrective actions to ensure compliance
  • Identify Refund or Gesture of Goodwill process/policy adherence, to identify if Supplier or Vendor error
  • Collaborate with AI Service Lead to ensure AI tools adhere to refund/compensation service processes

Policy Knowledge

  • Maintain working knowledge of tours & activities industry specific regulations, including consumer refund and compensation regulations
  • Drafting, updating, and enforcing internal refund/compensation processes to comply Regional regulations

Stakeholder Management

  • Take the lead on collaborating with business partners
  • Build trusted relationships with internal business units and external vendors

Reporting

  • Maintain audit documentation on processes and prepare compliance reports for CS Management
  • Maintain weekly Gesture of Goodwill spend reporting
  • Maintain weekly Supplier & Vendor Clawback for process/policy breach

Financial Steward

  • Responsible for auditing Gesture of GoodWill spending
  • Responsible for ensuring clawback from Supplier or external vendor is accurately credited to CS-OPS P&L

AI Automation

  • Build investment strategy to enable AI automated tooling to elevate ability audit and monitor operations
  • Working with CS AI Lead ensure future voice/non-voice AI-Assist remains compliant to regional regulations

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Internal Auditor Certification/Certified Compliance Analyst
  • 3+ years experience in Customer Operations, Service Excellence or CX Transformation
  • Experience working with Global Vendor BPO Operations in an audit or risk analyst role
  • Gen AI Governance experience
  • Close-Loop resolution for process mitigation
  • Customer obsessed mindset, advocating for simplicity and putting yourself in the shoes of the customer

Skills You Should Bring To The Role

  • Traveler first: drive exceptional value and effortless resolution service-support (essential)
  • Execution at speed: Challenge legacy processes, experiment, seeks to always improve (essential)
  • Communication: strong influencing skills with ability to articulate issues to C-Level leadership (required)
  • Data Driven: Strong ability to analyze data, identify trends, and resolve complex issues.

Industry: Experience in a similar role within the Travel Industry (Preferred)

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
The Vice President, Digital Customer Experience is accountable for the strategy, performance, and evolution of Choice Hotels International’s digital customer experience ecosystem, spanning digital commerce, digital content, customer care, loyalty servicing, and digital support across the guest journey.

This role sets the enterprise vision for how guests engage with Choice through the mobile app, mobile web, ChoiceHotels.com, and emerging digital platforms—from inspiration, shopping, and booking to servicing loyalty accounts, managing reservations, resolving problems with hotel bookings or stays, and receiving timely support when plans change.

As a senior leader within the Marketing organization, the VP serves as the connective leader between brand, demand generation, loyalty, customer care, product, operations, and technology. The role translates customer needs and business priorities into a cohesive digital experience strategy that strengthens brand preference, increases direct channel contribution, improves service outcomes, and deepens customer relationships.

The VP builds and leads a high-performing digital customer experience organization spanning Product Marketing, Digital Content, and Customer Care / Digital Servicing, while setting the strategy and vision that guide the Product Management and User Experience (UX) teams. This role will partner closely with the Product Management, User Experience and Engineering teams to align product priorities, experience design, content strategy, and delivery against the broader digital customer experience strategy. Success in this role is measured by sustained revenue growth, improved digital conversion, stronger loyalty engagement, higher customer satisfaction, better self-service and service-resolution outcomes, and the effectiveness of digital channels in supporting the full guest lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Digital Customer Experience Strategy & Vision

  • Define and evolve a multi-year digital customer experience strategy aligned to enterprise growth, brand, marketing, loyalty, customer care, and commercial priorities.
  • Set the vision for the mobile app, mobile web, ChoiceHotels.com, and emerging digital experiences, ensuring each platform plays a clear role in the guest journey.
  • Establish a guest-centric experience vision that connects inspiration, discovery, shopping, booking, loyalty engagement, reservation management, customer support, and post-stay engagement.
  • Lead the strategy, management, and development of digital content, including hotel- and brand-specific content, to support inspiration, discovery, decision-making, booking, servicing, and post-stay engagement across the digital customer journey.
  • Translate customer insights, business objectives, and service pain points into clear digital priorities, experience outcomes, and product roadmap inputs.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, UX, and Engineering teams to translate the digital customer experience vision into product roadmaps, capabilities, priorities, experience requirements, and delivery plans.
  • Provide strategic direction for UX design and research to ensure guest experiences are compelling, on-brand, intuitive, accessible, and conversion-optimized.
  • Drive personalization strategies across the digital ecosystem by leveraging data, segmentation, behavioral insights, loyalty intelligence, and emerging AI capabilities.
  • Influence product teams through clear strategy, outcomes-based priorities, strong cross-functional alignment, and disciplined prioritization.

Commercial Performance, Engagement & Service Outcomes

  • Own digital performance outcomes across direct booking revenue, partner-driven revenue contribution, digital loyalty engagement, and customer experience effectiveness.
  • Maximize the return on marketing and digital investment by improving conversion, merchandising, personalization, self-service adoption, and digital funnel performance.
  • Partner with Marketing, Loyalty, Revenue Management, Distribution, Customer Care, Advanced Analytics and Finance to optimize channel mix, traffic acquisition quality, lifetime value, and service-resolution economics.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs for digital conversion, engagement, app and web performance, loyalty account servicing, issue resolution, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Measure the impact of digital content quality, completeness, merchandising, and relevance on conversion, engagement, direct channel performance, and customer satisfaction.

Customer Care, Service & Digital Servicing

  • Set the strategy for how digital channels help guests manage loyalty accounts, service reservations, resolve booking issues, address stay-related problems, and receive support across the customer lifecycle.
  • Partner with Customer Care, Operations, Loyalty, Brand, and Hotel-facing teams to identify recurring service needs and translate them into improved digital self-service, assisted-service, and escalation experiences.
  • Advance digital servicing capabilities that reduce friction for guests, improve resolution quality, and create more seamless handoffs between digital channels and care teams.
  • Champion customer listening, service recovery insights, and voice-of-customer feedback to identify experience gaps and prioritize improvements across app, web, mobile web, and care interactions.
  • Ensure digital content supports service and self-service needs by making hotel, brand, reservation, loyalty, and stay-related information clear, accurate, actionable, and easy for guests to find.

Organizational Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build and lead a high-performing digital customer experience organization with the capabilities required to deliver modern, service-aware digital experiences and shape product-led outcomes through cross-functional partnership.
  • Strengthen integration among marketing, product, UX, analytics, digital content, loyalty, and customer care teams to deliver cohesive, high-impact guest experiences.
  • Establish clear operating rhythms, decision rights, performance metrics, and accountability across the organization.
  • Develop talent and leadership capability in digital strategy, customer experience, product thinking, service design, analytics, and transformation leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Brand, Loyalty, Customer Care, Operations, Product, Engineering, Revenue Management, Distribution, and Finance leaders to align strategy, priorities, messaging, digital execution, and service outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to ensure platform capabilities support marketing agility, customer servicing, loyalty engagement, innovation, and scalable digital operations.
  • Serve as a key member of the Marketing Leadership Team, shaping enterprise growth, guest engagement, customer care, and digital transformation strategies.
  • Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align resources and accelerate delivery of the digital customer experience vision.

Digital Ecosystem, Platform Evolution & Innovation

  • Set the direction for the evolution of ChoiceHotels.com, the mobile app, mobile web, and other digital platforms to deliver seamless, omnichannel guest experiences.
  • Define how digital platforms enable real-time campaign execution, personalization, loyalty engagement, account servicing, reservation management, lifecycle communications, and scalable digital content delivery.
  • Guide innovation efforts, including the application of GenAI and automation to marketing, search, personalization, digital servicing, customer care, and problem resolution.
  • Ensure the digital ecosystem is designed to support both enterprise growth and customer experience excellence across the full guest journey.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in digital customer experience, digital commerce, digital marketing, product management, customer care, service transformation, or digital experience leadership.
  • Proven accountability for large-scale digital revenue performance, customer engagement, and service-experience outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives across marketing, product, engineering, customer care, loyalty, operations, and commercial teams.
  • Experience setting digital product, digital content, and customer experience vision for web, mobile app, mobile web, and service channels in partnership with Product Management, UX, Brand, Hotel-facing, and Technology teams.
  • Demonstrated experience managing digital content strategy, governance, quality, and optimization, including hotel- and brand-specific content that supports commerce, servicing, and the end-to-end digital customer journey.
  • Significant experience managing senior leaders and building high-performing organizations.

Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in digital experience platforms, digital commerce, mobile app and web experiences, analytics, and customer experience optimization.
  • Strong understanding of conversion funnel management, personalization technologies, customer servicing tools, loyalty account management, and service-resolution journeys.
  • Familiarity with modern product management frameworks, agile delivery, service design, voice-of-customer programs, and data-driven decision making.
  • Understanding of how AI, automation, and digital self-service can improve both customer experience and operational efficiency.

SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $240,000 to $330,000 annually. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP), as well annual awards of Choice Hotels International common stock through Choice’s Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTI Plan).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Process Manager, Operations Strategy & Optimization (Remote)

Full time, United States, Canada

The Process Manager for Operations Strategy & Optimization is responsible for defining, enabling, and continuously improving operational service delivery. This role partners across Operations, Technology, Product, Implementation, Training, and Leadership teams to align on scalable service solutions, optimize processes, support operational readiness, and drives initiatives to improve consistency, productivity, performance, and customer outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a consultative, strategic thinker who can translate business needs into practical, scalable, and sustainable operational solutions.

About You

job.company_description:
Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service.
With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines is the premier US-based provider of air travel services that continues to grow its presence around the world. Through strategic joint ventures, innovative revenue enhancements, and continued cost and capacity discipline, Delta now stands ahead of the pack of network carriers in terms of products and services, operational performance, frequent flyer programs and customer service. Delta Supply Chain Management (SCM) recognizes the importance of finding talented individuals who are motivated, strategic-thinking, and innovative to become its future leaders.

SCM at Delta Air Lines acts as the principal sourcing function and partners with a wide range of internal business units that include: airport operations, in-flight services, marketing, finance, cargo, corporate services, information technology, sustainability, and human resources. SCM develops the strategy and negotiations for contracting procurement from suppliers of all goods (ex. passenger supplies, food, computer equipment) and services (ex. airport labor, marketing, healthcare plans). This requires broad skill sets developed from work experience and elevated through an MBA program including finance, strategy, negotiations, continuous improvement, logistics, and operations.

Delta’s Summer Internship Program is structured as follows: candidates will be placed within a commodity group in Supply Chain and work in a project-based, analytical support role. Candidates will spend a significant portion of their internship identifying key business issues, performing comprehensive analysis and, at the conclusion of the summer, presenting their findings to peers and SCM leadership. Throughout the summer, candidates will also have a variety of formal and informal networking and socializing opportunities, both in and out of the work environment, to become familiar with Delta’s businesses and culture.

Compensation for this internship is provided at $9,493 per month, subject to applicable taxes and withholdings.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Current MBA student
  • Candidates must have completed the first year of an MBA Program with a concentration in Finance, Operations, Supply Chain or another analytical discipline by the Summer of 2027
  • Must have a planned MBA program graduation date by the Summer of 2028
  • Must have at least 3 years (36 months) of post-undergraduate, full-time work or relevant military experience prior to enrolling in business school
  • Ideal candidates have strong analytical, leadership, written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated project management skills and ability to work effectively in teams across all organizational levels
  • Adept at managing heavy workloads in a short timeframe which will include identifying critical business issues for analysis, structuring projects and implementing change
  • Ability to quickly engage and add value to the selected commodity team, demonstrating strong communication skills, openness, and self-confidence in achieving results
  • Demonstrated values of integrity, respect for people, diversity appreciation, innovation, adherence to ethical standards, challenging the status quo, and excellence in performance
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proficient in research and analysis; sourcing concepts; process improvement; negotiations and contract management
  • Ability to digest large amounts of data and information and succinctly explain what can be learned from the data and how it can support decision making
  • Desire to learn leadership techniques and best practices in problem solving and conflict resolution to enable innovation and progress on difficult to solve challenges of our customers

Additional Best Practices

In This Role

  • You should be able to listen and learn from people with many different perspectives
  • You should be able to handle shifting priorities that come from the business needs
  • You should be high performing and interested in driving for results
  • You should be open to mentoring and learning as a method to grow and improve

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

With over 100,000 Delta employees across the globe, our culture is rooted in a shared commitment to living our values – Honesty, Integrity, Respect, Perseverance and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. When you join Delta, you truly begin the journey of your lifetime!

  • Domestic and International (standby) flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Access to over 500 discounts and specialty savings through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals, pet health services, Apple product discounts, exclusive tickets to sports games and more
  • Competitive pay for students based on their working hours
  • Industry-leading profit sharing program available for Co-Op/Intern Students employed as of 12/31
  • Eligible for pay on Holidays that are observed in your dedicated work area
  • Once in a lifetime experience through Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • Programs to engage with community service and sustainability
  • Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • On-site campus amenities include Starbucks, Gym, Emory Clinic, Walmart pharmacy and store, healthy dining options through Sodexo, edible garden and mental health coach
  • Backup dependent care services offered for 25 days highly subsidized by Delta
  • Housing Stipend available for students who reside more than 50 miles from work location

job.company_description: dnata is a leading global air and travel services provider. Established in 1959, the company offers quality and safe ground handling, cargo, travel, catering and retail services in 34 countries across six continents.
job.job_description:
Department: Central Functions

Location: London Heathrow

Description

Who are we?
Dnata is one of the world’s largest air and travel services providers. We provide a comprehensive range of inflight catering, onboard retail, supply chain and logistics services at all major and regional airports across the UK. Dnata Catering provide expertly crafted inflight catering services, delivering fresh and high-quality meals at major and regional airports across the UK. As the leading Halal caterer in the UK, we also provide tailored experiences to meet each customer’s unique needs. We’re a leader in VIP catering, offering bespoke inflight to private and charter clients.

The Role
Working alongside our team of procurement specialists, your role is key as you take responsibility for the strategic sourcing and category management for accountable categories. Developing clear category management strategies, you will maximise value across the end to end product selection sourcing process. The emphasis is on buying the right products to fit the longer-term needs of our customers and the business whilst achieving total cost solutions rather than a simple quick, price focussed fit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting the team in the delivery of the overall procurement business strategy, with direct accountability for specific categories
  • Develop strategic category plans to drive commercial, quality and service objectives of the business
  • Implement consistent and robust Supplier Performance Management for category vendors, driving continuous improvement initiatives, forecasts/re-forecasts and ongoing relationship development to optimise the value and performance of each supplier
  • Negotiating and managing commercial terms for all suppliers that fall within scope, integrating into central contractual agreements to synergise benefits and maximise sustainable value
  • Consolidating expenditure and suppliers wherever appropriate, to maximize volumes and minimise complexity
  • Negotiation and drafting of contracts are in place and maintained for all key, accountable vendors
  • Use technology to drive procurement best practice such as electronic tendering and auctions
  • Ensuring suppliers are reporting contracted SLA’s and KPI’s, putting in place recovery measures for failure
  • Enhancing all procurement practices in sourcing and supplier management through the implementation of the Scanmarket eSourcing platforms, including but not limited to all tenders, contracts and supplier information in order to underpin category opportunities where appropriate
  • Engagement with key internal stakeholders, presenting opportunities & impacts associated with supply chain optimisation
  • Following up on delivery queries, shortages etc. with suppliers
  • Supporting the menu development process for accountable airlines in collaboration with your internal stakeholders, such as Sales, compliance, costings, culinary and Commercial, through new product/service sourcing and pricing
  • Adhering to company compliance procedures and the development and implementation of functional processes, guidelines, policies and projects relative to accountable category activities

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Ideally sourcing and category management experience within food production
  • Market knowledge, procurement best practice
  • Good negotiation skills and an ability to influence key decision makers
  • Track record of commercial acumen
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Highly analytical and methodical approach
  • Ability to structure workload, to plan and multi-task efficiently
Desirable
  • Competent with eProcurement platforms and IT solutions
  • CIPS qualification or relevant industry experience#
  • Qualified in project management such as Prince2

Benefits

What's in it for you?
  • An opportunity to be part of the Emirates global family.
  • Free breakfast, lunch and dinner on site
  • Free tea and coffee
  • Simply health Plan
  • Refer a Friend Scheme
  • Discounted gym membership at over 2000 gyms nationwide
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Opportunity to enhance your learning through our inhouse apprenticeship programme
If you're invited to interview, please let us know if there are any adjustments we can make to ensure you're cleared for take-off and able to perform at your best. We’re committed to making the recruitment journey as smooth and inclusive as possible.

job.job_description:
Starte bei uns, um deine großartigen Ideen einzubringen. Und bleibe, weil sie gehört werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Enterprise Mobility, ein familiengeführter, weltweit tätiger Mobilitätsdienstleister mit einem Umsatz von 38 Milliarden US-Dollar, fast 90.000 Mitarbeitenden und Engagement in 95 Ländern. Unter der Leitung von CEO Chrissy Taylor bauen wir das Unternehmen auf eine starke Tradition, die uns die Stabilität gibt, den langfristigen Erfolg unserer Mitarbeitenden, unserer Kund:innen sowie unseres Geschäfts in den Fokus zu stellen. Bei uns erwarten dich Teams, die Vielfalt leben, gemeinsam anpacken und sich gegenseitig unterstützen.

Dein Einstieg bei uns

Als Management Trainee (m_w_d) hast du die Freiheit und Unterstützung, deine Kompetenzen weiterzuentwickeln und deinen Weg in die Filialverantwortung aktiv zu gestalten. Die meisten unserer heutigen Führungskräfte bis hin zu unserer CEO haben ihre Karriere als Management Trainee (m_w_d) begonnen, du lernst bei uns nicht theoretisch, sondern „on the job“, übernimmst Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an und baust so deine Karriere Schritt für Schritt auf.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du etwas bewegen willst und bereit bist, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Mit einem betriebswirtschaftlichen Studium kannst du dein Wissen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen und auf das nächste Level bringen. Kommst du aus einem anderen Bereich, holen wir dich dort ab, wo du stehst, und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst. Du arbeitest in Teams, in denen unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt werden und jede Person die Unterstützung und Wertschätzung erfährt, um ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten.

  • Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung für das operative Daily Business
  • Du sammelst Erfahrung in Kundenservice, Vertrieb, Business Management und Finance
  • Du baust dein Sales- und Verhandlungsgeschick aus
  • Du baust echte Kundenbeziehungen auf und entwickelst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
  • Du entwickelst dein unternehmerisches Denken, von Umsatz bis Kostenkontrolle
  • Du wächst Schritt für Schritt in eine Führungsrolle hinein

Deine Entwicklung

Bei uns zählt Leistung – und die wird gesehen:

  • Abschluss des Trainee-Programms nach durchschnittlich 10 Monaten
  • Im Anschluss erste Beförderung zum Management Assistant
  • Schneller Aufstieg möglich zur Filialleitung in unter 2 Jahren
  • Vielfältige Karrierewege, z. B. in unser Sales Team, HR oder Risikomanagement


Profil

Was du mitbringst

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium
  • Motivation, Dinge anzupacken und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Erfahrung im und Spaß am Kundenkontakt, Vertrieb und Teamarbeit

  • Eine unbefristete Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis für Deutschland

  • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Deutscher oder EU-Führerschein und 1 Jahr Fahrpraxis,
  • Maximal 3 Punkte im Verkehrszentralregister in Flensburg (Nachweis erforderlich)
  • Kein Verstoß gegen die Straßenverkehrsordnung in Zusammenhang mit Alkohol oder Drogen

Auch spannend: Bewerbungen aus Tourismus, Hospitality oder Sales sind willkommen, egal ob mit Studium oder abgeschlossener Ausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

Gehe den nächsten Schritt - Klick auf „Jetzt bewerben“, beantworte ein paar Fragen und fertig.
Wir melden uns bei dir und schauen gemeinsam, ob wir zueinander passen.

Noch unsicher? Du musst nicht alle Punkte perfekt erfüllen. Wenn du motiviert bist, und Lust hast dich weiterzuentwickeln, passt du wahrscheinlich sehr gut zu uns. Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Auch wenn du aus gesundheitlichen Gründen nicht Auto fahren kannst, suchen wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

Job Description

The Property

Located close to Tokyo's top shopping area of GInza as well as Tokyo Station and the central business districts of Marunouchi, Yaesu and Otemachi, Waldorf Astoria Tokyo Nihonbashi will be a gem within the city.

The hotel features 197 guest rooms, 3 distinctive restaurants and Peacock Alley, the elegant lounge and bar synonymous with the Waldorf Astoria brand. Guests can expect world-class amentities including an indoor pool, spa, fitness center, ballrooms and a chapel.

Responsibilities

As the Hotel Manager of Waldorf Astoria Tokyo Nihonbashi, you will be the custodian of our brand’s legacy and pillars: a refined haven for our guests, sincerely elegant service, and unforgettable experiences. You will be responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the hotel, lead a team of executives, inspiring a culture of excellence, financial stewardship, and a guest experience that embodies our brand’s promise.

Your eye for detail and passion for hospitality elevate every aspect of the guest journey. You lead with intent, ensuring experiences are elevated and emotionally resonant. Data-driven insights and guest engagement metrics inform your decisions, while brand pillars guide your actions

Financially astute, you will support budget management process and adapt to evolving conditions with agility. You ensure compliance with quality and brand standards, while proactively implementing initiatives that enhance guest satisfaction and protect our reputation.

Above all, you are a visionary leader. You foster a workplace where Team Members feel empowered to grow, contribute and live the values of Hilton - the company recognized as the World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Through your leadership, Waldorf Astoria becomes not just a place to work, but a place to belong.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts

  • Luxury Hotel Manager or Director of Operations experience in key cities
  • Proven experience in key gateway cities with strong command of operational excellence and business acumen
  • Proven experience in International Luxury standards – strong ability to elevate service culture, drive guest engagement and experiential differentiation at the property
  • Outstanding communication, negotiation skills and stakeholder management expertise
  • Leadership expertise and development, including exceptional levels of team member engagement
  • Demonstrated ability to translate brand into experiences for guests and team members alike
  • Fluent in Japanese with a strong understanding of Japanese business culture and local market dynamics

About Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts

Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts is built on a legacy of excellence. Our story began on Fifth Avenue in New York in 1893 and continued with the opening of Waldorf Astoria New York on Park Avenue in 1931, a hotel Conrad Hilton famously called “The Greatest of Them All.” What was once the world’s most iconic hotel is now a collection of landmark properties in the world’s most sought-after destinations. We are proud of a heritage defined by firsts, and a brand that continues to shape the future of luxury hospitality.

Waldorf Astoria is designed to resonate with a guest we call the Prestigious Connoisseur. These guests are fluent in luxury, with a refined eye for design, detail, and service. They see travel as a way to deepen personal connection and seek experiences that are seamless, authentic, and elevated. Many are executives, entrepreneurs, or business owners who value discretion, precision, and beauty in equal measure.

At Waldorf Astoria, we define effortless luxury — rooted in elegant service and brought to life through unforgettable experiences. We believe true luxury should make you feel at ease. It should never feel like a performance.

Our brand is anchored by three brand pillars: refined haven, sincerely elegant service, and unforgettable experiences. As General Manager, your role is to bring these pillars to life across every touchpoint, guiding your team to deliver on our brand’s promise of excellence.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. As a colleague of InterContinental Singapore Robertson Quay, you will be part of a team that embodies this philosophy, delivering exceptional service and elevating hospitality to new heights. If you believe in our values and want to be part of something truly special, we want you on our team!

YOUR DAY TO DAY

Sales Leadership & Business Development

  • Develop and implement sales strategies for corporate, leisure, MICE, government, long-stay, wholesale and travel trade segments.
  • Identify new business opportunities and maintain strong relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, travel agents, event organisers and business partners.
  • Lead the sales team in achieving individual and departmental revenue goals.
  • Conduct regular sales calls, client meetings, site inspections and networking activities.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities and business opportunities within Singapore’s luxury hotel market.
  • Work closely with the General Manager and Revenue team to drive pricing strategy, market positioning and revenue optimisation.
  • Represent the hotel at trade shows, client events, sales missions and industry networking functions.
  • Ensure effective account management and maintain a strong sales pipeline.

Reservations & Revenue Coordination

  • Provide leadership and direction to the Reservations team to maximise room revenue and conversion.
  • Ensure reservation standards, response times and service quality are maintained.
  • Work closely with Revenue Management to review rate strategies, room availability, market demand and booking trends.
  • Monitor pick-up reports, forecast, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and business mix.
  • Ensure all reservation procedures are aligned with hotel standards and brand expectations.
  • Support upselling initiatives and revenue opportunities through the Reservations team.
  • Review group bookings, room blocks and special rate requests to ensure profitability.

Marketing, Branding & Communications

Key duties include:

  • Develop and execute the hotel’s marketing and communications plan.
  • Drive brand awareness through digital marketing, social media, public relations, partnerships and promotional campaigns.
  • Oversee content creation, advertising, media relations, photography, collaterals and online presence.
  • Work with internal and external agencies, media partners and brand teams to ensure consistent brand messaging.
  • Plan marketing campaigns to support rooms, dining, events, weddings, festive promotions and hotel experiences.
  • Monitor online reputation, guest feedback platforms and digital performance.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are aligned with brand standards and commercial objectives.
  • Identify suitable partnerships with lifestyle brands, tourism partners, corporate partners and local businesses in the Robertson Quay area.

Team Leadership & Department Management

  • Manage daily operations and performance of the Sales, Reservations and Marketing departments.
  • Set clear goals, KPIs and action plans for team members.
  • Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews and coaching sessions.
  • Build a motivated, professional and results-driven commercial team.
  • Foster strong communication and collaboration with Front Office, Revenue, F&B, Events, Finance and Operations teams.
  • Ensure all team members understand hotel revenue goals, brand positioning and service expectations.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, training and development of departmental team members.

Budgeting, Reporting & Commercial Planning

  • Prepare and manage the annual Sales & Marketing budget.
  • Monitor departmental expenses and ensure cost-effective use of marketing funds.
  • Prepare sales forecasts, business reviews, production reports and market analysis.
  • Review account performance, segment performance and campaign return on investment.
  • Provide regular updates to the General Manager and ownership/management team on sales performance and market conditions.
  • Participate in revenue meetings, executive committee meetings and strategic planning discussions.

What We Need From You

  • Degree or Diploma in Hospitality Management, Business, Marketing or related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 to 10 years of relevant sales and marketing experience in the hotel industry.
  • At least 3 to 5 years in a senior leadership role, preferably in a luxury or upscale hotel.
  • Strong knowledge of Singapore hotel market, corporate accounts, MICE, travel trade and luxury hospitality trends.
  • Experience overseeing Sales, Reservations and Marketing functions.
  • Strong commercial mindset with proven ability to drive revenue and market share.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Strong network with corporate clients, travel partners, event organisers and industry contacts.
  • Good understanding of revenue management, digital marketing and brand positioning.
  • Able to work independently, lead a team and partner effectively with senior management.
  • Proficient in hotel systems, CRM tools, Microsoft Office and sales reporting platforms.

How Do I Deliver This

We genuinely care about people and we show this through living out our promise of True Hospitality each and every day. It’s what connects every colleague in all IHG® hotels.

Each IHG® hotel brand delivers True Hospitality in their own way, and at the heart of it all are specific, core service skills.

  • True Attitude: being caring, wanting to make positive difference, and building genuine connections with guest
  • True Confidence: having the knowledge and skills to perform your role, and giving guests the confidence that they can trust you, to help and support them during their stay
  • True Listening: focusing on what your guest is saying, picking up on body language that is often overlooked, and understanding what the guest wants and needs
  • True Responsiveness: is about providing guests with what they need, and doing so in a timely and caring manner

There’s so much more to the job than we can capture here. It’s simply about creating great experiences, doing the right thing and understanding people.

What We Offer

We’ll reward your hard work with a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package – including generous room and dining discounts, exceptional training opportunities and a strong support for your ongoing career development.

Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve – visit www.http://careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.

IHG is an equal opportunity employer: Minorities / Females / Disabled / Veterans.

job.job_description:
Job Description — Coraggio Group

Coraggio Group is a boutique management consulting firm helping leaders in travel and tourism, government, education, and nonprofit organizations build bold strategies and execute with confidence. We work at the intersection of strategic planning, organizational effectiveness, and destination development, and we're growing.

The Growth Strategy Manager is a newly shaped role that sits at the center of how we win work, tell our story, and build Coraggio's reputation in competitive markets. It's primarily a proposal leadership role, but it extends into the content, positioning, and competitive intelligence work that makes our proposals stronger and our firm more visible — and increasingly, into how we develop and bring our consulting service offerings to market.

This is the right role for someone who writes well, thinks strategically, and finds genuine satisfaction in the craft of making a firm's expertise legible and compelling to the people who are deciding who to hire. Experience in product marketing or service line development is a meaningful advantage.

THE ROLE AT A GLANCE

Proposal ownership is the primary responsibility of this role. Everything else — competitive positioning, case study development, firm content, and service offering development — supports, strengthens, and extends that core function. The Growth Strategy Manager leads end-to-end proposal development, manages the firm's competitive positioning assets, builds the content infrastructure that lets Coraggio show up confidently in every competitive situation, and increasingly shapes how Coraggio's consulting services are defined and positioned in the market.

Key Responsibilities

 Proposal Leadership and Process Ownership

This is where the role starts and where it stays anchored. You'll own the full proposal lifecycle from the moment an RFP lands to the moment a submission goes out the door.

  • Lead the full proposal lifecycle from intake through submission, including RFP triage, response planning, timeline management, and final quality review
  • Proactively search for and identify relevant RFP opportunities for consulting leadership consideration
  • Develop proposal structures, messaging frameworks, and narrative strategy for each pursuit
  • Coordinate contributors across the consulting team and manage review cycles without losing momentum
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with RFP requirements across all submissions
  • Lead post-submission debriefs and apply learnings to continuously improve proposal quality and win rates
  • Maintain and evolve Coraggio's proposal library, templates, and reusable content assets
  • Track and report on the business development and proposal pipeline for firm leadership

Competitive Positioning and Intelligence

Proposals don't exist in a vacuum. You'll maintain an active, current understanding of how Coraggio compares to the firms we most often compete against and use that knowledge to sharpen how we position ourselves.

  • Maintain a working competitive intelligence summary for Coraggio's key competitor firms, updated at least quarterly
  • Monitor how competitors structure proposals, describe their methodologies, and articulate their differentiators
  • Surface competitive positioning insights proactively and translate them into proposal strategy and firm messaging
  • Contribute to win/loss analysis and identify patterns that inform future pursuit strategy

Case Study Strategy and Development

One of Coraggio's most important growth levers is closing the gap between our reputation and our documented proof. You'll own the systems and content that make our track record visible and persuasive.

  • Lead a proactive case study development program with an ongoing pipeline of projects to document
  • Partner with consultants during and after project delivery to capture outcomes, client context, and measurable results before they're forgotten
  • Develop and maintain a framework for quantifying project outcomes, not just describing activities
  • Write and maintain a library of case studies organized by sector, service line, and challenge type, formatted for rapid deployment in competitive proposals
  • Identify which case studies are doing the most work in proposals and which need to be strengthened or replaced

Firm Positioning and Content Development

Beyond individual proposals, you'll own the content that represents Coraggio's expertise and capabilities to the market, working in close partnership with firm leadership.

  • Maintain and evolve Coraggio's capabilities narrative, including sector-specific service descriptions, methodology summaries, and firm boilerplate
  • Draft and manage thought leadership content — articles, LinkedIn posts, white papers, and similar — that reinforces Coraggio's expertise and competitive positioning
  • Write award applications, recognition submissions, and external visibility opportunities that build firm credibility over time
  • Develop capabilities one-pagers and service-line summaries tailored to Coraggio's core sectors
  • Partner with firm leadership to identify and begin positioning for strategic pursuits before RFPs are formally issued
  • Support the development and preparation of pitch materials, presentations, and related pursuit collateral

Consulting Service Offering Development and Positioning

As Coraggio continues to grow and evolve its service model — including the integration of the Destination Wayfinder framework and platform — there is an emerging and strategically important opportunity for the Growth Strategy Manager to help define, package, and position Coraggio's consulting service offerings as distinct, market-facing products. This is a developing area of responsibility that will grow in scope as the firm's offering strategy matures.

  • Partner with firm leadership to identify consulting service lines that are candidates for structured packaging and market positioning
  • Apply product marketing thinking — value proposition development, buyer persona analysis, competitive differentiation — to Coraggio's consulting service offerings
  • Develop positioning frameworks and messaging for service offerings that can be used consistently across proposals, marketing content, and client conversations
  • Lead go-to-market planning for new or newly repositioned service offerings, including launch sequencing, content needs, and enablement materials
  • Collaborate with the consulting team to translate methodology and delivery experience into compelling, market-ready service narratives
  • Support integration of the Destination Wayfinder stewardship framework into Coraggio's tourism consulting service portfolio, including positioning and client-facing materials
  • Monitor market signals and client feedback to inform service offering evolution and identify new positioning opportunities

Who We're Looking For

YOU BRING

YOU'RE ENERGIZED BY

  • 3 to 6+ years of proposal, content, business development, or product marketing experience, ideally in consulting or professional services
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills across proposal, marketing, and narrative formats
  • Strong project management instincts and the ability to coordinate contributors under deadline pressure
  • A genuine understanding of how consulting firms differentiate themselves and what makes a proposal persuasive
  • Comfort working directly with senior leaders and subject matter experts
  • Experience with or interest in AI tools in proposal and content development workflows
  • Experience in product marketing, go-to-market strategy, or service line positioning
  • The craft of making complex expertise clear, compelling, and scannable for decision-makers
  • Owning a process end-to-end rather than waiting for direction
  • Building systems that make the whole team faster and more effective
  • Competitive situations where good positioning and strong writing make a real difference
  • Working in a small, high-trust firm where your judgment is valued and your contributions are visible
  • Shaping how a firm's expertise is packaged and brought to market as distinct, compelling service offerings

Important Distinctions

This is not a sales role. The Growth Strategy Manager supports business development through positioning, content, and proposal quality, but doesn't manage client relationships or own a revenue target.

This is not a project delivery role. The boundary is clear: this role is firm-facing and growth-facing, not client delivery-facing. Scope creep into consulting work isn't the expectation or the goal.

Proposal timelines take priority. Growth strategy, content, and service offering work is meaningful and important, but gets scheduled around proposal commitments, not the other way around.

Service offering development is a growing, not guaranteed, scope. This area of responsibility will expand as the firm's service strategy matures. It is a real and intentional direction — but early-stage work, not a fully defined program today.

Additional Details

 Work Structure

This is a full-time position. Coraggio operates as a remote-first firm with staff distributed across the U.S. We have offices in Sarasota, Florida and Lakewood, Colorado. Regular video collaboration and occasional in-person team gatherings are part of how we work together.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Generous paid time off and flexible scheduling
  • A firm culture that takes its values seriously: Courage, Truth, Grace, and Humility
  • A seat at the table in a firm that's actively investing in how it grows and competes

About Coraggio

Coraggio is the Italian word for courage. It's also a daily reminder of the first commitment we make to every client: to have the courage to challenge them to reach beyond what's comfortable so they can reach their full potential.

We've been helping leaders in travel and tourism, government, education, and nonprofit organizations create bold strategies since 2005. We're a certified Benefit Corporation, a five-time recipient of Benefit Corporations for Good certification, and a recognized Oregon Most Admired Company. We're a 100% owned subsidiary of Miles Partnership, which gives our team access to deep research, marketing, and industry intelligence resources while we stay small, agile, and client-focused.

Bold Strategies. Brave Leaders. Bright Future.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As an experienced individual contributor, a Senior Market/Account Manager, hotels must demonstrate proven leadership skills and success in sales, while identifying new revenue generating opportunities and spearheading strategic initiatives. The Senior Market/Account Manager, hotels uses their knowledge of the travel industry, and their experience in sales negotiation, revenue management and data analysis, to increase revenue by optimizing Priceline’s hotel partnerships. Additionally, you will identify trends, optimize pricing, ensure content competitiveness, and use data to secure business wins that satisfy consumer demand and maximize hotel bookings on Priceline.com and Agoda.com websites.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Handle a portfolio of high-value and strategic accounts; build strong hotel supplier relationships and effectively communicate Priceline and Agoda’s value proposition to grow bookings, room nights and revenue in assigned portfolio
  • Evaluate market trends, partner performance, and competitor landscape to ensure the competitiveness of Priceline and Agoda’s products
  • Analyze data to identify business growth opportunities; initiate and drive sound recommendations to optimize hotel partnerships within assigned portfolio
  • Lead projects and strategic growth initiatives to positively impact the overall performance of Priceline and Agoda
  • Conduct ongoing reviews of production with hotel accounts and present strategic recommendations to optimize Priceline and Agoda accommodation availability, content competitiveness and hotel performance, using a consultative approach
  • Prioritize, plan and implement effectively to meet/exceed defined targets and goals

  • Any other relevant duties assigned

  • Prior sales experience would be advantageous

  • Strong data analytical skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build and leverage relationships
  • Able to multi-task and manage multiple projects

  • Challenge yourself to develop marketing solutions for Qantas Loyalty

Working in Qantas Loyalty is exciting and fast moving. We love what we do and look forward to what we might create for the future. Being part of a business that’s constantly changing challenges us to think and move on our feet quickly. Our agile way of working enables us to be responsive to business requirements and helps us to deliver exceptional outcomes. By taking the time to recognise and reward our members, we build stronger relationships with the people who matter most.

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for the go-to-market best practice, management, execution and iteration of Loyalty’s direct marketing activity. This role requires a high-level understanding of the business goals for Qantas Loyalty and a deep understanding of how to drive maximum engagement and performance through email, SMS and on site/in app activation.

You ’ll also coach and guide marketing coordinators and graduates, fostering a high-performance culture to build deep subject matter expertise. You will drive impactful campaigns that engage members and consistently exceed targets across all business verticals.

  • 3-5 years’ demonstrated direct/digital marketing experience
  • Tertiary qualifications in Marketing and/or Business.

  • Ability to deal with fast-paced environments and excel under pressure .
  • A proactive, experimental mindset to optimise campaign performance .
  • Proven leadership and high-impact coaching capabilities .
  • Demonstrated experience in dealing with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Operations and Data & Analytics .
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Commitment to change and continuous improvement with the ability to influence positive outcomes .

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion.  We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.  If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.  Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

job.job_description:
TUI Airline is seeking a technically skilled Senior Airline Partnerships Manager to ensure seamless integration and commercial success of our codeshare and interline partnerships, serving as the technical bridge between TUI's systems and partner airlines.

This vacancy can be located at any of our headquarters of our Airline AOC locations - namely Luton, Rijswijk, Zaventem, Stockholm or Hannover.

This role sits within Airline Commercial and Network Planning & B2B Sales (SD_0654) and reports to Head of Strategic Airline & Airport Partnerships.

The role will be published until 27 September 2026.

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • You'll lead comprehensive end-to-end testing of codeshare and interline implementations across all distribution systems and platforms, ensuring our partnerships deliver a flawless customer experience.
  • You'll ensure accurate configuration of fares, schedules, and commercial conditions in GDS systems, direct channels, and partner platforms while implementing monitoring protocols to detect technical discrepancies.
  • You'll serve as the primary technical liaison between TUI Airline and partner carriers' implementation teams, coordinating cross-functional resources to resolve complex integration challenges.
  • You'll develop and maintain technical reporting frameworks that measure the accuracy and effectiveness of partnership implementations, identifying optimization opportunities to improve conversion rates.
  • You'll create comprehensive technical documentation for all partnership implementations, building a repository of testing protocols and system configurations to enable scalable partnership growth.

About You

  • You have proven experience in airline distribution systems, GDS platforms, or technical partnership implementation with demonstrable expertise in testing methodologies for airline distribution channels.
  • You possess strong understanding of codeshare, interline, and fare filing technical requirements, with experience working with virtual interlining partners such as Hahn Air, Go7 or Dohop.
  • You bring experience with API integrations and technical documentation in travel distribution environments, along with the ability to interpret complex fare rules and partnership conditions.
  • You demonstrate exceptional attention to detail with a systematic problem-solving approach and strong project management capabilities for technical implementation timelines.
  • You have excellent communication skills to translate technical concepts to commercial stakeholders and can work effectively across multiple time zones with international airline partners.
  • This role requires strong business English (written & spoken).

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Company: Bókun, A Tripadvisor Company

Location: UK (Hybrid - Commutable to Oxford or London)

Contract: 6-Month Fixed-Term (Performance-based extension and growth path)

Compensation: Competitive Base Salary + Quarterly Sales Incentive Plan

About Bókun

Bókun is the leading reservation system and marketing platform for the global tours and activities industry. Founded in Iceland and now a fast-growing subsidiary of Tripadvisor Inc., we offer the best of both worlds: the high-energy pace and innovation of a startup with the stable backing of the world’s largest travel guidance platform.

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Development Associate to join our team. This is not a typical cold-calling role; it is a consultative position designed for those who want to master the art of SaaS sales by working with a high percentage of warm and qualified leads.

While this role begins as a 6-month fixed-term contract, we view it as the perfect foot in the door opportunity. For a high-performer, this is a proving ground to demonstrate your ability to grow and potentially take advantage of future openings and long-term career paths within Bókun and the wider Tripadvisor ecosystem.

What You Will Do

  • Consultative Outreach: Conduct high-volume engagement with prospective customers who have already shown interest in our platform, moving beyond scripts to have meaningful business conversations.
  • Value Positioning: Clearly articulate the Bókun value proposition, identifying an operator’s pain points and demonstrating how our suite of tools (Reservation systems, Channel Managers, and Websites) can grow their revenue.
  • Business Discovery: Act as a brand ambassador for both Bókun and Tripadvisor, utilizing a consultative approach to identify business needs and solve real-world challenges for tour providers.
  • Pipeline Management: Manage your activity and lead progression within Salesforce, ensuring every opportunity is nurtured and moved through the funnel with precision to meet key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Collaborative Growth: Work closely with our Account Executives and Support teams to ensure a seamless transition as high-quality opportunities convert into long-term partners.

What You Will Bring To The Team

  • Communication Mastery: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to build rapport quickly, tell a compelling story, and handle objections with curiosity and resilience.
  • Sales DNA: A results-driven, execution-focused mindset with a strong desire to exceed targets in a fast-paced environment.
  • Consultative Mindset: A focus on building effective client relationships through positive communication, honesty, and a genuine interest in helping small businesses thrive.
  • Technical Aptitude: Comfortable with technical interactions, including co-browsing with customers online to navigate our software and conduct product demos.
  • Growth Mindset: A proactive self-starter who is coachable, open to feedback, and views this initial contract as a launchpad for a professional sales career.
  • Experience: Prior experience in customer-facing roles (Hospitality, Customer Service, or Retail) is advantageous; a strong interest in travel-tech or SaaS sales is essential.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with Italian, Spanish, French, or other European languages is a significant plus.

If you are proactive, motivated, and eager to prove your ability in a team-oriented and entrepreneurial environment, then this is the perfect role for you. At Bókun, we value and nurture emerging talent, offering a culture that rewards those who take ownership of their results. Join a global team of professionals who are passionate about the future of travel. This is not just a job, but a career opportunity with significant potential for growth based on your results.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
