job.job_description:
Job Summary

Choice Hotels has an exciting opportunity for a Program Activation & Enablement Senior Manager within the Segment & Commercial Operations organization. This role is responsible for leading the program activation capability that enables successful deployment and adoption of strategic initiatives across the enterprise and franchise network. The position owns the Deployment Blueprint, activation governance framework, implementation standards, and organizational readiness processes that support effective program execution. Working closely with Program Leaders, Segment Leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps translate strategy into execution while driving adoption, alignment, and measurable business outcomes. This highly visible position serves as a key advisor and activation leader across multiple enterprise initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously enhance the enterprise program activation framework, Deployment Blueprint, governance model, tools, and standards used to launch and scale strategic initiatives successfully.
  • Partner with Program Leaders to define implementation strategies, deployment plans, readiness requirements, stakeholder engagement approaches, and adoption objectives.
  • Lead activation planning efforts that ensure strategic initiatives are effectively operationalized across the organization and franchise network.
  • Facilitate cross-functional collaboration among Program Leaders, Segment Leadership, Operations, Technology, Marketing, Learning, Communications, and other stakeholders to align execution efforts.
  • Manage the enterprise initiative intake process and activation pipeline, providing visibility into priorities, sequencing, dependencies, resource requirements, and implementation timelines.
  • Assess organizational readiness, operational impacts, change implications, risks, and dependencies to support portfolio planning and informed decision making.
  • Monitor program execution across multiple initiatives, tracking milestones, risks, mitigation strategies, stakeholder engagement activities, and implementation outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain governance processes that provide transparency, accountability, and executive visibility into strategic initiative deployment.
  • Develop measurements and success indicators to evaluate implementation effectiveness, stakeholder adoption, execution quality, and business outcomes.
  • Analyze deployment performance and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for process improvement and increased program effectiveness.
  • Lead the roadmap and adoption of AI-enabled tools and capabilities that improve deployment planning, communications, execution efficiency, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Create and maintain frameworks, playbooks, templates, best practices, and enablement resources that support consistent program activation across the enterprise.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on activation, implementation planning, organizational readiness, governance, and change enablement practices.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and operational excellence in program execution and adoption efforts.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, transformation, strategic planning, consulting, organizational effectiveness, change management, implementation, or related disciplines.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrated success driving adoption and organizational readiness for large-scale strategic programs or enterprise initiatives.
  • Experience developing governance models, implementation frameworks, deployment methodologies, or operational excellence programs.
  • Experience evaluating initiative impacts, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements within a portfolio management environment.
  • Experience utilizing AI-enabled solutions, automation tools, or advanced technologies to improve operational effectiveness and program delivery.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with project management, portfolio management, collaboration, and workflow management platforms.
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to improve communications, planning, reporting, stakeholder engagement, and operational efficiency.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills used to evaluate adoption and implementation effectiveness.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Organizational Leadership, Operations, Strategy, Communications, or a related field or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, or related certifications are preferred but not required.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $114,907 - $135,184. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

What is Sales Development?

Corporate Sales Development is responsible for the development and management of corporate sales incentive programs and strategies designed to maximize the revenue and market share performance for corporate accounts. This co-op opportunity is based at our General Offices (GO) and functions as a back-office support role. In this position, you will support the department by partnering closely with our analysts, field partners, and other commercial departments.

Job Summary

As a Sales Development Co-op, you will act as an internal consultant within the department, leading semester-long projects that support divisional strategies and business objectives. These initiatives often involve cross-functional collaboration to identify opportunities, improve processes, and deliver solutions that drive efficiency. Co-ops apply strong critical thinking and interpersonal skills to perform tasks such as:

  • Perform data analysis and collection
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and efficiencies
  • Resolve project-related issues and complexities

These projects are often complex and may involve exposure to sensitive or confidential information and present moderate financial risk. The final project deliverable is a capstone presentation given to division leaders highlighting project lessons learned, impacts made, and recommendations going forward.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Must be enrolled full-time in a bachelor's degree program
  • Available to work full-time for three alternating semesters: Spring 2027, Fall 2027, and Summer 2028
  • Must be able to work onsite in Atlanta, GA for the duration of the Co-op
    • The co-op is expected to work in office 4 days per week
  • At least a 3.0 GPA on a 4-point scale.
  • A strong team player, detail oriented, and perform well under pressure
  • Conveys professional image to all levels of associates
  • Proficient in MS Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint

  • Participating in the Co-op program does not guarantee a full-time opportunity at Delta Air Lines upon graduation. This position is intended to provide educational and professional work experience to prepare the student for the workforce
  • Cannot actively take any courses (inclusive of online or in-person) and work as a Co-op/Intern at the same time, which may delay graduation by 1-2 semesters
  • Demonstrates a commitment to safety, security, and protecting personal data
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles
  • Must be at least 18 years old and authorized to work in the United States
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Preferred majors in Business, Economics, Finance, or related fields
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills highly preferred
  • Possess business skills such as business modeling, project management, or competitive analysis
  • Working knowledge of Tableau or similar business intelligence tools
  • Working knowledge of SalesForce or other CRM tool

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The location for this position is virtual/remote

This is your chance to be part of an in-house Commercial Services team that propels Hilton's sales, revenue management, call center, and analytics functions! As a Complex Director of Leisure Sales, you will support the areas which are at the core of Hilton's "commercial engine" and are important to Hilton's ability to achieve profitable growth. Supporting Hilton Los Cabos and Conrad Punta de Mita and reporting to the Complex Commercial Director, you will manage the solicitation of new customer relationships and accounts, including wholesalers, receptive tour operators, and luxury travel agencies (Consortia), and maintaining existing accounts, while striving to increase revenue and promote relationships through negotiation of guest rooms for assigned Mexican Resorts.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Mentor and drive sales managers to achieve sales goals and budget and ensure proper deployment, and management of sales travel, trade show schedule, and sales expenditures.
  • Represent both resorts in interactions dealing with customers relative to sales and operational questions and challenges.
  • Conduct verbal sales presentations to prospective clients. Meet with and entertain clients, some of which will require travel.
  • Coordinate and attend scheduled Sales Department and related meetings.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Travel to each hotel to meet with potential customers.
  • Travel to industry-related trade shows in multiple destinations around the world.
  • Experience working directly with ownership and asset management.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Strategic Planning of the leisure team to include deployment, travel, and trade show management, and sales expenditures.
  • Develop marketing plans and initiatives for main accounts.
  • Solicit and develop new accounts to generate business opportunities for the Hilton Los Cabos and the Conrad Punta de Mita resorts.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Seven (7) years of hotel sales experience
  • Three (3) years of luxury hotel sales experience
  • Proven experience leading and developing sales teams
  • Recent work experience with the wholesale, FIT, and luxury consortia market segments
  • Up to 30% international travel required

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Experience delivering sales presentations, both in-person and virtual
  • Proficiency in communicating with prospects in English, both verbally and in writing, including responding to emails, phone calls, and demo requests

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $110,000 – $145,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Own Qantas' most strategic corporate and TMC partnerships across North America.
  • Drive the evolution of airline distribution through NDC and emerging sales channels.
  • Represent Qantas at the highest levels of industry, government and business across the region.
  • Permanent role based at our New York Office
  • Open to sponsorship
  • $140k - $170k USD per annum plus bonus

Spirit is everything at Qantas, and we want you to bring yours to ours. As one of the world's leading airlines and among Australia's most iconic brands, our reputation is built not only on our history of safety and innovation, but on exceptional service, and our people who make it happen. As we embark on the next chapter of our story with Project Sunrise, connecting Australia directly with global destinations through nonstop ultra long-haul flying, you'll be part of shaping the future of international aviation.

As Director of Sales, North America, you'll lead Qantas' corporate and TMC sales strategy across one of the world's most competitive aviation markets. Based in New York, you'll lead a team of three and manage relationships with some of Qantas' largest corporate customers, travel management companies (TMCs) and industry partners. You'll drive revenue growth, negotiate complex commercial agreements and identify new opportunities across a portfolio of strategic accounts.

Working closely with American Airlines, you'll play a key role in one of Qantas' most important global partnerships while helping shape the future of airline distribution, including NDC adoption across the market. We're looking for a highly commercial and relationship-focused sales leader with experience in corporate sales, TMC partnerships, airline sales or travel distribution, strong negotiation skills and the ability to represent Qantas with credibility, ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset.

You’ll have –

  • 10+ years' experience in sales, commercial, distribution or revenue-focused leadership roles.
  • Proven success developing and executing sales strategies that deliver revenue growth and market share gains.
  • Strong leadership capability with experience building, coaching and developing high-performing teams across multiple locations.
  • Exceptional commercial acumen, analytical thinking and the ability to make sound strategic decisions in a complex environment.
  • Expertise in strategic selling, key account management, business planning and commercial negotiations.
  • A track record of delivering large-scale sales, marketing or customer growth initiatives with measurable business impact.
  • Outstanding communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at executive level.
  • Experience within aviation, travel, hospitality or another complex B2B industry, supported by strong CRM and data analysis capability.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel from the USA to Australia and within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 4 weeks’ vacation and 15 days sick leave for eligible employees.
  • We are planning for the future: Our 401K match offering is 8% for eligible employees.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

At United, we take bold action, and our Global Government Affairs & Environmental team is the driving force behind our efforts to make change happen. By working closely with U.S., state and local, and foreign governments and coordinating grassroots advocacy efforts, the team represents United on regulatory, public policy and legislative issues, advocating every day for our airline, our employees and the millions of customers we serve around the globe.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Director – Regulatory Affairs will be responsible for developing and advocating positions before executive branch regulatory bodies and leaders to influence decisions of strategic importance to United’s business operations and enhance United’s reputation as a leading company. The scope of the role includes the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and related departments and agencies covering security, customer facilitation, technology issues including biometrics, cybersecurity, customs issues and trade policy, as well as other duties as assigned.

The Director will closely monitor federal political and regulatory activities within the area of responsibility and collaborate with relevant divisions and Government Affairs leadership to formulate and refine policy positions that benefit United, our employees and our customers. The Director will also engage regularly with and build trusted relationships with decision-makers and staff at key agencies across the federal government, as well as industry and association counterparts, developing effective advocacy strategies to drive positive short- and long-term outcomes for United.

Success in this role requires extensive cross-functional partnership across the organization. The Director will regularly collaborate with business partners in Congressional Affairs, State and Local Affairs, Legal, Corporate Security, Airport Operations, the Network Operations Center, Network Planning, Customer Strategy and Innovation, and other divisions across the company to support the mitigation and resolution of regulatory risks and challenges.

  • Leads and contributes to formulation of factual policy and economic arguments before agencies and effectively implements advocacy strategies to drive positive outcomes for the company.
  • Clearly and effectively communicates, represents United before the Federal government, and advocates for United's policy objectives and programs that advance the Company's image and reputation.
  • Actively and continuously develops and maintains external relationships of trust with agency decisionmakers and staff in order to gather advance information and drive positive results.
  • Coordinates effectively with key internal stakeholders including the rest of the Governmental Affairs team, Legal, Communications, Corporate Real Estate, Corporate Safety, Airport Ops, Flight Ops and Inflight, NOC, Corporate Security, DT, Finance, and hub leadership, as well as other relevant divisions.
  • Maintains external partnerships and relationships with trade associations, think tanks, other organizations to network and build coalitions to drive results.
  • Assists with compliance activities, regulatory filings, information requests and government investigations as needed.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 12+ years of relevant experience
  • 5+ years’ experience work for or directly with U.S. government agencies, or comparable experience outside of government in private sector or other organizations.
  • Background/understanding of U.S. regulatory and legislative processes, experience in drafting government filings and communications. Advocacy experience.
  • Existing relationships and ability to develop new relationships with decision makers, influencers, and leaders in the Federal government.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Results oriented and persistent self-starter.
  • Experienced in multi-tasking on multiple priorities and collaborating with leaders and subject matter experts.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position
  • Position is based in Washington D.C. and follows a 100% onsite work schedule

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • MBA, JD or other advanced degree
  • At least 5 years’ experience working with the Department of Homeland Security, CISA, TSA, CBP, data privacy regulators and policymakers, or comparable experience.
  • Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving.
  • Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies for responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Rejoignez 2 hôtels membre du réseau Accor, dont le groupe réunit plus de 45 marques, 5 500 hôtels, 10 000 restaurants et destinations lifestyle. Ici, nous croyons en vous et en ce que vous apportez. Les opportunités de développement et d'évolution sont nombreuses. Chaque geste, chaque sourire, chaque action, contribuent à créer un impact positif et mémorable pour nos clients, nos collègues et aussi pour notre planète. Ensemble, nous incarnons la vision de l’hospitalité responsable.

Ayez l’opportunité de devenir un Heartist®, et laissez votre coeur vous guider dans ce monde où la vie bat plus fort.

Description du poste

Deux établissements, deux univers de marque, un même projet à piloter

Vous aimez prendre rapidement la mesure d’un établissement, fédérer les équipes et transformer les enjeux opérationnels en résultats concrets ?

Dans le cadre du remplacement temporaire de notre Directeur, nous recherchons un Directeur Général / General Manager de transition H/F pour prendre les commandes du combo ibis & Novotel Strasbourg Centre Halles.

Au cœur de Strasbourg, vous rejoignez un environnement hôtelier stimulant, rythmé par une clientèle loisirs et affaires. Votre mission sera claire : garantir la continuité de la direction, mobiliser les équipes et maintenir un haut niveau de performance, de qualité et de satisfaction client.

Plus qu’un remplacement, nous vous proposons une mission à fort impact, au cours de laquelle votre leadership, votre capacité d’analyse et votre présence sur le terrain feront la différence.

Missions

Dès votre arrivée, vous prenez la direction opérationnelle des deux établissements et devenez le point de repère des équipes, des clients et des partenaires locaux.

Votre priorité : assurer une transition fluide tout en maintenant le cap sur la performance économique, l’excellence opérationnelle et la dynamique collective.

Piloter la performance des établissements

  • Garantir la bonne gestion opérationnelle, administrative et financière du combo
  • Suivre les budgets, les tableaux de bord et les principaux indicateurs de performance
  • Analyser le chiffre d’affaires, les coûts, les ratios d’exploitation et la rentabilité
  • Mettre en place rapidement les actions correctives nécessaires
  • Assurer un reporting régulier, fiable et orienté solutions
  • Veiller à la bonne utilisation des ressources et à la préservation du patrimoine des établissements

La fonction prévoit notamment le suivi de la rentabilité, l’analyse des ratios d’achat, des frais de personnel et des frais généraux, ainsi que la mise en œuvre de plans d’action adaptés. [Directeur | Word]

Fédérer et accompagner les équipes

  • Être présent sur le terrain et accessible au quotidien
  • Donner une direction claire et créer une dynamique commune entre les deux hôtels
  • Coordonner les équipes hébergement, restauration, technique, commerciale et administrative
  • Animer les réunions, les briefings et la circulation de l’information
  • Accompagner les managers dans leurs prises de décision
  • Piloter les plannings et adapter l’organisation à l’activité
  • Veiller au respect de la législation sociale et des procédures RH
  • Identifier les besoins de recrutement, de formation et de développement des compétences

Le Directeur encadre, anime et accompagne les équipes, supervise les activités et veille à la qualité du travail, directement ou par délégation. [Directeur | Word]

Développer l’activité commerciale et le revenu

  • Suivre les prévisions, le rythme des réservations et les montées en charge
  • Piloter la stratégie tarifaire en lien avec les dispositifs de Revenue Management
  • Analyser le marché hôtelier et la concurrence locale
  • Identifier de nouveaux leviers de chiffre d’affaires
  • Adapter les offres aux attentes des clientèles affaires et loisirs
  • Développer les relations avec les entreprises, partenaires et acteurs locaux
  • Soutenir les actions commerciales et la visibilité des établissements

Le poste implique le développement du chiffre d’affaires, l’analyse de la concurrence, l’application de la politique tarifaire et l’utilisation des outils de Yield Management. [Directeur | Word]

Garantir l’expérience client et la qualité

  • Incarner les établissements auprès des clients et des partenaires
  • Veiller à la qualité de l’accueil et des prestations proposées
  • Suivre les retours clients sur l’ensemble des canaux
  • Garantir des réponses rapides, personnalisées et adaptées
  • Contrôler l’application des standards des deux enseignes
  • Maintenir une culture de service exigeante et positive
  • Veiller au respect des règles d’hygiène, de sécurité et de conformité

Vous êtes le premier représentant des établissements auprès de la clientèle et des institutions locales. Vous garantissez la satisfaction client et la qualité des services proposés.

Qualifications

Le profil qui fera la différence

Vous êtes un dirigeant hôtelier expérimenté, capable de comprendre rapidement un environnement, de prendre des décisions et de créer de la confiance.

Vous avez déjà piloté un hôtel important, un établissement multi-activités ou, idéalement, un combo hôtelier. Les contextes de remplacement, de transition managériale, de transformation ou de forte activité vous stimulent.

Vos atouts

  • Expérience confirmée en direction ou direction adjointe d’hôtel
  • Expérience souhaitée dans un environnement multi-sites, multimarques ou comparable
  • Solide maîtrise de l’exploitation hôtelière et de la restauration
  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux financiers, commerciaux et de Revenue Management
  • Leadership de proximité et véritable goût du terrain
  • Capacité à fédérer rapidement des équipes aux métiers variés
  • Excellentes capacités d’organisation, d’analyse et de priorisation
  • Autonomie, rigueur, écoute et aisance relationnelle
  • Réactivité et capacité à gérer les imprévus avec calme
  • Bonne connaissance des normes hôtelières, sociales, juridiques, d’hygiène et de sécurité

job.company_description:
Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service.
With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta is on a journey to become a world-class retailer, changing the way Delta can sell and service flight and ancillary products and improve the overall customer experience. To achieve this goal, Delta’s Retail Strategy is to consistently offer, sell, and service high quality personalized products in the customer’s channel of choice.

Delta’s current system of record for purchases limits how we deliver and service enhanced product offerings. To solve this problem, Delta is creating a new system of record that requires a robust and flexible order data model. The order management data model will serve as the source of truth for all products sold and attributes of products needed to fulfill and service for the customer. To guide this effort, the Enterprise Solutions (ES) team is seeking a Product Manager - Order Data. The Product Manager will collaborate on designing, delivering, and maintaining proprietary data products that result in the improved ability to sell and service products for Delta Air Lines. The role partners across Delta and vendors to identify opportunities, define requirements, provide insights, prototype products, and deliver end-to-end solutions.

We are looking for candidates who have a passion for data, are motivated by solving problems, exhibit curiosity to understand current processes, and can think creatively to identify solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with stakeholders across the enterprise to determine requirements for order data.
  • Work with business and IT partners to translate business requirements into usable and reliable data solutions.
  • Analyze and use data to guide development roadmaps.
  • Drive implementation of data solutions.
  • Collaborate with other teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Communicate progress to leaders and stakeholders.
  • Maintain a pulse on industry efforts, disruptive technologies, and champion solutions to further Delta's position as industry leader

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • At least 5+ years of work experience in a Data Engineering, Data Management, Data Analysis, Statistics or Product Manager Role.
  • BA/BS or advanced degree in a process or project management discipline such Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering
  • Ability to understand large, unstructured data sets.
  • Understanding of data modeling and modern software architecture styles.
  • Demonstrates intellectual curiosity as well as sound analytical and communication skills; ability to communicate at all levels
  • Shown success in understanding and improving complex processes.
  • Capable of managing multiple projects with limited supervision in a fast-paced environment
  • Focused on results and can prioritize competing interests with seemingly disparate goals.
  • Uses data to quantify problems, identify trade-offs and develop solutions.
  • Communicates in a timely, accurate and effective manner.
  • Must be performing satisfactorily in present position
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in building or leading data design in a Retail capacity
  • Relevant working experience in Retail Order Management, Booking, Ticketing, Business Intelligence and Data Analytics.
  • PNR, Order, Booking and/or Ticketing knowledge
  • Experience in at least one commercial or operations function such as Reservations, Airport Customer Service, eCommerce, Revenue Management or Sales
  • Knowledge of revenue management theory or airline systems/data

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to join our Customer eXperience vertical in Barcelona (Hybrid) to lead a high performing team of cross-functional specialists, fully dedicated to one important mission - making travel changes and cancellations as easy as possible for customers. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As an Engineering Manager in the Customer eXperience vertical you will be in charge of:

  • Working with top-notch tech stack including Java 17, BigData (Kafka, BigTable, Redis, PostgreSQL), LLMs, Datamesh, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud, Sonarqube and Datadog
  • Collaborating with Product, Business, Architecture, Data Science to shape the technical strategy and evolution of the Payments domain, define the technical strategy for your modules and ensure their optimal performance
  • Helping your team translate functional specifications into high-performance logical technical design and code and split the work into smaller tasks that add quick value to customers
  • Promoting our standards of technical excellence, innovation and continuous improvement
  • Leading a high performing cross functional agile team of 7-10 experienced software engineers and developers
  • Taking an active role in finding and hiring the best talent available, in collaboration with our recruiters, and onboard new joiners into our culture of high performance, collaboration and growth
  • Managing performance, setting goals and prioritising work for your team, balancing the capacity of the team
  • Establish a sense of identity, engagement and belonging in your team, and improve team dynamics - in collaboration with your dedicated agile coach
  • Act as a mentor, helping others develop their skills and professional career


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Ability to take fast and data driven decisions
  • Strong communication and influencing skills
  • Ability to live and transmit our values
  • Intense focus on what delivers customer value
  • High standards around quality and technical excellence in coding
  • Developing and growing self and others
  • Presenting with confidence to both technical and non technical audiences
  • Knowledge and experience with coding, OO design, system design, performance tuning, performance engineering, design patterns, data modelling
  • Java and code base knowledge
  • Knowledge and experience with distributed, concurrent and scalable systems


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group powers travel for everyone, everywhere. As AI becomes core to how travelers plan, book, and manage their trips, it is also changing how we build for them — and merchandising is where that change is furthest along.

The Merchandising Platform team owns the commercial layer of the traveler experience across every Expedia Group brand: price display, product badging, price insights, the algorithms that identify and rank collections, and the merchandising pages and services that power them. Today, brand teams operate this platform manually — designing individual experiments, configuring each change, and waiting weeks between an idea and a result. We are building the agentic systems that change that: autonomous agents that generate hypotheses, assemble experiences from configurable components, run experiments continuously within brand-defined guardrails, and roll out winners — with brand teams acting as strategists and governors rather than operators.

In this role, you will be a hands-on AI builder PM at the centre of that shift. You will prototype and ship multi-agent systems that automate the merchandising experiment lifecycle end to end, define the trust and governance patterns that let agents act safely on live traveler experiences, and lead the most promising capabilities from experiment to production at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands — and set the pattern for how autonomous optimisation expands across the rest of the traveler journey.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own the product direction for autonomous merchandising optimisation — from agent-assisted experiment setup today to agents that generate, launch, evaluate, and roll out tests continuously within brand-defined success metrics, guardrails, and policies.
  • Rapidly prototype agentic flows hands-on: orchestration across specialised sub-agents, tool/function calling against internal platform APIs, prompt and context design, agent memory, and evaluation harnesses — proving value and feasibility before committing engineering investment.
  • Take successful prototypes to production with engineering, data science, and design — including human review gates, guardrail breach detection, automated rollback, audit trails, and attribution so every agent action is measurable and reversible.
  • Define the trust architecture for agents acting on live experiences: preview/approve/undo flows, escalation triggers, explainability, and override tracking — patterns designed to be adopted by teams across Expedia Group as autonomous optimisation expands to new surfaces.
  • Drive measurable outcomes: compress experiment cycle time from months to days, multiply experiment throughput per surface, and demonstrate conversion and revenue lift from agent-optimised merchandising — without degrading traveler trust or experience quality.
  • Partner closely with experimentation, content and configuration platforms, GenAI platform, and brand product teams across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo to make agent capabilities work end to end across the organisation.
  • Evaluate emerging capabilities from frontier labs and internal platforms — tool use, multi-agent orchestration, agent memory, evaluation techniques — and translate them into concrete product concepts and working demos.
  • Lead the organisational shift alongside the technical one: build brand teams' trust in agent-operated optimisation, define how they set strategy and guardrails rather than individual tests, and share playbooks so agentic operation becomes how merchandising works across Expedia Group.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management experience building consumer or platform products, including meaningful work with AI, ML, or technically complex systems.
  • Strong technical depth and experience partnering with engineering and DS/ML teams; comfortable discussing agent architectures, system design, data flows, tradeoffs, and constraints.
  • Hands-on ability to prototype: capable of using APIs/SDKs from major LLM providers and writing simple code (e.g., Python or TypeScript/JavaScript) to stitch together prompts, tools, and agent workflows.
  • Proven track record of taking 0→1 product ideas from concept through prototype to launched features, with clear impact on customer and business outcomes.
  • Deep experience with experimentation and measurement: A/B testing at scale, success metrics and guardrail definition, instrumentation, and using experiment data to drive iteration — this role automates the experiment lifecycle itself, so fluency here is essential.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to make complex technical topics accessible and to drive alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or shipping agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP or similar protocols, agent memory, human-in-the-loop review patterns, and agent evaluation.
  • Background in e-commerce merchandising, personalisation, or marketplace optimisation — pricing display, recommendations, ranking, promotional content, or campaign automation.
  • Experience with autonomous or continuous optimisation systems (e.g., bandits, automated experimentation platforms) and the governance questions they raise: explainability, accountability, over-optimisation, and segment-level effects.
  • Understanding of trustworthy AI principles — safety, bias, privacy, and failure-mode analysis — and how to apply them when agents act on live customer experiences, including regulatory constraints on pricing display and urgency messaging.
  • Background in software engineering, data science, or ML (professional experience or equivalent technical projects), even if you have primarily worked as a PM.
  • Experience building frameworks, tools, or platforms adopted by multiple teams in a large organisation, and driving the change management that adoption requires.

Accommodation requests

This versatile role is essential for the smooth operation of our Compliance & Ethics, Financial Crime Risk Management, and Regulatory programs. We are looking for an upbeat self-starter who is highly organized, thrives in a fast-paced technology environment, and is eager to make a lasting impact on our organization.

This position requires a presence in our Concord, MA office three days per week.

In This Role You Will

  • Support the day-to-day operation of KAYAK's Compliance & Ethics, Financial Crime Risk Management (FCRM) programs, including policy guidance, training coordination, and monitoring activities.
  • Help manage conflicts of interest disclosures, gifts and entertainment reviews, and anti-bribery and corruption processes.
  • Coordinate Know Your Partner (KYP) and risk-based third-party due diligence for prospective and existing partners, including information collection, review, follow-up, documentation, and escalation.
  • Assist with sanctions and restricted-country screening, supporting the Booking Holdings Financial Crime Risk Management Centre of Excellence and escalating issues to the appropriate team members as needed.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential FCRM, sanctions, ethics, and other compliance risks and issues.
  • Support risk assessments by gathering information, documenting findings, and tracking approved mitigation actions.
  • Contribute to compliance training and awareness initiatives, including the Ethics Ambassador Program and compliance communications to employees.
  • Support regulatory monitoring efforts — tracking new and evolving requirements across US, EU, and UK jurisdictions and helping translate them into actionable guidance for the business.
  • Help maintain and improve self-service compliance resources, including policies, procedures, process flows, trackers, evidence repositories, and the internal compliance knowledge hub.
  • Support periodic monitoring, control testing, compliance audits, and preparation of concise reports and management updates.
  • Identify and support opportunities to use approved AI-enabled tools and workflow automation to streamline compliance processes, while maintaining appropriate human review, data protection, and audibility.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners in People & Culture, Finance, Product, and Engineering on compliance-related matters

Please Apply If You Have

  • 5 or more years of experience in compliance and ethics, FCRM, sanctions, AML/KYC, third-party risk, legal operations, or a closely related control function - equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams independently and meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can explain a complex requirement clearly to someone who is not a lawyer or compliance professional.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to recognize when a situation calls for escalation, even when the right answer is not obvious.
  • Experience building productive working relationships across teams and functions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace tools, including spreadsheets and presentation software.
  • A positive, "can-do" mentality and a genuine eagerness to learn and contribute to a wide range of projects.

The Following Are Helpful But Not Required

  • Familiarity with one or more of the following areas: sanctions screening and OFAC concepts, the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), anti-bribery and corruption, financial crime risks and controls, consumer protection regulation, or platform regulation (such as the EU Digital Services Act or Digital Markets Act).
  • Experience working in a technology company, travel industry, or similarly fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional environment.
  • Experience using compliance, workflow, or case-management systems (e.g., learning management systems, helpline platforms, or document management tools).
  • Interest in using AI and automation tools to improve compliance workflows, documentation, or reporting.
  • Compliance, FCRM, AML, sanctions, or ethics certification such as CCEP, CAMS, or ICA.

We know that no candidate will check every box. If you meet most of these criteria and are excited about this work, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per location, per year
  • Company-wide week off a year – the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

Position oversees the development and implementation of departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures the rooms operations meet the brand’s target customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Property Operations

  • Working with Rooms management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
  • Reviewing comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
  • Evaluating if Operations Team is meeting service needs and provides feedback to operations team.
  • Participating in public space walk-throughs with Engineering and Housekeeping to ensure guest rooms, public space and back of the house areas are well maintained and preventative maintenance processes are in place.

Leading Operations Teams

  • Ensuring employees are treated fairly and equitably.
  • Celebrating successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.

Managing Relationships with Property Stakeholders

  • Attending owners meetings and provides meaning or context to the rooms operational and financial results.
  • Establishing relationship with owner as a business partnership and supports the relationship between the General Manager and the owner.

Managing Profitability

  • Coaching and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
  • Working with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establish ways to improve the departments’ financial performance.
  • Leading cost containment efforts within Rooms operations including organizational restructuring when necessary.
  • Focusing on maintaining profit margins without compromising guest or employee satisfaction.

Managing The Guest Experience

The Opportunity

Agoda is very excited to launch a new B2C fintech product

As Senior Business Analyst – New verticals, you will play a key role in defining, launching and growing the product across different markets. You'll devise, own and execute initiatives to drive acquisition, transaction growth and retention, working closely with product, fintech, and cross-functional marketing teams. This is a unique opportunity to incubate and grow a new business vertical within Agoda from the ground up.

We are looking for someone who can handle ambiguity well while remaining independent in developing fast-paced initiatives across this new and interesting product.

In this Role, You Will

  • Help on defining the Product Customer Value Proposition and Go To Market (GTM) Strategy
  • Design optimization strategy for the product across the full funnel – from user across key business metrices (i.e., acquisition, activation, transaction growth, top-ups loyalty and customer engagement)
  • Execute the marketing strategy: e.g.,

    • This is a sole contributor role with strong visibility across Managers and Directors

  • Marketing expertise: At least 3 years of experience with running strategic initiative within the e-commerce, consulting, OTA and fintech space
  • Strong analytical skills:
    • Comfortable working with data and performance metrics (CAC, LTV, activation, retention, payback, cohorts)

    • Innate desire to take ownership, make an impact and influence outcomes
    • Bias for action and experimentation
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
    • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating with multi team in multiple department 

    Nice to Have

    • Experience with Direct marketing, Performance marketing and Affiliate marketing for financial products
    • Experience in consulting, investment banking, e-commerce, fintech or financial services, such as Travel cards, multi‑currency wallets
    • Experience launching or scaling a new product or major feature as part of a team

Company Description

Set in the heart of Burleigh Heads on the Gold Coast, Mondrian Gold Coast is a bold, design-led luxury hotel that brings a fresh and playful energy to the Australian hospitality scene. Part of the global Ennismore collective, Mondrian is known for its distinctive design, vibrant dining, entertainment and experiences that are anything but ordinary. We’re a team that values individuality, creativity, genuine connections and having fun while delivering exceptional experiences for our guests.

Job Description

About the Role:

We’re looking for a passionate and detail-driven Housekeeping professional to join our team at Mondrian Gold Coast.

In this role, you’ll play an important part in ensuring our guest rooms and public areas consistently meet the high standards our guests expect. Working closely with the Director of Rooms and Executive Housekeeper, you’ll help lead the day-to-day operation of the Housekeeping department while creating exceptional guest experiences.

This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced resort environment, takes pride in the details and enjoys working with people.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Assist the Director of Rooms with daily inspections of guest rooms and public areas to ensure brand and service standards are consistently achieved.
  • Work closely with the Executive Housekeeper and wider Rooms Division to maintain operational standards and efficiency.
  • Monitor linen, uniforms and minibar operations, including inventory, cost control and ensuring standards are maintained.
  • Monitor guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve the guest experience.
  • Work collaboratively with Front Office and Engineering to ensure Out of Order rooms are returned to service within the required timeframes.
  • Coordinate and respond to VIP requirements and special guest requests, ensuring rooms are prepared and released ahead of arrival wherever possible.
  • Support effective cost management through responsible use of linen, energy, equipment and departmental resources.
  • Coach, mentor and support team members to deliver outstanding service and consistently meet brand standards.
  • Assist with onboarding and training new team members and contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture.
  • Champion workplace health, safety, confidentiality and compliance standards.
  • Step in and support other departments when required — we’re all about working together.

What We’re Looking For

You’ll be a natural leader who is organised, approachable and genuinely passionate about hospitality. You’ll have a strong eye for detail and the confidence to make decisions in a busy resort environment.

Ideally, You’ll Bring

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in Housekeeping or guest services, with at least 1 year in a supervisory role preferred.
  • Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organisation, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Experience working in a hotel or resort environment.
  • Knowledge of Opera Cloud, HUB OS and Microsoft Office is highly regarded.
  • A genuine passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences.
  • The ability to coach, develop and inspire team members.
  • Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of cost control.
  • Flexibility to work across shifts, including weekends and public holidays.
  • A current Australian driver’s licence — manual licence preferred.
  • The ability to communicate confidently in English. Additional languages are an advantage.
  • Knowledge of the Gold Coast, its attractions, restaurants and events is advantageous but not essential.

Why Join Us?

At Mondrian Gold Coast, we believe hospitality should be energetic, authentic and a little unexpected.

We’re Looking For People Who

Tell It Like It Is — authentic, honest and genuine.

Have Fun & Make Friends — energetic, positive and ready to bring good vibes to the workplace.

I've Got Your Back — accountable, dependable and someone who follows through.

Play to Win — creative, ambitious and open to doing things differently.

Right Here, Right Now — present, attentive and obsessed with the details that make a guest experience memorable.

If you’re ready to bring your personality, leadership and passion for hospitality to one of the Gold Coast’s most exciting hotel environments, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager - Proactive, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

The Opportunity

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle—delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Lead the Engineering Vision of a World-Class Island Resort

Set against the spectacular backdrop of the Great Barrier Reef, InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef is one of Australia’s most iconic luxury island resorts. As Director of Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in protecting and elevating the resort experience through exceptional engineering leadership, asset stewardship and operational excellence.

As a key member of the Executive Committee, you will lead the strategic and day-to-day direction of the Engineering function, taking ownership of the performance, reliability and presentation of the resort’s buildings, facilities, plant and critical infrastructure. From guest rooms, restaurants and bars to pools, recreational facilities and colleague areas, your leadership will ensure every element of Hayman performs at the level expected of a world-class luxury destination and in line with InterContinental brand standards.

What makes this opportunity truly unique is the complexity and scale of operating a luxury resort on a remote island. You will oversee critical infrastructure including power generation and distribution, desalination and water production, wastewater and sewerage, waste management, central plant, the colleague village and marine infrastructure ensuring the systems behind the experience are as exceptional as the experience itself.

A strong focus on preventative maintenance, asset longevity and proactive risk management will be central to your success. You will lead a high-performing Repairs & Maintenance program, identifying opportunities before they become operational issues and ensuring our resort assets are protected for the long term.

This is an opportunity to combine strategic executive leadership with hands-on operational impact. Working closely with the General Manager and fellow Executive Committee members, you will provide trusted advice on asset condition, infrastructure risk, capital priorities and future investment helping shape the continued evolution of Hayman as one of Australia’s premier luxury resort destinations.

See Yourself in Our Team

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Significant senior Engineering leadership experience within a complex, asset-intensive hotel, resort or comparable operating environment.
  • Proven experience at Director of Engineering, senior Chief Engineer or equivalent level, ideally within luxury hospitality or a large resort environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge across major building services, plant, electrical and mechanical systems, HVAC and refrigeration, utilities and critical infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Repairs & Maintenance, preventative maintenance and asset lifecycle management.
  • Proven experience developing and managing significant CAPEX programs and complex Engineering projects.
  • Strong commercial and financial capability including budgeting, utilities, procurement and contract management.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary Engineering and trades teams.
  • Strong understanding of relevant Australian technical, legislative and compliance requirements.
  • Strong executive communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a remote environment where forward planning, resilience and infrastructure reliability are critical.
  • Relevant tertiary, trade or professional Engineering qualifications and licenses appropriate to the responsibilities of the role.
  • Luxury hotel, resort, island or remote infrastructure experience will be highly regarded.
  • Join a vibrant and diverse team, making lifelong friendships, and become part of an unforgettable island community.

Live the Island Life

  • We make island living convenient and affordable with subsidised staff accommodation and meals. We also offer dedicated staff facilities - pool, beach, gym, bar, diner, laundry, and more.
  • Enjoy swimming, snorkeling, hiking, kayaking, and exploring the Whitsundays after your shift or on your days off.
  • Your commute ends in paradise, with beautiful beaches and breathtaking ocean views just moments away.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for career growth, training, and professional development.
  • Enjoy exclusive employee, friends, and family discount rates across our InterContinental Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe great hospitality starts with great people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, religions, genders, gender identities and sexual orientations. We pride ourselves on a diverse and family friendly environment, and welcome applicants with primary school aged children as our island offers a State Primary School.

If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know, we're here to support you.

Ready to Work in Paradise

  • Please visit our Careers Page for all details regarding living and working on Hayman Island at: https://haymanisland.intercontinental.com/careers/ or click the ‘Apply Now’ button.
  • We also invite you to learn more by following our social channels:
    • Facebook via @ICHIRcareers and Instagram via @ihg_australia_careers
Applications close on 16 September 2026. We will be reviewing and contacting candidates throughout the advertising period. This application will close earlier if the position is filled.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
