job.company_description:
At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s a bold idea that has defined our purpose-led, people-first organization for over 65 years, and it’s one that we continue to strive toward with every journey.
Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.
job.job_description:
Overview

Du hast Lust während deines Studiums viele praktische Erfahrung zu sammeln, wichtige Kompetenzen zu erlernen und nützliche Kontakte zu knüpfen, die deiner Karriere weiterhelfen? Dann bist du bei Enterprise genau richtig!

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und ungeahnten Aufstiegschancen. Stell dir über 1,7 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit 80.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 22,5 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns!

Responsibilities

Dein Praktikum wirst du in einer unserer 200 deutschlandweit Teams absolvieren und so unser Unternehmen von der Pike auf kennenlernen. Kaffeekochen und Kopieren steht für unsere Praktikanten nicht auf dem Programm: Vom ersten Arbeitstag an wirst du ins Tagesgeschäft mit einbezogen und erlernst so neue Kenntnisse wie Führungsqualitäten, Flexibilität und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten "on the job". Dabei erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und spannende Herausforderungen im Kundenservice, im Vertrieb, im Marketing oder im Business-Management. So zum Beispiel:

  • Verkaufsgespräche zu führen
  • Geschäftspartnerschaften aufzubauen und zu pflegen
  • Effektiv mit Kunden, Lieferanten und Kollegen zu kommunizieren und zu interagieren
  • Kostenkontrolle
  • Strategien zur Konfliktlösung
  • Flottenplanung

Bei Enterprise ist kein Tag wie der andere!

Und das Beste: Wenn du dich nach deinem Hochschulabschluss entscheidest, an unserem Management Trainee Programm teilzunehmen, dann werden dir die bereits im Praktikum erworbenen Kenntnisse angerechnet. Das verkürzt deine Zeit als Trainee und einer steilen Karriere bei Enterprise steht nichts mehr im Wege. Selbst wenn du dich nach dem Studium entscheidest, woanders zu arbeiten, so hast du doch durch dein Praktikum bei uns eine erstklassige Berufserfahrung vorzuweisen, die nicht nur auf deinem Lebenslauf gut aussieht, sondern dir in Jobinterviews und in deiner weiteren Karriere helfen wird. Ein Praktikum im Management bei Enterprise lohnt sich also wirklich! Und das auch im wörtlichen Sinne, denn alle unsere Praktika werden vergütet.

Qualifications

Unsere Praktika sind um dich herum konzipiert. Es spielt für uns keine Rolle, in welchem Semester du bist, welchen Studiengang du studierst oder wann du bei uns anfangen willst. Wie lange willst du dein Praktikum bei uns absolvieren? Das hängt ganz von dir ab. Du hast die Wahl zwischen mehrmonatigen Sommerpraktika bis hin zu ganzjährigen Praktika, die du jederzeit beginnen kannst. Und bei der großen Auswahl an unseren Filialen in Deutschland haben wir mit Sicherheit auch einen freien Praktikumsplatz an deinem Wunschort.

Wir freuen uns, wenn du motiviert bist, Eigeninitiative zeigst und Verantwortung übernehmen willst. Alles andere bringen wir dir während deines Praktikums bei. Und es werden sich für dich viele interessante Möglichkeiten und Situationen ergeben, in denen du richtig loslegen und uns zeigen kannst, was in dir steckt – egal wie lange du bei uns bleibst.

Auch Solltest Du In Deinem Gepäck Haben

  • Eine unbegrenzte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein und 1 Jahr lang Fahrpraxis.
  • Höchstens 3 Punkt im Fahreignungsregister (FAER) in Flensburg und keine Vermerke in deiner Fahrerakte aus den letzten 5 Jahren aufgrund von Alkohol- oder Drogendelikten.
  • Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

Bitte bewirb dich nur einmal, und zwar direkt auf die Stelle in der Region, in der du arbeiten möchtest. Bei deinem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiter kannst du aber gerne die möglichen Einsatzgebiete noch im Detail besprechen.

Are the topics below in your list of interests? If yes, this might be a good opportunity.

  • Software architecture? Micro services? Cloud? Systems Design?
  • Distributed, scalable and resilient in systems with millions of daily transactions? Availability and resilience in 24/7 systems? Performance tuning? Chaos engineering?
  • Domain-driven design? Hexagonal architectures? Event-driven architectures?
  • Technologies such as Java, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, BigTable, ElasticSearch, BigQuery, Redis?
  • AI applications using both specialised ML models and LLMs?


Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Backend Architect in the Architect Team you will be in charge of:

  • Drive the technical evolution of one or more backend microservices in our platform
  • Be the go-to person for lead engineers and senior developers for all questions regarding coding, design and tools
  • Collaborate with multiple teams (~30 developers)
  • Help business and product in scoping and phasing ideas already in their backlogs
  • Contribute ideas to backlogs to help business and product teams with their challenges
  • Mentor lead and senior engineers in their technical growth
  • Work with other architects in cross-team, company-level technical initiatives


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • 8+ years of backend development experience in Java
  • Software coding, design patterns, architecture and performance engineering
  • Communication with both technical and non-technical people
  • Assertiveness and influencing: able to get your point across and challenge those of others in a calm and positive manner


Nice to have

  • BS in Computer Science or a related technical field
  • Experience designing microservices
  • Experience in other languages and platforms (e.g., JavaScript, Groovy, Swift)
  • Experience with machine learning systems
  • Experience in big multi-language/country ecommerce websites
  • Experience in the travel sector


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.

Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.

Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.

Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone's day. When you join our Commercial Team, that's exactly what you'll do. As a Groups, Conferences & Events Sales Executive, you'll do far more than process enquiries—you'll drive revenue, build lasting client relationships and create memorable event experiences in one of the UK's busiest MICE hotels.

We are looking for a results-driven, commercially minded sales professional to join our high-performing team at the Hotel of the Year, located on Brighton's vibrant seafront.

If you're passionate about sales, thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy converting opportunities into business, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Manage group, conference and event enquiries from initial enquiry through to contract confirmation.
  • Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings, consistently achieving conversion and revenue targets.
  • Identify opportunities to maximize revenue through upselling, cross-selling and effective negotiation.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and overcoming objections to secure business.
  • Arrange and conduct hotel show rounds to showcase our facilities and services.
  • Work closely with operational teams to ensure a seamless handover and exceptional guest experience.
  • Manage event administration accurately, maintaining contracts, quotations and customer records.
  • Contribute towards departmental sales targets and the overall commercial success of the hotel.
  • Support promotional activities and represent the hotel professionally to grow future business.

What are we looking for?

Role

A Groups, Conferences & Events Sales Executive serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and alongside other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should demonstrate:

  • A results-driven approach with a genuine passion for sales.
  • Excellent organization and time management skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness with the ability to maximize every sales opportunity.
  • Confidence in negotiating, overcoming objections and closing business.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A professional and confident telephone manner.
  • The ability to build lasting client relationships.
  • A proactive, positive attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced MICE environment.
  • Previous experience in Sales or Hotel Sales.
  • High level of IT skills.
  • The right to work in the UK.

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • Previous experience within Conference & Events or Hospitality Sales.
  • Knowledge of Hilton systems or other hotel sales and property management systems.
  • Experience working within the MICE sector.
  • A qualification in Hospitality, Business, Sales or Events Management.

What You Are Getting

  • The opportunity to work for the UK's No.1 Employer and the Hilton Hotel of the Year.
  • Learn from an experienced Commercial Team with extensive hotel sales expertise.
  • Team Member travel rates across 8600+ Hilton hotels worldwide.
  • A vibrant seafront location with direct beach access.
  • Industry-leading career development opportunities within Hilton.
  • A supportive team culture focused on success, collaboration and development.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves, care for members of their team, and care for their loved ones. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
Your day to day:

As Complex Director of Sales & Marketing covering the Six Senses Grenada and InterContinental Grenada(Opening Q4 of 2026, you will develop and implement strategies to ensure revenue and room night sales goals are achieved, sales and marketing strategies are set, tactical plans are created and implemented, and results are monitored and achieved.

Leadership

  • Deploy sales and marketing colleagues for comprehensive coverage of key markets, segments, and customers
  • Develop your team and improve their performance through training, coaching and feedback
  • Assign performance and development goals for colleagues; monitor achievement of revenue targets and course correct when needed
  • Drive a great working environment for your teams to thrive, creating synergy between the two resorts and a sense of one team
  • Develop and maintain great working relationships with key clients, guests, vendors and communities in local markets

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Lead the strategic commercial plan for both resorts, working with Revenue Management and Marketing Communications
  • Implement strategies and programming that are tailored to the market segments of both resorts
  • With RM and GMs, analyze growth opportunities across key segments
  • Develop a strong sales strategic plan that maximizes high season revenue and creates shoulder season opportunities
  • Working with digital marketing and PR partners, develop and execute strategy to maximize awareness, interest, and realized revenues for the resorts

Cluster Sales Management

  • Develop a comprehensive travel and trade show plan to maximize coverage and impact
  • Work closely with Luxury Lifestyle Global Sales to coordinate sales plans
  • Monitor sales deployment and performance of the sales team
  • Nurture a proactive sales culture and an effective prospecting program

Financial Management and Reporting

  • Prepare departmental budgets and financial plans including both resorts' commercial plan  
  • Create and implement commercial plans that drive measurable incremental occupancy, achieve RevPAR goals, food and beverage, and catering revenues
  • Produce monthly reports and sales forecasts to analyze current/potential market and sales trends, coordinate activities to increase revenue and market share,e and monitor performance to ensure actual sales meet or exceed established revenue plan 
  • Review monthly reports and sales forecasts to analyze current/potential market and sales trends
  • Coordinate activities to increase revenue and market share and monitor performance to meet or exceed established revenue plans

Guest Experience

  • Create programming at both resorts to drive incremental revenues
  • Communicate special needs for arriving VIPs, large groups, and other key guests
  • Lead marketing efforts to upsell guests on hotel services, offerings, and amenities

Responsible Business

  • Work closely with key business leaders, officials, and representatives of local community groups within the city to ensure constant high-profile exposure for the hotel
  • Effectively communicate and market aspects of the hotel that are sustainable or “green” and use information to gain new business opportunities
  • Work with advertising agencies, consulting firms, and vendors to maximize advertising investments and ensure ads represent brand identity
  • Raise the awareness and reputation of your hotel and the brand locally – occasionally acting as hotel representative for media-related inquiry
  • Identify improvements to marketing activities and overall hotel sales performance and work with other departments 
  • Ad-hoc duties – unexpected moments when we must pull together to get a task done

Accountability

This is the top commercial role overseeing two resorts. Resorts may have multiple sites and facilities, high-volume catering and/or convention facilities, and a large number of VIP and special service guests. May manage a large number of professional-level and administrative sales, catering, and/or convention employee

Skills And Experience

  • To execute the position of Area Director of Sales & Marketing, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:
  • Five or more years of experience in a senior sales and marketing role
  • Experience in managing a remote team(s); dual property experience is ideal
  • Strong knowledge of the Caribbean market and business trends preferred
  • Technical skills include Advanced MS Office and familiarity with various property systems

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for an Area Director of Sales & Marketing at Intercontinental Dominica, Six Senses Grenada & InterContinental Grenada. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

Location – Remote: **Candidate must reside within the US East Coast near a major airport

About Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada

Surrounded by nature, there are 56 pool suites. Combining eco-credentials and comfort, the design uses natural, renewable, and repurposed materials. The organic and contemporary interiors feature an open-plan bedroom, while the outdoor terrace leads to a private plunge pool for a cooling dip. In addition, there are 15 villas enjoying a prime hillside or oceanfront setting, ranging between one, two, and four bedrooms. The five four-bedroom villas located on the Bluff offer a 270-degree view of one of the most coveted locations in the Caribbean. It has never been more important to be mentally, physically, and spiritually happy. This has been considered in every aspect of the design, with ample light, fresh air, and space.

About InterContinental Grenada - La Sagesse

Opening November 2026, this stunning resort will offer 120 thoughtfully designed guest rooms and suites, complemented by a collection of exceptional restaurants and bars, a world-class spa, state-of-the-art fitness center, and a striking pool and Beach Club. With panoramic views overlooking La Sagesse Bay, this resort will offer expansive indoor and outdoor meeting and event space, seamlessly combining sophisticated luxury with the island’s stunning natural beauty.

About Us

IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the largest hotel companies in the world and one of the world’s leading hotel and resort companies with a family of 19 brands. Our purpose – True Hospitality for Good – comes to life in every one of our collections. With luxury and lifestyle, we are taking it to new heights.

Five visionary brands - InterContinental, Regent Hotels, Six Senses, Vignette Collection and Kimpton Hotels - make up our luxury collection. Individually, they are icons. Together, they bring unforgettable and unparalleled experiences to travelers in over 430 hotels and resorts in 100 countries around the world.

Having recently added a host of incredible properties to our portfolio, we now stand as one of the world’s leading luxury operators. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests unforgettable and unparalleled experiences.

With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Principal Product Manager, Agentic Evals

Introduction To The Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

Expedia Group powers travel for everyone, everywhere. As AI becomes core to how travelers plan, book, and manage their trips, our ability to evaluate quality, safety, and performance becomes essential. You will build the frameworks and tools that ensure every AI experience meets a high standard of clarity, accuracy, and trust.

The Core AI Experiences team defines the foundational methods for evaluating AI across the company. We create the metrics, tooling, and processes that guide how teams measure accuracy, safety, latency, helpfulness, and long-term traveler outcomes.

In this role, you will lead the strategy and build-out of Expedia Group’s AI evaluation framework. You will work closely with engineering, data science, and product teams to drive consistency and support decisions grounded in evidence. Your work will influence every AI-powered experience across Expedia Group and set the bar for quality, safety, and trust company-wide.

In This Role You Will

  • Define Expedia Group’s AI evaluation framework, principles, and adoption strategy
  • Build tools and workflows that support reliable, scalable measurement across brands
  • Partner with engineering and data science on metric design, instrumentation, and model evaluation
  • Establish clear, durable standards for accuracy, safety, transparency, and performance
  • Publish evaluation insights, scorecards, and recommendations that shape roadmaps
  • Influence strategic decisions on AI investments and risk management
  • Drive alignment across product, engineering, data science, and platform teams on evaluation strategy, standards, and prioritization
  • Create governance models that ensure consistency and responsible deployment at scale
  • Shape cross-team operating models and evaluation practices that guide how AI products are built and deployed across the company

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, quantitative, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of product management experience, including significant work with AI, ML, data platforms, or evaluation systems
  • Strong technical depth and experience partnering with DS/ML teams
  • Proven ability to build frameworks, metrics, or tools that scale across large organizations
  • Experience with model evaluation, instrumentation, experimentation, or system reliability
  • Strong written and verbal communication that brings clarity to complex technical spaces
  • Track record of influencing cross-functional leaders and driving alignment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building evaluation platforms, ML tooling, or governance frameworks
  • Familiarity with LLM behavior, model evaluation methods, or prompt testing
  • Understanding of trustworthy AI principles, safety evaluation, and failure-mode analysis

Summary of Position

Provide travel services for business travelers, including arranging domestic and international air, ground transportation, hotel, and any other travel services as requested. Utilize communication skills and teamwork to deliver optimum service and achieve high customer satisfaction, as well as develop strong collaborative relationships with clients and vendors.


Schedule / Shift

7A-12M CT , shifts include Sat & Sundays 8A-5P & holidays


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Communicate with customer in verbal and written form to determine destination, mode of transportation, travel dates, financial considerations, and accommodations required.
  • Arrange all travel related services. Including, but not limited to, bookings, such as air, rail, car, car service, hotel, seat assignments, and any other accommodations requested by the client.
  • Understanding of simple international travel, including fares and pricing, available resources and travel documentation requirements. 10-25% of air bookings should be international.
  • Be consultative with customer, adhering to organization’s Travel Policy guidelines.
  • Compute cost of travel related services using the GDS (Global Distribution System) or other booking tools and resources.
  • Assist customers with various needs, such as travel changes and special requests, including any necessary problem solving.
  • Quality Control each reservation before queuing to the relevant ticketing/quality control queue.
  • Ability to quickly assess information, anticipate issues and outcomes, and make effective decisions including ability to draw clear conclusions. Escalate to leadership for guidance when necessary.
  • Review incoming correspondence and materials as needed; prioritize, summarize, and respond in a timely manner.
  • Maintain all reservations in a completed state regardless of if authorization to ticket received at time of call.
  • Monitor assigned queues and tasks throughout the workday to ensure reservations and tasks are accurate and complete. Responsible for ensuring that all tasks within their team are completed or re-assigned by end of shift.
  • Work independently and with leadership team when necessary to make effective decisions, including resolving customer service issues.
  • Create and update passenger profiles to properly service each traveler.
  • Collect payment from customer for travel services according to Client’s Travel Policy and CTM Policy and Procedures.
  • Read daily briefings and industry announcements to keep abreast of industry developments.
  • Participate in training opportunities to maintain and expand travel knowledge and customer service skills.
  • Maintain a comprehensive working knowledge of GDS and any other product used for specific account being handled (i.e. CTMAdvisor, Online Booking Tool, iQCX, Banx, etc.)
  • Maintain productivity goals as set by leadership.

  • Develop supportive relationships with clients and demonstrate superior customer service.

Education and Experience

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong interpersonal skills and capability to work effectively with all levels.
  • Demonstrates professionalism and skills to maintain positive image.
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to keep confidential any information, observations, or viewpoints regarding business matters.
  • High degree of motivation with driving sense of responsibility, accountability, and responsiveness.
  • Working knowledge of technology and PC literacy.
  • Proficient on GDS.
  • Strong ability to prioritize and multi-task.
  • Geography knowledge.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Lead a specialist team delivering exceptional support for customers with complex travel accessibility requirements across the Qantas network
  • Drive operational excellence, accessibility outcomes and continuous improvements to the customer experience
  • Influence change across a broad stakeholder network while leading a high-performing team in a Monday to Friday role based at our Mascot Campus

We’ve always been pioneers, and we’re proud to see that spirit in our people today. Our resilience has helped us through good and tough times, and it still drives us to keep pushing the challenging expectations today. We take a commercial mindset to all we do, ensuring we make strategic decisions that live up to customer expectations. It’s in us to be our best. We see it as our responsibility to take ownership and drive outcomes, ensuring we make a contribution to take the organisation forward.

At Qantas, creating inclusive and accessible travel experiences is a key part of delivering exceptional customer outcomes. We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager, Access and Inclusion to lead our Customer Specific Needs operation, supporting customers with a wide range of accessibility and travel requirements while driving operational performance, compliance and continuous improvement.

Reporting to the Manager Accessibility & Customer Policies, this role leads a team of Customer Specific Needs Consultants responsible for coordinating complex travel arrangements, including medical clearances, mobility assistance, service animals, oxygen requirements and stretcher cases. You will be accountable for operational performance, customer outcomes, team leadership and regulatory compliance while partnering with stakeholders across the business to deliver safe, inclusive and customer-focused solutions.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Leading and developing a high-performing team that cover cross a 7-day operational environment
  • Driving performance against service levels, customer satisfaction measures, quality outcomes and incident reduction targets
  • Managing complex customer escalations and serving as the primary operational escalation point for sensitive cases
  • Partnering with Medical, Legal, Airports, Engineering, Contact Centres and Digital teams to deliver end-to-end customer outcomes
  • Leading continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis, reporting and operational insights
  • Ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory requirements, policies and procedures
  • Managing workforce planning, rostering and operational coverage requirements
  • Supporting accessibility initiatives, operational readiness activities and change implementation programs across the customer experience ecosystem

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Bring

  • Minimum 3-5 years' management experience within specialist customer operations, regulated service environments, aviation, healthcare, disability services or similar sectors
  • Proven experience delivering operational performance outcomes across customer satisfaction, service levels and incident reduction measures
  • Strong people leadership capability, including coaching, performance management and team development
  • Experience leading operational change, transformation or continuous improvement initiatives
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across a broad range of internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data and reporting to drive decision making
  • Experience managing complex customer issues in sensitive and high-pressure environments
  • Knowledge of customer service technologies and reporting tools, including Salesforce, Genesys and Microsoft Office products
  • Qualifications in business, operations, customer service, health or a related discipline are highly regarded but not essential

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

Applications close on Friday 25th September 2026

Please note: Applications will only be considered for candidates who have the right to work in Australia / New Zealand without restriction or sponsorship.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The team

Agoda's Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We're analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional — partnering closely with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and Supply to shape Agoda's growth agenda.

The opportunity

We're looking for experience Marketing Growth Strategy & Analytics leaders to own high-impact commercial initiatives from strategy through execution. You'll translate business goals into structured plans, lead cross-functional programs, and use data and experimentation to unlock growth. This role sits at the center of key decisions — influencing how we grow, price, and operate across markets — with strong visibility to senior leadership.

In this role, you'll get to

  • Define and execute strategies within your scope — which may span areas like pricing, channel performance, customer acquisition, retention, or go-to-market — translating commercial priorities into testable hypotheses, scalable frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead experimentation roadmaps, including A/B tests and other measurement approaches, to evaluate impact and sharpen decision-making.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to surface trends, opportunities, and risks; build dashboards and executive-ready narratives that communicate performance clearly.
  • Model business impact, evaluate trade-offs, and support planning around P&L, growth, and long-term value creation.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, Supply, and senior leadership to drive alignment and execution.
  • Build playbooks and processes that enable repeatability and scale across markets, channels, or partners.
  • Mentor and develop team members while contributing to a high-performance, test-and-learn culture.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in growth, marketing, pricing, strategy, analytics, revenue management, consulting, or related data-driven roles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — comfortable turning ambiguity into clear frameworks and action plans.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL, Tableau, or similar BI/analytics tools; proven ability to translate data into commercial recommendations.
  • Practical experience with experimentation, measurement, and performance optimization.
  • Strong business acumen: P&L drivers, unit economics, growth levers, and ROI.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior and cross-functional audiences.
  • High ownership and execution discipline in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.

It's great if you have

  • Experience in a high-growth digital business (e-commerce, travel, tech, fintech) or an analytically rigorous environment such as management consulting or internal strategy.
  • Familiarity with statistical analysis, forecasting, machine learning, or hypothesis-testing frameworks.
  • Experience using Python or R for analysis, modeling, or automation.
  • People management experience — hiring, coaching, and developing teams.
  • Experience with external partners, affiliates, marketplaces, loyalty programs, or B2B/B2B2C channels.
  • MBA or advanced degree (equivalent hands-on experience equally valued).

Why join Agoda

  • Work on high-impact, global business problems with direct visibility to senior leadership.
  • Shape commercial strategy in an organization that genuinely values analytical rigor, ownership, and experimentation.
  • Build and scale initiatives that influence growth, profitability, and customer experience at a global scale.

Job Title

SAFe System Architect - Services Engineering EMEA Train

About The Role

As a System Architect within the Services Engineering EMEA Train, you will play a key role in defining and driving the architectural vision that supports the development of scalable, resilient, and business-critical solutions across multiple teams and locations.

Working in a SAFe environment, you will provide technical leadership by shaping the system architecture, evolving the architectural runway, and ensuring alignment across products, teams, and business domains. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, Release Train Engineering, Architecture Communities, customer stakeholders, and development teams based in Bad Homburg, Bangalore, Dubai, Istanbul, and Nice.

In this role, you will review complex architectural and technical requirements, ensure alignment with the SAFe Large Solution Organization, and support their successful implementation while enabling long-term platform evolution and operational resilience.

Why this role

The EMEA Digital scope brings together multiple airline-specific eCommerce applications built on Amadeus Digital platforms, including both the legacy eRetail platform and the new DES platform.

This complexity creates an opportunity for the System Architect to identify synergies across teams, define the right architectural enablers, and help maximize the effectiveness of the Train from a technical perspective.

Main Responsibilities

Define and Communicate the Architectural Vision for the EMEA Train

  • Establish and maintain the Train-level architectural vision in alignment with SAFe principles and Amadeus standards.
  • Ensure architectural runway readiness to support future business needs with scalable, reliable, and sustainable solutions.
  • Provide clarity on system boundaries, interfaces, integration models, and key architectural decisions.

Guide Design and Architecture Across Distributed Development Teams

  • Review and validate complex technical designs across multiple development teams and locations.
  • Promote reuse, harmonization, and alignment with technology standards across the Train.
  • Support teams in addressing architectural challenges, managing technical debt, and maintaining long-term sustainability.

Cross-Organizational Architectural Alignment & Governance

  • Collaborate with Business Domains (Offer, Order, TTX), Solution teams, and adjacent Trains to ensure architectural consistency across the Amadeus ecosystem.
  • Align architectural decisions with engineering standards, security requirements, performance expectations, and integration frameworks.
  • Represent the Train in cross-domain and solution-level architecture forums.
  • Help ensure that dependencies, integration models, and shared enablers are understood and incorporated into planning and roadmaps.
  • Foster collaboration across Product, Service, Engineering, and Solution organizations.

Support ART Ceremonies and SAFe Events

  • Participate in PI Planning, System Demos, ART Syncs, architecture communities, and other SAFe events.
  • Provide guidance on dependencies, risks, enablers, and architectural priorities.
  • Facilitate technical alignment between teams, Product Owners, Product Managers, RTEs, and Digital Labs Customer Interface stakeholders.

Drive Continuous Improvement of Technical Practices within the Train

  • Support modernization initiatives, including AI adoption, automation, observability, technology upgrades, and quality improvements.
  • Encourage knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement across teams.
  • Identify and help address architectural and systemic bottlenecks.

Support Customer-Facing Technical Clarifications

  • Provide architectural insights to stakeholders engaging with customers.
  • Clarify technical constraints, extensibility considerations, and architectural impacts of custom developments.
  • Ensure customer-specific solutions remain aligned with the long-term architectural strategy.

Common accountabilities

  • Brings significant depth and breadth of expertise within their area and supports the development of others through guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Applies a broad understanding of the business and technology environment to improve efficiency, recommend solutions, and contribute to strategic objectives.
  • Works independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders.
  • Contributes to innovation, continuous improvement, and the delivery of high-quality outcomes.

What we can offer you

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you'll power the future of travel with a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, from on-the-job training to formal activities, and daily interactions.

🤗 A caring environment – Amadeus fosters a caring environment that supports both professional growth and personal well-being.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive compensation packages, including salary, bonus, caregiving and health benefits and health benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - Embrace our flexible working model, enabling you to excel wherever and however you work best.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community – We are committed to enabling each employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental to shaping our relationships with customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. job.job_description:
Choice Hotels International is looking for an Analytics and Visualization Manager with a passion for turning data into decisions, not just dashboards. This role operates at the intersection of business intelligence, AI tooling, and analytical storytelling, and plays a central role in shaping how our franchise network, commercial teams, and senior leaders interact with data at the business unit and company level.

You will serve as a senior contributor within a high-performing Analytics team that builds everything from predictive models to generative AI products. Your focus will be on building the intelligence layer end-to-end: architecting and delivering analytics data products that surface strategic insights, enable conversational exploration, and close the gap between data and action — with direct implications for business unit revenue, cost, and performance outcomes.

For years, analytics teams have largely operated on a request-and-report model: someone needs an answer, submits a request, and a manual analysis or report is built. This role is part of a broader effort to build data products that proactively surface meaningful insights, provide AI-generated summaries, and enable business users to explore data independently. The objective is to reduce one-off reporting requests by delivering scalable, self-service data products with continuously available insights.

Choice Hotels operates as a franchisor, which means data products must serve a wide range of users — from a hotel owner reviewing nightly performance to a segment executive evaluating portfolio strategy. This role is responsible for designing analytics experiences that are intelligent, proactive, and scalable: surfacing the right insight, in the right context, before the user has to ask for it. The opportunity here is not just to build dashboards, but to shape the analytics product vision and influence how the entire organization thinks about data-driven decision-making.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Analytics Product Design & Insight Generation

  • Lead the end-to-end design and delivery of Tableau dashboards that pair advanced visualizations with AI-generated narrative commentary, surfacing key drivers, anomalies, and recommended actions for both operational and executive audiences
  • Serve as the internal authority on Tableau Pulse, Ask Data, and Einstein Discovery integrations, driving the adoption of automated insight surfaces that proactively deliver intelligence to business users without requiring manual requests
  • Develop and own a forward-looking roadmap for analytics data products aligned with mid to short-term business unit strategy, recommending approaches and prioritizing investments based on business impact
  • Collaborate with data scientists to translate model outputs and predictions into clear, actionable visual narratives that inform high-stakes business decisions across franchise operations, revenue management, and marketing
  • Define and govern the standards for analytics product design across the team, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with company strategy and governed data definitions

Conversational Analytics & AI-Augmented Intelligence

  • Architect and maintain sophisticated analytics experiences that enable across multiple business units to query data using natural language, reducing dependency on ad hoc report requests at scale
  • Lead prototyping and iterative development of LLM-integrated workflows — including connecting large language models with Redshift data sources to auto-generate performance summaries, anomaly explanations, and strategic narratives
  • Drive the strategic vision for self-service analytics across the organization, identifying opportunities to eliminate bottlenecks, improve data literacy, and empower business users to answer their own questions
  • Evaluate emerging AI and agentic development tools and recommend adoption strategies that accelerate the team's analytics delivery capabilities and align with enterprise technology standards
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that integrate conversational analytics into broader enterprise data products and digital experiences

Data Architecture & Analytical Infrastructure

  • Architect and maintain robust, scalable data sources, flows, and published extracts that power both traditional dashboards and AI-augmented analytics experiences, ensuring performance, reliability, and governance at the business unit level
  • Write, optimize, and review complex SQL against AWS Redshift and S3 tables to source, validate, and structure data for Tableau dashboards, automated reporting workflows, and AI-generated outputs — ensuring accuracy, performance, and strict alignment with governed definitions
  • Design and deliver sophisticated user-friendly data products beyond dashboards, including Python-generated Excel reports, automated workbooks, and lightweight analytical tools that connect directly to governed data sources, reduce reliance on manual data pulls, and enable end-user data manipulation in familiar formats
  • Lead strategic partnerships with the Data Engineering team to ensure data readiness, platform scalability, and infrastructure alignment for current and future analytics product needs
  • Establish and enforce data quality standards, semantic layer governance, and documentation practices that ensure trusted, consistent use of analytics products across all stakeholder groups

Stakeholder Engagement, Influence & Communication

  • Translate highly ambiguous and strategically significant business questions from franchise operations, revenue management, marketing, and other business unit stakeholders into structured analytical frameworks and user-ready data products that drive measurable outcomes
  • Serve as a primary analytics thought partner and internal resource for business unit heads and department leaders, advising on data strategy, analytics product capabilities, and the interpretation of complex analytical outputs
  • Drive adoption and governance of Tableau dashboards and automated reporting workflows at scale by establishing enterprise usage standards, maintaining comprehensive documentation, enabling stakeholder communities, and monitoring adoption and data quality metrics to ensure consistent, trusted use across the organization
  • Influence departmental analytics strategies by identifying gaps, championing best practices, and recommending new approaches that align analytics capabilities with broader business unit and company objectives
  • Lead the development and delivery of compelling analytical narratives that address mixed audiences — from individual franchisees to segment executives — with clear, data-grounded storytelling that drives strategic alignment and action
  • May direct analytics workstreams or activities in a matrixed environment, coordinating across data science, engineering, and business teams to ensure integrated, high-quality delivery
  • Engage with external vendors, technology partners, and analytics platform providers to evaluate tools, negotiate capabilities, and integrate solutions that advance the team's strategic objectives

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics, data, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5–7 years of progressive experience building Tableau dashboards and analytics data products, including ownership of semantic layers, governed metrics, reusable data models, and enterprise-scale reporting infrastructure.
  • 5–7 years of experience writing advanced SQL queries, with deep experience in Redshift or other columnar databases; ability to design, optimize, and review complex analytical queries in a production environment.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering analytics products that directly support business unit revenue, cost, or performance outcomes.
  • Experience with query tools such as DBVisualizer, DBeaver, or similar; ability to evaluate and recommend tooling upgrades aligned with team needs.
  • Advanced knowledge of data modeling concepts, joins, aggregation logic, performance optimization, and semantic layer design principles.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint), with demonstrated ability to create executive-ready deliverables.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or other Atlassian products for project tracking, documentation, and cross-functional coordination in agile delivery environments.
  • Proven experience using AI-assisted and agentic development tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or similar) to accelerate code development, automate reporting workflows, generate data-driven outputs, and prototype LLM-integrated analytics experiences.
  • Recognized internally as a primary resource for analytics best practices, Tableau governance, and AI-augmented BI capabilities, with the ability to translate functional concepts into strategies aligned with company goals.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with full accountability for data accuracy, consistency, and governance across dashboards, semantic layers, AI-generated outputs, and reporting workflows
  • Advanced analytical mindset with a demonstrated track record of independently identifying, investigating, and resolving complex and novel data, modeling, and reporting challenges with limited precedent.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex priorities simultaneously while maintaining data quality, delivery timelines, and strategic alignment across stakeholder groups.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business strategies, influence senior stakeholders, and drive alignment on definitions, methodologies, and analytical outputs.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy, take full ownership of strategic deliverables, and proactively navigate ambiguity in complex, cross-functional problem spaces.
  • Ability to influence departmental strategy in a matrixed environment, building credibility and driving adoption across business unit and analytics communities without formal authority.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $114,000.00 to $135,000.00.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance of your own financial operation. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation - This position is non exempt and offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $60,000 with an average 40 hour work week.

  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing

We’re a family-owned, world-class portfolio of brands and leading provider of mobility solutions worldwide. Founded more than 65 years ago with a commitment to the communities that we serve, we operate a global network with 90,000 dedicated team members across nearly 100 countries, and more than 2.1 million vehicles taking our customers where they want to go. We owe our success to each and every one of our people. That's why we empower everyone on our team with opportunities for growth.

At Enterprise Mobility, you will have the chance to run your own financial operation and provide balance to the marketing and operational pieces of our business. We offer a comprehensive development program where you will work closely with sales and marketing, human resources, risk management, real estate strategy, and more to produce excellence in customer service, growth strategies, operating efficiencies, and profitability.

As your understanding of our business grows and your ability to make solid business decisions develops, you will soon take on a supervisory role within a business management team. With our entrepreneurial philosophy, there is truly nothing holding you back.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

  • Must have basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Flexibility for career advancement could include relocation outside of state

  • No drug or alcohol related convictions on driving record (DUI/DWI) within the past 5 years

Job Description

The Finance Director is responsible for understanding and promoting the hotel's financial performance and is responsible for conducting all financial activities within the framework of the policies, regulations and contractual frameworks.

The role works with the General Manager and is responsible for building excellent working relationships across a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, including hotel finance, commercial, IT, procurement, human resources, operations, owners and asset managers, and Regional Operations Finance.

Responsibilities

  • Maximize hotel profitability and performance.
  • Work with the general manager to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost savings, and working capital improvements.
  • Lead financial processes, including annual budgets, monthly forecast reviews, cash flow analysis, and benchmarking tools.
  • Conduct financial analysis, monitor market trends, and assess competitive conditions to support business decisions and maximize profitability.
  • Monitor and ensure the financial stability of the hotel by identifying, assessing and managing financial risks.
  • Ensure financial oversight of capital projects and ensure compliance with budgets and schedules.
  • You will act as a strategic business partner and financial advisor to hotel management and ownership, moderate monthly performance reviews and give presentations
  • Ensure accurate and timely month-end reporting to Hilton EMEA and owners within set deadlines.
  • Monitor and optimize operational costs and maximize efficiency while maintaining compliance with corporate policies and government regulations.
  • Evaluate and improve financial processes within the department to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Ensure the accuracy of income statements, balance sheets, and other important financial documents.
  • Lead and develop the finance team by fostering a culture of continuous improvement, training, performance excellence, and professional development.
  • Ensure effective communication within the finance team, including regular meetings to discuss relevant company and hotel updates.
  • Work with hotel management to identify revenue initiatives, cost savings, and process improvements.
  • Take on other assigned tasks and responsibilities, including participating in financial projects.
  • Show a complete understanding of the rental and management contracts and ensure that the hotel complies with corporate and legal requirements.
  • Transparently communicate key financial insights and variances to owners and the regional finance director.
  • Strengthen competency among team members through training, recognition, and sharing best practices.
  • Monitor business processes to maximize departmental efficiency and ensure management goals are met.
  • Act in accordance with fire, health and safety regulations on property
  • Ensure financial oversight of capital projects to ensure compliance with critical timelines and financial forecasts.
  • Review and approve payments for invoices and other project-related expenses.
  • Oversees day-to-day financial operations, including accounting processes, balance sheet reconciliations, and payment approvals.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the income statement (profit and loss) and balance sheet in accordance with company policies.
  • Manage the preparation, monitoring, and control of annual budgets, forecasts, and month-end financial reports.
  • Review and approve journal vouchers, monthly reports, and pay-based payments to ensure deadlines and guidelines are met.
  • Ensure proper permits, licenses, and legal documents are obtained and up-to-date.
  • Lead internal and external audits to ensure compliance with Hilton guidelines, HGB, USGAAP and regulatory requirements.
  • Proactively address audit deficiencies and management measures.
  • Review and manage user access controls for financial systems to ensure appropriate levels of access for team members.
  • Conduct monthly credit meetings with the general manager, front office, and sales teams.
  • Review the older debt report, provide actionable insights, and address payment issues effectively.
  • Review and approve chargebacks with credit cards.
  • Act as a financial advisor and strategic business partner for the general manager, owners, and department heads.
  • Monitor and control financial arrangements, including lease and management contracts, to ensure accurate reporting, payments, and accruals.

Qualifications

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate effective goals, targets and priorities with a long-term perspective
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Financial and operational analytical skills (operational analysis)
  • Knowledge of department and hotel operations
  • Ability to exercise judgment in evaluating situations and making informed decisions
  • Ability to analyze and interpret financial data
  • Leadership and organizational skills (team orientation, flexible, adaptable)
  • Ability to analyze large amounts of complex financial information from many sources and generate reports, as well as forecasts and forecasts
  • Proficiency in MS Office suite applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

Additional Preferences

  • University degree in accounting or finance / accounting certificate
  • Experience at the hotel level or in the industry
  • Preferred: 5 years of relevant and advanced experience in accounting or finance
  • Preferred: 2 years in a management position

What You Can Expect From Us

  • A position of responsibility with ample opportunities for growth
  • Performance-based compensation (base salary plus bonus)
  • All the benefits and career opportunities of an international hotel chain
  • Internal promotion opportunities and national and international career development
  • Access to Hilton Worldwide University with thousands of free learning opportunities
  • Accommodations at Hilton hotels worldwide (at employee rates)

What You Should Know

Every company has its own expectations for future employees—but as we all know, nobody is perfect. So please don’t let it discourage you if you don’t yet fully meet all the requirements. Feel free to apply anyway. What matters most to us is your personality—we can teach you any specific knowledge or skills you may still be lacking. Be creative with your application or take a “traditional” approach—either way, we look forward to hearing from you.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.
