Senior Software Development Engineer (Content)

Introduction to the team

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

Within Expedia Product & Technology, our Content organization enables Expedia Group to acquire, enrich and distribute hundreds of millions of assets (images, texts, attributes, videos, etc.) used across our various brands and lines of businesses. While planning your next trip on Expedia Group websites or mobile applications, every step of your experience was enhanced by our Content!

Our team is dedicated to delivering highly scalable software solutions in an agile development environment, using state-of-the-art technologies. Our culture provides a safe environment to spark creativity and encourage continuous learning and growth. Much of our development is on back-end services. We work in a DevOps model where developers are involved in all aspects of software development from design to test, implementation, deployment, monitoring and support.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and evolve complex services, APIs, and data models that power Expedia Group’s content and product catalog experiences, ensuring high availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Lead system design and low-level design (LLD) efforts for content and catalog services, including API design, contracts, and data modeling that enable scalable and reusable solutions across multiple domains.
  • Drive end‑to‑end delivery for multi‑service features, from technical discovery and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support, raising the engineering bar for the team.
  • Collaborate closely with product, architecture, and partner engineering teams to define technical requirements and deliver content capabilities that are reusable across lines of business and markets.
  • Champion engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, observability, operational readiness, and incident response for content systems, while mentoring other engineers in best practices.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled and AI‑assisted solutions into content workflows and services, applying AI/ML concepts to real‑world products and improving content quality, coverage, and developer productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Several years of professional software development experience owning one or more backend or full‑stack services in a production environment, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing service‑oriented or microservice architectures for complex content or catalog‑like domains, including API design, data modeling, and low‑level/system design.
  • Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (Kotlin or Java preferred) and associated frameworks, plus strong skills working with relational or NoSQL databases (Redis/Valkey, Cassandra and ScyllaDB preferred), including schema design and data access patterns for content systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and operating large‑scale, high‑throughput content, catalog, or similar distributed systems with strong focus on performance, availability, resiliency, and cost efficiency.
  • Demonstrated leadership in driving architecture and technical direction across multiple services or a domain, including evolving APIs, contracts, data models, and integration patterns in partnership with architecture and product.
  • Strong track record of improving engineering efficiency and reliability through automation, CI/CD optimization, test strategy, observability, and operational excellence for mission‑critical services.
  • Familiarity with AI‑driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating AI/ML‑enabled solutions into existing content services and pipelines.
  • Experience applying AI or ML techniques to content‑centric or data‑rich systems (for example, classification, enrichment, deduplication, or recommendation) to enhance content quality, coverage, and developer effectiveness.
  • Experience leveraging translation, localization and internationalization tools and technologies

Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events. Education And Experience

OR

Managing Event Logistics and Operations

  • Delivers excellent customer service throughout the customer experience and encourages the same from other employees.

  • Sets a positive example for guest relations.

  • Conducts formal pre- and post-event meetings as required to review/communicate group needs and feedback.

  • Facilitates various meetings as he/she perceives necessary (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, etc).

  • Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.
  • Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.

Lead global photo, video and content production across IHG Hotels & Resorts, turning marketing and brand briefs into high-quality, channel-ready assets. This role manages projects from brief to delivery, balancing creative brand strategy, commercial discipline, brand governance and stakeholder alignment across global and regional teams.

Your day to day

  • Lead end-to-end global photo, video, social-first and campaign content production, from brief through final delivery.
  • Translate marketing and brand objectives into clear production briefs, deliverables, timelines, budgets, usage requirements and success measures.
  • Partner with brand, marketing, media, social, localization, legal, procurement and agency teams to keep work strategically aligned and on brand.
  • Recommend the right production model for each brief, balancing generative ai, quality, speed, cost, risk, brand fit and channel performance.
  • Manage partner briefing, estimates, scopes, schedules, supplier delivery, budgets and cost trade-offs with commercial discipline.
  • Guide stakeholders through key milestones, decision points, feedback and approvals, providing clear recommendations throughout delivery.
  • Shape shot lists, visual references, scripts, storyboards, capture plans and edits so outputs are distinctive, brand-right and commercially effective.
  • Partner with brand, marketing, media, social, localization, legal, procurement and agency teams to keep work strategically aligned and activation ready.
  • Partner on talent releases, image rights, usage terms, AI riders and renewals, while supporting scalable AI-forward production workflows.
  • Establish repeatable workflows, templates, checklists and standards that improve quality, speed, consistency and cost discipline.

What we need from you

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent education and professional experience.
  • Significant experience in creative production, content strategy, brand marketing and multi-channel campaign delivery, ideally within a global brand, in-house studio, agency or consumer-facing business.
  • Strong understanding of production budgets, scopes, schedules, talent usage, licensing, rights management, supplier briefing, vendor negotiations and financial reconciliation.
  • Confident reviewing campaign briefs, shot lists, concepts, edits and final assets to ensure work is on brief, on brand, channel-ready and commercially useful.
  • Strong stakeholder and project management skills, with the ability to prioritise, consolidate feedback, influence partners and manage multiple workstreams with confidence.
  • Good knowledge of integrated marketing channels and asset requirements across digital, social, paid media, CRM, web, PR, experiential and partner marketing.
  • Comfort with emerging production models and technologies, including AI-enabled content creation, image generation, content adaptation, modular video, automation and scalable workflows, with an understanding of associated brand, legal and usage considerations.
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, PowerPoint, Excel, Smartsheet or equivalent workflow tools; experience with DAM platforms, Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Smint, Censhare, production budgeting tools or project management systems is a plus.

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in the Atlanta office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

The salary range for this role is $90k to $105k. This role is also eligible for bonus pay. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the team

Expedia Group Advertising builds the platforms and experiences that connect advertisers with millions of travelers across the globe. Our mission is to help partners reach the right traveler with the right message at the right time through intuitive advertiser experiences, high-performance ad delivery systems, and intelligent, AI-powered optimization. We are growing our Advertiser Experience engineering team and are looking for a talented, product-minded Software Development Engineer III who is excited to build thoughtful advertiser-facing experiences and the backend services that power them. You will help shape the next generation of our advertising marketplace, working at the intersection of user experience, scalable distributed systems, and generative AI.

In This Role, You Will

  • Implement backend APIs and services that power high-quality UI experiences and deliver trust, transparency, and performance to our partners
  • Build and optimize services that support campaign management and optimization across Expedia Group’s advertising network
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and latency of mission-critical systems
  • Use LLMs and generative AI to simplify advertiser workflows, improve campaign setup, and automate repetitive tasks
  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate personalized recommendations, smart defaults, and AI-assisted decision support
  • Partner with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and other engineering teams to deliver measurable advertiser value
  • Leverage AI-enabled solutions and AI-assisted development tools to improve developer productivity and product outcomes
  • Advocate for high-quality code, automated testing, and strong observability practices
  • Participate in operational reviews and drive continuous improvement
  • Mentor junior engineers and help elevate the technical bar of the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years for Bachelor's degree or 3+ years for Master's in a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development, working with cloud-based and distributed systems at scale
  • Proficiency in Java/J2EE, C#, or similar object-oriented languages, with hands-on experience integrating services with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure/test automation, and delivering features in Agile development environments
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying scalable services in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to advertising technologies (ad serving, campaign management, RTB, auctions)
  • Experience with event streaming or messaging systems (e.g., Flink, Kafka, or similar real-time data processing technologies)
  • Experience working with data-driven systems, ML-powered features, or experimentation platforms
  • Experience contributing to architecture and design discussions for services, APIs, and data models
  • Demonstrated ability to improve service quality through performance tuning, observability, and automation
  • Experience using metrics and data to inform engineering decisions and measure impact
  • Experience applying generative AI to product experiences and internal tools
  • Experience contributing to multiple multi-quarter, cross-team projects
  • A Master's degree in a related technical field

Please note that this role is only available in Chicago, IL or Seattle, WA, in alignment with our flexible work model, which requires employees to be in the office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

Summary

Marriott International is seeking a visionary and strategic Senior Director, Global Select + Midscale Brands to shape the future of assigned brands within a rapidly evolving portfolio. This leader translates global category vision into actionable strategies and long-term brand plans, guiding multi-year priorities and making enterprise-level decisions that balance brand ambition, commercial performance, and market realities. By partnering closely with continent and discipline teams, the Senior Director fosters innovation, elevates guest experiences, and ensures brand relevance and measurable business impact across markets.

The Senior Director will have direct responsibility for multiple brands and work closely with continents to monitor and develop strategies and tactics to improve Brand Health metrics, including customer satisfaction, unit growth, and competitive positioning. The role will lead multi-disciplinary projects to deliver complex key brand initiatives, including launching new brands, repositioning brands, and driving transformational change across the brand lifecycle.

As a connector and brand steward, this role balances enterprise objectives with market dynamics, exercises sound judgment in ambiguous, matrixed environments, champions operational excellence, and inspires teams to deliver differentiated results. The ideal candidate is a results-driven, commercially minded brand strategist with exceptional leadership skills, a passion for guest experience, and the ability to influence without authority, align senior stakeholders, and drive sustained performance in service of Marriott’s growth ambitions.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • 4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, or related major
  • 10+ years of relevant brand management professional experience demonstrating career growth and exceptional performance
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic brand plans and multi-year business strategies with clear performance outcomes
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing complex, multi-brand initiatives in highly matrixed, global environments
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging consumer insights and market data to inform strategy and prioritize initiatives based on business impact

Preferred

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree
  • Experience collaborating with continent / business teams to drive initiatives and align competing priorities
  • Track record of delivering results in complex, ambiguous environments requiring strong judgment, decisiveness, and influence
  • Demonstrated commercial and financial acumen, including evaluating trade-offs between brand value, owner economics, and enterprise ROI

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Brand Strategy, Architecture & Stewardship

  • Defines and maintains brand positioning for assigned brands; ensures clarity and alignment with global strategy while enabling appropriate local flexibility within established guardrails.
  • Develops compelling, differentiated brand strategies informed by consumer, competitive, and stakeholder needs and grounded in commercial and operational realities.
  • Supports creation of strategic brand business plans, including economic strategy, product/service models, brand positioning, and value proposition.
  • Defines and manages brand initiatives and projects through execution across continents, ensuring strategic pull-through and accountability for outcomes.

Brand Health, Advocacy & Growth

  • Defines brand performance metrics and recommends performance targets aligned to both brand health and business growth objectives.
  • Monitors performance for assigned brands and identifies optimization opportunities, making data-driven recommendations to course-correct as needed.
  • Serves as brand advocate, educating stakeholders on brand strategy, positioning, and strategic pillars to build shared understanding and commitment.
  • Represents the brand in external forums, reviewing and evolving standards and operational practices with credibility among owners, partners, and industry stakeholders.

Innovation, New Product Integration

  • Leads new product creation / integration for the Select category from concept through sustained market performance.
  • Plays point across product and customer teams to ensure new brands are positioned, launched, and sustained effectively, making prioritization decisions to maximize long-term brand and business value.

Leadership, Continent Empowerment & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Serves as the primary liaison between global leadership and continent teams, supporting communication strategies and integration plans, escalating challenges and sharing best practices while driving clarity, alignment, and decision velocity.
  • Collaborates with cross-discipline teams—including design, standards, end-to-end experience design, marketing, and global operations—to shape and implement brand initiatives through influence, executive presence, and strong storytelling.

Insights-Driven Product Innovation & Operational Feasibility

  • Leverages consumer insights, market trends, and data analytics to identify opportunities for innovative products and experiences that differentiate the brand and drive guest engagement.
  • Leads brand-specific innovation projects, supports integration within global guardrails and ensures solutions are scalable across regions.
  • Partners with cross-discipline teams to ensure new products and initiatives are operationally feasible, scalable, and aligned with brand strategy from concept through implementation balancing speed, quality, and cost considerations.

Leadership Development, Culture & Team Excellence

  • Translates global vision into actionable team strategies, ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities and clear ownership of results.
  • Inspires and leads high-performing teams, fostering innovation and excellence while developing future brand leaders and building a strong talent pipeline.
  • Drives a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and learning across the team.

Key Accountabilities

  • Support technology cost transparency project by maintaining the cost model and reports within IT costing tool.

  • Assist other Business Support and Finance staff with monthly capital reporting and analysis including testing of process controls..

  • Work with Business Support and Finance staff in the preparation and coordination of the allocation process.
  • Serve as the primary contact for Finance and the secondary contact for the cost center managers to ensure issues are researched and resolved in a timely manner
  • Develop reports to meet business needs. Ensure that work is being completed in an effective and efficient manner while still meeting the business needs.
  • Provide relevant and timely financial information and analysis to the group's management team in order to facilitate business decisions and special projects.
  • Respond to ad hoc requests, projects, and presentations.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education -

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field of work.

Experience -

At least 3 years progressive work-related experience in areas of financial and/or business analysis, with demonstrated technical proficiency related to the position.

Technical skills and Knowledge -

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

The Software Development Engineer III position is part of the Consumer Payments team within Expedia Global Payments, under the Travel foundations org. This team builds and maintains critical systems that power backend APIs for consumer and B2B payment processing, administrative tools for payment configuration, and support for a variety of payment methods across the platform.

Our services are designed with security, scalability, and availability in mind, supporting credit card processing and payment routing at global scale. As an engineer on this team, you'll apply your passion for backend development, cloud computing, and modern engineering practices to solve real-world challenges that impact millions of travelers and partners worldwide. We are looking for an engineer who demonstrates strong ownership, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in building reliable systems that perform well in production.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend payment services that support Expedia’s global travel platform
  • Apply software design principles, data structures and/or design patterns and computer science fundamentals to write code that is clean, maintainable, optimized, modular with good naming conventions
  • Implement secure data handling practices to protect payment information and meet compliance standards
  • Recommend and apply architectural patterns or GenAI capabilities to improve system design and innovation
  • Enhance service reliability through observability, automation, and continuous operational improvements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact features aligned with Expedia’s strategic goals

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or Master's in a related technical field, or equivalent related professional experience
  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development, working with cloud-based and distributed systems at scale
  • Proficiency in Java or Kotlin, with hands-on experience integrating services with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure/test automation, and delivering features in Agile development environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on payment platforms or implementing backend services leveraging GenAI technologies
  • Experience contributing to multiple multi-quarter, cross-team projects
  • Experience supporting complex distributed systems in production through monitoring, debugging, incident resolution, and root-cause analysis
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying scalable services on AWS
  • A Master's degree in a related technical field

Please note that this role is only available in Austin, TX, in alignment with our flexible work model, which requires employees to be in the office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

The total cash range for this position in Austin is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. job.job_description:
Complex Director of Revenue

Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada & InterContinental Grenada Resort

Are you ready to shape the revenue strategy for two of the Caribbean's most exciting luxury hospitality destinations?

IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Complex Director of Revenue to lead revenue strategy, distribution, forecasting, and reservations for Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada and the pre-opening InterContinental Grenada Resort. This is a unique opportunity to drive commercial performance across a world-class luxury resort and a highly anticipated new hotel opening.

About The Opportunity

This role oversees revenue and reservations for both properties, ensuring a unified commercial strategy while pricing the Six Senses repositioning onto a wellness-inclusive model in which added value is absorbed into rate, holding the Six Senses to InterContinental rate differential by design, and delivering the successful opening of InterContinental Grenada. Complex Director of Revenue serves as a key commercial leader, partnering closely with the Area General Manager, ownership, and regional stakeholders to optimize performance and deliver long-term growth. The role reports directly to the Area General Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

Revenue Strategy & Pricing

  • Develop and execute revenue and pricing strategies for both properties.
  • Ensure clear market positioning and rate integrity across all demand periods.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and demand patterns to drive revenue opportunities.

Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Lead weekly and monthly forecasting processes.
  • Develop annual budgets and strategic revenue plans.
  • Provide performance analysis and recommendations to senior leadership.

Inventory Management

  • Manage room inventory, restrictions, minimum stay controls, overbooking, and group allocation strategies.
  • Maintain pricing and inventory accuracy across all distribution channels.

Distribution & Commercial Systems

  • Oversee distribution strategy across brand.com, GDS, OTA, wholesale, and trade channels.
  • Support system configuration, optimization, and testing, including pre-opening activities for InterContinental Grenada.
  • Utilize revenue management systems and business intelligence tools to drive informed decision-making.

Reservations Leadership

  • Provide leadership and oversight for the cluster reservations function.
  • Drive conversion performance, training, service standards, and operational excellence.
  • Ensure alignment between revenue strategy and inventory management.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Lead weekly commercial strategy discussions.
  • Present performance updates, forecasts, and recommendations to ownership and IHG leadership.
  • Develop strong partnerships across hotel operations, sales, marketing, and finance teams. Operate within a documented commercial governance framework: revenue recommends, the Area General Manager authorizes, with one documented strategy per property by demand period.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in hotel revenue management within ultra-luxury or luxury resort environments.
  • Must have Caribbean / Eastern Caribbean market experience. Proven revenue leadership in the Caribbean, ideally the Eastern Caribbean luxury tier (Anguilla, St Barths, St Lucia, St Kitts, Grenada).
  • Experience with US, UK, and European source markets, tour-operator and wholesale channels, long-haul airlift and extended booking windows, a Carnival-and-festive calendar, and compsets of independent ultra-luxury resorts.
  • Experience managing complex forecasting, pricing, and distribution strategies.
  • Multi-property and/or pre-opening revenue accountability held directly, including rate architecture build, systems loading and testing, and benchmark anchoring.
  • Fluency in revenue and benchmarking systems, including IHG Concerto, Lighthouse, STR and Demand360.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while balancing multiple priorities.

Ready to Shape the Future of Revenue Leadership?

IHG is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all—because hospitality begins with humanity.

Apply now and be part of the story that defines global luxury.

The salary range for this position is $150,000.00 - $170,000.00. This role is also eligible for bonus pay. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

Location – Remote: This role offers remote flexibility, with candidates ideally based in the Caribbean or within the U.S. Eastern time zone and near a major airport. Regular travel to Grenada will be required, including consistent on-property presence and extended time on-site during the opening period.

About Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada

Surrounded by nature, there are 56 pool suites. Combining eco-credentials and comfort, the design uses natural, renewable, and repurposed materials. The organic and contemporary interiors feature an open-plan bedroom, while the outdoor terrace leads to a private plunge pool for a cooling dip. In addition, there are 15 villas enjoying a prime hillside or oceanfront setting, ranging between one, two, and four bedrooms. The five four-bedroom villas located on the Bluff offer a 270-degree view of one of the most coveted locations in the Caribbean. It has never been more important to be mentally, physically, and spiritually happy. This has been considered in every aspect of the design, with ample light, fresh air, and space.

About InterContinental Grenada - La Sagesse

Opening in November 2026, this stunning resort will offer 120 thoughtfully designed guest rooms and suites, complemented by a collection of exceptional restaurants and bars, a world-class spa, state-of-the-art fitness center, and a striking pool and Beach Club. With panoramic views overlooking La Sagesse Bay, this resort will offer expansive indoor and outdoor meeting and event space, seamlessly combining sophisticated luxury with the island’s stunning natural beauty.

Please include a portfolio link in your application

About The Team

Expedia Group’s Creative Tech Team sits at the intersection of design, marketing, storytelling, automation, and engineering. We are building the next generation of AI-powered creative systems that help our brands show up in ways that are smarter, more personal, more dynamic, and distinctive for travelers around the world.

Working across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo, the team turns creative ambitions into scalable realities - connecting brand expression with intelligent templates, structured design systems, automation, and emerging generative capabilities.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Assembly Designer who thrives at the intersection of design, automation, and technology. In this highly hands-on role, you will oversee and execute highly crafted brand creative through scalable production systems, helping transform a single creative idea into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, languages, and formats.

You will operate at the assembly layer between creative vision and automated production. Working alongside brand designers, creative technologists, software engineers, machine learning teams, copywriters, and marketing partners, you’ll translate creative intent into intelligent templates, modular systems, and production-ready workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the precision of production design as much as the craft of visual design - someone who can protect brand quality while increasing speed, experimentation, and creative scale.

In this role, you will

Build and execute creative assembly systems

  • Execute automated assembly systems that produce high-quality brand creative at scale.
  • Transform layered design files and campaign concepts into reusable, production-ready templates.
  • Develop dynamic layouts capable of generating large volumes of high-quality variations.
  • Assemble creative across multiple brands, channels, markets, languages, placements, and screen sizes.
  • Translate briefs and business objectives into channel-native creative for programmatic display, paid and organic social, paid app, app store, and other digital touchpoints.
  • Balance quality, scale, brand expression, and performance requirements across every output.
  • Partner with design teams to evolve one-off assets into durable creative systems.
  • Balance flexibility, creative expression, and production reliability across every output.

Design AI-native templates and systems

  • Test, prototype, and execute modular template systems using agentic AI tools and node-based workflows.
  • Build reusable components optimized for automation, localization, personalization, and rapid iteration.
  • Structure files and design systems to support dynamic content, localized copy, asset swapping, and AI-generated imagery or motion.
  • Explore generative brand components, adaptive layouts, and new ways for identity, motion, and storytelling to respond to context.
  • Help move promising experiments from prototype to repeatable, documented systems that global teams can adopt.

Automate creative production workflows

  • Contribute to and maintain creative assembly workflows using scripting, plugins, APIs, n8n, and other automation tools.
  • Automate repetitive production, versioning, validation, and export tasks across the creative pipeline.
  • Connect creative assets with structured data, content sources, DAMs, APIs, and AI workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers to translate creative requirements into clear technical specifications and production integrations.
  • Improve workflow speed, reliability, and observability while maintaining a high bar for craft.
  • Build systems that support always-on content, rapid-turn production, creative versioning, and high-volume campaign needs.
  • Partner with Growth and campaign teams to support test-and-learn programs, creative optimization, and iterative performance improvement.

Own quality assurance and delivery readiness

  • Create and perform independent quality assurance checks before assets are released.
  • Design automated validations for text overflow, image placement, safe areas, layout integrity, localization, accessibility, and brand compliance.
  • Identify and resolve graphics, copy, data, and template issues proactively.
  • Establish repeatable review and approval workflows that support Brand Studio and marketing partners.
  • Own final delivery readiness, ensuring exports are accurate, complete, on-brand, and fit for channel requirements.
  • Continuously improve template performance, output quality, and the reliability of the overall production system.
  • Validate responsive, mobile-first, and platform-specific behavior across formats, placements, and device experiences.
  • Use data, insights, and performance learnings to inform design decisions and improve the effectiveness of creative systems.

Collaborate, enable, and raise the bar

  • Partner closely with brand designers, copywriters, marketers, creative technologists, engineers, product teams, and machine learning specialists.
  • Act as a bridge between creative, marketing, and technical disciplines, making complex systems practical and approachable.
  • Lead or support workshops, demos, documentation, playbooks, and hands-on enablement for creative and marketing teams.
  • Share best practices across design and engineering communities and help define standards for creative automation.
  • Evaluate emerging models, tools, standards, and responsible-use practices, bringing relevant new thinking into production.
  • Clearly communicate the value, limitations, and opportunities of AI-powered creative workflows to partners and leadership.
  • Present work, system proposals, and creative recommendations clearly to senior creative leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Help mentor peers and share practical guidance on motion systems, production craft, and emerging creative technologies.

What You Bring

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience across digital design, production design, creative technology, design systems, or related disciplines, including at least 2 years working in template-based or automated production workflows.
  • Exceptional visual design craft and attention to detail, with the ability to protect brand quality at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with After Effects and n8n or comparable workflow-automation tools.
  • Advanced experience with Figma, Weavy, and other node-based creative workflows.
  • Experience creating scalable template systems, modular components, and dynamic layouts.
  • Strong understanding of design systems, production operations, asset structures, and multi-channel delivery.
  • Experience translating creative concepts into clear production logic, technical requirements, and repeatable workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Computer Science, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of digital channel and platform best practices, with experience designing for responsive and mobile-first environments.
  • Ability to work fluidly in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while managing priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating APIs, structured data, DAMs, or content systems into creative workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools, diffusion models, LLMs, prompting for production use, or AI-assisted asset generation.
  • Familiarity with tools and workflows such as Runway, ComfyUI, TensorFlow Magenta, GPT-based systems, StyleGAN, or comparable technologies.
  • Fluency across 2D, motion, and/or 3D workflows, with experience scaling assets across campaigns and product surfaces.
  • Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or related real-time and 3D tools.
  • Knowledge of DesignOps, creative operations, digital asset management, or marketing technology.
  • Experience supporting global brands and localization workflows across languages, markets, and channels.
  • Familiarity with machine learning-enabled production and responsible AI practices.
  • Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Google Web Designer, Animate, or comparable code-based creative production tools.
  • Experience working with external agencies, production partners, or distributed creative teams.
  • Experience defining or evolving brand guidelines, motion systems, design toolkits, or production standards.

Why this role matters

Creative production is evolving from manually creating individual assets to designing intelligent systems that produce them. As a Creative Assembly Designer, you’ll help build and operate the infrastructure that transforms creative concepts into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, and languages.

By bridging design, automation, marketing, and engineering, you’ll help shape the future of AI-powered creative production - enabling faster workflows, greater creative diversity, and scalable content that helps millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands in more relevant and distinctive ways.

Application

Please include a portfolio link in your application. We’re looking for a compelling showcase of your work in creative technology, systems design, automated production, motion, and/or AI implementation. Please highlight examples that show how you move from creative concept to scalable, production-ready execution.

Expedia Group Advertising builds the platforms and experiences that connect advertisers with millions of travelers across the globe. Our mission is to help partners reach the right traveler with the right message at the right time through intuitive advertiser experiences, high-performance ad delivery systems, and intelligent, AI-powered optimization. We are growing our Advertiser Experience engineering team and are looking for a talented, product-minded Software Development Engineer III who is excited to build thoughtful advertiser-facing experiences and the backend services that power them. You will help shape the next generation of our advertising marketplace, working at the intersection of user experience, scalable distributed systems, and generative AI.

  • Build and optimize services that support campaign management and optimization across Expedia Group’s advertising network
  • Improve reliability, scalability, and latency of mission-critical systems
  • Use LLMs and generative AI to simplify advertiser workflows, improve campaign setup, and automate repetitive tasks
  • Work with data scientists and ML engineers to integrate personalized recommendations, smart defaults, and AI-assisted decision support
  • Partner with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and other engineering teams to deliver measurable advertiser value
  • Leverage AI-enabled solutions and AI-assisted development tools to improve developer productivity and product outcomes
  • Advocate for high-quality code, automated testing, and strong observability practices
  • Participate in operational reviews and drive continuous improvement
  • Mentor junior engineers and help elevate the technical bar of the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years for Bachelor's degree or 3+ years for Master's in a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development, working with cloud-based and distributed systems at scale
  • Proficiency in Java/J2EE, C#, or similar object-oriented languages, with hands-on experience integrating services with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure/test automation, and delivering features in Agile development environments
  • Demonstrated experience designing and deploying scalable services in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to advertising technologies (ad serving, campaign management, RTB, auctions)
  • Experience with event streaming or messaging systems (e.g., Flink, Kafka, or similar real-time data processing technologies)
  • Experience working with data-driven systems, ML-powered features, or experimentation platforms
  • Experience contributing to architecture and design discussions for services, APIs, and data models
  • Demonstrated ability to improve service quality through performance tuning, observability, and automation
  • Experience using metrics and data to inform engineering decisions and measure impact
  • Experience applying generative AI to product experiences and internal tools
  • Experience contributing to multiple multi-quarter, cross-team projects
  • A Master's degree in a related technical field

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Please include a portfolio link in your application

About The Team

Expedia Group’s Creative Tech Team sits at the intersection of design, marketing, storytelling, automation, and engineering. We are building the next generation of AI-powered creative systems that help our brands show up in ways that are smarter, more personal, more dynamic, and distinctive for travelers around the world.

Working across Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo, the team turns creative ambitions into scalable realities - connecting brand expression with intelligent templates, structured design systems, automation, and emerging generative capabilities.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Assembly Designer who thrives at the intersection of design, automation, and technology. In this highly hands-on role, you will oversee and execute highly crafted brand creative through scalable production systems, helping transform a single creative idea into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, languages, and formats.

You will operate at the assembly layer between creative vision and automated production. Working alongside brand designers, creative technologists, software engineers, machine learning teams, copywriters, and marketing partners, you’ll translate creative intent into intelligent templates, modular systems, and production-ready workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the precision of production design as much as the craft of visual design - someone who can protect brand quality while increasing speed, experimentation, and creative scale.

In this role, you will

Build and execute creative assembly systems

  • Execute automated assembly systems that produce high-quality brand creative at scale.
  • Transform layered design files and campaign concepts into reusable, production-ready templates.
  • Develop dynamic layouts capable of generating large volumes of high-quality variations.
  • Assemble creative across multiple brands, channels, markets, languages, placements, and screen sizes.
  • Translate briefs and business objectives into channel-native creative for programmatic display, paid and organic social, paid app, app store, and other digital touchpoints.
  • Balance quality, scale, brand expression, and performance requirements across every output.
  • Partner with design teams to evolve one-off assets into durable creative systems.
  • Balance flexibility, creative expression, and production reliability across every output.

Design AI-native templates and systems

  • Test, prototype, and execute modular template systems using agentic AI tools and node-based workflows.
  • Build reusable components optimized for automation, localization, personalization, and rapid iteration.
  • Structure files and design systems to support dynamic content, localized copy, asset swapping, and AI-generated imagery or motion.
  • Explore generative brand components, adaptive layouts, and new ways for identity, motion, and storytelling to respond to context.
  • Help move promising experiments from prototype to repeatable, documented systems that global teams can adopt.

Automate creative production workflows

  • Contribute to and maintain creative assembly workflows using scripting, plugins, APIs, n8n, and other automation tools.
  • Automate repetitive production, versioning, validation, and export tasks across the creative pipeline.
  • Connect creative assets with structured data, content sources, DAMs, APIs, and AI workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers to translate creative requirements into clear technical specifications and production integrations.
  • Improve workflow speed, reliability, and observability while maintaining a high bar for craft.
  • Build systems that support always-on content, rapid-turn production, creative versioning, and high-volume campaign needs.
  • Partner with Growth and campaign teams to support test-and-learn programs, creative optimization, and iterative performance improvement.

Own quality assurance and delivery readiness

  • Create and perform independent quality assurance checks before assets are released.
  • Design automated validations for text overflow, image placement, safe areas, layout integrity, localization, accessibility, and brand compliance.
  • Identify and resolve graphics, copy, data, and template issues proactively.
  • Establish repeatable review and approval workflows that support Brand Studio and marketing partners.
  • Own final delivery readiness, ensuring exports are accurate, complete, on-brand, and fit for channel requirements.
  • Continuously improve template performance, output quality, and the reliability of the overall production system.
  • Validate responsive, mobile-first, and platform-specific behavior across formats, placements, and device experiences.
  • Use data, insights, and performance learnings to inform design decisions and improve the effectiveness of creative systems.

Collaborate, enable, and raise the bar

  • Partner closely with brand designers, copywriters, marketers, creative technologists, engineers, product teams, and machine learning specialists.
  • Act as a bridge between creative, marketing, and technical disciplines, making complex systems practical and approachable.
  • Lead or support workshops, demos, documentation, playbooks, and hands-on enablement for creative and marketing teams.
  • Share best practices across design and engineering communities and help define standards for creative automation.
  • Evaluate emerging models, tools, standards, and responsible-use practices, bringing relevant new thinking into production.
  • Clearly communicate the value, limitations, and opportunities of AI-powered creative workflows to partners and leadership.
  • Present work, system proposals, and creative recommendations clearly to senior creative leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Help mentor peers and share practical guidance on motion systems, production craft, and emerging creative technologies.

What You Bring

Required qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience across digital design, production design, creative technology, design systems, or related disciplines, including at least 2 years working in template-based or automated production workflows.
  • Exceptional visual design craft and attention to detail, with the ability to protect brand quality at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with After Effects and n8n or comparable workflow-automation tools.
  • Advanced experience with Figma, Weavy, and other node-based creative workflows.
  • Experience creating scalable template systems, modular components, and dynamic layouts.
  • Strong understanding of design systems, production operations, asset structures, and multi-channel delivery.
  • Experience translating creative concepts into clear production logic, technical requirements, and repeatable workflows.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Computer Science, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of digital channel and platform best practices, with experience designing for responsive and mobile-first environments.
  • Ability to work fluidly in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while managing priorities and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating APIs, structured data, DAMs, or content systems into creative workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools, diffusion models, LLMs, prompting for production use, or AI-assisted asset generation.
  • Familiarity with tools and workflows such as Runway, ComfyUI, TensorFlow Magenta, GPT-based systems, StyleGAN, or comparable technologies.
  • Fluency across 2D, motion, and/or 3D workflows, with experience scaling assets across campaigns and product surfaces.
  • Experience with Unity, Unreal Engine, Cinema 4D, or related real-time and 3D tools.
  • Knowledge of DesignOps, creative operations, digital asset management, or marketing technology.
  • Experience supporting global brands and localization workflows across languages, markets, and channels.
  • Familiarity with machine learning-enabled production and responsible AI practices.
  • Working knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Google Web Designer, Animate, or comparable code-based creative production tools.
  • Experience working with external agencies, production partners, or distributed creative teams.
  • Experience defining or evolving brand guidelines, motion systems, design toolkits, or production standards.

Why this role matters

Creative production is evolving from manually creating individual assets to designing intelligent systems that produce them. As a Creative Assembly Designer, you’ll help build and operate the infrastructure that transforms creative concepts into thousands of high-quality, brand-safe assets across channels, markets, and languages.

By bridging design, automation, marketing, and engineering, you’ll help shape the future of AI-powered creative production - enabling faster workflows, greater creative diversity, and scalable content that helps millions of travelers experience Expedia Group brands in more relevant and distinctive ways.

Application

Please include a portfolio link in your application. We’re looking for a compelling showcase of your work in creative technology, systems design, automated production, motion, and/or AI implementation. Please highlight examples that show how you move from creative concept to scalable, production-ready execution.

The total cash range for this position in Beverly Hills is $110,500.00 to $155,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $177,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $110,500.00 to $155,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $177,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. job.job_description:
Role Purpose

Participate in feasibility and investment analysis for real estate development projects. With direction from project manager or director, conduct financial modeling, market research, and analysis of comparable asset performance. Coordinate with corporate Operations, Technical Services, Brand Management, Tax, Legal, and Finance Departments to ensure all issues relevant to development projects are properly identified, analyzed, and documented in the Company’s capital papers.

Key Accountabilities

  • Financial Modeling/Investment Analysis - Participate in financial modeling to include NPV, IRR, and earnings impact, by using proforma developed for Subject, proposed deal terms provided by VP of Development, and input as appropriate from Technical Services, Tax, and Financial Reporting teams. Review findings with Director or project manager to determine financial viability of project, and assist in developing proposed enhancements/modifications to deal terms to make each project meet the Company’s returns requirements. Revise modeling/analysis/proposal, as necessary, throughout negotiations of deal terms.
  • Market Feasibility Analysis – Participate in determining competitive set for hotel being analyzed (“Subject”) by reviewing existing supply in market place and identifying competitive assets. Obtain historical occupancy and ADR performance for the competitive set from Smith Travel Research and counterparts at other lodging companies. Determine positioning of the Subject within competitive set, review historical supply and demand growth patterns for the competitive set, and identify any known additions to supply in the market. Project occupancy and ADR for the Subject and determine viability of the Subject within the market. Review analysis and findings with VP of Operations and VP of Development to obtain consensus on market feasibility. Projects include small or relatively simple competitive sets.
  • Writing Capital Approval Papers – If the Company decides to pursue the project, participate in writing portions of the necessary approval papers for the Americas Operating Committee and the Executive Committee as directed (approval papers have historically ranged from 5 – 50 pages depending upon the size of the Company’s investment, and include a description of the project, the dynamics of the competitive market, competitive properties, proposed positioning of the Subject, deal structure, S.W.O.T. analysis, and financial implications to the Company).
  • Developing Proforma Income Statements - Obtain historical P&L (profit and loss) statements for comparable assets from within the Company’s estate, or from outside consultants. Review performance of competitive assets and similarities/dissimilarities between competitive assets and the Subject. Utilize most comparable key performance metrics from P&L statements analyzed and occupancy/ADR projections developed during market feasibility analysis to develop proforma P&L for the Subject. Review findings and support with VP of Operations and VP of Business Development, and develop consensus on the Subject’s projected performance.
  • Market/Industry Research – Consult with industry contacts (e.g., consultants, real estate brokers, counterparts at other major lodging companies, etc.) and review industry publications/forecasts to remain knowledgeable of general market/industry trends and to facilitate market/industry research. Provide findings to project manager or director and internal clients to facilitate understanding of competitive fee structures for business segments (e.g., timeshare branding, etc.) which are new to the Company. In addition, provide a framework on the direction of industry trends and performance to assist in projecting hotel performance.
  • Ad Hoc Investment Analysis Projects – May assist the Director of Investment Analysis or project manager with review of financial analysis conducted within other areas of the Finance Department. Assistance may include providing guidance to Finance Department on financial modeling and the Company’s analysis policies or conducting financial analysis for non-hotel specific projects such as the Company’s franchise development plan.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education –

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Hotel Management, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

Experience

  • 1-3 years progressive work-related experience in financial analysis, forecasting, statistical analysis, data mining and interpretation, or similar, with demonstrated understanding of multiple disciplines/processes related to the position.

Technical skills and Knowledge –

  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors and/or staff. Must be able to work effectively with senior managers, possess strong relationship management skills, and well-developed negotiating and persuading abilities.
  • Demonstrated financial and business analysis skills, and demonstrated ability to analyze operating, forecast, and budget information. Demonstrated ability to use the results of analysis to make effective strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of financial statements, financial principles and the ability to convert them to use in the hotel industry.
  • Demonstrated PeopleSoft, Hyperion, or similar computer system experience preferred
  • Highly proactive and flexible competency levels with the ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks/projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of the relevant labor market, economic conditions, and industry trends. Demonstrated ability to analyze these factors and draw logical conclusions.
  • Demonstrated ability to use statistical mining software and related programs, as well as to generate documents or reports in EXCEL, Word and PowerPoint.

Please note that this is a hybrid position and requires going to the Guadalajara office 3-4 times per week.

  • Have extensive experience in bringing clarity, consistency, and usability to the Loyalty product experiences
  • Are dedicated to designing product experiences that are helpful and human
  • Know that the same content strategy and design skills are that help you leverage AI to create better content faster

In This Role, You Will

Exemplify sound practices in human-centered content strategy and design. You'll be a confident content practitioner who can lead by example and is well-versed at taking a cross-organizational, holistic approach to the user experience. While no two days are the same, you'll specifically be expected to :

  • Design thoughtful, intuitive, and accessible content solutions for a range of product use cases and interactions – from onboarding and in-app education to transactional flows and push notifications.
  • Apply solid information architecture methods (such as content modeling and mapping) and UI frameworks to design scalable content solutions.
  • Audit, analyze, structure, create, and present compelling UX content throughout the product experience.
  • Partner across product and research teams using human-centered design methods to drive content tests that measurably improve the traveler experience, and identify, log, prioritize, and resolve content bugs across the portfolio.
  • Apply a holistic, customer-focused approach to creating a cohesive content strategy for our loyalty programme across all product areas.
  • Use both qualitative and quantitative insights, along with business analytics, to drive content insights and solutions.
  • Partner across teams to improve the accessibility, inclusion, readability, and translatability of product content
  • Have strong facilitation and presentation skills to clearly and confidently communicate the rationale for decision-making to team members and stakeholders.
  • Influence, persuade, and negotiate with stakeholders to design the best experiences that meet the needs of travelers and businesses.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience in core skills such as UX Writing, content audits and analysis, content mapping and modeling, information architecture, content planning and sourcing, conversational design, and storytelling (this is not a content marketing role)
  • 5+ years of experience as a Content Designer, UX writer, or Content Strategist
  • Ability to audit, analyze, structure, create, and design content independently in compelling user-focused product experiences using established frameworks
  • Strong skills in confidently presenting compelling rationale and narratives behind content strategies and decisions to peers, partners, and key stakeholders - such as Legal, Marketing, Security, Product, and top leadership
  • Expertise in persuasion and negotiation with stakeholders to create optimal experiences that balance both traveler satisfaction and business objectives
  • Experience applying human-centered design (HCD) practices to product experiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience taking a thoughtful, empathetic, and inclusive approach to design that meets every user where they are
  • Experience in solving complicated content problems for multiple user segments and can develop content solutions across brands.
  • Maintain a portfolio of work that showcases your skills as a design thinker and honed UX writer. We are particularly interested in examples of how your influence enhances cross-functional thinking to drive retention in Loyalty and Membership areas.
  • Demonstrate a curiosity to explore and apply emerging AI technologies, including prompt engineering, structured content to enhance strategy and operational efficiency.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Job Title

Business Finance Analyst

Summary

Amadeus is looking for a Financial Reporting & Analysis Specialist to join our Finance organization and drive accurate, insightful reporting that supports business decision-making. In this role, you will prepare monthly financial results, lead analysis on key cost areas, support planning and forecasting processes, and act as a trusted business partner across Finance, Commercial and Hospitality stakeholders. You will also play a key role in Finance's digital transformation, developing automated dashboards and leveraging AI tools to modernize reporting. If you're analytical, proactive and excited about combining strong financial acumen with data analytics and automation, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and oversee accurate, timely reporting of monthly financial results, KPIs and legal entity information, ensuring consistency across all reporting tools and systems.
  • Lead analysis and communications on HOS-Advertising Fixed Costs, and support Gross Margin analysis, variance investigation and long-range planning exercises.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, delivering ad-hoc reports and translating complex financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Manage month-end closing activities and lead estimation processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Amadeus Group policies.
  • Develop and maintain automated dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, advanced Excel and AI tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot) to streamline financial analysis and forecasting.
  • Drive Finance transformation by identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate processes, and by sharing knowledge and best practices across the Finance community.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • Strong background in financial reporting, planning or business analysis, ideally within a multinational or matrixed organization.
  • Solid understanding of P&L, Gross Margin analysis, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
  • Proven experience developing dashboards and automated reporting using Power BI and advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot).
  • Comfortable working with AI-powered tools and exploring new technologies to improve financial processes.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to act as a trusted partner to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Proactive, curious and results-driven, with a genuine interest in continuous learning and process improvement.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

What We Can Offer You

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

Enterprise Mobility is excited to announce the opening of a Government and Public Affairs Manager on our Corporate Government and Public Affairs team in Canada!

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced, government affairs professional to manage our federal advocacy efforts in Canada while supporting select provinicial files. This in-house role is central to shaping public policy outcomes, strenghthening relationships with senior government stakeholders, and advancing the company’s priorities in mobility, transporation and technology policy.

Our ideal candidate is bilingual (English- French) and able to build effective relationships with government officials and external stakeholders. They possess exceptional communication skills and can clearly and persuasively convey complex policy issues to various audiences. Demonstrataing the highest levels of professionalism, integrity, and ethical standards, this individual thrives in collaborative environments while also working effectively and independently when needed. They bring excellent interpersonal, organizational and time management skills, along with the agility and sound judgment required to balance multiple requests and competing priorities. Additionally, they exhibit exceptional strategic judgment and political acumen, enabling them to navigate complex situations and advance organizational objectives effectively.

This position will work out of an office and can be located in Toronto, Ottawa or Montreal.

Travel within Canada, particularly between Ottawa, Toronto, Montreal, Quebec City and key provincial capitals will be required to meet with government officials, attend industry events and support corporate initiatives.

Enterprise offers an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, Retirement Savings Plan with company match& profit sharing, schedule flexibility, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.
