job.job_description:
Role Purpose

The Senior Manager, Strategy serves as a core member of the Office of the Americas CEO, owning and advancing key strategic workstreams that shape IHG's Americas region agenda.

This role works across all business functions (Commercial, Operations, Development, Marketing, Finance, HR, etc.) to translate complex business challenges into clear analytical frameworks, actionable recommendations, and executive-ready communications. It also works to drive recommendations forward to action and results.

The ideal candidate brings the structured problem-solving and synthesis skills developed in a top-tier consulting or in-house strategy environment, paired with a strong bias toward action and tangible outcomes.

This is a strategy role, but one that demands an operator's urgency.

Key Accountabilities

  • Own strategic workstreams end-to-end: Take full ownership of high-priority strategic initiatives from problem structuring through execution and measurement, operating independently across all Americas business functions and managing stakeholders at all levels.
  • Drive analysis to action: Lead rigorous, hypothesis-driven analyses on complex business questions, with an expectation that recommendations are not just well-supported but are advanced actively, with clear next steps, owners, and timelines.
  • Executive communication and storytelling: Develop materials for the Americas CEO and senior leadership, including board-level presentations, strategic briefings, and stakeholder communications, with a consistent emphasis on clarity and executive readiness.
  • Competitive and market intelligence: Track performance trends, competitive moves, and market dynamics across the Americas hotel landscape. Translate external signals into timely implications and recommended responses for IHG's strategy.
  • Cross-functional strategic coordination: Partner across all Americas functions to align priorities, remove obstacles, and maintain momentum on strategic initiatives. Serve as a connective layer between the CEO's office and the broader organization.
  • Strategic planning: Contribute to the Americas annual and long-range planning processes, including initiative prioritization and cross-functional alignment. Ensure the strategic agenda stays visible and progressing throughout the year.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education –

Bachelor’s / Master’s Degree (preferred) in Business, Strategy, Finance or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

Experience –

7~10 years progressive work experience in strategy, consultancy, finance, or corporate level experience with exposure to a broad range of strategy issues. Post-degree qualification and previous travel industry experience is highly desirable.

Skills and Knowledge –

Strategic Thinking and Analysis

  • Structures ambiguous problems using hypothesis-driven frameworks and translates findings into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Synthesizes large volumes of information across competitive, financial, and operational inputs into executive-ready insights
  • Develops and stress-tests business cases, scenario plans, and strategic options at the enterprise level
  • Tracks market and competitive dynamics and identifies their implications for business strategy

Communication and Influence

  • Communicates with clarity and confidence to audiences ranging from working teams to C-suite and board level
  • Designs and delivers executive presentations and strategic briefings that drive decision-making
  • Exceptional written communication skills, including experience drafting executive memos, strategic briefs, and leadership narratives
  • Influences outcomes and advances priorities without direct authority over delivering teams
  • Strong negotiation and conflict management skills across a matrixed, cross-functional environment

Execution and Drive

  • Moves initiatives from analysis to recommendation to action with urgency and accountability
  • Manages multiple workstreams simultaneously, maintaining momentum and stakeholder alignment

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Builds trusted relationships across all Americas business functions and at all organizational levels
  • Designs and facilitates working sessions and strategic workshops with diverse, cross-functional participants
  • Integrates perspectives from functional partners to strengthen strategic output and organizational buy-in

Technical Proficiency

  • Advanced research, data gathering, and synthesis techniques
  • Financial modeling and business case development
  • Expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including scenario analysis, and complex data manipulation
  • Expert proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to build executive-ready presentations that communicate strategy visually and concisely
  • Project planning, scoping, and control methods
  • Risk identification and scenario planning
  • Business analysis and process assessment
  • Familiarity with hotel industry performance metrics (RevPAR, ADR, NUG, pipeline) preferred

Travel - 10% limited as needed

Location – Atlanta, GA: Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office.  This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

The salary range for this role is $119,273 to $140,000. This role is also eligible for bonus pay.  We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Why Join Us?

To shape the future of travel, people must come first. Guided by our Values and Leadership Agreements, we foster an open culture where everyone belongs, differences are celebrated and know that when one of us wins, we all win.

We provide a full benefits package, including exciting travel perks, generous time-off, parental leave, a flexible work model (with some pretty cool offices), and career development resources, all to fuel our employees' passion for travel and ensure a rewarding career journey. We’re building a more open world. Join us.

Senior Market Manager

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their partners.

From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Make an Impact

As a Senior Market Manager, you will manage and develop a segment of the portfolio to deepen partner relationships and grow accounts through strategic planning. You will act as a trusted advisor, take ownership of partner challenges, and coordinate internal and external solutions that deliver strong business outcomes. You may also lead negotiations for smaller accounts and share best practices across teams and regions.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish and foster trusted relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across partner accounts.
  • Develop and manage dynamic local, regional, or chain-level account plans based on partner needs, industry trends, account value, and likelihood of success.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen and grow accounts, including cross-selling relevant products, services, and solutions.
  • Lead partner discussions, progress reviews, fact-finding meetings, and feedback sessions to understand needs and demonstrate the value of Expedia Group’s offerings.
  • Apply knowledge of the partner’s business, industry, market dynamics, competitors, financial drivers, and operational complexity to anticipate needs and influence decisions.
  • Identify business issues and potential solutions, assess costs, benefits, risks, and financial implications, and build a clear rationale for recommended action.
  • Explain standard contracts and terms, partner with legal resources on appropriate terms for simple contracts, and seek senior support when negotiating complex or short-term agreements.
  • Replace simple or short-term contracts with complex, multi-year agreements where appropriate for the account or region.
  • Travel to connect with partners face to face in assigned market (Bay Area)
  • Align products, technology, and offerings to partner and market needs while maintaining a thorough working knowledge of Expedia Group’s portfolio and competitors’ strengths and weaknesses.
  • Build productive relationships across the team, department, organization, and broader industry to support portfolio and organizational priorities.
  • Represent Expedia Group at relevant industry events, support market or territory planning, and build the company’s profile in the assigned market where needed.
  • Provide ongoing input to senior management on scalable solutions that improve process efficiency and partner outcomes.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree.
  • You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience.
  • You are proficient in English and, where applicable, the local language of the assigned market or markets.
  • You are an impactful communicator who can present compelling rationales, influence stakeholders, handle objections, and move negotiations toward favorable outcomes.
  • You apply effective sales techniques, including portfolio management, cross-selling, account planning, and strategic relationship development.
  • You have experience negotiating with director- and C-suite-level stakeholders and managing operational complexity.
  • You understand how to consider issues from another party’s perspective, identify common ground, and evaluate the costs and benefits of possible solutions.
  • You understand the financial impact of decisions and how your role contributes to positive outcomes.
  • You can build working knowledge of partner industries, market trends, economic challenges, competitive landscapes, products, technologies, and services.

The total cash range (inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target) for this position in San Francisco is $147,500.00 to $206,500.00. job.job_description:
職務内容（Responsibilities）

1. 日本市場における商業戦略の策定・実行

· Trip.com Group全体の成長戦略および日本市場特有の市場環境・商習慣を踏まえ、日本市場におけるパートナーシップの事業戦略を策定・実行する。

· 日本を代表する旅行プラットフォーム、アフィリエイトネットワーク、メディア企業、新興デジタルチャネルなどを含む、高い事業価値を持つビジネス機会を特定・優先順位付けし、獲得につなげる。

· グローバルのパートナーシップ戦略を、日本のビジネスパートナーやステークホルダーに響く、現地市場に適した戦略・施策へと落とし込む。

· 日本市場におけるパートナーシップチャネルの収益成長を牽引し、Trip.com Groupの地域全体の業績向上に大きく貢献する。


2. パートナーエコシステムの構築・拡大

· 主要な日本企業とのC-suiteおよび経営層レベルの関係を構築・維持する。対象には、大手旅行プラットフォーム、アフィリエイトネットワーク、メディア企業、航空会社、観光局などが含まれる。

· 日本特有の関係性を重視するビジネス文化を理解し、戦略的パートナーとの間で信頼・信用を構築するとともに、長期的なビジネス上の方向性を一致させる。

· コンテンツパートナーシップ、ロイヤリティプログラム、共同マーケティング、新たな流通・販売チャネルなど、日本市場に適した新しいパートナーシップモデルを特定・開発する。

· 日本市場における競合環境やパートナーエコシステムの変化を継続的に把握し、Trip.com Groupが競合他社との差別化を図り、魅力的なビジネス価値を提供できる状態を維持する。


3. チームのリーダーシップ・能力向上

· 日本のパートナーシップチームを支援・コーチング・育成し、戦略的思考力、ビジネス推進力、パートナーシップマネジメント能力を高める。

· 市場戦略・施策を継続的に検証・改善し、チームに対してパフォーマンス基準に基づく成果創出を求めるとともに、ビジネス上の意思決定の質を向上させる。

· メンタリング、ナレッジ共有、能力開発を通じて、パートナーシップ組織全体の成果創出力を高めるリーダーとして機能する。

· 責任感、協働、継続的な改善を重視する高いパフォーマンス文化を醸成する。


4. オペレーションガバナンス・実行品質の向上

· 日本市場におけるビジネスガバナンス、精度の高い予測・フォーキャスト、計画策定の徹底を推進する。

· ROIの評価フレームワーク、ビジネスガバナンス基準、パフォーマンスレポーティングを一貫性・透明性を持って運用する。

· 定期的な計画・レビューサイクルを強化し、正確かつ信頼性の高いビジネスパイプラインおよびパートナー実績の可視化を実現する。

· 複数部門をまたぐ施策をリードし、実行品質およびオペレーション効率の向上を図る。


5. ステークホルダー・社内各部門との連携

· Marketing、Product、Finance、Legal、Regional Leadershipなどの社内ステークホルダーと強固な関係を構築し、日本市場におけるパートナーシップの優先事項が適切に反映され、必要なリソースが確保されるよう推進する。

· 主要な戦略的パートナーに対するシニアレベルの対外的な窓口として、業界イベント、パートナーサミット、経営層とのミーティングなどにおいてTrip.com Groupを代表する。

· APAC全体におけるパートナーシップチャネルの事業領域・影響力をさらに拡大するため、部門横断的な戦略プロジェクトにも参画する。


応募資格（Requirements）

日本市場に対する深い理解と、独自のビジネス文化・商習慣を踏まえて事業を推進できる能力を持ち、戦略的なビジネスセンスとパートナーシップ構築力を兼ね備えたリーダーを求めています。

本ポジションに適した候補者は、従来型のBD・営業担当者ではなく、「事業戦略を描く人材」「パートナーシップをリードする人材」「長期的な関係を構築できる人材」という3つの要素を兼ね備えた方です。


経験・バックグラウンド（Experience & Background）

· パートナーシップ、アフィリエイトマーケティング、事業戦略、ビジネスディベロップメント等の領域において、8～10年以上の実務経験。旅行、Eコマース、コンシューマーインターネット業界での経験があれば尚可。

· 日本市場における事業成長を実現した実績があり、P&Lまたは売上への具体的なインパクトを生み出した経験。

· 日本の旅行・デジタル業界に関する深い知識。主要OTA、アフィリエイトネットワーク、メディアパートナー、および市場を取り巻く競争環境に関する十分な理解。

· 高いパフォーマンスを発揮するチームのマネジメントまたはコーチング経験。メンバーの成長を促し、チームのビジネス水準を高められる能力。

· クロスファンクショナルかつマトリックス型の組織での業務経験があり、複数の市場・部門にまたがってシニアレベルのステークホルダーを巻き込み、影響力を発揮できる方。

· グローバルまたはリージョナルの旅行プラットフォーム、日本の旅行会社（例：JTB、KNT-CTホールディングス、楽天トラベル）、または日本を代表するデジタル・アフィリエイト企業での経験があれば尚可。


言語（Language）

· 日本語：ネイティブレベル必須

日本のビジネスパートナーとの関係構築、国内チームのリード、日本市場における円滑な業務遂行に必要となります。

· 英語：ビジネスレベル必須

グローバルのリーダーシップチームおよび各国・地域のチームとの連携に必要となります。


スキル・能力（Skills & Capabilities）

· 戦略的思考力

市場全体を俯瞰し、複雑な市場環境の中から事業インパクトの大きい機会を見出し、戦略を実行可能な計画へ落とし込める能力。

· ビジネス・商業感覚

日本のデジタル市場におけるパートナーシップの収益構造、アフィリエイトモデル、収益ドライバー、ROIの考え方について深い理解を有すること。

· リレーション構築力

日本の経営層・シニアビジネスリーダーとの間に強固な信頼関係を構築できる卓越した能力。合意形成、長期的な関係構築、細部への配慮など、日本特有のビジネス文化を理解し、適切に対応できること。

· 組織・リーダーシップ能力

直接的な指示だけでなく、周囲への影響力を通じてチームをリードし、メンバーの能力を高め、マトリックス型の組織において成果に対する責任を促進できる能力。

· オペレーション・マネジメント能力

計画策定、フォーキャスト、パフォーマンス管理などを体系的かつ規律を持って推進できる能力。

· ステークホルダーマネジメント

社内外のシニア層・経営層に対して、自信を持ってコミュニケーションを行い、関係者を巻き込みながらプロジェクトを推進できる能力。

· コーチング能力

メンバーの成長を支援し、チーム全体のビジネス・商業能力を高めることに強い関心と意欲を持っていること。

Location Barnard's Inn 86 Fetter Lane, London, London, United Kingdom, EC4A 1ENVIEW ON MAP

Schedule Full Time

Located Remotely? N

Position Type Management

Position Summary

This fixed-term position will provide additional Revenue Management Support (RMS) capacity during the Power of M transition. The role will manage the day-to-day revenue management requirements of a flexible portfolio of hotels, enabling the hotels’ dedicated Revenue Managers to focus on Power of M deployment activities while maintaining continuity of core RMS service delivery and commercial support.

SCOPE

Responsible for delivering agreed business-as-usual revenue management activities across a flexible and changing portfolio of RMS-supported hotels. Portfolio assignments will align with Power of M deployment requirements and may change as hotels enter or complete transition activity. The role will maintain pricing, forecasting, inventory strategy, performance review and hotel communication in line with agreed Core Deliverables, helping protect revenue and profit while the dedicated Revenue Manager concentrates on Power of M tasks.

Provides BAU revenue management coverage that supports the wider RMS team through the Power of M transition. The role is not the primary owner of Power of M deployment tasks but may provide relevant hotel context, commercial input and handover support when required.

Provides revenue management functional expertise to hotels assigned within the flexible transition-support portfolio.

Location requirements: Contracted from London Regional Office however is a field-based role and therefore supports 100% remote working.

Language Requirements: High proficiency (speaking, reading and writing) in English is required. Multi language capability would be viewed as a bonus given the international nature of the business.

Travel Requirements: Up to 5% business travel may be required.

CORE ACTIVITIES

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Expected Contributions

  • Manage the day-to-day revenue management requirements of a flexible portfolio of RMS-supported hotels during the Power of M transition.
  • Provide temporary BAU coverage for hotels whose dedicated Revenue Manager is completing Power of M deployment activities.
  • Deliver agreed Core Deliverables, including pricing, inventory management, forecasting, performance analysis, reporting and hotel communication.
  • Adapt quickly to changing portfolio assignments, hotel priorities and deployment waves, ensuring clear handovers and continuity of service.
  • Maintain close communication with the dedicated Revenue Manager and RMS leadership, escalating material commercial risks, hotel concerns and support requirements promptly.
  • Prepare and support sales strategy meetings, weekly strategy packs, forecasts, performance critiques and other routine RMS deliverables for assigned hotels.
  • Execute agreed revenue strategies, promotions, programmes and packages accurately and within required deadlines.
  • Build effective relationships with hotel leadership teams and provide clear, consistent revenue management guidance throughout the coverage period.
  • Use technical knowledge, judgement and established RMS processes to resolve standard business requests and support strong commercial outcomes.
  • Support structured portfolio handovers as hotels move into and out of Power of M transition activity.
  • Perform other duties appropriate to the fixed-term transition-support role, as directed by the RMS EMEA Leadership Team.

Specific Expected Contributions (including duties and responsibilities)

  • Provides consistent day-to-day revenue management support to assigned hotels, communicating pricing, competitive positioning, inventory controls and restrictions in line with agreed strategy and Core Deliverables.
  • Utilizes Marriott’s revenue management systems and tools to maximize revenue and profit for both transient and group segments, as required by the agreed Core Deliverables.
  • Prepares sales strategy meeting agenda and supporting documentation.
  • Conducts Sales Strategy meetings with General Manager and key property staff to educate and evaluate pricing and inventory strategies. Develops and implements strategies with the General Manager that will maintain and/or increase the hotel’s RevPAR.
  • Analyzes competitive performance using market share tools and shares recommendations for improvement with hotel teams.
  • Conducts remote system diagnostics audits and provide consistent recommendations.
  • Delivers training to various team members at contracted properties, ensuring hotel responsibilities are clear and manageable.
  • Executes pricing through High Performance Pricing, to include promotions, programs, and packages. Ensures compliance and participation in company promotions and digital channels, completing set up in HPP and eFast.
  • Ensures retail rates are evaluated through One Yield’s Retail Pricing Optimizer and updated based on changes in demand, product, or competitive positioning.
  • Ensures retail price parity is executed across all booking channels and ensure that the Hotel(s) sales strategies are effectively implemented in the reservation system and the inventory systems in a timely manner.
  • Ensures that technical questions relating to reservations and property management systems are escalated to the correct support desk in a timely manner. Assists hotels with pricing and provides input on business evaluation recommendations, if required in the assigned core deliverables.
  • Perform ad-hoc revenue tasks and analysis as directed by RMS Senior Leadership team.
  • Leads efforts to coordinate strategies between group sales offices, if required in the assigned core deliverables.
  • Conducts any analysis required to maximize room revenue and profit, in line with agreed service deliverables.
  • Analyzes reports and available information to make long-term pricing recommendations with brand initiatives as a key focus.
  • Critiques property performance weekly/monthly for Transient & Group segments for assigned hotel(s).
  • Prepares, communicates, and critiques weekly and monthly rooms projections, in line with agreed service deliverables.
  • Responsible for accurate execution of inventory management tasks.
  • Uses demand forecast and relevant data points to determine, implement and control selling strategies.
  • Drives compliance and participation in company promotions and digital channels.

Fixed-Term Assignment Context: This role is specifically established to provide additional BAU capacity during the Power of M transition. Portfolio size and hotel allocation will remain flexible and will be determined by deployment demand and RMS business priorities.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education & Experience

2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Finance and Accounting, Economics, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major. 3 years’ experience in the revenue management discipline.

Skills & Knowledge

  • Building Successful Relationships – is able to develop constructive and cooperative working relationships with others and maintain them over time. Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships Understands the distinction between managed and franchise owners/operators and is able to seamlessly provide support to all levels of the business.
  • Demonstrating Knowledge - Demonstrating knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
  • Executing on a Strategy - taking a predetermined strategy and supporting the execution of that strategy.
  • Communicating Information Timely - Informing and/or updating other team members on relevant information in a timely manner.
  • Generating and Delivering Accurate and Timely Results - Generating and providing accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Analytical/Critical Thinking - The ability to gather and organize information using a logical and systematic process.
  • Intermediate Computer Skills – Utilizing the internet for job related search and information. Intermediate or higher mastery level of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Job Specific Computer Skills – MS Office applications essential. Marriott systems (MARSHA, Opera PMS and Opera S&C, HPP, MarRFP, eFast, MRDW, One Yield) would be advantageous but not necessary.
  • Oral Comprehension - The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Writing - Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.
  • Mathematics - Using mathematics to solve problems. The ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly and correctly.

United Kingdom

At the time of application, applicants must have the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Unfortunately, this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship or relocation assistance

job.job_description:
Company Description


Would you like to work for a company where hospitality is a work of heart and you can be all you are?

Our purpose is to pioneer the art of responsible hospitality, connecting cultures with heartfelt care. With over 230,000 hospitality experts in more than 40+ hotel brands, we nurture a real passion for service and achievement beyond limits.

At the Accor Global Reservation Centre, we offer memorable experiences to our clients.

You will be part of an international team helping guests offering them the best experience when making the reservation in the luxury hotels around the world. You will be sharing your expertise and knowledge of our spectacular, world-class locations and properties while having authentic conversations with guests.


Job Description


Job Purpose

As a Luxury Reservation Consultant, you will be a key member of our Global Reservation Centre based in Barcelona, handling inbound booking calls and utilizing your sales skills to offer knowledgeable recommendations while reserving rooms and suites for our luxury brand hotels worldwide. You will leverage your expertise and passion for our spectacular, world-class locations and properties to engage guests in authentic conversations, driving bookings and maximizing revenue. Your ability to understand guest needs and provide tailored solutions will be key in delivering exceptional service and achieving sales targets.

Your mission will be to serve as the connection between Accor and our guests through:

  • Responding to guests requests in an unscripted environment, where we are known as Heartists® (Heart + Artist). Everything we do comes from the heart, and you have the freedom be creative in your guest conversations
  • Having authentic conversations while you book global travel experiences to luxury destinations
  • Sharing your knowledge and your passion for hospitality, making thoughtful recommendations help your guests choose the right room and package for their need

What is in for you?

  • Great welcoming plan: You will have a specific training plan for one month that will help you to understand more about our culture, values, business and quality standards that will help you to feel comfortable and confident when taking your firsts calls.
  • Inclusive and International Workplace: Join a diverse, inclusive, and enjoyable work environment where we benefit from the diversity of over 30 nationalities.
  • Collaborative Atmosphere: Engage with a team of passionate individuals dedicated to excellence. You will be joining a dynamic new team excited to meet you and welcome you aboard!
  • Exclusive Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounted rates at our iconic properties worldwide.
  • Incentive Plan: Earn rewards based on smart goals
  • Global Reach: Make a global impact by connecting with guests from around the world.
  • Community Involvement: Participate in opportunities to give back and make a positive impact in the community.


Qualifications


Your experience and skills include:

  • Relevant Experience: Background in sales, customer service, hospitality, or tourism. Luxury travel experience is a plus.
  • Language Skills: Native or proficiency level in German and fluency in English (C1-C2).
  • Tech Savvy: Comfortable with computers and new software.
  • Passion for Travel: Genuine interest in travel and hospitality.
  • Active Listener: Ability to understand and respond to guests' needs.
  • Excellent Communicator: Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Customer Service: Solid understanding of service principles and best practices
  • Responsible: Strong sense of responsibility and accountability.
  • Eager to Learn: Curious and eager for self-development.
  • Team Player: Collaborative and respectful in a diverse multicultural environment.
  • Availability : Start October 2026


Additional information


If you are passionate about luxury and sales, and are looking for a role that values genuine interactions and exceptional guest experiences, apply now to become a Luxury Reservation Consultant with us. Let's create unforgettable experiences together.

Location and Availability Requirements:

  • Must be currently legally entitled to work part-time in Spain
  • 20/25 hours/week contract
  • AM & PM Schedules
  • Days off during week days

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit, and promote diverse talent.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
We’re on the look for a passionate and hands-on Back of House Manager (Full-Time) to help keep everything running smoothly behind the scenes at Kimpton Clocktower Hotel!

Kimpton Clocktower Hotel is a Manchester icon - a bold blend of grand Victorian architecture and playful, contemporary design. We’re a little bit classic, a little bit rebellious and always full of character! From buzzing social spaces to unforgettable dining and events, we create stays that feel vibrant, personal and anything but ordinary.

As our Back of House Manager, reporting into the Executive Chef, you’ll be at the centre of our kitchen operations - keeping standards high, supporting the team and making sure everything behind the scenes runs like clockwork. Your role will include the following responsibilities:

  • Oversees daily back of house operations including cleanliness, organisation, goods-in, equipment standards and safe working practices across kitchen support areas.
  • Supports the Executive Chef with operational and payroll standards keeping BOH areas service-ready, managing payroll and updating UKG for accurate payroll forecasting.
  • Leads, coaches and organises the back of house team creating a positive, well-structured environment, completing rotas and keeping everyone clear on standards.
  • Manages stock, deliveries and BOH systems including receiving deliveries on Procure Wizard, maintaining storage standards, reducing waste and supporting cost control.
  • Works closely with Kitchen, Food and Beverage, Events and wider hotel teams to support seamless service and a great guest experience.
  • Maintains compliance with food safety, hygiene, health and safety and internal policies across all back of house areas.

We want someone brilliantly organised, calm under pressure and proud of the standards they set - a hands-on leader who can keep the back of house operation moving and bring out the best in their team. Plus, we’re looking for someone who has…

  • Previous experience in a back of house, kitchen operations, stewarding or similar supervisory/management role within a busy hotel or hospitality environment.
  • A strong understanding of food hygiene, health and safety, COSHH and safe working practices.
  • The confidence to lead a team, set clear standards and support colleagues with coaching, training and day-to-day guidance.
  • Excellent organisation skills, with the ability to manage priorities, stock, deliveries and operational routines in a fast-paced environment.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a real eye for detail and pride in maintaining clean, safe and efficient back of house areas.
  • Food Safety certification and knowledge of HACCP would be desirable.

Joining the Kimpton family isn’t just about providing our guests with excellent service - we’ve secured a spot in Fortune’s ‘100 Best Companies to Work For’ 7 times since 2009, and it’s no surprise why! We can offer you…

  • Financial Perks: up to £33,000.00 per annum, guaranteed hours, free meal on shift, paid holidays, enhanced sick pay, subsidised travel for unsocial hours, plus Wagestream to save, track, and access your pay anytime.
  • Career Growth: Training programmes, global progression opportunities and 2 paid volunteering days per year. IHG was recognised as a ‘Best Employer 2025’ UK by Mercer.
  • Colleague Perks: Discounts at 6,000+ IHG hotels worldwide, plus friends & family rates. Extra savings through our perks portal on shopping, experiences and more.
  • Wellbeing: Generous maternity/paternity pay, 24/7 employee assistance, and access to mental health first-aiders.
  • Refer a Friend: Share the opportunity and reap rewards when your friends join!

If you’re someone who likes to march to the beat of your own drum and wants to join a company that celebrates authentic individuality, apply today! Check out our Instagram page @kimptonclocktower to see more.

As a Back of House Manager, you’ll be 100% you, bringing your authentic personality to everything you do; be the ultimate host, confidently leading yourself and making creative decisions that elevate every interaction; and spark joy, using every tool available to craft meaningful and memorable experiences.

You must meet the legal requirements to work in the UK.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Must have excellent spoken and written Korean skills, and Business level of English

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Data Scientist, Analytics

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

We're looking for a senior-level individual contributor to provide valuable analytics and decision support to drive Expedia's Localization product within Content Product Analytics.

In this role, you will partner with cross-functional teams to contribute to many aspects of product development, including understanding user behavior, A/B experimentation, and problem-solving using statistics and causal inference techniques.

In This Role, You Will

  • Develop and deploy advanced machine learning models to solve complex business challenges and drive data-informed decision making.
  • Design and lead complex A/B and causal experiments to measure the impact of localization changes on traveler engagement and booking conversion; own the experimentation framework for the Localization product area
  • Translate complex multilingual data insights into compelling narratives for product, engineering, and executive audiences; influence roadmap prioritization through data.
  • Write advanced SQL and Python to build scalable, automated analytics pipelines and self-serve dashboards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and implement end-to-end data pipelines and intelligent systems that operate at production scale.
  • Lead and mentor data scientists and engineers, fostering technical excellence and a culture of continuous learning.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, ensuring models are reliable, ethical, and scalable.
  • Co‑own with Product and business leaders the metric frameworks and decision workflows for your area

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent related professional experience
  • 8+ years of experience in data science, applied science, or analytics (6+ years with MS/PhD) in an industry setting
  • You are a proven expert in statistical modeling and experiment design — including A/B testing, quasi-experiments, and causal inference methods (e.g., Pre/Post, causal impact, multivariate, multi-armed bandit)
  • You have hands-on experience building ML/NLP models at production scale (e.g., text classification, semantic similarity, quality scoring)
  • You have advanced proficiency in SQL and Python, with ability to write clean, production-quality code
  • You have experience working with large-scale, unstructured text data and LLMs — including prompt design, evaluation (e.g., golden sets, LLM-as-judge), and RAG patterns
  • You have demonstrated ability to mentor junior data scientists, balance speed, risk, and analytical rigor
  • You have experience with advanced visualization techniques / best practices, and building scalable dashboards
  • You operate independently, managed cross-function projects and able to influence product and business strategy through data, and storytelling skills

Please note that this role is only available in the following location: London, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

job.job_description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Senior Developer will be responsible for the design, development, and evolution of United's Ticketing Platform. This role will lead the transition from legacy mainframe development approaches toward cloud-native architecture and AI-enabled, spec-driven software engineering while delivering scalable solutions that support critical ticketing capabilities across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership, communication, and mentoring skills. This individual will partner with Product to translate business outcomes into actionable solutions, collaborate with Engineering and Architecture on technical design, work with EQE to strengthen quality and automation, and coach developers as they grow their technical and professional capabilities.

  • Lead technical design phases by configuring AI agents to ingest Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), business requirements, system architectures, and approved engineering standards.
  • Orchestrate agent workflows that transform high-level business and technical artifacts into detailed, implementation-ready specifications for microservices and platform capabilities.
  • Oversee the end-to-end design, development, documentation, testing, deployment, and support of backend solutions built on C# and .NET Core.
  • Lead the decomposition of legacy mainframe ticketing capabilities into scalable, resilient, and cloud-native services.
  • Design event-driven architectures and communication patterns leveraging Solace messaging technologies.
  • Define and govern API contracts, policies, security standards, and routing rules managed through Kong API Gateway.
  • Architect scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure deployments across AWS services, including ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, and related cloud-native technologies.
  • Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Harness to automate build, testing, security validation, deployment, and release activities.
  • Continuously refine AI prompt pipelines, validation practices, and engineering guardrails to improve the accuracy, completeness, and quality of agent-generated technical specifications.
  • Lead API integrations between internal platforms, external systems, and cloud services using API-first design principles.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate business capabilities into scalable technical solutions and delivery plans.
  • Partner with Engineering, Architecture, EQE, Platform Engineering, and Operations teams to ensure solution quality, successful delivery, and operational readiness.
  • Facilitate technical discussions, design reviews, and architecture assessments, helping cross-functional teams reach clear and timely decisions.
  • Highlight and document risks, issues, blockers, dependencies, and technical decisions while driving resolution plans with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Mentor and coach developers in software engineering best practices, cloud-native design, AI-assisted development, technical problem-solving, and software craftsmanship.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Champion quality engineering by partnering with EQE to improve automation, testability, reliability, and overall software quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and build trusted relationships across the organization.
  • Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in distributed systems, cloud engineering, API development, platform engineering, and AI-enabled software delivery.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred
  • 3+ years of experience in software development
  • Experience in the design, development, documentation, testing, and debugging of enterprise software systems
  • Deep expertise in C# development, .NET Core, and advanced object-oriented design principles
  • Strong experience designing and developing distributed systems, microservices, and API-first architectures
  • Experience modernizing legacy or mainframe-based applications into cloud-native architectures
  • Production experience with enterprise integration technologies, including Solace messaging and Kong API Gateway
  • Proven experience building cloud-native applications and infrastructure on AWS
  • Advanced experience with CI/CD automation tools, including GitHub Actions and Harness
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI coding agents, large language model workflows, or AI-assisted engineering practices into the software development lifecycle
  • Strong understanding of spec-driven development, technical documentation, and automated software delivery practices
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum or SAFe frameworks and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, EQE, Platform Engineering, and Operations organizations
  • Strong verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and leadership skills
  • Experience mentoring developers and fostering technical and professional growth within engineering teams
  • Ability to influence without direct authority, navigate differing perspectives, and build alignment across cross-functional teams
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills in a fast-paced delivery environment
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience supporting airline Ticketing, Order Management, Reservation Systems, Passenger Services Systems, or related airline technology platforms
  • Knowledge of Generative AI frameworks, prompt engineering, AI agent orchestration, and evaluation techniques
  • Proficient in Python scripting for automation, data analysis, and operational tooling.
  • Experience leading adoption of emerging engineering practices and technologies
  • Experience serving as a technical mentor, coach, development lead, or facilitator of an engineering community of practice
  • Experience designing highly scalable event-driven architectures and platform services
  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), event sourcing, CQRS, and cloud-native architecture patterns
  • Experience driving quality improvements in partnership with Quality Engineering teams
  • Agile experience

The base pay range for this role is $112,480.00 to $146,540.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. To request an accommodation, contact JobAccommodations@united.com

Build the foundations for a long-term career with TUI

Ready to Take the First Step?

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Account Executive – New Accounts Growth (Tokyo Based)

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness.

We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to know our team:

IHM (Independent Hotel Management) Team

Account Executives for New Account Growth, a team within IHM, are creative entrepreneurs who develop innovative solutions for Agoda’s newly acquired and high-potential independent hotel partners. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek. Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we roll out new products to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and services and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.

The Opportunity:

As an Account Executive, New Account Growth within IHM, your key objective is to maintain sellability, expand coverage, and enhance the quality of Agoda’s supply network through dedicated account management for newly acquired hotel partners. Together with your team, you will take ownership of a portfolio of hotels, supporting their successful onboarding and continued growth post-acquisition. You will also ensure that partnership-related activities are executed with a high level of care and attention, rather than through a purely scaled approach.

Responsibilities:

  • Build relationships with the newly acquired hotel partners to guide them through onboarding and drive them toward their booking performance on Agoda
  • Encourage program participation to boost initial performance and drive consistent growth
  • Communicate efficiently with partners through various communication methods, including face-to-face meetings, phone, email, messaging, and webinars
  • Use data and dashboards to prioritize tasks
  • Train and inform partners on our technologies, tools and models
  • Prioritize daily tasks, monitor results and track progress in internal systems
  • Respond to partners' requests in a timely and effective manner

Must-Have Skills & Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills in Japanese (native level) and English (business level).
  • Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.


Your Role

As an Accounting System Installer, you will play an important role in supporting Hyatt's continued growth across Europe, Africa and the Middle East by implementing and enhancing the finance systems that keep our hotels operating efficiently.

In this role, you will lead the implementation, configuration and ongoing support of BirchStreet and related finance systems across new and existing Hyatt hotels. Working closely with hotel teams, vendors and regional stakeholders, you will help deliver successful hotel openings, acquisitions, transitions, conversions and system upgrades while ensuring colleagues have the tools, training and support they need to succeed. From system integrations and supplier enablement to marketplace administration and post-go-live support, you'll help create a seamless experience for hotels throughout the region.


The ideal candidate will come from a hotel Finance, Procurement or Accounting background and will be comfortable using and implementing systems.


Location: This position is based in either Germany or Spain. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in the European Union.


Your Responsibilities

  • Implement, configure, administer and continuously enhance BirchStreet across Hyatt hotels throughout the EAME region.
  • Coordinate finance system implementations for hotel openings, acquisitions, transitions, conversions and upgrades, managing project timelines, training and go-live readiness.
  • Support integrations between BirchStreet and related finance systems, including ERP, PMS, POS and eInvoice solutions, ensuring accurate system performance and data flow.
  • Configure and validate system setup, including user access, approval workflows, supplier data, catalogues, order guides, inventory and finance mappings before hotel handover.
  • Administer Hyatt EAME Marketplace 321 while supporting supplier onboarding, catalogue maintenance and procurement process improvements.
  • Lead or support regional finance systems projects, including data migration, user training, system enhancements and post-go-live hypercare.
  • Troubleshoot complex finance system, integration and procurement issues, coordinating testing, issue resolution and user acceptance activities for system enhancements.
  • Provide ongoing support for eInvoice solutions, ensuring supplier readiness, interface validation, compliance and operational excellence across the region.


Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in hotel procurement, accounting, finance operations or supplier management.
  • Experience supporting hotel openings, acquisitions, transitions, conversions or post-go-live support is an advantage.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong knowledge of hotel finance systems and integrations, including BirchStreet, ERP, PMS, POS and eInvoice solutions, with familiarity with systems such as iScala and Opera preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, with experience using implementation documentation, project trackers and reporting tools; experience with Smartsheet or Microsoft Power Platform is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced regional environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Finance, Procurement, IT, hotel operations, suppliers and external vendors.
  • Willingness to travel across the EAME region to support implementations, training and go-live activities.


How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Annual allotment of complimentary stays at Hyatt hotels worldwide
  • Attractive colleague, friends & family hotel rates globally
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities through Hyatt’s myLearning platform
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your continued education and long-term career growth


We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We'd love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to Team

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. This Software development engineer III role is part of the Intelligent Applications team which sits within our Technology division. The Intelligent Applications team builds and scales AI-powered traveler and agent experiences, including virtual assistants and trip-planning capabilities, that make it easier for customers and service teams to find answers, resolve issues, and complete travel tasks more efficiently.

In This Role, You Will

Design, develop, and deliver robust, scalable services and applications by writing high‑quality, maintainable code and tests across the full software development lifecycle. Own and evolve low‑level design, API contracts, and data models for services within your domain, ensuring reliability, performance, and clear integration patterns with other systems. Collaborate with product, architecture, and peer engineering teams to break down complex business and technical problems into actionable plans and incremental deliverables. Drive and uphold engineering best practices for code quality, observability, operational readiness, and security, including participating in design reviews, code reviews, and on‑call rotations as needed.

Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products. Work across multiple services or components in your domain, contributing to reusable patterns, libraries, and platforms that increase developer efficiency and support use cases across different product areas.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Several years of professional software development experience building and operating production services or applications in a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Proven experience owning the design and implementation of services or components, including low‑level system design, API design, and data modeling within a defined product or domain.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language and associated frameworks, along with solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience contributing to the reliability, performance, and maintainability of services through testing, monitoring, and operational best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and evolving distributed systems or multi‑service architectures, including clear API contracts, data models, and integration patterns at domain scope.
  • Demonstrated ability to use metrics, experimentation, and data analysis to inform technical decisions, optimize system behavior, and validate impact at scale.
  • Track record of improving operational excellence through automation, observability, incident response, and performance tuning for production systems.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating AI/ML‑enabled features into existing services.
  • Experience leading technical solutions for complex projects within a domain, mentoring other engineers through design and implementation, and driving continuous improvement in engineering practices.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I-9 to confirm work authorization.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

Agoda Homes—a core business line within Agoda—supports a wide range of non-hotel accommodation types including serviced apartments, homes, private villas, farm stays, chalets, boats, and more. While these accommodations have always been available on Agoda.com, today’s evolving landscape demands a sharpened focus on expanding supply and elevating quality. Our team builds long-term, cross-cultural partnerships that create exceptional value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity

This role is responsible for expanding the supply of non-hotel accommodations in Japan. The role includes sourcing and acquiring new supply, and combining on-the-ground insights with data analysis to uncover strategic opportunities with our existing non-hotel accommodation partners. You will communicate key findings to internal and external stakeholders and contribute to projects such as developing a host community network to accelerate supply growth.

This position is based in our Tokyo office. You will work closely with colleagues across regional and central teams, including teams in Thailand, South Korea, Taiwan, and more. 

In this role, you will be responsible for: 

Grow the business through targeted sourcing of new accommodation partners 

Build trusted relationships with decision makers; use a consultative approach to acquire new partners 

Combine data insights to support our existing partners grow their business

Report weekly/monthly KPI’s and key metrics internally to showcase successes and highlight potential opportunities   

Support Agoda homes’ regional & global leadership in executing scalable initiatives/projects to drive homes business growth  

Assist in developing a community of host network, host events, attend relevant events in the market  

Prepare materials required for partner meetings 

Consolidate feedback from hosts to understand product gaps/feature requests  

Please note that responsibilities may evolve based on business needs. 

What You’ll Need to Succeed: 

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in relevant fields 

Fluency in both Japanese (for partner engagement) and English (for internal communication) 

Experience in B2B sales or similar partner-facing roles 

Proven track record of a self-starter who can think out-of-the-box and autonomously execute projects tasks in a fast-paced environment  

Results-oriented strategic thinker, who is assertive, creative and open to innovate 

Fast learner, adapts well to, and is energized by change  

Strong business development skills, with the ability to build and develop relationships with our key partners, and acquire new hosts on our platform  

Ability to effectively execute the team’s vision, while communicating and getting buy-in from key stakeholders  

Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both internal / external stakeholders. A collaborative mindset with strong execution and a “get-it-done” attitude 

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, and similar. 

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.
