job.company_description: Flight Centre is your centre for travel, providing a one-stop-shop for flights, hotels, holidays, tours and more. For over 40 years we've delivered millions of amazing travel experiences for our customers. With over 35,000 years of experience between us, we remain passionate about our mission to open up the world for those who want to see.
job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

*Flight Centre is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. *

job.job_description:
Hyatt Inclusive Collection se encuentra en búsqueda de tu talento como Supervisor(a) de Contabilidad General | Shared Service Center


Objetivo del puesto

Supervisar y asegurar la correcta ejecución de los procesos de contabilidad general, garantizando el cumplimiento de las políticas contables, fiscales y de control interno, así como la entrega oportuna, precisa y confiable de la información financiera. La posición será responsable de coordinar actividades contables para las propiedades y unidades de negocio asignadas, promoviendo la estandarización de procesos, la eficiencia operativa y el cumplimiento de los niveles de servicio establecidos dentro del Shared Service Center.


Principales funciones:

  • Supervisar las operaciones de contabilidad general y asegurar el registro correcto, completo y oportuno de las transacciones financieras.
  • Coordinar y revisar cierres contables mensuales y anuales, garantizando el cumplimiento del calendario corporativo y de los entregables establecidos.
  • Revisar pólizas contables, provisiones, reclasificaciones, amortizaciones, depreciaciones y demás asientos de cierre.
  • Realizar y validar conciliaciones bancarias, intercompañías y de cuentas de balance, asegurando el seguimiento y resolución de partidas pendientes.
  • Supervisar la integración y depuración de cuentas contables, identificando diferencias, riesgos y desviaciones relevantes.
  • Elaborar, revisar y analizar estados financieros, reportes de resultados, variaciones presupuestales e informes gerenciales.
  • Analizar fluctuaciones mensuales y explicar variaciones significativas contra presupuesto, forecast y periodos anteriores.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de las normas contables, fiscales, corporativas y de auditoría aplicables.
  • Coordinar la atención de auditorías internas y externas, preparando información, soportes y conciliaciones requeridas.
  • Dar seguimiento a controles internos e identificar oportunidades de mejora, automatización y estandarización en los procesos contables.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas, procedimientos, matrices de autorización y lineamientos de segregación de funciones.
  • Monitorear indicadores de desempeño, tiempos de respuesta, calidad de la información y cumplimiento de acuerdos de nivel de servicio del Shared Service Center.
  • Dar seguimiento a incidencias contables y coordinar su resolución con hoteles, áreas corporativas y equipos de soporte.
  • Liderar, desarrollar y dar retroalimentación al equipo de contabilidad, asignando cargas de trabajo y asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos.
  • Capacitar al equipo en políticas contables, procedimientos, herramientas y mejores prácticas del área.
  • Participar en procesos de transición, migración e integración de nuevas propiedades o unidades de negocio al Shared Service Center.
  • Colaborar con las áreas de Finanzas, Cuentas por Pagar, Cuentas por Cobrar, Tesorería, Impuestos, Nómina, Compras y Operaciones para asegurar la integridad de la información financiera.
  • Mantener una comunicación efectiva con los equipos financieros de los hoteles y brindar soporte en consultas relacionadas con registros, cierres y conciliaciones.
  • Preparar información financiera y análisis especiales solicitados por la gerencia, contraloría o dirección corporativa.
  • Promover una cultura de servicio, precisión, cumplimiento y mejora continua dentro del equipo.


Requisitos

  • Licenciatura en Contaduría Pública, Finanzas o carrera afín.
  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en contabilidad general.
  • Experiencia indispensable en la industria hotelera.
  • Experiencia en Shared Services altamente deseable.
  • Experiencia previa supervisando equipos de trabajo y distribuyendo cargas operativas.
  • Conocimiento sólido de cierres contables, conciliaciones, integración de cuentas, estados financieros y controles internos.
  • Experiencia en análisis de variaciones, provisiones, depreciaciones, amortizaciones y operaciones intercompañías.
  • Conocimiento de normas contables, obligaciones fiscales y procesos de auditoría.
  • Capacidad para trabajar con calendarios de cierre exigentes y múltiples unidades de negocio.
  • Habilidad para analizar información financiera, identificar riesgos y proponer soluciones.
  • Orientación al detalle, organización, sentido de urgencia y enfoque en resultados.
  • Excel intermedio-avanzado, incluyendo tablas dinámicas, fórmulas, cruces de información y manejo de bases de datos.
  • Buen manejo de sistemas ERP como SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft o similar.
  • Deseable experiencia con herramientas de conciliación, reportería financiera y automatización de procesos.
  • Inglés intermedio-avanzado, deseable para comunicación con equipos regionales y corporativos.


Zona de trabajo: Centro de Cancún. Corporativo ubicado frente al Hospital Galenia.

job.job_description:
Responsible for defining and delivering Global PMS Capabilities & Integrations across the Next Generation Property Management System ecosystem, including multiple PMS platforms.

This role partners with business stakeholders, hotel operations teams, technology teams, architects, software developers, engineers, integration partners, and PMS vendors to develop and execute a comprehensive product strategy and roadmap for PMS capabilities, platform services, and integrations that support IHG's global hotel portfolio.

The Product Manager must operate effectively at both the strategic and tactical levels, identifying opportunities to standardize, scale, and optimize global PMS capabilities while enabling seamless integrations across the hospitality technology landscape. The role requires balancing long-term platform strategy with near-term business priorities to deliver measurable value to hotels, guests, owners, and corporate stakeholders.

The Product Manager owns the end-to-end lifecycle of global PMS capabilities and integrations, from ideation and discovery through delivery, adoption, optimization, and retirement. This includes governing capability standards, driving platform scalability and reusability, identifying opportunities for platform convergence and standardization, managing integration dependencies, and ensuring solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and supportability requirements.

Additionally, this role drives alignment across cross-functional teams and global stakeholders, influences vendor product roadmaps, supports business case development and product performance reviews, communicates product strategy and outcomes at all levels of the organization, and ensures PMS platforms and the broader integration ecosystem continue to evolve in support of IHG's strategic objectives and future growth.

Your day to day

  • Lead the development and execution of the product strategy and roadmap for Global PMS Capabilities and Integrations, ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives, hotel operational needs, and guest experience priorities across multiple PMS platforms.
  • Define and prioritize PMS capabilities and integration requirements that support hotel operations, enterprise initiatives, and cross-functional business processes while balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform evolution.
  • Own and manage the portfolio of PMS capabilities, platform services, and third-party integrations, driving roadmap decisions that maximize business value, operational efficiency, scalability, and adoption across global hotel brands and regions.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, hotel operations teams, architecture, engineering, data, security, and vendor partners to identify opportunities, document requirements, and deliver integrated solutions that support enterprise and hotel objectives.
  • Influence and drive PMS vendor roadmaps and integration partner development pipelines, advocating for IHG priorities and ensuring alignment to strategic capability needs, technical standards, and delivery timelines.
  • Lead cross-functional teams through discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, and optimization of PMS capabilities and integrations, ensuring successful delivery of prioritized roadmap initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain a holistic view of the PMS ecosystem, identifying capability gaps, integration dependencies, technical risks, and opportunities to standardize functionality across platforms and regions.
  • Define and document business requirements, product specifications, process flows, acceptance criteria, and technical user stories required to support capability and integration delivery.
  • Source and analyze operational, customer, hotel, and product performance data to drive decision-making, validate business outcomes, and prioritize future investments.
  • Develop business cases, forecast value realization, and measure product performance through defined KPIs, leveraging insights to drive adoption, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively engage stakeholders across hotel operations, technology, commercial, loyalty, finance, support, and regional teams to ensure roadmap alignment and successful product adoption.
  • Monitor industry trends, hospitality technology advancements, competitive offerings, and emerging integration opportunities to ensure PMS capabilities remain modern, scalable, and best-in-class.
  • Manage the full product lifecycle for assigned PMS capabilities and integrations, continually assessing performance, stakeholder feedback, technical debt, and future business needs to prevent capability obsolescence
  • Communicate product vision, strategy, roadmap progress, business value, release plans, and performance metrics to stakeholders at all levels of the organization, tailoring messaging appropriately for executive, business, and technical audiences.
  • Drive integration governance and capability alignment across the PMS ecosystem, ensuring solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and operational support requirements.
  • Foster collaboration across product, delivery, engineering, architecture, operations, and vendor teams to remove impediments, accelerate decision-making, and maximize business value delivery.
  • Provide regular status updates, roadmap reporting, risk assessments, and strategic recommendations to leadership, PMO, and key stakeholders.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, User Experience, Customer Experience, Statistics, Business, or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • 3-6 years of relevant work experience as a Product Manager in a modern software development company
  • Skills & Technical Experience
  • Expert knowledge of the IHG digital landscape as well as strong familiarity with competitors and other eCommerce websites to understand trends and best practices
  • Able to recognize when and how to pivot with ease and effectively deliver.
  • Demonstrated deep knowledge and understanding in a specific area of expertise including products.  
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff. Demonstrated ability to present new concepts, research findings, and business outcomes to various groups including corporate clients, senior management, potential vendors, and industry consultants. 
  • Demonstrated program management experience with modern, established product management processes in organizing, planning and executing projects from conception through implementation. Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks/clients required.   
  • Demonstrated experience in detailed product development discovery, documentation, and design work.  
  • Demonstrated analytical skills and ability to perform research and use the results of analysis to make effective strategic decisions. 
  • Demonstrated proficiency with MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt tactics and strategies to fast moving, rapidly evolving marketplace required 
  • Demonstrated ability to use prototyping or simulation in product creation 
  • Experience in formal requirements methodologies such as vision, scope, context, use cases, etc.
  • Strong storyteller, is able to formulate cohesive messages with meaningful and impactful points that resonate with target audience.
  • Demonstrated hotel industry knowledge reflecting the entire customer experience journey (reservations – stay – loyalty – on-property, and ongoing relationship management). 
  • Familiarity with AEM 6.5 Touch UI a plus
  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit with a keen eye for identifying new market opportunities and transforming that into an actionable plan
  • Thrive in ambiguity where the solution doesn't exist and the problems aren't fully known
  • Results driven candidate that can take an idea and develop a strong business case that will become the team's roadmap
  • Knowledgeable in technology and enterprise software
  • Ability to work and lead across all parts of the organization
  • Comfortable and experienced in presenting product vision/strategy to large and senior audiences

Preferred

  • Demonstrated hotel industry knowledge reflecting the entire customer experience journey (reservations – stay – loyalty – on-property, and ongoing relationship management). 
  • Familiarity with AEM 6.5 Touch UI a plus
  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit with a keen eye for identifying new market opportunities and transforming that into an actionable plan
  • Thrive in ambiguity where the solution doesn't exist and the problems aren't fully known
  • Results driven candidate that can take an idea and develop a strong business case that will become the team's roadmap
  • Knowledgeable in technology and enterprise software
  • Ability to work and lead across all parts of the organization
  • Comfortable and experienced in presenting product vision/strategy to large and senior audiences

Travel - 10%

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an exception of three (3) days in the ATLANTA office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team Mission

The Global Communications team builds GetYourGuide's reputation as the leading source of expertise on the experiences category. We deliver value to travelers, partners, and policymakers through communications that are sharp, credible, and designed to travel.

We operate as a newsroom: fast-moving, editorially driven, and built for distribution at scale. We are investing in the systems, channels, and distribution muscle that ensure every story we develop reaches the right audience, in the right format, at the right time.

The Role

As Senior Communications Manager, you will own the operational backbone of GetYourGuide's newsroom. You’ll build the infrastructure it runs on –the story pipeline, media CRM, distribution channels, and owned properties — and you ensure that our original storytelling moves through the system and lands at the right time and on the right channels.

Your Mission

  • Operationalize the publishing pipeline — give the team full visibility on what’s shipped when, what's in development, what's live, and what's next; ensure every story has a clear distribution path and moves on time
  • Build and maintain distribution operations — own end-to-end publishing across external, internal, and owned channels; maintain global media database including beats, relationship status, and pitching notes; drive distribution with agency, freelance partners, and key internal stakeholders
  • Lead media relations and targeted pitching — drive outreach using our CRM and media tracker, build tailored pitch lists per outlet format (press, podcasts, newsletters), manage distribution via agencies and freelancers, and strengthen our global media network over time
  • Own and develop our owned channels — maintain press page as a trusted destination for up-to-date information on the experience economy; develop and run media alerts including cadence, content selection, and performance tracking
  • Explore and pilot new media formats — identify and test formats that extend GYG's corproate reach (podcasts, Substack, AMAs, creator partnerships, emerging channels); track engagement and bring recommendations on what to scale, iterate, or sunset
  • Manage social distribution — build a consistent motion in collaboration with B2B,Employer Brand, and other teams; publish regularly and keep the pipeline moving without bottlenecks

Your Toolkit

  • Proven track record in communications, content operations, or media — you know how newsrooms or editorial teams work and can raise the bar on ours
  • Strong track record of operational delivery — you are organised, process-driven, and thrive on owning systems end-to-end; you make "go / no-go" decisions quickly and keep pipelines moving
  • Hands-on media relations experience — you know the media landscape well, grasp its rapid evolution, and have a track record of helping brands break through
  • Excellent channel fluency — you understand how stories travel across channels and can define channel strategy per story (what goes where, and why)
  • Comfortable working with AI and automation tools to speed up research, drafting, tracking, and coordination — you use them as a default, not an afterthought
  • Strong written English and communication skills — you can package raw materials (quotes, stakeholder context, positioning) into finished, channel-ready

Extras that give you an edge

  • Background in PR, Comms or content marketing at a tech company (B2C preferred)
  • Experience building or managing a media CRM and pitching cadence from scratch
  • Familiarity with the travel, experiences, or marketplace industry
  • Native-level German a plus

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Designation: Manager (Business Analytics)


Company Overview


Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centers, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 600 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. With a portfolio of consumer travel brands including CheapOair and OneTravel, Fareportal enables consumers to book-online, on mobile apps for iOS and Android, by phone, or live chat. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.


Fareportal is one of the leading sellers of airline tickets in the United States.We are a progressive company that leverages technology and expertise to deliver optimal solutions for our suppliers, customers, and partners.


FAREPORTAL HIGHLIGHTS:


  • Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
  • Fareportal partners with over 600 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
  • 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
  • Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.


Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.


Role Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Business Analyst with 4–5 years of experience to join our travel and hotel division. The ideal candidate will come from a premier institution such as IIT, IIM, ISB, or other top-tier colleges and possess strong capabilities in business strategy, marketing analytics, financial planning, and operational optimization.

This role will be responsible for driving business growth by identifying market opportunities, improving financial performance, optimizing costs, and generating actionable insights across our travel ecosystem.


  • Demonstrates strong analytical capabilities to interpret data, derive meaningful insights, and identify opportunities for business improvement.
  • Effectively collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to align findings, influence decisions, and drive actionable outcomes.
  • Owns end-to-end project execution, including solution design, implementation, impact measurement, and continuous optimization.
  • Serves as a trusted business partner by providing data-driven consultation, guiding strategic decision-making, and promoting self-service analytics through market and business insights.
  • Exhibits a self-driven mindset with strong stakeholder management skills, capable of coordinating across departments and leading initiatives as a project manager when required.
  • Possesses the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations that create measurable business value.


Key Responsibilities


Business Strategy & Growth

  • Analyze industry trends, customer behavior, and competitor strategies to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Develop data-driven recommendations to expand market share and improve customer acquisition.
  • Partner with leadership teams to define strategic initiatives for business expansion.
  • Evaluate new products, partnerships, and revenue streams within the travel and hotel domain.


Marketing Analytics & Customer Insights

  • Generate actionable insights from customers, campaign, and booking data to improve marketing effectiveness.
  • Measure and optimize ROI across digital marketing channels, partnerships, and customer acquisition initiatives.
  • Build customer segmentation models and identify opportunities for retention and cross-selling.


Financial Analysis & Profitability Improvement

  • Conduct detailed financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting exercises.
  • Analyze revenue trends, margins, and business unit performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
  • Support leadership in pricing strategy and revenue optimization.


Cost Optimization & Operational Excellence

  • Perform cost-benefit analyses and identify areas for operational savings.
  • Recommend process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs.
  • Develop frameworks for measuring operational performance across business functions.


Data & Reporting

  • Create predictive models and business cases to support strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including marketing, finance, operations, and technology.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear and actionable business recommendations.


Requirements


Education

  • MBA from IIM, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR, or equivalent premier business schools.
  • B.Tech./B.E. from IITs, NITs, BITS Pilani, or other leading institutions.


Experience

  • 4–5 years of experience in business analytics, strategy consulting, corporate strategy, investment analysis, or growth roles.
  • Prior experience in travel, hospitality, e-commerce, OTA, mobility, or consumer internet businesses is strongly preferred.


Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
  • Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and cost optimization.
  • Deep understanding of marketing analytics and customer behavior.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics tools.
  • Experience working with large datasets and deriving strategic insights.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional initiatives.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership and execution capabilities.


Disclaimer

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company’s sole discretion, with or without notice.

Director, Strategic Partnerships

Whether it’s hotels, rental cars, flights, cruises, or packages, our Lines of Business develop the relationships and partnerships that allow us to deliver exceptional value and experiences to Priceline customers—helping them enjoy the moments that matter most.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Director, Strategic Partnerships, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping the future growth of Priceline’s B2B distribution business within the highly competitive travel marketplace. You will define and execute strategic partnership initiatives that unlock new revenue opportunities, expand market presence, and strengthen relationships with many influential travel businesses.

You’ll serve as a senior representative of the Priceline brand, cultivating executive-level relationships across the travel ecosystem. This role requires a strategic operator who can balance big-picture market opportunities with disciplined execution. You’ll oversee complex partnerships from strategy through negotiation, implementation, optimization, and expansion—working closely with Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and Customer teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

Leveraging your industry expertise, analytical mindset, and leadership skills, you’ll identify emerging opportunities, solve complex commercial challenges, and build scalable partnerships that deliver exceptional value for Priceline, our partners, and our customers.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Define and execute the strategic partnership roadmap, identifying growth opportunities, market trends, and innovative partnership models that strengthen Priceline’s competitive position.
  • Build, nurture, and expand executive-level relationships with high-value strategic partners across the travel ecosystem, particularly focused on the loyalty and corporate travel segments,.
  • Be a leader, acting as a manager, advocate, mentor, and peer. Engage with direct reports, guide priorities, and provide detailed support when needed to communicate partnership direction and strategy across the company
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including partnership agreements regarding growth initiatives, and long-term strategic commitments.
  • Own portfolio performance, developing strategies to accelerate revenue growth, improve partner engagement, and maximize business outcomes.
  • Identify and pursue new partnership opportunities that expand distribution, enhance customer value, and create competitive differentiation.
  • Represent Priceline externally at industry events, conferences, and executive forums, strengthening brand presence and marketplace influence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Legal, Operations, and Customer teams to align partner strategies with company priorities.
  • Influence product capabilities and roadmap decisions by translating partner insights, industry trends, and commercial opportunities into actionable strategies.
  • Develop scalable frameworks, processes, and operating models that improve partnership effectiveness and long-term growth.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and guidance across teams to elevate commercial thinking, partnership strategy, and execution excellence.

Who You Are

  • A strategic commercial leader with 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, or commercial strategy, ideally within travel, hospitality, marketplace, e-commerce, or technology environments.
  • Proven track record building and scaling high-value enterprise partnerships that drive significant revenue growth and business impact.
  • Deep understanding of the travel ecosystem, including supplier relationships, distribution models, connectivity, and evolving market dynamics.
  • Experienced leading complex commercial negotiations and influencing executive stakeholders across partner organizations.
  • Able to identify market opportunities, develop strategic plans, and translate vision into measurable execution.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience using data, business cases, and performance metrics to guide decisions.
  • Comfortable operating across strategy and execution—equally effective setting direction and diving into details to remove barriers.
  • Exceptional communicator with the ability to influence senior leaders, align diverse stakeholders, and represent the company externally.
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and driving outcomes in a fast-paced, competitive environment. We’re a small team and often wear many hats. Some projects may not be completely defined. This individual will take a resourceful approach to what’s needed and drive results
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability, and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $155,000- $195,000K USD

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

Applying for this position

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all current employees, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

KAYAK is seeking a Mid-level Conceptual Copywriter to join a newly forming idea-first creative hub in London covering UK and EMEA. We’re looking for a mid-weight creative to generate and craft bold, format-ready concepts from brief to delivery. You’re a modern, channel-agnostic team player who thinks big, even in the smallest formats. With a keen eye for tone, wit and an understanding of idea and execution, you’ll write for the channel, the audience and the moment.

You may have worked at an advertising or creative agency, an in-house creative team, or somewhere entirely unexpected. However you got here, you understand the power of language and how to wield it to tell stories and connect brands and people.

This role is based in our London office 3 times a week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conceive and develop original campaign ideas across multiple formats — from OOH and social media to short-form video scripts — ensuring each concept is tailored to the specific channel, audience, and communication objective.
  • Write compelling hooks, headlines, scripts, and briefs that are sharp, format-aware, and built to earn attention — whether in three words on a billboard or thirty seconds on screen.
  • Collaborate with designers, video editors and production partners to execute a range of campaign assets, digital and social media.
  • Adapt copy and concepts across formats with a strong understanding of how message, tone, and structure must shift between OOH, paid social, organic content, and short-form video.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams — including campaign managers, brand strategist and performance marketers — to ensure creative concepts are both ambitious and executable within real-world constraints.
  • Be comfortable working solo or as part of a larger team — bouncing ideas, building on others' thinking, and helping the wider team unlock stronger creative directions.
  • Leverage and champion AI tools as part of the creative process — using them for ideation, storyboarding, and rapid concept exploration — with the taste and judgment to know when they enhance the work.
  • Maintain a strong visual aesthetic and sensibility, understanding how copy and design work together to shape the overall creative direction of a campaign.

Please Apply If You Are

  • Up to 7 years into your creative career, with strong thinking, craft, and a portfolio that shows what you can do - with a background rooted in campaign ideation and short-form copy, not long-form editorial.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, format-aware copy, and integrated campaign work across multiple channels.
  • Deep knowledge of advertising formats — you understand how to write for OOH, social media, and short-form content, and know that a great idea must be tailored to the format and audience, not simply repurposed.
  • Script and brief writing ability — you can write a tight video script and a clear, actionable creative brief with equal confidence.
  • Strong aesthetic and visual understanding — you can think in images as well as words, and understand how copy shapes the overall visual and creative direction of a campaign.
  • A collaborative, ego-free mindset — you're a natural thinker who takes feedback constructively, understands that great work serves business and communication goals, and thrives in a cross-cultural team environment.
  • Confidence presenting and defending ideas — you can pitch a concept clearly to stakeholders and adapt it with grace when the brief evolves.
  • Experience writing for short-form video formats (e.g., Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) is a must — familiarity with how copy and pacing work together in short-form storytelling is valued.
  • Experience in film production processes is advantageous.

Benefits And Perks

  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousand of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice

  • Bike2Work
  • Season ticket loan

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Requirements

Singapore Airlines is recruiting Direct Entry First Officers on fixed-term contracts. To apply, you will need to meet the following requirements:

  • Possess a valid Class 1 Medical Certificate that is recognised by, or can be validated by, the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS)
  • Hold a valid Air Transport Pilot Licence (ATPL) with an Airbus A350 (A350) or Airbus A380 (A380) aircraft type rating that is recognised by, or can be validated by, CAAS. If you hold a foreign licence, you may check your eligibility using this document.
  • Minimum 3,000 hours of flying experience as a First Officer is preferred. Candidates with at least 1,500 hours will also be considered. Notwithstanding the above conditions, candidates must have a minimum of 1,500 hours on the A350 and/or A380.
  • Minimum two years of flying experience on either the A350 or A380 as a First Officer, prior to the application date.
  • Able to speak and understand English with ICAO English Level 5 or above for inflight radio-telephony communications
  • Minimum height requirement of 1.58m to ensure full reach and the safe operation of all flight deck controls.

Selection Process

Applicants will undergo various stages of assessment, which may include (but not limited to) interviews, simulator assessment and medical examinations.Successful candidates will be placed on either the A350 or A380 fleet.

Training

Successful candidates will receive the relevant training.

Tenure of Service

Successful candidates will be offered a fixed-term contract of up to 12 months.

We thank all candidates for their interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Working closely with third-party service providers, Service Delivery Managers and teams across Finance, Commercial, Sales and Customer Operations, you’ll help shape best-practice ways of working and deliver meaningful improvements to efficiency, cash flow and customer outcomes.

You’ll also support the ongoing governance of O2C controls, ensuring appropriate approval processes, reconciliations and segregation of duties are embedded across the operating model. This is an opportunity to influence transformation initiatives while working across a complex, highly collaborative environment.

About You

We're looking for an experienced process improvement or finance transformation professional with strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash operations and a track record of turning complex processes into simpler, more effective ways of working.

job.job_description:
About Sojern:

Sojern is the leading AI-powered marketing platform built for hospitality, designed to boost growth and profitability for the travel industry. The Sojern marketing platform brings you unrivaled traveler insight, intelligent audiences, multichannel activation and optimization, and a connected guest experience—all in one place.


More than 10,000 travel marketers rely on our platform annually to find, attract, convert, and engage travelers. Sojern, founded in 2007 and acquired by RateGain in 2025, is headquartered in San Francisco, California with teams in the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific.



Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Manager to drive new business growth for Sojern’s Property Ad Solutions across Spain. This is an Individual Contributor role where you will utilise Sojern’s full suite of digital marketing solutions, including SEM, Metasearch, Display, Social, Email, Native, and Video, to help hotels increase direct bookings.


You will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building a strong and diversified sales pipeline, and consistently meeting or exceeding targets.


As a highly driven self-starter with a strong hunter mindset, you will be skilled at understanding the varying needs of different hotel segments, anticipating their marketing and branding challenges, and delivering compelling, tailored pitches that influence key decision-makers. Leveraging your expertise in digital advertising, advanced prospecting capabilities, and consultative selling approach, you will build long-term partnerships and deliver measurable business outcomes, reinforcing Sojern’s position as a leading hospitality marketing partner in the region.



Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and grow a high-value pipeline by owning and expanding a portfolio of independent and regional chain hotel clients within assigned market(s), with market allocation tailored to the candidate’s experience and expertise. Leveraging Sojern’s full range of advertising solutions (SEM, Metasearch, Email, Social, Display, Native, and Video) while managing the entire sales funnel—from prospecting through close—and executing targeted strategies that drive revenue growth, tailored to each client’s unique needs and market challenges.
  • Consistently meet and exceed new business targets, driving revenue impact and overall sales objectives through high-velocity sales activity, including cold calling, prospecting, and structured follow-ups.
  • Design compelling pitches using insights to highlight Sojern’s value proposition, educating hotel partners on driving direct bookings, brand visibility, and measurable ROI.
  • Collaborate with regional booking engines and other partners to uncover new client opportunities, further expanding Sojern’s global presence, and confidently present at workshops, seminars, and industry events to engage audiences and deliver compelling insights.
  • Maintain thorough and up-to-date records of all sales activities, opportunities, and client interactions, employing advanced reporting and dashboards for data-driven insights.
  • Work closely with Onboarding, CSM teams, Marketing/PR, Product, and other regional sales teams to share best practices and ensure seamless cross-functional collaboration.
  • Be prepared to travel regionally for client meetings, industry events, and trade shows to build relationships and remain informed about market developments.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest ad tech innovations, programmatic tools, and hospitality marketing practices to enhance sales pitches and promote continuous improvement.



Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of sales experience: With a proven track record in business development, preferably within digital marketing or hospitality. A strong industry network is an advantage. Experience in high-velocity sales environments, including cold calling, prospecting, and structured follow-ups, is required.
  • Language Proficiency: Professional fluency in English and Spanish required.
  • Digital Marketing Acumen: Solid understanding of the latest advertising trends, channels, and best practices, with hands-on experience in selling media solutions to hotels.
  • Hotel Industry Experience: Familiarity with the hospitality sector, whether through marketing or overall Distribution, enabling you to quickly understand hotel-specific challenges and opportunities.
  • Pipeline Building Expertise: Proven ability to identify and nurture prospects, maintaining a robust and diversified pipeline that consistently generates new business opportunities.
  • Results-Oriented Mindset: Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding targets, using data-driven strategies to optimise performance and achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Team Player Mentality: Collaborative spirit and willingness to work cross-functionally, sharing knowledge and insights to help the broader team succeed.
  • Comprehensive understanding of sales strategies, market trends, and competitor analysis
  • Proficiency with standard business and sales software, including Salesforce, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office is required.



Equal Opportunity Statement:

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

job.job_description:
• Lead and drive technology and engineering standards, whilst driving AI adoption within our Product Innovation Centre.
  • A fantastic opportunity to work across cross functional teams to uplift our software engineering and quality engineering capability
  • Full-time and permanent position based at our Adelaide Head Office.


Qantas has established a new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide, a hub that will transform how we design, build and deliver digital experiences for millions of customers. At its core is a shift to a product-led operating model: moving away from traditional project-based IT delivery toward empowered, cross-functional product teams that own outcomes end-to-end.


The Head of Technology Chapter is accountable for the end-to-end engineering and quality engineering capability across the Product Innovation Centre, leading Chapter Leads for Mobile Engineering, Web Engineering, Backend & Integration Engineering, and Quality Engineering. Through this chapter structure, the role provides hardline leadership to all software and quality engineers, while maintaining alignment with product and platform squads where engineers contribute day-to-day delivery outcomes.


The role is responsible for defining engineering strategy, establishing technical standards, and driving the adoption of modern software engineering and AI-native development practices. It provides leadership on engineering priorities and capability development. This role ensures consistent quality, scalability, and operational excellence across the organisation.


In partnership with the Senior Manager, Applied AI, the Head of Technology Chapter co-leads our AI-native engineering transformation. This role is accountable for embedding AI-native practices into engineering teams and ensuring sustained adoption through strong chapter leadership and accountability.


Operating across a distributed chapter structure, the role translates enterprise technology strategy into execution. Success is measured through engineering excellence, widespread adoption of AI-native ways of working and the ability to sustain consistent standards as the Centre scales beyond hundreds of engineering and quality professionals.


You’ll Have

  • 15+ years in software engineering or technology roles, including 10+ years in senior engineering leadership across multiple teams or disciplines
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated hands-on fluency in AI-assisted and agentic engineering practice
  • Enterprise-level leadership across engineering and quality engineering capability, including strategic direction setting and leading leaders through coaching and accountability.
  • Capability strategy design and maturity uplift at scale, including workforce planning across engineering and quality disciplines.
  • Governance of enterprise engineering standards across engineering, testing, security, reliability, and deployment, with genuine enforcement authority
  • Systems thinking across complex technology environments, with ownership of technical debt strategy and systemic risk management.
  • Proven ability to align Engineering, Quality Engineering, Platform, Design and Delivery practice to reduce friction and improve outcomes.
  • Executive-level influence and decision support through governance forums


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.


You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.


  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on 22nd of September


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Manager-Technical Contract Performance is responsible for driving improved supplier performance by enforcing liquidated damage remedies for late delivery of aircraft parts and managing contract intelligence initiatives. Manager will supervise up to four international direct reports, tasked with identifying, initiating and settling lead time and turnaround time claims, along with tracking, capturing and processing payment of such claims from United's aircraft goods and services suppliers. This position acts as the primary liaison to the Strategic Sourcing department in the development of contract language in support of obtaining such remedies and serves as a subject matter expert in the area of technical contract product support provisions, contract incentives, and the integration of contract intelligence solutions into contract management processes.

  • Perform and supervise analysis of annual volume of over 120,000 purchase orders and 150,000 repair orders
  • Identify available remedies from overdue orders
  • Initiate and settle over 600 claims per year
  • Manage contract intelligence initiatives supporting contract management processes, including coordination of requirements, implementation activities, and integration of solutions designed to improve contract analysis and accessibility across Tech Ops Supply Chain
  • Maintain proficiency and currency with Warranty Administration team by supporting a portfolio of claims with vendors
  • Collaborate and liaise with the Strategic Sourcing team in the drafting of liquidated damages language in new agreements
  • Support recurrent training of product support provisions contained in all technical contracts

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree or related experience
  • Three (3) years of experience in supply chain, logistics, finance, or similar industry
  • Proven people leadership
  • Understanding of material logistics, supply chain management and contract administration
  • Strong negotiation, communication, analytical and organization skills
  • Advanced MS Excel
  • Up to 20% travel
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Three (3) years of experience initiating claims using data extracts, filtering transactions with available knowledge of existing contracts, negotiating settlements with suppliers and processing payments
  • Experience with contract intelligence tools, or implementation of technology solutions supporting contract management processes
  • Boeing PSAA and Airbus SSC product support provisions
  • Able to draft concise product support contract terms
  • Advanced knowledge of SCEPTRE
  • Able to write complex SQL queries
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and effectively leverages them for research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to company policies related to responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.

The base pay range for this role is $102,220.00 to $133,194.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
Marketing Manager, Japan


Job Summary:


We are looking for a Marketing Manager to drive sustainable growth for Trip.com Japan, a leading online travel agency, by solving critical business and organizational problems. This role goes beyond managing individual projects. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and execution, owning product growth initiatives that connect global product capabilities with localized user experiences and on-the-ground delivery. You will play a critical role in contributing to business growth through marketing activities with strategic action planning for customers' engagement.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Execute and manage marketing activities, including campaign operations and CRM, to optimize customer touchpoints — bringing fresh ideas and local insights to enhance relevance and engagement.
  • Support the development and execution of Japan’s engagement programs, working closely with global and local cross-functional teams.
  • Monitor and analyze performance across campaigns and channels, identify improvement opportunities, and take initiative to implement actionable optimizations.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders (campaign, CRM, and operations teams) to ensure smooth execution while adapting global frameworks to local needs.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal teams and partners, proactively identifying ways to maximize business impact through collaboration.
  • Take ownership of assigned projects, manage day-to-day challenges, and drive timely delivery with a strong sense of responsibility.
  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders, sharing insights, progress, and improvement ideas to support better decision-making.
  • Manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating strong organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.


業務内容

  • 顧客接点の最適化に向けて、キャンペーンオペレーションや CRM を含むマーケティング活動を実行・管理する。新しいアイデアや現地ならではの知見を取り入れ、関連性とエンゲージメントを高める。
  • グローバル・ローカルのクロスファンクショナルチームと密接に連携しながら、日本におけるエンゲージメントプログラムの企画・実行をサポートする。
  • キャンペーンおよびチャネル全体のパフォーマンスをモニタリング・分析し、改善機会を特定して、実効性のある最適化施策を主体的に実行する。
  • グローバルのステークホルダー(キャンペーン、CRM、オペレーションチーム)と協働し、グローバルの枠組みを現地のニーズに適応させながら、円滑な実行を確保する。
  • 社内チームやパートナーと強固な協力関係を構築し、協働を通じて事業インパクトを最大化する方法を主体的に見出す。
  • 担当プロジェクトのオーナーシップを持ち、日々の課題に対応しながら、強い責任感を持って納期通りのデリバリーを推進する。
  • ステークホルダーと明確なコミュニケーションを図り、インサイトや進捗、改善アイデアを共有して、より良い意思決定を支援する。
  • 優れた組織力・優先順位付け・問題解決能力を発揮しながら、スピード感のある環境で複数のタスクを管理する。


Basic Qualifications:


  • Business-level proficiency in English (spoken, written, and reading).
  • Hands-on experience in digital marketing, including areas such as customer acquisition, promotions, CRM, product marketing, or channel marketing.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and apply them to improve performance.
  • Understanding of B2C marketing fundamentals, including conversion optimization and customer journey management.
  • User-focused mindset, with the ability to identify customer needs and pain points through data and/or research, and translate them into actionable improvements.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to present ideas and insights in a structured and persuasive way.

As a Vendor Manager within the Business Operations team, you will own the performance, governance, and strategic management of a portfolio of vendors supporting the Strategic Partnerships & Affiliates (SPA) organisation. You will be responsible for ensuring vendors deliver high-quality, scalable, and compliant services that support business objectives and enhance the experience of both internal stakeholders and external partners.

Working cross-functionally with operational, commercial, and technology teams, you will drive vendor performance through robust governance, data-driven decision making, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will identify opportunities to optimise processes, implement automation, mitigate operational risks, and improve service delivery outcomes. As the organisation continues to scale, you will play a key role in evolving ops vendor management from a transactional function into a strategic capability that delivers measurable business value, operational efficiency, and long-term partnership success.

Responsibilities

  • Lead vendor governance across internal and external teams, supporting the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of the vendor operating model.
  • Manage vendor performance, value delivery, and commercial outcomes, ensuring contractual obligations, service levels, quality standards, and key performance indicators are consistently achieved.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement with vendor partners, driving scalability, operational efficiency, process standardisation, and service excellence.
  • Monitor vendor performance trends, identify risks and performance gaps, conduct root cause analysis, and own the development and execution of vendor improvement plans.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to support the delivery of vendor-enabled transformation initiatives, including automation and process optimisation opportunities, ensuring clear requirements, effective testing, operational readiness, and sustainable support models are established.
  • Define and optimise support frameworks, quality controls, escalation processes, and governance mechanisms to ensure reliable and scalable service delivery.
  • Drive prioritisation and alignment of vendor initiatives, balancing business needs, vendor capacity, and strategic objectives while managing stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for vendor-related operational risks, service issues, and performance concerns, coordinating resolution across internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven experience in vendor management, ideally within a digital, e-commerce or technology environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive vendor performance using performance metrics, governance routines, and data-driven insights.
  • Experience in the implementation of automation, tooling and technology-enabled operations.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, and decision-making capability.
  • Strong stakeholder management experience, with the ability to influence at a senior level.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, ambiguous environment and prioritising across multiple vendors, stakeholders, and requests.
  • Solid analytical skills; able to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into concrete actions for vendors and internal teams.
  • Experience in travel, online marketplaces, or partner/affiliate ecosystems is a plus.

AI Quality Assurance Program Manager I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The AI Quality Assurance Program Manager ensures that all artificial intelligence systems across Tripadvisor’s Travel Experiences execute reliably, accurately, and aligned with business goals. Positioning yourself at the intersection of AI performance, traveler satisfaction, and product development, you will establish testing frameworks, audit AI outputs, and turn quality findings into actionable operational insights. You will drive performance tracking, unblock cross-functional teams, and regularly report AI accuracy, success metrics, and enhancement roadmaps to executive leadership.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week/month in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the AI-Era Quality Strategy: Establish the end-to-end quality framework across human agents and AI agents, evolving QA from traditional sample-based auditing toward continuous, AI-enabled quality management.
  • Establish AI Quality & Testing Frameworks: Design and maintain comprehensive evaluation benchmarks, testing protocols, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows to verify AI agents, support bots, and recommendation engines operate as intended.
  • Audit AI Outputs & Traveler Interactions: Continuously evaluate AI-generated outputs (e.g., automated support chats, tour recommendation accuracy, and booking updates) for intent fulfillment, safety, tone, and hallucination prevention.
  • Drive Business Updates & Insights: Deliver executive-ready reporting that translates complex QA evaluation data, model accuracy rates, and error trends into strategic recommendations for business leaders.
  • Lead Cross-Functional AI Improvements: Partner closely with Data Science, AI Engineering, Product, and CX teams to turn QA findings into prompt refinements, model fine-tuning, and updated knowledge base inputs.
  • Maintain Release Momentum: Track project timelines for new AI deployments, manage QA regression testing schedules, and hold technical teams accountable to quality standards before full traveler rollout.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years in technical program management, QA management, or AI/ML product operations focused on system reliability and evaluation.
  • AI Evaluation Expertise: Strong operational knowledge of AI/LLM testing methodologies, prompt evaluation, intent recognition accuracy, and AI safety guardrails.
  • Data-Driven Insight Delivery: Proven ability to analyze AI logs, leverage analytics tools, and turn quality metrics into clear, executive-ready presentations and dashboards.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional track record of bridging technical AI engineering teams with business stakeholders and front-line traveler support operations.
  • Domain Empathy: Deep interest in online travel, traveler behavior, and maintaining high trust across consumer-facing AI interactions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with modern LLM evaluation tools, annotation platforms, or customer service AI tools (e.g., Zendesk AI, Intercom, Salesforce).
  • Background in travel tech, e-commerce marketplaces, or fast-scaling consumer platforms.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
