About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪 Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Creator Manager to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

This is your chance to be part of something big. As our first social Creator Manager in APAC, you’ll shape a creator programme that doesn’t just rack up views - it helps people travel smarter. 

We’re after a sharp strategist with serious creative instincts and a sixth sense for what works on social. Someone who gets that influence starts with trust and builds it through relevance, resonance and bold moves that pay off.

You’ll shape our influencer strategy across partnering with creators to craft content that’s helpful, saveable, scroll-stopping and platform-perfect. Not rinse-and-repeat brand deals, but thoughtful collaborations that feel true to each creator and genuinely useful to their communities. 

Working closely with our Regional APAC and Global Social & Community Leads (plus your counterparts across EMEA and AMER), you’ll help build a world-class creator model - one that earns trust, drives performance and turns Skyscanner into the travel brand people love. 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building standout creator collaboration: You’ll develop meaningful relationships with creators across key APAC markets, turning successful collaborations into long-term partnerships delivering sustained value for both them and us. 
  • Designing purposeful creator strategies: You’ll work hand-in-hand with our regional and global Social & Community team to ensure creator content isn’t just an aesthetic, it’s purposeful and aligns with our broader brand and marketing strategies and activities.
  • Manage multi-market creator programmes and campaigns:  You’ll manage our rolling organic advocate programmes across APAC markets alongside splash campaign activities, in collaboration with agencies, freelancers and partners to deliver stories that people genuinely want to watch, save and share.
  • Localising with insight: You’ll provide sharp APAC market expertise, ensuring our global creator strategy lands authentically in every region without losing its local flavour. 
  • Spotting relevant trends: You’ll identify the right cultural moment and social media trends to develop bold creator activations that land with meaning and momentum.
  • Scaling our commission-led model: You’ll work in collaboration with our Senior Affiliate Marketing Manager, building a creator affiliate programme that works for emerging voices and established names alike. 
  • Optimising for performance: You’ll use analytics platforms, such as insights tools for creator vetting, social dashboards for metrics tracking and performance reporting frameworks, to drive decision, measure impact and improve results.

About You

  • Creator ecosystem expert: You know the creator world inside and out, with experience from agencies, in-house teams, or both. You’ve ran campaigns across APAC (including South Korea, India, Japan, Taiwan, Australia), understand how each market differs and aren’t afraid to get hands-on with creator tooling. And when it comes to local regulations and disclosure rules, you’ve got them covered.
  • Strategic operator: You know how to plan, launch, measure and optimise creator campaigns that don’t just go live, they go far. 
  • Platform fluent: Across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube you speak their language, understand platform quirks and instinctively know what plays where. Plus, you will test new platform opportunities for creator activities.
  • Relationship builder: You’re the kind of person who turns introductions into long-term partnerships. From spotting rising talent early to nurturing trusted collaborators over time, you build relationships that can last well beyond a single campaign.
  • Cross-functional connector:  You’re confident working with agencies and freelancers - crafting sharp briefs, giving thoughtful feedback and pushing for best-in-class creative while protecting the creator’s voice. You know standout work happens when collaboration is built on trust and clarity. 
  • Comms expert: Internally, you’re the glue. You keep freelancers, agencies and internal stakeholders and channels aligned, informed and moving in the same direction whilst balancing creative ambition with commercial reality and making it all feel seamless. You're also a clear communicator with an internal radar for timelines, to-do lists and the tiny details that keep everything running like clockwork. 
  • Trend spotter: You’ve got a sixth sense for emerging travel creators and cultural shifts before the algorithm catches on. 
  • Commercially savvy: You’re confident managing contracts, invoices and budgets. You know how to negotiate fairly and effectively. 
  • Data-driven decision maker: You love getting into the numbers, using insights to improve performance and guide smarter creative bets. You will be curious about the role of creators in the emerging world of LLMs and AI.

What It’s Like Here

We are the real deal — no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Description de l'entreprise

Le siteThalassa Sea & Spa Le Touquet incarne les valeurs de la marque Thalassa Sea & Spa, offrant à nos clients une expérience inoubliable alliant détente, confort et gastronomie. Le site offre le choix entre une expérience hôtelière de qualité 3 étoiles (Ibis) et 4 étoiles (Novotel), ainsi qu'un Institut de Thalassothérapie équipé d'une piscine d'eau de mer chauffée et de 2 bassins de soins collectifs.

Description du poste

Prêt(e) à donner du sens aux chiffres dans un lieu d'exception ?

Entre la plage, les embruns et l'effervescence d'un complexe hôtelier où chaque journée est différente, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Contrôleur(se) de Gestion .

Au sein du site Novotel / Ibis / Institut Thalassa Le Touquet , vous ne serez pas simplement derrière des tableaux Excel. Vous serez un véritable partenaire de terrain, au cœur de la performance de nos activités hôtelières, de restauration et de bien-être.

Si vous aimez comprendre, analyser, proposer, accompagner et voir concrètement l'impact de votre travail, alors vous pourriez bien être la personne que nous attendons.

Rattaché(e) au Directeur Administratif et Financier, vous accompagnez les équipes dans le pilotage de la performance de l'établissement.

Concrètement, Vous Serez Amené(e) à

  • Suivre la performance du site (hôtellerie, restauration, institut) : analyse des P&L par points de ventes
  • Assurer le suivi et l'analyse de la cohérence entre achats, stocks et consommations restauration
  • Suivre et analyser la cohérence des outils de restauration (logiciels INFRASYS et FUTURELOG)
  • Site Proposer des plans d'actions en fonction de l'évolution des indicateurs des performances
  • Analyser et suivre les déchets alimentaires
  • Assurer le suivi des fiches techniques en collaboration avec le service restauration
  • Suivre et accompagner les chefs de service pour les procédures d'audit interne
  • Être le support au service comptabilité notamment en période de clôture, bilan et budget
  • Contrôler mensuellement les fonds de caisses de tous les points de ventes
  • Réaliser l'inventaire et les clôtures des stocks
  • Remplacer ponctuellement l'économe
  • Collaborateur avec les équipes terrain
  • Respecter les normes HACCP
  • Être référent des demandes transversales à l'établissement (clé verte, RGPD, audit, …)

Cette liste n'est pas exhaustive. Parce qu'un complexe vit toute l'année… et évolue sans cesse.

Qualifications

Ce que nous recherchons

Vous aimez les chiffres, mais vous appréciez surtout les faire parler.

Vous êtes curieux(se), rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et vous aimez aller sur le terrain pour comprendre le fonctionnement d'une activité.

Vous savez travailler en équipe, dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs variés et proposer des solutions concrètes.

Une première expérience en contrôle de gestion, idéalement dans l'hôtellerie, la restauration ou les services, sera naturellement un atout.

Informations supplémentaires

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous évoluez dans un environnement dynamique où l'hôtellerie, la restauration et le bien-être se rencontrent, au sein d'un établissement reconnu et d'un grand groupe international.

Et parce que nous savons aussi prendre soin de nos collaborateurs :

  • Contrat à durée indéterminée – 35 heures hebdomadaires + 2 heures supplémentaires majorées à 10% (annualisation du temps de travail)
  • Travail sur site, 5 jours par semaine (flexibilité horaire en fonction des événements mensuels)
  • Rémunération : 2 300 € à 2 400 € brut mensuels , selon votre profil
  • Convention HCR
  • 13ᵉ mois après une an d'ancienneté
  • Prime d'intéressement collectif
  • Prime de participation aux bénéfices du Groupe
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Dispositif d'épargne salariale
  • Prime carburant
  • Tarifs préférentiels dans les hôtels Accor
  • Avantages du Comité Social et Économique
  • Parking gratuit sur site
  • Accès aux équipements sportifs du site (salle de sport, piscine…)
  • Récupération des jours fériés après 3 mois d'ancienneté

Et si c'était vous ?

Vous recherchez un poste où vos analyses ont un véritable impact sur les décisions ?

Vous aimez être proche du terrain autant que des chiffres ?

Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, au bord de la mer, au sein d'équipes engagées et passionnées ?

Alors rencontrons-nous.

Job Title

Legal Counsel

Job Description Summary

Serve as Legal Counsel supporting Hospitality Travel Intelligence business unit.

Support the Travel Intelligence business unit as the first level legal advisor, including supporting for the Travel Intelligence partnership team, data governance matters, and commercial contracting activities. Draft and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including SaaS, data licensing, technology partner, and data distribution agreements. Provide clear, pragmatic legal advice to senior business stakeholders, contribute to the review and launch of new products, and support Go-To-Market and product strategies. Manage legal aspects of partner and vendor relationships, including support on strategic partnerships. Advise on applicable regulatory and compliance frameworks.

Provide day-to-day legal support across the business by actively engaging across the organization, including product, sales, account management, order management, VISTA, finance, R&D, operations, CISO, Risk and Complaince, IP, Group Privacy Unit, regulatory team. Provide legal support for cross-functional initiatives that expand Travel Intelligence offerings across Travel Unit and Travel Distribution customer segments, ensuring alignment with broader commercial and strategic objectives. Lead the coordination on compliance, data privacy, and data governance matters as they relate to the Travel Intelligence business; exercise discretion in keeping HOS Legal leadership informed of any relevant matters.

Provide practical business-oriented solutions to complex legal issues. Manage competing priorities and multi-task in a fast-paced, demanding environment.

As a Legal Counsel Your Role Will Be To

Business Support

  • Act as legal counsel supporting the fast-growing business area of Travel Intelligence with its wide ranging service offering, by providing tailored legal advice throughout the complete product lifecycle.
  • Collaborate closely and provide strategic advice to the counsel leading the Destinations & More Sales area with particular focus on data governance and commercialization to support its transversal expansion into broader customer segments, including drafting and negotiating of a variety of commercial agreements (e.g., Data as a Service agreements, distribution agreements, technology partner agreements, SaaS agreements).
  • Keep abreast of the evolution of the applicable Regulatory and industry landscape in order to provide forward-looking advice to HOS Legal leadership in order to mitigate potential detrimental impacts on Amadeus.
  • Provide solution-oriented, responsive and commercially-practical legal advice, while mitigating legal risks and exposure.
  • Develop and present legal positions and negotiations strategies for high-value and high-visibility deals to HOS Legal and Business leadership.
  • Pro-actively liaise internally to ensure all escalations and approvals are obtained throughout all processes.
  • Role includes direct and significant interfacing and negotiating with HOS mid and senior level business and product teams and external lawyers; the Employee is expected to pro-actively consult with other support units in Legal (Regulatory, IP, Privacy, Data Governance, etc.) as necessary to advance (strategic) product developments and contract negotiations.
  • In-depth understanding of the broad product suite.

Risk and Compliance support

  • Own the monitoring and prompt revision of all relevant contract templates to adapt to changes in the product, partner and vendor, industry or regulatory landscape. Ensure HOS Legal leadership is aware and aligned with such revisions.
  • Lead relevant compliance and risk management initiatives related to business areas supported and escalate to senior HOS Legal leadership as required.
  • Ensure Amadeus general and Hospitality-specific policies and standards are maintained and enforced consistently.
  • Liaise and collaborate with Amadeus Privacy, Risk & Compliance, Data Governance, and CISO teams to ensure uniform enforcement of policies and minimization of risk. These activities also require appropriate levels of knowledge sharing with other legal team members, especially the General Counsel and Deputy General Counsel.
  • Take a leading role compliance-related projects as they arise and keep HOS Legal leadership sufficiently informed about the progress of such projects.
  • Exercise sound judgement and discretion on risk acceptance and escalation to HOS Legal leadership where appropriate

Internal customer support

  • Serve as trusted legal advisor to the supported business areas. Review and respond to a variety of questions from the business and keeping the overall Hospitality strategy at mind while providing such advice.
  • Support and liaise with various internal areas, including product, sales, account management, CISO, operations, technology and engineering, marketing, finance, delivery, customer care, order management and communications as well as Legal colleagues in TRU and TRD.
  • Provide practical business-oriented solutions to complex legal issues. Role requires providing expedient, reliable, off-the-cuff advice on a wide variety of general issues relating to the supported business areas.
  • In connection with the roll-out of updated contract terms, pro-actively communicate any relevant changes to affected internal stakeholders and represent HOS Legal in the overall roll-out stream of any such updated contract terms.
  • Manage competing priorities and multi-task in a fast-paced, demanding environment. Effectively communicate to relevant stakeholders (business and legal) on competing priorities ensuring the understanding and buy-in from such stakeholders.
  • Represents Hospitality Travel Intellgence Legal in transversal initiatives and working groups as required.

General Legal Support

  • Pro-actively maintain and update all HOS Travel Intelligence contract templates (MSA, data sharing, partner & vendor forms) and policies and keep HOS Legal leadership updated on any such updates at all times.
  • The role will also require coordinating with all applicable teams to update terms as products evolve and customer feedback is taken into account.
  • In close collaboration with all relevant internal stakeholders, lead the Travel Intellgence related continuous updating of the online terms and conditions, including general terms, product-specific terms and third party terms.
  • Provide legal support on various other matters, such as conducting legal research, performing due diligence/data mining reviews, assistance with the preparation of negotiation guidelines, preparation and delivery of legal training to the business, assisting in the development of processes/systems to streamline the delivery of legal services to the company (e.g., automation and other efficiency-related initiatives), and ad hoc matters/projects, as they arise.
  • Occasionally, assist with other Hospitality legal matters outside of Travel Intelligence area.

Experience

About the ideal candidate:

  • Qualified lawyer with 10+ years PQE
  • Strong experience in commercial, IT, SaaS or data-related contracts
  • Background in law firm and/or in-house environment
  • Experience in complex negotiations and stakeholder management

Skills & Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of SaaS, data governance, and regulatory frameworks
  • Strong drafting, analytical, and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment

Education & Languages

  • Law degree (LLM is a plus)
  • Fluent in English; additional European language is a plus

Tools

  • Familiarity with legal tech and contract management tools (e.g. Ironclad)

What We Can Offer You

  • 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including bonus, equity, pension plan, travel, life and healthcare insurance, as well as lunch and transport allowance and other benefits.
  • 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  • 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  • 🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  • 🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.
  • 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  • 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  • 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

Grand Hyatt Cancún Beach Resort busca un(a) Ama de Llaves Ejecutiva para liderar la preparación y operación del área de habitaciones, lavandería y áreas públicas del resort.

Garantizar que las habitaciones, suites y áreas públicas cumplan consistentemente con los estándares de limpieza, presentación, calidad y servicio de una propiedad de lujo.

Principales responsabilidades:

Experiencia y aptitudes deseadas

当社について:

世界的な温泉地である別府に誕生した、唯一無二のラグジュアリーリゾート「ＡＮＡインターコンチネンタルホテル別府リゾート&スパ」。開放的な客室は全89室。息を呑む絶景が広がるインフィニティプール、スパ、露天風呂や温泉施設、4つの会議室・宴会場、クラブインターコンチネンタルを備え、最高のひとときをお届けします。モダンかつ日本ならではの美しいデザインを取り入れたレストランとバーでは、季節の食材とシェフの独創的なアイディアが詰まった洗練された料理が、特別なひとときを演出します。

＜チーフエンジニア募集＞

温泉、スパ、客室、レストランなど、リゾート全体の施設管理を統括するChief Engineerを募集します。

このポジションでは、日々の設備運営だけでなく、オーナーとの窓口としてCAPEX計画の立案・推進を担い、ホテル資産価値の向上をリードしていただきます。

世界的ラグジュアリーブランドであるInterContinentalの品質基準を維持しながら、別府ならではの温泉資源を活かした施設運営を実現する重要な経営ポジションです。

施設管理の専門性、リーダーシップ、そして経営視点を兼ね備えた方からのご応募をお待ちしています。

日常業務内容:

  • ホテル設備管理 ホテルおよび温泉施設の設備維持管理全般 電気設備、空調設備、給排水設備、機械設備の保守管理 温泉関連設備の運転管理および予防保全 修繕計画の策定・実施 設備トラブル対応および緊急対応
  • チームマネジメント エンジニアリングチームの統括 業務計画立案および人員配置 部下育成、評価、パフォーマンス管理 安全衛生および法令遵守の推進
  • 予算・コンプライアンス管理 修繕・設備投資予算の管理 外部業者との契約・折衝 各種法定点検および監査対応 省エネルギー施策・環境活動の推進 ゲストエクスペリエンス向上 快適で安全な滞在環境の提供 温泉リゾートとしての施設品質向上 ホテルブランド基準の維持・改善
  • CAPEX・資産管理 ホテルの中長期設備投資計画（CAPEX）の策定および実行 設備更新・改修プロジェクトの予算立案、進捗管理、品質管理 オーナー企業への提案資料作成および設備投資案件のプレゼンテーション 投資対効果を考慮した設備改善・省エネルギー施策の推進 ホテル資産価値の維持・向上に向けた戦略立案

応募者に求めるもの:

【経験・スキル】

  • 必須 ホテル、商業施設、病院、工場等における施設管理経験 建築設備、電気設備、機械設備に関する知識・経験 マネジメント経験 問題解決能力および高いコミュニケーション能力
  • 歓迎 ホテル・リゾート施設での勤務経験 温泉施設やスパ設備の管理経験 英語でのコミュニケーション能力

新しいことにチャレンジしたい方、多様性のある職場環境でスキルを磨きたい方歓迎いたします！

当社が提供するもの:

  • 年間公休：120日
  • 各種社会保険完備
  • 各種教育訓練制度

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

We’re looking for a driven, resilient, and results-oriented Account Executive to strengthen our expert Sales Team in Berlin. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in our growth by acquiring the best and most popular things to do in travel destinations. You will focus on building and managing a high-performing sales pipeline, negotiating optimal terms, and driving supplier acquisition in the DACH region. This is a unique opportunity to directly impact millions of travelers while advancing GetYourGuide’s position in the experience industry.

Your Mission

  • Identify, acquire and onboard new suppliers, primarily tour and experience providers, as well as attractions.
  • Effectively manage the entire sales funnel, including outreach, negotiation, closing, and onboarding, to consistently hit and exceed quota.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align supplier acquisition with broader business goals, ensuring sustainable growth.
  • Represent GetYourGuide at relevant industry events to drive acquisition and establish credibility.
  • Regularly travel (up to 15%) to build strong relationships with suppliers in destination and create long-term partnerships

Your Toolkit

  • You have 3+ years of experience in B2B sales acquisition, with a proven track record of exceeding sales targets, running a disciplined, data-driven process, and confidently using sales tools and software — including CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and sales enablement tools.
  • You are resilient, hungry for success, and thrive under pressure, consistently raising the bar for yourself.
  • You speak German at a native level as well as proficiency in English.
  • You excel at handling objections, reframing conversations with insights, and creating constructive tension to close challenging deals.
  • You bring strong problem-solving skills, using data to prioritize actions and inform decisions.
  • You are an excellent communicator, able to articulate value propositions clearly to diverse audiences, adapting your approach for maximum impact.
  • You collaborate with peers, share best practices, and lift the team to new heights.

What Sets You Apart

  • You’re energized by AI: you make time to experiment, build intuition through hands-on trials, and translate discoveries into practical improvements in how you work.

We want your journey with us to be extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits
  • And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.company_description: 🌎 We're here to help every traveller explore the world effortlessly, with a vision to become the world's number one travel ally.
job.job_description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪 Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Social Media Manager, APAC (12-Month FTC) to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

We’re on a mission to become the world’s number one travel ally and this is your chance to help us get there.

As a Social Media Manager for the APAC region, you will work closely with our Regional APAC team and Global Social & Community Leads. You will manage social media activities in our optimised APAC markets. Additionally, you will help launch new markets that fit our business needs.

You play a key role in growing our social media presence while actively engaging with travellers across multiple platforms. Community engagement, creative content and third-party management come naturally to you. More importantly, you have a solid pulse on social - knowing what the latest trends are and translating them into ideas for Skyscanner.

This role is for someone who can connect with everything that’s happening across social, supercharge our brand’s social presence and works to drive measurable impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Regional APAC social activities and campaigns:  You’ll support the management of owned activities across multiple markets alongside any global or regional campaigns with the help of our external partners.
  • Launch and develop new markets: You will work closely with regional stakeholders, including the APAC creator manager. Your goal is to develop social launch plans for new APAC markets. This ensures that the content, community, and operations are prepared and aligned with business priorities.
  • Own social content & storytelling: You'll oversee the development of engaging, platform relevant content that resonates with our audience and is aligned to brand guidelines. You’ll also identify opportunities to localise global campaigns to cater to market-specific nuances.
  • Community management: You understand the importance of community engagement and can guide a team of external partners in responding to comments, messages as well as user-generated content.
  • New local platform research: You’ll monitor for emerging social platforms within the region to identify opportunities to deepen social footprint in markets. You’ll conduct the right analysis to ascertain launch feasibility and impact.
  • Spotting trends: You’ll be able to identify the right cultural moments and social media trends. You’ll work with external partners to develop timely content or community management tactics that land with meaning and momentum.
  • Optimising performance: You’ll use analytics platforms, such as insights tools, to track performance and translating these insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Third-party management: You'll be managing and working closely with external partners across the various markets to ensure smooth delivery on owned activities.
  • Regional planning support: You'll assist our regional and global leads on planning, reporting and budget processes where needed to ensure smooth delivery across owned activities.
  • Team coordination: You’ll support our regional team in ensuring contracts and invoices for external partners are processed on time. You’ll also support the management of our regional freelancer tooling platforms (such as UGC collection and moderation).

About You

  • Social media expert: You live and breathe social. You know that there’s no such thing as ‘one size fits all’ when it comes to storytelling on different platforms. You’ve had some regional experience in APAC (including Malaysia, Taiwan & Australia) and understand how each market differs.
  • Creative storyteller: You have the creative mind to transform data, trends and product stories into engaging and shareable content that will resonate with local audiences.
  • Trend spotter: You’re deeply connected to internet trends and know how to identify which ones are worth acting on.
  • Platform native: You understand the nuances across key platforms in APAC, how audiences behave on each and have a good sense of how algorithms work. You are also endlessly curious about what’s next and on the lookout for emerging platforms to test for opportunities.
  • Cross-functional connector: You’re confident working with agencies and freelancers - giving thoughtful feedback and promoting for best-in-class creatives while staying true to what we are as a brand.
  • Comms expert: You keep freelancers, agencies as well as internal stakeholders aligned and informed about ongoing activities. You're able to communicate timelines, to-do lists and the tiny details that keep everything running like clockwork.
  • Data-informed: You’re confident using social analytics to understand performance, uncover insights and using it to improve content strategies.
  • Project manager: You have robust project management skills and can balance multiple markets/deadlines all at once while also being flexible to adapt to changing priorities. Being organised is one of your greatest strengths, and you're able to keep multiple work-streams transitioning along while never losing sight of the details.

What It’s Like Here

We are the real deal — no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better — and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

We're committed to ensuring our application and recruitment processes are inclusive and accessible to everyone. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations for interviews, and/or wish to apply under the Disability Confident scheme, please let your recruiter know. If you’d like more information on any of our policies, such as hybrid working or Parental Leave policies (typically we pay a minimum of 24 weeks birth parent/maternity leave globally), our recruitment team can provide more information on these.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda's Brand team is a diverse group of strategists, brand managers, media planners, project managers, visual designers, and creatives. We are master collaborators who help shape and protect what consumers, business partners, and employees see, hear, and feel about Agoda to generate trust, desire, and long-term brand loyalty. As guardians of the Agoda brand, we combine creativity, data, and consumer insight to build recognizable identity and deliver meaningful experiences across markets.

About This Role

The Agoda Ambassador program brings together creators, agencies, and Agoda teams to grow the business through authentic, performance-led content. The program operates across two verticals: Activities and Accommodations. This global individual-contributor role will lead the Activities vertical end to end, from creator acquisition and activation through agency partnerships, content growth, business strategy, and performance management. The role will also lead the engagement vertical across both Activities and Accommodations, own the program's cross-vertical automation agenda, and support broader Accommodations priorities where required. Success requires a strong commercial mindset, operational discipline, analytical fluency, and the ability to influence creators, agencies, and internal stakeholders.

In this role, you'll get to

Program strategy and business growth

  • Lead end-to-end business and operational ownership of the Activities vertical within the Agoda Ambassador program.
  • Develop and execute strategies to grow Activities bookings, active creators, posting frequency, and relevant content supply.
  • Use data and business insights to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and prioritize initiatives.
  • Work closely with the Activities Marketing team to create and activate promotional codes that support creator campaigns and business growth.
  • Support broader Accommodations and Brand team priorities where required, while maintaining focus on core Activities metrics.

Creator, agency, and partner management

  • Drive creator acquisition, onboarding, activation, and ongoing engagement for Activities.
  • Scale agency partnerships by unblocking the onboarding pipeline and directly managing relationships with at least three agencies.
  • Build trusted relationships with creators and partners, communicate expectations clearly, and resolve issues that affect participation or performance.

Engagement leadership across Activities and Accommodations

  • Lead the Agoda Ambassador engagement vertical across both Activities and Accommodations, defining the engagement strategy, priorities, and operating rhythm for creators and agencies.
  • Own the cross-vertical engagement charter, including content calendars, creator and agency communications, email responses, surveys, and the rollout of new propositions.
  • Design and deliver initiatives that increase creator participation, posting frequency, content creation, and sustained program activity across both verticals.
  • Use engagement and performance data to identify opportunities, refine communications, and improve creator and agency effectiveness.

Content activation and program operations

  • Plan and activate creator content for Activities across relevant social platforms and markets.
  • Coordinate product and supply workflows with internal teams, balancing partner needs with program and business performance.
  • Manage multiple workstreams across creators, agencies, marketing, product, technology, supply, and Brand stakeholders in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Provide product and technical support by identifying issues, coordinating with the right teams, and driving them through to resolution.

Automation, analytics, and performance

  • Lead the automation of the Agoda Ambassador program across both Activities and Accommodations to improve efficiency, scalability, and partner experience.
  • Track, analyze, and communicate program performance, including daily Activities bookings, the number of active creators generating at least one booking, creator posting activity, and the volume of Activities content created.
  • Build clear performance views and translate data into recommendations, actions, and business decisions.
  • Continuously improve operating processes, identify bottlenecks, and create scalable ways of working across teams and external partners.

What You'll Need To Succeed

  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in social media, affiliate marketing within an online business, creator or influencer programs, agency management, partnerships, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing creator, agency, or partner relationships and delivering measurable commercial or engagement outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and hands-on comfort with SQL and Tableau, with the ability to turn data into clear business insights and growth strategies.
  • Experience using social monitoring tools to understand content activity, engagement, and program performance.
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, or a strong willingness and ability to learn and apply them to improve program operations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, agency negotiation, creator communication, commercial thinking, and project management skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a bias for action, with the ability to lead complex cross-functional work and manage multiple priorities independently.
  • High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively across global teams and external partners.

About The Opportunity

Join our Commercial Finance team as a Commercial Finance Analyst supporting the Commercial Software function. You’ll partner directly with the Global CTO and leadership team, turning financial, investment, and performance data into actionable insights that shape business decisions. This is a highly visible role where you'll influence investment priorities, drive financial performance, and help create greater transparency across a growing technology environment. If you enjoy combining commercial thinking, financial analysis, and stakeholder partnership, this is an exceptional opportunity to make a real impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the Global CTO and leadership team as the primary finance contact, translating financial information into actionable business insights.
  • Own budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes for the Commercial Software teams.
  • Deliver month-end reporting, variance analysis, and commentary on actual versus budget and forecast performance.
  • Monitor and report on key software commercial KPIs, including headcount, cloud spend, SaaS licensing, and project profitability.
  • Develop financial models, investment appraisals, and business cases to support strategic decision-making.
  • Support capital expenditure and operating expenditure classification and development cost capitalisation activities.
  • Constructively challenge cost and investment decisions to maximise business value and returns.
  • Improve reporting processes, data quality, and operational efficiency through the use of BI tools and best practices.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis and commercial support for initiatives, contracts, and pricing decisions.
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA).
  • 3+ years PQE.
  • Proven experience in Commercial Finance, FP&A, or business partnering roles.
  • Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills.
  • Advanced Excel skills including complex formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Strong financial modelling capability.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Commercially minded with strong analytical capability.
  • Experience supporting Commercial Software, Product, Engineering teams, or senior technology leaders.
  • Understanding of development cost capitalisation and SaaS revenue/cost metrics.
  • Experience in a technology or SaaS business preferred.
  • Power BI or similar BI/reporting tool experience preferred.
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.

job.job_description:
About Skyscanner

Everyone loves travelling, but planning is not without its challenges ✈️. That's why we've spent 20 years building tools that turn travel-planning chaos into a breeze. Today, around 160 million travellers count on us every month to skip the whole “47 browser tabs open” phase and find flights, cars, and hotels quickly and easily 💻.

Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍.

Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here).

Now, we’re on the lookout for a Business Development and Partnerships Manager to help us bring that vision to even more travellers.

About The Role

(Hybrid)

As the Business Development and Partnerships Manager joining our Affiliate and Performance Partnerships team, you will thrive on building meaningful partnerships and thinking big picture for our program. You will lean into data-led decision-making, be adaptable to our enterprise partners' needs, and have strong commercial awareness. This role requires a strong negotiator with experience managing complex partner relationships.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Sales / Negotiations - You are a sales and negotiation expert. You love working with partners and know how to find value in those relationships that works for everyone.
  • Big picture thinker - You are a creative and big-picture thinker – nothing is impossible.
  • Forward thinker - You are an early adopter and like to be ahead of the competition – you look for partners that share those values.
  • Partnership Management - Own and manage a portfolio of current partnerships by quickly building personal relationships with our global enterprise-sized partnerships and assessing opportunities to grow revenue.
  • Reporting / Insights - Provide consistent reporting and insights to external partners as well as internal stakeholders.
  • Data-driven decisions - Leverage internal data, partner insights, market trends, and the competitive landscape to make data-driven recommendations for perpetual improvements
  • Tech knowledge - Continually researching and understanding the global travel tech environment to ensure that we remain at the forefront of the industry.
  • Industry knowledge - Conduct competitive intelligence scans/benchmarking and develop strategies to adapt to changing environment within the travel vertical
  • Partner growth - Lead and assist in negotiating media placements, collaborations, and exclusives with key partners
  • Commercial - Identify and initiate new ideas, incentives and bonus structures to achieve and exceed performance goals

About You

  • Sales / Partner management experience - Strong sales, negotiation and partnership management skills – knowing the travel tech space is a plus
  • Business Development - Demonstrated success conducting outreach and recruiting for new performance-based marketing partners and relationships
  • Technical partner integration experience - Deep technical skills and the ability to talk product: knowledge on APIs, feeds, widgets, etc
  • Team player / Autonomous - Ambitious, results-driven individual who enjoys working as a team but can also thrive independently
  • Analytical - Able to analyse data and determine partner or market success focused around ROI
  • Commercial understanding - Commercial outlook, negotiation and experience of managing 3rd parties
  • Relationship builder - You love people. You’ll be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with hundreds (if not thousands) of partners
  • Business acumen - Strong business and marketing acumen with an ability to identify business opportunities, deliver results, and adjust plans as appropriate
  • Tooling / Technologies / AI - Experience with management and tracking technologies used to measure performance and do business development

What It's Like Here

We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭.

Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨.

Sound like your kind of adventure? 🚀 Apply now and help us shape the future of travel.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Agoda's Brand team is a diverse group of strategists, brand managers, media planners, project managers, visual designers, and creatives. We are master collaborators who help shape and protect what consumers, business partners, and employees see, hear, and feel about Agoda to generate trust, desire, and long-term brand loyalty. As guardians of the Agoda brand, we combine creativity, data, and consumer insight to build recognizable identity and deliver meaningful experiences across markets.

About This Role

The Agoda Ambassador program brings together creators, agencies, and Agoda teams to grow the business through authentic, performance-led content. The program operates across two verticals: Activities and Accommodations. This global individual-contributor role will lead the Activities vertical end to end, from creator acquisition and activation through agency partnerships, content growth, business strategy, and performance management. The role will also lead the engagement vertical across both Activities and Accommodations, own the program's cross-vertical automation agenda, and support broader Accommodations priorities where required. Success requires a strong commercial mindset, operational discipline, analytical fluency, and the ability to influence creators, agencies, and internal stakeholders.

In this role, you'll get to

Program strategy and business growth

  • Lead end-to-end business and operational ownership of the Activities vertical within the Agoda Ambassador program.
  • Develop and execute strategies to grow Activities bookings, active creators, posting frequency, and relevant content supply.
  • Use data and business insights to identify growth opportunities, diagnose performance gaps, and prioritize initiatives.
  • Work closely with the Activities Marketing team to create and activate promotional codes that support creator campaigns and business growth.
  • Support broader Accommodations and Brand team priorities where required, while maintaining focus on core Activities metrics.

Creator, agency, and partner management

  • Drive creator acquisition, onboarding, activation, and ongoing engagement for Activities.
  • Scale agency partnerships by unblocking the onboarding pipeline and directly managing relationships with at least three agencies.
  • Build trusted relationships with creators and partners, communicate expectations clearly, and resolve issues that affect participation or performance.

Engagement leadership across Activities and Accommodations

  • Lead the Agoda Ambassador engagement vertical across both Activities and Accommodations, defining the engagement strategy, priorities, and operating rhythm for creators and agencies.
  • Own the cross-vertical engagement charter, including content calendars, creator and agency communications, email responses, surveys, and the rollout of new propositions.
  • Design and deliver initiatives that increase creator participation, posting frequency, content creation, and sustained program activity across both verticals.
  • Use engagement and performance data to identify opportunities, refine communications, and improve creator and agency effectiveness.

Content activation and program operations

  • Plan and activate creator content for Activities across relevant social platforms and markets.
  • Coordinate product and supply workflows with internal teams, balancing partner needs with program and business performance.
  • Manage multiple workstreams across creators, agencies, marketing, product, technology, supply, and Brand stakeholders in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Provide product and technical support by identifying issues, coordinating with the right teams, and driving them through to resolution.

Automation, analytics, and performance

  • Lead the automation of the Agoda Ambassador program across both Activities and Accommodations to improve efficiency, scalability, and partner experience.
  • Track, analyze, and communicate program performance, including daily Activities bookings, the number of active creators generating at least one booking, creator posting activity, and the volume of Activities content created.
  • Build clear performance views and translate data into recommendations, actions, and business decisions.
  • Continuously improve operating processes, identify bottlenecks, and create scalable ways of working across teams and external partners.

What You'll Need To Succeed

  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in social media, affiliate marketing within an online business, creator or influencer programs, agency management, partnerships, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing creator, agency, or partner relationships and delivering measurable commercial or engagement outcomes.
  • Strong analytical skills and hands-on comfort with SQL and Tableau, with the ability to turn data into clear business insights and growth strategies.
  • Experience using social monitoring tools to understand content activity, engagement, and program performance.
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, or a strong willingness and ability to learn and apply them to improve program operations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, agency negotiation, creator communication, commercial thinking, and project management skills, including the ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a bias for action, with the ability to lead complex cross-functional work and manage multiple priorities independently.
  • High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively across global teams and external partners.

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

This is where your biggest challenge awaits you:

Within the Data Department, you will join the Data Engineering vertical and report to our Data Director. Your mission will be to co-lead a Feature Team (FT) alongside a Product Owner. Your team's mission is to provide the best Data Products (Analytics and AI) to your users while ensuring the lowest possible service cost.

Context:

In the midst of organizational and digital transformation, Accor is adopting an Agile culture and the DevOps technical requirements of major players (Amazon, Google). Our technical ecosystem has evolved significantly in recent years and is now based primarily on market-leading Cloud/SaaS solutions (Snowflake, Tableau, AWS), integrating the best of open source (dbt, airflow, etc.).

Within the Data department, the Data Engineering vertical works closely with our Product, Data Managers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Scrum Masters teams.

Your Mission:

As a technical advisor and guarantor of “quality/performance,” your job will be to manage the people involved in developing and improving data products.

As Tech Lead, you will be responsible for:

  • Managing and coaching a team of Data Engineers (internal and external)
  • Ensuring the implementation of best development practices (DevOps, etc.)
  • Making technical and modeling choices in consultation with other Data Leads (Snowflake urbanization, patterns, dependencies, quality, etc.)
  • Integrating data sources under the responsibility of your FT via our in-house “DataHub” solution
  • Industrializing Data products (analytics & AI)
  • Optimizing their performance and costs (FinOps)

Qualifications

And you?

As a graduate of an engineering school or with a specialized master's degree, you have at least five years of significant experience in data and previous managerial experience.

Your enjoyment of teamwork and excellent communication skills make you a natural team leader.

You are therefore genuinely keen to develop and manage a technical team, supervise service providers, and provide technical leadership for our Data Engineering community.

With technical expertise in Snowflake or other modern data platforms (e.g., BigQuery), you are committed to:

  • taking on functional and technical challenges by providing “progressive” solutions

    developing useful and “optimized” data products

  • providing high-quality service to your user “customers”

  • challenging the status quo, proposing improvements, and implementing them

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Agile culture (Jira, Confluence, Gitlab) & DevOps (CI/CD, etc.)
  • In-depth knowledge of Snowflake features
  • Knowledge of dbt
  • Experience in data science and data products (analytics & AI)
  • Experience with different data modeling techniques
  • Bonus: Tableau (or other analytics tools), FinOps culture, and e-commerce skills (SEO/SEA)

Soft skills and leadership

  • You know how to solve problems proactively and independently, using your analytical and synthesis skills
  • You demonstrate leadership and know how to motivate a team
  • You are fluent in English (working language)
  • You are dynamic and rigorous, with a service-oriented mindset and a taste for challenge, enabling you to fully invest yourself in your mission

Additional Information

Accor dares to impact: 

- The world  

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents. 

  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

- Your career

  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences. 

  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis. 

- Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:

  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.

  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.

  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.

  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

- And also:

  • ALL - Heartist® Program: unforgettable stays and experiences at all Accor locations and partner venues worldwide. 

  • Heartist® for Good Program: commit to supporting an association of your choice from those available on our volunteering platform (1 day offered per year by the Group during your working hours). 

  • An Employee Social Committee (CSE) supporting the financing of your cultural and sports activities. 

  • Sustainable Mobility Package for the use of eco-friendly transportation or access to a company bike program in partnership with Zenride.

  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, in accordance with the rates set by French law “Loi Finance”.

  • €11 meal vouchers.

  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor without additional costs in case of enrollment of your dependents. 

  • Attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, and recreational areas as well as wellness and sports facilities, on-site or through Gymlib.



Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, including those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, regardless of gender, so go ahead and apply!



Recruitment is all about people!  

Is this mission appealing to you? Apply, and we will offer you: 

  1. A meeting with our recruitment team to present the essential aspects of the position to you or guide you towards the role that may suit you. 
  2. An interview with the team manager responsible for the role you are interested in.  
  3. For some roles, you might also be required to complete an assessment (use case and motivation questionnaire. 
  4. A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group's culture, work environment, training program, career prospects, as well as various benefits offered by the Group. 
  5. A personalized feedback.

job.job_description:
Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !



Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Au sein de la Direction Data, vous rejoignez la verticale Data Engineering et reporterez ainsi à notre Data Director. Vous avez comme mission de co-piloter une Feature Team (FT) en binôme avec un/une Product Owner. La vocation de votre équipe est de fournir les meilleurs Produits Data (Analytics et IA) à vos utilisateurs tout en assurant un cout de service le plus faible possible.

Contexte :

En pleine transformation organisationnelle et digitale, Accor adopte une culture Agile et les exigences techniques DevOps des grands acteurs (Amazon, Google). Notre écosystème technique a fortement évolué sur les dernières années, et se base désormais principalement sur les solutions Cloud/SaaS leader du marché (Snowflake, Tableau, AWS), en y intégrant les pépites de l'open source (dbt, airflow, etc.)

Au sein du département Data, la verticale Data Engineering travaille en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Product, Data Managers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, ML Engineers et nos Scrum Masters.

Votre mission :

Référent technique et garant de la "qualité/performance", votre travail consiste à piloter les acteurs intervenant sur le développement et l’amélioration des produits Data.

En tant que Tech Lead, vous aurez la responsabilité :

  • D’encadrer et de coacher une équipe de Data Engineers (internes et externes)
  • D'assurer la mise en oeuvre des bonnes pratiques de développements (DevOps, etc.)
  • Des choix techniques et de modélisation en concertation avec les autres Leads Data (urbanisation Snowflake, patterns, dépendances, qualité, etc.)
  • De l’intégration des sources de données sous la responsabilité de votre FT via notre solution maison "DataHub"
  • De l’industrialisation des produits Data (analytics & IA)
  • De l'optimisation de leurs performance et couts (FinOps)

Qualifications

Et vous ?

Diplômé d’une école d’ingénieurs ou d’un Master spécialisé, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative de 5 ans minimum dans la Data et d'une expérience managériale préalable.

Votre goût du travail en équipe et votre excellente communication vous permettent d'être un leader d'équipe.

Vous présentez ainsi une réelle volonté de développer et manager une équipe technique, à encadrer des prestataires, et à animer techniquement notre communauté Data Engineering.

Doté d'une expertise technique sur Snowflake, ou autres Modern Data Platform (ex: BigQuery), vous avez à cœur de :

  • relever des défis fonctionnels et techniques en apportant des solutions "progressives"
  • développer des produits Data utiles et "optimisés"
  • fournir un service de haute qualité à vos "clients" utilisateurs
  • challenger le status quo, proposer des améliorations et les mettre en oeuvre

Compétences Techniques

  • Maitrise de SQL et Python
  • Culture Agile (Jira, Confluence, Gitlab) & DevOps (CI/CD, etc.)
  • Connaissance approfondie des fonctionnalités Snowflake
  • Connaissance de dbt
  • Expérience autour de sujets Data Science, produits Data (analytics & IA)
  • Expérience des différentes modélisations de données
  • Les + : Tableau (ou autres outils Analytics), culture FinOps et compétences e-commerce (SEO/SEA)

Soft-skills et leadership

  • Vous savez résoudre des problèmes de façon proactive et autonome dans un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse
  • Vous faites preuve de leadership et savez animer une équipe
  • Vous maitrisez l'anglais (langue de travail)
  • Dynamique et rigoureux, ayant l'esprit de service et le goût du challenge pour vous investir pleinement au sein de votre mission

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements

Sur le monde

  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.

Sur votre carrière

  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.

Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :

  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.

  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.

  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.

  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation dédiée.

Et aussi :

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.

  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.

  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.

  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride.

  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, au barème de la Loi Finance.

  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.

  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.

  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.



Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !



Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  1. Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  2. Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,
  3. Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  4. Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  5. Un feedback personnalisé.

🌍 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group’s global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.



Job Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!



This is where your greatest challenge awaits:

Reporting to the SVP of Data Science & AI, you will join a team at the heart of the Accor Group’s transformation through data and artificial intelligence.

Within the Data department, the Data Science & AI vertical aims to define and implement the Group’s AI vision, to scale up the use of ML, GenAI and Agentic AI, and to maximise the business impact of these technologies on the customer experience, hotel operations and internal teams.

As a senior technical leader, you will drive the design, development and deployment of machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI solutions, as well as LLM-based platforms, enabling high-impact business capabilities and services.



Your Mission

  • Deliver end-to-end AI initiatives, from problem framing and model selection to experimentation, deployment and continuous improvement.
  • Design and implement LLM-based solutions, including conversational assistants, agentic workflows and other advanced AI applications.
  • Define and lead Accor’s AI architecture, ensuring scalability, flexibility and alignment with emerging technologies and industry best practices.
  • Establish and promote best practices in prompt engineering, model evaluation, MLOps and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with Data, Platform and Product teams to industrialize AI solutions that are reliable, scalable, performant and effectively monitored.
  • Mentor and support the broader Data & Engineering community on AI architectures, reusable components and software engineering best practices.
  • Drive technology watch activities and lead POCs to evaluate new models, tools and frameworks.

Qualifications

And you?



  • Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Data Science and Machine Learning, including several years working with deep learning, generative AI and LLMs.
  • Proven track record of designing, deploying and operating Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions, including chatbots, content generation platforms and agentic workflows.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain GenAI concepts, limitations and risks to non-technical audiences and influence strategic decision-making.
  • Hands-on expertise in Python and modern AI/ML frameworks and technologies, including PyTorch, LangChain, LangGraph and related ecosystems.
  • Strong knowledge of RAG, vector databases, embeddings and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Proven experience with cloud-based MLOps and LLMOps practices (AWS, MLflow, CI/CD, etc.), including LLM evaluation, observability and large-scale monitoring of quality, latency and cost.
  • Experience within hospitality, travel, retail, or large-scale B2C/B2B environments would be a strong advantage.

Additional Information

Accor dares to impact:

- the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the impact of digital on the environment across all our projects.

- your career:

  • We enable all our employees to manage their work-life balance and offer them the means to shape their work environment according to their preferences.
  • Training and career paths are defined both individually and collectively, allowing us to grow together on a daily basis.

- Specifically, at Accor Tech & Digital:

  • Remote work available several days per week from France, with flexible work options: work from home, from our offices, or even from our hotels and coworking spaces through Worklib.
  • Every Wednesday afternoon, dedicate your time to deep work and personal development.
  • Work in a multicultural and English-speaking environment.
  • Continuous improvement & training: hackathons, exceptional technology partnerships, dedicated talent management, certifications and a dedicated learning platform.

and also,

job.job_description:
Gracias a nuestra expansión, estamos buscando gente talentosa, experimentada, motivada y proactiva que vea los desafíos como oportunidades, crea en sus habilidades y posea un conjunto de competencias versátiles. Valoramos a aquellos que tienen una pasión por aprender, crecer e innovar, esforzándose por lograr el éxito y crear experiencias memorables. Únete a nuestro equipo para seguir construyendo juntos nuestra historia de éxito.

Descripción del puesto

Como Gerente de Ventas Tour and Travel, será responsable de planificar, dirigir y coordinar la distribución o movimiento de productos o servicios a los clientes. Este rol garantiza la gestión eficaz de los territorios de ventas, las cuotas y los objetivos y establece programas de formación para los representantes de ventas. El Gerente de Ventas II también analizará las estadísticas de ventas recopiladas por el personal para determinar el potencial de ventas, los requisitos de inventario y monitorear las preferencias de los clientes.

Funciones y responsabilidades del puesto

  • Desarrollar e implementar estrategias de ventas, planes territoriales y pronósticos para lograr los objetivos de ventas de la empresa.
  • Establecer y mantener relaciones sólidas con clientes, proveedores y distribuidores clave.
  • Supervisar la contratación, capacitación y desarrollo de los representantes de ventas para garantizar un equipo de alto rendimiento.
  • Supervisar y administrar los presupuestos de ventas, los gastos y los recursos para garantizar una eficiencia y un rendimiento óptimos.
  • Colabore con los equipos de marketing y administración de productos para desarrollar y ejecutar planes y actividades promocionales.
  • Lleve a cabo reuniones de ventas periódicas para revisar el progreso, analizar los desafíos y brindar orientación y apoyo a su equipo.
  • Analizar datos y tendencias de ventas para identificar oportunidades de mejora y para informar la toma de decisiones.
  • Asegurar el cumplimiento del equipo con las políticas de la empresa, las reglamentaciones legales y los estándares de la industria.
  • Completar tareas adicionales o responsabilidades asignadas.

Experiencia laboral

  • Gestiona el servicio, el apoyo o los asociados y/o supervisores profesionales
  • Adapta los planes y las prioridades departamentales para abordar los desafíos operativos y de recursos
  • Toma decisiones guiadas por políticas, recursos y plan de negocios
  • Recibe orientación moderada
  • Tiene de 5 a 7 años de experiencia laboral
  • Tiene de 0 a 1 año de experiencia gerencial

Competencias

Trabajo en equipo y colaboración

Gestión de acciones

Experiencia comercial

Defender las necesidades de los huéspedes

Impacto

Innovación

Habilidades interpersonales

Conocimiento funcional del trabajo

Liderazgo

Resolución de problemas

Desarrollo de talento

Educación

  • Se prefiere un título de asociado o una licenciatura en administración de empresas, ventas o un campo relacionado.
  • Se considerará una combinación equivalente de educación y experiencia.

Certificaciones

  • Profesional certificado en liderazgo de ventas (CSLP)
  • Ejecutivo de ventas certificado (CSE)
  • Se pueden requerir o preferir certificaciones adicionales

Si considera que reúne los requisitos anteriores, ¡esperamos recibir su solicitud!

Todas las personas aplicantes serán evaluadas y consideradas para las oportunidades en PLAYA, sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, edad, genética, identidad o expresión de género, nacionalidad o discapacidad.
