Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

Data Support Specialist I, CDS Operations (Remote)

Full time, Singapore, United Kingdom, Spain, Poland*

If you are located in the Warsaw area, you will need to work in-office for 50% of working time monthly. If you are located in the Kraków and Rzeszów areas, you will need to work in-office at least 1 day per week.

The Data Support Specialist I is the first point of contact for all support queries related to our client reporting tools. You will work on a wide range of different tasks daily, from troubleshooting data, reports, and tool issues to providing training, support, and access to the tools. You will work with Agencies, Owned, Partner, JV and 3rd Party to receive the transactional data and ensure it is processed into BCD reporting. You will also work with internal and external customers and coordinate with our internal technical teams. Client Data Solutions is a global team, so the Data Support Specialists will build close relationships with others from around the globe to support our day-to-day business.

As a Data Support Specialist I, CDS Operations, you will

  • Conduct data investigations to identify origin and potential corrections
  • Troubleshoot data and tool issues/errors, analyzing the return to make an informed deduction to be communicated to requesters
  • Set up 3rd Party exports/imports and ensure that we have the necessary Data Release Authorization in place
  • Troubleshoot report queries by reviewing report calculations, parameters and underlying data, and explaining what the reporting fields are returning and the report’s purpose
  • Create and maintain internal/external user access to our supported tools; DecisionSource, Data Quality Services, FileMover, APIs, etc
  • Understand the tools we maintain. You will know processes and best practices to provide training and guidance to users. Continue education on various functions/skills utilized in position

About You

  • Prior experience in a customer service technical support role
  • SQL and relational database knowledge
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong problem solving and process reengineering skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

What We Offer You

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About Us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

  • https://www.bcdtravel.com/blog/
  • https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/
  • https://www.instagram.com/bcdtravel/
  • https://www.facebook.com/bcdtravel/

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

This position is advertised across multiple European locations. The expected annual gross salary ranges by country are as follows:

  • Spain: 24,5470- 28,088 EUR
  • Poland: 71,205- 113,528 PLN

The final salary offered will ultimately depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and location, and will be determined in line with internal equity.

We do not request salary history and are committed to equal pay in line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com.

DESIRABLE CRITERIA

  • Experience leading workforce planning / modelling in an aviation, transport or operational setting

job.job_description:
Overview

Kundenservice liegt dir im Blut? Du bist ein echtes Verkaufstalent und liebst es, Herausforderungen im Sinne deiner Kunden zu lösen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Über Uns

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein in Deutschland wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und großartigen Aufstiegschancen. Der Hauptsitz unseres 1957 gegründeten Unternehmens ist in St. Louis (USA), aber unser globales Netzwerk erstreckt sich auf mehr als 90 Länder. Stell dir 2,3 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit über 90.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 39 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns und was wir bewegen!

Du bist stolz darauf, auch bei mehreren Aufgaben gleichzeitig den Überblick zu behalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Für unsere Filiale in Mönchengladbach  suchen wir engagierte und motivierte Kundenberater in Vollzeit (m_w_d) zur Unterstützung unseres dynamischen Teams! Direkt vor Ort berätst du unsere Kunden, vermietest Fahrzeuge, übergibst diese an unsere Kunden und kümmerst dich um alle dazugehörigen administrativen Tätigkeiten.

Responsibilities

Kein Tag ist wie der andere:

  • Vermiete das passende Auto für den individuellen Bedarf deiner Kunden
  • Dein Kunde vertraut dir als kompetenter Ansprechpartner
  • Jeder Kunde ist anders, aber dein Kundenservice ist immer gleich erstklassig
  • Administrative Tätigkeiten erledigst du schnell und professionell

Qualifications

Deine individuellen Stärken:

Kommunikative Fähigkeiten sind uns wichtig, Unternehmergeist und Teamfähigkeit wissen wir sehr zu schätzen. Erste Erfahrungen im Verkauf und Kundendienst sind garantiert von Vorteil. Aber vor allem solltest du motiviert sein und Lust dazu haben, deinen Kunden einen exzellenten Service zu bieten.

Diese Kriterien Erfüllst Du

  • Mindestalter von 18 Jahren.
  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung wünschenswert
  • Führerschein der Klasse B
  • Eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Diese Benefits Warten Auf Dich

  • Eine umfangreiche Einarbeitung in einem großartigen Filialteam
  • Eine Bandbreite an Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
  • Diverse Boni und Provisionen zusätzlich zu deinem Gehalt
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie weitere Versicherungen
  • Regelmäßige Events bzw. Firmenfeiern
  • Fahrzeuganmietung zu vergünstigten Mitarbeiterkonditionen (für dich, deine Familie und Freunde)

Deine Bewerbung

Um dich auf diese Stelle zu bewerben, klicke einfach auf „Jetzt Bewerben”. Du erstellst kurz dein Profil in unserem System und beantwortest einige stellenbezogene Fragen – fertig! Ein Recruiter wird sich mit dir in Verbindung setzten, um alles Weitere zu besprechen.

WICHTIG: Enterprise ist ein inklusiver Arbeitgeber. Es ist uns wichtig, eine Vielfalt an Mitarbeitenden mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen zu beschäftigen. Daher richtet sich diese Stellenanzeige an alle Bewerber (m_w_d). Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

job.job_description:
日本＆ミクロネシア地域におけるラグジュアリーブランドのローカライズ、定義、展開、およびパフォーマンス向上を共同で主導します。本役職は、地域の営業、オペレーション、D&E（ダイバーシティ＆インクルージョン）、開発の各チームと緊密に連携し、イニシアチブの「ホテル対応」展開を確保するとともに、ブランドおよびホテルのパフォーマンス向上を推進し、当社の成長戦略を支援します。

消費者のインサイト、競合分析、およびシステムの適応性を活用して意思決定を行い、ゲスト体験の競争力、一貫性、品質を確保するための継続的改善システムを設計・実施します。

日々の業務

グローバルフレームワークに基づき、担当地域に合わせて適宜調整したブランド戦略およびブランド計画のローカライズと実施を管理します。

各ブランドの製品・サービスイノベーションの開発、パイロット実施、およびホテルへの導入を支援し、ブランドの健全性／属性に対する認識を強化するとともに、地域内でのブランド認知度とブランドエクイティを高めます。必要に応じて、グローバルプロジェクトグループと連携して展開を行います。「ホテルレディ」プロセスの採用を確実にします。

コーポレートオフィスおよびホテル従業員向けのブランド導入プログラムの展開を管理する。

New Hotel Opening（新規開業ホテル）のエンドツーエンドでの提供を確実にするため、ホテルブランドの開業前プロセスを遂行する。

ホテルの品質管理チームのメンバーと連携し、ブランド基準およびゲスト体験基準の策定・実施・評価を管理・実行する。これにより、関連するすべての製品・サービスの改善がブランド基準に反映されるよう確保するとともに、ブランド基準が常に最新かつ正確な状態を維持されるようにする。

高品質かつ一貫性のあるホテルブランドマーケティングを支援するための地域向けツールキットおよびリソースの開発を主導し、効果的な導入を確実にする。また、その他のステークホルダーチーム（開発部門、D&Eなど）向けのブランドツールについても同様の支援を行う。

プロジェクト予算、コスト見積もり、請求書を監視・追跡し、地域内で制作されたすべてのブランド資料のファイリングシステムを整備する。

ホテル運営チームおよび地域マーケティングチームが、ホテルにおけるブランドマーケティングのコンプライアンスを達成できるよう支援する。

すべてのブランドにおいて一貫したグローバルブランドコミュニケーションガイドラインを維持するため、サブリージョンのコーポレートオフィスに対するブランドガーディアンおよび窓口としての役割を果たす。

すべてのブランド投資の成果を定量化するための適切な追跡・測定システムが整備されていることを確認し、事業上の優先事項に対して投下資金から最大の成果が得られるよう責任を負う。

ブランド／カテゴリーディレクターと連携し、マーケティング・シェアード・サービス・チームに対してブランドコミュニケーションのニーズや目標を説明し、同チームが関連する地域ブランドキャンペーンを策定・実行できるようにする。

カテゴリー、ブランド、および消費者インサイトチームと連携し、市場、ブランド、およびビジネスチャンスを徹底的に理解するための調査要件を特定・策定する。

担当地域のブランドを強化するため、既存データを分析し、必要に応じて追加調査を実施し、現在および将来の消費者ニーズ、製品・ブランド認知度、価格・価値に対する認識、ならびに消費者および仲介業者の動向に関する知見を最大限に深める。

地域ステークホルダー向けコミュニケーションプログラムの策定および実施を支援する。

応募要項

学歴

マーケティング、コミュニケーション、またはビジネス関連の学位を有することが望ましい

経験

ラグジュアリー・ホスピタリティ業界、またはその他の消費者向けラグジュアリー分野において、5年以上の実務経験（特に大手多国籍企業での経験が望ましい）。マーケティングおよび／またはブランドマネジメントに重点を置いた職務経験があること

アジア地域における多国籍企業での実務経験

必須スキル

プレゼンテーションスキル、人前で話す能力、グループでの意思決定のファシリテーションを含む、優れた口頭および書面によるコミュニケーション能力

自主性があり、自発的に行動できること

優れたプロジェクト管理能力およびステークホルダー管理能力

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

About The Role

Strategic Partnerships is running a multi-vertical, multi-region portfolio with real scale ambitions. The channels are defined. The teams are in place. What's missing is the machine that makes it all repeatable, and the person obsessed with building it.

This is a role for someone who chooses hard problems over safe ones, who sees an under-built operating system and can't help but fix it, and who measures success by whether the org around them got faster, sharper, and more capable. You sit at the center of how Partnerships executes: owning the planning cadences, performance frameworks, cross-functional machinery, and analytical infrastructure that lets a lean team manage a complex portfolio without losing speed or discipline.

You'll work directly with the Head of Strategic Partnerships and lead the Operations team, translating direction into action and making sure nothing important falls between the cracks. The right person for this role gets energy from closing things - you don't hand off recommendations, you stay in the room until things are done.

Your mission

  • We're building a repeatable, scalable operating system for Strategic Partnerships as we convert our pipeline into launched, multi-vertical distribution.
  • You'll own the planning cadences, financial frameworks, execution machinery, and cross-functional coordination that let a lean team manage a complex portfolio without losing speed or discipline.
  • You work directly with the Head of Strategic Partnerships, lead the Operations team, and own the core P&L and planning infrastructure.
  • Own the GMV forecast and P&L accountability for the partnership channel. Build the forecasting model, track actuals, and maintain forecast accuracy within 5-7%.
  • Translate data into investment decisions.
  • Design and run the annual and quarterly planning cycles end-to-end. Set targets, cascade OKRs, build financial frames, and run QBRs. Own the output, not the facilitation.
  • Build and maintain the operating system. Define the playbooks, checklists, readiness gates, and stage gates that channel teams use. Enforce hygiene and accountability.
  • Lead the Operations team. Manage and develop 3+ people. Make hiring and performance decisions. Build commercial instincts in your team.
  • Own strategic project execution. Take complex, ambiguous problems from framing through delivery. Unblock cross-functional dependencies. Don't escalate; solve.
  • Drive CRM and pipeline discipline. Define stage definitions, enforce coverage ratios, maintain data hygiene. Educate and hold commercial teams accountable.
  • Build channel economics models. Separate reported from incremental revenue. Reprice terms against measured floors. Model unit economics and guide investment decisions.

Your Toolkit

Must haves:

  • 7-10+ years combining strategy and operations. Deep expertise in ops roles at marketplaces, platforms, or high-growth tech. The consulting foundation helps. The operational experience matters more.
  • Owned a revenue or GMV forecast and been measured on it. You know what accountability to a number means.
  • Owned an annual or quarterly planning cycle as the owner of output. You set targets, designed OKRs, and were responsible for the results.
  • Runs CRM and pipeline as a discipline. You've defined stage gates, enforced coverage ratios, and held teams accountable to them.
  • Understands partner and channel economics. You can separate reported from incremental, reprice terms, and build a channel P&L from scratch.
  • Comfortable building and scaling forecast and unit economics models. You model scenarios, run sensitivity analysis, and pressure-test business cases in Excel.
  • Led an operations or analytics team of 3 or more people. You've made hiring and performance calls that mattered.
  • Cleared cross-functional dependencies you didn't own. You've unblocked projects by coordinating functions you don't manage.
  • Uses AI tools to improve your work. You've used Claude, ChatGPT, or similar with concrete examples of impact.

Nice To Have

  • Travel or experiences industry background
  • Consulting background, then moved in-house
  • SaaS RevOps experience
  • Scaled teams from 0 to 10+

Your Profile Will Not Be Considered If

  • Have never owned a forecast or quota
  • Have only advised or facilitated with no output you were accountable for
  • Have managed only 1-2 people or relied on "cross-functional influence" instead of direct reports
  • Have used AI tools to do the work instead of to improve your thinking

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Take ownership of financial control and reporting across key Qantas business units while leading a large, high-performing team of finance professionals.
  • Play a pivotal role in strengthening financial performance, leading continuous improvement initiatives and influencing how one of Australia's most recognised brands operates and grows.
  • 12 month fixed term contract based at Mascot Sydney

At Qantas, finance plays a critical role in enabling strategic decision making and ensuring the financial strength of one of Australia's most iconic organisations. We're looking for an experienced finance leader to join our Centre of Finance Excellence as Head of Financial Control & Reporting.

As Head of Financial Control & Reporting, you'll lead a large, high-performing team responsible for financial accounting, forecasting, reporting and governance across the Qantas, Freight and Corporate segments. Reporting to the Head of Centre of Finance Excellence, you'll partner closely with senior finance leaders and executives to ensure the delivery of accurate, insightful and timely financial information that supports key strategic and commercial decisions.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders across a complex business environment. You'll provide leadership across financial control, compliance, performance reporting and continuous improvement initiatives while driving engagement and capability within a large team of finance professionals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Leading a large team of finance professionals to deliver monthly financial reporting, forecasting and analysis.
  • Maintaining accountability for profit and loss, balance sheet and capital expenditure reporting across multiple business segments.
  • Ensuring strong financial governance, internal controls and compliance with accounting standards.
  • Partnering with CFOs, Heads of Finance and business leaders to deliver commercial insights and support decision making.
  • Leading financial transformation and continuous improvement initiatives that improve systems, processes and reporting outcomes.
  • Managing complex stakeholder relationships and influencing outcomes at senior executive level.
  • Driving a culture of accountability, capability development and high performance across the finance function.

You’ll Have

  • Significant experience in financial accounting, financial control or financial management within a large and complex organisation.
  • Proven success leading sizeable, high-performing finance teams.
  • Deep technical accounting expertise and strong knowledge of accounting standards and reporting requirements.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage confidently with senior executives.
  • A strategic mindset combined with strong commercial acumen and analytical capability.
  • Experience leading change, managing competing priorities and delivering outcomes in a complex environment.
  • Degree qualifications in Finance or Accounting together with CA or CPA accreditation.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

If you’re ready for a culture that will challenge and excite you, submit an application today.

Applications close: Wednesday 16 September 2026

By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Required:

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred:

  • 4 year college degree.
  • Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
  • Lodging sales experience.
  • Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

  • Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators in the market.
  • Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.
  • Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction with Regional Marketing Communications.
  • Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer expectations.

  • Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
  • Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through.
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase brand/product awareness.
  • Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
  • Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.
  • Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
  • Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
  • Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Leadership

  • Partners with Human Resources to attract, develop and retain the right people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.

  • Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s and other Booking Holdings brands’ non-accommodation partners and promote our top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s and Booking Holdings’ unique travel product portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek.  Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda and the other group companies, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant profits to the overall business. 

Location: This role requires you to be based in Bangkok, Thailand (with relocation support provide)

The Opportunity:

To utilize your technical expertise to support and drive Agoda’s B2B partnership growth by optimizing connectivity with the company’s largest B2B accommodation partners. Work with diverse internal teams and world-leading travel providers in Agoda’s B2B team, delivering innovative, scalable travel solutions at speed.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Drive the profitable growth of Agoda’s Strategic Partnerships/Travel Distribution business.
  • Manage end-to-end technical account management for Agoda’s largest B2B accounts.
  • Take full ownership of connection performance, including new builds, rebuilds, upgrades, day-to-day success rates, and ensuring optimal access to inventory, rates, rate plans, content, and availability.
  • Extract and analyze complex data sets to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (especially with Product Managers) to identify business needs and influence the design and prioritization of next-generation features.
  • Automate business processes to support operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues impacting client connectivity, ensuring seamless operations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to B2B clients, translating business needs into technical requirements.

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, engineering, or computer science field.
  • 4-6+ years of hands-on experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, or similar roles in technology or travel industries.
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to leverage data and insights to drive business strategy and decisions.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities across concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a self-starter mentality - able to identify opportunities, relentlessly drive growth, and push projects over the finish line.
  • Practical experience with API integrations/data transfers, with strong proficiency in SQL and Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

It's Great if you have:

  • In-depth understanding of technical integrations and system architecture.
  • Experience in travel technology, hospitality tech, or related industries.
  • Strong command of Python, XML, or data modeling concepts.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Senior Saleforce Marketing Cloud Specialist

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Are you a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer who wants to own CRM production end-to-end while helping shape how AI shows up in it? This role keeps the core of the job the same – building, deploying, and troubleshooting SFMC campaigns at scale – while introducing Agentforce and AI-assisted development into the toolkit. You’ll continue to be the technical backbone of CRM Production, with growing exposure to AI agents, prompt-driven workflows, and the next generation of Marketing Cloud tooling.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end CRM campaigns within Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and Content Development
  • Build and maintain scalable solutions using AMPscript, SQL, and APIs, ensuring high performance and reliability
  • Own full lifecycle delivery: requirements review, build, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Implement complex journey logic, including entry criteria, suppressions, deduplication, and personalization
  • Develop and optimize data processes and automations, ensuring data accuracy and alignment with business requirements
  • Perform rigorous QA and validation, including data checks, content proofing, and journey testing
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative fixes
  • Review peer code and provide actionable feedback to improve quality and reduce defects
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Ops, Data, Solution) to deliver high-impact CRM campaigns
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to team best practices and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tooling, and campaign performance
  • Own continued delivery of core CRM development – Journey Builder, Automation Studio, AMPscript/SSJS, SQL – ensuring agentic capabilities are layered on a stable, high-performing production foundation.
  • Partner with Marketing, Data, Legal/Privacy, and Solution teams to identify high-value agent use cases (welcome journeys, cart recovery, customer service handoffs) and translate them into shipped, measurable workflows.
  • Stay current with the fast-moving Agentforce/LLM landscape and proactively bring forward new capabilities, model updates, and patterns the team should adopt.
  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of the daily development workflow, with sound judgment about when to trust, verify, or override AI-generated code.
  • Practical skill in prompt engineering – writing, testing, and iterating on prompts/instructions for LLM-driven features, with an understanding of grounding, context windows, and hallucination mitigation.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud development
  • Strong expertise across:
    • Journey Builder & Automation Studio
    • AMPscript (required) and SSJS (preferred)
    • SQL for segmentation, validation, and troubleshooting
  • Deep understanding of SFMC data model:
    • Data Extensions, Send Logs, Data Views, Contact Builder
  • Experience with API integrations and triggered sends
  • Proven experience working in production environments with high-volume campaigns
  • Strong focus on QA, accuracy, and error prevention (pre- and post-send validation)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across data, automation, and journey layers
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in fast-paced, agile environments
Nice To Have

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud / CDP
  • Experience with QA tools such as Litmus

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $82,500.00 to $115,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $132,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $82,500.00 to $115,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $132,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Executive Assistant serves as a trusted partner to the General Manager, providing comprehensive executive, secretarial and administrative support while also assisting with the coordination and follow-up of hotel operations. The role acts as a key communication link between the General Manager, Executive Committee, Department Heads and operational teams, ensuring that priorities, projects and key actions are effectively coordinated and followed through.

Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities

Executive & Personal Assistant to the General Manager

  • Provide comprehensive secretarial, administrative and personal assistance to the General Manager.
  • Manage the General Manager’s calendar, appointments, meetings, correspondence, telephone calls and daily schedules.
  • Coordinate and arrange all activities, meetings and appointments relating to the General Manager.
  • Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, briefing materials, correspondence and other documents as required.
  • Manage confidential information and documents with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.
  • Coordinate the General Manager’s business travel arrangements, itineraries and expense reimbursements.
  • Assist the General Manager in preparing annual budgets, business plans, presentations and management reports.
  • Provide secretarial and administrative support to Executive Committee members as required.
  • Follow up on action items, requests and special assignments delegated by the General Manager and ensure timely completion.
  • Coordinate and compile the General Manager’s Monthly Report and other management reports.
  • Provide operational support to the General Manager by coordinating and following up with key operational departments, particularly Front Office, Food & Beverage and Rooms Division.
  • Attend and take accurate minutes of Executive Committee, Department Head and other key management meetings, and ensure timely distribution and follow-up.
  • Act as a key liaison between the General Manager, Executive Committee, Department Heads, colleagues and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and monitor reporting deadlines for Regional Office, Owners and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain an efficient filing, document control and tracking system for the Executive Office.

Operations Support & Coordination

  • Monitor and follow up on key operational action plans, ensuring that agreed actions are completed within the required timeline.
  • Assist in coordinating cross-departmental operational projects and initiatives led by or assigned by the General Manager.
  • Support the preparation of operational updates, presentations, reports and briefing materials for management meetings.
  • Assist in coordinating VIP arrivals, high-profile guests, special events and important hotel functions, ensuring that all relevant departments are aligned and prepared.
  • Work closely with Front Office and F&B leaders to follow up on operational priorities, guest-related matters, special arrangements and service recovery actions assigned by the General Manager.
  • Coordinate welcome letters, personal notes and appropriate welcome amenities for VIPs, high-returning guests and other priority guests.
  • Assist with special guest visits, inspections, owner visits, media visits and other high-profile hotel activities as assigned.
  • Assist the General Manager with special projects, hotel initiatives and strategic assignments.
  • Coordinate and follow up on cross-functional projects involving multiple departments to ensure alignment and timely execution.
  • Undertake other duties, responsibilities and special assignments as reasonably assigned by the General Manager.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Role Overview

As a Senior Product Manager in our Discovery organization, you will be an integral part of a cross-functional team, working closely with other product managers, engineers, UX designers, researchers, and data professionals. Your role involves creating and executing a vision for a product area, constantly learning from our customers, and iterating to improve the user experience. You will also collaborate with our UX team, composed of product designers, researchers, and writers.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can envision GetYourGuide beyond its current state, champion our users' voices, and execute a compelling vision.

Successful PMs at GetYourGuide bring a growth mindset and drive business and customer impact by identifying opportunities, getting buy-in from your stakeholders, and executing with urgency.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive strategy for your product area, set clear, measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Drive sustained customer impact through a long-term (12 months+) roadmap, identifying areas for non-incremental impact.
  • Articulate and connect your product area’s strategy to the company’s mission. Break down the strategy into actionable steps, regularly update stakeholders on progress, and create excitement for your long-term vision. Build alignment across cross-functional teams, partner teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Drive coherence across multiple discovery entry points (e.g., browse, landing pages, inspiration modules), balancing short-term wins with a durable information architecture and scalable content strategy.
  • Synthesize customer feedback, research insights, and business metrics to identify and prioritize the most meaningful traveler problems. Define success measures and iterate based on evidence to ensure we deliver real customer value. Make strategic decisions on sequencing and prioritizing product work to maximize impact and learning.
  • Build and execute an experimentation strategy—developing a robust hypothesis pipeline, defining guardrails and a learning agenda, and ensuring high-quality measurement. Use experiment outcomes to derive actionable insights, inform roadmap decisions, and align cross-team priorities and trade-offs.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery, ensuring high-quality execution from discovery through launch and iteration, and enabling effective collaboration across engineering, design, research, and data.
  • Build strong relationships and alignment across partner teams that influence discovery quality (e.g., Search, Recommendations, Brand/Content, Commercial). Set clear expectations, align on shared goals and trade-offs, and drive cross-functional execution against your roadmap.
  • Represent the traveler perspective at all levels, communicate decisions with clarity and transparency with your team, peers, and executive leadership. Coach PMs and cross-functional partners to raise the bar on product thinking and execution and foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Your toolkit

  • 6+ years of professional experience in product management.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead with customer problems and value creation, using data and metrics to validate impact rather than as the starting point.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a significant product area with responsibilities for strategy, KPI definition, goal-setting, and roadmap execution.
  • Ability to build alignment with a cross-functional mission team in a collaborative way that is aligned with our Guiding Principles.
  • Strong ability to lead in ambiguity, influence without authority, and align multiple teams around shared outcomes.
  • Strong data analytics skills with the ability to derive insights from large data sets.
  • Demonstrated passion for driving customer and business impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Bonus: Experience working in a marketplace or the travel industry is a plus, but not required.
  • Bonus: Experience owning consumer discovery/browse/search-adjacent top-of-funnel product areas at scale, including SEO- and landing-page ecosystems (content, templates, indexation, and measurement) is a plus but ot required.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  • Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*

The team

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Partnerships Manager, you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Develop long lasting relationships with key supply partners to enable Agoda’s growth in the region
  • Maintain regular and meaningful engagement with Agoda’s key supply partners
  • Analyze large datasets to propose tailor-made solutions to Agoda’s supply partners
  • Leverage analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new opportunities to grow Agoda’s business
  • Train and inform clients of both new and existing technologies, tools, and models
  • Prepare materials to aid in growing our business during partner meetings
  • Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner
  • Gain buy-in from relevant stakeholders to execute strategies and help launch promotional campaigns to enhance productivity and maintain Agoda’s competitiveness
  • Leverage product offerings to match market demands to maximize our ability to convert passive customers into active ones
  • Deliver on country KPIs, growth targets and country strategic initiatives

Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting for senior stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas

It’s Great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree
  • Experience in Travel industry

How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines is continually looking to embrace new technologies and enhance the customer experience, and with that in mind we are looking for current students who are interested in working with a leading innovation team in the airline industry. The interns will receive flight benefits during the assignment.

The Venture & Tech Scouting team plays a key role in developing and executing corporate innovation initiatives that contribute to Delta Air Lines' market leadership and growth. Through our trusted brands and our portfolio of offerings, we aim to reach the highest levels of customer service with each interaction. And we invest in — and care about — each other, our communities and every journey. It’s a point of pride and distinction, rooted in our origins. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.
Over the years, we’ve learned moving forward isn’t a simple matter of going from point A to B. Today, mobility is the movement of people and goods. It goes beyond the vehicles we drive to encompass an integrated way of travel that meets every individual’s unique needs and preferences.
That is why it’s our vision to be the world’s best and most trusted mobility company. As mobility continues to evolve, we'll continue to innovate to work toward a reimagined mobility future that is more accessible, efficient and sustainable for all.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.

  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Java Senior Software Engineer in the Prime area you will be in charge of:

  • Have meaningful experience being in a Senior Engineer role driving technical work for other engineers. You stay up-to-date on industry trends and understand how to apply them.
  • Provide technical guidance for complex initiatives. Deliver strategic technical improvements. Improve code structure and architecture, taking care of testability and maintainability, and identifying opportunities for technical investments to help the team meet the objectives.
  • Successfully deliver projects with high complexity, involving multiple stakeholders, including monitoring and mitigating timeline risks.
  • Effectively give and receive feedback, including code reviews, and architecture reviews, and mentoring other team members, coaching them to upgrade their skills and grow to the next level.
  • Communicate complex ideas to technical and business stakeholders, and establish alignment within the broader organization.
  • Constantly looking to expand your skills and skill sets through learning and increasing knowledge.
  • You will work in a fully agile organization, using Kanban practices to deliver business value continuously. You will actively participate in team ceremonies and events, as well as the product definition and ideation processes, as part of a high-performing cross-functional team, working with other top engineers, product managers, architects, UX designers to design, build, operate and evolve the Prime domain of the microservice platform. You will receive mentorship and support to help you develop your career super fast.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Deep understanding of software engineering concepts such as OOP, functional programming, concurrency, data structures, design and architecture patterns, databases, APIs etc.;
  • Experience working with the entire software development cycle, including deploying to production and testing (both unit and integration), as well as Cloud and Continuous Delivery environments;
  • Strong data-driven capabilities, analytical skills, design pattern skills and creativity that will allow you to solve complex business and customer problems;
  • Ambition to be the best and provide resilient, high-performing, well-dimensioned solutions to complex problems;
  • Strong focus on quality, and a technical excellence mindset;
  • Excellent communication skills and an open mind to reach agreements for the benefit of the team and your stakeholders;
  • Ability to visually represent your solutions in standard diagrams that can be shared with both technical and non-technical audience;
  • Strong organisational skills. Ability to organise, prioritise and delegate tasks to overcome deadlines in an uncertain environment;
  • Fluent English level that will allow you to work in a multicultural environment and communicate at all levels;
  • A strong mindset for continuous learning and improvement, growth and innovation;
  • A team player attitude with a focus on knowledge sharing within a dynamic team;
  • Passion for what you do, willing to improve every day and apply the latest state-of-the-art technology, when possible, to your solutions.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here’s what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Pri me Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our Priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it’s like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As an Assistant Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As a Cluster Sales Assistant Manager, this position plays the responsibility of international sales for 2 properties, Hilton Osaka and Double Tree by Hilton Osaka Castle.

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

This Role Requires The Following Language Skills

  • Japanese (business level above)
  • English (Conversational level)

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered

Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

The Care Operations team at GetYourGuide sits at the heart of delivering exceptional experiences for our customers, suppliers, and partners. Through a relentless focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement, the team drives the operational standards that underpin GetYourGuide's ability to scale world-class customer service. We work cross-functionally across the business to ensure that every touchpoint in the customer journey is supported by robust processes, accurate knowledge, and a culture of excellence.

Within Care Operations, the Process Improvement, Quality Assurance and Learning Excellence team owns the systems, knowledge, and workflows that enable our teams to operate at their best. As GetYourGuide transitions to AI-powered customer service, this team is at the forefront of a critical transformation — evolving our knowledge base architecture to serve both human agents and AI systems, and ensuring that the processes underpinning our operations are fit for the future.

Your mission

As Knowledge and Process Manager, you'll be the point of contact for process, communication and product changes within the Care department, and the advocate for the stakeholder, whether that's a customer, supplier or partner, across the end-to-end journey. You'll work across Care and with other GetYourGuide teams to define business needs, translate them into process requirements, flows and quality standards, and build the data and reporting systems that give everyone visibility into how things are going.

  • Identify, plan and implement key projects that improve quality and efficiency, increase productivity, reduce cycle time and cut costs, driving measurable improvement in the business and in customer satisfaction
  • Provide regular project status updates, feedback and reporting against your key responsibilities and objectives
  • Consult with teams across the department to identify, diagnose and problem-solve in order to optimise Care operations
  • Drive process improvement projects based on KPIs and on changes taking place elsewhere in GetYourGuide
  • Build awareness with internal and external stakeholders of how their work impacts the customer's process and experience
  • Bring an AI and data mindset to how you diagnose problems and design solutions, using AI tools to work faster and surface insight that would otherwise take longer to find

Your toolkit

  • Proven experience leading a team of specialists in a knowledge management, process improvement, or customer care operations function (3+ years), with a track record of setting direction, developing people, and delivering results through others
  • A customer-focused mindset and genuine drive to deliver service excellence
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day work, from self-serve analysis to generating outputs independently, and an interest in applying that thinking to Care's process design
  • Direct ownership of a knowledge base strategy, including governance models, content standards, ownership frameworks, and maintenance cadences, ideally in Zendesk , Salesforce, or a comparable helpdesk environment
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing change management programmes across complex, cross-functional stakeholder landscapes, including teams outside your direct reporting line
  • Strong organisational skills and a sharp eye for detail
  • Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Fluent English

Extras that give you an edge

  • Background in customer care operations
  • Experience in a high-performing, high-paced organisation with strong procedural discipline
  • Background in operations or a logistics-heavy industry
  • A diagonal or lateral career path that shows growth across different functions

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

job.job_description:
We are seeking a Senior Global Mobility Specialist to join our global People Operations team, where innovation knows no borders. This team delivers seamless employee experiences by streamlining international assignments, relocations, and talent movements across key regions. It removes cross-border friction and ensures full compliance so teams can focus on driving customer success. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.

As a Senior Global Mobility Specialist, you will manage end-to-end relocation and U.S. immigration processes across the organization. You will challenge outdated workflows, serve as a trusted advisor to employees, and partner with legal and HR leaders to resolve complex mobility challenges. This role requires sound operational judgment, strong execution, and the ability to turn complex regulatory requirements into clear actions.

What You'll Do

  • End-to-End Assignment Management: Oversee the full lifecycle of global mobility assignments, including visa/work permit applications (U.S. and international), relocation logistics, and expatriate support.
  • U.S. Immigration Compliance & Case Management: Partners with immigration counsel to manage U.S. immigration processes including H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, and Green Card sponsorship. Ensure compliance with USCIS, DOL, and other federal regulations. Liaise with immigration counsel to support case strategy and execution.
  • Global Compliance & Advisory: Act as a subject matter expert on international and U.S. immigration, tax, and labor laws. Ensure compliance and mitigate risks across jurisdictions.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with People Business Partners, Legal, Payroll, and external vendors to coordinate mobility processes and resolve complex immigration and relocation issues.
  • Employee Support: Serves as advisor in case of any queries, as well as escalation point when issues arise.
  • System enhancements:
  • Maintaining and developing existing system configuration. Looking for opportunities in changing and automating global mobility processes, including leveraging AI-enabled solutions.
  • Policy Development & Implementation: Contribute to the development and refinement of global mobility and immigration policies aligned with business goals and legal requirements.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze mobility and immigration metrics and trends to identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with relocation providers, immigration attorneys, and tax advisors to ensure high-quality service delivery. Manage accuracy and completeness of vendor invoices.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, or related field
  • 6+ years of experience in global mobility or general people operations area
  • Strong knowledge of US immigration regulations and related labor processes
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills
  • Strong interpersonal and communication abilities
  • Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools
  • Experience with global HRIS systems, ideally in Workday
  • Experience working in a international environment

Join TUI Airline as we expand our commercial capabilities and unlock new revenue potential across global markets. As our Senior B2B Commercial Partner Manager, you'll drive external revenues and foster high-performance relationships with both internal TUI tour operators and external B2B partners.

This vacancy can be located at any of our headquarters within the market locations.

The role will be published until 18 september 2026

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.

About The Job

  • You'll execute our B2B commercial strategy at a regional level, translating strategic direction into market-specific actions that optimise capacity, distribution and yield.
  • Acting as the primary commercial contact for internal TUI tour operators and selected external partners, you'll be their voice within TUI while building strong, trust-based relationships that unlock long-term value.

About You

  • Your track record demonstrates success in managing complex regional accounts, delivering revenue growth and maintaining long-term relationships in a multi-stakeholder environment.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

About The Role

As our Senior Product Data Scientist, you will be the cornerstone of our advanced analytics capability.

This is more than a technical role; it's a high-impact position designed to shape the future of our product by embedding deep, quantitative intelligence into its core.

You will help set the vision for how data science can solve our most challenging problems.

You will act as a catalyst, mentoring a talented team of product analysts while spearheading the development of models and frameworks that drive our product strategy forward.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the development of Data Science within Product, producing statistical models that directly impact the insights and recommendations that drive the product and customer experience.
  • Use your knowledge and experience to help scale the impact of the Product Analytics team through data science. Creating automation, self service model capability, improve experimentation velocity, and drive efficiency.
  • Architect and implement sophisticated statistical models (predictive, classification, clustering, etc.) to enhance product features like personalization and recommendations.
  • Exploration of new tooling, product and approaches including Agentic AI and AI Agents, to identify opportunity areas, explore through POC to then drive to adoption.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to identify high-impact opportunities where data science can solve customer problems and improve the product.
  • Champion experimentation by designing and analyzing complex AB tests, causal inference models, and uplift modeling to inform product decisions.
  • Guide and mentor other product analysts in best practices for experimentation, modeling, and data-driven product development upskilling the team and defining the roadmap for Product Data Science.
  • Communicate complex data insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders with clarity and influence.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Significant experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalize crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design teams).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling your impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

Nice To Haves

  • Advanced programming background with the ability to build simulations and prototype data products.
  • Experience validating quantitative findings with qualitative methods (e.g., surveys, user research).
  • Demonstrated experience with applied AI, such as NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI for analytics.
  • Deep experience in developing sophisticated customer segmentation models including predictive LTV modeling.
  • Experience working within a two-sided marketplace, e-commerce, or the travel technology industry.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
