job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

About The Role

As a Principal Product Data Scientist, you will operate as the most senior technical leader in the Product Data Science function. You will shape the vision, set the technical direction, and drive strategic impact through innovative analytical solutions. This role is both highly technical and deeply collaborative, requiring excellence in leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and define the Data Science strategy for Product, ensuring that advanced analytics, data science, and AI methodologies are central to how we build great products and improve customer experiences.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior Product and Engineering leadership, ensuring that data-driven decision making is embedded at the highest levels of the organization.
  • Drive the development and adoption of next-generation data science tooling, platforms, and frameworks, with a focus on automation, scalability, and reproducibility.
  • Spearhead the exploration and integration of emerging AI technologies, such as Agentic AI and AI Agents, identifying and developing high-impact use cases from POC to production.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, and uplift modeling, ensuring statistical rigor in decision-making processes.
  • Take ownership of the most complex, high-profile analytical projects, translating ambiguous questions into clear, actionable recommendations that deliver commercial and customer value.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop other Data Scientists and Analysts, fostering a culture of critical thinking, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
  • Lead initiatives to scale impact through automation, self-service, and democratization of data science capabilities.
  • Develop sophisticated customer segmentation, and predictive models that directly inform and optimize the product roadmap.
  • Communicate complex analytical and technical concepts to diverse audiences, influencing stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalize crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Advanced programming background with the ability to build simulations and prototype data products.
  • Experience validating quantitative findings with qualitative methods (e.g., surveys, user research).
  • Demonstrated experience with applied AI, such as NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI for analytics.
  • Experience working within a two-sided marketplace, e-commerce, or the travel technology industry.
  • Masters degree or equivalent relevant programs

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
Role Purpose

Co-manage hotel projects, aligned with assigned Manager, Property Improvements & Plan Review, for an assigned territory of franchised hotels which may include a Property Improvement Plan (PIP) for a renovation and/or new development (ND) hotel construction project. Serve as a recognized architectural, design and construction expert for a segment of mid-scale or upscale IHG brand hotels. Manager, Property Improvements & Plan Review will focus primary responsibilities on either PIP discipline or Plan Review discipline as assigned per hiring manager.

PIP Responsibilities (some or all may apply)

Responsibilities may include managing all on-site PIP renovation / new development design and construction activities to ensure compliance with franchise License Agreements, including conformance with any associated PIP, Plan Review and FF&E submittals, Hotel Brand Visions, Hotel Design Guidelines, Hotel Brand standards, IHG Brand Safety Standards and ADA requirements and other related design criteria requirements. Provide construction guidance and assistance to IHG franchisees and their assigned design team consultants through all phases of the PIP or ND projects, including assisting with design / construction solutions as project field conditions arise, ensuring timely and successful completion of projects while promoting Great Hotels Guests Love.

Plan Review Responsibilities (some or all may apply)

Responsibilities include approving (or not approving) project plans, design boards, life safety plans and other related project submittals for a broad range of complex of PIP and ND projects to ensure conformance with Hotel Brand Vision and Hotel Design Guidelines, Hotel Brand Standards, IHG Brand Safety Standards, ADA requirements, and other related design criteria requirements. Provide design guidance and assistance to IHG franchisees and their design consultants through all phases of the PIP or ND projects, ensuring timely and successful completion of projects while promoting Great Hotels Guests Love.

May lead and review the work of less experienced staff by providing mentoring, technical guidance and/or training in daily activities. From time to time provide feedback to management and brand on product related issues / recommendations for improvements.

Key Accountabilities

PIP Responsibilities (some or all may apply)

  • Property Improvement Plan (PIP) projects –Conduct PIP visits / product assessments for existing hotel product seeking to License or re-License an IHG franchise agreement. Inspection includes a thorough walk of the hotel assessing the hotel’s architecture and design for appropriateness in today’s market, condition of current product, and conformance to Brand and IHG Life Safety Standards, building codes, and ADA.
  • Produce a comprehensive PIP narrative document that lists PIP renovation requirements.
  • Conduct and manage onsite design and PIP scope meetings with ownership ensuing onsite renovation activities are in compliance with PIP documents and are on schedule with PIP Milestone Dates.
  • Co-manage hotel projects with Manager, Property Improvements & Plan Review.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Job Title

Process Improvement Principal Specialist

Position Summary

The Commercial Process & Automation team enables a data‑driven and scalable commercial organization. As a Process Improvement Principal Specialist, you will partner across Amadeus Hospitality to design and improve commercial processes that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and employee experience.

In this role, you will primarily apply Lean principles to simplify workflows and reduce waste, complemented by Six Sigma methods when variation and quality improvement are required. You will collaborate with stakeholders across functions and seniority levels to analyze processes, design improvements, define meaningful performance metrics, and support sustainable adoption of change. This role emphasizes partnership, clarity, and practical impact across the Customer Lifecycle (CLC) and related transformation programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Commercial teams to improve end‑to‑end lead‑to‑cash processes, focusing on scalability, efficiency, and experience.
  • Apply Lean principles (such as value stream mapping, waste reduction, and continuous improvement) to design simpler and more effective processes.
  • Facilitate collaborative workshops to understand current‑state processes, co‑design future‑state solutions, and support informed decision‑making.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and intelligent tooling (including generative artificial intelligence, workflow automation, and process mining) aligned with business needs.
  • Define, monitor, and support the use of key process performance indicators (KPIs) and service‑level agreements (SLAs) to sustain improvements over time.

Experience

Required Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in process improvement, business transformation, or operational excellence, gained through a variety of career paths.
  • Experience contributing to or leading multiple improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience working collaboratively across functions, regions, and roles in complex or evolving environments.

Methodology & Tools

  • Practical experience applying Lean methodologies as a primary approach to process improvement.
  • Familiarity with commercial systems such as customer relationship management (CRM), configure‑price‑quote (CPQ), contracting platforms, and service management tools.
  • Experience using or learning process and data tools such as process mining, robotic process automation (RPA), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Dataverse), or similar technologies.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Able to communicate ideas clearly in writing, conversation, and presentations, adapting style and depth for different audiences.
  • Builds trust‑based relationships and works effectively with others, even without formal authority.
  • Able to balance independent work with close collaboration and shared accountability.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in business, engineering, information systems, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lean or Six Sigma certification (or equivalent applied experience).
  • Exposure to hospitality, travel technology, or commercial operations.
  • Familiarity with change management approaches (such as Prosci ADKAR or Kotter’s 8‑Step), gained through formal training or practical application.

What We Can Offer You

  • 💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer.
  • 🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  • 🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  • 🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  • 🌟 A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  • 🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  • 📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  • 🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

It's an exciting time to be part of the Operations Planning and Performance (OP&P) organization as we modernize the data foundations that support the airline operations. OP&P helps Delta operations function as an integrated system; anticipating risks, aligning priorities, and delivering actionable insights that improve operational performance, customer outcomes, and enable profitable growth. The Data Foundations team is responsible for designing, building, and stewarding trusted, well-governed data products and platforms that enable analytics, engineering, automation, and AI at scale. Our mission is to create the foundational data capabilities that help OP&P make better decisions, operate more efficiently, and accelerate innovation.

To achieve this, we are leading a transformation strategy to:

  • Modernize from creating single-purpose data assets toward building scalable data products that can support multiple business analytics & science use cases
  • Design & manage a modernized analytics/engineering developer workspace that enables creating more reliable and hardened curation pipelines & advanced analytic capabilities
  • Steward proper business data management that reduce duplication, improve consistency, and enable trusted, effective use of data through aligned business definitions, contextual understanding, ontology, and governance standards

This role will primarily serve as the team lead in transforming our current data asset portfolio into a trusted foundation of hardened, reusable data products. Working in close partnership with IT, Operations, and Analytics stakeholders, this individual will translate business priorities into clear, delivery-ready requirements while maintaining accountability for business context, data quality standards, stewardship decisions, and realization of business value. Additionally, this role will provide thought leadership across the Data Foundations team, helping shape and advance capabilities in data management, governance, infrastructure & frameworks.

  • Develop, document, and steward the operations semantic layer: business definitions, critical data elements, metadata, business rules & logic, ontology, lineage expectations, and data quality standards.
  • Facilitate functional specification, source-to-target mapping, and transformation logic reviews to confirm that business intent and data meaning are accurately represented before implementation.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate redundant data assets and promote the adoption of common foundational data products across multiple business processes and functional domains.
  • Collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to design and evolve modern data platforms, developer workspaces, and data pipelines that support scalable and reliable data delivery.
  • Represent OP&P in enterprise data governance councils and working groups, and coach/mentor junior data stewards as the stewardship function scales.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise data governance standards, stewardship practices, metadata management, data quality processes, and documentation requirements across the Data Foundations domain.
  • Lead workshops to define business processes, collect operational context, and better understand upstream policy, process and technology workflows that contribute to how data flows.
  • Partner with Operations, Technology, IT, Analytics, and business stakeholders to identify data needs, define priorities, and translate business requirements into clear, delivery-ready product roadmaps and requirements.
  • Serve as the product engineer and steward for foundational data assets & products; ensuring alignment on business meaning, data quality expectations, and consumption for OP&P.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrates that privacy is a priority when handling personal data.
  • 5+ years of experience in data management, product ownership, data engineering, data modeling, data governance, or related discipline.
  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating business needs into actionable product priorities and acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to influence, facilitate, and drive consensus across business, operational, analytical, and technology stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, master/reference data, and stewardship principles.
  • Strong analytical and interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop effective relationships and influence without direct authority.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, as well as executive presence to be an effective representative of the business across the organization.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and partnering with technical teams on data product delivery.
  • Familiarity with modern enterprise data platforms, cloud data services, data catalogs, or analytics ecosystems.
  • Applied experience with SQL & Python.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience implementing enterprise data governance frameworks, stewardship workflows, or domain ownership models from the ground up.
  • Experience defining critical data elements, business glossaries, source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, and data quality controls.
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud data solutions and services (Lambda, Glue, Redshift, Airflow).
  • Experience with Git, Agility (VersionOne) & Aha!
  • Familiarity or experience within operational domains such as Aircraft, Airspace, Airport, Crew and Flights.
  • Extensive experience serving as a data product owner, product engineer or data steward.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

Principal Product Manager, Third-Party Inventory – End-to-End Traveler Experience

Introduction to the Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our customer-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.

Third-party inventory expands the breadth, depth, and competitiveness of our global accommodation marketplace. In this role, you will shape the end-to-end traveler experience for third-party inventory, ensuring it is trustworthy, consistent, and seamless across discovery, booking, payments, cancellations, modifications, and post-booking service.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define the long-term experience vision, product principles, and strategic roadmap for third-party inventory.
  • Establish experience standards that promote traveler trust, consistency, quality, and customer lifetime value.
  • Influence strategy beyond your immediate team by aligning Product, Engineering, Supply, Partnerships, Commercial, Operations, Customer Service, Data Science, Design, and senior leadership.
  • Translate complex traveler and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, success metrics, and decision frameworks.
  • Create clarity in complex, cross-functional decision spaces through concise narratives, data, and artifacts.
  • Use experimentation, analytics, and A/B testing to prioritize opportunities, evaluate impact, and guide trade-off decisions across platforms and customer journeys.
  • Identify risks, connect key stakeholders, and facilitate critical decisions across the organization.
  • Incorporate AI-driven systems, tools, and workflows where they create measurable business and traveler value, while supporting safe and responsible adoption.
  • Apply competitive and marketplace insights to shape differentiated product strategies and improve traveler outcomes.

Required

Experience and Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in digital product management, including ownership of consumer-facing products, customer journeys, or e-commerce experiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or related field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • Experience defining and executing product strategy and roadmaps in complex, cross-functional environments, with accountability for KPIs and experimentation outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Analytics teams on technically complex products, including web application architecture, APIs, data flows, and experimentation platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows, including applying AI/ML concepts to products in measurable, safe, and standards-aligned ways.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and peer teams on cross-organizational priorities and trade-offs.

Preferred

  • Experience owning complex consumer, marketplace, or platform products from strategy through execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Understanding of marketplaces, travel, e-commerce, payments, supply platforms, or other transaction ecosystems.
  • Experience working with third-party APIs, suppliers, partners, or distributed technology ecosystems.
  • Customer-centric product judgment and the ability to translate technical constraints into simple experiences.
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills.
  • Experience influencing senior executives and multiple Product and Engineering organizations.
  • Ability to work effectively without direct authority in ambiguous, global, and matrixed environments.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Director of Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of Finance Division, Financial Planning & Control Department. He/She will be responsible for ensuring proper budgeting, correct accounting, timely processing, analysis and reporting of expenses/recoveries, as well as budgeting, forecasts and cost savings initiatives for Head Office Divisions (Fixed Cost) and Variable cost items under his/her responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

Operating expenditure accounting for Divisions under his/her charge:

  • Review and ensure that accruals/J ournal Vouchers (JVs) put through for accuracy and completeness. Check for omissions/errors in invoices raised/JVs put through.
  • Accounts Receivable and Account Payable invoice approvals. Review and ensure correct accounting allocation by Divisions.
  • Monitor and review monthly accounts variance analysis. Review and monitor Divisions’ expenditure against budget and forecast. Work with users on explanations for budget overruns and supplementary budgets. Ensure that users comply with Finance Manual procedures on budgetary control.
  • Discuss and liaise with Divisions on accounting treatment for their business process/initiatives.
  • Compile and analyse material monthly expense variances. Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reports to Corporate Accounts & Projects department as per reporting timelines.
  • Monitor and clear suspense accounts to ensure that balances are within timelines set. Work with users on explanations for balances exceeding stipulated timelines.

Annual operating budget/Long term projection exercise

  • Assist with preparation work for roll out of budget/long term projection exercise.
  • Assist/Support Divisions on queries regarding budget/projection. Work with Divisions to identify and achieve cost savings/efficiencies.
  • Assist with preparation of budget paper as per timeline.

Monthly rolling forecast exercises

  • Assist with user queries and carrying out of preparation work for roll out of forecast exercises.
  • Analysis of significant variances for forecast figures for preparation of forecast materials.

Understand the business processes of the different divisions and how it relates to the accounting treatment of their expenses. Work closely with the various divisions to have a better understanding of their operations and be able to provide value-added advice whenever necessary.

Work with internal and external auditors during their audits of the section’s processes and controls. Follow up on recommendations given.

Handle ad-hoc projects, such as implementation or enhancements of IT systems, to improve processes. Department’s representative for ad-hoc projects/exercises or administrative matters.

Provide guidance to staff on work procedures relating to the use of systems and resolution of work-related problems. Monitor and assess staff performance.

Requirements

  • University Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy or an equivalent professional qualification recognised by ACCA.
  • Good attention to details.
  • Good numerical and analytical skills.
  • Effective time management skills.
  • Effective communications skills.

The end date of this position is in December 2027.

Summary of Position

This role will be responsible for project management - direction, planning, implementation, execution, control and completion of the implementation to a new global distribution system (GDS), Amadeus in North America. The Senior Project Manager will operate as a key member of the North America project team and will have accountability for the day-to-day delivery of assigned North America workstreams. The role will work in alignment with the Global GDS Project Manager and senior stakeholder and governance groups. The Senior Project Manager is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively manage assigned deliverables and dependencies, and escalate matters requiring strategic direction, cross-workstream decisions or senior leadership intervention. As the project scales down, the expectation would be that other projects are added to the scope of responsibility.

Schedule / Shift

Standard hours

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned workstreams within the Amadeus GDS transformation, ensuring alignment to the overall Global programme strategy and milestones.
  • Individual responsibility of the management of a large scale and complex projects. Plan and implement a project plan achieve goals and objectives of the project, as well as alignment of the overall business strategy.
  • Develop full-scale project plans: define tasks, required resources, project dependencies, critical paths, and manage multiple simultaneous project schedules.
  • Help to define project scope, goals, and deliverables on own projects as well as others as needed.
  • Represent CTM in customer and vendor facing meetings and in collaboration with third party partners in reporting on the status of the project and reporting associated dependencies, risks and status.
  • Maintain integrated schedule of project milestones in an external shared multi-party project plan.
  • Seek out efficiencies through effective management of projects across the organization, including the recommendation and execution of process changes.
  • Identify and manage impacts of the GDS transition on business processes, agent workflows, customer experience, technology platforms and operational teams.
  • Partner with business and operational leaders to ensure appropriate change management, communications, training and readiness activities are incorporated into the delivery plan.
  • Ensure team members and stakeholders have a comprehensive understanding of the overall project deliverables.
  • Serve as an escalation point for challenging project issues.
  • Use a hybrid project management methodology and toolkit for consistent practices and standards.
  • Build, develop, and grow any business relationships vital to the success of projects and growth of project management office.
  • Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential risks, and devise contingency plans.
  • Coordinate project closure to distill best practice and ensure lessons learned are documented and followed.
  • Conduct project phase retrospectives and create a recommendations report to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements.
  • Manage expectations by regular communications to the business through reports on progress of project portfolio and individual project responsibility, as well as problems and solutions to stakeholder and senior management.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Domestic (and global) travel is a requirement for this position. An accommodation may be considered under the Americans with Disabilities Act, but a bona fide reason must exist. The company will engage in the interactive process as necessary.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • This position may have direct and/or indirect reports which includes responsibility for overall performance management, including hiring, training, coaching, feedback, development, etc.
  • Models the way for employees and sets a positive example by demonstrating our core values.
  • Provides ongoing feedback and supports team member growth by working with employees and encouraging growth plans.
  • Drives employee engagement. Facilitates regular and ongoing conversations about employee engagement and takes action to improve team and organizational culture.

Required of all CTM Positions

  • Embrace CTM’s core values of Connect, Deliver and Evolve
  • Professional, collaborative and supportive interaction with employees, clients, suppliers and vendors.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Appropriate and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests.
  • Creative and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrates calm under pressure – is a proactive contributor and eager to learn.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to do basic math.
  • Ability to read and interpret information.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and/or work experience required.
  • 5+ years of direct work experience in a project management capacity and working with complex technology transformation, platform implementation, migration or business process change programmes.
  • Experience in risk management and change management.
  • Experience managing large-scale testing, business readiness, cutover and go-live activities
  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Experience in the Corporate Travel Management industry strongly preferred

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Knowledge and expertise in project management concepts, practices, strategies and technologies.
  • Advanced knowledge and skill in using project management software tools.
  • Working knowledge of business travel management platforms and practices would be of high value. Candidate doesn’t need to be proficient in the GDS or OBTs, but a working knowledge of managed business travel would be ideal.
  • Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, leadership technique, production methods and coordination of people and resources.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with individuals at all levels of the Company in a professional manner.
  • Must possess strong people skills and ability to read communication styles of team members and contractors who come from a broad spectrum of disciplines.
  • Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including upper management, clients, and other departments.
  • Ability and desire to drive change that aligns with company strategy and goals.
  • Skill in using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions or approaches to problems.
  • Excellent decision-making and leadership capabilities, with an eye for detail.
  • Adaptability and ability to tolerate stress.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form.
  • Desire to enhance knowledge and skills of self and others.

job.job_description:
Social Video Creative & Editor | Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor Group is seeking a Social Video Creative & Editor to join the Tripadvisor Creative team. Reporting to the Creative Director, this person will work primarily with the Creative and Social teams to create and edit social-first content across Tripadvisors channels on platforms including but not limited to TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube. As well as support any additional creative needs as appropriate.

The ideal candidate is comfortable producing short-form videos and other social media posts, capturing original content or leveraging existing content, creator content, stock footage and UGC. They are a social native that understands platform nuances, has a great eye for social trends and is passionate about all things travel. We're looking for a self-starter with excellent judgment and communication skills. This is a fulltime, paid position.

Job Location: Hybrid in Boston, or New York.

You Will

  • Operate at the forefront of social creativity with a creator first mindset and a strong instinct for what cuts through on platforms. You live and breathe internet culture, spotting emerging trends and turning them into brand storytelling that feels timely and part of the conversation.
  • Work closely with Tripadvisor Groups Creative and Social teams to develop social media content for TikTok, Instagram and YouTube with potential for Facebook, Pinterest and Reddit.
  • Lead production and execution of a range of social videos and posts, leveraging trends and placing Tripadvisor at the heart of the cultural conversation.
  • Use AI and emerging creative tools to supercharge production, experimenting with new workflows that allow us to ideate, produce and scale high quality video content faster while keeping the craft and originality of the work front and centre.
  • Appear on-camera or voice videos; in partnership with the brand team, hone Tripadvisor’s unique voice on social.
  • Participate in brainstorms, proactively bring new ideas to the table, take direction and feedback from Social and Creative team leads.
  • Manage workback calendars and production needs to meet deadlines with the social media team.
  • Find creative ways to adapt relevant archival Tripadvisor Group footage to support the social media calendar.
  • Assist the Creative team on diverse video editing projects, demonstrating flexibility and readiness to assist across video and photo production tasks as needed.

You Have

  • 4+ years video editing experience, preferably with a focus on native social formats e.g. TikTok, Reels.
  • Experiencing capturing social first videos and photos, specifically short-form video content (30-90 seconds).
  • Experience creating specifically for social media for a brand either at an agency or directly with a brand.
  • Ability to script, storyboard and contribute during creative development.
  • Proficiency in editing and design software such as the Adobe suite, Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva and in-app editing tools.
  • Experience using AI creative tools such as Runway, Midjourney, ChatGPT or Adobe Firefly to enhance ideation, editing and rapid content production.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate creative concepts and strategic thinking to cross-functional teams. Ability to work independently and under close direction
  • Consistent attention to detail including project structure and asset organization
  • A genuine love for and excitement about all things social and travel

To Apply

  • Provide any links to your public social media accounts.
  • Attach a resume
  • Attach a portfolio of your previous work

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

The salary range for this role in the U.S. is $80,000 - $100,000. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. An employee’s pay position within the wage range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. This compensation range may also be modified in the future.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.company_description:
Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service.
With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta Air Lines, connection is at the heart of everything we do and guides our every action. We strive to welcome and care for all of our customers during their travels with us and aim to deliver an elevated experience.

Delta's brand is built on industry-leading operational reliability and customer experience. Within Operations Planning & Performance (OP&P), the OCC Planning team serves as the analytical engine supporting the OCC Strategy organization. OCC Strategy acts as the strategic thought partner to operational leadership, helping the airline identify opportunities, improve decision-making, evaluate performance, and prepare for future operational challenges.

The Analytics Leader plays a critical role in this mission by transforming operational data into actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance management, and continuous improvement efforts across the Operations Control Center (OCC). Working in close partnership with OCC Strategy leadership, the Analytics Leader leads analytical efforts supporting critical initiatives such as After-Action Reviews (AARs), seasonal planning, performance measurement, operational readiness assessments, and strategic operational studies.

While OCC Strategy serves as the primary customer, the role requires maintaining a broad understanding of airline operations and collaborating across Flight Control, Operations Management, Crew, ACS, TechOps, Meteorology, and other operational stakeholders to connect operational execution with future planning and strategy. Through data-driven analysis and storytelling, the Analytics Leader helps leaders understand operational outcomes, identify underlying drivers of performance, evaluate strategic initiatives, and develop recommendations that improve future reliability and operational effectiveness. Successful candidates are naturally curious, highly analytical, and comfortable operating in ambiguous environments. They seek to understand not only operational outcomes, but the underlying drivers that influence those outcomes and the opportunities available to improve future performance. This position requires strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence decision-making through data-driven storytelling and analytical rigor.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary analytical partner to OCC Strategy by leading analyses that support OCC strategic planning, operational readiness reviews, performance evaluations, and executive decision-making
  • Lead analytical support for Winter Planning, Summer Planning, and station planning efforts by evaluating historical performance, weather impacts, operational constraints, network vulnerabilities, and recovery outcomes
  • Measure the effectiveness of seasonal planning initiatives and operating strategies and translate findings into recommendations that improve future seasonal execution
  • Partner with OCC Strategy to lead Post-IROP After-Action Reviews (AARs), seasonal retrospectives, and operational scorecards used to evaluate operational effectiveness
  • Develop performance frameworks and measurement methodologies that convert lessons learned into actionable improvements for future planning, operating procedures, and OCC strategy.
  • Build deep understanding of OCC operational processes, technologies, decision-making frameworks, and business challenges through close partnership with Flight Control, Operations Management, Crew, ACS, TechOps, Meteorology, and other stakeholders to ensure analytical recommendations are operationally feasible and aligned with future strategic needs.
  • Independently lead projects from business problem definition through implementation, including methodology design, data acquisition, analysis, recommendation development, and executive communication.
  • Conduct strategic studies related to topics such as delay propagation, proactive cancellation effectiveness, resource fragility, recovery effectiveness, diversion performance, and future operating strategies.
  • Build datasets, scorecards, dashboards, models, and decision-support tools that improve OCC Strategy's ability to measure performance, evaluate operational strategies, and make informed decisions.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operational analysis, strategy, consulting, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading analytical projects from problem definition through recommendation and implementation
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets to solve business problems and support decision-making
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and critical thinking skills
  • Experience developing and delivering presentations and recommendations to leadership audiences
  • Proficiency with SQL and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline
  • Advanced degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
  • Experience applying statistical techniques, forecasting methodologies, experimental design, optimization, predictive analytics, or other quantitative methods to solve business challenges
  • Proficiency with Python, R, or other analytical programming languages
  • Experience building analytical datasets, automating reporting processes, and developing scalable analytical solutions
  • Familiarity with data engineering concepts including data modeling, ETL processes, data transformation, and data quality management
  • Experience developing performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and operational scorecards
  • Experience supporting strategic planning, performance management, continuous improvement, or operational excellence initiatives
  • Experience translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations
  • Airline, transportation, logistics, or operations-focused industry experience preferred

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

Introduction To The Team

The Associate Account Manager’s primary responsibility is to develop and maintain a high-quality portfolio of relevant, attractive, and competitive hotel and property products for Expedia Group’s fast-growing global traveler base. The Associate Market Manager works with lodging partners within their assigned territory to help maximize the production potential in the marketplace.

Make an impact!

In This Role, You Will

  • Possess a growth mindset, consistently using feedback to improve in role
  • Relationship builder; earns the confidence of others. Bridges and sustains solid partnerships based on mutual support through a collaborative style

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a International Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

As the International Sales Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Complete the relevant Hilton University courses promptly and pass the tests.
  • Be familiar with hotel product knowledge and related activities in both local and international markets.
  • Responsible for the promotion and sales of all hotel products to international markets, including but not limited to rooms, catering, banquets, and MICE business.
  • Complete international sales targets and related tasks set by the hotel.
  • Develop international sales plans and obtain approval from the Director of Sales or Commercial Director, maintaining and developing overseas clients and accounts according to the plan.
  • Understand international customer needs through overseas sales trips, virtual meetings, telephone sales, and face-to-face visits, achieving sales.
  • Produce quotations efficiently, send contracts to international clients and follow-up promptly.
  • Show international clients around the hotel.
  • Operate the hotel reservation system to book rooms, banquet venues, and group business for overseas clients.
  • Send the team’s work order promptly and ensure that relevant departments receive accurate information.
  • Establish strong relationships with international customers, maintain updated client databases, and promptly report customer needs and feedback to the hotel.
  • Promote and recommend other hotels within the global Hilton network to international clients.
  • Proactively collect global market and industry information and share it with the Sales team to capture business opportunities and convert them into confirmed business.
  • Understand competitor information in international markets, including key clients, room offerings, catering, conference promotions, and provide timely feedback to the Commercial Director / Director of Sales / Senior Sales Manager.
  • Welcome key international customers, overseas group leaders, and VIPs upon arrival.
  • Motivate and train department employees and ensure strong performance in handling international business.
  • Ensure effective communication between the Sales team and Operations team through regular meetings and assist relevant departments with international events and group business.
  • Handle feedback or complaints from international guests with professionalism and cultural awareness.
  • Maximize international sales opportunities at all times and effectively forecast team and banquet revenue from overseas markets.
  • Provide necessary supervision and guidance to the Sales Director or sales representatives in handling international accounts, quotations, and contracts.
  • Actively participate in the development of global marketing plans and collaborate to achieve budget targets.
  • Conscientiously perform assigned tasks and special projects.
  • Design new hotel products targeting international markets based on demand, set sales targets, and be responsible for related promotion and sales.
  • Organize customer engagement activities such as FAM trips, client events, and networking sessions for international or potential clients, maintaining and strengthening relationships.
  • Regularly analyze international source markets and develop expansion strategies and channels.
  • The department reserves the right to change or supplement the job description if necessary.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?

Skills

A Senior Sales Manager serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Hospitality: Volunteer to provide unparalleled hospitality.
  • Integrity: Do what you should do all the time.
  • Leadership: Strive to be a leader in both your industry and your community.
  • Teamwork: Actively promote teamwork spirit in all work.
  • Ownership: take responsibility for your actions and make decisions.
  • Now: Operate with urgency and discipline.
  • College degree.
  • 3 years or above hotel sales and related experience.
  • Good English and Japanese reading and writing skills to meet business needs.
  • Good communication, organization and presentation skills.
  • Able to work under strong pressure.
  • Understand local customers and have strong market analysis ability.
  • Have certain customer resources.
  • Able to lead by example.

What will it be like to work for Hilton? Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And, our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all!

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Job Summary

The global distribution landscape in the lodging industry continues to expand and become more complex, and Marriott International recognizes the development and execution of an enhanced future intermediary partner relationship strategy as a key strategic focus. The Distribution team led by the Vice President Channel Distribution oversees Marriott’s approach to channel strategy partnership, account management and commercial relationships as it relates to Online Travel Agents (OTA), Wholesalers, Global Distribution Systems (GDS), Travel Management Companies (TMC), Small and Medium Businesses (SMB), Restaurants and Bars (R&B) Intermediaries, and other emerging distribution channels. As part of Marriott’s Distribution team, the Director Distribution APEC reports to the Senior Director Distribution APEC and Vice President Food and Beverage APEC.

The Director Distribution APEC is accountable for assigned initiatives to support Marriott’s Global Distribution Strategy in APEC with focus on a) managing the day-to-day relationship with assigned OTA, Wholesale and R&B account portfolio by building/maintaining strong trusted relationships with account partners and internal Marriott partners that are accountable for delivering against mutually defined account goals and KPIs, b) transforming and modernizing traditional and offline B2B Wholesale and R&B relationships to create efficiencies and improve content controls by taking advantage of new tools and technology, c) supporting business development for new Channel Partners, d) supporting Marriott’s global channel distribution strategy and developing region specific recommendations, and e) providing distribution strategy guidance and education to continent stakeholders.

This position will be located at the Marriott Corporate Office in Singapore.
