job.job_description:
Senior UX Researcher - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior UX Researcher to join our UX Research team in Barcelona (hybrid). We are looking for a Senior User Researcher to become the dedicated research and intelligence partner for Prime, the heart of eDreams ODIGEO’s business. You will connect evidence from across flights, hotels, rail, ancillaries, payments, Customer Experience and international markets to create an integrated understanding of the Prime member journey. You will identify the strategic knowledge gaps that matter most, lead high-value mixed-methods research and advise Product Directors and executive leaders on opportunities to improve acquisition, engagement, cross-product adoption, retention, revenue and member experience.

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges, and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior UX Researcher in the UX Research team, you will be in charge of:

CORE: Prime Research and Intelligence

 Research and Intelligence

  • Manage the strategic research roadmap across the Prime lifecycle (acquisition, onboarding, engagement, adoption, retention).
  • Prioritize key research to guide Prime strategy, growth, revenue, and experience
  • Execute end-to-end generative, evaluative, and mixed-methods research.
  • Synthesize user feedback, behavioral data, and research into actionable insights.
  • Maintain an Evidence and Opportunity portfolio with source traceability and action items.
  • Link research-backed decisions to execution and measurable results.


Cross-Functional Program Management

  • Coordinate Prime research demand and cross-functional dependencies across teams.
  • Connect research across products to map the end-to-end Prime journey and remove silos.
  • Balance competing priorities for research resources, participants, and CRM capacity.
  • Establish delivery plans, key decisions, risks, and escalations for complex research initiatives.
  • Support cross-product research directly shaping Prime strategy and member experience.


Executive-Level Stakeholder Management

  • Advise Prime Product Directors and executives with actionable research insights.
  • Summarize evidence into clear recommendations, trade-offs, and risk assessments.
  • Regularly share insights, knowledge gaps, and research priorities with leaders.
  • Identify research gaps early to de-risk key product investments.
  • Transparently report research limitations and confidence levels.
  • Guide roadmaps using objective, evidence-based data.


Research Operations

  • Internal Member Participant Recruitment Management
  • Lead team-wide CRM participant recruitment as the primary owner.
  • Manage recruitment workflows, including prioritization, targeting, scheduling, incentives, and CRM QA.
  • Maintain a central roadmap, calendar, and contact records for cross-team outreach.
  • Enforce contact frequency, fatigue, privacy, consent, and sample quality controls.
  • Align cross-team recruitment to eliminate duplicate outreach and scheduling conflicts.
  • Monitor campaign metrics and member-contact risks to improve the CRM operating model.


Research Operations Infrastructure

  • Build scalable research infrastructure, including RACIs, SOPs, intake, and templates.
  • Set research planning, participant management, evidence traceability, and quality standards.
  • Track operations metrics to remove bottlenecks and increase speed, reliability, and output.
  • Partner with UR leadership and UXD Ops to define operational ownership.
  • Develop business cases for dedicated Research Operations capacity.


AI Transformation and Operations

  • Scale responsible AI workflows from planning to impact tracking.
  • Prioritize AI use cases that clear bottlenecks and improve accessibility.
  • Set validation, privacy, traceability, and quality controls.
  • Pilot and scale AI workflows based on quality and output impact.
  • Drive adoption with guidelines while keeping researchers accountable.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of UX/behavioral research experience in digital products, e-commerce, SaaS, or subscriptions.
  • Proven leadership in strategic research influencing product roadmaps and business decisions.
  • Strong mixed-methods expertise across qualitative and quantitative research.
  • Skill in synthesizing multi-source evidence into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to advise and influence Product Directors and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience with recruitment, customer panels, and scalable research operations.
  • Strong systems thinking to build governance, workflows, and measurable operational controls.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Design, Data, CRM, Legal, and Privacy teams.
  • Applied experience using AI in research workflows with strong evidence quality and privacy judgment.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.


Valuable Additional Experience

  • Advanced survey design, experimentation, or statistical analysis (R, Python, SPSS, SQL, Excel).
  • UX lab experience in experimental research, eye-tracking, or biometrics.
  • Membership, subscription, loyalty, retention, or LTV research.
  • Travel, international e-commerce, or multi-product user journey experience.
  • Familiarity with research repositories, taxonomies, or AI knowledge systems.
  • Coordinating recruitment via CRM or owned customer channels.
  • Setting participant-contact, fatigue, or sampling policies.
  • Cross-country, multi-language, or cross-cultural research experience.
  • Fluency in Spanish, German, French, or Italian (English is standard).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support, and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

job.job_description:
Organization- The Standard, Hua Hin

Summary

 Developing and Maintaining Rooms Division Goals

  • Sets clear expectations and holds Rooms Division leaders accountable for service, operational and financial performance.
  • Develops and implements Rooms Division operating strategies aligned with hotel business objectives.
  • Establishes challenging, realistic and measurable goals for Front Office, Housekeeping, Spa and Security.
  • Reviews departmental performance and identifies areas requiring corrective action or improvement.
  • Ensures operational standards, policies and procedures are consistently implemented.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve service delivery, efficiency and overall Rooms Division performance.
  • Challenges existing processes where necessary and drives appropriate operational improvements.
  • Ensures departmental leaders understand their responsibilities, priorities and expected outcomes.

Developing and Managing Budgets and Financial Performance

  • Develops and manages Rooms Division budgets and forecasts.
  • Reviews financial reports and operating results to evaluate performance against budget and forecast.
  • Monitors payroll, overtime, operating expenses and other controllable costs.
  • Ensures manpower and scheduling are aligned with occupancy, business demand and operational requirements.
  • Reviews productivity and staffing levels to ensure effective use of available resources.
  • Works with departmental leaders to address unfavorable financial or productivity variances.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve revenue, efficiency and profitability without compromising guest experience.
  • Evaluates operational and financial implications when making decisions.
  • Makes recommendations for CAPEX and operational investments based on business needs and expected impact.

Leading Front Office and Guest Experience

  • Oversees Front Office operations to ensure an efficient and welcoming arrival, stay and departure experience.
  • Ensures Front Office leaders maintain appropriate staffing, service standards and operational control.
  • Reviews guest feedback, complaints and satisfaction results and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.
  • Supports the team in managing significant guest concerns and service recovery situations.
  • Ensures guest information, preferences and special requirements are effectively communicated to relevant departments.
  • Promotes proactive guest engagement and anticipates opportunities to enhance the guest experience.
  • Maintains visible leadership presence in guest areas, particularly during high business periods.

Leading Housekeeping Operations

  • Oversees Housekeeping operations to ensure guestrooms and public areas meet required cleanliness and presentation standards.
  • Ensures effective manpower planning and room allocation according to occupancy and business levels.
  • Monitors housekeeping productivity, room turnaround and quality performance.
  • Ensures appropriate control of linen, guest supplies, uniforms and operating equipment.
  • Works closely with Front Office and Engineering to ensure room availability and timely resolution of maintenance issues.
  • Reviews recurring room defects, cleanliness issues and guest complaints and ensures corrective action is implemented.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve Housekeeping efficiency and productivity while maintaining service quality.

Leading Spa Operations

  • Oversees Spa operations to ensure high-quality guest experiences and achievement of business objectives.
  • Reviews Spa revenue, productivity, treatment utilization and operating expenses.
  • Ensures staffing and scheduling are appropriate to business demand.
  • Works with Spa leadership to identify opportunities to increase revenue and guest engagement.
  • Ensures Spa facilities and operating practices meet service, hygiene and safety standards.
  • Supports the development of Spa colleagues and ensures appropriate service and product knowledge.

Leading Security and Loss Prevention

  • Oversees Security/Loss Prevention operations to protect guests, colleagues, hotel assets and reputation.
  • Ensures appropriate safety, security, emergency response and incident management procedures are maintained.
  • Reviews significant incidents and ensures appropriate investigation and corrective action.
  • Ensures Security manpower deployment is appropriate to business levels, events and identified risks.
  • Works closely with Human Resources, Engineering and other departments on safety, security and emergency preparedness.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment and composure when managing sensitive or high-pressure situations.

Leading the Rooms Division Team

  • Utilizes strong leadership and communication skills to lead, influence and develop departmental leaders.
  • Encourages trust, respect, collaboration and accountability throughout the Rooms Division.
  • Leads by example and demonstrates integrity, professionalism and sound business judgment.
  • Ensures regular communication occurs across all Rooms Division departments.
  • Sets clear performance expectations and holds leaders accountable for agreed results.
  • Delegates responsibility appropriately while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
  • Provides clear, candid and timely feedback to improve performance.
  • Coaches and develops departmental leaders and colleagues to strengthen capability and performance.
  • Identifies high-potential talent and supports succession planning and career development.
  • Addresses performance or behavioral issues promptly and appropriately.

Ensuring Exceptional Guest Service

  • Ensures services consistently meet or exceed guest expectations.
  • Reviews guest satisfaction results, comments, complaints and other feedback to identify areas for improvement.
  • Ensures departmental leaders take appropriate corrective action based on guest feedback.
  • Empowers colleagues to resolve guest concerns within appropriate guidelines.
  • Encourages teams to understand guest needs and anticipate expectations.
  • Ensures service recovery addresses both the immediate guest concern and any underlying operational issue.
  • Balances guest satisfaction with appropriate financial and operational considerations.

Managing Manpower and Productivity

  • Ensures departmental manpower is planned according to occupancy, workload and business needs.
  • Reviews FTE, payroll, overtime, productivity and scheduling across all Rooms Division departments.
  • Holds departmental leaders accountable for effective use of existing manpower.
  • Evaluates manpower requests based on workload, productivity and operational requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve scheduling, work processes and resource allocation before increasing headcount.
  • Works with Human Resources and Finance to ensure manpower plans remain appropriate and cost-effective.
  • Ensures workforce decisions support both colleague wellbeing and responsible financial management.

Driving Operational Improvement and Data-Based Decisions

  • Uses financial, operational and guest data to establish priorities and make informed decisions.
  • Reviews relevant KPIs and performance trends across Front Office, Housekeeping, Spa and Security.
  • Requires departmental leaders to identify root causes and corrective actions for recurring issues.
  • Analyses information and evaluates alternatives before determining solutions.
  • Encourages teams to question ineffective processes and identify better ways of working.
  • Ensures agreed action plans have clear ownership and are followed through to completion.
  • Adapts plans and processes when business conditions or guest expectations change.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Works collaboratively with other Executive Committee members and departments to achieve hotel-wide objectives.
  • Builds effective relationships with Food & Beverage, Engineering, Sales & Marketing, Revenue, Finance and Human Resources.
  • Encourages departments to share information and resolve issues collaboratively.
  • Breaks down departmental silos and prioritizes overall hotel success over individual departmental interests.
  • Communicates relevant information clearly and in a timely manner.
  • Considers guest, colleague, operational and owner impact when making significant decisions.
  • Supports hotel-wide initiatives and takes ownership of collective Executive Committee outcomes.

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

  • Provides guidance and direction to Rooms Division leaders, including setting performance standards and monitoring results.
  • Partners with Human Resources in recruitment, performance management, colleague relations and talent development.
  • Ensures departmental leaders effectively manage staffing, scheduling, productivity and colleague performance.
  • Ensures expectations and objectives are clearly communicated to colleagues.
  • Creates an environment where colleagues can raise questions, concerns and ideas openly.
  • Ensures colleagues are treated fairly, consistently and respectfully.
  • Identifies developmental needs and provides coaching, mentoring and appropriate learning opportunities.
  • Supports the development of future leaders and internal talent pipelines.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, or related field.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of Rooms Division experience, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Strong background in Front Office, Housekeeping, Guest Experience, and Rooms Revenue Management.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing departmental budgets, forecasts, and productivity.
  • Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Outstanding guest service mindset with a passion for creating memorable guest experiences.
  • Proficient in PMS and hotel management systems (Opera experience preferred).
  • Fluent in English and Thai, both written and spoken.
  • Legally authorized to work in Thailand.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager, MICE, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

Sales & Business Development

  • Prospect and secure MICE and group business from key markets and assigned corporate accounts.
  • Develop and maintain detailed account plans in Salesforce; ensure timely updates of all sales activities.
  • Conduct client meetings, lead site inspections, and organize familiarization trips and client entertainment (flexibility for evenings/weekends required).
  • Represent the hotel at trade shows, networking events, and sales trips to generate new leads.
  • Collaborate with Hilton Sales network, TMCs, and MICE partners to strengthen relationships and drive new business.
  • Support corporate sales activities when required ensuring seamless collaboration across segments, including
  • Manage corporate RFP processes and maintain accurate trackers; ensure rates are correctly loaded in GDS.
  • Utilize third party tools such as TravelClick Hotelligence (Agency 360) to analyze market trends and identify new business opportunities.

Account Management

  • Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to maximize repeat business.
  • Ensure timely responses to inquiries and proposals to improve conversion rates.
  • Monitor account performance and implement strategies to achieve revenue goals.

Conference & Events

  • Work closely with the Events team to ensure smooth handover of confirmed business.
  • Support initiatives to increase conversion and optimize space utilization.

Revenue & Reporting

  • Support pricing strategies and competitor analysis in collaboration with Revenue Management.
  • Assist in preparing monthly activity reports detailing confirmed and provisional business.
  • Contribute to annual sales forecasts and revenue plans.

Systems & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate data management in all sales systems.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Hilton systems, procedures, and brand standards.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 to 3 years’ experience in hotel/event sales, preferably in MICE or group segments.
  • Strong selling, negotiation, and lead management skills.
  • Commercial acumen with experience in forecasting and analytics.
  • Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build strong client relationships and deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Flexibility to travel and work evenings/weekends as required.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce, GDS, and revenue management tools is an advantage.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
アソシエイトマネージャー共同ブランドマーケティングジャパン

Associate Manager, Co-Brand Marketing Japan

IHGの日本の共同ブランド・クレジットカード・ポートフォリオにおいて、新規顧客獲得（非会員）および既存会員向けマーケティングの企画・実行を支援していただきます。

カード会員のライフサイクル全体にわたるマーケティング施策の効果的な実施を支援するとともに、社内のチーム、外部代理店、パートナーとの主要な窓口としての役割を担います。

カード新規獲得および継続的な会員エンゲージメントを促進するマーケティング資料の作成を調整し、事業目標を達成するための戦術的な提案を行い、チャネルのパフォーマンスを最適化します。

職務内容

年次共同ブランド・新規獲得（非会員）およびポートフォリオ（会員）マーケティング計画の策定と実行を支援し、ダイレクトメール、Eメール、ウェブサイト、アプリ、その他の会員向けコミュニケーションなど、利用可能なすべてのチャネルを効果的に活用します。パフォーマンスの継続的な改善を促進するプロセスおよび実行体制を構築します。

社内チーム、代理店、ベンダー、外部パートナーと連携し、ターゲット層の選定、クリエイティブアプローチ、オファー／インセンティブの構成、制作の詳細など、キャンペーンの仕様を策定します。また、マネージャーに提案を提示して承認を得た上で、承認された施策を実行します。

各キャンペーンや施策において、正確な測定と分析を可能にする適切な管理体制が整っていることを確認します。パフォーマンス、インサイト、および推奨される最適化策をまとめます。

広告代理店やフルフィルメント業者との日常的な関係を管理し、すべての顧客獲得およびポートフォリオ関連資料の高品質かつタイムリーな提供を確保する。

部門横断的なステークホルダーと連携し、マーケティング施策の円滑な実行を支援する。また、緊密な協力関係を構築・維持し、連携と成果を最大化する。

マーケティングミックス全体における競合他社の動向を監視し、顧客獲得効率とカード会員のエンゲージメントを向上させるための提言を行う。

必要に応じて、シニアマネージャーを補佐し、その他のマーケティングプロジェクトや施策を支援する。

募集要項

学歴

マーケティング、ビジネス、または関連分野の学士号または修士号、あるいは同等の学歴と関連実務経験の組み合わせ。

必須の経験と専門知識

企業マーケティング環境において、キャンペーン開発、クロスチャネルでの実行、クリエイティブ制作に携わった、2～5年の段階的な実務経験。

顧客獲得および／またはポートフォリオ（顧客維持、エンゲージメント、ライフサイクル）マーケティングの支援経験がある方を強く歓迎します。

外部の代理店、パートナー、またはベンダーとの協業経験。

技術的スキルおよび知識

日本語および英語の流暢な能力（会話・文章）が必須

キャンペーン管理、コミュニケーション計画、市場投入戦略、およびマーケティングツールの使用経験。

プロモーション、チャネル、またはフリークエンシーマーケティングにおける実績のある経験が望ましい。

マーケティングの概念や原則（測定や最適化を含む）について深い理解があること。

優れた問題解決能力および分析能力を有すること。

社内チーム、パートナー、ベンダーとの間で、明確かつ効果的な口頭および書面によるコミュニケーション能力を有すること。

優れた組織力および時間管理能力を有し、複数のプロジェクトを同時に管理できること。

チームワークを重視する姿勢を持ち、優れた対人スキルと、問題解決に向けた積極的なアプローチができること。

プレゼンテーションおよびファシリテーションのスキルを実証できること。

Excel、Word、PowerPointの熟練した操作能力が必須です。

Associate Manager, Japan Co-Brand Marketing

You will support the development and execution of both Acquisition (non-cardmember) and Portfolio (cardmember) marketing for IHG’s Japan Co-Brand credit card portfolio.

In this role, you will help ensure effective implementation of marketing initiatives across the full cardmember lifecycle and serve as a key point of contact with internal teams, external agencies, and partners.

You will coordinate the production of marketing materials that drive card acquisition and ongoing cardmember engagement, make tactical recommendations to meet business objectives, and optimize channel performance.

Key Accountabilities

Assist in the development and execution of an annual Co-Brand Acquisition (non-cardmember) and Portfolio (cardmember) marketing plan, ensuring effective use of all available channels including, but not limited to, direct mail, email, website, app, and other member communications. Develop processes and delivery systems that drive continuous improvement in performance.

Partner with internal teams, agencies, vendors, and external partners to develop campaign specifications, including target audience selection, creative approach, offer/incentive structure, and production details; present recommendations to the Manager for approval and execute approved initiatives.

Ensure each campaign or initiative includes appropriate controls to enable accurate measurement and analysis; summarize performance, insights, and recommended optimizations for future iterations.

Manage day-to-day relationships with advertising agencies and fulfillment vendors, ensuring high quality and timely delivery of all Acquisition and Portfolio materials.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support successful execution of marketing initiatives; build and maintain strong working relationships to maximize alignment and outcomes.

Monitor competitive activity across the marketing mix and provide recommendations to improve acquisition efficiency and cardmember engagement.

Support the Senior Manager with additional marketing projects and initiatives as needed.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Critical Experience & Expertise

2–5 years of progressive experience in a corporate marketing environment, with exposure to campaign development, cross-channel execution, and creative production.

Experience supporting customer acquisition and/or portfolio (retention, engagement, lifecycle) marketing strongly preferred.

Experience working with external agencies, partners, or vendors.

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Fluency in both Japanese and English (spoken and written) required

Experience with campaign management, communications planning, go-to-market strategies, and marketing tools.

Demonstrated Experience In Promotional, Channel, Or Frequency Marketing Preferred.

Strong understanding of marketing concepts and principles, including measurement and optimization.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Clear, effective verbal and written communication skills across internal teams, partners, and vendors.

Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives.

Team-oriented mindset with strong interpersonal skills and a proactive approach to problem solving.

Demonstrated presentation and facilitation skills.

Proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint required.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.

Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.

We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.

We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Care at GetYourGuide is in the middle of a fundamental transformation — and it's one of the most important bets we're making as a company. We're moving from traditional human-led support to an LLM-powered model, where AI handles the majority of interactions and our human teams focus on the cases that genuinely need them. That shift changes everything: how we staff, how we plan, how we measure, and what "great care" even looks like.

The Care Experience & Strategy team sits at the centre of this change. We're the function that turns operational complexity into clarity — owning the forecasting, analytics, and strategic planning that keep Care running as the model underneath it evolves. This isn't a team that maintains what exists. It's a team that's actively rebuilding how a world-class support organisation operates in an AI-first world. If you're energised by building something new rather than running something established, this is where you want to be.

Your mission

As Manager of Workforce Management, you'll own the forecasting and planning capability that Care's transformation depends on. Reporting to the Head of Care Experience & Strategy, you'll lead a team of three WFM specialists to replace our manual, Google Sheets-based forecasting models with an AI and automations driven approach — cutting forecast run time from ~23 hours to under 2 hours, while sharpening the accuracy our operations rely on. This is a build role, not a maintain role. You'll set the direction, make the calls on methodology and tooling, and take your team along with you.

  • Lead the end-to-end transformation of our forecasting capability, replacing manual Google Sheets-based models with an AI-driven solution that improves both speed and accuracy.
  • Build and mature forecasting models for emerging lines of business, ensuring our planning capability scales alongside GetYourGuide's growth
  • Develop a scenario modelling capability that enables Care leadership to stress-test assumptions, model trade-offs, and make faster, more confident operational decisions
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of three WFM specialists — setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, and creating an environment where the team can do their best work
  • Drive AI adoption within your team — identifying new use cases, building workflows and automations, and helping your team develop their own AI capabilities
  • Partner closely with Care Operations, Finance, and Technology stakeholders to ensure forecasting outputs are understood, trusted, and acted upon
  • Define and own the metrics that measure forecast quality, model performance, and planning effectiveness — using data to continuously improve
  • Strengthen the continuous feedback loop between Realtime Management insights and future forecasts, driving continuous improvement of our forecasting accuracy

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with at least 3 in workforce management, operations analytics, or a related planning function, ideally within a customer care, support, or contact centre environment
  • Proven track record of building or significantly improving forecasting models, with a strong grasp of forecasting methodologies and their practical trade-offs
  • Demonstrated experience applying automation and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work — you can share concrete examples of workflows or automations you've built and the impact they had
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with large datasets, building models, and translating complex outputs into clear operational recommendations
  • Experience leading a small team of specialists, with the ability to set direction, develop people, and maintain high standards
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills — you can translate technical forecasting concepts into language that resonates with operational and senior leadership audiences
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement — you don't wait to be told something is broken before fixing it

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, NICE, Assembled, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL, or other tools used for data modelling and automation
  • Experience building forecasting models in a multi-channel or multi-LOB care environment
  • Exposure to scenario planning or capacity modelling in an operational context

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

We are seeking a Senior Product & Technology Consultant to join our global Product & Technology Consulting team, where innovation knows no borders. You will bridge technical and commercial goals, guide development teams through API onboarding and optimize complex hospitality connectivity workflows. This role requires technical depth, analytical problem-solving and the confidence to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

What you'll do

  • Guide customer engineering teams through API onboarding, testing, implementation and production launch across REST, SOAP and OAuth architectures.

  • Lead or support customer onboarding and adoption of LGX solutions and hotel APIs, helping bridge technical and functional knowledge gaps across customer and internal teams.

  • Troubleshoot complex implementation issues by analyzing payloads, service logs and system behaviors to accelerate root-cause resolution.

  • Use generative AI and automated log analysis tools to streamline API debugging, speed up issue diagnosis and build repeatable team playbooks.
  • Coach Product & Technology Consulting colleagues and deliver technical enablement sessions to improve team capabilities and customer self-sufficiency.
  • Act as an internal multiplier by sharing expertise across hospitality, API, connectivity and integration engagements.

What you'll bring

Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience in travel technology, hospitality technology, software integration or a comparable customer-facing technical consulting environment.
  • Proven experience supporting external customer or partner development teams through API onboarding, implementation, testing, go-live and production support.
  • Strong technical expertise with REST, SOAP, OAuth, XML, JSON, API debugging, log analysis, web services and integration architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Fluent written and spoken English skills.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% based on customer needs across EMEA time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of hotel and hospitality connectivity, including PMS, OTA, GDS, channel manager, hotel aggregator or payment gateway integrations.
  • Experience with LGX or comparable hospitality connectivity and content distribution solutions.
  • Experience managing complex multi-platform integration programs, including LGX-related workflows or equivalent orchestration environments.

  • Professional fluency in an additional EMEA language.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

We are looking for a Senior Search Analyst to work on data-led analytical elements of our paid search program. You will be part of a dynamic and innovative team where autonomous decision-making, self-motivation and flexible thinking is encouraged. You will play a crucial role in shaping the future success of the company.

About The Role

In this role you will join the Search Engine Marketing (SEM) bidding team, who own and manage the data-led systems that ensure we’re making the most out of our paid search advertising spend. Your contribution will have a direct impact on paid search bidding strategies, optimizing existing automated systems and using data to help identify new opportunities or problem areas in paid search marketing. You will work in collaboration with the wider SEM team, Data Science and Data Engineering teams to actively measure and manage the performance and optimization of our paid search program across UK & FIGS markets. Furthermore, you will help the team adopt AI. This means finding real-world applications for AI tools to make our systems run faster, improve the quality of our data analysis and uncover deeper analytical insights.

What You'll Do

  • Produce original analyses to identify and explore opportunities to optimize our search engine marketing (SEM) bidding strategies towards maximizing revenue.
  • Seek out and implement improvements to our existing automated paid marketing systems.
  • Plan and execute measurement tests and experiments to evaluate the impact of different bidding strategies and apply findings to improve performance.
  • Apply analytical techniques to measure the true return of our SEM spend.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as Marketing and Data Science/Machine Learning to align on strategies, share insights, and ensure objectives are met.
  • Check on marketing performance daily and regularly report outward to the wider team and upward to the leadership team about trends, wins, and future plans.
  • Leverage AI tools and technologies for day-to-day tasks & systems to enhance efficiency, generate insights and streamline workflows.
  • Stay informed and proactively implement emerging ad technologies, best practices in media systems management and bidding optimization, process improvements and automation to enhance performance.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business / Maths / Statistics or a related quantitative field.
  • 2+ years experience working in a data analytics position, preferably in a digital marketing environment.
  • Ability to turn complex data into compelling storytelling and actionable recommendations.
  • Expertise in interrogating data using SQL and writing custom SQL queries, and understanding of database structures.
  • Understanding of statistical analysis techniques used for experimental design such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis and time series analysis.
  • Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, with a genuine eagerness to expand your knowledge and application of AI within SEM, data and bidding.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively present findings, explain complex concepts and influence stakeholder decisions making.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Has a genuine passion for learning and self-improvement, continuously seeking out new opportunities to expand knowledge and skills.
  • Prior exposure to Paid Search, Bidding, and Marketing KPIs is a strong plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year

job.job_description:
Organization- Hyatt Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt seeks an enthusiastic Business Development Manager to join our Inclusive Collection Sales Team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader North America and Global Field Sales team, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best and fastest-growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands, and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities for our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy, and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and a discount at the on-site fitness center
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K with company match

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results-driven, and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving Inclusive Collection sales and business growth within your assigned territory covering 4 states. Key responsibilities include identifying, developing, and maintaining strong relationships with travel agencies and advisors; executing strategic and tactical sales plans; delivering product training; escorting travel advisor FAM trips; and representing the Inclusive Collection at industry conferences and events.

As a BDM, you’ll blend strategy with execution to grow market share and strengthen advisor engagement:

  • Drive Revenue Growth: Identify, develop, and expand relationships with travel agencies and advisors to increase Inclusive Collection sales.
  • Build Strong Partnerships: Cultivate high-value connections while increasing engagement with the Confidant Collective.
  • Expand Your Network: Prospect, onboard, and activate new agency accounts through sales calls, training, incentives, and FAM trips.
  • Be a Brand Ambassador: Represent Inclusive Collection at industry events, conferences, and trade shows—both domestically and internationally.
  • Educate & Inspire: Deliver impactful product trainings via in-person events, sales calls, webinars, blitzes, and social platforms.
  • Collaborate Strategically: Partner with tour operators and internal teams to maximize business opportunities.
  • Own Your Territory: Manage and optimize your regional budget to drive ROI through targeted sales activities.
  • Leverage Data & Tools: Utilize Salesforce to track performance, pipeline, competitive insights, and ROI.
  • Stay Connected: Maintain consistent communication with Regional Director, including weekly and bi-weekly meetings, for territory planning, strategy alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Live the Brand: Champion Hyatt’s core values in everything you do.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

You’re not just a salesperson—you’re a connector, storyteller, and strategist who thrives in a fast-paced, relationship-driven environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree or 5+ years equivalent experience in sales/marketing
  • 2–3+ years in field sales or business development within the travel industry
  • Proven ability to build trust, influence partners, and grow relationships
  • Strong presentation, communication, and organizational skills
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and results-oriented with the ability to multitask
  • A collaborative team player who works effectively across functions
  • Adaptable, flexible, and energized by travel and client engagement
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Valid driver’s license and passport required
  • Willingness to travel up to 75% (domestic & international)
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends as needed
  • Must be based in or willing to relocate to Southern California

Experience Preferred:

  • Background in luxury resort or hospitality sales
  • Established relationships with key West Coast Travel Agencies, Consortia and Tour Operators
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM
  • Spanish language skills a plus

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all-encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

The salary range for this position is $80,000-$90,000. This position is also eligible to earn incentive awards, an annual bonus, monthly or quarterly incentives, etc.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level, and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The location for this position is virtual/remote

This is an exciting opportunity to join a world‑class Global Sales team dedicated to delivering Hilton's unmatched scale, access, expertise, and experience to our owners, operators, and customers. As the Director, Sales Worldwide Accounts (Group Sales), you will help shape a differentiated sales experience that elevates Hilton's diverse portfolio of brands and drive meaningful connections.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and lead an identified roster of accounts to generate market share growth and expand Hilton's presence across key corporate companies and industries. Additionally, you will be responsible for account planning, cross-team collaboration, building & strengthening customer relationships, uncovering new opportunities, and driving performance and incremental growth to our hotels and to Hilton.

As part of the Corporate Group Sales team and reporting to the Managing Director, you will focus on Financial & Insurance Corporate Accounts, playing a pivotal role in advancing Hilton's position within this critical segment.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Guide the account planning strategy for your accounts to facilitate growth.
  • Aggregate client account-based growth data and evaluate areas of opportunity.
  • Qualify accounts and maintain compliance to account governance protocol
  • Ensure our client's daily needs are met while identifying viable opportunities to improve operational and financial performance through targeted initiatives.
  • Be a subject matter expert in all brands and closing the sale with clients.
  • Anticipate client needs and develop an approach that is tailored to each client
  • Generate leads and mine opportunities within existing accounts to drive incremental revenue.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team including Hilton Direct partnership team members and HWS Sales Specialists to drive total account value and provide total client solutions.
  • Network with business decision-makers and executives to influence positive buying behaviors.

What Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Model account-based trends on a cadence (i.e. weekly, quarterly, etc.), compare data with previous years' results and forecast future account-based growth rates.
  • Provide accurate forecasting and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
  • Understand industry trends that impact customer buying behaviors and offer innovative solutions.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Ten (10) years of hotel/travel sales and account management experience
  • Experience analyzing data and making data-centric recommendations
  • Experience maintaining national or global accounts
  • Knowledge of the hospitality and travel industry
  • Travel up to 40%

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • BA/BS Bachelor's Degree
  • In-depth knowledge and use in Delphi or similar property sales management system
  • Experience using Salesforce (CRM)

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $100,000 – $145,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), and the Company's long-term incentive plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive sales professional who thrives on building relationships, identifying new opportunities and converting high-value business. With a strong focus on Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Events (MICE).

A little taste of your day-to-day: 

  • Proactively source and convert new MICE business through cold outreach, networking, tradeshows and industry events.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with PCOs, venue finders, associations, meeting planners and key clients to drive repeat and new business.
  • Develop and implement sales strategies that grow MICE revenue, room nights and overall hotel revenue.

What We Need From You

  • At least 2 years’ experience in a sales role within a multi-unit or similar hospitality environment.
  • Strong knowledge of sales principles, techniques and client management.
  • Experience working with international and regional clients, ideally with an understanding of multi-hotel brands and destinations.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of market trends and customer needs.

What you can expect from us: 

You’ll be rewarded for your hard work with a suite of benefits that supports you and your family’s well-being, including: 

  • Parental Leave Cover for 12 months
  • Annual Salary of $80-85k plus super
  • Paid birthday leave 
  • Hotel perks like accommodation and food & beverage discounts
  • Enhanced parental leave 
  • Proactive health days and flexible work options. 
  • Your career journey will be supported through our lifelong development program 
  • IHG Career Milestone celebrations 
  • Transfer of entitlements as you move and grow with IHG. 
  • Access to our discount retail platform that makes your pay go even further 

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate differences and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

At the Central Data Products team, our mission is to build, operate, and drive adoption of horizontal data products that empower multiple clusters across GetYourGuide.

We are a horizontal team within central services, and our products are pivotal to the entire flywheel: Consumer, Growth, and Supply. We own the systems that decide how our marketplace is understood and organized: location and travel category tagging that powers landing pages, the landing page eligibility framework that unlocks marketing efficiency at scale, destination maps and travel-relevance models that steer supply acquisition into untapped markets, and the Customer Lifetime Value model that shifts the company from short-term revenue optimization to long-term customer value. Many of these systems are LLM-based and running in production today.

As the Senior Data Science Manager of Central Data Products, you will lead the vision, strategy, and execution of a portfolio of data and ML products used across the company. Your team is senior and cross-functional (Data Scientists, MLOps Engineers, and a Product Manager), and its output is measured in company-level business impact, not in models shipped.

Your mission

  • Lead all hiring and performance management processes for your team, helping Data Scientists and MLOps Engineers reach their full potential in a domain that mixes classical ML, LLMs, and production data infrastructure.
  • Drive high-impact outcomes by managing the team's roadmap and portfolio allocation across a diverse set of horizontal data products, making explicit trade-offs between exploration, productionalization, and ongoing operations.
  • Find and deliver solutions to complex technical challenges that span multiple services and business domains, from marketplace tagging quality to predictive customer models.
  • Own adoption, not just delivery. Horizontal data products only create value when clusters build on them, so you will drive operationalization together with Growth, Supply, and Consumer stakeholders.
  • Raise the operational bar for data products in production: quality baselines, LLM-as-judge and golden dataset monitoring, incident management, and reliable at-scale pipelines.
  • Build strategic partnerships with senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales, aligning ownership of shared systems from day one.

Your toolkit

  • You have a strong sense of ownership, ensuring technical and product plans are aligned with your stakeholders, your team, and organizational and company goals.
  • You approach ambiguous, broadly scoped problems with an open mind and a bias toward a directional first version over extended discovery.
  • You bring a strong technical background in machine learning and engineering, enabling you to evaluate decisions on modeling approaches, data architecture, evaluation methods, and production pipelines.
  • You actively lead and contribute to technical, design, and product discussions within your team's domain, balancing exploration speed with production reliability.
  • You are passionate about building and developing a high-performing team: mentoring, coaching, and empowering senior individual contributors to do the best work of their careers.
  • You translate technical results into business decisions and can hold your own with commercial stakeholders on impact, trade-offs, and prioritization.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience leading teams that own horizontal or platform-like data products serving multiple internal customers, where adoption is as hard as the build.
  • Experience running ML or data products in production, including quality monitoring, evaluation systems, and incident management.
  • Experience applying LLMs to large-scale classification, extraction, or tagging problems, and knowing when a classical model is the better answer.
  • Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or travel domains.
  • Experience in a high-growth environment, taking projects from zero to one and scaling them across an organization.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy.
