Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Performance Marketing Strategy Manager

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services—helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Make an Impact

The Performance Marketing Strategy Manager will support paid media strategy for Expedia Group’s B2B Supply Marketing business. This role connects business goals to channel planning, strengthens how the team operates, and supports better decisions across planning, performance reviews, budget recommendations, and agency management.

You will work across a complex paid media portfolio with channel and performance specialists, internal stakeholders, agencies, and external partners. Your judgment, cross-functional partnership, and ability to execute independently will help surface the right work, clarify priorities, and keep the portfolio moving against the most important business needs.

In This Role, You Will

  • Support cross-channel paid media planning by translating business goals into actionable priorities, recommendations, and next steps across SEM, paid social, and programmatic.
  • Partner with channel specialists, performance specialists, agencies, vendors, and teams including analytics, finance, creative, and product to support strategic priorities and day-to-day decision-making.
  • Establish and maintain a clear operating rhythm for prioritization, performance reviews, issue triage, escalation, accountability, and follow-through across the paid media portfolio.
  • Drive weekly performance readouts for leadership, translating channel inputs into a clear portfolio narrative that highlights actions, risks, recommendations, and unresolved measurement gaps.
  • Provide budget allocation recommendations and conduct regular budget check-ins to ensure pacing and investment decisions remain aligned to business goals.
  • Improve decision quality by distinguishing verified performance from directional signals, identifying channel mix and experimentation opportunities, and ensuring recommendations are grounded in business relevance and measurement quality.
  • Identify manual, slow, or ambiguous reporting, measurement, and planning workflows and help convert them into more durable, scalable processes.

What Success Looks Like

  • Paid media decisions are faster, clearer, and better grounded in evidence.
  • Channel and performance specialists have clear direction on priorities, ownership, and escalation paths.
  • Monthly budgets are managed and monitored with greater rigor across the portfolio.
  • Leadership receives clear weekly performance narratives, budget recommendations, and actionable opportunities.
  • Measurement limitations are surfaced early and handled deliberately.
  • Reporting, prioritization, and escalation cadences are consistent across the portfolio.
  • The function is less dependent on manual reconciliation and individual backstopping and is more resilient as a system.

Experience And Qualifications

  • You have significant experience in paid media, performance marketing, growth marketing, or a related strategy and operations role.
  • You have demonstrated success supporting cross-channel paid media planning across multiple publishers and performance objectives, including SEM, paid social, and programmatic.
  • You have strong judgment and can work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • You have experience making budget allocation recommendations, participating in pacing discussions, and supporting performance tradeoff decisions across a paid media portfolio.
  • You can translate data into executive-ready weekly performance narratives, recommendations, and business cases.
  • You have experience working with agencies or external vendors and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
  • You have deep familiarity with performance measurement, attribution tradeoffs, reporting limitations, and diagnosing performance or process issues.
  • You have proven experience designing or improving operating models, cadences, workflows, or business processes in a marketing organization.
  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues for senior audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in travel, B2B marketing, marketplace, ecommerce, or another high-scale digital acquisition business.
  • Familiarity with paid media and measurement tools and data environments, such as platform reporting, GA4, campaign management tools, and performance reporting systems.
  • Experience balancing strategic planning with day-to-day operational realities in a lean or capacity-constrained team environment.
  • Comfort balancing near-term performance demands with longer-term capability building.

 

The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $104,000.00 to $145,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $166,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Equal Opportunity

Summary of Position

The Sr. Manager, Enterprise Meetings is directly responsible for the implementation, management, and ongoing optimization of every Strategic Meetings Management (SMM) client program within CTM Meetings & Events. This role owns the full program lifecycle — current-state assessment, program design, policy and workflow build, technology configuration, stakeholder rollout, adoption, and continuous optimization. The Manager serves as the operational owner of the SMM portfolio, partnering with Account Management, Sourcing, Planning, Technology, and Finance to deliver consistent and well-governed program experience. This role may lead a small team of SMM specialists supporting implementation and ongoing program administration.

Schedule / Shift

Standard

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Own end-to-end implementation of assigned SMM clients — discovery, current-state and spend assessment, program design, policy drafting, technology configuration, testing, training, and go-live — delivered against a documented implementation plan, timeline, and defined success criteria.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for assigned SMM clients regardless of program phase (assess, design, implement, adopt, optimize), maintaining a current phase-based roadmap and next-best-action plan for every account in the portfolio.
  • Build and maintain a standardized SMM implementation playbook and toolkit — project plans, intake and approval workflows, policy language, approval matrices, training curricula, and communication plans — to compress time-to-value and eliminate one-off, unrepeatable builds.
  • Configure, test, and maintain client SMM technology environments (Cvent or equivalent), including meeting request and approval workflows, budget and expense modules, registration templates, supplier and venue sourcing tools, integrations, and user permissions.
  • Drive meeting capture and program adoption by designing stakeholder communication and change-management campaigns, monitoring request and registration volume against the expected meeting population, and acting on leakage and non-compliant booking behavior.
  • Extend program visibility to small and simple meetings — consistently the largest pool of untracked meetings spend — through tiered intake paths and self-service tooling scaled appropriately to meeting complexity and value.
  • Own SMM data integrity and reporting: define data standards and taxonomy, validate meeting and spend data at the source, and produce dashboards and management information that quantify savings, cost avoidance, compliance, supplier performance, and risk exposure.
  • Lead recurring program governance for SMM clients — operating reviews, adoption checkpoints, and policy refresh cycles — and prepare the analysis, insight, and recommendations that support Account Management-led reviews and executive reporting.
  • Identify and execute optimization opportunities across the portfolio, including policy tightening, preferred supplier utilization, sourcing and contract consolidation, payment and reconciliation improvement, workflow automation, and adoption of AI-enabled sourcing and RFP capabilities where approved and appropriate.
  • Ensure duty-of-care and data governance requirements are embedded in every SMM program by design — attendee data handling and privacy, attendee tracking and manifest accuracy, emergency communication protocols, and documented compliance with client policy and applicable regulation.
  • Maintain the SMM program documentation library (policies, SOPs, process maps, configuration records, training materials, and version history), ensuring changes are controlled, communicated, and adopted.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery with Sourcing, Planning, Registration, Technology, Finance, and Account Management; resolve process breakdowns at the source and escalate risk early with a clear recommended course of action.
  • Maintain a prioritized portfolio view of all SMM implementations and program initiatives, including capacity forecasting and workload allocation across the team, so that new commitments are made against known capacity rather than assumption.
  • Define, track, and report program-level KPIs and SLAs; proactively flag accounts trending off-plan and own the corrective action through to resolution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery with Sourcing, Planning, Registration, Technology, Finance, and Account Management; resolve process breakdowns at the source and escalate risk early with a clear recommended course of action.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • This position may have direct reports as programs scale and could be responsible for hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and development planning for the SMM program support team.
  • Allocates and rebalances work across the team on a regular cadence based on implementation phase, client priority, and available capacity; makes trade-offs and sequencing decisions explicit rather than implicit.
  • Builds bench capability and reduces key-person dependency by cross-training the team across clients, platforms, and program phases.
  • Models the way for employees and sets a positive example by demonstrating our core values.
  • Provides ongoing feedback and supports team member growth by working with employees and encouraging growth plans.
  • Drives employee engagement. Facilitates regular and ongoing conversations about employee engagement and takes action to improve team and organizational culture.

Required of all CTM Positions

  • Embrace CTM’s core values of Connect, Deliver and Evolve.
  • Professional, collaborative and supportive interaction with employees, clients, suppliers and vendors.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Appropriate and professional written and verbal communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests.
  • Creative and analytical thinking with strong problem-solving and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrates calm under pressure – is a proactive contributor and eager to learn.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to do basic math.
  • Ability to read and interpret information.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Regular and reliable attendance.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, travel, operations or a related field or relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in travel management company operations, including at least 5 years in a senior operational leadership role managing leaders and multi-functional teams.
  • Experience managing global projects and service delivery across multiple regions, ensuring consistent execution, operational efficiency and alignment with business objectives.
  • Demonstrated experience leading large-scale operational change, process improvement, technology adoption and multi-site or remote teams.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with budgets, forecasts, productivity management and profit improvement.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Advanced MS Office skills (Outlook, Excel, Word), accounting basics, and basic statistical knowledge required.
  • Ability to strategize with exposure to global operations
  • Excellent people skills to enable interaction with internal departments, Account Management, Sales, and customers.
  • Strategic and operational leadership with the ability to convert business objectives into actionable plans and measurable results.
  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing efficient business processes, service models and change initiatives across multiple locations.
  • Strong customer focus and deep understanding of the corporate travel industry.
  • Ability to analyze operational, financial and productivity data and make sound, data-driven decisions.
  • Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence at all levels.
  • Instills a sense of urgency related to exceeding customer expectations
  • Must be able to analyze data such as agent productivity reports in order to achieve results.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

All qualified applicants applying for job openings posted in the U.S. will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of, race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic or status protected by applicable law.

job.job_description:
• Outstanding opportunity for an experienced Program Manager to join a significant Transformation Program on a 12‑month fixed-term contract, covering a period of parental leave.
  • With the program already well underway, you will step into a pivotal role responsible for maintaining momentum, driving delivery outcomes, and ensuring the continued execution of an established Technology transformation roadmap.
  • Work across organisational design, change management, technology and property – ensuring that a cohesive plan delivers on the required outcomes
  • Based in the Adelaide CBD or Mascot, you will partner with key stakeholders across South Australia and Sydney, providing leadership, structure and clarity across a complex portfolio of work


Qantas has established a new Product Innovation Centre in Adelaide, a hub that will transform how we design, build and deliver digital experiences for millions of customers. At its core is a shift to a product-led operating model: moving away from traditional project-based IT delivery toward empowered, cross-functional product teams that own outcomes end-to-end.


As Program Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring the Innovation Centre delivers on the required outcomes across a broad range of workstreams. You will set the standard for project delivery by establishing and maintaining consistent delivery frameworks, governance practices, reporting standards and delivery controls.


You own the plan and the sequence, hold the stream leads to it, and resolve conflicting dependencies. You manage the risks, dependencies and budget; ensuring that there is one cohesive outcome. The stream leads deliver their own outcomes, you're responsible for those outcomes delivering towards the strategy.


This role offers a unique opportunity to influence outcomes across all workstreams and shape a plan to deliver on an ambitious strategy


You’ll Have

  • Minimum 10 years' experience in program and project delivery, including at least 3 years in program management, practice management, or project management leadership.
  • Degree qualification in Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • PRINCE2, MSP, Agile or equivalent delivery certifications are highly regarded.
  • Proven track record leading large-scale delivery teams and embedding program and project management disciplines across complex portfolios.
  • Extensive experience across multiple delivery methodologies including PRINCE2, MSP, Agile, Hybrid delivery models, and Lean Portfolio Management, with the ability to tailor approaches to suit organisational needs.
  • Demonstrated capability to scale delivery practices in large, matrixed organisations, including the implementation of standardised frameworks, templates, governance processes, and tooling.
  • Experience leading enterprise technology programs, with strong expertise in managing program structures, risks, dependencies, benefits realisation, and stakeholder outcomes.
  • Successful history of building high-performing delivery teams while uplifting capability, consistency, and delivery quality.
  • Strong portfolio oversight capabilities, including prioritisation, sequencing of initiatives, dependency management, and balancing delivery risk across multiple workstreams.
  • Experience with delivery assurance, resource planning, and enterprise portfolio management tools such as Clarity and Power BI would be advantageous.
  • Strategic thinker with exceptional planning, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and influencing skills.
  • Comfortable operating in environments characterised by ambiguity, evolving priorities, and delivery pressure.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the confidence to present delivery insights, recommendations, and program health updates to senior executives and leadership teams.


Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.


You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.


  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Applications close on the 20th of September


Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. By coming to work for us, you’ll be part of an organisation that encourages diversity, supports charities and environmental initiatives. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application. Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

About Tripadvisor

We're seeking a strategic and data-driven CRM Manager to join our team and spearhead the development and execution of comprehensive, full-funnel CRM marketing initiatives. This pivotal role is responsible for stimulating user engagement, boosting conversion rates, and fostering long-term retention through personalized and targeted messaging across multiple channels, including email, push notifications, in-app messages, and onsite experiences. You’ll collaborate closely with product, marketing, and analytics teams to orchestrate impactful campaigns that effectively connect our members with new features, content, and offers, ultimately driving business growth and enhancing customer lifetime value.

Job location: Remote US East Coast

What You’ll Do

  • Campaign Strategy & Execution:
  • Conceptualize, develop, and launch innovative CRM campaigns across email, push, in-app, and onsite channels to support lifecycle marketing, product launches, promotional offers, and other key business objectives. Ensure seamless integration and coordination across channels for optimal campaign performance.
  • Product Marketing Alignment:
  • Forge strong partnerships with product and marketing teams to effectively communicate new product features, updates, benefits, and value propositions to members through various CRM channels. Craft compelling messaging that resonates with target audiences and drives product adoption.
  • Segmentation & Personalization:
  • Leverage customer data, behavioral insights, and predictive analytics to segment audiences and deliver personalized messaging and experiences tailored to individual user preferences, needs, and stage in the customer journey.
  • Onsite CRM & Retargeting:
  • Drive a cohesive full-funnel strategy by seamlessly connecting offsite messaging with onsite experiences. Collaborate closely with web/product teams to ensure consistency, optimize user flows, and maximize conversion rates.
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting:
  • Meticulously analyze campaign performance and user behavior data to identify trends, optimize content and targeting strategies, and share actionable insights with cross-functional teams. Prepare and present regular performance reports to stakeholders.
  • Customer Journey Mapping:
  • Develop and refine customer journey maps to visualize and understand key touchpoints and interactions throughout the customer lifecycle. Identify opportunities for optimization and personalization at each stage.
  • AI-Driven Personalization & Optimization:
  • Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance audience segmentation, content personalization, send-time optimization, and campaign performance. Partner with analytics and product teams to test and implement AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and customer experience across the lifecycle.

Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of demonstrated experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing, preferably with a digital product or subscription-based business.
  • Deep understanding of email marketing, push notifications, in-app messaging, and retargeting best practices.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset; ability to derive actionable insights from data and use them to inform strategic decisions and measure results.
  • Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance audience segmentation, content personalization, send-time optimization, and campaign performance. Partner with analytics and product teams to test and implement AI-driven solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and customer experience across the lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with strong project management and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Creative problem-solver with a passion for innovation and customer-centricity.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

The salary range for this role is $120,000 - $140,000 (USD) This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. An employee’s pay position within the wage range will be based on several factors including, but limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. This compensation range may also be modified in the future.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor, you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Senior Business Analyst, Customer AI Automation, is responsible for advancing United's Retail AI automation capabilities through effective design and implementation of our vision. This role focuses on transforming customer service across voice, chat, and future channels by building scalable AI solutions that deliver fast, effortless resolutions and eliminate wait times.

Our Vision

We are giving our people the backup they have always deserved, so that when a customer needs a human, they get our best one, not our most exhausted one. That is the United we are building: one where technology handles the volume and our people own the "moments that matter." This is where we stop competing on routes and prices and start competing on trust.

This role partners across Digital Technology, Commercial, Customer Experience, Customer Service & Advocacy, and AI Engineering teams to ensure AI automation strategies are practical, scalable, and aligned with business objectives and customer needs.

AI Strategy & Requirements Definition

  • Partner with business stakeholders to define and prioritize customer retail intents and journeys suitable for AI automation.
  • Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications for AI agents, conversational flows, and voice automation solutions.
  • Define success criteria, KPIs, and measurement frameworks for AI automation initiatives, including resolution rates, customer satisfaction, containment rates, and wait-time reduction.

Customer Journey & Process Analysis

  • Analyze customer interactions across voice, chat, and digital channels to identify automation opportunities and pain points.
  • Map current-state and future-state customer journeys, highlighting where AI can deliver the greatest impact.
  • Assess contact center operations and identify high-volume, routine interactions that can be effectively automated while preserving quality.

AI Solution Design & Implementation Support

  • Design conversational AI flows, voice automation workflows, and agentic solutions that align with customer needs and business goals.
  • Collaborate with AI engineers and developers to ensure technical solutions meet business requirements and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Define escalation logic and handoff protocols to ensure seamless transitions between AI and human agents.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment

  • Serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Partner with Customer Service leadership to understand operational constraints, agent workflows, and service-level requirements.
  • Work with Customer Experience teams to ensure AI solutions maintain United's brand voice and service standards.

Data Analysis & Performance Optimization

  • Analyze AI performance data, customer feedback, and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to optimize conversational flows, prompts, and automation logic.
  • Track and report on AI automation KPIs, including containment rates, resolution accuracy, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency gains.

Change Management & Adoption

  • Develop training materials, user guides, and documentation to support AI solution adoption.
  • Support change management activities to ensure smooth rollout of AI automation capabilities.
  • Gather feedback from agents, customers, and stakeholders to continuously refine and improve AI solutions.

Governance & Best Practices

  • Ensure AI solutions adhere to responsible AI principles, security protocols, and regulatory requirements.
  • Document business processes, requirements, and solution designs to maintain institutional knowledge.
  • Stay informed on AI industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to customer service automation.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree required; Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related major preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in business analysis, product management, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of customer service operations, contact center workflows, and customer journey mapping.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements and translating them into technical specifications.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and derive actionable insights to drive business decisions.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, conversational AI, or automation technologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional partners across Technology, Operations, and Customer Experience to align solutions with business needs.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate requirements, insights, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with data analysis tools and techniques, including Excel, SQL, and data visualization tools.
  • Proficiency with Agile/Scrum methodologies and product development lifecycle tools, including Jira and ADO.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship.
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification.
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position.

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or Agile/Scrum certifications.
  • Hands-on experience with conversational AI platforms, chatbot design, or voice automation solutions.
  • Experience with AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with contact center platforms, IVR systems, and customer service technology.
  • Experience implementing or supporting AI/Generative AI solutions in customer-facing environments.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing methodologies, experimentation frameworks, and AI model evaluation.
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles, AI governance, and bias mitigation strategies.
  • Experience in the travel, retail, or e-commerce industry.
  • Proficiency with business intelligence tools, including Tableau and Power BI, and advanced analytics.
  • Understanding of how AI automation and human agent capabilities align to deliver optimal customer experiences.

The base pay range for this role is $102,220.00 to $133,194.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Vous êtes un leader de terrain, passionné par l’hospitalité et l’expérience client ?

Rejoignez un hôtel 4 étoiles à l’esprit boutique, au cœur des montagnes, où élégance, identité locale et exigence de service se conjuguent dans une atmosphère chaleureuse et confidentielle.

Ouvert à l’année, doté de 75 chambres et suites, d’un restaurant, d’un Spa et d’espaces dédiés aux séminaires et réunions, Le Saint Gervais Hotel & Spa Handwritten Collection**** accueille une clientèle loisir et professionnelle, dans un environnement marqué par le rythme des saisons.

Son identité repose sur l’équilibre subtil entre les standards d’un groupe international, l’authenticité d’une adresse locale et le caractère intimiste d’un boutique-hôtel.

Description du poste

Votre rôle

Garantir une expérience client distinctive, accompagner les équipes sur le terrain et piloter avec exigence la performance opérationnelle et économique de l’établissement.

Missions du poste

Faire vivre une expérience client d’exception tout en pilotant la performance de l’hôtel et de ses équipes.

Le/la Directeur(trice) d’hôtel est garant(e) de la performance globale de l’établissement, de la qualité de l’expérience client et de son rayonnement local.

Coordonner l’ensemble des activités de l’hôtel : hébergement, restauration, bar, séminaires, Spa et fonctions supports en s’appuyant sur les standards de la marque Accor, tout en développant une véritable personnalité locale.

La réouverture du Spa en janvier 2027 fait partie des challenges à venir, suite à des travaux d’embellissement.

Le/la Directeur(trice) est particulièrement attentif(ve) à la qualité de service, à la satisfaction client, à l’engagement des équipes et à la maîtrise des coûts.

Responsabilités

  • Direction et pilotage de l’établissement
  • Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de l’hôtel en lien avec la Direction du Groupe et les objectifs de la marque Accor.
  • Assurer la responsabilité globale des résultats opérationnels et financiers de l’établissement.
  • Piloter l’activité en fonction des spécificités du marché de montagne et de sa saisonnalité.
  • Anticiper les périodes d’activité et adapter l’organisation, les ressources et les coûts.
  • Garantir la cohérence et l’excellence des prestations proposées dans chaque point de vente.
  • Être présent(e) sur le terrain et maintenir une relation étroite avec les clients et les équipes.
  • Superviser et accompagner la performance de l’ensemble des activités de l’établissement.
  • Suivre la qualité, du service et de l’expérience client.
  • Piloter le chiffre d’affaires et les ratios, optimiser les cartes, les achats et coûts matières.
  • Développer l’activité locale et la clientèle extérieure pour le F&B.
  • Garantir la qualité de l’accueil et de l’organisation des événements.
  • Assurer l’excellence de l’expérience bien-être, de l’occupation et de la rentabilité du Spa.
  • Développer des offres combinant hébergement, restauration, activités montagne et bien-être.
  • Expérience client & qualité de service

Premier(ère) ambassadeur(drice) de l’expérience client, vous garantissez un niveau de service 4 étoiles plus.

Vous développez une culture de l’hospitalité, de l’attention personnalisée et du sens du détail. Vous suivez les indicateurs de satisfaction clients et mettez en place les actions correctives nécessaires.

Vous êtes particulièrement attentif(ve) aux commentaires clients, à la réputation en ligne et à l’image de l’établissement.

Vous créez une expérience cohérente entre l’hôtel, le restaurant, le Spa et les espaces séminaires.

La qualité de service constitue un véritable challenge quotidien et est au cœur de vos priorités.

  • Management des équipes
  • Fédérer, accompagner et responsabiliser les équipes autour d'une culture commune de service et d’excellence.
  • Développer une relation managériale fondée sur la proximité, l’exigence et la bienveillance.
  • Recruter, intégrer et fidéliser les talents, notamment dans un contexte de forte saisonnalité.
  • Développer les compétences et favoriser la polyvalence des équipes.
  • Donner du sens aux objectifs et responsabiliser les managers sur leurs résultats.
  • Prendre des décisions rapidement et montrer l’exemple sur le terrain.
  • Gestion financière & maîtrise des coûts

Le/La Directeur(trice) est excellent gestionnaire, capable de concilier niveau de service élevé et maîtrise des coûts avec une activité à forte saisonnalité.

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets de fonctionnement de l’établissement.
  • Piloter le chiffre d’affaires, les marges et les principaux indicateurs de performance.
  • Maîtriser les coûts de personnel, les achats, les consommations et les charges opérationnelles.
  • Mettre en place une culture de la gestion et de la rentabilité auprès des équipes.
  • Optimiser les ressources en fonction de l’activité et de la saisonnalité.
  • Contrôler les achats et négocier avec les fournisseurs en privilégiant le meilleur rapport qualité/prix.
  • Identifier les leviers d’amélioration de la rentabilité sans dégrader l’expérience client.
  • Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction du Groupe.
  • Développement commercial & ancrage local
  • Développer le chiffre d’affaires de l’hôtel, du restaurant, du Spa et des espaces de réunions/séminaires.
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales Accor.
  • Développer les clientèles loisirs, corporate, groupes et séminaires, événements festifs sur mesure loisir.
  • Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales sur le marché régional et national.
  • Développer les partenariats avec les acteurs économiques et touristiques locaux (fournisseurs locaux, acteurs du tourisme et de la montagne).
  • Créer des évènements et animations menant à faire de l’hôtel un lieu de vie reconnu localement.
  • Entretenir des relations privilégiées avec les entreprises, institutions, offices de tourisme, prestataires, acteurs de la destination.
  • Faire de l’hôtel un établissement pleinement intégré à son territoire.

Qualifications

Profil recherché

Expérience significative en direction ou direction adjointe d’un hôtel 4 ou 5 étoiles, avec restauration et idéalement Spa et/ou activité séminaires.

La connaissance de l’environnement saisonnier, idéalement en montagne est un atout.

Maîtrise des standards de l’hôtellerie internationale et idéalement de l’environnement Accor.

Compétences

  • Excellent sens du service et de l’hospitalité
  • Solides compétences en gestion financière et pilotage des coûts
  • Forte culture du résultat
  • Leadership naturel et capacité à fédérer
  • Excellente capacité d’organisation et d’anticipation
  • Sens commercial développé
  • Capacité à analyser les indicateurs de performance et à transformer les données en actions concrètes
  • Très bonne maîtrise des problématiques de saisonnalité
  • Anglais professionnel indispensable

Personnalité

Charismatique, élégant(e), accessible, vous incarnez l’établissement auprès des clients comme des collaborateurs.

Le/la candidat(e) devra être un véritable leader de terrain, un(e) excellent gestionnaire, un(e) ambassadeur(drice) de la destination, un(e) passionné(e) de l’hospitalité, exigeant(e) sur la qualité sans être rigide, à l’aise dans un environnement saisonnier et en mouvement, capable de prendre des décisions et d’assumer ses responsabilités.

Une personnalité ayant une véritable sensibilité produit, un goût pour le beau, le détail et l’expérience client sera particulièrement appréciée.

Enjeux du poste

  • Faire progresser durablement la qualité de service.
  • Développer une culture de l’excellence et de l’attention client.
  • Préserver l’ADN élégant et confidentiel de l’établissement.
  • Offrir une expérience premium sans perdre la simplicité et l’authenticité propres à la montagne.
  • Améliorer la performance économique.
  • Trouver le juste équilibre entre qualité, chiffre d’affaires, rentabilité et maîtrise des coûts.
  • Positionner l’hôtel comme un acteur incontournable de sa destination.
  • Fédérer les équipes.
  • Créer une équipe engagée, stable et responsabilisée malgré les contraintes de la saisonnalité.
  • Développer les activités annexes.
  • Accroître la performance du restaurant, du Spa, des événements et des séminaires.

Indicateurs de performance

Le/La Directeur(trice) sera évalué(e) sur le chiffre d’affaires, le RBE, le RevPAR et taux d’occupation, le prix moyen, la rentabilité des différents départements, le ratio masse salariale, le ratio coût matières, la satisfaction et fidélisation des clients, l’E-réputation et les notes clients, la performance du restaurant et du Spa, le développement de l’activité groupes et séminaires, l’engagement et la fidélisation des collaborateurs, le développement des partenariats locaux.

Plus qu’un(e) directeur(trice) d’hôtel, nous recherchons un véritable ambassadeur de notre maison, avec une âme de leader, de gestionnaire et ambassadeur(drice) local(e), à même de faire vivre un hôtel 4 étoiles ++ de montagne avec élégance, exigence et authenticité, de créer une relation forte avec ses équipes et ses clients, tout en conservant une culture très rigoureuse de la performance.

Informations supplémentaires

Écrivez la prochaine page de votre parcours à nos côtés,

Adressez Votre Candidature à L’adresse Mail

nicolas.queval@accor.com

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
Overview

Enterprise Mobility's Marketing team is excited to announce the opening of a Brand Expression Manager!

The Brand Expression Manager develops and guides brand expression frameworks that guide how brands are represented across the end-to-end customer journey. This role translates brand strategy, customer insights, and business priorities into standards, tools, and guidance for messaging, content structure, tone, channel use, and customer touchpoints. Additionally, the Brand Expression Manager works across stakeholders to improve consistency, clarity, and effectiveness across regions and markets. This role also identifies brand experience gaps, supports scalable practices, and ensures each brand is expressed in a way that strengthens customer engagement, loyalty, and brand health and equity.

Enterprise offers an excellent benefits package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

Compensation decisions will be made based on factors that include, but are not limited to experience, education, location and skill level

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

Responsibilities

We are hiring now for immediate openings. Responsibilities include:

  • Lead the development of brand journey frameworks across key touchpoints, defining brand expression and ensuring consistent and effective application throughout the end-to-end customer experience
  • Translate brand strategy into practical frameworks, standards, and guidance that inform content, channel, digital, journey, and customer interaction decisions
  • Develop and maintain brand journey maps and brand expression principles that guide consistent brand expression across end-to-end experiences
  • Evaluate brand expression across touchpoints to identify gaps, friction points, and opportunities to improve clarity, cohesion, and overall brand experience quality
  • Guide cross-functional alignment with CX, Digital, Product, Marketing, Loyalty, Brand Editorial, and Creative teams to incorporate brand standards into journey design, content planning, and customer interactions
  • Establish scalable messaging systems and brand expression tools that drive consistency, flexibility, and speed to market across teams
  • Leverage customer, market, and business insights to inform brand and content recommendations that strengthen brand perception, engagement, loyalty, and advocacy
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on brand journeys and customer-informed brand expression, aligning stakeholders and championing brand-led decisions across marketing teams
  • Manage and develop a team of marketing professionals

In addition to these job functions, candidates will also need to display proficiency in the following Competencies:

  • Building Relationships
  • Communication
  • Ethics and Values
  • Forward-Thinking
  • Managing and Developing People
  • Resilience
  • Planning and Organizing

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

Minimum:

  • Must have a Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, or another applicable field
  • 6+ years experience of brand, content, or omnichannel marketing, with a focus on how brands are expressed across customer touchpoints
  • 6+ years experience developing messaging frameworks, brand systems, or experience guidelines that scale across multiple teams and touchpoints
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future

Preferred

  • Experience influencing and guiding work across a matrixed organization without direct ownership
  • Experience working in a global or multi-market environment, with demonstrated ability to balance global brand consistency and local market relevance
  • Experience partnering with Customer Experience, UX, or Product teams to shape end-to-end journeys and interactions

job.job_description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Accommodation Connectivity Specialist to join our Accommodation 3PP + Connectivity team in Barcelona (Hybrid) to own the relationship with an assigned portfolio of connectivity partners, and grow these relationships and ensure best in class performance, working hand in hand with the rest of the commercial teams and Product teams.

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
  • Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Connectivity Specialist in the Accommodation 3PP + Connectivity you will be in charge of:

  • Own the relationship with our existing assigned connectivity partners to foster long lasting partnerships that support eDreams’s inventory strategy and overall objectives. This is to be achieved through regular communication with the partners.
  • Monitor daily the technical performance of the assigned connectivities, proposing and implementing the action plans based on the analysis of the performance indicator. Work with Product teams to ensure that the necessary reporting and monitoring tools and visualisation are in place.
  • Provide daily technical support to external and internal teams (e.g. Account Managers, Sales teams) to solve technical issues. Proactively seek ways to improve key performance metrics such as reducing errors, Look-to-Book ratios and/or latencies, and process inefficiencies. Provide ongoing input to the Connectivity Manager for developing effective and scalable solutions to improve process efficiencies.
  • Identify growth opportunities with our accommodation providers, leveraging insights from connectivity data and working closely with the commercial teams. Participate in the analysis of potential new connectivity partners, through market analysis and benchmark. Support when needed in the contracting of the new partners identified.
  • Lead the integration and certification processes of the connectivity partners assigned. Supports the onboarding of chains when mass product uploads are required.
  • Optimize hotel content mapping workflow to drive conversion.
  • Own and duly complete the documentation of connectivity processes.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in business or tech related fields
  • At least 2 years of work experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the hotel industry is a must, including experience with hotel distribution systems and knowledge of OTA standard API structure and monitoring tools, specially applied to channel managers and switches, as well as familiarity with XML language.
  • Strong stakeholder management across both technical and commercial departments. Ensuring communication is always structured and service-oriented with clear messages being delivered. Project management skills including the ability to multi-task, prioritise effectively, and to meet deadlines
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English is a MUST. Any other European languages are very welcome
  • Good motivational skills and appetite for learning
  • Analytical skills: Effective and strong critical thinking skills in handling project details by employing keen screening abilities.
  • Autonomy: Able to work well independently and within a team; excellent communication skills with a “can do” attitude toward problem solving.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

job.job_description:
Organization- ALG Vacations and Trisept United States Offices

Summary

ALG Vacations (ALGV), part of Hyatt, is widely recognized for providing the industry's leading leisure travel experience to destinations worldwide. As North America's leading vertically integrated travel, hospitality, and leisure management groups, we can oversee all aspects of the vacation- from the moment a guest books a trip to the time they return home. Serving more than three million passengers annually, each of our highly respected brands offers unique benefits and a wide portfolio of destinations.

Grow your career as Group Service Specialist within ALG Vacations. The primary focus of this role is s2pporting Travel Advisors through phone calls, chats, and case management as Advisors are booking or modifying group reservations for clients. Responsibilities include responding to questions and requests, managing inventory additions and releases, processing modifications, and supporting finalization activities.

About ALG Vacations

It all begins when our client’s book with ALG Vacations. As North America’s leading tour operator, we keep our standards as high as our passion for travel, working together with our agents to ensure every client’s vacation exceeds every expectation. We are an industry innovator that combines the expertise of many different brands.

ALG Vacations consistently delivers exceptional value to travelers and strong performance to resort owners and partners by strategically leveraging the power of its portfolio of brands across multiple segments, comprising:

  • Vacations: The largest seller of vacation packages and charter flights in the U.S. for travel to Mexico and the Caribbean, moving approximately 3.2 million passengers annually through well-established vacation brands
  • Destination Management Services: Best-in-class destination management services provided by Amstar® DMC and Worldstar®
  • Loyalty Program: Exclusive loyalty program Unlimited Vacation Club®
  • Technology Solutions: Innovative technology solutions provider Trisept Solutions®, connecting over 88,000 travel agents with leading travel suppliers.

Since 2021, ALG Vacations has proudly been part of Hyatt. At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging – of making people feel at home no matter where they are in the world. Since 1957, our colleagues have been at the heart of driving Hyatt to become one of the world’s leading and fastest-growing hospitality brands, without ever losing focus on people and care. 

To learn more about ALG Vacations: https://alg.www.vaxvacationaccess.com/about-us/

Our Values

At ALG Vacations, we care for people so they can be at their best. We bring our values to life every day to ensure our colleagues have what they need to thrive, be their best selves, and create memorable guest experiences.

Experimentation

  • Empathy
  • Inclusion
  • Integrity
  • Respect
  • Well- Being

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

Travel Perks and Benefits for both ALG Vacations and Hyatt

Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

Basic Life Insurance

Short- & Long-Term Disability

Paid Parental Leave

Corporate Wellness Program

Travel Discounts & Deals

Paid Time Off & Holidays

401(k) Plan with Company Match

We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free and tobacco-free workplace and perform pre-employment background checks.

The Role

The Group Service Specialist is responsible for completing assigned work accurately, efficiently, and with a strong focus on customer service. This role requires a detail-oriented individual with strong technical proficiency, a passion for assisting customers, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. A solid understanding of group travel operations and processes is essential.

Responsibilities include responding to questions and requests, managing inventory additions and releases, processing modifications, and supporting finalization activities. The Group Service Specialist serves as a key point of contact and collaborates closely with Travel Advisors, suppliers, and internal teams across the organization to ensure seamless service delivery.

Success in this role requires excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills. Team members are expected to take ownership of assigned cases and tasks, proactively drive resolutions, and ensure work is completed accurately and within established service standards. Working within a POD structure, the Group Service Specialist partners with team members to support shared goals, maintain productivity, and deliver exceptional service experiences.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 2+ years of customer service experience
  • High School Diploma/equivalent required

Experience Preferred:

  • Previous travel industry experience preferred

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We Welcome You:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

The pay range for this position is an hourly rate of $19 to $22. This position is also eligible to earn overtime and shift differentials under certain circumstances.

The final pay rate/salary offered to the successful candidate will depend on experience, skill level and other qualifications for the role, as well as the location of the performance of work. Pay for the successful candidate will meet local requirements, including the local minimum wage rate.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.
