About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:  

Agoda is a travel booking platforms with accommodations at its core. As such our Key Account team is a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. The Key Accounts team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda a market leader; we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to New York and beyond, the Agoda team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The Key Accounts team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.  

The Opportunity:  

As an Account Manager (Global Key Accounts) (Japanese Speaking), your key objective is growing the coverage and quality of Agoda’s supply network. Along with your team, you take care of a portfolio of high-growth supply partners and assist in partnership-related functions at scale.  

In this role, you’ll get to:  

  • Manage hotel level relationships within Japan
  • Engage with our hotel partners to highlight revenue growth opportunities and innovative solutions 
  • Communicate efficiently with partners through various communication methods including phone, email, messaging and webinars  
  • Use data and dashboards to prioritize tasks  
  • Execute on our focused project sprints  
  • Train and inform partners on our technologies, tools and models  
  • Prioritize daily tasks, monitor results and track progress in internal systems  
  • Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner  

What you’ll need to succeed:  

  • Native level Japanese Language skills
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience working in business development or execution role preferred  
  • Demonstrates basic computer skills (Powerpoint / Excel)  
  • Analytical skills desired  
  • Analytical and proven track record in using data to drive achievements and make decisions 
  • Intellectual curiosity  
  • Autonomous and result driven (history of achieving ambitious targets)  
  • Ability to work under pressure in a competitive industry/rapidly changing environment  
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills  
  • Ability to work in a highly dynamic and fast-paced environment 

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

  • Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Saleforce Marketing Cloud Specialist

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Are you a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer who wants to own CRM production end-to-end while helping shape how AI shows up in it? This role keeps the core of the job the same – building, deploying, and troubleshooting SFMC campaigns at scale – while introducing Agentforce and AI-assisted development into the toolkit. You’ll continue to be the technical backbone of CRM Production, with growing exposure to AI agents, prompt-driven workflows, and the next generation of Marketing Cloud tooling.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end CRM campaigns within Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, and Content Development
  • Build and maintain scalable solutions using AMPscript, SQL, and APIs, ensuring high performance and reliability
  • Own full lifecycle delivery: requirements review, build, QA, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
  • Implement complex journey logic, including entry criteria, suppressions, deduplication, and personalization
  • Develop and optimize data processes and automations, ensuring data accuracy and alignment with business requirements
  • Perform rigorous QA and validation, including data checks, content proofing, and journey testing
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative fixes
  • Review peer code and provide actionable feedback to improve quality and reduce defects
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Marketing, Ops, Data, Solution) to deliver high-impact CRM campaigns
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to team best practices and documentation
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, tooling, and campaign performance
  • Own continued delivery of core CRM development – Journey Builder, Automation Studio, AMPscript/SSJS, SQL – ensuring agentic capabilities are layered on a stable, high-performing production foundation.
  • Partner with Marketing, Data, Legal/Privacy, and Solution teams to identify high-value agent use cases (welcome journeys, cart recovery, customer service handoffs) and translate them into shipped, measurable workflows.
  • Stay current with the fast-moving Agentforce/LLM landscape and proactively bring forward new capabilities, model updates, and patterns the team should adopt.
  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of the daily development workflow, with sound judgment about when to trust, verify, or override AI-generated code.
  • Practical skill in prompt engineering – writing, testing, and iterating on prompts/instructions for LLM-driven features, with an understanding of grounding, context windows, and hallucination mitigation.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud development
  • Strong expertise across:
    • Journey Builder & Automation Studio
    • AMPscript (required) and SSJS (preferred)
    • SQL for segmentation, validation, and troubleshooting
  • Deep understanding of SFMC data model:
    • Data Extensions, Send Logs, Data Views, Contact Builder
  • Experience with API integrations and triggered sends
  • Proven experience working in production environments with high-volume campaigns
  • Strong focus on QA, accuracy, and error prevention (pre- and post-send validation)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across data, automation, and journey layers
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in fast-paced, agile environments
Nice To Have

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud / CDP
  • Experience with QA tools such as Litmus

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $82,500.00 to $115,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $132,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Austin is $82,500.00 to $115,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $132,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data, machine learning, and AI provides secure, differentiated, and personalised experiences that build loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

The Content AI team develops machine learning capabilities that improve the quality, relevance, and usefulness of content-focused products and services across Expedia Group. Working within the Product & Technology Machine Learning Science and Engineering organisation, you will translate research and experimentation into reliable, scalable production outcomes. The team works across content understanding, review intelligence, search relevance, ranking, recommendations, content moderation, image-based AI applications, and Generative AI experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide.

In This Role, You Will

  • Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models and algorithms for Content AI applications.
  • Design and implement end-to-end machine learning solutions, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimisation.
  • Apply statistical analysis, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making to assess model performance and guide technical direction.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, applied scientists, and domain experts to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable ML solutions.
  • Contribute to system design, low-level design, API development, and data modelling for production machine learning systems.
  • Build and operate production solutions using technologies such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Redis, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Design and deploy scalable batch and real-time ML pipelines supporting customer-facing applications.
  • Develop and operationalise LLM applications, RAG systems, and Generative AI capabilities for content understanding, summarisation, classification, and recommendation use cases.
  • Build evaluation frameworks and observability solutions to monitor model quality, reliability, latency, drift, and business impact.
  • Evaluate trade-offs between model quality, scalability, latency, and infrastructure cost when developing AI-powered products.
  • Partner with engineering teams to deploy and scale machine learning systems in production.
  • Produce clear technical documentation and share expertise through mentorship, design reviews, and technical leadership.

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 5+ years of industry experience developing machine learning solutions in production environments.
  • Proficient programming and software engineering skills in Python, including experience building production-grade services and APIs.
  • Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and/or PyTorch.
  • Experience owning machine learning solutions across the full lifecycle, including experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and operational improvement.
  • Experience building and operating production ML systems at scale.
  • Understanding of distributed systems, data structures, algorithms, system design, low-level design, API design, and data modelling.
  • Experience with batch and real-time data processing systems, databases such as Redis, and low-latency serving technologies such as KServe, FastAPI.
  • Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver measurable machine learning outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Data Science, or a related STEM field.
  • Experience applying Generative AI and LLMs to customer-facing products and designing, building, or scaling RAG systems.
  • Experience in search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation, content intelligence, moderation, NLP, computer vision, or related AI domains.
  • Experience with Airflow or comparable workflow orchestration platforms.
  • Experience with cloud-native environments and container technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience developing model evaluation frameworks and AI quality measurement systems.
  • Experience making architectural decisions across multi-service machine learning environments.
  • Experience balancing model quality, operational cost, scalability, and performance requirements for production AI systems.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
Company Description

Grand Mercure Khao Lak Bangsak provides a haven of elegance and comfort.

Discover welcoming hospitality as you take advantage of all this Thai-style contemporary beachfront hotel has going for it. From the secluded bays across Andaman sea views or down; right close access within minutes by boat ride away! Delight in our personalized service and knowledgeable staff as we ensure your stay at Grand Mercure Khao Lak Bangsak.

Indulge in luxury in one of the 195 stylish modern rooms or suites. Gaze out at the Khao Lak resort from your room’s private balcony or wander through the gardens to our facilities. Feel the tranquillity from the uniquely-designed canal meandering through Grand Mercure Khao Lak Bangsak, a nod to Thailand’s riverside villages.

Job Description

  • Financial Leadership & Strategic Planning: Business advisory, cost-control, and commercial decision-making.
  • Financial Reporting, Budgeting & Forecasting: P&L management, USALI compliance, and annual budget planning.
  • Internal Controls & Cash Management: Risk mitigation, asset safeguarding, auditing, and credit control.
  • Tax, Legal & Regulatory Compliance: Managing Thai taxes (VAT, Corporate Tax), government relations, and contracts.
  • Departmental Leadership & Talent Development: Managing and mentoring the local finance team.

Qualifications

  • Language Skills: Specific fluency requirements for Thai (written/spoken) and English (corporate/reporting).
  • Education & Professional Certification: Accounting/Finance degrees and certifications (e.g., CPA, CA).
  • Professional Experience: Hospitality tenure, leadership experience, and resort-specific operational knowledge.
  • Systems & Technical Skills: Required software proficiency (PMS, POS, Accounting, Excel).
  • Core Competencies: Soft skills, business ethics, and analytical capabilities.

Additional Information

  • Adaptability - Ability to effectively adjust to major changes in work tasks or the work environment.
  • Aligning Performance for Success - Skilled at focusing and guiding others in accomplishing work objectives.
  • Building a Successful Team - Skilled at building a cohesive team and facilitating goal accomplishment.
  • Building Trust - Ability to interact with others in an honest, fair and respectful way; giving others confidence in one's intentions and those of the organization.
  • Communication - Skilled at clearly conveying information and ideas through a variety of media; engaging the audience and helping them understand and retain the message.
  • Customer Focus - Ability to develop and sustain productive customer relationships; actively seeking information to understand and address customers' needs.
  • High Work Standards - Sets high standards of performance for self and others; assumes responsibility and accountability for successfully completing assignments or tasks.
  • Planning and Organizing - Skilled at establishing courses of action for self and others to ensure work is completed efficiently.
  • Problem Solving / Decision Making - Ability to identify and understand issues, problems, and opportunities; using effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing solutions.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Continuous Improvement Trainer develops Lean capability across TechOps by delivering training programs, facilitating workshops, coaching leaders and employees, and supporting deployment of the TechOps Lean operating system ("Flight Path"). This role is responsible for building proficiency in Lean principles, Daily Management, Structured Problem Solving, leader standard work, and continuous improvement methodologies.

The position partners with operational leaders, frontline employees, and Continuous Improvement teams to develop the knowledge, skills, and behaviors required to successfully deploy and sustain the TechOps Lean Transformation while accelerating development of future facilitators, frontline leaders, and Continuous Improvement practitioners.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Deliver Flight Path training programs, workshops, simulations, bootcamps, and learning events that build Lean capability across TechOps.
  • Facilitate Structured Problem Solving, action planning, and capability development activities that support operational excellence and continuous improvement objectives.
  • Coach leaders, facilitators, and employees on Lean methodologies, Daily Management, standard work, and Flight Path principles.
  • Support Kaizen events and transformation initiatives through facilitation, training, coaching, and capability-building expertise.
  • Develop and continuously improve training materials, curricula, simulations, exercises, and learning content.
  • Deliver instructor-led classroom training, virtual learning experiences, workshops, and simulation-based learning programs.
  • Assess learner proficiency and provide coaching, feedback, and development recommendations to improve capability and application of Lean concepts.
  • Collaborate with Continuous Improvement Managers, Coaches, and operational leaders to identify capability gaps and support workforce development plans.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements to learning methods, content, and delivery approaches.
  • Practice safety-conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures and promote a culture of safety throughout the organization.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Education, Organizational Development, Aviation Management, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in operations, continuous improvement, operational excellence, organizational development, training, facilitation, or related business functions.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering instructor-led training, workshop facilitation, coaching, or capability development programs.
  • Experience supporting Lean, operational excellence, continuous improvement, or transformation initiatives preferred.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, communication, and coaching skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to teach and develop others through classroom instruction, workshops, simulations, and practical application.
  • Experience facilitating Structured Problem Solving, Kaizen events, workshops, or process improvement activities.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and influence employees at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts in a clear, practical, and engaging manner.
  • Working knowledge of Lean principles, Daily Management, standard work, leader standard work, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience developing training materials, presentations, learning content, and instructional resources.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and learning technologies.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.

Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Team mission

Come join our Comparison team as our Senior Product Designer! The Comparison team is a new strategic area of the business focused on our category verticals of our activities, like adventure tours or shows and events. This team will explore deepening our understanding of specific categories, distinct UX formats they need, and how we can best merchandise key information to our travelers. Our UX Team is a multi-disciplinary team of Product Designers, Content Designers, and UX Researchers passionate about solving customer problems in an effective and delightful way. Your mission

  • Design and iterate on high-quality customer experiences across web and app, from discovery through to delivery.

Who We Are:

Fareportal is a travel technology company powering a next-generation travel concierge service. Utilizing its innovative technology and company owned and operated global contact centres, Fareportal has built strong industry partnerships providing customers access to over 500 airlines, a million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies around the globe. Fareportal provides its airline partners with access to a broad customer base that books high-yielding international travel and add-on ancillaries.


FAREPORTAL HIGHLIGHTS:


  • Fareportal is the number 1 privately held online travel company in flight volume.
  • Fareportal partners with over 600 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.
  • 2019 annual sales exceeded $5 billion.
  • Fareportal sees over 150 million unique visitors annually to our desktop and mobile sites.


Fareportal, with its global workforce of over 2,600 employees, is strategically positioned with 9 offices in 6 countries and headquartered in New York City.


Role Overview


We are looking for a data-driven Marketing Analyst to help scale and optimize marketing performance for our e-commerce business. The role focuses on analyzing marketing channels, customer behavior, and campaign performance to drive profitable growth.

You will play a key role in customer lifetime value (LTV) analysis, customer segmentation, and experimentation, helping the marketing and product teams make data-backed decisions to improve acquisition efficiency, retention, and overall marketing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

- Marketing Performance Analysis:

  1. Analyze performance across marketing channels including Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Affiliates, SEO, Email, and App campaigns .
  2. Track and monitor key metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV, conversion rate, CTR, and AOV.
  3. Build dashboards and reports to track daily, weekly, and monthly marketing performance .
  4. Identify trends and insights to improve campaign efficiency and marketing ROI .


- Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) Analysis:

  1. Develop and maintain LTV models to understand the long-term value of customers acquired through different channels.
  2. Analyze LTV vs CAC across channels, campaigns, and customer cohorts o Support marketing budget allocation based on profitability and payback periods.
  3. Monitor cohort performance and repeat purchase behavior.


- Customer Segmentation & Behavioral Analysis

  1. Create and maintain customer segmentation frameworks based on acquisition channel, behavior, demographics, and purchase patterns.
  2. Analyze high-value customer segments and identify opportunities for targeted acquisition.
  3. Support marketing and CRM teams with segmentation insights for retention and lifecycle campaigns.
  4. Conduct deep-dive analysis into new vs returning customers, high-value cohorts, and churn patterns.


-Experimentation & A/B Testing

  1. Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and marketing experiments across campaigns, creatives, landing pages, and targeting strategies.
  2. Measure experiment results and provide statistically sound insights and recommendations.
  3. Work with marketing and product teams to build a structured experimentation roadmap.
  4. Track and document learnings from experiments to improve future campaigns.


-Attribution & Measurement

  1. Support development and analysis of multi-touch attribution models o Analyze the contribution of brand vs non-brand marketing channels o Ensure accurate tracking across analytics platforms (e.g., GA4, AppsFlyer, Amplitude, Mixpanel).


-Reporting & Business Insights

  1. Build dashboards and automated reports using SQL, Excel, and BI tools o Present actionable insights to marketing, product, and leadership teams o Translate complex data into clear business recommendations.


Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience: 8-12 years of experience in marketing analytics, growth analytics, or digital analytics. Experience working with e-commerce, marketplaces, or consumer tech companies

Technical Skills: Strong SQL and Python skills for data extraction and analysis, Advanced

Excel / Google Sheets skills, Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Data

Studio), Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) or similar analytics platforms

Analytical Skills: Experience building LTV and cohort analysis models, Strong

understanding of customer segmentation techniques, Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and marketing experiments.


Disclaimer

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Fareportal reserves the right to change the job duties, responsibilities, expectations or requirements posted here at any time at the Company’s sole discretion, with or without notice.

job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.

Strategy Director

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

Priceline has strong fundamentals and a clear strategic ambition to be America’s definitive travel deals brand. In today’s travel environment, we have both the moment and the platform to lead. Getting there requires the analytical rigor, structural clarity, and narrative precision to translate our ambition into a plan the whole organization can execute against.

Reporting to the SVP of Strategy & Brand Marketing, this role serves as the analytical and strategic backbone of how Priceline sets direction, measures progress, and communicates its vision across the organization and Booking Holdings.

Priceline has a strong strategic foundation and a clear point of view on where we’re headed. As we define our 2027 ambitions and beyond, sharpen the pillars that organize our priorities, and build the frameworks that guide how the company operates, this role will be instrumental in developing and synthesizing analytical inputs, defining opportunities, authoring strategic direction, and structuring the narratives that communicate that vision across the business. If you are energized by turning complex information into clear strategic choices and crafting the data-informed storylines that make them land, this is the role for you.

In This Role, You Will Get To

Shape the Corporate Strategy

  • Lead the analytical and synthesis work at the core of Priceline’s corporate strategy development, including researching the competitive landscape, sizing opportunities, building strategic frameworks, and helping define the 1-year and 3-year ambitions and pillar priorities that guide the business forward

Build the Analytical Picture

  • Conduct competitive benchmarking, market analysis, and customer and consumer research to develop a fact-based view of where the market is heading and where Priceline is best positioned to win

Synthesize and Structure

  • Translate complex inputs from business metrics, market data, leadership perspectives, and functional plans into concise, executive-ready narratives, frameworks, and recommendations that support strategic decision-making

Own the KPI Framework

  • Define and maintain the corporate KPI structure that measures progress against strategic priorities, ensuring the right metrics are tracked, owned, and reported with rigor

Connect Corporate Strategy to Functional Plans

  • Partner with leaders across Commercial, Product, Technology, Marketing, and other functions to translate corporate priorities into functional strategies, identify gaps, and drive cross-functional alignment

Drive Strategy Communication Deliverables

  • Build executive-ready presentations, briefs, updates, and written materials for Leadership Team meetings, Extended Leadership Team sessions, CEO updates, quarterly business reviews, and company-wide forums

Contribute to Cross-Brand and Booking Holdings Efforts

  • Support cross-brand strategy initiatives by developing analyses, recommendations, and deliverables that connect Priceline’s priorities to broader Booking Holdings conversations and opportunities

Operationalize the Plan

  • Help translate strategic priorities into action by mapping initiatives to owners, timelines, milestones, and success measures while building mechanisms to track and communicate progress

Who You Are

  • 6-10 years of experience in strategy, with a background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of both strongly preferred
  • Strong analytical and research skills with experience conducting competitive benchmarking, customer and consumer research, market analysis, and business performance analysis
  • Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to structure complex ideas and develop compelling executive-ready presentations, briefs, and strategic narratives
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize information from multiple stakeholders and sources into clear recommendations, frameworks, and strategic choices
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of strategy and storytelling, balancing analytical rigor with impactful communication
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams while maintaining quality and pace
  • Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with experience building trust across functions and influencing stakeholders without direct authority
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and creating structure in evolving business environments
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $170,000-$210,000.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

The team owns shared data infrastructure and raw data quality foundations, including ingestion, storage, orchestration, runtime, and platform governance. You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Operations, Security, and Product partners to build a scalable, trusted, and cost-effective platform for analytics, reporting, experimentation, and machine learning.

  • Improve platform reliability by building the tooling and platform capabilities needed for monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational readiness.
  • Drive platform modernization and simplify legacy systems where it creates clear value.

job.job_description:
Job Description

The successful candidate will join the Flight Services & Fuel Efficiency department in SIA Operations Control Centre (TMM).

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the progress of SIA flights and disseminate relevant flight information to parties concerned.
  • Consistently evaluate route and operational safety information, such as curtailment of airport facilities, including runways and fueling facilities, industrial unrest, meteorological warnings, and crew flight time limitations, while assessing their impact on flights.
  • Keep the operations crew informed via ACARS when necessary.
  • Work to minimise flight delays and passenger inconvenience.
  • Arrange additional flights, charters and/or relief flights as required.
  • Coordinate and handle delays or special diversions to enroute stations or airports when commercial, economic, or technical circumstances require it.
  • Act under stipulated procedures for accidents/incidents involving SIA aircraft and property, as well as for emergencies such as hijackings, bomb threats and/or medical emergencies involving SIA or Star-Alliance partner flights in Singapore.
  • Analyse the cause of flight delays and their subsequent handling with the objective of improving the handling techniques to avoid or minimise their recurrence.
  • Monitor flight progress (Flight Following) & revise/update flight plans, noting changes in critical fuel scenarios for (EDTO) (Extended Diversion Time Operation)
  • Communicate with Technical Crew and Flight Dispatchers on changes to flight plan when necessary; in-flight re-routing due to revised operating conditions, airspace and/or weather-related matters, further route optimisation, etc.
  • Provide flight planning support during IRROPS.
  • Monitor significant weather (e.g., Typhoon, Volcanic Ash, severe weather around terminal airspaces) and provide the necessary rerouting and information for operational resilience.
  • Monitor ad-hoc significant disruption to air routes/airspaces.
  • Coordinate arrival & departure sequencing, European Delay Management, Tactical Cost Index Adjustment and others.
  • Maintain Flight Dispatch currency.
  • Support fuel initiative operations
  • Ensure SIN ATFM Management Measures are communicated to the crew.
  • Any other duties as assigned by the department.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably with a background in Flight Operations or pilots ATPL
  • As this is an operational role, you will need to be able to work on shift duties

Successful candidates will undergo a suitable training program that typically runs for 12 months. Training duration for candidates with relevant experience will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis. The trainee must successfully complete the training program and competency assessments before being appointed as Flight Controller.

Successful candidates are required to sign a bond for the duration of training and two years thereafter.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Shape the future employee experience and employee engagement strategy across the Qantas Group
  • Drive workforce insights, culture initiatives and organisational development outcomes
  • 12-month fixed term opportunity based at our Mascot Campus, Sydney

The aviation sector doesn’t stand still. Challenged to adapt and change, we’ve responded by reinventing our customer experience, broadening our business and achieving what was thought impossible. This allows us to stand strong as the Qantas Group.

As the Organisational Development Manager, you'll play a key role in shaping how we listen to, engage and support our people across the Qantas Group. Working within the Organisational Development team, you'll lead critical employee listening, engagement and culture initiatives, transforming workforce insights into meaningful actions that improve both employee experience and organisational performance.

This is a highly visible role that partners with senior leaders, HR Business Partners, Employee Experience, Internal Communications, People Analytics and specialist Centres of Excellence across the business. You'll be responsible for driving enterprise-wide employee listening programs, delivering strategic insights and recommendations, and ensuring meaningful action is taken to strengthen engagement, culture and leadership effectiveness across diverse workforce groups.

A key focus of the role is turning data into action. You'll lead annual engagement surveys and employee listening initiatives, analyse workforce trends and engagement data, develop executive-level insight packs and influence stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes. You'll act as a custodian of culture and engagement frameworks, helping the business understand employee needs and continuously focus on improving the employee experience.

What You’ll Bring To The Role

  • 10+ years' experience in Organisational Development, Employee Experience, Employee Engagement, Culture, Change or a related People function within a large, complex organisation.
  • Experience leading employee listening, workforce insights or engagement programs from strategy through to implementation and delivery of measurable outcomes.
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Proven stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, including experience partnering with senior leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organisational change, culture transformation or continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong project management capability with experience delivering complex programs end-to-end.
  • Qualifications in Organisational Psychology, Human Resources, Business, Change Management or a related discipline.

Why Qantas? 

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. 

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.  

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel. 

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including up to 18 weeks paid parental leave and additional purchased leave options.  
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.

  • Hands-on experience with major ERP or financial systems platforms such as Oracle, SAP, and Workday Financials.
  • Demonstrated experience leading system implementations, enhancements, integrations, upgrades, testing cycles, or finance process automation initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of financial data structures, chart of accounts, master data, system integrations, reporting hierarchies, and data quality controls.
  • Experience supporting financial controls, system access governance, audit requests, and SOX or equivalent internal control requirements.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into functional specifications, process designs, testing plans, and practical system solutions.

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Masters of Business Administration
  • Certified Public Accountant

  • Experience with Oracle R12 ERP modules, particularly GL, Project Accounting, Fixed Assets and System/Security Admin

  • Skills with enterprise reporting and business intelligence tools

job.job_description:
Mach mit uns Lust auf Reisen

l’tur steht seit über 30 Jahren für spontane Reisen, attraktive Angebote und echte Urlaubsmomente. Als Teil der TUI Group verbinden wir die Dynamik einer bekannten Last-Minute-Marke mit den Möglichkeiten und dem Netzwerk eines internationalen Touristikkonzerns.

Für unser Brand-Marketing-Team in Rastatt suchen wir eine Teamleitung (m/w/d) in Vollzeit, die unsere Markenstrategie in kreative und wirksame Kampagnen übersetzt. Du führst ein kleines Team aus Grafik, Social Media, Handelsmarketing und Kampagnenmanagement, setzt klare Prioritäten und sorgst gemeinsam mit internen Fachbereichen und externen Partnern für eine konsistente Umsetzung unserer Marke.

Die Position eignet sich besonders für erfahrene Brand- oder Campaign-Manager/innen, die bereits erste Führungserfahrung gesammelt haben und nun mehr Verantwortung für Marken, Team, Kampagnen und Umsetzung übernehmen möchten.

Deine Mission

Du führst und entwickelst unser Brand-Marketing-Team und sorgst für klare Prioritäten, hohe Qualität und eine verlässliche Kampagnenumsetzung. Du berichtest an die zuständige Bereichsleitung Marketing & Sales und arbeitest eng mit E-Commerce, Vertrieb sowie weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen.

Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team aus 10 Mitarbeitenden übersetzt Du unsere Markenstrategie in kreative Formate und integrierte Kampagnen. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Digital, Social, Video und Creator Content. Ausgewählte klassische Maßnahmen, zum Beispiel für die ltur-eigene Reisebüro-Kette, setzt Du gemeinsam mit internen Ansprechpartnern, Agenturen und Produktionspartnern um.

Du behältst Timings und vereinbarte Budgets im Blick, wertest Kampagnenergebnisse anhand definierter Kennzahlen aus und entwickelst unsere Formate kontinuierlich weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung unseres Brand-Marketing-Teams aus den Bereichen Grafik und Kampagnenmanagement.
  • Du entwickelst die Markenstrategie und Markenpositionierung im bestehenden strategischen Rahmen gemeinsam mit der Bereichs- und Geschäftsleitung weiter und sorgst für deren konsistente Übersetzung in Kampagnen, Botschaften und relevante Touchpoints.
  • Du planst und koordinierst integrierte Kampagnen mit Schwerpunkt auf digitalen Kanälen, Social Media, Video und Creator Content.
  • Du entwickelst Kampagnenideen, Briefings und skalierbare Content-Formate gemeinsam mit Deinem Team.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Marken- und Designrichtlinien über alle relevanten Touchpoints hinweg konsistent angewendet werden.
  • Du entwickelst unseren Kampagnenauftritt innerhalb des bestehenden Markenrahmens kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du steuerst Agenturen, Creator/innen, Produktionspartner und weitere externe Dienstleister.
  • Du koordinierst ausgewählte Maßnahmen in klassischen Kanälen wie Out-of-Home, Audio, Print oder Point of Sale.
  • Du steuerst definierte Kampagnenbudgets innerhalb der abgestimmten Jahresplanung und behältst Kosten, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick.
  • Du analysierst Kampagnenergebnisse anhand vereinbarter Marken- und Kampagnen-KPIs und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit E-Commerce, Vertrieb, Hotel- und Flugeinkauf sowie weiteren internen Schnittstellen zusammen.
  • Du begleitest ausgewählte Marken- und Kommunikationsprojekte, beispielsweise Kooperationen, Kampagnenpartnerschaften oder die Einführung neuer Content-Formate.

Zusammenarbeit in der TUI Group

Als Teil der TUI Group arbeitest Du bei ausgewählten Themen mit internationalen Marketing-Teams zusammen.

Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung gemeinsamer Marken-, Technologie- und Kommunikationsinitiativen für l’tur und der neuen TUI-Marke Sundeals. Gleichzeitig profitierst Du vom fachlichen Austausch, den verfügbaren Technologien und dem Netzwerk eines international führenden Touristikkonzerns.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, Betriebswirtschaft oder in einer verwandten Fachrichtung.
  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Brand-, Kampagnen- oder Content-Marketing, idealerweise in einem B2C-, Lifestyle-, Touristik- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.
  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder disziplinarischen Führung gesammelt und möchtest Dich in dieser Verantwortung weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Planung, Umsetzung und Budgetsteuerung digitaler und kanalübergreifender Kampagnen.
  • Du verstehst es, kreative Ideen mit klaren Zielen, verfügbaren Budgets und messbaren Ergebnissen zu verbinden.
  • Du kennst die Anforderungen relevanter Social-Media-Kanäle und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Short-Form-Video, Creator Content und modulare Content-Produktion.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen, Kreativteams, Produktionspartnern oder Creator/innen.
  • Du kannst Kampagnenergebnisse einordnen, verständlich aufbereiten und daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen Office-, Kampagnen- und Analysetools. Erfahrungen mit Anwendungen wie Meta Business Suite, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Swat.io oder vergleichbaren Tools sind von Vorteil.
  • Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis für kreative Produktionsprozesse. Eigene Erfahrungen mit Adobe-Anwendungen sind hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
  • Du hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit einem Team Ideen umzusetzen und sichtbare Ergebnisse zu schaffen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Teamlead-Rolle mit einem klar definierten Aufgabenbereich
  • Die Möglichkeit, Deine Führungserfahrung gezielt auszubauen
  • Ein motiviertes Team mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen
  • Gestaltungsspielraum bei Kampagnen, Content-Formaten und Arbeitsweisen
  • Eine bekannte Marke mit viel Potenzial für kreative Kommunikation
  • Eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit E-Commerce, Vertrieb und Produkt
  • Ein internationales Netzwerk und fachlicher Austausch innerhalb der TUI Group
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und attraktive Benefits
  • Vergünstigte Reisemöglichkeiten und weitere touristische Vorteile

Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Schritt?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns Kampagnen, die Lust auf Reisen machen.

job.job_description:
Senior Manager, Incentives Strategy and Operations | Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

We are looking for an analytically rigorous, commercially minded, and execution-oriented leader to help shape and scale Tripadvisor’s incentives and loyalty portfolio.

This role will own the strategic and operational governance for how we evaluate, prioritize, and scale incentives across the business. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to turn complex program economics into clear recommendations, scalable processes, and better business decisions.

You will play a critical role in helping the business answer some of its most important growth and profitability questions: Which incentives are truly incremental? Which audiences should we invest in? How do we balance conversion, customer value, margin, and cost discipline? And how do we build the operating model required to scale incentives responsibly across markets, channels, and customer segments?

This is a high-impact role for someone who can build structure from ambiguity, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and translate analysis into strategy, governance, and action. While execution teams will support campaign delivery, this role will be responsible for setting the strategic direction, operating cadence, measurement standards, and investment discipline that enable the incentives portfolio to scale effectively.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2-3 days per week in our London office.

What You’ll Do

Shape the strategy and governance model for incentives and loyalty:

  • Develop the strategic framework for how Tripadvisor evaluates, prioritizes, and scales incentive and loyalty initiatives across the business.
  • Define the principles and guardrails for when, where, and how incentives should be used, balancing growth, profitability, customer experience, and operational complexity.
  • Partner with CRM, Product, Regional, Marketing, Data, and Finance teams to ensure incentive initiatives are aligned to broader business priorities.
  • Help move the business from isolated campaigns and tests toward a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined incentives portfolio.
  • Establish clear operating rhythms for reviewing performance, making investment decisions, and prioritizing future opportunities.

Build The Financial And Analytical Backbone For Incentives Performance

  • Own the framework for evaluating incentive and loyalty program performance, including redemption, incremental bookings, revenue impact, margin impact, customer lifetime value, cost-to-serve, and ROI.
  • Partner closely with Finance to build and maintain reliable P&L reporting infrastructure for incentives and loyalty, including spend tracking, forecasting, cost visibility, and program-level economics.
  • Support the department lead and Finance partners with the inputs needed for budget planning, investment trade-off discussions, and performance reviews.
  • Establish reporting cadences, approval processes, and investment guardrails so incentive spend remains transparent, disciplined, and aligned to business objectives.
  • Ensure leadership has a clear, trusted, and consistent view of incentive performance across programs, markets, channels, and customer segments.

Turn Insights Into Roadmap And Investment Decisions

  • Lead recurring and ad hoc deep dives into program performance, customer segments, test results, cost drivers, and behavioral trends to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should invest next.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear strategic recommendations, business cases, and executive-ready narratives.
  • Partner with Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to shape the incentives roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritized based on expected impact, cost, feasibility, and strategic fit.
  • Identify opportunities to improve incentive effectiveness through better targeting, program design, customer segmentation, channel coordination, and measurement.
  • Help leadership understand trade-offs across short-term conversion, long-term customer value, margin impact, operational complexity, and strategic growth.

Build Scalable Operating Processes For Cross-functional Execution

  • Design and improve the operating processes required to propose, approve, launch, measure, and review incentive initiatives.
  • Create clear standards for how incentive programs are evaluated before launch and assessed after execution.
  • Partner with execution teams to ensure campaign delivery is supported by strong strategic rationale, clear measurement plans, and appropriate financial guardrails.
  • Help build a scalable test-and-learn discipline for incentives, enabling the business to move quickly while maintaining measurement rigor and financial accountability.
  • Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and areas of ambiguity that could limit the business’s ability to scale incentives effectively.

Champion Incentive Economics Across The Business

  • Serve as a key thought partner to Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams on how incentive investment translates into customer and business value.
  • Own the metrics, narrative, and recommendations that feed into recurring business reviews and leadership updates on incentives and loyalty.
  • Bring a structured, analytical perspective to strategic discussions, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition or isolated campaign results.
  • Act as a connective tissue across teams, ensuring incentives are managed as a disciplined business portfolio rather than a set of disconnected campaigns.

What Success Looks Like

A successful candidate will help the business build a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined approach to incentives and loyalty.

In This Role, Success Means

  • Leadership has a clear and trusted view of incentive performance, spend, ROI, and business impact.
  • Finance and business teams are aligned on how incentive economics are measured, reported, and forecasted.
  • Incentive investment decisions are grounded in clear evidence, consistent measurement, and well-defined business trade-offs.
  • Cross-functional teams have a repeatable operating model for proposing, launching, measuring, and scaling incentives.
  • The incentives roadmap reflects the highest-value opportunities across customer segments, channels, markets, and product surfaces.
  • Execution teams are supported by clear strategic direction, operating processes, and measurement standards.
  • The business can scale incentives with greater speed, confidence, and financial control.
  • Incentives become a more disciplined growth lever that supports both customer acquisition and long-term customer value.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • 7+ years of experience in growth strategy, business operations, commercial strategy, go-to-market strategy, incentives, loyalty, pricing, performance marketing, financial planning and analysis, or management consulting.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience building or interpreting P&L models, ROI frameworks, forecasts, business cases, or investment recommendations.
  • Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, interpret complex data, and translate insights into clear business decisions.
  • Experience partnering with Finance, Data/Analytics, Product, Marketing, CRM, Regional, or Operations teams to build shared infrastructure and drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to build crisp strategy documents, business reviews, and decision-ready presentations.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive progress across teams with different priorities, incentives, and levels of context.
  • Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • A structured problem-solving approach, with a bias toward action and a high bar for analytical rigor.

Nice To Have Skills

  • Experience in management consulting, business operations, growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, or commercial strategy roles.
  • Experience working on loyalty, promotions, incentives, pricing, marketplace growth, customer lifecycle, or monetization programs.
  • Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, customer segmentation, or lifetime value analysis.
  • Familiarity with BI tools, SQL, dashboards, or analytics workflows.
  • Experience building operating rhythms, governance processes, or scalable cross-functional planning mechanisms.
  • Experience working in travel, marketplaces, e-commerce, consumer technology, or membership-based businesses.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


In this Role, you’ll get to

• Extract, process, and analyze large datasets from our data warehouse using SQL and Python.

• Perform deep-dive analyses to uncover trends, identify opportunities, and diagnose business problems.

• Partner closely with local Singapore teams (Supply, Operations, Marketing) and global HQ teams to understand business needs and provide data-backed recommendations.

• Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise, and compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Conduct ad-hoc analysis to support strategic initiatives.

• BI Product Contribution: Collaborate with the central teams to improve analytical models and products, ensure data quality, and advocate for the analytical needs of the Singapore business.


What you'll Need to Succeed

• Bachelor's degree or above in a relevant field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Business, Analytics, or a related quantitative field.

• 2-5 years of proven experience as a BI Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role.

• Solid experience in commercial/business analysis, preferably within the consulting firm or E-commerce industries. A strong understanding of business drivers and metrics is essential.

• Advanced proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.

• Understanding of statistical concepts and strong capability in mathematics.

• Strong hands-on experience with Python and advanced analytics (e.g., regression, decision tree, clustering, time series & forecasting, etc.) will be a plus.

• Passionate about data science and the power of data to solve real-world business problems.

• Genuine interest in and curiosity about the travel and hotel industry.

• Excellent logical, structured, and analytical thinking skills.

• Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?



Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!



Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com



Have a good trip, and see you soon!
