job.job_description:
Department: Service Delivery

Location: Belfast

Description

Who are we?
Dnata is one of the world’s largest air and travel services providers. We provide a comprehensive range of inflight catering, onboard retail, supply chain and logistics services at all major and regional airports across the UK. Dnata Catering provide expertly crafted inflight catering services, delivering fresh and high-quality meals at major and regional airports across the UK. As the leading Halal caterer in the UK, we also provide tailored experiences to meet each customer’s unique needs. We’re a leader in VIP catering, offering bespoke inflight to private and charter clients.

The Role
Our Transport Manager will pro-actively manage the daily operation, with responsibility for the delivery of safety cost, quality, compliance and people KPIs – in line with company, legal and airline standards. To be actively involved and maintain an effective and productive team which focuses achievement on results and develops and sustains effective customer relationships.


Key Responsibilities


Transport Operations
  • Manage the day-to-day operation of the HGV fleet and transport department.
  • Plan and coordinate vehicle and driver schedules to meet customer requirements.
  • Ensure vehicles and drivers are allocated efficiently and effectively.
  • Monitor vehicle utilisation, mileage, fuel consumption and operating costs.
  • Deal promptly with operational issues, breakdowns, delays and customer requirements.
  • Work closely with customers, suppliers, drivers and senior management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce unnecessary costs.
Compliance & Operator Licence
  • Maintain full compliance with the company's Operator Licence undertakings.
  • Ensure drivers comply with UK drivers' hours, working time and tachograph legislation.
  • Maintain accurate records relating to drivers, vehicles, maintenance and compliance.
  • Ensure regular driver licence checks and relevant entitlement checks are completed.
  • Monitor and manage driver infringements, taking appropriate corrective action where required.
  • Ensure vehicle inspections, safety checks and defect reporting procedures are properly managed.
  • Liaise with external maintenance providers and ensure vehicles are maintained to the required standard.
  • Prepare for and assist with DVSA, Traffic Commissioner and other regulatory inspections.
  • Ensure company policies and procedures are implemented and consistently followed.
  • Driver Management
  • Recruit, onboard and manage HGV drivers where required.
  • Conduct regular driver meetings, briefings and performance reviews
  • Promote a strong safety culture throughout the transport operation.
  • Ensure drivers receive appropriate training, including relevant CPC and operational training.
  • Manage attendance, performance, conduct and disciplinary matters in conjunction with senior management/HR.
  • Provide drivers with clear instructions and support to ensure operational and legal requirements are met.
Fleet Management
  • Oversee the condition, availability and presentation of the HGV fleet
  • Ensure planned preventative maintenance and statutory inspections are completed on time.
  • Monitor MOTs, PMI inspections, repairs, defects and vehicle downtime.
  • Ensure daily defect reporting and vehicle safety-check procedures are followed.
  • Maintain accurate fleet records and ensure documentation is readily available for inspection.
  • Health & Safety
  • Ensure transport operations are carried out in accordance with company health and safety policies.
  • Carry out and review relevant risk assessments and safe systems of work.
  • Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses and implement corrective actions.
  • Promote safe driving and vehicle operating standards across the business.



Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Tacho and Working Time directive regulation knowledge
  • Level 4 qualification i.e. A Level or equivalent experience
  • GCSE English and Maths grade C/4 or above
  • CPC Knowledge
  • Demonstrable evidence of people management experience, e.g. dealing with performance issues, holidays, rosters and absence management
  • Experience in a fast-moving and changing shop floor environment such as manufacturing, logistics, or FMCG
  • Problem solving skills.
  • Experience within the transport sector or logistics.
  • Stakeholder management.
  • Computer literate - Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel
  • Evidenced people management experience e.g. dealing with performance issues, holidays, rosters and absence management
  • An understanding of cost and control management
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good organisation skills and flexibility


Benefits

What's in it for you?
  • An opportunity to be part of the Emirates global family.
  • Free breakfast, lunch and dinner on site
  • Free tea and coffee
  • Simply health Plan
  • Refer a Friend Scheme
  • Discounted gym membership at over 2000 gyms nationwide
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Opportunity to enhance your learning through our inhouse apprenticeship programme

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance of your own financial operation. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

This position is located at 320 Pronghorn Trail, Bozeman, MT 59718

We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation - This position offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $60,000 with an average 40 hour work week.
  • Paid Time Off, starting with 20 days off per year
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At Enterprise Mobility, you will have the chance to run your own financial operation and provide balance to the marketing and operational pieces of our business. Responsibilities

Starting as an Accountant, you are executing accounting procedures and principles that will lead to financial statement, preparation, and financial analysis.

  • Support budgeting and forecasting

  • May be responsible for preparation and sales and other tax returns

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

  • Must have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

Organization- Regional Office - Palma

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns & Projects to join the Digital & Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.

In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. You will work with regional and global teams, hotels, agencies, and external partners to drive customer and World of Hyatt member acquisition, conversion, engagement, loyalty, and retention.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and in creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and guests have been at the heart of our business and have helped Hyatt become one of the world’s leading and fastest-growing hospitality companies.

Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

The Role

Reporting to the Director, Digital & Direct Channels South EAME, the Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns & Projects will be responsible for coordinating the strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM initiatives, digital campaigns, and projects related to the web and digital ecosystem.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Coordinate campaigns, tactics, and touchpoints aimed at Hyatt guests and World of Hyatt members, using segmentation, personalization, and data analysis to improve engagement, conversion, and direct bookings.
  • Manage the relationship calendar and ensure the proper alignment of campaigns with commercial, regional, global, and hotel priorities.
  • Lead the execution and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, ensuring alignment with direct-channel performance objectives.
  • Coordinate promotions and activations across the digital ecosystem, managing timelines, content, assets, and messaging across different touchpoints.
  • Act as a liaison between Digital Marketing, Web, Contact Center, Revenue Management, Operations, eDistribution, and Marketing teams.
  • Coordinate digital projects from end to end, managing milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
  • Monitor performance, define and track CRM KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Analyze customer behavior and feedback to continuously improve CRM initiatives and the digital customer experience.
  • Ensure CRM processes comply with GDPR and best practices in data governance and data quality.
  • Coordinate relationships with CRM and digital agencies across South EAME and the wider EAME region, ensuring consistency in strategy, reporting, execution, and best-practice adoption.

Who You Are

You are passionate about improving the customer experience through data, technology, and creativity. You are organized, collaborative, and results-oriented, with the ability to coordinate complex projects and connect teams with different perspectives.

You also share Hyatt’s core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing.

We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals often apply for jobs only when they meet all the listed qualifications. If you do not meet every requirement but feel inspired by this opportunity and believe you can bring value, we encourage you to apply.

We would love to learn more about your experience and discover how you could help make Hyatt even better.

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in CRM, digital marketing, digital campaigns, or a closely related field.
  • Experience planning, executing, and analyzing digital and CRM campaigns.
  • Experience coordinating projects and working with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience working with external agencies, preferably in regional or international environments.
  • Knowledge of marketing, digital analytics, CRM, personalization, content, ecommerce, and cloud-based technology platforms.
  • Experience with platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, metasearch, display/programmatic, and affiliate marketing.
  • Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, combining creativity with a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic, international environment with multiple priorities.
  • High level of English, both written and spoken; additional languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Previous experience with Hyatt and Hyatt systems will be considered an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is preferred.

job.job_description:
当社について

IHGホテルズ＆リゾーツでは、社員一丸となって、「True Hospitality for Good」を世界規模でお届けしております。コーポレートオフィスと6,700を超えるホテルを展開するIHGでのキャリアは、あなたの可能性を広げる最適な職場です。IHGのユニークな文化と、あなたをサポートし、鼓舞する優秀な同僚がお待ちしております。IHGでは、あなたのキャリアがどのようなものであれ、また、どのようなことを達成したいのであれ、さまざまな機会をお選びいただけます。

近年、私たちは社内を変革してきました。お客様やオーナー様に愛され、選ばれるホテル企業になるため、業績を伸ばし、成長への絶え間ないフォーカスを維持するという大胆な野望を抱いています。

私たちはホスピタリティ・ビジネスを中核とし、つながりを大切にし、共にあることで生産性を支える独自の仲間意識を育んでいます。IHGでは、オフィスワークとリモートワークを融合させたハイブリッドな働き方をすることで、従業員に柔軟性とバランスを与えています。そのため、リーダーはチームと協力し、いつ、どのようにコラボレーションするかを決定します。

最高のワークライフを送れるよう、さまざまな福利厚生をご用意しています。これには、多数のホテルでの宿泊割引、リチャージ・デイ、年間を通じたボランティア・デーなどが含まれます。マイウェルビーイング・フレームワークを通じて、健康、ライフスタイル、職場におけるウェルビーイングのサポートに取り組んでいます。当ホテルはユニークで包括的な企業文化を提供しており、そこには常に、所属し、成長し、変化をもたらすための「あなたのための部屋」があります。

私たちの使命は、すべての人を歓迎し、違いを認め合い、従業員が自分らしさを発揮できるような、インクルーシブなチームを作ることです。IHGホテルズ＆リゾーツは、人種、肌の色、宗教、性別、性的指向、性自認、国籍、退役軍人の地位、障害の有無にかかわらず、応募者と従業員に均等な雇用機会を提供します。当社は、信頼、サポート、受容の文化を推進しています。異なる背景、経験、考え方を常に歓迎します。

日々の業務

日本&ミクロネシアは成長が著しい地域の為、複数のホテルを担当いただく、ポートフォーリオレベニューマネージャーを募集いたします。IHG レベニューチームの一員として、契約ホテルを担当し、積極的かつ効果的なレベニューマネジメント、RevPar及びRGIを指標として競合ホテルよりも優れたパフォーマンス、ポートフォーリオホテルの予算目標達成が責務となります。主に客室売上に注力していただきますが、今後は宴会や料飲部門にも関わっていく予定です。

応募資格

最低5年間のホテル業界での職務経験があり、その内最低3年間のクラスター/ポートフォーリオレベニューマネージメントに携わった経験が望ましい。

国際的に認められたホスピタリティーの学位の保持者、あるいはセールス＆マーケティングに関わった経験があり、CRS（Concerto, Trust, Marsha等, PMS(Opera)、レベニューマネージメントのシステム（Optims, Ideas, Rategain, Perform & Price Optimization）に精通している事。

自主的に働きながら、ステークホルダーと良好な関係を保ち、会社の目標を達成し成功に導く能力。

日本語の能力が必要です。

 

Your day to day

Due to growth and expansion in this region, we're looking for a Portfolio Revenue Manager to support a number of hotels in Japan.

You'll be an integral member of the Revenue Management for Hire team, responsible for pro-actively and cost effectively maximizing subscriber hotel room revenues, RevPAR and system delivery to achieve superior performance in comparison to the competitive set as measured in RGI and as against budget growth targets across a portfolio of hotels within the Japan and Micronesia region. Your scope of work focuses on Room Accommodations, but may include conferencing and events and food and beverage outlets as we continue to evolve our services.

You will be the key driver of revenue generation data analysis and recommend logical, tactical and strategic initiatives. You will also promote desired revenue management work culture around the five Winning Ways of Do the right thing, Show we care, Aim higher, Celebrate difference and Work better together.

What we need from you

To be successful in this role, you will have at least five years experience within the Hospitality Industry in addition to a minimum of 3 years experience in a Cluster/Portfolio Revenue Management Environment.

You will currently hold an internationally recognized Degree in Hospitality or Sales & Marketing related field and have proven knowledge of Central Reservation Systems (Holidex Plus/Trust/Marsha), Property Management Systems (Opera) and Revenue Management Software Systems (Optims, Ideas, Rategain, Perform & Price Optimization).

You will have a proven ability in exceeding company targets, managing key stakeholders and the ability to be successful whilst working autonomously.

Japanese language proficiency is essential.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH in Hannover bieten wir ab August 2027 ein interessantes und vielseitiges duales Studium zum Bachelor of Science Business Economics mit der Fachrichtung Tourismus- und Eventmanagement (m/w/d) an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • mit TUI WORKWIDE bis zu 30 Tage im Ausland arbeiten
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du möchtest verstehen, wie wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen entstehen, analysierst gerne Zusammenhänge und hast Spaß daran, mit Zahlen und Daten echte Mehrwerte zu schaffen? Dann starte dein duales Studium bei TUI!

Während deines Studiums wechselst du regelmäßig zwischen Theorie und Praxis. An der Leibniz Fachhochschule in Hannover erwirbst du fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen, das du in den Praxisphasen direkt bei TUI anwenden kannst. Dabei lernst du verschiedene Fachbereiche kennen, arbeitest an spannenden Projekten mit und gewinnst Einblicke in die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge eines internationalen Touristikunternehmens.

Ob...

  • Controlling,
  • Finance
  • Commercial Analytics oder
  • weitere betriebswirtschaftliche Fachbereiche:

Bei uns arbeitest du mit modernen Daten- und Analysetools, unterstützt wichtige Entscheidungsprozesse und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zur gefragten Nachwuchskraft. Dabei übernehmen wir nicht nur deine Studiengebühren, sondern bieten dir auch zahlreiche Trainings, E-Learnings und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge spannend findest und gerne den Dingen auf den Grund gehst.
  • du Spaß an Zahlen, Daten und analytischem Denken hast.
  • du neugierig bist und neue Themen mit Offenheit und Eigeninitiative angehst.
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt.
  • du sowohl selbstständig arbeiten als auch gemeinsam im Team Lösungen entwickeln möchtest.
  • du Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • du sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst.
  • du dein Abitur erfolgreich abgeschlossen hast oder bald abschließen wirst.

Deine Noten sind für uns ein wichtiger Anhaltspunkt. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen und mitzugestalten.

Lade Deine Bewerbung Einfach Online Hoch

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt)
  • Lebenslauf
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnus
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und schicke uns deine Unterlagen.
  • Zeig uns, was in dir steckt - mit einem kurzen Online-Test.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen und entdecke beim Assessment Center die Welt von TUI.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot für den Start im August 2027 und deine Reise bei TUI kann beginnen.

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

About The Role

As a Principal Product Data Scientist, you will operate as the most senior technical leader in the Product Data Science function. You will shape the vision, set the technical direction, and drive strategic impact through innovative analytical solutions. This role is both highly technical and deeply collaborative, requiring excellence in leadership, communication, and cross-functional influence.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and define the Data Science strategy for Product, ensuring that advanced analytics, data science, and AI methodologies are central to how we build great products and improve customer experiences.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior Product and Engineering leadership, ensuring that data-driven decision making is embedded at the highest levels of the organization.
  • Drive the development and adoption of next-generation data science tooling, platforms, and frameworks, with a focus on automation, scalability, and reproducibility.
  • Spearhead the exploration and integration of emerging AI technologies, such as Agentic AI and AI Agents, identifying and developing high-impact use cases from POC to production.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, and uplift modeling, ensuring statistical rigor in decision-making processes.
  • Take ownership of the most complex, high-profile analytical projects, translating ambiguous questions into clear, actionable recommendations that deliver commercial and customer value.
  • Mentor, coach, and develop other Data Scientists and Analysts, fostering a culture of critical thinking, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
  • Lead initiatives to scale impact through automation, self-service, and democratization of data science capabilities.
  • Develop sophisticated customer segmentation, and predictive models that directly inform and optimize the product roadmap.
  • Communicate complex analytical and technical concepts to diverse audiences, influencing stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalize crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Advanced programming background with the ability to build simulations and prototype data products.
  • Experience validating quantitative findings with qualitative methods (e.g., surveys, user research).
  • Demonstrated experience with applied AI, such as NLP, Large Language Models (LLMs), or Agentic AI for analytics.
  • Experience working within a two-sided marketplace, e-commerce, or the travel technology industry.
  • Masters degree or equivalent relevant programs

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we offer internships, co-ops, and full-time opportunities for early career professionals. In any role, you’re a key member of our team, contributing to real projects that help move the business forward while gaining hands-on experience, growing your professional skill set, and connecting with industry leaders. You’ll also have a chance to build community through our employee-run Business Resource Groups, participate in industry conferences, and enjoy unlimited standby travel anywhere we fly.

The Operations Strategy & Analytics team collaborates with cross-functional teams such as Aircraft Technical Operations, Network Operations and Network Planning to design, develop and maintain predictive models that drive actionable insights and optimize various aspects of our airline operations with an emphasis on Aircraft Technical Operations performance.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities for Operations Strategy & Analytics include:

  • Engage with domain experts to understand business challenges, identify data-driven opportunities, and enhance decision-making and operational efficiency in the intersection of Aircraft Technical Operations and Network Operation Center business process.
  • Conduct data mining, data cleaning, and feature engineering to ensure high-quality datasets for analysis and modeling, in order to reduce unplanned out of service aircraft or improve throughput or mitigate risk for Aircraft Technical Operations.
  • Develop state-of-the-art models (e.g. machine learning, statistics or optimization) models and advanced analytics solutions to create actionable business insights for better future operational outcomes to enable data-driven decision making within demand, supply and buffers as it relates to Aircraft Technical Operations performance
  • Effectively communicate complex data insights and model results to non-technical partners in a clear and concise manner.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and standard processes in data science and machine learning to ensure the continuous improvement of our analytics capabilities.

This is a 6-month (Summer-Fall) commitment.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Applicant must be a current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing a degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering or a related quantitative field
  • 2+ years of experience or schooling in data science, machine learning, optimization, statistics or a related field
  • 1+ years designing and programming/coding data structures for large-scale computer models
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Coursework or work experience with statistics, machine learning, optimization, big data analytics and/or forecasting techniques
  • Ability to work with cross functional groups, with strong relationship building skills
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models or advanced analytics solutions with business results.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to non-technical partners.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and presentation skills with a focus on collaboration
  • Experience using SQL, Python or R preferred
  • Ability to handle simultaneous projects and adapt to a fast-paced, changing environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working toward a master’s degree or higher
  • Green Belt certification and demonstrated results through utilization of DMAIC
  • Prior experience in the aviation industry or a strong understanding of airline operations is a plus
  • Knowledge of United/industry data sources
  • Structured programming for large-scale computer models
  • Familiarity with Palantir Foundry
  • Field experience working with frontline workers
  • Demonstrated understanding of the capabilities and limitations of generative AI tools and the ability to leverage AI effectively to support research, analysis, content creation, and problem-solving. Applies critical thinking to validate AI-generated outputs while adhering to organizational policies related to responsible AI use, data privacy, and security.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Introduction:

The Client Success Team is responsible for driving our clients’ retention and growth. The team is a fast-paced and dynamic unit focused on providing customer . The key goal of the team is to launch, innovate, and scale our corporate travel solutions. The business development executive will work closely with Senior Business development managers to support day-to-day operational duties and assist the General Manager in administrative tasks.



In this Role, you’ll get to:

  •  Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients through regular communication and meetings.
  • Identify and understand client needs and expectations, ensuring they are met or exceeded.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients, providing timely and accurate information and updates.
  • Identify opportunities to grow revenue through upselling, cross-selling, and renewals.
  • Acting as client advocates, sharing new client requirements with internal stakeholders.
  • Ensuring solutions are enhanced to continually meet clients’ needs.
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews to achieve strategic goals of program
  • Sign renewal contracts with existing clients
  • Analyze account profitability, identify and implement ways to increase profitability.
  • Raise enhancements needed, follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure these enhancements go live
  • Work closely with the sales team to identify and target new key clients.
  • Develop and implement account strategies to increase share of wallet, deepen account penetration, increase profitability and client stickiness.
  • Analyze client data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Work with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery and issue resolution.
  • Collaborate with other departments (e.g., operations, finance, marketing) to ensure seamless client experience.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior account managers, sharing knowledge and best practices.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to enhance overall client satisfaction.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, best practices, and competitors' offerings.
  • Attend relevant industry events and conferences to network, sharing knowledge learnt at the events back with internal teams after.


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • University degree or equivalent experience. MBA will be an advantage 
  • Fluent in English and Chinese (Knowing Chinese is a plus not mandatory)  
  • Excellent interpersonal and communications skills
  • Preferred 2- 3 years’ experience in consulting firm or as business analyst would be a plus
  • Flexible and adaptable with a strong willingness to learn 
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision 
  • Able to adjust different communication methods depending on the stakeholders 
  • Possess a strong learning attitude, remaining humble with a hunger to succeed
  • Can do attitude, self-motivated and able to work independently 
  • Have tenacity which will help overcome obstacles. 
  • Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint and any other related software for day-to-day operations 
  • Willingness to travel, if needed 


Behavioural Requirements:

  • Desire to learn new things and improve yourself
  • Integrity is fundamentally important to you 
  • You want to make a corporate travel experience better for everyone 
  • You are naturally inspiring 
  • You are street smart 


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.



Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com



Have a good trip, and see you soon!

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Taiwan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok or Shanghai office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week / Relocation support will be provided).

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Taiwan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Taiwan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Taiwan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Taiwan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required

job.job_description:
Company Description

Hyde Perth has recently established itself as a world class employer of choice and to be part of something special. Since the hotel’s opening in March 2026, we have been bringing the signature Hyde energy to the vibrant heart of Western Australia. This bold and stylish hotel embodies the spirit of the Hyde brand: luxurious yet laidback, sophisticated with a festival soul. 

Hyde is embracing an evolved brand identity that is all about a festival vibe with music at its core. Hyde perfectly balances an elevated bohemian-chic aesthetic with a youthful, laidback ambience. The spaces are defined by vibrant colours and are designed to encourage serendipitous connections and new discoveries around every corner. Hyde is all about the freedom and personal discovery that comes with great music, time with friends and connecting with something bigger. 

Job Description

As Sales Coordinator, you will provide essential administrative and coordination support to the Sales team at Hyde Perth, helping to ensure enquiries, client communications, sales activities, and event opportunities are managed efficiently and professionally.

Working closely with the Director of Sales and wider Sales team, as well as Revenue, Reservations, Marketing, Food & Beverage, and Hotel Operations, you will play an important role in supporting the smooth journey from initial enquiry through to confirmed business and event delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised, proactive and customer-focused individual looking to build their career in hotel sales and hospitality.

You will be responsible for keeping sales information accurate and up to date, assisting with proposals and quotations, coordinating client requirements, and providing day-to-day administrative support to the commercial team.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Administration & Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Director of Sales and Sales team.
  • Prepare and distribute proposals, quotations, presentations, and other sales documentation.
  • Assist with the preparation of contracts, agreements, and other client documentation.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client, account and contact information within the CRM and hotel systems.
  • Assist with maintaining accurate sales activity, pipeline, tentative and confirmed business records.
  • Prepare regular sales reports and assist with tracking sales activity and performance.
  • Assist with diary management, meeting coordination and preparation for client appointments and sales meetings.
  • Assist with internal events coordination.
  • Maintain organised sales files, documents, and records.

Client & Enquiry Coordination

  • Act as a professional and responsive point of contact for clients and prospective customers.
  • Assist the Sales team by responding to Corporate, Leisure, MICE, group, and event enquiries.
  • Gather client requirements and ensure relevant information is accurately captured and communicated.
  • Follow up on outstanding enquiries and proposals as directed by the Sales team.
  • Assist with coordinating hotel site inspections and client visits.
  • Support the Sales team in preparing for client meetings, presentations, and appointments.
  • Assist with post-event and post-stay follow-up and client communication where required.

MICE & Event Support

  • Assist the Sales team with the coordination of group, MICE, and event enquiries.
  • Support the preparation of event proposals, quotations, and function documentation.
  • Ensure confirmed event details are accurately recorded and communicated to the relevant hotel departments.
  • Assist with updating event information, room requirements, menus, AV requirements, and accommodation details.
  • Liaise with Reservations, F&B, Events and Operations teams to ensure information is communicated accurately.
  • Assist with preparing event documentation and operational information for confirmed business.
  • Provide administrative support throughout the event planning process.

Sales & Marketing Support

  • Assist with the preparation of sales presentations, client communications, and promotional materials.
  • Support the Sales team with client entertainment, networking events, trade shows, and sales activities.
  • Assist with maintaining sales collateral and ensuring information is current and on brand.
  • Support the team with market research, competitor research and identifying potential business opportunities.
  • Assist with maintaining databases of corporate clients, agencies, PCOs, DMCs, TMCs and other relevant contacts.
  • Support the coordination of sales campaigns and initiatives as required.

General

  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Revenue, Reservations, Marketing, F&B and Hotel Operations.
  • Ensure all client information is handled accurately and professionally.
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail across all administrative and sales activities.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and high-performing Sales & Marketing team.
  • Follow all hotel policies, procedures, and brand standards.
  • Undertake other reasonable duties as required to support the Sales team and hotel.

Qualifications

You are organised, enthusiastic and customer-focused, with a genuine interest in building a career in hospitality sales.

You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable managing multiple priorities and take pride in getting the details right. You will be a confident communicator who enjoys working with people and supporting a busy commercial team.

You do not necessarily need extensive hotel sales experience. We are looking for someone with the right attitude, strong organisational skills, and a willingness to learn.

Ideally, You Will Have

  • Previous experience in administration, customer service, hospitality, sales support, events, or a similar role.
  • An interest in developing a career within hotel sales and hospitality.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • A professional and confident manner when communicating with clients and colleagues.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
  • A proactive, positive, and solutions-focused approach.
  • Strong computer skills and confidence learning new systems.
  • Experience with CRM (Ivvy), Opera, iVvy or similar systems is advantageous but not essential.
  • Previous experience within a hotel or hospitality environment is advantageous.
  • A genuine passion for hospitality and delivering excellent client experiences.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support the wider Sales & Marketing team.

Additional Information

What Is In It For You 

  • The chance to make your mark in a fast-growing Brand. 
  • Learning opportunities to broaden your skillset and development that helps you think, make, and thrive at work. 
  • An annual diversity and inclusion calendar of events creating opportunities for you to learn, celebrate and make a positive impact. 
  • The opportunity to be yourself and collaborate with other bright minds in a relaxed, innovative culture. 
  • Excellent discounts across the entire Ennismore family of brands, including Accor’s Heartist (Employee) program and related benefits. 

 Hyde is an equal opportunity employer. We endeavour to select, place, train, and promote the best qualified individuals based upon job-related factors such as ability, work quality, suitability, experience, and potential.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta’s Revenue Management team currently has a Transpacific Pricing Senior Analyst role open in Atlanta, GA to assist with the ongoing development of Delta’s market-level Transpacific pricing strategy and analysis of revenue performance. The primary responsibility of this position is to identify the revenue maximizing pricing strategy for each Transpacific market within an assigned scope while cultivating strong relationships with internal business partners and Joint Venture partners Korean Air.

A Senior Analyst in this role will leverage existing performance tools to improve performance and identify incremental revenue opportunities while maintaining competitive fare positioning, rules, pricing policies, procedures, and programs for the assigned scope. They should proactively identify opportunities to refine processes and tools, embrace challenging analytical tasks, and possess excellent communication skills to convey detailed analytical insights to key stakeholders through both verbal and written channels. This position also works closely with Inventory management, Network Planning, and partner Korean Air to ensure alignment with divisional and corporate priorities.

Primary Job Functions

  • Ability to quickly analyze data, concisely summarize results, and effectively present conclusions and recommendations
  • Exhibit strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Collaborate with Inventory to implement revenue-optimal strategies, as well as partner with System Strategy on cross commercial initiatives
  • Partner with Global Pricing Distribution (GPD) and Enterprise Solutions (ES) to develop and improve pricing processes, tools, and automation

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Candidate must seek challenging work and demonstrate proficiency independently managing complex and high-profile market scopes or projects
  • 2+ years of superior quantitative, analytical, leadership, and organizational skills
  • Candidate must have strong communication and ability to influence, including the ability to work well with other Commercial teams and DL partners in a collaborative nature
  • Must have the ability to work well with others in a time-sensitive, team-focused, and results-oriented environment with minimal supervision
  • Must be performing satisfactorily in current position
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Pricing and Revenue Management (PRM) or Commercial (Sales, Network, Alliances, etc.) experience
  • Familiarity with Pricing systems (Sabre AirPrice, ATPCO), Sales programs, and PRM concepts is preferred, as well as proficiency in Hyperion/Brio and commercial data sources (RPAD, FPS, MIDT, HFDB, etc.)
  • Previous Commercial project management and tool development experience

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
Overview

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance of your own financial operation. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

Schedule:Monday-Friday 7:45am - 5:00 PM (with 1 hour lunch)

This position is located at: 6300 E 37th Street North, Wichita KS 67220.

We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation - This position offers targeted 1st year annual compensation of $55,000 with an average 42 hour work week.
  • Paid Time Off, starting with 12 days off per year
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing

We’re a family-owned, world-class portfolio of brands and leading provider of mobility solutions worldwide. Founded more than 65 years ago with a commitment to the communities that we serve, we operate a global network with 90,000 dedicated team members across nearly 100 countries, and more than 2.1 million vehicles taking our customers where they want to go. We owe our success to each and every one of our people. That's why we empower everyone on our team with opportunities for growth.

At Enterprise Mobility, you will have the chance to run your own financial operation and provide balance to the marketing and operational pieces of our business. We offer a comprehensive development program where you will work closely with sales and marketing, human resources, risk management, real estate strategy, and more to produce excellence in customer service, growth strategies, operating efficiencies, and profitability.

As your understanding of our business grows and your ability to make solid business decisions develops, you will soon take on a supervisory role within a business management team. With our entrepreneurial philosophy, there is truly nothing holding you back.

Responsibilities

Starting as an Accountant, you are executing accounting procedures and principles that will lead to financial statement, preparation, and financial analysis.

  • Prepare financial statements
  • Perform branch audit evaluations
  • Assemble bank reconciliation and account schedule
  • Prepare journal entries, expense accruals and allocations
  • Participate in a timely and accurate month-end closing process
  • Assist personnel with questions regarding accounting policies and procedures
  • Analyze income statements fluctuations
  • Provide process improvement and cost saving ideas
  • Managing financial records, assist in financial reporting
  • Support budgeting and forecasting
  • Conduct audits and ensure compliance
  • Collaborate with other departments
  • May be responsible for T& E reports, coding, account classification and reimbursement amounts
  • May be responsible for preparation and sales and other tax returns

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

  • Must have a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Willingness to attain CPA, CMA, or other advanced financial degree preferred
  • Must have basic proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Flexibility for career advancement could include relocation outside local area/state
  • Must have a valid driver's license with no more than 2 moving violations and/or at-fault accidents on driving record in the past 3 years
    • No drug or alcohol related convictions on driving record (DUI/DWI) within the past 5 years
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
  • Must be willing to relocate outside local area/state for career advancement
  • Must be at least 18 years old

job.job_description:
The Opportunity


Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns & Projects to join the Digital & Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.

In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. You will work with regional and global teams, hotels, agencies, and external partners to drive customer and World of Hyatt member acquisition, conversion, engagement, loyalty, and retention.


Who We Are


At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and in creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and guests have been at the heart of our business and have helped Hyatt become one of the world’s leading and fastest-growing hospitality companies.

Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.


The Role


Reporting to the Director, Digital & Direct Channels South EAME, the Associate Manager,CRM , Digital Campaigns & Projects will be responsible for coordinating the strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM initiatives, digital campaigns, and projects related to the web and digital ecosystem.


Key responsibilities include:


  • Coordinate campaigns, tactics, and touchpoints aimed at Hyatt guests and World of Hyatt members, using segmentation, personalization, and data analysis to improve engagement, conversion, and direct bookings.
  • Manage the relationship calendar and ensure the proper alignment of campaigns with commercial, regional, global, and hotel priorities.
  • Lead the execution and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, ensuring alignment with direct-channel performance objectives.
  • Coordinate promotions and activations across the digital ecosystem, managing timelines, content, assets, and messaging across different touchpoints.
  • Act as a liaison between Digital Marketing, Web, Contact Center, Revenue Management, Operations, eDistribution, and Marketing teams.
  • Coordinate digital projects from end to end, managing milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
  • Monitor performance, define and track CRM KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Analyze customer behavior and feedback to continuously improve CRM initiatives and the digital customer experience.
  • Ensure CRM processes comply with GDPR and best practices in data governance and data quality.
  • Coordinate relationships with CRM and digital agencies across South EAME and the wider EAME region, ensuring consistency in strategy, reporting, execution, and best-practice adoption.


Qualifications


  • At least 3 years of professional experience in CRM, digital marketing, digital campaigns, or a closely related field.
  • Experience planning, executing, and analyzing digital and CRM campaigns.
  • Experience coordinating projects and working with multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience working with external agencies, preferably in regional or international environments.
  • Knowledge of marketing, digital analytics, CRM, personalization, content, ecommerce, and cloud-based technology platforms.
  • Experience with platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, metasearch, display/programmatic, and affiliate marketing.
  • Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, combining creativity with a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a dynamic, international environment with multiple priorities.
  • High level of English, both written and spoken; additional languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Previous experience with Hyatt and Hyatt systems will be considered an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent is preferred.


Who You Are


You are passionate about improving the customer experience through data, technology, and creativity. You are organized, collaborative, and results-oriented, with the ability to coordinate complex projects and connect teams with different perspectives.

You also share Hyatt’s core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing.


We Welcome You


Research shows that individuals often apply for jobs only when they meet all the listed qualifications. If you do not meet every requirement but feel inspired by this opportunity and believe you can bring value, we encourage you to apply.

We would love to learn more about your experience and discover how you could help make Hyatt even better.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive; additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in Hilton's Revenue Management Consolidated Centre (RMCC), you’re not just gaining hands-on experience at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

  • Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.
  • Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into RMCC. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.
  • Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.
  • Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.
  • Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.
  • Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends.
  • Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare.
  • Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.

Our Placement Opportunities

We have a two placement opportunities within our highly talented Revenue Management Consolidated Centre:

Revenue Analyst And Pricing Placement

This placement is ideal for a student interested in revenue management and pricing strategy, offering exposure to how commercial performance is driven across Hilton's EMEA portfolio. During the internship, you'll gain hands-on experience analysing business performance, supporting pricing decisions, and contributing to projects that directly impact hotel revenue.

You will be an integral part of the team and play an active role in our success, with responsibilities including:

  • Supporting analysis of hotel performance to identify opportunities and risks.
  • Assisting in the development and communication of pricing, inventory, and promotional strategies.
  • Contributing to EMEA and global projects using a test-and-learn approach, measuring performance to drive improvements.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support delivery of commercial priorities.
  • Assisting in the preparation of reports, insights, and presentations for stakeholders.
  • Supporting consistent processes and operational best practices across the RMCC.
  • Gaining exposure to revenue management systems and tools used to support pricing decisions.
  • Perform tasks across Microsoft products such as Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint, with the use of VBA, SQL, Python or similar coding languages.

RMCC Business Development Placement

This role is ideal for someone interested in business development, focused on identifying growth opportunities and driving commercial success across Hilton's EMEA portfolio. During the internship, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting RMCC expansion, including onboarding new hotels and contributing to large-scale change management initiatives within a structured framework.

You will play an active role in the team's success, with responsibilities including:

  • Hands-on experience in business development, strategic planning, and customer relationship management.
  • Preparing collateral and resources to support RMCC growth.
  • Supporting pre-opening activities for new hotels, ensuring timelines and stakeholder satisfaction are met.
  • Providing analysis to support ramp-up performance of new hotel openings.
  • Assisting in testing and implementing pricing, inventory, and capability enhancements.
  • Supporting EMEA and global projects with a test-and-learn approach, using performance metrics to drive improvements.
  • Ensuring efficient use of systems in line with company best practices and standard operating procedures.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

  • A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.
  • A Hospitality or Business Management related degree is preferred.
  • Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.
  • You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Exceptionally organised and comfortable prioritising tasks and working to deadlines.
  • You should be able to demonstrate a genuine interest in RMCC.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

  • Online assessments.
  • In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

job.job_description:
Manage and perform strategic analysis of complex markets to assess the desirability of specific locations in the U.S., Canada, the Caribbean, and Mexico to determine the value of a new or converted franchise hotel on the existing franchise system. Provide strategic analysis and support regarding complex strategic and operational questions across multiple functions (including development, brand strategy and franchise operations). Provide support for key decision making processes, including the Franchise Approval Committee. Maintain and track regional view on system size and pipeline highlighting actions required to meet IHG system size growth ambition. Provide financial, analytical and business planning support and advice to assigned business unit to ensure their success in implementing the Company’s strategic priorities.

Your day to day

  • Conduct strategic analyses which include the development, data mining, and interpretation of quantitative analytical support for Franchise Sales and Development and Americas Finance.
  • Provide in-depth analytical support and insight, including a deep understanding of complex market performance drivers, to identify target locations for the Company’s mainstream, upscale or new brand hotels. Develop reports and processes to maintain and track performance against targets over time. Communicate frequently with the field sales team to translate complex analysis into easy to understand market insights. Support the development and ongoing evolution of the COMPASS model build outs and improvements to the tool.
  • Support and manage the development of key strategic reports utilized regularly for decision making by senior management, including reports specifically for the CEO and regional operating committee members (reports include confidential data and information with which major decisions are made).
  • Perform market analyses for the US, Canada, Caribbean, and Mexico territories to include studies of current and future trends of consumer economic, demographic and competitive data.
  • Independently conduct market field work to establish viability and/or feasibility of proposed IHG branded hotels.
  • Build and maintain data and systems underpinning Market Strategy approach e.g., Compass, Tableau, Business Objects, Access database(s).
  • Maintain and track Americas region view on system size, pipeline, all development revenue streams, and royalty projections to ensure alignment with IHG system growth ambition.
  • Review proposed hotel projects for location attributes, notification to existing owners, and recommendations as part of IHG’s internal review process.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Business, Strategy, Finance, Statistics or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work related experience
  • 3 plus years’ progressive work experience in strategy, consultancy or finance with demonstrated mastery of technical and business knowledge, understanding multiple disciplines/processes and tackling complex strategic issues related to the position. Previous work experience in the Hotel Industry, market planning or real estate development areas are highly desirable
  • Demonstrated project management experience in planning and executing complex analytical projects and processes from conception through implementation.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking through an ability to analyze markets, performance data, and complex business issues in order to draw insight/conclusions.
  • Demonstrated financial modeling/analysis (DCF, NPV, accounting, statistics) and basic financial principals.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess and understand a variety of internal and external economic and financial issues and to analyze data and forecast future business trends in order to support the strategic market/business planning function.
  • Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff. Demonstrated ability to communicate and present data and analysis using a persuasive argument or to effectively negotiate a position.
  • Demonstrated advanced-level knowledge and understanding of economic conditions, industry trends, financial statements, and other issues affecting potential franchise transactions. Demonstrated ability to analyze these factors and draw logical conclusions.
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills and relationship-building skills, in order to effectively act as a liaison to explain analysis, recommendations and decisions to the Director, Market Strategy & Development Analytics, the development/ franchise sales organization and senior management
  • Demonstrated financial and business analysis skills, and demonstrated ability to analyze operating, forecast, and budget information. Demonstrated ability to use the results of analysis to make effective strategic decisions

Travel – 15-25%

Location – Atlanta, GA: Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

The salary range for this role is $84,000.00 to $97,000.00. This role is also eligible for bonus pay (as applicable). We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401K, and other benefits to employees.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
