job.job_description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we offer internships, co-ops, and full-time opportunities for early career professionals. In any role, you’re a key member of our team, contributing to real projects that help move the business forward while gaining hands-on experience, growing your professional skill set, and connecting with industry leaders. You’ll also have a chance to build community through our employee-run Business Resource Groups, participate in industry conferences, and enjoy unlimited standby travel anywhere we fly.

You'll have the opportunity to work on projects that impact our company’s reliability performance--we carry over 450,000 passengers per day on over 4,300 flights to 350 worldwide destinations.

Throughout the course of the program, interns will be responsible to their respective manager, but there may also be opportunities or projects that have emphasis or travel to other hub or line station cities within our network.

This role requires business intuition, a working knowledge of analytical methods and tools and a passion for delivering insightful, accurate results in support of providing the company an understanding of our operational performance. We are seeking creative, driven and detail-oriented individuals who enjoy tackling tough problems with data and insights. Individuals who have a curiosity and desire to solve problems are encouraged to apply. 

This internship is designed solely to provide you with skill development and valuable work experience. This role will likely not convert to a full-time position at United at the conclusion of the internship.

Specific Projects May Include

  • Tracking and analyzing operational and customer data from multiple sources to assist with data preparation, reporting, and dashboard development.
  • Serve as an internal consultant, providing business analyses to management of various operating divisions on challenges and opportunities facing the airline.
  • Evaluating scheduled block time performance (i.e. time required for a flight to travel between departure and arrival gates).
  • Understanding factors impacting current issues such as departure and arrival delays, gate holds, taxi times, etc.
  • Identifying and reporting on competitive performance trends.
  • Potential assignments include analyzing operational performance, developing strategic plans, establishing performance metrics, evaluation of schedules as relates to operational reliability and providing insights into the customer experience.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Strong analytical skills/proficient with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Experience using SQL and/or Python
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to handle simultaneous projects and adapt to a fast-paced, changing environment
  • Solid interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team

The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda serves our customers and partners to deliver satisfying results. This is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team — the backbone of CEG’s global operations. Our team includes project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes.

We are a data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role sits in the B2B Partnerships and Automation team, part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team drives end-to-end customer experience and process improvements, and scales impact through automation, AI, and tooling across customer-facing and agent-facing journeys.

The Opportunity

This Associate Director role owns and leads the project management team for this area: setting direction, raising the delivery bar, and being accountable for the outcomes of the team’s portfolio.

The portfolio typically covers:

  • (i) automation, AI, and tooling that improve customer and agent experience, and
  • (ii) process optimization and CX improvements across the post-booking journey, including operational (CS) support and optimization.

You will combine strategic problem solving, hands-on data-driven execution, strong project management, and senior stakeholder and partner management. Commercial acumen is a real advantage: you will often be the CEG project counterpart to commercial and partner stakeholders, translating business needs into deliverable work without owning the commercial P&L.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead the Project Management Team and its Portfolio

  • Own the PM team end-to-end: vision, structure, ways of working, hiring, coaching, performance, and succession of project managers (and people managers on the team, where applicable).
  • Set long-term direction and annual/quarterly OKRs for the team, aligned with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
  • Own the outcomes of the team’s portfolio of global initiatives — prioritization, quality, impact, risk, and delivery.
  • Prioritize and drive work that moves mission-critical metrics: customer satisfaction (e.g. CSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG project readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Data, Strategic Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Operations/Support, and other teams.

Drive Automation, AI, and Continuous Innovation

  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer and agent journeys (e.g. self-service, workflow automation, AI quality testing, agent guidance).
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Data, and CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions — from experimentation through global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Oversee configuration and governance of operational flows and low-code/automation tools so solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with CX standards.
  • Act as a natural innovator: reframe problems, pitch new approaches (tech/AI and non-tech process), and systematically improve how the team and CEG work — not only execute a pre-agreed roadmap.

Shape Process, CX, and Operational Support Improvements

  • Lead project work that improves CEG end-to-end processes across the post-booking journey, removing pain points and improving operational performance through targeted initiatives and data-driven insight.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve internal SOPs and related processes, balancing CX/PX outcomes vs efficiency/cost.
  • Drive strategic project initiatives such as localization support in key growth markets, regulatory work, and operational (CS) support and optimization — in close partnership with ops and commercial teams, without taking line ownership of those functions.
  • Define clear problem statements and business cases; prioritize customer and partner pain points against success metrics.

Partner, Stakeholder, and Commercial Interface

  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across CEG, Agoda, Booking Holdings, and other functions; influence priorities and decisions as the owner of this PM team’s agenda.
  • Be a primary project counterpart for core partners and commercial stakeholders: understand commercial context, surface operable trade-offs, and land cross-functional alignment.
  • Present to CEG senior leadership with confidence and minimal supervision; act as the go-to person for this team’s domain.
  • Monitor milestones, risks, and dependencies; troubleshoot issues; implement mitigation — remaining the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

Experience & Background

  • At least 8–10+ years in project/program management, operations, customer experience, process improvement, strategy, management consulting, or similar — with a strong project management core (this is non-negotiable).
  • Significant people leadership: building and leading a high-performing team of project managers (including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working across operational CS / customer support environments (optimization, process, tooling, quality, or service delivery projects) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience as a counterpart to commercial or partner stakeholders, with genuine commercial acumen, is highly advantageous.
  • Experience working closely with Product, Technology, and Data on technical, automation, or AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g. SQL, Tableau, Metabase, or similar) and experience using them to drive decisions.
  • Comfort working with or overseeing workflow, automation, and agent-guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product, Engineering, and Data. Coding ability is a plus; willingness to learn is expected.
  • Exposure to AI/ML-driven solutions in an operational or CX context (e.g. chatbots, routing, classification, quality testing, or decision-support tools) is a strong plus.

CX, Process, And Delivery Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and CX transformation, ideally in operations or customer support environments.
  • Excellent project and stakeholder management: multiple initiatives in parallel, structured problem-solving, orchestration of cross-functional teams.
  • Experience defining and driving improvements in KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, SLAs, handle time, productivity, or cost-to-serve.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, multicultural environment; comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation.
  • Growth mindset: proactive, hands-on, detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Eagerness to pitch new ideas, take initiative, and seek out opportunities for improvement; comfortable giving and receiving feedback.
  • Comfortable with flexible working hours. This team operates across global time zones (notably Asia and the US, and other Booking Holdings / partner locations). Early or late calls are a normal part of the role, not an exception.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package (relocation support and visa support provided for successful overseas candidates)
  • High-impact career opportunity with a major global OTA, including potential moves between teams and global locations. You will interact with departmental senior leadership regularly.
  • Dynamic, multinational tech environment with colleagues from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities through corporate learning programs.
  • Modern office space and convenient location at the heart of Bangkok Metropolitan, Hub of Asia.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Description de l'entreprise

L'hôtel 5 étoiles « L’Isle de Leos MGallery Collection » est situé au cœur du centre historique et touristique de l’Isle-sur-la-Sorgue, une ville touristique de 30 000 habitants renommée pour ses canaux, ses galeries d’art et ses 300 antiquaires ouverts tout au long de l’année.

Doté de 49 chambres, d’un espace Wellness/Spa d’exception L’Olivier de Leos, d’un bar, d’un restaurant bistronomique où la cuisine raffinée rencontre l’ambiance chaleureuse d’une brasserie traditionnelle provençale et d’espaces de réception et de séminaires, cet établissement singulier, se veut le symbole d’une nouvelle forme d’hôtellerie en centre-ville.

L’hôtel se positionne comme une grande maison d’hôtes de charme centrée sur le bien-être qui accueille chaque client « comme un ami » mais aussi comme un lieu de vie qui raconte et fait vivre l’esprit de L'Isle-sur-la-Sorgue et de la Provence.

L’hôtel fonctionne en lien avec le Domaine de Leos, une propriété viticole et oléicole de 41 hectares qui commercialise des produits remarquables, multimédaillés et plébiscités par les plus grands chefs français.

L’hôtel propose à ses clients de multiples prestations exclusives de haut de gamme à l’intérieur de l’hôtel, dans le Domaine de Leos, dans la ville (toute l’offre culturelle et touristique de la ville est accessible à pied), dans la région proche (Luberon, Mont Ventoux, Alpilles et Avignon) et en Provence.

Engagé dans une démarche citoyenne et écologique ambitieuse, l’hôtel, qui est autonome en énergie à 82% et a été labellisée BDM Or (Bâtiment Durable Méditerranéen), se définit comme un « Eco-hôtel » garantissant ainsi à ses clients un niveau optimal de qualité énergétique et environnementale.

Au fil des saisons, au coin du feu ou au bord de la Sorgue, entre ressourcement, restauration provençale et moments d’exception dans ce lieu singulier, chacun écrit sa propre expérience à L’Isle de Leos MGallery Collection.

Description du poste

Vos Futurs Enjeux Et Challenges Sont Multiples

En tant qu'Assistant(e) Maître d'hôtel H/F/X, vous garantissez un service en salle fluide et de qualité, vous soutenez le Responsable de salle dans le management et la coordination des équipes et vous contribuez à la satisfaction et à la fidélisation des clients, tout en respectant les standards de la marque MGallery Collection.

  • Supervision et organisation du service

  • Assurer la fluidité du service pendant les heures de pointe.

  • Former et accompagner les membres de l’équipe aux standards de l’établissement.

  • Assurer le respect du timing et de la qualité des plats servis.
  • Gérer les retours ou incidents en salle de manière professionnelle.
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue du service et des procédures.

Qualifications

  • Expérience significative dans un poste similaire, de préférence au sein d'un établissement de luxe.
  • Formation professionnelle en Restauration
  • Leadership et esprit d'équipe
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et sens du service client.
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral (la maîtrise d’une troisième langue est un plus).

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Program Manager, Flight Training Analytics & Strategy, plays a critical role in taking complex, ambiguous business challenges and translating them into clear, actionable insights that inform leadership decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and execution – bringing together data, business context, operational considerations, and technical inputs to drive well-informed decisions.

As Program Manager of the Flight Training Analytics & Strategy team, you will be accountable for both strategic insight and disciplined execution—leading complex initiatives from problem framing through leader readout and implementation alignment.

As Program Manager of the Flight Training Analytics & Strategy team, you will be expected to:

  • Evaluate performance, risks, opportunities, and trade-offs using a mix of quantitative analysis, qualitative inputs, and strategic frameworks
  • Design, build and own models to support planning, forecasting, and scenario analysis, integrating data, operational realities, and stakeholder perspectives
  • Ensure models and analysis are transparent, well-documented, and scalable for reuse
  • Lead end to end strategic and analytics initiatives, from scoping and approach definition through delivery and leader readout
  • Create concise, compelling one-pagers and presentations that translate complex work into clear narratives and recommendations
  • Manage project plans, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Coordinate inputs from cross-functional partners to ensure alignment, momentum, and high-quality outputs
  • Identify risks, gaps, or changes in direction early and adjust plans to keep work moving forward
  • Help connect our analytics, automation strategy, and business leaders to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with capabilities
  • Serve as a thought partner and mentor to other team members, raising the bar on problem structuring, execution, and communication
  • Practice safety conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures.     

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Strong experience leveraging modeling, forecasting, and scenario analysis (Excel, Google Sheets, or equivalent; SQL and/or Python, or other database interface tools and/or languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence without authority
  • Proven experience producing executive-ready one-pagers and presentation decks
  • Strong leadership skills, presentation skills, written and oral communication skills, positive attitude and able to manage change successfully in a fast-paced environment
  • Possess analytical thinking skills, be a self-starter and be a quick learner
  • Proven track record of successfully working in a cross-departmental team environment, delivering results on time and on budget
  • Strong business acumen and excellent communication skills with senior management, employees, FAA Reps, union officials, vendors, customers
  • Openness to feedback from, and ability to prioritize the needs of, a diverse set of stakeholders
  • Demonstrable experience with conflict resolution, problem solving and communicating with tact and diplomacy
  • Ability to lead, manage, and communicate to all levels within the organization
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience leveraging data to drive decision-making and prioritization
  • Flexibility and availability to travel, as well as to perform periodic after-hours and weekend work
  • Performing satisfactorily in current position

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, economics, finance, statistics, business, or a related field
  • Exceptional storyteller
  • Outside of the box thinking
  • Strong organizational, project management, and personal management skills
  • Exceptional ability to structure ambiguity and reduce complexity into actionable frameworks
  • Highly preferred: curiosity, sense of humor, willingness to try new ideas, and persistence in the face of adversity

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives

  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!

At the National Convention Centre Canberra (NCCC), we bring events to life — from creative gala dinners to large-scale, multi-day conferences, all supported by exceptional service and catering.

We’re currently seeking an Assistant Event Services Manager to join our Event Services team. Reporting to the Event Services Manager, this is a hands-on leadership role supporting the operational management, planning and delivery of conferences and events across the Centre.

You’ll help lead our Event Services team, coordinate day-to-day operations, maintain high service and presentation standards, manage departmental costs and support the delivery of seamless experiences for our clients and guests.

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be:

  • Assisting with the operational management, planning and delivery of conferences, events and functions across the NCCC
  • Coordinating day-to-day Event Services operations to maximise guest satisfaction, service quality and departmental performance
  • Ensuring events are accurately executed and delivered in accordance with Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), while maintaining data integrity
  • Supporting operational management across Event Services, Facilities and Stores in line with Fire Life Safety, HACCP, WHS and Security requirements
  • Working with the Event Services Manager to manage departmental budgets and costs, with a focus on wages, beverage costs, linen and operating supplies
  • Supporting departmental revenue, GOP and P&L performance and identifying opportunities to drive incremental revenue
  • Maintaining and using NCCC and IHG operating systems including MICROS, FutureLog, Shiji and other operational tools
  • Assisting with the management and operation of the NCCC car park
  • Ensuring function rooms, public areas, back-of-house areas and storerooms are maintained and presented to a high standard
  • Working closely with Stores, Kitchen, Events, Facilities, Finance and Maintenance teams to support seamless event delivery
  • Providing leadership, direction and support to Event Services team members, including recruitment, onboarding, training and succession planning
  • Supporting the development and delivery of comprehensive team training programs
  • Promoting team engagement, development and a positive workplace culture
  • Communicating relevant safety information to team members and supporting the identification, assessment and management of workplace risks
  • Ensuring team members receive appropriate induction, refresher training and supervision in relation to workplace health and safety responsibilities
  • Supporting and promoting employee health and wellbeing initiatives across the department

What We’re Looking For:

  • Previous leadership or supervisory experience within large-scale events, conferencing, hospitality or food and beverage operations
  • Strong operational knowledge and the ability to coordinate multiple events and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • A strong understanding of workplace health and safety, HACCP, Fire Life Safety and operational compliance requirements
  • Experience working with event, point-of-sale or operational systems such as MICROS, FutureLog and Shiji would be advantageous
  • Commercial awareness with an understanding of wage control, operational costs, revenue and departmental performance
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with BEOs and event requirements
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple departments
  • Strong leadership skills and a genuine interest in developing, training and supporting team members
  • A guest-focused mindset with a passion for creating exceptional event experiences
  • The confidence and flexibility to work in a dynamic operational environment where no two days are the same

You'll be rewarded for your hard work with a suite of benefits that supports you and your family's wellbeing, including:

  • Paid Birthday Leave
  • Hotel Perks like accommodation and Food & Beverage discounts
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Proactive health days and flexible work options
  • Your career journey will be supported through our lifelong development program
  • IHG Career Milestone celebrations
  • Transfer of entitlements as you move and grow with IHG
  • Access to our discount retail platform that makes your pay go even further

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees, regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability. job.job_description:
As the world's largest family of luxury hotels, we take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Drawing on decades of international expertise and local insight, we create inspiring experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Every InterContinental hotel reflects the culture and character of its destination while delivering the thoughtful service and sophistication our guests expect.

As the first InterContinental Resort in Australia, InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort embodies the elegance of a grand Queensland estate, surrounded by the beauty and tranquillity of Sanctuary Cove.

We are currently seeking a Groups Reservations Agent to join our team.

Your Day to Day

As a Groups Reservations Agent, you will play a key role in managing and coordinating the Resort's group accommodation business, ensuring a seamless experience from booking confirmation through to guest arrival. Reporting to the Reservations Manager, you will be responsible for high-value and high-volume group reservations while maintaining strong knowledge of FIT and Inbound reservations to provide operational support across the department when required.

Working closely with Sales, Conference & Events, Revenue, Front Office and operational teams, you will help deliver exceptional guest experiences while maximising occupancy and revenue opportunities.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage Group Reservations from initial booking through to arrival, ensuring accuracy, timely follow-up and exceptional service.
  • Coordinate high-value and high-volume group bookings, including rooming lists, room allocations, VIP requirements, special requests and amendments.
  • Ensure group reservations are managed in accordance with contracted rates, room allocations, cut-off dates, payment terms, cancellation policies and agreed inclusions.
  • Monitor group pickup against contracted room blocks and deadlines, identifying risks and opportunities to support hotel revenue objectives.
  • Liaise closely with Sales, Conference & Events, Revenue, Front Office, Housekeeping, Finance and other operational departments to ensure all reservation requirements are accurately communicated and actioned.
  • Accurately process reservations, amendments and cancellations within Opera and associated reservation systems.
  • Review upcoming arrivals and ensure guest preferences, VIP recognition, package inclusions, transfers and special requests are accurately recorded and communicated.
  • Support FIT and Inbound Reservations during peak periods and operational requirements, maintaining a strong working knowledge of associated systems, inventory and processes.
  • Deliver exceptional service through all guest, travel agent, travel arranger and group organiser interactions via phone and email.
  • Maintain accurate guest profiles, reservation records and correspondence in accordance with Resort and IHG standards.
  • Conduct reservation audits and arrivals checks to identify and resolve discrepancies before guest arrival.
  • Identify opportunities to maximise revenue through upgrades, extended stays, accommodation packages, transfers and additional resort experiences.
  • Attend departmental briefings, meetings and training sessions as required.
  • Uphold IHG brand standards, policies and values in every interaction.

What We Need From You

Ideally, you'll bring:

  • Previous experience in a hotel Reservations environment, with Group Reservations experience highly desirable.
  • Experience managing high-volume accommodation bookings and multiple stakeholder relationships.
  • Knowledge of Group, FIT and Inbound Reservations, or the ability to quickly develop expertise across these segments.
  • Experience using Opera PMS, Holidex or similar hotel reservation systems.
  • A confident and professional telephone manner with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and exceptional organisational skills.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Confident Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel.
  • A proactive approach to problem solving and ownership of guest and reservation enquiries.
  • A genuine passion for hospitality and delivering personalised guest experiences.
  • The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Completion of Year 12 or equivalent.
  • Full Australian working rights.

What We Offer

At IHG, we provide more than just a job. We offer a place where you can be yourself, share your ideas, develop your career, and be part of a supportive and inclusive team.

In return for your passion and commitment, you'll enjoy a range of benefits including:

  • Paid Birthday Leave.
  • Hotel discounts across IHG properties worldwide.
  • Food and Beverage discounts.
  • Access to world-class learning and career development programs.
  • IHG Career Milestone celebrations.
  • Transfer of entitlements as you grow your career within IHG.
  • Access to our exclusive retail and lifestyle discounts platform.

At IHG, we are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels welcome, valued and respected. We celebrate difference and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all.

We are proud to be IHG, and we know you will be too.

job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH in Hannover bieten wir ab August 2027 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung Tourismuskaufleute (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reiseveranstaltung in der TUI Zentrale an.

Die TUI Deutschland GmbH ist der führende Reiseveranstalter auf dem deutschen Markt und eine Tochtergesellschaft der TUI Group. Sie steuert von Hannover aus nicht nur die Entwicklung, sondern auch den Vertrieb und die Vermarktung von TUI-Reisen in Deutschland. Neben der Kernmarke TUI gehören auch Spezialisten wie airtours, ltur und Gebeco zur Unternehmensgruppe. TUI Deutschland verantwortet außerdem die Geschäfte in Österreich und der Schweiz, um das zentraleuropäische Geschäft zu bündeln.

UNSER ANGEBOT

Deine Entwicklung

  • strukturiertes Onboarding
  • Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Seminarreise und ein mehrwöchiger Auslandseinsatz
  • umfangreiche Unterstützung bei deiner Prüfungsvorbereitung

Deine Vorteile

  • 30 Urlaubstage
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • attraktive Ausbildungsvergütung (1.082 € / 1.193 € / 1.337 € / Monat)
  • Reisevergünstigungen
  • mit TUI WORKWIDE bis zu 30 Tage im Ausland arbeiten
  • Deutschlandticket als Jobticket
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft

Deine Perspektiven

  • Netzwerkaufbau
  • internationale Zusammenarbeit
  • Übernahmemöglichkeiten in der gesamten TUI Welt, bei herausragenden Leistungen eine Übernahmegarantie

ZUR POSITION

Du liebst Reisen und möchtest wissen, was hinter einem Urlaub steckt, bevor er gebucht wird? Dann komm zu TUI! Bei uns lernst du die Welt eines Reiseveranstalters kennen und erhältst Einblicke in die Entwicklung, Vermarktung und Umsetzung von Reisen.

Freu Dich Auf

  • Einblicke in verschiedene Fachbereiche eines internationalen Reiseveranstalters
  • Mitarbeit in Bereichen wie Produktentwicklung, Marketing, Vertrieb und Kundenservice
  • Kennenlernen unserer unterschiedlichen Hotelkonzepte, Marken und Reiseprodukte
  • Mitwirkung an spannenden Projekten und kreativen Aufgabenstellungen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams und internationalen Kolleg*innen
  • Übernahme eigener Verantwortung und aktive Mitgestaltung
  • Verständnis dafür, wie aus einer Idee ein unvergessliches Urlaubserlebnis entsteht

Bei uns bekommst du vielfältige Einblicke, übernimmst Verantwortung und entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt zum Profi der Touristikbranche.

ZU DIR

Du passt zu uns, wenn...

  • du Reiseträume wahr werden lassen möchtest.
  • du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Kommunikation zu deinen Stärken zählt. 
  • du offen für Neues bist und Veränderungen eher spannend als anstrengend findest. 
  • du digital unterwegs bist und moderne Tools selbstverständlich nutzt. 
  • du im Team aufblühst und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest. 
  • du (Fach)Abitur oder einen erweiterten Realschulabschluss mitbringst.
  • du gute Englischkenntnisse mitbringst und schon Auslandserfahrung gesammelt hast.

Noten sind wichtig. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung für die Touristik.

Lade deine Bewerbung einfach online hoch: 

  • Anschreiben (oder erzähl uns auf kreative Weise, warum du zu uns passt) 
  • Lebenslauf 
  • Deine letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. dein Abschlusszeugnis 
  • Optional: Praktikumsnachweise, Zertifikate oder weitere Unterlagen, die zeigen, wer du bist 

Bereit für deinen Start bei TUI? ️✈️

  • Bewirb dich online und sende uns deine Unterlagen. 
  • Zeig uns, wer du bist – im Auswahlprozess möchten wir dich und deine Stärken kennenlernen.
  • Lerne uns persönlich kennen – ab November laden wir dich zu unserem Bewerberauswahlverfahren ein.
  • Willkommen an Bord! Wenn alles passt, erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot und startest im August 2027 deine Reise bei TUI. 

Von einem Arbeitsplatz zu einem Ort, an dem man dazugehört. Bei TUI schätzen wir Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion und ermutigen alle, so zu sein, wie sie sind. „Come as you are“ – das ist unsere Vision, denn nur durch Vielfalt ist unser Potenzial grenzenlos. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
Grand Hyatt Vail Resort & Spa


Director of Engineering & Capital Projects

Salary: $150,000 - $170,000 + Relocation Assistance Available

Lead Engineering Operations, Capital Investments, and Asset Strategy for a Premier Hyatt Resort

At Hyatt, we believe exceptional guest experiences begin behind the scenes. Every memorable stay is supported by innovative leaders who ensure our facilities, infrastructure, and physical assets operate at the highest standard.


We are seeking a Director of Engineering & Capital Projects to join our Executive Leadership Committee and lead the strategic direction, operational performance, and long-term stewardship of our resort's engineering and facilities portfolio.


Reporting directly to the Managing Director, this highly visible executive leadership role is responsible for engineering operations, capital project delivery, asset preservation, infrastructure planning, sustainability initiatives, regulatory compliance, and team leadership across the property.

This is an outstanding opportunity for an experienced engineering, facilities, construction, or capital projects leader who wants to influence major business decisions, lead multi-million-dollar investments, and partner directly with ownership groups, corporate leadership, contractors, architects, and consultants.


What You'll Lead

Executive Leadership & Asset Strategy

  • Serve as a key member of the Resort Executive Leadership Committee.
  • Develop and execute long-range asset preservation and capital investment strategies.
  • Partner with ownership groups and Hyatt corporate leaders to maximize asset value and operational performance.
  • Lead annual capital planning, forecasting, and budgeting initiatives.
  • Provide strategic recommendations regarding infrastructure improvements, equipment replacement, and property enhancements.

Engineering & Facilities Operations

  • Oversee all engineering, maintenance, utilities, and facility operations across the resort.
  • Ensure reliable operation of HVAC, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, life-safety, and energy management systems.
  • Direct preventive and predictive maintenance programs that protect guest satisfaction and asset longevity.
  • Maintain compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, reliability, and sustainability.

Capital Projects & Renovations

  • Lead the planning and execution of major renovation, infrastructure, and capital improvement projects.
  • Manage project scope, budgets, schedules, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Partner with architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and vendors throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Oversee project bidding, contract review, vendor selection, and construction management activities.
  • Ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to Hyatt quality standards.
  • Act as the primary liaison between ownership, hotel leadership, and project teams for capital initiatives.

Financial & Operational Performance

  • Develop and manage engineering operating budgets and capital expenditure plans.
  • Monitor project spending and financial performance against approved budgets.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce operating costs.
  • Evaluate equipment replacement strategies and return-on-investment opportunities.
  • Support sustainability and energy management initiatives that improve performance and reduce expenses.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing engineering and facilities team.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, safety, and operational excellence.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development opportunities for team members.
  • Lead emergency preparedness, risk management, and safety compliance programs.
  • Develop future leaders within the engineering organization.

Stakeholder & Ownership Relations

  • Communicate facility performance, project status, and capital recommendations to ownership and corporate stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with regulatory agencies, building officials, and planning departments as required.
  • Build strong partnerships across operations, finance, rooms, food and beverage, and other departments.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor regarding the property's long-term infrastructure and capital investment needs.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Significant leadership experience overseeing engineering, facilities, construction, or property operations within hospitality, healthcare, higher education, commercial real estate, manufacturing, or other large-scale environments.
  • Proven experience leading capital projects, renovations, infrastructure upgrades, or major facility improvement initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, and life-safety systems.
  • Experience developing and managing operating and capital budgets.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams and managing multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong project management, financial analysis, and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety regulations, and compliance requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hotel, resort, or hospitality engineering leadership experience.
  • Experience managing multi-million-dollar capital improvement programs.
  • Background in energy management and sustainability initiatives.
  • Construction management, owner's representative, or renovation leadership experience.
  • Professional certifications, licenses, or technical credentials.
  • Experience supporting luxury, upscale, or destination resort properties.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

  • Executive Visibility
  • Work directly with the Managing Director, ownership groups, and Hyatt corporate leadership on strategic business and asset decisions.
  • Lead Major Capital Investments
  • Drive high-impact renovation and infrastructure projects that shape the future of the resort.
  • Strategic Influence
  • Play a critical role in long-term planning, asset preservation, sustainability initiatives, and operational excellence.
  • Career Growth with Hyatt


Join one of the world's leading hospitality companies with opportunities for advancement across Hyatt's global portfolio.


Competitive Compensation

  • Salary Range: $150,000 - $170,000
  • Relocation Assistance Available
  • Annual incentive opportunity


Why Work at Hyatt?

  • Enjoy free meals in our colleague cafeteria for every shift worked
  • Free parking on-site
  • 1 hours of sick pay earned for every 30 hours worked, up to 48 hours/year
  • Discounted & Complimentary hotel room nights
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Retirement Savings Plan
  • Basic Life Insurance
  • PTO earned based on hours worked, up to 17 days within your first year
  • Opportunities to work around the world with Hyatt Hotels and Resorts

Our growing Flight Centre Luxury teams are evolving to meet the increasing desire for flexibility. To meet the demands of a changing market and create greater flexibility for our business and teams, we are expanding on the success of our existing remote businesses and we are looking for a Remote/Hybrid Future Team Leader for our Luxury Queensland team. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a high-performing team into the next phase of our journey while working from wherever inspires you most - work from home, in our global head office or both.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing all OBW Business and Operating systems
  • Meeting shop Budget and P&L expectations
  • Coaching and developing team members
  • Providing vision and motivation for the team
  • Maintaining an overall positive team environment

Your Benefits:

  • Uncapped Earnings with a base wage + commissions - great earning potential with a team TAC of over $210k!
  • Luxury travel industry perks – There's no better way to recommend premium product than by having experienced it first-hand. Get ready to be invited to try premium air, cruise and land product for yourself.
  • Quality time with clients - in Flight Centre Collection, we don’t service a queue, we meet with our clients at a mutually agreed time in a location that suits the client - no busy shopping centre noise, an environment to build the dream from start to finish. We also have our Global Head Office in Southbank as a base for this team and clients are welcomed to experience this too.
  • Autonomy, freedom and flexibility – You know how you work best and what it takes to be a success. At Flight Centre Collection, you run your day and your client relationships to suit your own unique style. We are open to flexibility with work arrangements.
  • Surround yourself with the best in the business – Our people are at the top end of the industry. They have admirable knowledge and a comprehensive repertoire of skill, with staff retention at 94% and an average tenure of 14 years in industry.
  • Travel Discounts – as a part of Flight Centre Travel Group, travel consultants are extended travel discounts including for family & friends.
  • Reward & Recognition – Sales incentives, and out of this world global recognition holidays. & Much, MUCH more…

This is a rare and exciting opportunity within Flight Centre Collection. As we adapt and grow our business, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of this model, building scalable support structures, and making a lasting impact on the evolution of Luxury Travel. job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Taiwan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok or Shanghai office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week / Relocation support will be provided).

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Taiwan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Taiwan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Taiwan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Taiwan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Role Description:

The Manager People Operations (APAC) is responsible for leading the end-to-end People Operations strategy and service delivery for the company’s largest and most complex employee population.

The role translates global People strategy into high-quality, compliant, and employee-centric operations at APAC level, while ensuring alignment with global standards and adapting to headquarters-specific needs. The role leads operational excellence across the employee lifecycle, drives continuous improvement, and ensures delivery of reliable, scalable People services.

Due to the scale and complexity of the headquarters population, significantly larger than other regions, this role operates with increased scope, stakeholder exposure, and operational impact.

You report to the Global Senior Manager People Operations.

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:

People Operations Leadership

  • Define the APAC People Operations objectives, priorities, and roadmaps aligned with the wider People Ops and PST strategy.
  • Translate global frameworks into effective regional execution, tailored to headquarters needs
  • Represent People Operations in key regional and cross-functional initiatives
  • Own the senior People Operations lead for the APAC population


Service Delivery

  • Accountable for the team’s accurate, compliant, and timely personnel administration and payroll inputs
  • Own service delivery performance, including SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and compliance
  • Drive continuous improvement of People Operations processes to enhance employee experience and operational efficiency
  • Accountable for monitoring data integrity and process adherence across People systems (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow)
  • Identify operational risks and implement mitigation plans
  • Review quarterly business reviews (QBRs), scorecards, and performance insights; challenge and endorse improvement actions
  • Ensure successful integration and maturity of APAC Ops team as part of the tiering model
  • Drive integration of knowledge management within the day to day operations


Stakeholder & Partnership Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders, including but not limited to Payroll, HR Advisory, Legal, and global People teams
  • Act as escalation point for high-risk issues and persistent performance challenges
  • Lead alignment conversations to ensure APAC needs are reflected in global process design


Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of People Operations Specialists and Senior Specialists
  • Conduct regular 1:1s focused on performance, engagement, and development
  • Own performance management processes, including bi-annual reviews and ongoing goal tracking
  • Allocate work and projects based on team capacity, strengths, and development goals
  • Foster a high-performance, service-oriented, and continuously improving team culture


Workforce & Capacity Management

  • Own APAC capacity planning and workforce forecasting across People Operations and Talent Coordination
  • Assess current and future workload trends to ensure appropriate resourcing levels
  • Make data-driven recommendations on internal FTE growth, reallocation, or role redesign
  • Evaluate and manage APAC contingent workforce strategy, including decisions to extend, convert, or roll off contingent workers
  • Balance service levels, budget constraints, and operational risk when making resourcing decisions
  • Partner with Finance and Global People leadership on headcount planning and budget alignment
  • Ensure optimal allocation of resources across peak periods and strategic initiatives


Compliance, Governance & Risk

  • Ensure regional compliance with APAC labor law and internal policies
  • Oversee implementation and operationalization of company policies and procedures
  • Maintain audit readiness and documentation standards
  • Partner with key stakeholders such as Legal, Payroll, Comp & Ben on regulatory changes impacting People Operations


Process Improvement & Transformation

  • Drive capacity management for APAC team and assess con
  • Proactively identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate processes
  • Lead or contribute to regional and global People Operations improvement initiatives
  • Use data and insights to drive operational decisions and resource planning
  • Support scaling of People Operations services in line with organizational growth


Qualifications & Skills:

  • 5+ years of people leadership experience in an international HR or People Operations environment
  • Strong experience in People Operations service delivery, payroll processes, and HR systems (Workday experience strongly preferred)
  • Demonstrated experience leading process improvement and operational excellence initiatives
  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and senior business relationships
  • Solid knowledge of APAC labor law and HR compliance requirements
  • Experience working with outsourced or centralized service models (e.g., Talent Coordination, shared services, or RPO-style environments) is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to manage performance through KPIs, SLAs, and service metrics
  • Strong coaching and people development skills
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, scaling organization
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-informed mindset
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Project and change management experience
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus


Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) at Booking.com:

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

job.job_description:
Job Summary

Choice Hotels International is seeking a Senior Manager, Social Media Strategy & Marketing to lead enterprise social strategy across platforms, creators, and content ecosystems. This role will help define how social media, influencer marketing, and organic content work together to tell meaningful stories about our brand(s) that drive relevance, engagement, and business impact. This person will guide the evolution of social media from a channel execution function into a fully integrated content and demand driver, ensuring alignment across brand, media, search, and emerging ecosystems. The Senior Manager will establish the strategic foundation for how social content contributes to both including integration with SEO and generative AI-driven search environments. This role partners closely with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and cross-functional teams to strengthen key messages, RTB’s, and positioning for the brand(s), evaluating creators and content capabilities to drive that forward. They need to have knowledge and awareness of cultural trends and determining ways to amplify them through authentic brand-led storytelling and drive innovation across platforms.

Note: This role is 4 days onsite in North Bethesda, MD and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Social Strategy Leadership

  • Develop the enterprise social media strategy, defining the role of each platform and how organic, creator, and paid social efforts work together
  • Translate business and marketing goals into integrated social and content strategies that drive measurable impact
  • Establish enterprise frameworks for messaging and success measurement
  • Assist in the development of long-term social strategy roadmaps, platform POVs, and capability evolution
  • Translate paid social objectives, audience strategies, and performance insights into social and creator content approaches, ensuring alignment between media investment and content development
  • Have a steadfast commitment to the KPI’s to grow engagement, build brands and drive demand.

Creator & Influencer Strategy

  • Lead enterprise creator and influencer strategy, including use cases, content frameworks, and governance models
  • Oversee creator sourcing, briefing, and content direction in partnership with agencies and internal stakeholders
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to brand, loyalty, and segment teams on how to leverage creator marketing
  • Evaluate and guide onboarding of influencer and creator platforms, vendors, and partnerships

Organic Content Strategy & Social Leadership

  • Set the strategic direction for organic social content across enterprise and brand channels
  • Define content testing and optimization frameworks to improve engagement and performance
  • Ensure integration between organic content, paid amplification, and broader campaign execution
  • Work cross-functionally with Brand, PR, and Loyalty teams to elevate social as a strategic marketing channel

Social Content Discoverability & GEO/AEO

  • Partner with SEO and content strategy teams to ensure social and creator content supports discoverability across search, generative AI, and emerging ecosystems
  • Collaborate with the Paid Media team on their social content within GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) strategies.
  • Work with the email marketing team to ensure a cohesive messaging and strategic lifecycle engagement between social media, email, and beyond
  • Establish best practices for structuring, tagging, and distributing content to improve indexing and visibility
  • Determine signals that improve content performance beyond engagement with Analytics and SEO teams
  • Partner on enterprise initiatives such as LLM visibility and content discoverability

Cross-Functional Leadership & Enterprise Impact

  • Own social media plans with Paid Media, SEO, Analytics, PR, to ensure integrated strategy and execution
  • Serve as a subject matter expert, providing POVs and recommendations on social and creator strategy
  • Assist in driving relationships with key social platform partners (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, Pinterest), including joint business planning (JBPs), identifying strategic opportunities, and ensuring platform partnerships inform both content and media strategy
  • Align social strategy with broader marketing priorities and business objectives
  • Drive visibility and understanding of social strategy across stakeholders

Agency & Partner Leadership

  • Act as the lead for social and creator agency partners, setting expectations and performance standards
  • Ensure agency partners operate as extensions of the internal team
  • Manage external partnerships across influencer platforms and content vendors

Innovation & Capability Evolution

  • Stay ahead of platform capabilities, cultural trends, and technology shifts and translate them into actionable strategies
  • Lead test-and-learn initiatives across social platforms, creator models, and content formats
  • Identify opportunities to scale new capabilities that enhance engagement and discoverability

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build and lead a high-performing social strategy team
  • Coach and develop team members to drive increased autonomy and enterprise thinking
  • Foster a culture of innovation, curiosity, and continuous learning

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 7-10 years of experience in social media, digital marketing, content strategy, or related fields
  • 3+ years of management experience with direct reports and cross-functional initiatives

Technical & Functional Expertise

  • Deep expertise across social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snap, YouTube, etc.) and awareness of emerging platforms and social media trends
  • Strong understanding of creator and influencer marketing models
  • Experience integrating social strategy with paid and organic social media, brand marketing, and SEO
  • Familiarity with content discoverability and AI-driven content ecosystems preferred
  • Understanding of performance metrics and testing frameworks

Leadership & Business Competencies

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with enterprise impact
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong collaboration, ability to influence

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $123,663.00 - 145,486.00. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
Overview

Du hast Lust während deines Studiums viele praktische Erfahrung zu sammeln, wichtige Kompetenzen zu erlernen und nützliche Kontakte zu knüpfen, die deiner Karriere weiterhelfen? Dann bist du bei Enterprise genau richtig!

Als weltgrößter Mobilitätsdienstleister triffst du bei Enterprise auf ein wachsendes internationales Unternehmen mit spannenden Herausforderungen und ungeahnten Aufstiegschancen. Stell dir über 1,7 Millionen Fahrzeuge an 9.500 globalen Standorten mit 80.000 Mitarbeitenden vor, die einen Jahresumsatz von 22,5 Milliarden US-Dollar einfahren. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns!

Responsibilities

Dein Praktikum wirst du in einer unserer 200 deutschlandweit Teams absolvieren und so unser Unternehmen von der Pike auf kennenlernen. Kaffeekochen und Kopieren steht für unsere Praktikanten nicht auf dem Programm: Vom ersten Arbeitstag an wirst du ins Tagesgeschäft mit einbezogen und erlernst so neue Kenntnisse wie Führungsqualitäten, Flexibilität und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten "on the job". Dabei erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und spannende Herausforderungen im Kundenservice, im Vertrieb, im Marketing oder im Business-Management. So zum Beispiel:

  • Verkaufsgespräche zu führen
  • Geschäftspartnerschaften aufzubauen und zu pflegen
  • Effektiv mit Kunden, Lieferanten und Kollegen zu kommunizieren und zu interagieren
  • Kostenkontrolle
  • Strategien zur Konfliktlösung
  • Flottenplanung

Bei Enterprise ist kein Tag wie der andere!

Und das Beste: Wenn du dich nach deinem Hochschulabschluss entscheidest, an unserem Management Trainee Programm teilzunehmen, dann werden dir die bereits im Praktikum erworbenen Kenntnisse angerechnet. Das verkürzt deine Zeit als Trainee und einer steilen Karriere bei Enterprise steht nichts mehr im Wege. Selbst wenn du dich nach dem Studium entscheidest, woanders zu arbeiten, so hast du doch durch dein Praktikum bei uns eine erstklassige Berufserfahrung vorzuweisen, die nicht nur auf deinem Lebenslauf gut aussieht, sondern dir in Jobinterviews und in deiner weiteren Karriere helfen wird. Ein Praktikum im Management bei Enterprise lohnt sich also wirklich! Und das auch im wörtlichen Sinne, denn alle unsere Praktika werden vergütet.

Qualifications

Unsere Praktika sind um dich herum konzipiert. Es spielt für uns keine Rolle, in welchem Semester du bist, welchen Studiengang du studierst oder wann du bei uns anfangen willst. Wie lange willst du dein Praktikum bei uns absolvieren? Das hängt ganz von dir ab. Du hast die Wahl zwischen mehrmonatigen Sommerpraktika bis hin zu ganzjährigen Praktika, die du jederzeit beginnen kannst. Und bei der großen Auswahl an unseren Filialen in Deutschland haben wir mit Sicherheit auch einen freien Praktikumsplatz an deinem Wunschort.

Wir freuen uns, wenn du motiviert bist, Eigeninitiative zeigst und Verantwortung übernehmen willst. Alles andere bringen wir dir während deines Praktikums bei. Und es werden sich für dich viele interessante Möglichkeiten und Situationen ergeben, in denen du richtig loslegen und uns zeigen kannst, was in dir steckt – egal wie lange du bei uns bleibst.

Auch Solltest Du In Deinem Gepäck Haben

  • Eine unbegrenzte Arbeitserlaubnis in Deutschland.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein und 1 Jahr lang Fahrpraxis.
  • Höchstens 3 Punkt im Fahreignungsregister (FAER) in Flensburg und keine Vermerke in deiner Fahrerakte aus den letzten 5 Jahren aufgrund von Alkohol- oder Drogendelikten.
  • Solltest du aufgrund einer körperlichen Einschränkung nicht Auto fahren können, bewirb dich bitte trotzdem. Gemeinsam werden wir eine Lösung finden.

Bitte bewirb dich nur einmal, und zwar direkt auf die Stelle in der Region, in der du arbeiten möchtest. Bei deinem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiter kannst du aber gerne die möglichen Einsatzgebiete noch im Detail besprechen.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

GetYourGuide's Localization team plays a critical role in making travel experiences accessible and compelling for millions of travelers worldwide. We ensure that every piece of content resonates authentically with local markets while maintaining the highest quality standards. Our team combines deep linguistic expertise with cutting-edge technology to scale localization efficiently and effectively across GetYourGuide's global marketplace.

As our Senior Localization Specialist focused on Language Quality & AI, you will own our strategy for evaluating language quality, as well as testing and training AI models to help us achieve quality at scale.

This is a project-based role in which you will lead 1-3 major initiatives each quarter. Your work will directly support our global growth, requiring a blend of strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and data-driven rigor to deliver measurable improvements.

Your mission

  • Evaluate and train MT/AI models to continuously improve the output for different content types and make recommendations based on model effectiveness
  • Define strategies for optimizing MT/AI models and determine the right allocation of MT/AIPE and human translation/review to achieve quality goals
  • Design scalable quality measurement workflows, including integrations with TranslatedOS and automation
  • Measure and report on language quality across 36+ languages and multiple content types (product, marketing, inventory), and establish quality benchmarks
  • Analyze quality data (e.g. error patterns) and deliver insights into how quality levels impact users and business outcomes across different markets
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders (e.g., Engineering, Quality Account Managers) to align on MT architecture decisions

Your toolkit

  • 3+ years evaluating and optimizing MT and AI models across different content types and languages for a tech company with a large global reach
  • Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs for translation tasks
  • Strong technical knowledge of localization, including translation management systems, quality evaluation frameworks, automation tools, and managing translation memories, style guides, style guides, and glossaries
  • Proven ability to design and implement scalable systems using methods like MTQE, AI LQA, and human review to measure language quality
  • Strong analytical skills, using data and insights to make informed decisions
  • Comfortable with high autonomy in fast-paced, ambiguous settings, executing with a test-and-learn mindset
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills – you can translate quality insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders

Extras that give you an edge

  • Passionate about AI-first workflows and localization, and the potential to achieve human precision at AI scale
  • Familiarity with TranslatedOS or similar AI-powered platforms
  • Background in computational linguistics, language technology, or related technical fields
  • Prior experience working as a translator or linguist (you understand quality from the ground up)

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

job.job_description:
