job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Role Summary

Agoda is looking for a strategic, data-driven leader to steer our global marketing investments. In this role, you aren’t just spending a budget; you are managing a global P&L. You will bridge the gap between high-level financial targets and granular marketing execution, ensuring every dollar spent maximizes long-term profitability. You will define our global market strategy, own our Lifetime Value (LTV) frameworks, and lead a high-performing team to outpace the competition in a high-velocity travel market.

This position grants you a "seat at the table" for Agoda’s most critical commercial decisions. You will use machine learning and predictive analytics to solve the "game theory" of the online travel industry, where pricing and loyalty change by the hour.

What You Will Do

  • P&L Stewardship: Drive marketing investment strategies to meet Finance P&L targets, balancing short-term volume with long-term margin optimization.
  • Strategic Growth Strategy: Define and execute Agoda’s global growth roadmap, identifying market opportunities and responding to competitor moves in real-time.
  • Investment Orchestration: Coordinate marketing spend across all digital channels (Performance, Brand, Meta) to ensure a cohesive and efficient global footprint.
  • LTV & Unit Economics: Together with the data science team, own and refine our definition of Lifetime Value (LTV); use these insights to shift the business toward high-value customer acquisition.
  • Forecasting & Modeling: Lead business forecasting efforts to predict market shifts and proactively adjust investment levels.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the primary liaison between Marketing, Corporate Strategy, Product, Finance and Supply to align and execute cross-functional initiatives.
  • Team Development: Lead and mentor a team of analysts, fostering a culture of rigorous experimentation and "get-things-done" ownership.

Experience & Skills

  • Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business strategies. Expertise in SQL, Excel, or data visualization tools is expected.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong background in Revenue Management, Forecasting, Pricing, or Growth Equity. You understand how marketing levers impact the bottom line.
  • Strategic Mindset: Experience defining 1–3 year growth strategies in a global, fast-paced e-commerce or OTA environment.
  • Product Exposure: Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and technical product development—you can speak the language of engineers and data scientists.
  • Leadership: Experience hiring and coaching high-potential talent in a multicultural, high-pressure environment.

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Paid Social Manager defines and evolves how paid social media is leveraged across Choice Hotels. This is an individual contributor role within Paid Media Labs, serving as the organization’s hub for channel expertise, innovation, and thought leadership in paid social. This role is responsible for helping evolve how Choice approaches platforms/partners such as Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Snapchat and other social media partners, developing best practices, identifying partner innovation opportunities, and enabling teams to execute at a high level.

This position focuses on defining the “how” and “why” of paid social, ensuring teams are equipped with the right frameworks, partner strategies, and forward-looking POVs to drive both immediate performance and long-term capability building.

  • Note: This role is 4 days onsite in North Bethesda, MD and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future**

Key Responsibilities

Channel Expertise & Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the in-house SME for Paid Social across platforms (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, and emerging social channels).
  • Recommend and help evolve how Choice Hotels leverages Paid Social across brands, segments, and media programs to drive business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain forward-looking and backward-looking POVs on:
    • Audience targeting, segmentation, and prospecting vs. retargeting approaches
    • Platform capabilities, automation, privacy changes, and emerging industry trends
  • Collaborate with Creative team on Creative best practices for Paid Social (e.g., video, short-form, and AI-enabled creative)
  • Translate competitive intelligence, platform developments, and industry trends into actionable recommendations that inform channel strategy, planning, and investment decisions.
  • Build strong partnerships with social platforms and agency partners to identify innovation opportunities, benchmark performance, and stay ahead of emerging trends.
  • Serve as a key liaison with the agency Social Media COE to ensure alignment on best practices, testing priorities, and innovation opportunities.

Influence on Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with Paid Media Planning & Activation teams to guide and influence paid social strategies; provide input into annual channel strategy and quarterly media plans
  • Provide frameworks, best practices, and recommendations that support campaign approach and investment decisions.
  • Ensure campaigns reflect best-in-class paid social practices without direct ownership of execution
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or missed opportunities and recommend improvements

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development

  • Build and maintain relationships with key social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, and others).
  • Parter with key social platform partners on JPBs focused on:
    • Innovation roadmaps
    • Beta and early access opportunities
    • Partner accountability and value creation
    • Best-in-class capability adoption
  • Ensure platform partners contribute to long-term capability building and not just campaign delivery

Operational Excellence & Capability Building

  • Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and frameworks that improve the consistency, quality, and scalability of the team’s work over time
  • Share what’s working across platforms, bring fresh insights to the table, and collaborate to keep social strategy and content ahead of the curve

Testing, Innovation & Insights

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Strong understanding of:

Additional Skills & Competencies

job.job_description:
Senior Marketing & Culture Manager · £Competitive + Company Benefits · Full Time · Kings Cross


London sets the perfect stage for The Standard’s first European flagship and since opening in 2019, The Standard, London has firmly established itself as one of the capital’s most dynamic lifestyle hotels.


Set in King’s Cross within the hotel’s iconic brutalist building, The Standard brings its design-led, culture-driven, activation-heavy philosophy to the heart of the city. With 266 guestrooms ranging from snug Cosy Cores to terraced suites with outdoor bathtubs overlooking St Pancras Station. A constant programme of Happenings, from DJs and brunches to live music and cultural panels, the hotel has become both a neighbourhood fixture and an international destination.


Our Restaurants, Bars, and Rooftop terraces are legendary, and The Standard is known worldwide for nightlife and culturally relevant dining. Isla offers seasonal, produce-led menus on a serene garden terrace; Double Standard pairs American diner spirit with British pub classics; The Rooftop serves cocktails and hotdogs with panoramic London views; and Decimo brings bold Mexican Spanish cooking, mezcal, and skyline views via our iconic red-pill lift.


Together, these venues create a complex, high-volume, multi-outlet operation running from early morning through late night, welcoming hotel guests, London locals, and international visitors alike. In London, The Standard’s signature mix of playful, sophisticated, and unexpected hospitality continues to evolve, rooted firmly in the culture and energy of the city.


We are now looking for an experienced and Senior Marketing & Culture Manager who will embody our Anything but Standard ethos and lead the continued growth of our incredible brand.


Your role:


As our Senior Marketing and Culture Manager, you will support the Director of Marketing and Culture in the day to day running of the department, taking a leading role in the execution of all marketing, cultural and communications activity across both Rooms and Food and Beverage.


You will be responsible for translating strategy into action, ensuring that all campaigns, content, partnerships and activations are delivered to a high standard, on brand, and aligned with the commercial priorities of the hotel.


Working closely with the Director, Sales, Revenue and operational teams, you will take ownership of integrated marketing activity across the property, ensuring a cohesive approach across all touchpoints, from rooms to restaurants, bars and cultural programming. This is a hands on role requiring creativity, organisation and commercial awareness, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast paced environment.


What you'll be doing?

  • Leading the execution of integrated 360° marketing campaigns across Rooms, Restaurants, Bars and Happenings.
  • Bringing our programming calendar to life through compelling storytelling, creative briefs and seamless campaign delivery.
  • Managing our digital presence, content calendar, CRM communications, newsletters, paid media activity and agency relationships.
  • Building culturally relevant partnerships and collaborations while supporting influencer, VIP and media hosting.
  • Producing best-in-class content and marketing collateral through photoshoots, creative production and digital campaigns that stay true to The Standard brand.
  • Monitoring campaign performance, reporting on engagement and ROI, and identifying opportunities to continually improve our marketing activity.


This is not a ‘Standard’ Senior Marketing & Culture Manager role so you will need to have serious stamina and passion; thrive in a high volume, high energy environment and able to work equally well both independently and as part of a team.


Do you have what it takes to be our Senior Marketing & Culture Manager at The Standard, London?


While we take every detail of design and guest experience seriously, we do not take ourselves too seriously. ‘Standard People’ are at the heart of our brand; vivid, dynamic and engaging. We need a proactive self-starter and are ideally seeking an individual with a Marketing background in the Hospitality industry and other creative industries for at least 3-5 years at a managerial level.


All applicants must be eligible to live and work in the UK. Documented evidence of eligibility will be required from candidates prior to commencing employment.


If you think you have what it takes to be our Senior Marketing & Culture Manager at The Standard, London we’d love to hear from you!


Benefits Include

  • Meals on duty
  • Pension Scheme
  • Life Assurance
  • Employee Rates across all participating Hyatt and Standard properties
  • In-house Experience Programme
  • F&B Discounts ranging from 25-50%
  • Recruitment Referral Bonus up to £600 gross
  • Tuition Aid Scheme
  • Season Ticket Loan
  • Medical Assistance (including online GP and Physio)
  • Employee Assistance Programme with Well-being service

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Director of Finance, you’re not just overseeing all hotel financial operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Drive financial strategy: Oversee all financial operations, ensuring alignment with the hotel’s strategic goals to optimize profitability and efficiency
  • Oversee financial planning and analysis: Direct the preparation of annual plans, projections, and budgets, providing financial insights to support business decisions
  • Advise hotel leadership: Serve as the primary financial advisor to hotel management, ownership, and department heads, offering data-driven recommendations to enhance financial performance
  • Ensure financial compliance: Uphold adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and safeguard hotel assets through strong financial controls
  • Optimize financial reporting: Oversee systems and processes to drive accuracy, efficiency, and transparency in financial reporting.
  • Monitor and approve financial transactions: Oversee and authorize hotel sales, purchases, salaries, and expenses to maintain fiscal responsibility and operational efficiency
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Expedia Group Product Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our customer-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.

We connect Travelers to new experiences, through trusted relationships. We use the power of Expedia Group brands to empower strategic partners to nurture and grow the existing relationship with their audience. Strategic Partnerships and Affiliates breadth of solutions which include cashback, travel offers, loyalty exchange, co-branded sites, Affiliate APIs and EG’s Affiliate Program, bring a partners’ audience onto EG sites, thereby increasing EG’s traffic and exposure.

Introduction to the Layla AI Team

Layla is an AI-native travel-planning and booking company, now part of Expedia Group’s Product organization. Through a conversational travel assistant, Layla helps travelers move from inspiration to a complete, bookable itinerary — flights, hotels, activities, and the day-by-day detail — in minutes. As part of Expedia Group, the team combines Layla’s planning and personalization capabilities with Expedia Group’s global supply, first-party traveler insights, marketplace scale, and booking technology.

The team is small and senior by design and operates with startup pace: you own a surface, ship it, and see the impact on real travelers within weeks — with decisions driven by data and AI tooling used in practice every day.

As a Senior Mobile Engineer working in Flutter, you will help build Layla’s mobile trip-planning and booking experiences across iOS and Android.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain Layla’s cross-platform mobile experience in Flutter (Dart), delivering a single, high-quality codebase that performs reliably across iOS and Android.
  • Own end-to-end feature delivery for mobile — including low-level design, API integration, and data modeling — for conversational trip-planning and booking features that connect to Layla and Expedia Group services.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and backend engineering to turn the conversational travel experience into intuitive, accessible, and performant mobile flows, iterating quickly based on experimentation and real traveler feedback.
  • Drive mobile quality and reliability through automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, performance monitoring, and observability across both platforms.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled capabilities within the app — such as assistant-driven planning, personalization, and recommendations — applying AI/ML concepts to real-world mobile features responsibly.
  • Contribute to native interoperability where platform-specific capabilities are required, and help establish reusable patterns and engineering best practices for Flutter development at Layla.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Professional experience building and shipping production mobile applications with Flutter and Dart, including ownership of features from design through release and support.
  • Experience delivering to both iOS and Android from a shared codebase, including API integration, data modeling, and network/offline data handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and maintain testable, maintainable, and performant mobile codebases using modern frameworks, tooling, and libraries.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, with a focus on safely integrating these capabilities into mobile features.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency with Flutter/Dart, mobile UI/UX best practices, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and/or Android (Kotlin/Jetpack) interoperability via platform channels or native modules.
  • Proven track record leading technical design for complex mobile initiatives — including architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models that span multiple services or domains.
  • Experience building accessible (a11y) and inclusive mobile user interfaces.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML-enabled capabilities into mobile applications — such as intelligent assistant flows, personalization, recommendations, or content ranking — with attention to safety and responsible use.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (for example, Claude or similar) to improve developer productivity, code quality, and delivery speed.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive architectural improvements (modularization, design patterns, platform standardization) and to mentor other engineers.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team

In Product, ideas come alive. The world moves fast, and our culture is built on ownership, speed, and minimal bureaucracy. This is the environment that empowers you to make decisions, move quickly, and do what you believe is right. Our Product Managers move fast, learn from failure, and continuously iterate.

As a product-centric organization, we work cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch, bringing together engineering, design, data, and business teams. Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility across the organization, with direct impact on the company’s growth and strategy. We put travelers first and aim to create exceptional travel experiences through innovative product thinking.

The opportunity

This role is based in Bangkok/Tokyo based. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical, hands-on, and highly data-driven. They are responsible for building products end-to-end, using analysis, experimentation, and rapid iteration to create solutions that are tailored to traveler needs.

As our next Senior Product Manager, Localization (Japan Market), you will define product strategy and drive execution for experiences serving Japanese travelers. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, build impactful products, and deliver high-quality solutions for the Japan market.

You will work with dedicated engineering resources that you help prioritize and allocate. We expect you to be hands-on, spend meaningful time with your SCRUM teams, and bring strong product judgment, experimentation mindset, and execution rigor. This role offers the opportunity to shape localized experiences at scale and influence how Agoda serves one of its key markets. This is an Individual Contributor role.

In this role, you’ll get to

  • Develop a deep understanding of the online travel ecosystem, market dynamics, competitive landscape, and user needs in the Japan market
  • Define, build, launch, and optimize products and features through testing, experimentation, and rapid iteration
  • Drive localization initiatives that improve the experience for Japanese travelers across the product journey
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions
  • Translate market insights, customer needs, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps
  • Use data and quantitative analysis to identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and measure product performance
  • Collaborate across regions, product areas, and functions to solve complex problems and drive meaningful business impact

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
  • Proven ability to use analytics and quantitative methods to inform strategy, prioritization, and decision-making
  • Strong data skills, with the ability to independently analyze performance and generate actionable insights
  • Excellent communication skills in either Japanese with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
  • Proven experience in Japan market localization, with a deep understanding of Japanese consumers, market dynamics, and local product requirements
  • Experience developing, launching, and optimizing products in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience leading product strategy, go-to-market thinking, and cross-functional product development discussions
  • Strong entrepreneurial mindset and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complexity and drive change
  • Hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and execution

It’s great if you have

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
  • Experience with data tools such as SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

job.job_description:
If you’re looking for the next stamp in your career passport, we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Brisbane Bayside who are keen to dazzle, discover, and delight our customers at the following Flight Centre stores:

  • Victoria Point
  • Capalaba
  • Wynnum Plaza

Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined, both personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • A genuine passion for travel and desire to help open up the world to our customers!
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and Flichella    

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition. Explore us on LinkedIn or check out our careers page at www.fctgcareers.com

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Summary

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.


Your Role

As a Brand Health Accountability Consultant , you will support the global execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs, with a particular focus on the EAME region. Your work will span key initiatives including the Focused Improvement Program, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program, Quality Assurance and Renovation policies.

In this role, you will collaborate across Owner Relations, Operations, Brands, Learning & Development, Communications, Finance and Legal to support consistent, effective and defensible execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs. You will also contribute to the strategic direction of Hyatt’s Accountability infrastructure, helping identify opportunities to evolve policies, strengthen interventions and ensure programs can scale effectively across Hyatt’s growing portfolio.

Contract: This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.


Location: This position is based in either Germany, Spain or the UK. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in the European Union or in the UK.


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the day-to-day administration and execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs by monitoring performance, managing communications, tracking progress and identifying opportunities to strengthen program effectiveness, compliance and reward structures.
  • Develop and deliver clear, impactful communications for a variety of audiences, including hotel operators, owners, cross-functional partners and senior leadership. Create presentations, training materials, workshops and executive updates that translate complex information, data and processes into actionable insights.
  • Support the EAME region by coordinating accountability-related training initiatives, serving as a key resource for program inquiries and supporting the Accountability mailbox to help ensure timely responses and issue resolution.
  • Partner directly with owners, operators and Hyatt leaders, both virtually and in person, to support participation in the Brand Protection Program. Communicate expectations, provide guidance, monitor progress and help drive successful program outcomes, including hotels’ successful exit from the program.
  • Support the growth and integration of Hyatt’s emerging franchise portfolio within EAME, serving as a primary resource for Portfolio Health programs and initiatives. Help drive adoption of the Owner/Operator Survey, Recognition, Quality Assurance, Focused Improvement Policy, HySat Goal Setting and Scorecard tracking, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program and Renovation Policies.
  • Partner with EAME Finance, Legal and Communications teams to evaluate the expansion, integration and communication of Accountability programs and related initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, deadlines and stakeholder needs while maintaining speed, accuracy and strong attention to detail. Coordinate effectively across teams to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner by identifying trends, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. Develop recommendations that support business goals, operational performance and the long-term success of Hyatt’s Accountability programs.
  • Represent Global Brand Health Accountability in meetings, presentations and cross-functional initiatives, serving as a trusted resource and subject matter expert.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt’s core values and take on additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve .


Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive global hospitality experience, with a strong understanding of hotel operations and the complexities of working across markets and regions.
  • Significant experience working within franchise operations and partnering effectively with owners, operators and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated project and/or vendor management experience, with the ability to manage complex initiatives, competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing global operational processes, including governance, established rules and processes, performance measures, documentation, rewards and consequences.
  • Previous people leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred; fluency in German is a plus.
  • Experience working across multiple operating regions—such as the U.S., Latin America, Western or Eastern Europe, the Middle East or Asia Pacific—is an advantage.


How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Annual allotment of complimentary stays at Hyatt hotels worldwide
  • Attractive colleague, friends & family hotel rates globally
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities through Hyatt’s myLearning platform
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your continued education and long-term career growth


We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Expedia Group Product Team

The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our customer-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.

We connect Travelers to new experiences, through trusted relationships. We use the power of Expedia Group brands to empower strategic partners to nurture and grow the existing relationship with their audience. Strategic Partnerships and Affiliates breadth of solutions which include cashback, travel offers, loyalty exchange, co-branded sites, Affiliate APIs and EG’s Affiliate Program, bring a partners’ audience onto EG sites, thereby increasing EG’s traffic and exposure.

Introduction to the Layla AI Team

Layla is an AI-native travel-planning and booking company, now part of Expedia Group’s Product organization. Through a conversational travel assistant, Layla helps travelers move from inspiration to a complete, bookable itinerary — flights, hotels, activities, and the day-by-day detail — in minutes. As part of Expedia Group, the team combines Layla’s planning and personalization capabilities with Expedia Group’s global supply, first-party traveler insights, marketplace scale, and booking technology.

The team is small and senior by design and operates with startup pace: you own a surface, ship it, and see the impact on real travelers within weeks — with decisions driven by data and AI tooling used in practice every day.

As a Senior Mobile Engineer working in Flutter, you will help build Layla’s mobile trip-planning and booking experiences across iOS and Android.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain Layla’s cross-platform mobile experience in Flutter (Dart), delivering a single, high-quality codebase that performs reliably across iOS and Android.
  • Own end-to-end feature delivery for mobile — including low-level design, API integration, and data modeling — for conversational trip-planning and booking features that connect to Layla and Expedia Group services.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and backend engineering to turn the conversational travel experience into intuitive, accessible, and performant mobile flows, iterating quickly based on experimentation and real traveler feedback.
  • Drive mobile quality and reliability through automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, performance monitoring, and observability across both platforms.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled capabilities within the app — such as assistant-driven planning, personalization, and recommendations — applying AI/ML concepts to real-world mobile features responsibly.
  • Contribute to native interoperability where platform-specific capabilities are required, and help establish reusable patterns and engineering best practices for Flutter development at Layla.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Professional experience building and shipping production mobile applications with Flutter and Dart, including ownership of features from design through release and support.
  • Experience delivering to both iOS and Android from a shared codebase, including API integration, data modeling, and network/offline data handling.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and maintain testable, maintainable, and performant mobile codebases using modern frameworks, tooling, and libraries.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, with a focus on safely integrating these capabilities into mobile features.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency with Flutter/Dart, mobile UI/UX best practices, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and/or Android (Kotlin/Jetpack) interoperability via platform channels or native modules.
  • Proven track record leading technical design for complex mobile initiatives — including architecture decisions, API contracts, and data models that span multiple services or domains.
  • Experience building accessible (a11y) and inclusive mobile user interfaces.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML-enabled capabilities into mobile applications — such as intelligent assistant flows, personalization, recommendations, or content ranking — with attention to safety and responsible use.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (for example, Claude or similar) to improve developer productivity, code quality, and delivery speed.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive architectural improvements (modularization, design patterns, platform standardization) and to mentor other engineers.

Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness & travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. View our full list of benefits.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

The B2B Pricing team sits within B2B Marketing and partners with Product, Commercial, Finance, and Data Science to define, test, and scale strategies that drive sustainable growth and profitability for Agoda and our partners. We combine deep analytical rigor with an experimentation mindset to optimize across marketing levers (primarily pricing) and advise on growth across B2B2C channels.

The Opportunity:

As Associate Manager/Manager, B2B Pricing & Commercial Strategy, you will own pricing strategy and execution while acting as a consultative, data‑driven advisor to B2B2C growth initiatives. You’ll translate commercial goals into testable pricing and marketing levers, design measurement, and lead cross‑functional rollouts that improve business outcomes. You will work closely with the commercial organization and cross‑functional stakeholders, serving as a go‑to partner for pricing and growth decisions for key partners (e.g., large loyalty programs, marketplaces, and digital wallets such as Rakuten or Paytm).

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Define and evolve pricing strategies, segmentation, and marketing action for partners.
  • Lead the experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate tests), including hypotheses, success metrics, and decision frameworks.
  • Build marketing roadmaps and analyses (elasticity, cannibalization, incrementality) to advise relevant marketing actions.
  • Act as a consultative growth advisor to partner teams: co‑create joint plans, model impact/P&L, align OKRs, and operationalize execution across channels.
  • Build playbooks to scale winning strategies across markets and partners; document learnings and institutionalize best practices.
  • Create Tableau dashboards and crisp executive narratives that synthesize performance, insights, and recommendations; drive action in weekly/monthly reviews.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners including strategic presentations.

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Summary

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.


Your Role

As a Brand Health Accountability Consultant , you will support the global execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs, with a particular focus on the EAME region. Your work will span key initiatives including the Focused Improvement Program, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program, Quality Assurance and Renovation policies.

In this role, you will collaborate across Owner Relations, Operations, Brands, Learning & Development, Communications, Finance and Legal to support consistent, effective and defensible execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs. You will also contribute to the strategic direction of Hyatt’s Accountability infrastructure, helping identify opportunities to evolve policies, strengthen interventions and ensure programs can scale effectively across Hyatt’s growing portfolio.

Contract: This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.


Location: This position is based in either Germany, Spain or the UK. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in the European Union or in the UK.


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the day-to-day administration and execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs by monitoring performance, managing communications, tracking progress and identifying opportunities to strengthen program effectiveness, compliance and reward structures.
  • Develop and deliver clear, impactful communications for a variety of audiences, including hotel operators, owners, cross-functional partners and senior leadership. Create presentations, training materials, workshops and executive updates that translate complex information, data and processes into actionable insights.
  • Support the EAME region by coordinating accountability-related training initiatives, serving as a key resource for program inquiries and supporting the Accountability mailbox to help ensure timely responses and issue resolution.
  • Partner directly with owners, operators and Hyatt leaders, both virtually and in person, to support participation in the Brand Protection Program. Communicate expectations, provide guidance, monitor progress and help drive successful program outcomes, including hotels’ successful exit from the program.
  • Support the growth and integration of Hyatt’s emerging franchise portfolio within EAME, serving as a primary resource for Portfolio Health programs and initiatives. Help drive adoption of the Owner/Operator Survey, Recognition, Quality Assurance, Focused Improvement Policy, HySat Goal Setting and Scorecard tracking, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program and Renovation Policies.
  • Partner with EAME Finance, Legal and Communications teams to evaluate the expansion, integration and communication of Accountability programs and related initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, deadlines and stakeholder needs while maintaining speed, accuracy and strong attention to detail. Coordinate effectively across teams to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner by identifying trends, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. Develop recommendations that support business goals, operational performance and the long-term success of Hyatt’s Accountability programs.
  • Represent Global Brand Health Accountability in meetings, presentations and cross-functional initiatives, serving as a trusted resource and subject matter expert.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt’s core values and take on additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve .


Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive global hospitality experience, with a strong understanding of hotel operations and the complexities of working across markets and regions.
  • Significant experience working within franchise operations and partnering effectively with owners, operators and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated project and/or vendor management experience, with the ability to manage complex initiatives, competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing global operational processes, including governance, established rules and processes, performance measures, documentation, rewards and consequences.
  • Previous people leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred; fluency in German is a plus.
  • Experience working across multiple operating regions—such as the U.S., Latin America, Western or Eastern Europe, the Middle East or Asia Pacific—is an advantage.


How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Annual allotment of complimentary stays at Hyatt hotels worldwide
  • Attractive colleague, friends & family hotel rates globally
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities through Hyatt’s myLearning platform
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your continued education and long-term career growth


We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

The B2B Pricing team sits within B2B Marketing and partners with Product, Commercial, Finance, and Data Science to define, test, and scale strategies that drive sustainable growth and profitability for Agoda and our partners. We combine deep analytical rigor with an experimentation mindset to optimize across marketing levers (primarily pricing) and advise on growth across B2B2C channels.

The Opportunity:

As Associate Manager/Manager, B2B Pricing & Growth Strategy, you will own pricing strategy and execution while acting as a consultative, data‑driven advisor to B2B2C growth initiatives. You’ll translate commercial goals into testable pricing and marketing levers, design measurement, and lead cross‑functional rollouts that improve business outcomes. You will work closely with the commercial organization and cross‑functional stakeholders, serving as a go‑to partner for pricing and growth decisions for key partners (e.g., large loyalty programs, marketplaces, and digital wallets such as Rakuten or Paytm).

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Define and evolve pricing strategies, segmentation, and marketing action for partners.
  • Lead the experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate tests), including hypotheses, success metrics, and decision frameworks.
  • Build marketing roadmaps and analyses (elasticity, cannibalization, incrementality) to advise relevant marketing actions.
  • Act as a consultative growth advisor to partner teams: co‑create joint plans, model impact/P&L, align OKRs, and operationalize execution across channels.
  • Build playbooks to scale winning strategies across markets and partners; document learnings and institutionalize best practices.
  • Create Tableau dashboards and crisp executive narratives that synthesize performance, insights, and recommendations; drive action in weekly/monthly reviews.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners including strategic presentations.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 5+ years in data-driven role, revenue/growth, marketing, strategy, or analytics roles in e‑commerce, travel, tech;
  • Consulting experience is a strong plus
  • Strong business acumen and structured problem‑solving; ability to frame trade‑offs, model scenarios, and influence decisions with clear “so‑what.”
  • Fluency with data: advanced Excel, SQL, and Tableau; comfort with large datasets and experiment readouts.
  • Practical experience with controlled experiments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication; able to simplify complex analyses for senior and partner audiences and drive alignment.
  • High ownership and bias for action; thrive in an ambiguous, fast‑paced, test‑and‑learn environment.
  • BA/BS in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent experience.

It’s great if you have:

  • Building decision frameworks in production.
  • Background in management consulting or internal strategy (e.g., growth, pricing, or partnerships).
  • MBA or advanced degree is a plus; we value equivalent operating experience and measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Python/R for modeling and scaling analysis.
  • Domain exposure to B2B channels, partner/affiliate programs, or wholesale/whitelabel constructs.

job.job_description:
Organization- Hotel Martinez

Summary

Inauguré en 1929, l’Hôtel Martinez, qui fait partie de The Unbound Collection by Hyatt, incarne la Riviera des Années Folles. Le style Art Déco caractérise ce lieu iconique de La Côte d’Azur à travers ses différents espaces de vie, recréant l’harmonie parfaite entre une nature généreuse et un art de vivre méditerranéen. Ses 410 chambres et suites sont un clin d’œil à l’univers du Yachting et ses Appartements Penthouse rendent hommage au 7ème Art. L’atmosphère conviviale, d’insouciance et de joie de vivre fait de l’Hôtel Martinez le rendez-vous incontournable de La Croisette et l’adresse des personnalités de tous horizons.

En symbiose avec les origines de l’Hôtel Martinez, « La Plage du Martinez » se réinvente avec une nouvelle carte et un nouveau décor face à la mer et à l’iconique ponton de l’hôtel. La cuisine met à l’honneur des références fortes à la Méditerranée et à la French Riviera, en s’appuyant sur une collaboration étroite avec des producteurs locaux et des produits de saison. La décoration, signée Rémi Tessier, s’inspire de l’esprit yachting en plongeant les convives dans l’ambiance du pont d’un bateau. En exclusivité, 150 « Director Chairs » ont été créées, chacune ornée d’une sélection de 150 réalisateurs et acteurs emblématiques, offrant un véritable clin d’œil au monde du cinéma et du yachting.

Le restaurant « La Palme d’Or » accueille les convives autour d’une expérience gastronomique unique, sublimant les saveurs de la Méditerranée. En complément, le restaurant « Le Sud » célèbre l’hédonisme méditerranéen avec une cuisine ouverte cultivant l’esprit yachting.

Ainsi, l’Hôtel Martinez continue de briller par son élégance et son héritage, combinant histoire, gastronomie et design, pour offrir à ses invités une expérience inoubliable au cœur de La Côte d’Azur.

« We care for people so they can be their best »

Notre raison d’être nous inspire à faire preuve de care, jour après jour, envers toutes les personnes avec qui nous sommes en contact. Alors que nous continuons à nous d é velopper à travers le monde, nous ne perdons pas de vue ce qui est le plus important à nos yeux : le bien- ê tre et l ’é panouissement de tous, clients, partenaires, coll è gues, fournisseurs et membres de la communaut é locale.

Les hôtels Hyatt en France sont fiers d’avoir obtenu la certification Great Place To Work™ 2026-2027, une reconnaissance fondée sur les témoignages et l’expérience vécue par nos collaborateurs. Venez découvrir un environnement où chacun peut grandir, s’épanouir et développer sa carrière au sein de Hyatt.

Qualifications

Département : Finance - Achats

Vous reportez au Directeur Financier

Votre périmètre :

  • Gestion de la politique achats de l’entreprise et des procédures Hyatt
  • Négociations fournisseurs
  • Gestion des contrats de l’hôtel
  • Supervision des investissements (Capex FF&E)
  • Participation à l’arrêt mensuel des résultats
  • Assistance systèmes de tous les utilisateurs de l’hôtel du logiciel Procurement

A compétences égales, nous recrutons des personnes en situations de handicap.

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Summary

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.


Your Role

As a Brand Health Accountability Consultant , you will support the global execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs, with a particular focus on the EAME region. Your work will span key initiatives including the Focused Improvement Program, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program, Quality Assurance and Renovation policies.

In this role, you will collaborate across Owner Relations, Operations, Brands, Learning & Development, Communications, Finance and Legal to support consistent, effective and defensible execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs. You will also contribute to the strategic direction of Hyatt’s Accountability infrastructure, helping identify opportunities to evolve policies, strengthen interventions and ensure programs can scale effectively across Hyatt’s growing portfolio.

Contract: This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.


Location: This position is based in either Germany, Spain or the UK. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in the European Union or in the UK.


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the day-to-day administration and execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs by monitoring performance, managing communications, tracking progress and identifying opportunities to strengthen program effectiveness, compliance and reward structures.
  • Develop and deliver clear, impactful communications for a variety of audiences, including hotel operators, owners, cross-functional partners and senior leadership. Create presentations, training materials, workshops and executive updates that translate complex information, data and processes into actionable insights.
  • Support the EAME region by coordinating accountability-related training initiatives, serving as a key resource for program inquiries and supporting the Accountability mailbox to help ensure timely responses and issue resolution.
  • Partner directly with owners, operators and Hyatt leaders, both virtually and in person, to support participation in the Brand Protection Program. Communicate expectations, provide guidance, monitor progress and help drive successful program outcomes, including hotels’ successful exit from the program.
  • Support the growth and integration of Hyatt’s emerging franchise portfolio within EAME, serving as a primary resource for Portfolio Health programs and initiatives. Help drive adoption of the Owner/Operator Survey, Recognition, Quality Assurance, Focused Improvement Policy, HySat Goal Setting and Scorecard tracking, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program and Renovation Policies.
  • Partner with EAME Finance, Legal and Communications teams to evaluate the expansion, integration and communication of Accountability programs and related initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, deadlines and stakeholder needs while maintaining speed, accuracy and strong attention to detail. Coordinate effectively across teams to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner by identifying trends, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. Develop recommendations that support business goals, operational performance and the long-term success of Hyatt’s Accountability programs.
  • Represent Global Brand Health Accountability in meetings, presentations and cross-functional initiatives, serving as a trusted resource and subject matter expert.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt’s core values and take on additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve .


Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive global hospitality experience, with a strong understanding of hotel operations and the complexities of working across markets and regions.
  • Significant experience working within franchise operations and partnering effectively with owners, operators and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated project and/or vendor management experience, with the ability to manage complex initiatives, competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing global operational processes, including governance, established rules and processes, performance measures, documentation, rewards and consequences.
  • Previous people leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred; fluency in German is a plus.
  • Experience working across multiple operating regions—such as the U.S., Latin America, Western or Eastern Europe, the Middle East or Asia Pacific—is an advantage.


How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Annual allotment of complimentary stays at Hyatt hotels worldwide
  • Attractive colleague, friends & family hotel rates globally
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities through Hyatt’s myLearning platform
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your continued education and long-term career growth


We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

The B2B Pricing team sits within B2B Marketing and partners with Product, Commercial, Finance, and Data Science to define, test, and scale strategies that drive sustainable growth and profitability for Agoda and our partners. We combine deep analytical rigor with an experimentation mindset to optimize across marketing levers (primarily pricing) and advise on growth across B2B2C channels.

The Opportunity:

As Associate Manager/Manager, B2B Pricing & Commercial Strategy, you will own pricing strategy and execution while acting as a consultative, data‑driven advisor to B2B2C growth initiatives. You’ll translate commercial goals into testable pricing and marketing levers, design measurement, and lead cross‑functional rollouts that improve business outcomes. You will work closely with the commercial organization and cross‑functional stakeholders, serving as a go‑to partner for pricing and growth decisions for key partners (e.g., large loyalty programs, marketplaces, and digital wallets such as Rakuten or Paytm).

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Define and evolve pricing strategies, segmentation, and marketing action for partners.
  • Lead the experimentation roadmap (A/B and multivariate tests), including hypotheses, success metrics, and decision frameworks.
  • Build marketing roadmaps and analyses (elasticity, cannibalization, incrementality) to advise relevant marketing actions.
  • Act as a consultative growth advisor to partner teams: co‑create joint plans, model impact/P&L, align OKRs, and operationalize execution across channels.
  • Build playbooks to scale winning strategies across markets and partners; document learnings and institutionalize best practices.
  • Create Tableau dashboards and crisp executive narratives that synthesize performance, insights, and recommendations; drive action in weekly/monthly reviews.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners including strategic presentations.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 5+ years in data-driven role, revenue/growth, marketing, strategy, or analytics roles in e‑commerce, travel, tech;
  • Strong business acumen and structured problem‑solving; ability to frame trade‑offs, model scenarios, and influence decisions with clear “so‑what.”
  • Fluency with data: advanced Excel, SQL, and Tableau; comfort with large datasets and experiment readouts.
  • Practical experience with controlled experiments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication; able to simplify complex analyses for senior and partner audiences and drive alignment.
  • High ownership and bias for action; thrive in an ambiguous, fast‑paced, test‑and‑learn environment.
  • BA/BS in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent experience.

It’s great if you have:

  • Building decision frameworks in production.
  • Background in management consulting or internal strategy (e.g., growth, pricing, or partnerships).
  • MBA or advanced degree is a plus; we value equivalent operating experience and measurable outcomes.
  • Familiarity with Python/R for modeling and scaling analysis.
  • Domain exposure to B2B channels, partner/affiliate programs, or wholesale/whitelabel constructs.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team

The B2B Digital Marketing team sits within Agoda’s B2B Marketing organization and is responsible for delivering high‑quality, scalable marketing campaigns for our partners across B2B2C channels. We work closely with Commercial, Product, Data, and regional Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are efficiently executed, performance is clearly measured, and partners receive actionable, data‑driven recommendations that drive value for both Agoda and our partners.

Our mission is to balance operational excellence with growth impact — building repeatable, scalable frameworks that allow us to support dozens of partners at once, while still delivering insights tailored to each partner’s performance and business context.

The role

As Manager, B2B Digital Marketing, you will own the end‑to‑end marketing delivery for partner campaigns, manage a small team, and play a critical role in shaping how we operate and scale partner marketing. This role sits at the intersection of people management, analytics, process optimization, and value creation. You’ll ensure campaigns run smoothly and efficiently, while also continuously improving performance through insight‑driven recommendations, standardized frameworks, and better tools.

What you will be doing

Campaign Delivery & Partner Marketing

  • Own the delivery of B2B partner marketing campaigns across channels, ensuring timely execution, high quality, and consistent standards.
  • Oversee campaign planning, setup, monitoring, and post‑campaign analysis.
  • Ensure partners receive clear insights on performance and actionable recommendations to improve outcomes.

Process Management & Optimization

  • Design, improve, and document end‑to‑end marketing delivery processes to increase efficiency, reliability, and output quality.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement through tooling, automation, and clearer workflows.
  • Establish SLAs, quality checks, and governance to ensure campaigns run smoothly at scale.

Analytics, Insights & Value Creation

  • Analyze campaign performance to understand what works, what doesn’t, and why.
  • Identify drivers of success across partners and campaign types (e.g., formats, targeting, budget allocation, creatives).
  • Translate insights into practical recommendations that increase campaign effectiveness and average value per partner.
  • Use data to prioritize efforts and guide partners toward higher‑impact marketing actions.

Scalable Frameworks & Tooling

  • Build standardized frameworks, playbooks, and tools that allow the team to manage and improve tens of partners simultaneously.
  • Balance standardization with flexibility by enabling customizable recommendations based on partner performance data and business context.
  • Partner with Data, Product, and Marketing Ops to scale solutions through dashboards, templates, and self‑serve tools where possible.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage, coach, and develop 2 direct reports; set clear goals, structures, and feedback loops.
  • Communicate confidently with internal stakeholders and external partners, simplifying complex data into clear narratives and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for B2B marketing delivery and performance discussions.

What you’ll need to succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in data‑driven marketing, operations, analytics, consulting, or growth roles, ideally in tech, e‑commerce, travel, or B2B environments.
  • Consulting experience is a strong plus
  • Strong SQL skills (must‑have) with the ability to independently analyze large datasets and draw clear conclusions.
  • Proven experience improving processes, frameworks, or operating models in a complex or scaling environment.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data to business impact and practical recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence, educate, and align both internal teams and partners.
  • People management experience or clear readiness to manage and develop others.
  • Bachelor’s degree

It’s great if you have

  • Background in management consulting, internal strategy, or operations excellence roles.
  • Experience building standardized playbooks or scalable partner programs.
  • Familiarity with marketing performance metrics and experimentation concepts.
  • Experience working with dashboards (e.g., Tableau or similar BI tools).
  • Exposure to B2B, affiliate, partner marketing, or marketplace models.

The Opportunity:

As Associate Manager/Manager, B2B Pricing & Commercial Strategy, you will own pricing strategy and execution while acting as a consultative, data‑driven advisor to B2B2C growth initiatives. You’ll translate commercial goals into testable pricing and marketing levers, design measurement, and lead cross‑functional rollouts that improve business outcomes. You will work closely with the commercial organization and cross‑functional stakeholders, serving as a go‑to partner for pricing and growth decisions for key partners (e.g., large loyalty programs, marketplaces, and digital wallets such as Rakuten or Paytm).

  • Build playbooks to scale winning strategies across markets and partners; document learnings and institutionalize best practices.
  • Create Tableau dashboards and crisp executive narratives that synthesize performance, insights, and recommendations; drive action in weekly/monthly reviews.
  • Vendor/Partner Management: Manage relationships with external partners including strategic presentations.

  • 5+ years in data-driven role, revenue/growth, marketing, strategy, or analytics roles in e‑commerce, travel, tech;
  • Strong business acumen and structured problem‑solving; ability to frame trade‑offs, model scenarios, and influence decisions with clear “so‑what.”
  • Fluency with data: advanced Excel, SQL, and Tableau; comfort with large datasets and experiment readouts.
  • Practical experience with controlled experiments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication; able to simplify complex analyses for senior and partner audiences and drive alignment.
  • High ownership and bias for action; thrive in an ambiguous, fast‑paced, test‑and‑learn environment.
  • BA/BS in a quantitative field (e.g., Economics, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent experience.

  • Building decision frameworks in production.

  • Familiarity with Python/R for modeling and scaling analysis.
  • Domain exposure to B2B channels, partner/affiliate programs, or wholesale/whitelabel constructs.
