  • Design and support measurement programs including incrementality testing, geo holdouts, brand lift studies, media mix modeling (MMM), and other experimental approaches.
  • Collaborate across teams to implement measurement plans, monitor progress, and ensure findings are translated into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Translate complex analyses into compelling narratives that connect marketing performance to business outcomes and inform future investment decisions.
  • Partner with external analytics agencies and measurement vendors to define data requirements, ensure successful delivery of data inputs, and support the execution of measurement studies.
  • Own the day-to-day management and analysis of KAYAK's global brand tracking program, including vendor coordination, study implementation, and insight generation.
  • Monitor key marketing and business performance indicators, identifying trends, opportunities, and risks across markets.
  • Conduct analyses to support strategic decision-making, annual planning, performance diagnosis, audience understanding, and investment optimization.
  • Contribute to the evolution of KAYAK's measurement framework by identifying new methodologies, tools, and opportunities to improve how we understand marketing effectiveness.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 4–6 years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, paid media, strategy, or a related analytical function — ideally within a consumer technology, travel, or digital-first environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are also considered.
  • Experience evaluating and optimizing marketing performance across digital and/or offline media channels.
  • Familiarity with marketing measurement approaches such as incrementality testing, attribution, brand lift studies, or media mix modeling.

  • Proficiency in Excel and SQL for data analysis; experience with Python is a plus.
  • Familiarity with marketing and analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adjust, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, or similar tools.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Google Data Studio.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Clear, confident communication skills — you can explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A curious, collaborative mindset and a genuine interest in continuously improving how marketing effectiveness is measured and understood.
  • Experience working with external agencies, research vendors, or measurement partners is a plus.

Benefits And Perks

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Employee Resource Groups

Job Description

SIA has multiple positions for generative AI/deep learning experts to drive our AI and data science initiatives.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Member of the in-house AI Center-of-Excellence team that works on challenging problems in advanced AI (including areas on generative multimodal AI, autonomous agent, NLP, computer vision, recommender system), mathematical optimization, game theory, and experimental design.
  • Research and develop advanced machine learning algorithms to meet complex product requirements. The scope includes defining hypotheses, executing necessary tests and experiments; evaluating, tuning and optimizing algorithms and methods; and having an eye towards cloud implementation ease, scalability, and robustness in a live customer facing production environment.
  • Provide technical direction and guidance to a small and highly skilled team of junior and senior data scientists embedded in Kanban data squads. These squads deliver products/services in generative AI, data science and data analytics to stakeholders in a large number of business units. Serve as a go-to technical expert in your area of AI expertise.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to create impactful and intelligent features/products. Collaborate with other team members including data scientists, data engineers and data strategists. Strategic ownership of all critical end-to-end AI processes.
  • Administer/maintain performant cloud and on-premises GPU compute resources that train large ML models and provide inference API microservices in production.

Requirements

  • PhD degree related to computer science, machine learning or other AI disciplines is required (consideration will be given to exceptional candidates without advanced degrees).
  • Demonstrated intellectual firepower as a rapid problem-solver and tech lead.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python. Strong technical skills in algorithm design/analysis, data structure and SQL. At least intermediate-level mastery of functional/object-oriented software development using modern programming languages such as Scala, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java or C# is a must.
  • Hands-on proficiency in the use of workflow/map-reduce and stream processing systems such as Spark and Kafka for big-data processing.
  • 3 or more years of relevant industry experience as a hands-on technical expert in shallow and deep machine learning, with additional specializations in most of the following areas:
    • Experience in the use of recent proprietary/open-source LLM APIs (such as OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude 2, Google PaLM 2, or Meta LLaMA 2); software development skills involving multi-agents and prompt engineering using LLM application/data frameworks (such as LlamaIndex and LangChain).
    • Highly conversant with GPU-accelerated deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch and TensorFlow).
    • Demonstrated ability in rapidly adapting, training and deploying state-of-the-art AI models or services in production based on the latest published research papers and open-source code.
    • Familiarity of Bayesian statistics/inference and Bayesian/causal networks for probabilistic reasoning.
  • Significant hands-on experience of AWS, Azure, GCP or other public cloud environment.
  • Excellent mentoring, interpersonal and communication skills for working with both technical staff and non-technical business users.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum/Kanban methodologies is a plus.
We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor is looking for a Content Manager for our Spanish market to develop outstanding, culturally-aligned experiences for a global audience. As a key representative of our users, you will ensure that our content fosters trust, resonates with local audiences, and increases conversion. You will be the bridge between global product vision and local cultural reality.

This is a high-impact role where you will directly contribute to our business growth by improving user engagement and brand perception in one of our most important markets. You will be part of the Localization team and you will work with product, marketing, analytics, research, engineering, and design teams to influence every aspect of content creation. Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in our London office.

What You'll Do

  • Craft, Adapt & Refine: Localize, write, edit, and transcreate clear, culturally-relevant, compelling content across all user-facing touchpoints. You’ll own the voice of your market, ensuring content is resonant, persuasive, and local-first.
  • Shape the Content Strategy: Partner with product managers, UX designers, SEO, vendors, and researchers to define and execute content strategies for high-priority product features, from initial concept to launch.
  • AI-native localization: manage LLM-driven workflows, help design prompts, and leverage machine translation to protect quality, maximize efficiency, and scale content volumes.
  • Think as a user: Act as the voice of the traveller. You’ll synthesize local user research and market trends to challenge global assumptions and advocate for local user needs.
  • Drive impact through testing: Initiate and support A/B tests on localized content to measure the impact on conversion, engagement, and traffic to inform content strategies.
  • Collaborate and Iterate: Work seamlessly with cross-functional teams to ensure content is integrated into the design and development process from the beginning. Provide regular feedback to your global colleagues and contribute to a unified content strategy.
  • Own and Maintain Quality: Ensure all content adheres to Tripadvisor Group’s brands voice and tone while feeling completely natural to local users. Partner with translation vendors to create, maintain and optimize all linguistic assets for your market.
  • Champion usability: Operate within a continuous QA mentality to keep the UX fresh and relevant. Proactively identify and fix content-related issues in our product, making data-driven, user-centric recommendations for improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • Native-level fluency and cultural authority: A deep, intuitive understanding of the language, culture, and user behaviour in your market.
  • 5+ years of experience: You worked in a localization, UX writing, transcreation, translation, content design, or related role within a global ecommerce or tech company. Experience in the travel industry is a significant plus.
  • Open-minded, innovative approach: You use AI as an enabler and you have a curious, forward-thinking mind. You are comfortable experimenting with technology to automate the repetitive so you can focus on the creative.
  • Excellent command of localization practices: You master foundational internationalization and localization principles. You have 3+ years experience of working with translation management systems and you have familiarity with linguistic quality assurance frameworks (MQM or similar).
  • A solid understanding of UX content methodologies: You are comfortable working with design tools (e.g., Figma, Miro), analyzing user research, and using data to inform your decisions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: You build strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional colleagues, using data and user insights to demonstrate how localized content strategy serves as a primary engine for global growth.

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Job Summary – (Role Summary)

The Field Marketing Services Task Force Manager provides flexible, interim support across the Field Marketing Services organization to ensure continuity, accelerate onboarding, and support key initiatives during periods of growth, transition, or change.

This role supports the development and execution of marketing plans, programs, promotions, processes, and communications across multiple functions, and leads assigned projects on a short- or long-term basis. The Task Force Manager operates as an agile, cross-functional resource, quickly adapting to business needs and delivering high-impact support where it is most critical.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities – (Key Activities)

  • INTERIM COVERAGE

Provide interim support across multiple functions within Field Marketing Services (AMER), stepping into active roles and workflows as needed. Supported functions may include:

  • Account Management Team Act as a direct point of contact for stakeholders and participating hotels. Drive client relationship management, strategic marketing planning, and project management of Field Marketing service deliverables for an assigned hotel portfolio.
  • Centralized Marketing Team Support execution of marketing deliverables for hotels on bundled Commercial Services programs. Partner closely with Commercial Strategists to deliver revenue, sales, and marketing initiatives aligned to program objectives.

SCALING SUPPORT

  • Support pre-opening and renovation marketing programs, ensuring readiness and alignment with brand and Field Marketing standards

CONTINUITY & TRANSITION MANAGEMENT

Education

Core Competencies

We are currently seeking a Portfolio Revenue Manager to cover a 12 Month Parental Leave and help ensure that our revenue department continues to succeed over the next year.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and experienced revenue manager ready to take their career to the next level: drive revenue growth across our iconic hotels and brands, optimize pricing strategies and channel performance, build best practices and work with sector-leading technology.

As Portfolio Revenue Manager, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing and Reservations teams, including Sales, Marketing and Reservations, to optimize our revenue performance across a portfolio of 2-3 properties and achieve our business goals.

You will formulate and execute revenue strategies, identify market trends, and collaborate closely with the executive team on forecast and pricing. You will be a contributor to our revenue management community of practice internally and externally, mentor junior team members and receive learning and development support as you grow your career.

You will;

  • Oversee revenue management strategies for multiple properties.
  • Ensure consistent pricing and revenue strategies across all hotels.
  • Conduct market analysis and performance benchmarking.
  • Lead the weekly/bi-weekly Revenue Management meetings providing insights based on reporting data.
  • Develop topline revenue forecasts and actively seek opportunities to drive incremental profit across all revenue centers of the business.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and optimize pricing and inventory.
  • Mentor, coach and develop junior team members in revenue management practices.
  • Collaborate with senior management, sales, finance, and front office teams to align strategies with business goals.
  • Ensure reservations are well managed and coordinate with the reservations team.
  • Drive market share in your competitive set and ensure all systems are adequately used to optimize RevPAR.
  • Leverage your knowledge of the distribution landscape, including online travel agencies and distribution networks to optimize hotel profits.
  • Responsible for data quality and system hygiene of Revenue Management and Distribution applications; platforms and tools used by the hotels.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in revenue management roles. Experience within a multi-property environment is preferable.
  • Proven ability to work independently while also thriving in collaborative team environments.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and ability to make strategic decisions that enhance revenue growth.
  • Proficient in revenue management principles.
  • IDeaS Revenue Management Platform experience highly desirable.
  • In-depth knowledge of the distribution landscape, online travel agencies, and emerging market trends.
  • A collaborative forward-thinking mindset with a passion for elevating revenue management as a respected and valued community of practice with key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Being a positive team player who communicates kindly and is willing to integrate withe the team.

Additional Information

Benefits/ What's in it for you?

  • Learning programs through our “Learn your Way” Academy platforms, ongoing training and development opportunities (self-pace, virtual webinars, face to face)
  • ALL Heartist, Employee benefit card, offering discounted accommodation, food and beverage at Accor properties worldwide.
  • Complimentary Duty Meal
  • Mental health and well-being support initiatives, including Access to our Employee Assistance Program.

If you are passionate about the hospitality industry, meet the above criteria, and are eager to contribute to an evolving hotel, we want to hear from you!

The Sydney Boulevard Hotel is an unbranded property Managed by Accor.

Only candidates who have work rights will be considered.

Must have a valid NSW RSA.

Must be willing to undergo a police check.

Job Title

Head of Industry and Government Affairs USA

External Job Title: Head of Industry and Government Affairs USA

Position type: Full-time, permanent

Location: United States – Washington DC

Job family: Industry and Government Affairs

About Your Business Area/Department

Amadeus IT Group is a Spanish-headquartered travel technology company, listed on the Spanish stock exchange and headquartered in Madrid. It provides the technology that connects the travel ecosystem — distribution and booking platforms for airlines, hotels, travel agencies and other travel providers, plus IT solutions such as passenger service, departure control and hospitality systems.

Operating globally across airlines, airports, hotels, rail and travel sellers, its technology supports a large share of the world's travel bookings and traveler journeys every year.

Amadeus' Industry and Government Affairs team anticipates, shapes and responds to the regulatory, policy and institutional developments that affect our business. Working hand in hand with Business Units, Legal, Corporate Strategy and Corporate Communications, the team represents Amadeus with governments, regulators, trade associations, diplomatic services and industry coalitions around the world. In the United States, one of our most strategically important markets, the team protects Amadeus' market access and competitive position, reduces regulatory uncertainty and turns institutional intelligence into commercial advantage.

Summary Of The Role

As Head of Industry and Government Affairs USA, you will define and execute Amadeus' US industry, regulatory and government affairs strategy. You will own senior external engagement with institutional decision makers, trade associations, Congressional and Senate stakeholders, diplomatic services and relevant US public bodies, and you will drive internal alignment on Amadeus' positions across Business Units, Legal, Corporate Strategy and Corporate Communications.

This is a senior, high-visibility role with genuine ownership. You will set the US advocacy roadmap, ensure there are no surprises on political and regulatory developments, convert intelligence into recommendations for executive decision makers, and strengthen Amadeus' reputation and influence across the US institutional ecosystem, while supporting concrete business development opportunities.

In This Role You’ll

  • Lead cross-functional working groups and transversal initiatives covering US regulatory priorities, strategic industry issues and business development opportunities.
  • Represent Amadeus externally in selected senior forums, conferences and institutional meetings to strengthen our visibility, credibility and influence.
  • Translate regulatory and institutional intelligence into business impact, from risk mitigation to opportunity identification in support of US growth objectives.

  • Sound judgement, discretion and maturity in handling sensitive political, regulatory and reputational issues.
  • Full professional proficiency in English. Spanish or other languages relevant to inter-national stakeholder engagement are a plus.

  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe.

Working at Amadeus, you will find

Diversity & Inclusion

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Manager, FP&A serves as a strategic finance business partner supporting Choice Hotels' commercial and marketing organizations. This role leads financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and long-range planning activities while providing actionable insights that drive revenue growth, operational efficiency, and informed decision-making. The position develops sophisticated financial models, evaluates investment opportunities, and translates business strategies into measurable financial outcomes. Success in this role requires exceptional analytical capabilities, financial acumen, relationship-building skills, and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization.

Note: This role is 4 days onsite in North Bethesda, MD and is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Serve as the strategic finance partner for assigned commercial and marketing functions.
  • Lead annual, quarterly, monthly, and long-range planning processes.
  • Manage SG&A, headcount, revenue, expense, and key metric forecasting activities.
  • Perform variance analyses, identify risks and opportunities, and communicate actionable recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain financial models and analytical tools to support business planning and performance management.
  • Partner across functions to identify opportunities to improve efficiency and optimize financial results.

Strategic Analysis & Decision Support

  • Provide financial and operational insights to support leadership decision-making.
  • Analyze business performance and identify trends, risks, growth opportunities, and revenue drivers.
  • Serve as the primary financial subject matter expert for supported business functions.
  • Partner with business leaders to translate strategic objectives into actionable long-range financial plans.
  • Evaluate investment opportunities through financial modeling, scenario analysis, and business case development.
  • Assess future growth strategies and funding requirements and recommend financially sound solutions.

Business Partnership & Influence

  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders by providing financial guidance and strategic recommendations.
  • Communicate performance results, financial trends, and key insights to stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships that facilitate collaboration and alignment to business objectives.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Present complex financial information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance, consulting, or a related field with increasing levels of responsibility.
  • Experience driving business performance through financial analysis, planning, and decision support.
  • Hospitality industry experience or familiarity with franchise business models preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with demonstrated expertise building and maintaining complex financial models.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial planning methodologies.
  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and/or Oracle Smart View is preferred.
  • Tableau and SQL experience preferred.
  • Strong financial modeling and data-driven decision-making capabilities.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional partners and senior leaders.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Demonstrates integrity, respect, and alignment with Choice Hotels' values.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
  • Relevant finance, accounting, analytics, or business certifications preferred.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $114,907 - $125,000. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just sit on the sidelines.

job.job_description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We are building a world-class Search Engine Marketing organization and are seeking a highly motivated and strategically-minded Senior SEM Specialist to join one of the most efficient SEM teams in Europe. Composed of SEM Account Managers, Analysts, Data Scientists, and Data Engineers, we are among the top Google and Microsoft Bing customers by spend in Europe.

This is a key strategic role within eDreams Odigeo that will help shape the future of the business. You will work alongside Country Managers, Product Managers, Pricing Analysts, Marketing Analysts, and many more, acting as a strategic PPC expert.

The SEM team members are passionate about data, automation, and innovation, thriving in a collaborative and agile environment. They are eager to learn, deep dive into complex challenges, share constructive feedback, and constantly challenge the status quo.

We are looking for a leader in execution who can take things to the next level. As part of an agile team, you will have the opportunity to drive forward long-term strategic initiatives autonomously, design and implement best-in-class campaigns, and contribute to our high level of automation and strategic direction.

Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform...

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior SEM Specialist, your role extends beyond execution to include strategic leadership, mentorship, and significant business impact:

  • Strategic Leadership & Planning: Build and drive long-term PPC strategies that contribute to sustained business growth, aligning PPC efforts with overarching business objectives and the broader marketing mix.
  • Performance Optimization & Risk Mitigation: Conduct complex data analysis to uncover strategic patterns, translate these findings into actionable strategies, and proactively identify potential risks within PPC initiatives, developing robust mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Cutting-Edge Execution & Standards: Plan, design, implement, and optimize highly effective SEM campaigns across all our brands & products, ensuring execution adheres to best-in-class industry standards and sets a high performance benchmark. Provide operational guidance and coordination within assigned scopes.
  • Business Acumen & Strategic Optimization: Steer spend and revenue of the SEM campaigns towards given targets by deciding on the right bid strategies, strategically optimizing PPC spend across diverse program scopes to maximize performance, volume, and ROI, considering company-wide KPIs.
  • Forecasting & Innovation: Contribute to forecasting and scenario planning, providing valuable insights to the leadership team. Champion a culture of experimentation and innovation, proactively exploring new platforms and methodologies to maintain our technical edge.
  • Stakeholder Management & Communication: Serve as the primary contact for key high-level stakeholders. Influence strategic decisions by effectively presenting complex, data-driven insights in high-level executive summaries to peers, managers, and external partners (e.g., Google, Microsoft).
  • Team Guidance & Expert Mentorship: Act as a recognized subject matter expert who elevates the team's capabilities by providing in-depth technical guidance, disseminating best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.
  • Agile & Collaborative Work: Take full ownership of chosen quarterly strategic initiatives, coordinating the working team to achieve the objective, and closely collaborating with other departments to align actions towards common company targets.


What can you expect:

  • Strategic Impact: Make a direct, high-level impact on Odigeo's success by steering and strategically shaping one of its biggest acquisition channels.
  • Scale and Autonomy: Work at scale across all Brands, Products & Markets with large, open budgets and a high level of autonomy as part of an agile, self-organizing team.
  • Mastery Focus: Become a Top Tier SEM Professional by working in one of the best SEM teams, fully committed to automation, innovation, and technical mastery. The role is designed for those who want to deepen their expert knowledge and drive leading-edge results.
  • Collaboration with Peers: Collaboration, Exchange and Discussion seeing eye to eye - Odigeo's SEM team consists of Senior experts (min 5+ years of experience) who are focused on challenging each other to achieve unrivaled excellence in the field.
  • An awesome multicultural team that values open communication, different opinions, learning, testing, continuous optimization, and having fun in and outside of work.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions! You will have the opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact on our business. Here is what we are looking for:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of demonstrable experience in SEM/PPC, ideally managing high 6-figure+ monthly budgets.
  • Strategic & Technical Expertise: Excellent, in-depth knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Bing, including advanced bid strategy design and implementation. G Ads certification is a plus.
  • Mandatory Quantitative Background: A degree in a highly quantitative field is required (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or similar quantitative Business fields).
  • Exceptional Data-Driven Leadership: Superior skill level in data analysis, interpretation, and complex data storytelling. You must be able to analyze big datasets, find non-obvious patterns, discover deep strategic insights, and articulate these findings clearly for executive decision-making.
  • Curiosity & Proactive Ownership: Naturally curious and highly proactive, with a relentless drive to dig beneath the surface, solve complex business challenges, and take full ownership of end-to-end outcomes.
  • Technical Data Proficiency: Advanced level in MS Excel is mandatory. Strong practical knowledge of web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics) and experience working with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) or advanced statistical software is highly beneficial.
  • Influence & Mentorship: Proven ability to constructively challenge the status quo, influence strategic decisions, and provide effective mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
  • Ownership & Acumen: Strong Sense of Ownership, taking the lead on end-to-end strategic initiatives with a can-do attitude. Demonstrable business acumen beyond core PPC metrics.
  • Language Skills: Fluent English is mandatory; additional European-based language is a plus.
  • Mindset: Experience working in an agile environment and/or in the travel sector is a plus. Always striving to grow & learn, embracing a 360° feedback culture.
  • AI & Automation Mindset: Experience in leveraging AI for strategic PPC campaign optimization, automation, and reporting is a strong plus.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Summary

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Your Role

As a Brand Health Accountability Consultant , you will support the global execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs, with a particular focus on the EAME region. Your work will span key initiatives including the Focused Improvement Program, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program, Quality Assurance and Renovation policies.

In this role, you will collaborate across Owner Relations, Operations, Brands, Learning & Development, Communications, Finance and Legal to support consistent, effective and defensible execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs. You will also contribute to the strategic direction of Hyatt’s Accountability infrastructure, helping identify opportunities to evolve policies, strengthen interventions and ensure programs can scale effectively across Hyatt’s growing portfolio.

Contract: This is a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Location: This position is based in either Germany, Spain or the UK. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in the European Union or in the UK.

Your Responsibilities

  • Support the day-to-day administration and execution of Hyatt’s Accountability programs by monitoring performance, managing communications, tracking progress and identifying opportunities to strengthen program effectiveness, compliance and reward structures.
  • Develop and deliver clear, impactful communications for a variety of audiences, including hotel operators, owners, cross-functional partners and senior leadership. Create presentations, training materials, workshops and executive updates that translate complex information, data and processes into actionable insights.
  • Support the EAME region by coordinating accountability-related training initiatives, serving as a key resource for program inquiries and supporting the Accountability mailbox to help ensure timely responses and issue resolution.
  • Partner directly with owners, operators and Hyatt leaders, both virtually and in person, to support participation in the Brand Protection Program. Communicate expectations, provide guidance, monitor progress and help drive successful program outcomes, including hotels’ successful exit from the program.
  • Support the growth and integration of Hyatt’s emerging franchise portfolio within EAME, serving as a primary resource for Portfolio Health programs and initiatives. Help drive adoption of the Owner/Operator Survey, Recognition, Quality Assurance, Focused Improvement Policy, HySat Goal Setting and Scorecard tracking, Brand Protection Program, Brand Compliance Program and Renovation Policies.
  • Partner with EAME Finance, Legal and Communications teams to evaluate the expansion, integration and communication of Accountability programs and related initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, deadlines and stakeholder needs while maintaining speed, accuracy and strong attention to detail. Coordinate effectively across teams to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner by identifying trends, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement. Develop recommendations that support business goals, operational performance and the long-term success of Hyatt’s Accountability programs.
  • Represent Global Brand Health Accountability in meetings, presentations and cross-functional initiatives, serving as a trusted resource and subject matter expert.
  • Demonstrate a commitment to Hyatt’s core values and take on additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve .

Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive global hospitality experience, with a strong understanding of hotel operations and the complexities of working across markets and regions.
  • Significant experience working within franchise operations and partnering effectively with owners, operators and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated project and/or vendor management experience, with the ability to manage complex initiatives, competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
  • Proven experience managing global operational processes, including governance, established rules and processes, performance measures, documentation, rewards and consequences.
  • Previous people leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
  • Fluency in Spanish is preferred; fluency in German is a plus.
  • Experience working across multiple operating regions—such as the U.S., Latin America, Western or Eastern Europe, the Middle East or Asia Pacific—is an advantage.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Annual allotment of complimentary stays at Hyatt hotels worldwide
  • Attractive colleague, friends & family hotel rates globally
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities through Hyatt’s myLearning platform
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your continued education and long-term career growth

We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, performance is product quality. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Performance to define and lead the strategy for improving user-perceived performance across our traveler facing experiences, while building the systems, operating model, and guardrails needed to prevent regressions before they reach travelers.


In this role, you will partner across engineering, architecture, product, UX, analytics, experimentation, and platform teams to make performance measurable, actionable, and durable. You will own the product vision and roadmap for performance across web and app, balancing near-term experience improvements with longer-term investments in instrumentation, diagnostics, release protections, and performance-by-default product development practices.


You will help Expedia Group deliver faster, more stable, and more resilient experiences for travelers by ensuring teams can understand performance, prioritize the right improvements, and prevent degradation at scale.


What you will do:


  • Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for performance across web and native app experiences.
  • Establish a clear performance product vision spanning page and screen load speed, interaction responsiveness, visual stability, reliability of measurement, and degradation prevention.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to identify and prioritize platform and product investments that improve performance at scale.
  • Own the performance measurement framework across web and app, including headline metrics, driver metrics, and guardrail metrics that help teams make better prioritization decisions.
  • Lead discovery across stakeholder groups to identify root causes of poor user experience, quantify business impact, and translate findings into roadmap priorities.
  • Drive adoption of performance standards, budgets, and release guardrails that reduce regressions and improve consistency across teams.
  • Shape the operating model for performance reviews, regression triage, escalation paths, and accountability for remediation.
  • Partner with experimentation and analytics teams to evaluate how product, content, and feature changes affect performance and traveler outcomes.
  • Collaborate with teams responsible for observability, monitoring, and developer tooling to improve visibility into performance bottlenecks and degradations.
  • Influence roadmaps across multiple product and platform teams without direct authority, aligning leaders on shared goals, sequencing, and trade-offs.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for performance strategy, progress, and outcomes with senior stakeholders across Product and Technology.


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of product management experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 6+ years with a Master's degree.
  • Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, success metrics, and measurable outcomes for platform products or highly technical product domains.
  • Experience owning products through discovery, prioritization, delivery, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
  • Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives across multiple product, engineering, and platform teams, influencing roadmaps and driving alignment without direct authority.
  • Strong technical product management experience, with the ability to partner closely with engineering teams on complex technical challenges.
  • Deep understanding of web and/or mobile application performance, including performance measurement, observability, monitoring, diagnostics, release protections, and performance regression prevention.
  • Experience using data, analytics, experimentation, and customer insights to evaluate impact and make informed product decisions and trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups in a global organization.


Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience in application performance, developer productivity, platform products, infrastructure, developer tools, or similarly technical domains.
  • Experience establishing performance standards, budgets, guardrails, governance models, escalation processes, and accountability mechanisms across multiple teams.
  • Experience building frameworks, playbooks, or operating models that drive quality, reliability, and performance improvements at scale.
  • Experience working on data-intensive products and translating complex technical metrics into actionable product insights.
  • Background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or prior hands-on software development experience.
  • Proven track record of taking products from concept through scaled adoption and measurable business impact.
  • Experience using experimentation and analytics to understand how product and feature changes affect customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven products, tools, or workflows, including experience identifying opportunities to apply AI/ML capabilities to solve customer or business problems.

job.job_description:
As Regulations Lead, you will act as the compliance & regulations specialist and provide leadership and coordination across Ground Operations regulatory compliance, manuals, and internal training activities. This role ensures that TUI Airline maintains an outstanding portfolio of compliant processes and procedures, aligned with EASA, IATA, IOSA, and other regulatory requirements. You will act as the primary point of contact for regulatory matters within Ground Operations, driving consistency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the team. You will manage and support the implementation of the new EASA & UK CAA Ground Handling Regulation, to ensure we are compliant with this new regulation both as an airline and ground handler.

We are happy to consider this role on a hybrid working model basis in line with local office attendance and/or business requirements (whichever is higher). Regular monthly travel should be expected between our Airline AOC office location and/or major airport bases.

Applications close 17 Sept 2026

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation

About The Job

  • Lead and develop a small team of subject matter experts responsible for regulations, manuals, and training, allocating priorities and resources to ensure timely delivery of compliance objectives whilst coaching and mentoring team members to build expertise and resilience
  • Act as the senior subject matter expert for Ground Ops and ground Handling regulations, providing strategic advice to management
  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess impact on Ground Operations processes, ensuring Ground Operations Manuals (GOM/GHM/IPM) remain compliant and up to date
  • Represent Ground Ops in regulatory forums and maintain strong relationships with authorities (EASA, IATA, NAA)
  • Represent Ground Ops in internal meetings and maintain a strong relationship with Ground Ops Nominated Persons and AOC compliance, safety and security departments
  • Manage Ground Ops oversight performance data. Analyse trends and escalate/present data to relevant responsible managers
  • Oversee internal & external audits and ensure closure of non-compliance findings driving standardisation and simplification of processes across all TUI Airlines
  • Maintain and improve the departmental quality system (DQS) and ensure adherence to internal procedures
  • Ensure Ground Operations Manual suite remains compliant and up to date with the latest regulation
  • Drive standardisation and simplification of processes across all TUI Airlines
  • Support with IOSA revalidation audits as and when required
  • Oversee Ground Ops training programmes and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal standards, supporting the development of engaging training content and maintain digital training libraries
  • Act as the interface between Ground Ops and Safety, Compliance & Security teams, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and continuous improvement

About You

  • Proven experience in Ground Operations with strong regulatory knowledge (EASA, IATA, IOSA)
  • Strong understanding of compliance frameworks and audit processes
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong business English (spoken and written); international travel will be required

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

SECURITY CLEARANCE STATEMENT

Safety and security are top priorities for us, so all job offers require successful completion of security checks before you can start. The specific requirements, timelines, and processes vary by country and may include professional references, criminal record checks for countries where you’ve recently lived, and any additional documentation required by local regulations, some of which may involve a cost depending on your location.

We’ll guide you through every step of the process. Your official start date will only be confirmed once all required checks have been completed and cleared, as employment can only begin after these requirements are satisfactorily met.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with large datasets, has a passion for financial systems, and combines strong accounting knowledge with analytical problem-solving. You’ll work cross-functionally with Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to improve processes, strengthen financial controls, and support scalable finance operations.

Location: Oxford UK

This role is a hybrid position that requires 1 day per week in our Oxford office.

What You'll Do

  • Support daily and month-end Order-to-Cash accounting processes across multiple products and payment platforms.
  • Perform high-volume data reconciliations across financial systems, investigating and resolving discrepancies to ensure financial accuracy and completeness.
  • Apply accounting principles to analyse transactional activity, prepare reconciliations, and support accurate financial reporting.
  • Partner with Finance Systems, Engineering, Product, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Customer Operations to resolve accounting and billing issues and improve business processes.
  • Support finance system enhancements, user acceptance testing (UAT), and implementation of new processes and system improvements.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, variance analysis, and other month-end close activities.
  • Document, maintain, and improve financial processes and internal controls.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing supporting documentation and responding to audit requests.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve the efficiency and scalability of finance operations.
  • Other general accounting projects and month-end close work as assigned

Skills & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations, financial systems, or a related role.
  • Experience working with ERP platforms such as Workday and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
  • Experience supporting B2C Order-to-Cash processes in a high-volume transaction environment.
  • Experience with SQL, BigQuery, Power Query, Alteryx, or other data analysis and automation tools.
  • Experience participating in finance systems implementations, process automation, or continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience supporting audits and maintaining strong financial controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting.
  • Experience supporting high-volume transactional finance or Order-to-Cash processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, complex formulas, and working with large datasets.
  • Strong systems aptitude and an interest in financial systems and process improvement.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

What We Are Looking For

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for financial systems, technology, and continuous process improvement.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify trends, investigate root causes, and recommend solutions.
  • A collaborative approach with the ability to build strong relationships across technical and non-technical teams.
  • A proactive mindset with a desire to improve processes through automation and data-driven decision making.
  • High levels of integrity, accountability, and ownership.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems, tools, and business processes.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Sobre nosotros

InterContinental Madrid forma parte de IHG Hotels & Resorts, una de las compañías hoteleras líderes a nivel mundial, con presencia internacional y un amplio portfolio de marcas reconocidas por su excelencia y calidad de servicio. Bajo la filosofía de IHG, trabajamos para crear experiencias inolvidables y fomentar una cultura donde las personas, la diversidad y el desarrollo profesional ocupan un lugar central.

Como Revenue Trainee, participarás, directamente junto al Revenue Director, en el análisis y desarrollo de estrategias orientadas a la optimización de los ingresos y la rentabilidad del hotel.

Durante las prácticas, tendrás la oportunidad de conocer de forma integral el funcionamiento del área de Revenue Management, participando en procesos de análisis de demanda, estrategia de precios, previsión de resultados, benchmarking de la competencia, planificación del negocio y elaboración de informes de rendimiento.

Asimismo, adquirirás una visión global del negocio hotelero y de la relación del Departamento de Revenue con otras áreas clave del hotel.

Serás una pieza clave para hacer realidad la visión comercial y de calidad de InterContinental Madrid.

¿Cuáles serán algunas de tus funciones?

  • Apoyo al Revenue Director en el desarrollo e implementación de la estrategia de Revenue Management del hotel.
  • Análisis del mercado hotelero de Madrid, con especial atención al posicionamiento y comportamiento de los hoteles de 5 estrellas y principales competidores.
  • Seguimiento y análisis del business mix, evolución de la demanda, ocupación, ADR, RevPAR y otros indicadores relevantes para la gestión de ingresos.
  • Apoyo en el análisis de la estrategia de precios, disponibilidad y posicionamiento competitivo del hotel.
  • Realización de estudios de benchmarking competitivo, analizando tarifas, tendencias de mercado y comportamiento de la competencia.
  • Participación y acompañamiento al Revenue Director en las reuniones de Yield Meeting y Revenue Room, colaborando en la preparación de la información necesaria para la toma de decisiones.
  • Formación y apoyo en la gestión de los diferentes canales de distribución y Channel Management.
  • Introducción al funcionamiento y utilización de los principales sistemas y herramientas de gestión hotelera y Revenue Management, entre ellos:
    • PMS / OPERA; Concerto ; GRS ; RMS ; IHG Groups & Events ; SBRP ;Passkey
  • Apoyo en la elaboración y seguimiento del Forecast semanal y mensual, analizando la evolución de reservas, ingresos y principales indicadores del hotel.
  • Participación en la preparación y seguimiento del Budget anual relacionado con el área de Revenue.
  • Elaboración de análisis, presentaciones y reportes de resultados para la Dirección y la propiedad del hotel mediante herramientas como Vision y Business Intelligence (BI).
  • Gestión y seguimiento de informes diarios, semanales y mensuales, incluyendo análisis de reservas, grupos y eventos On The Books (OTB).
  • Realización de Cross Training en diferentes departamentos del hotel con el objetivo de comprender su impacto sobre la estrategia de Revenue Management y adquirir una visión global del negocio.

Requisitos del puesto

  • Estudiante de Grado o Máster en Turismo, Dirección Hotelera, Administración y Dirección de Empresas, Revenue, Economía, Finanzas, Business Analytics o titulaciones similares.
  • Posibilidad de formalizar convenio de prácticas con universidad o centro de estudios.
  • Interés por desarrollar una carrera profesional en Revenue Management, estrategia hotelera, análisis de negocio o áreas comerciales.
  • Buen manejo de Microsoft Excel y herramientas ofimáticas.
  • Se valorarán conocimientos de Power BI, herramientas de Business Intelligence o análisis de datos.
  • Se valorará el conocimiento previo del sector hotelero y del mercado turístico de Madrid.
  • Nivel de inglés y español alto, tanto oral como escrito.
  • Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y facilidad para relacionarse con diferentes departamentos. Perfil analítico, organizado y orientado al detalle. Facilidad para trabajar con datos y capacidad para interpretar información y obtener conclusiones de negocio.

¿Qué puedes esperar de nosotros?

  • Beca mensual.
  • Programas de formación y acceso a IHG University
  • Acceso al Comedor de Empleados
  • Beneficios en negocios locales
  • Acceso a gimnasio de empleados

Nuestra misión en IHG es dar la bienvenida a todos y crear equipos inclusivos donde celebramos la diferencia y alentamos a los colegas a llevar todo su ser al trabajo. IHG Hotels & Resorts ofrece igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a los solicitantes y empleados sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional o discapacidad. Promovemos una cultura de confianza, apoyo y aceptación. Siempre dando la bienvenida a diferentes orígenes, experiencias y perspectivas.

Entonces, únete a nosotros y te convertirás en parte de nuestra familia global en constante crecimiento.
