Job Title

Sr. Digital Media Performance Strategist

Key Things To Consider Before Applying

  • Please note that relocation assistance is not available for this position. We encourage candidates who currently reside in the Maitland/Orlando, FL area, or who can relocate at their own expense, to apply.
  • Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employer sponsorship for employment authorization.
  • This is a hybrid position and requires working from onsite 50% of the time.

Summary Of The Role

Join our Digital Media team and help drive revenue growth and performance for leading hospitality brands across North America (NORAM).

As a Senior Digital Performance Strategist, you will serve as a trusted advisor to hotel and resort clients, leading the strategy, optimization, and performance of revenue-generating digital advertising campaigns. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on expertise in Google Ads and Paid Search, a proven track record of improving ROAS and business outcomes, and the ability to translate campaign performance into actionable recommendations for clients.

This is a highly consultative and performance-driven role focused on helping clients maximize Return on Advertising Spend (ROAS), increase bookings and revenue, optimize acquisition strategies, and achieve measurable business results. Success in this position requires a blend of Paid Search expertise, digital marketing strategy, performance analysis, client relationship management, and revenue-focused decision-making.

This is a hybrid position and requires working from onsite 50% of the time.

In This Role You'll

  • Manage and maintain a portfolio of hospitality clients across the North America (NORAM) region.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and strategic consultant to clients and key stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client business objectives, revenue goals, and performance KPIs.
  • Build, optimize, and manage digital advertising strategies with a strong emphasis on Google Ads and Paid Search.
  • Monitor and optimize campaign performance to improve ROAS, revenue, conversions, CPA, and acquisition efficiency.
  • Analyze campaign data and provide strategic recommendations based on business outcomes and performance trends.
  • Conduct recurring business reviews and performance discussions with clients.
  • Recommend budget allocation, pacing, forecasting, and optimization strategies to maximize advertising effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign implementation and ongoing optimization.
  • Ensure campaign tracking, measurement, and reporting frameworks are properly implemented.
  • Identify growth opportunities and develop strategies to improve overall account performance.
  • Stay current with industry trends, Google advertising products, platform updates, and hospitality marketing best practices.
  • Contribute to process improvements, training initiatives, and knowledge-sharing activities across the team.

Minimum Requirements

About the Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads, with a strong focus on Paid Search (Google Search Campaigns).
  • Experience working with revenue-generating campaigns where ROAS, CPA, conversions, bookings, or revenue were primary success metrics.
  • Experience managing enterprise-level advertising budgets with direct responsibility for campaign performance, budget allocation, pacing, and optimization decisions.
  • Experience managing and optimizing Facebook/Meta Ads campaigns, including audience targeting, campaign setup, budget management, performance analysis, and optimization.
  • Proven ability to analyze campaign performance and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience presenting performance results, optimization strategies, and business recommendations to clients or stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), and Paid Search best practices.
  • Strong consultative, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns, priorities, and client relationships in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Performance Max (PMax), Demand Gen, YouTube Ads, Display Campaigns, Search Ads 360 (SA360), or other Google advertising solutions.
  • Experience supporting hospitality, travel, tourism, hotel, or related industry clients.
  • Experience working in a client-facing digital agency, media agency, advertising agency, or performance marketing environment.

Working At Amadeus, You Will Find

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, equity, and benefits.

🌟 A flexible working model - We want our employees to do their best work, wherever and however it works best for them.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

What We Can Offer You

  • Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits.
  • Work a flexible hybrid schedule.
  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe

Application Process

The application process takes no longer than 10 minutes!

Create your candidate profile, upload your Resume/CV and apply today!

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

This position, reporting into the Display & Video Advertising Manager, will contribute with the rest of the team to deliver on our ambitious growth expectations. In this role you will work with the rest of the team in designing the strategy and executing, measuring and optimising both acquisition and re-engagement campaigns across several media providers, including, but not limited to, Meta, TikTok, Youtube, Pinterest, Spotify, Snapchat.

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Paid Social Specialist in the Online Display & Video Marketing team you will be in charge of:

  • Design and execute full funnel marketing campaigns – from awareness/branding to performance-based acquisition, retargeting and re-engagement – across different paid social providers and geographies for both Web and App platforms;
  • Own the campaign performance to ensure campaign targets are met (sales, cost per sale, ROAS, brand awareness, reach, etc) through continuous analysis and optimization;
  • Design the agenda for the assigned media and campaigns, across all the key enablers including campaign setup, measurement, creative, tracking;
  • Preparation of regular reports with clear, actionable insights;
  • Design and execute A/B testing for media buying, audiences, content/promotions and creatives;
  • Collaborate with providers (Meta, TikTok, etc.) in order to maximise the full potential of each platform/media (testing new features, digesting new data, etc);
  • Create new/improve current best practices and document processes for campaign launch and ongoing optimization;
  • Collaborate with the internal creative team as well as external creative agencies to ensure creatives do align to the requirements from publishers;
  • Help defining the budget and generate investment scenarios for the launch of new campaigns;


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • At least 4 years of experience in online marketing related roles focusing on Paid Social with proven hands-on track record of managing high-budget performance campaigns;
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience in managing one or more media buying platforms among Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc
  • Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to analyze data following new approaches to make optimization decisions;
  • Truly curious and passionate about online marketing. Willing to help create and nurture a best-in-class marketing organization. We are looking for people that really want to be the best at digital advertising and know each media inside out;
  • Strong understanding of display and video performance metrics, industry best practices, audience segmentation, cross and upselling strategies, creative performance insights;
  • Strong organizational skills, comfortable working in demanding environments. You will be surrounded by top industry talents.
  • Any prior experience in mobile app performance marketing (like AppsFlyer, Google App Campaigns, or Meta and TikTok App) is valued and considered a plus, but is not mandatory;
  • Self driven to achieve results;
  • Any level in English as long as you are able to tell a story from the data, communicate information around campaigns and have relevant conversation with the team and the stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program. Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padeltournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

The location for this position is virtual/remote (within Canada)

This is your chance to be part of our in-house Hilton Supply Management (HSM) team that supports our brands, owners, and operators! HSM has transformed how supply chain and procurement adds value to the hospitality industry, with 6 billion dollars of spend influence, over 2000 suppliers, and support of sustainability, supplier diversity, and responsible sourcing goals. As a Director, Account Management, you will support HSM's customers in the Canadian market, partnering with HSM's internal teams to help customers further leverage HSM programs and increase their savings. On the Account Management team reporting to the VP of Strategy & Business Operations, you will oversee a portfolio of accounts, responsible for relationship management, customer success, and year over year growth.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Serve as the primary contact for customer's leadership team, ensuring the client's day-to-day needs are met while identifying and executing on key growth opportunities.
  • Coordinate with the customer's procurement and operations teams to support strategic initiatives through partnership with suppliers and HSM's internal teams.
  • Be the first point of escalation within HSM for supplier related issues in your market.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • You will partner with the customer's leadership team to set long term strategic objectives and drive critical initiatives.
  • You will work with HSM Category Management to identify white space and expand programs and services in your market.
  • You will work with the HSM Onboarding team to add properties to the HSM program as new customers join HSM or existing customers expand.

Deliverables You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Promote program participation (i.e., utilization) through reporting, coaching emails, and business reviews for key ownership and management groups.
  • Be HSM's lead contributor to strategic business reviews with the customer and suppliers.
  • Increase program growth and adoption in your market by expanding HSM's programs in services in your market.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Eight (8) years of professional experience in hospitality and/or procurement/supply chain related roles
  • Experience analyzing information to make data-based business decisions
  • Experience delivering presentations to executive level stakeholders
  • Travel approximately 25%-50%

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Experience in Account Management/Customer Success roles
  • Experience leading teams/direct reports

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, we don’t just offer jobs—we provide careers built on support, growth, and exceptional benefits that empower you to Thrive personally and professionally. We’re proud to invest in our Team Members’ mental and physical wellbeing, ensuring they feel valued and supported in an inclusive and diverse environment.

When you join Hilton, you gain access to unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Mental wellbeing resources – Your health comes first. Eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Extended health and welfare plans – Get added peace of mind with health and wellness benefits that go beyond provincial coverage
  • Pension and RRSP plans – We’ve got your future in mind with retirement plans that help you grow your savings
  • Discounts and perks through Perkopolis – Enjoy exclusive savings on travel, shopping, tickets, and more!
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the team

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Make an impact!

Join Expedia Group’s Growth Marketing Technology team to help shape the future of marketing through data-driven innovation and AI-powered solutions. As a Product owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in developing scalable marketing technologies that enhance automation, measurement, and personalization across global marketing campaigns on platforms such as Google, Meta and Apple. You will partner closely with engineering and machine learning teams to define priorities and solve complex problems. This is an opportunity to lead meaningful work and influence how modern marketing capabilities are built and delivered.

In This Role, You Will

  • Drive the productionization of AI and agentic capabilities, including tool use, orchestration, state and context management, failure handling, human-in-the-loop experiences, and operational controls

Experience And Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience

  • Strong understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, feature development, model training, evaluation, experimentation, deployment, monitoring, drift, and iteration
  • Experience partnering with engineering and data science on technical architecture, APIs, data pipelines, workflow orchestration, scalable data products, MLOps, observability, and reliability
  • Experience defining evaluation and validation frameworks for AI or ML products, including offline metrics, online experimentation, human evaluation, quality thresholds, error analysis, and guardrails
  • Experience building or productizing agentic systems, intelligent workflows, recommended systems, optimization systems, decision engines, or comparable AI-enabled platforms; able to explain the underlying technical approach and trade-offs
  • Strong technical fluency in SQL and Python or a similar language, with the ability to inspect data, reason about model or system outputs, and participate credibly in technical solutioning
  • Proficient communication skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, and experience influencing senior technical and business partners through ambiguity
  • Experience in growth marketing, advertising technology, marketing automation, or another complex domain with measurable optimization or business outcomes
  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI and ML innovation, with the judgment to identify practical applications, understand limitations, and translate emerging techniques into production opportunities

We are seeking a Head of Airline Payments EMEA-APAC to join our global Airline and Hospitality Payments team, where innovation knows no borders.

Payments are no longer just the final step in travel. They shape conversion, trust, operational efficiency and the customer experience. This role will help airlines across EMEA and APAC move faster, simplify payment complexity and get more value from Sabre Travel Payments.

As Head of Airline Payments EMEA-APAC, you will lead regional commercial growth for airline payments. You will build new customer relationships, grow existing accounts and guide airlines through payment modernization with clear, practical advice. You will also connect regional customer needs with Sabre’s global product, marketing and operations teams so we can keep solving the right problems, together.

This is a senior commercial leadership role for someone who can challenge old ways of working, build trust with customers and turn opportunity into measurable growth. Let’s get going.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the EMEA-APAC airline payments sales strategy across new business, renewals, expansion and share-shift opportunities.
  • Build and grow trusted relationships with airline payment, distribution, finance and commercial leaders.
  • Guide customers through payment modernization, including acceptance, virtual cards, account-to-account payments, supplier enablement, fraud, chargebacks and reconciliation.
  • Shape compelling value propositions, negotiate enterprise agreements and move opportunities from early engagement to commercial close.
  • Partner with product, marketing, operations and regional commercial teams to connect customer needs with roadmap priorities and go-to-market plans.

What You’ll Bring

  • Solid experience in strategic sales, commercial partnerships or business development, ideally in airline payments, fintech, travel technology or enterprise SaaS.
  • Proven success selling payment or financial technology solutions to airlines, travel sellers or other travel ecosystem partners.
  • Strong understanding of merchant services, payment acceptance, fraud management, chargebacks, reconciliation, virtual cards and account-to-account payments.
  • Experience leading complex, long-cycle enterprise sales and negotiating with senior customer stakeholders across EMEA, APAC or global markets.
  • Strong commercial judgment, a collaborative leadership style and the confidence to challenge legacy processes when there is a better way forward.

At Sabre, you’ll work with people who are ambitious for our customers and each other. You’ll collaborate with airlines, fintechs, banks, card networks and travel leaders to help solve real payment challenges across the travel ecosystem.

You’ll also play a role in helping travel payments move toward more open, order-based and customer-centered ways of working. The status quo has had its turn. Now we build what comes next.

Job Description

The successful candidate will play a key role within the Properties Department, overseeing the facilities management of assigned SIA owned and leased premises in Singapore. The role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, from managing preventive and corrective maintenance to coordinating soft services, project management, internal works requisitions, facility bookings, and more. The candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders, service providers, and regulatory authorities to ensure the smooth, safe, and efficient operation of all facilities under their care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team to deliver systematic, cost-effective, and responsive maintenance of building equipment, systems, and common services.
  • Oversee the operations of the Building Operations Centre (BOC), ensuring timely and professional handling of service requests, feedback, and complaints from occupants, with issues tracked to closure.
  • Manage and monitor Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) and other FM related service contracts, ensuring performance in line with specifications, SLAs/KPIs, and statutory compliance.
  • Strategically plan and manage energy and utility consumption to support sustainability targets, including achieving Green Mark and energy management goals.
  • Prepare, manage, and control operating and capital expenditure budgets, including forecasting, cost estimation, and tracking of project and maintenance expenditure.
  • Plan and manage improvement and retrofitting projects, overseeing the full project lifecycle from feasibility and design through procurement, implementation, commissioning, and handover.
  • Liaise with authorities, regulatory agencies, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with statutory requirements, licences, inspections, and permits related to property and facilities.
  • Assist the Manager in conducting feasibility studies, site assessments, technical evaluations, and lifecycle costing to support FM strategies and initiatives.
  • Manage administrative functions related to building and facilities operations, including procurement, requisition processing, documentation, asset tracking, and service level monitoring.
  • Drive continuous improvement in FM service delivery, maintenance regimes, digitalisation efforts, and customer experience through proactive reviews, root cause analysis, and system enhancements.
  • Conduct regular inspections and audits of service providers to ensure adherence to safety, regulatory, environmental, and quality standards, and close out findings promptly.
  • Collaborate closely with building occupants and business units to meet operational needs, project schedules, and space requirements, including facility bookings.
  • Stay abreast of the latest technologies and best practices, and drive Smart FM, energy optimisation, and digital building initiatives.
  • Lead the IFM team during emergencies such as system failures, fire alarms, or business continuity events, and maintain and test emergency response plans.
  • Promote a strong workplace culture of safety, service excellence, environmental stewardship, and stakeholder engagement within the FM team.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned to support facility management related operations.

Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering, Building, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Candidates with relevant internship or work experience in facilities management, engineering, or building maintenance will have an added advantage.
  • Basic understanding of FM operations, building services, and systems, including MEP, ACMV, P&S, and fire protection.
  • Certifications such as BCA GMAP (FM), SCEM, WEMP, or FSM are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving abilities, with good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player with a proactive mindset and a willingness to learn in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Able to respond to urgent operational matters when required (including after office hours).
  • Strong interest in building operations, facilities management, and sustainability practices.
  • Knowledge of relevant Singapore codes and regulations (e.g., Fire Safety Act, WSH, BCA requirements).
  • Ability to read technical drawings and familiarity with CMMS/Smart FM platforms and basic data analysis (e.g., Excel/Power BI) will have an added advantage.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

As Regulations Lead, you will act as the compliance & regulations specialist and provide leadership and coordination across Ground Operations regulatory compliance, manuals, and internal training activities. This role ensures that TUI Airline maintains an outstanding portfolio of compliant processes and procedures, aligned with EASA, IATA, IOSA, and other regulatory requirements. You will act as the primary point of contact for regulatory matters within Ground Operations, driving consistency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence across the team. You will manage and support the implementation of the new EASA & UK CAA Ground Handling Regulation, to ensure we are compliant with this new regulation both as an airline and ground handler.

We are happy to consider this role on a hybrid working model basis in line with local office attendance and/or business requirements (whichever is higher). Regular monthly travel should be expected between our Airline AOC office location and/or major airport bases.

Applications close 17 Sept 2026

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation

About The Job

  • Lead and develop a small team of subject matter experts responsible for regulations, manuals, and training, allocating priorities and resources to ensure timely delivery of compliance objectives whilst coaching and mentoring team members to build expertise and resilience
  • Act as the senior subject matter expert for Ground Ops and ground Handling regulations, providing strategic advice to management
  • Monitor regulatory changes and assess impact on Ground Operations processes, ensuring Ground Operations Manuals (GOM/GHM/IPM) remain compliant and up to date
  • Represent Ground Ops in regulatory forums and maintain strong relationships with authorities (EASA, IATA, NAA)
  • Represent Ground Ops in internal meetings and maintain a strong relationship with Ground Ops Nominated Persons and AOC compliance, safety and security departments
  • Manage Ground Ops oversight performance data. Analyse trends and escalate/present data to relevant responsible managers
  • Oversee internal & external audits and ensure closure of non-compliance findings driving standardisation and simplification of processes across all TUI Airlines
  • Maintain and improve the departmental quality system (DQS) and ensure adherence to internal procedures
  • Ensure Ground Operations Manual suite remains compliant and up to date with the latest regulation
  • Drive standardisation and simplification of processes across all TUI Airlines
  • Support with IOSA revalidation audits as and when required
  • Oversee Ground Ops training programmes and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal standards, supporting the development of engaging training content and maintain digital training libraries
  • Act as the interface between Ground Ops and Safety, Compliance & Security teams, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and continuous improvement

About You

  • Proven experience in Ground Operations with strong regulatory knowledge (EASA, IATA, IOSA)
  • Strong understanding of compliance frameworks and audit processes
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong business English (spoken and written); international travel will be required

Job Summary:

As a Regent Experience Manager, you will elevate guest relations. Deliver impeccable, anticipatory service while acting as our established guests’ central property point of contact. This leader shall be accountable for overseeing the front desk, emerald connect and enhancing the overall guest journey from pre-arrival to making a lasting impression post-departure by offering exceptional personalized service and “Enabling Uplifting Experiences.” This will ensure seamless coordination of guest preferences by maximizing satisfaction and acting with thoughtful kindness. 

Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Director of Guest Experience, every day is different, but you will mostly:

  • Promote Regent’s service philosophy and style through our people attributes. 
  • Conduct daily shift briefings. 
  • Lead and manage a team of Concierge colleagues and serve as liaison for the guest to all departments, and all VIP Services, fostering a culture of excellence and ensuring consistent delivery of exceptional guest experiences.
  •  Welcome guests upon arrival, providing room escorts, and a warm and friendly introduction to the hotel's services and facilities. 
  •  Act as a personal concierge, assisting guests with reservations, booking activities, arranging transportation, and providing recommendations for local attractions, dining, and entertainment options.
  • Serve as a butler for designated guests and VIPs, attending to their every need, including packing and unpacking, garment pressing, shoe shining, and ensuring their accommodation is beautifully presented and well-maintained.
  • Implement processes for pre-arrival and post-stay communication with all guests.
  • Accurately update the Opera and KYC system for arrivals, departures, preferences, profile notes, traces, and alerts to ensure up-to-date guest information.
  • Enter all guest requests and complaints in the KYC system and follow up accordingly.  
  • Develop and maintain relationships with VIP guests, understanding their preferences and expectations to provide personalized and tailored services.
  • Collaborate with various departments to ensure seamless coordination of guest preferences and services, including front desk operations, housekeeping, food and beverage, spa, and transportation. 
  • Inspect guest rooms to ensure cleanliness and preferences have been elegantly and thoughtfully arranged. 
  • Oversee the implementation and execution of the hotel's guest recognition program (One Rewards), ensuring it meets the highest standards and provides a unique, memorable experience for our VIP guests. 
  • Continuously analyze guest feedback and reviews, identifying areas of improvement and implementing strategies to enhance the overall guest experience and satisfaction scores. 
  • Create and maintain a comprehensive database of guests and VIPs, preferences, and historical information to facilitate proactive guest engagement and personalized offerings. 
  • Ensure a high level of accuracy and attention to detail when managing guest preferences and maintaining guest history records.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to guest experience and VIP services, adapting strategies and practices accordingly. 
  • Develop and implement training programs according to Regent Santa Monica Beach standards for all colleagues to elevate service standards and foster a culture of exceeding guest expectations. 
  • Monitor key performance indicators and track progress towards meeting guest satisfaction goals, providing regular reports and analyses to senior management. 
  • Manage guest complaints and resolution processes, taking ownership of guest concerns and ensuring prompt and satisfactory resolution.
  • Collaborate with management to maintain service standards aligned with Forbes Five-Star Standards.
  • Other tasks/projects as assigned.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a guest services leadership role, preferably in a luxury hotel environment. 
  • Bachelor's degree in hospitality management or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven track record of delivering exceptional guest experiences and achieving high guest satisfaction scores. 
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team. 
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with guests, staff, and senior management. 
  • Detail-oriented with exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 
  • Proficient in guest service software and familiarity with guest satisfaction measurement systems. 
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, weekends, and holidays as required.

What you can expect from us:

The hourly pay for this role is $39.62. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed at Regent Santa Monica Beach.

Guests have made grand entrances through the doors of Regent® Hotels & Resorts for nearly half a century. Born in 1970, our collection of modern hotels and resorts are home to stays both serene and sensational. The type of experiences that elevate above the noise and charm for even the most seasoned of travellers. An invitation to life’s most scenic moments. We are the legendary innovative luxury brand, reimagining modern hospitality by sparking fresh perspectives across hand selected hotels and resorts. Regent colleagues are gracious hosts, with emboldened spirit and dynamic as they provide meaningful moments to deliver the greatest of the guest experiences.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  • Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*

Strategic Accounts Management Team

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity:

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Develop long lasting relationships with key supply partners to enable Agoda’s growth in the region
  • Maintain regular and meaningful engagement with Agoda’s key supply partners
  • Analyze large datasets to propose tailor-made solutions to Agoda’s supply partners
  • Leverage analytical and problem-solving skills to identify new opportunities to grow Agoda’s business
  • Train and inform clients of both new and existing technologies, tools, and models
  • Prepare materials to aid in growing our business during partner meetings
  • Respond to partners requests in a timely and effective manner
  • Gain buy-in from relevant stakeholders to execute strategies and help launch promotional campaigns to enhance productivity and maintain Agoda’s competitiveness
  • Leverage product offerings to match market demands to maximize our ability to convert passive customers into active ones
  • Deliver on country KPIs, growth targets and country strategic initiatives
  • Support the Area Manager in preparing country reporting for senior stakeholders

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas
  • Native level Japanese to communicate with clients speaking Japanese and intermediate English to communicate internally.

It’s Great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree
  • Experience in Travel industry

Job Description

As an Account Director for the Area Sales Office Australia, you will be responsible for the performance of a portfolio of key and strategic accounts on a local and national basis. There may be some opportunities outbound to consider as well. The Account Director will create and communicate the account strategies in order to drive increased share for Hilton and is responsible for the implementation and execution of various projects that will achieve this. The role is responsible for driving revenue for both Corporate Sales (IBT – Individual Business Travelers) and Group/Events. The role will also manage the RFP process for these accounts.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

Planning Activities

  • Develop strategies and directions for accounts in your portfolio.
  • Identifies and evaluates business opportunities for the company.
  • Executes strategic account development plans and supports communications of key messages internally and externally.
  • Responsible for the delivery of account strategies and activities
  • Total account management focus.
  • Quickly determine the segments within the account that provide greater opportunities.

Organizing Activities

  • Implements plans to ensure overall strategic direction of the account portfolio and supports the company’s revenue strategies.
  • Develops account plans that specify objectives and sales activities to support the defined account strategy and ensure maximum opportunity for account penetration.
  • Establishes and develops long term effective working relationships with key customers to drive business.
  • Depending on the segment,
  • manages the RFP process ensuring the correct procedures are in place to support the client and drive business into Hilton, for corporate transient clients.
  • Handles group requests from corporate clients, at times supported by a coordinator or venue finder.
  • Ensure relevant updates are sent both to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Monitors and reviews the impact of marketing initiatives on the account strategy.
  • Networking with sub account handlers and global leads where relevant.
  • Strengthening relationships with key hotels and aligning strategies where relevant.
  • Manages cross-functional links to other teams, departments and functions.
  • Regular meetings to take place with customers.
  • Attends relevant industry conferences and events.

Directing Activities

  • Foster beneficial relationships with business partners, potential clients, business contacts, our hotel, and the HWS community in order to drive revenue
  • Drive positive results through customized solutions.
  • Sell outstanding solutions or services to account portfolio, with the ability and ambition to expand revenue opportunities
  • Will be encouraged to be inquisitive and able to optimally solve problems.

Controlling Activities

  • Ensure revenue targets are achieved and effectively ask clients for business, using Hilton sales techniques.
  • Exhibit strong motivation to drive revenue

Supportive Functions

  • Directly responsible for managing a portfolio of defined accounts.
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of negotiating business travel sales contracts with corporate accounts, an understanding of the RFP Process, comfort level with business travel sales terminology, and business travel sales reporting.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of group business, sourcing tools, and group business terminology.
  • Effective utilization of Salesforce to manage customer connections and results.
  • In this role, you will have individual goals for transient corporate and group revenue to be generated from your account portfolio.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree/College diploma
  • 4-5 years’ experience, in hotel sales and/or in an above property sales position
  • 4-5 years’ experience, in the business travel sales market and/or group sales market
  • Experienced in new account development and mining for business.
  • Organizational and multitasking skills with superb attention to detail
  • Exhibit outstanding communication skills.
  • Extremely flexible and adaptable self-starter
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Able to negotiate, close agreements, and achieve goals.
  • Demonstrate strong organizational skills, the ability to meet deadlines, and to solve problems and present business solutions both internally and externally.
  • Can travel as required.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS)
  • 3 years' experience of Group Sales experience
  • 2 years’ experience, in a full-service hotel of 500+ rooms
  • 3 years’ experience using Salesforce and Delphi
  • Above property skills in negotiating global agreements on behalf of multiple hotels

H OW WE WILL SUPPORT YOU

Benefits

Hilton is proud to support the mental and physical wellbeing of all Team Members so they can Thrive personally and professionally in a diverse and inclusive environment, thanks to programs and benefits such as:

  • Go Hilton travel program: 110 nights of discounted travel with room rates as low as $40/night
  • Hilton Shares: Our employee stock purchase program (ESPP) - you can purchase Hilton shares at a 15 percent discount
  • Paid parental leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents

  • Learn more about the rest of our benefits

At Hilton, we believe every Team Member is a leader. We are committed to offering leadership development opportunities and programs through every step of a Team Member’s career journey and at every level, both in our hotels and across corporate.

What It Is Like Working For Hilton

Hilton, the #1 World’s Best Workplace, is a leading global hospitality company with a diverse portfolio of world-class brands . Dedicated to filling the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, we have welcomed more than 3 billion guests in our more-than 100-year history. At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

In This Role, You Will

  • Support the operation and execution of transactional global payments to and from Expedia Group across financial platforms.
  • Partner with Corporate Accounts Payable and Receivable, Procurement Operations, Partner Payment Operations and Services, and other business teams.
  • Investigate and resolve complex financial transaction, data, and system issues.
  • Lead information management and reporting activities, ensuring requests are addressed accurately and within agreed timelines.
  • Audit system outputs and validate the accuracy of financial data, analytics, and reporting.
  • Develop and improve processes for information storage, archiving, disposal, and data sharing in line with privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify root causes, recommend solutions, and lead the implementation of process improvements.
  • Create reports, tools, measures, and data visualizations that improve operational efficiency and provide actionable insights.
  • Manage multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholder needs while balancing immediate deliverables with longer-term objectives.
  • Translate complex analyses into clear, natural-language insights that inform business decisions.
  • Partner with Business Intelligence teams to productionalize opportunities identified through analysis.
  • Support team leadership, escalations, knowledge sharing, and coaching on systems, processes, and data privacy practices.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, data analytics, or related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • Six or more years of applicable experience in financial operations, payments, sales operations, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Experience working with financial systems, ERP platforms, databases, and management reporting tools.
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills, including the ability to work with large datasets.
  • Experience validating data accuracy, identifying trends, and developing actionable reporting or visualizations.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, complex projects, and overlapping deadlines.
  • Proficient written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Experience identifying root causes and implementing practical process improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to problem solving.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience with global payments, accounts payable, accounts receivable, procurement operations, or partner payment services.
  • Experience with data visualization, business intelligence, or reporting tools.
  • Knowledge of information governance, data privacy, and regulatory requirements.

job.job_description:
About the Role

Trip.com Group is one of the world's leading online travel platforms, connecting hundreds of millions of travellers with partners across accommodation, transport, and experiences. Japan represents one of our most strategically important markets - a mature, high-value travel ecosystem with deeply rooted commercial relationships and significant growth potential in both inbound and outbound travel.

We are seeking a Japan Partnership Lead to own and elevate our partnerships and affiliate strategy across the Japanese market. This is a high-impact strategic leadership role — not a country manager or sales executor position. You will shape the commercial growth agenda for Japan, build and deepen relationships with key local partners, and drive the strategic direction of our partnerships channel in one of the most competitive and nuanced travel markets in the world.

You will work closely with the Senior Marketing Partnerships & Affiliate Director and serve as a key leadership voice for Japan.


Key Responsibilities

Japan Market Commercial Strategy

  • Define and execute the Japan partnerships commercial strategy, aligned to Trip.com Group's broader growth priorities and the unique dynamics of the Japanese market.
  • Identify, prioritise, and capture high-value commercial opportunities — including strategic partnerships with leading Japanese travel platforms, affiliate networks, media companies, and emerging digital channels.
  • Translate global partnerships strategy into locally compelling, culturally attuned market plans that resonate with Japanese business partners and stakeholders.
  • Drive revenue growth across Japan's partnerships channel, contributing materially to Trip.com Group's regional financial performance.

Partner Ecosystem Development

  • Build and maintain C-suite and senior-level relationships with key Japanese partners — including major travel platforms (e.g. Rakuten Travel, Yahoo! Travel / LINE Yahoo), affiliate networks (e.g. A8.net, ValueCommerce), media houses, airlines, and tourism boards.
  • Navigate Japan's relationship-driven business culture to establish trust, credibility, and long-term commercial alignment with strategic partners.
  • Identify and develop new partnership models suited to the Japanese market — exploring opportunities in content partnerships, loyalty programmes, co-marketing, and emerging distribution channels.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape and evolving partner ecosystem in Japan, ensuring Trip.com Group maintains a differentiated and commercially compelling value proposition.

Leadership & Team Elevation

  • Support, coach, and develop the Japan partnership team, elevating their strategic thinking, commercial execution, and partnership management capabilities.
  • Challenge and refine market plans, hold the team accountable to performance standards, and raise the quality of commercial decisions.
  • Act as a leadership multiplier — scaling the effectiveness of the partnerships organisation through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and capability building.
  • Foster a high-performance culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Operational Governance & Execution Quality

  • Drive commercial governance, forecasting discipline, and planning rigour within the Japan market.
  • Ensure ROI frameworks, commercial governance standards, and performance reporting are applied consistently and transparently.
  • Strengthen the planning cadence, ensuring reliable, accurate commercial pipelines and partner performance visibility.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives that enhance execution quality and operational efficiency.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders - including marketing, product, finance, legal, and regional leadership - to ensure Japan partnership priorities are well-represented and resourced.
  • Serve as a senior external-facing presence with key strategic partners, representing Trip.com Group at industry events, partner summits, and executive meetings.
  • Contribute to cross-functional strategic initiatives that extend the commercial reach and influence of the Partnerships channel across APAC.


Profile Requirements

We are looking for a leader who combines strategic commercial acumen with deep expertise in the Japanese market and a proven ability to navigate its unique business culture. The right candidate will be a hybrid of commercial strategist, partnerships leader, and relationship builder — not a traditional BD or sales profile.

Experience & Background

  • 8~10+ years of experience in partnerships, affiliate marketing, commercial strategy, or business development — ideally within travel, e-commerce, or consumer internet.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving commercial growth within the Japanese market, with measurable P&L or revenue impact.
  • Deep familiarity with Japan's travel and digital ecosystem — including major OTA players, affiliate networks, media partners, and the competitive dynamics shaping the market.
  • Experience leading or coaching high-performing teams, with strong capability in developing others and raising commercial standards.
  • Exposure to cross-functional, matrixed organisations and the ability to influence at senior levels across markets and functions.
  • Prior experience at a global or regional travel platform, Japanese travel company (e.g. JTB, KNT-CT Holdings, Rakuten Travel), or leading digital/affiliate company in Japan is highly desirable.

Language

  • Native Japanese - essential for building partner relationships, leading local teams, and operating effectively within the Japanese market.
  • Fluent English — required for collaboration with global leadership and cross-market teams.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strategic thinking — ability to see the bigger picture, identify high-leverage opportunities in a complex market, and translate strategy into executable plans.
  • Commercial understanding — strong grasp of partnership economics, affiliate models, revenue drivers, and ROI frameworks within the Japanese digital landscape.
  • Relationship mastery — exceptional ability to build trust and credibility with senior Japanese business leaders, navigating the nuances of Japanese business culture (consensus-building, long-term relationship orientation, attention to detail).
  • Organisational leadership — ability to lead through influence, elevate teams, and drive accountability in a matrixed environment.
  • Operational discipline — structured approach to planning, forecasting, and performance governance.
  • Stakeholder management — confident communicator at senior and C-suite level, both internally and externally.
  • Coaching capability — genuine interest in developing others and raising the commercial capability of the team.


What We Offer

  • A strategic leadership role with direct impact on one of Trip.com Group's most important markets.
  • Exposure to a global, fast-growing travel platform with opportunities to shape the future of travel partnerships in Japan.
  • Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.
  • A collaborative, high-performance culture that values strategic thinking, initiative, and continuous learning.
  • Tokyo-based position with opportunities for regional and global collaboration.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Job Location: Remote in the United Kingdom

This role is a remote position in the United Kingdom. Occasional travel to company offices as necessary.

What You’ll Do

As CRM Specialist for the CRM Operations team, you will play a critical role in executing Tripadvisor communications with members via commerce streams, member newsletters and content collection communications. The ideal candidate will have a combination of email marketing experience, project management skills and the ability to communicate effectively regarding project status and email analytics.

Responsibilities Will Include, But Not Be Restricted To

  • Production of email campaigns, app push notifications, and site banners/interstitials
  • Work within our marketing automation platforms to produce audiences, campaign logic, and templates based off of technical specifications
  • Assist with translation requests (we send in many languages)
  • Heavily test all work to preemptively catch bugs, plus approve work of teammates by following our QA process
  • Assist managers in ad-hoc projects

Examples

  • Tripadvisor sends multiple highly visible emails each week. The emails go to tens of millions of people in many languages across the globe.
  • This person will be producing and sending 3-5 campaigns each week. One aspect of this is creating templates by updating copy, images, links, etc. within our template editor tool.
  • Focus is on the execution of the email, push, and site marketing campaigns

What We Seek

  • Meticulous attention to detail with a clear, methodological approach to problem solving
  • Experience working in a CRM role in a high energy online environment
  • Candidates should have 2+ years of email production experience in a corporate setting, with a strong focus on B2C
  • Experience building campaigns in the customer engagement platform, Braze, is a plus
  • Comfortable multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment, with the ability to manage large cross-functional projects and numerous weekly launches
  • Patience and professionalism when more clarification is needed or requirements change
  • Strong communication skills that enable you to engage with senior leaders and internal stakeholders

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions

Director, Global Mobility & Immigration

Expedia Group is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Director, Global Mobility & Immigration, to lead the vision, design, and execution of our global mobility and immigration programs.

Please note this role is only available in Seattle and aligned to our flexible hybrid policy, requiring three days a week in office.

This leader will be responsible for developing scalable solutions that support international hiring, employee relocation and workforce mobility. The role will partner closely with People Team leaders, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Payroll, and business stakeholders to create programs that balance employee experience, operational effectiveness, compliance, and business objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strategic leadership with operational excellence and brings a proven ability to modernize programs, leverage technology, and drive measurable business outcomes.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Lead and develop a global team of mobility and immigration professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and partnership.
  • Develop and execute Expedia Group's global mobility and immigration strategy in alignment with business priorities, workforce planning, and talent acquisition objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders on workforce mobility, international hiring, talent deployment, and emerging mobility trends.
  • Partner with stakeholders across People, Legal, Finance, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition to ensure mobility programs support evolving organizational needs.
  • Evaluate workforce mobility implications associated with business expansion, organizational redesign, acquisitions, and new employment models.
  • Design scalable mobility solutions that support business growth while maintaining a strong focus on employee experience and compliance.
  • Support the mobility infrastructure required for new market entry, entity establishment, and organizational integration initiatives.

Program Leadership & Operations

  • Own the global mobility and immigration policy framework, including governance, risk management, and program design.
  • Lead global immigration and mobility programs, including work authorization, visa sponsorship, permanent residence support, and relocation services.
  • Establish governance frameworks that ensure consistent delivery, operational efficiency, and policy compliance.
  • Review and adapt mobility policies to ensure competitiveness, scalability, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Drive program effectiveness through continuous process improvement and service optimization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate risks associated with employee movement across jurisdictions.

Vendor Management

  • Oversee relationships with immigration, relocation, and mobility service providers.
  • Lead vendor selection, contract negotiations, service-level management, and performance reviews.
  • Conduct RFP processes and implement solutions that improve quality, efficiency, and employee experience.
  • Ensure vendor partnerships deliver scalable support aligned with Expedia Group's global workforce needs.

Technology, Analytics & Innovation

  • Champion the use of technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to enhance mobility and immigration operations.
  • Develop analytics, dashboards, and reporting capabilities that provide insights into program performance, workforce trends, service levels, and costs.
  • Establish key performance indicators and governance metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Leverage data-driven insights to inform strategic decision-making and optimize program outcomes.
  • Explore innovative approaches to improve employee experience and operational scalability.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience leading global mobility, immigration, relocation, or workforce mobility programs within complex multinational organizations.
  • Demonstrated success transforming mobility functions into strategic business enablers that support hiring, retention, workforce planning, and location strategy.
  • Strong understanding of global immigration processes, workforce mobility compliance requirements, payroll considerations, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Proven ability to influence and partner with senior leaders across HR, Legal, Finance, Payroll, and Talent Acquisition.
  • Strong track record of driving operational excellence, program transformation, change management, and service delivery improvements.
  • Experience managing global vendor ecosystems and complex stakeholder relationships.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting a publicly traded global organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence geographically dispersed stakeholders across multiple regions.
  • Experience building and scaling global programs during periods of organizational growth and transformation.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $207,500.00 to $290,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $332,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe.
