Get to Know our Team:

The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team. We serve as the backbone for CEG’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes.

We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role is within the Operational Excellence and Automation team, which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end customer experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both customer-facing and agent-facing journeys.

Think your experience could be a great fit for Agoda?

If you're passionate about project or program management and excited by the possibility of building your career with Agoda, we'd love to hear from you—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement listed for this role.

Please note that this application will be considered for our 2027 hiring cycle.

By sharing your profile, you may be considered for future opportunities that better match your skills and aspirations. We'll keep your application in our talent pool and reach out if a relevant role becomes available.

Your next opportunity could be closer than you think—stay connected with Agoda!

The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global operational excellence and automation initiatives in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on:

(i) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, and

(ii) process optimization and CX improvements across the post‑booking customer journey.

You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives

  • Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning automation/AI and process excellence initiatives.
  • Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.

Drive Automation & AI driven solutions

  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, workflow automation, AI quality testing).
  • Partner with Product Management / Technology / CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Oversee the configuration and governance of operational flows and low‑code/automation tools, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business goals and CX standards.

Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements

  • Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.
  • Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving Localization support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points.
  • Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics.

Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team

  • Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
  • Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the Operational Excellence and Automation team.
  • Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
  • Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Experience & Background

  • Freshers until 8+ years of experience in project/program management, operations, customer experience, process improvement, strategy, management consulting, or similar fields.
  • Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions.
  • Comfort working with or overseeing workflow / automation / agent guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product/Engineering/Data teams. Coding ability is a plus (you have to be willing to learn)
  • Exposure to AI/ML‑driven solutions in an operational or CX context (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, routing, classification, or decision support tools) is a strong plus.

CX, Process, And Delivery Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and CX transformation, ideally in operations or customer support environments.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel, structure complex problems, and orchestrate cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience defining and driving improvements in KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, SLAs, handle time, productivity, or cost‑to‑serve.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, dynamic, multicultural environment, comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation in a high‑velocity setting.
  • A growth mindset and positive attitude: proactive, hands‑on, detail‑oriented, and with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Eagerness to pitch new ideas, take initiative, and seek out opportunities for improvement; comfortable giving and receiving feedback.
  • Professional experience with Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with collaboration and project tracking tools is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package (relocation support and visa support provided for successful overseas candidates)
  • Exciting, high‑impact career opportunity with a major global OTA, including potential moves between teams and global locations. You will interact with departmental senior leadership regularly.
  • Dynamic, multinational tech environment with colleagues from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities through corporate learning programs.
  • Modern office space and convenient location at the heart of Bangkok Metropolitan, Hub of Asia.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

About The Opportunity

The General Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership for the resort, driving financial performance, operational excellence, and exceptional guest experience. This leader will oversee all aspects of the property while developing a high-performing team and fostering strong relationships with ownership, Hilton, and the local community.

The ideal candidate will be a proven hospitality executive with experience leading a large-scale luxury or upper-upscale resort. The successful GM will bring strong commercial acumen, operational discipline, and a passion for service, while positioning the resort for continued growth and success in the Santa Barbara market.

About The Property

Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort is a premier oceanfront destination set across 24 acres along Santa Barbara’s iconic East Beach. Offering the perfect blend of coastal beauty, elevated amenities, and classic California hospitality, the resort features 360 guest rooms and suites, multiple dining outlets, a full-service spa, swimming pool, tennis and pickleball courts, and direct access to the beach.

With approximately 60,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor event space, the resort is a sought-after destination for leisure travelers, meetings, weddings, and special events. Its stunning oceanfront setting, expansive resort amenities, and proximity to all that Santa Barbara has to offer make Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort a standout hospitality destination and one of the market’s most distinctive properties.

What are we looking for?

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years’ General Manager experience managing a property with minimum $30 million revenue.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with expertise in budget management, financial oversight, revenue optimization, and driving profitability.
  • Demonstrated eye for detail and a commitment to delivering elevated, luxury-level hospitality and guest experiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive high team member engagement and build a strong culture, with a proven track record of developing talent, improving retention, and leading high-performing teams.
  • Strong community leadership and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish a trusted presence within Santa Barbara, while building meaningful local partnerships, and leveraging community connections to drive business and long-term success.
  • Adept at identifying opportunities for business expansion and driving long-term profitability in the hospitality industry.
  • Experience managing owner relations and fostering positive partnerships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Resort experience.
  • Local market experience.
  • Hilton brand experience.

Responsibilities

As General Manager, your responsibilities will also include:

  • Managing and optimizing hotel operations: You will lead the hotel with strategic oversight of all departments — ensuring alignment with Hilton brand standards. Through effective budgeting, forecasting, and service delivery, you’ll drive operational excellence and a seamless guest experience. By identifying inefficiencies and leveraging guest feedback, you’ll implement targeted improvements that enhance workflow, reduce waste, and elevate service. Your focus on continuous improvement, coaching, and innovation will strengthen team performance and consistently exceed guest expectations.
  • Managing commercial financial performance: You’ll take full ownership of the property’s financial performance, including sales, revenue and finance that will lead to growth, cost control, and profitability. This means setting and achieving targets for key performance indicators like GOP and RevPAR, while maintaining strong financial discipline. You'll also collaborate closely with the hotel’s commercial team and lead budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning processes to ensure sustained financial health and business agility.
  • Communicating with key stakeholders: As the primary point of contact for hotel owners and Hilton’s corporate leadership, you will be responsible for maintaining alignment on business goals, operational strategies, and performance expectations. You will deliver regular updates, collaborate on long-term planning, and act as a trusted advisor, ensuring transparency and partnership at every level.
  • Leading and developing on-property teams: You will cultivate a high-performing, people-first culture by recruiting top talent, championing diversity and inclusion, and supporting the professional development of every team member. Through performance management, coaching, and recognition programs, you'll inspire engagement, accountability, and continuous growth. Your leadership will empower teams to deliver outstanding service while growing their own careers at Hilton.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

The Traveler Business Team builds and drives growth for our global consumer businesses—Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. This division creates compelling and differentiated traveler value for each brand by setting the strategic vision, operating strategy, and plan. Responsibilities include investment allocation and prioritization, P&L accountability, and leading cross-functional teams across Expedia Group, who are all held accountable to a single scorecard.

As part of Vrbo’s revenue accounting team, you’ll help support the growth of our global online vacation rental business. Reporting to the Director, Accounting, you’ll lead key revenue accounting processes and collaborate with Sales, FP&A, Product Management, Legal, Tax, Technology, and external auditors.

Key Responsibilities

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead monthly and quarterly revenue accounting close activities, including invoicing, contract analysis, close procedures, and account reconciliations.
  • Apply revenue recognition guidance and document appropriate accounting treatment for products and services.
  • Prepare and analyze reconciliations for revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, bad debt expense, and related reserves.
  • Implement scalable processes, automation, and reconciliation tools for the eCommerce Merchant business.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, applicable accounting standards, and SOX requirements.
  • Reconcile GAAP reporting to internal operating metrics and investigate variances.
  • Improve systems and reporting tools to support accurate revenue recording and classification.
  • Participate in testing and reviewing accounting entries for new eCommerce product releases.
  • Support new product and system implementations by evaluating revenue accounting requirements.
  • Respond to interim, quarterly, and year-end audit requests and collaborate with external auditors.
  • Partner cross-functionally to research, resolve, and proactively address revenue-related issues.

Required

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • Four to seven years of corporate and/or public accounting experience.
  • Experience applying revenue recognition guidance.
  • Experience preparing revenue and deferred revenue reconciliations and journal entries.
  • Experience working with high-volume transactional revenue systems and performing data analysis.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to interpret and research accounting guidance.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to deliver accurate, high-quality work on time.
  • Proficient written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with SQL, Power Query, Tableau, or similar data and reporting tools.
  • Experience supporting SOX processes and controls.
  • Experience with eCommerce, marketplace, subscription, or other technology-enabled business models.
  • Experience participating in accounting system or product implementations.

The total cash range for this position in Springfield is $66,000.00 to $92,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $105,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Job Summary

The FLEX Director, Digital Analytics is a key leader within Marriott’s Enterprise Data, Analytics & AI organization, responsible for defining and advancing the analytics strategy that informs digital product decisions across our portfolio—including Marriott.com and the Bonvoy app—to help consumers seamlessly discover, shop and book, and enjoy their stay at Marriott properties.

This role serves as a strategic partner to Digital leaders, embedding analytics into product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and experience design. The Director shapes the analytical agenda by bringing clarity to complex business questions, identifying where to focus, and translating data into actions that improve traffic quality, conversion, revenue, and long-term customer value.

In close partnership with digital product, marketing, and channel teams, the Director ensures analytics support is aligned to key decisions across the customer journey. This includes developing a strong understanding of traffic acquisition and demand drivers—such as Paid Search, SEO, and other channels—and how they influence on-site behavior, conversion, and retention. The role also provides a holistic view of how Marriott’s digital ecosystem builds awareness of the portfolio and the value of Marriott Bonvoy. Overall, the Director ensures strategies reflect both demand generation and conversion dynamics, as well as the broader role digital plays in driving customer engagement.

Beyond insight delivery, the Director leads the development of scalable measurement and experimentation capabilities, enabling continuous optimization of Marriott’s digital ecosystem. By connecting behavioral, transactional, and market data, the role drives a forward-looking, insight-led approach to digital growth and customer experience innovation.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in analytics or related roles, with 3+ years in management preferred
  • Advanced SQL

Preferred

  • Expertise in e-commerce analytics, marketing analytics, customer loyalty analytics, conversion optimization, and digital performance measurement
  • Strong understanding of booking flows, pricing strategies, customer purchase behavior and membership value
  • Familiarity with A/B testing, multivariate testing, and experimentation frameworks
  • Knowledge of web and mobile commerce KPIs, including funnel analysis and abandonment metrics
  • Experience with analytics tools (Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, etc) and data visualization platforms
  • Ability to lead and develop high-performing teams, including Senior Manager-level associates
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to translate complex data into strategic recommendations

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

End-to-End Customer Journey Analytics

  • Lead analytics strategy across the full digital customer journey ensuring alignment between acquisition, experience, and retention
  • Develop a connected view of customer behavior across touchpoints, identifying friction points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities across lifecycle stages
  • Translate journey insights into clear product and business actions that improve conversion, engagement, and lifetime value

Traffic & Demand Driver Insights (Paid + Organic)

  • Establish a comprehensive understanding of traffic sources and demand drivers, including Paid Search, SEO, direct, and partner channels
  • Analyze the interplay between traffic quality and onsite behavior, evaluating how acquisition strategies influence engagement, conversion, and downstream value
  • Identify opportunities to optimize channel mix, landing experiences, and content strategies to improve traffic efficiency and conversion performance

Digital Product Strategy & Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to Digital Product and Strategy teams, shaping roadmap priorities, feature investments, and experience enhancements
  • Partner on portfolio and roadmap planning, contributing analytical insight to guide investment decisions, sequencing, and expected business impact
  • Translate complex inputs across teams (product, marketing, loyalty, revenue) into clear, structured insights and recommendations that support executive decision-making

Opportunity Identification & Growth Enablement

  • Identify and quantify high-impact opportunities across traffic acquisition, conversion funnels, personalization, and loyalty engagement
  • Frame ambiguous business challenges, define the required analyses, and guide teams toward structured, hypothesis-led problem solving
  • Continuously surface insights that inform both near-term performance improvements and longer-term strategic direction

Measurement, Experimentation & Capability Building

  • Define and scale measurement frameworks spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, and retention KPIs
  • Lead advancement of experimentation capabilities (A/B testing, multivariate testing, causal analysis) to validate product and marketing enhancements
  • Support development of predictive and diagnostic approaches (eg, demand forecasting, LTV modeling, churn risk) to inform proactive decision-making
  • Ensure consistent metrics, definitions, and analytical rigor across digital initiatives

Insight Development & Executive Storytelling

  • Synthesize complex data into clear, compelling narratives that guide decisions, highlight tradeoffs, and align stakeholders
  • Develop executive-ready materials and strategic frameworks that support Digital planning, investment decisions, and performance reviews
  • Provide a consistent, trusted perspective on what is driving digital performance and where to act

Team Leadership & Analytics Excellence

  • Lead and develop a team of analysts and Senior Managers, setting expectations for strategic thinking, business impact, and analytical rigor
  • Establish best practices for problem framing, insight generation, and storytelling
  • Foster a culture where teams independently identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and elevate insights to partners

Cross-Functional Influence & Strategic Execution

  • Partner across Digital, Marketing, Loyalty, Revenue Management, Finance, and Technology to ensure alignment between strategy, measurement, and execution
  • Support and influence cross-functional initiatives and strategic programs, ensuring analytics is embedded in planning and delivery
  • Drive adoption of analytics insights and capabilities, ensuring they translate into measurable business outcomes across the organization

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

The Performance Marketing team is looking for a strategic and data-driven Senior Manager to lead the marketing function for one of Agoda's most strategic partnerships, owning the P&L, leading a team, and driving partnership strategy.

This partnership generates millions in annual revenue across multiple whitelabel brands serving millions of travelers globally.

This position sits at the intersection of strategic thinking and operational excellence — someone who can lead a team, shape marketing strategy, influence partnership direction, and drive measurable business impact through data-driven decision-making and complex stakeholder management.

We're looking for a proven leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds clarity through frameworks, and can lead complex cross-functional initiatives with discipline and influence, earning strong stakeholder trust and executive confidence.

As a key player in the marketing and partnership ecosystem, you will work closely with partner marketing leadership, regional business development teams, and Agoda's commercial and product teams to ensure marketing strategies align with business priorities and contribute directly to revenue goals. You'll be responsible for end-to-end marketing leadership for the partnership.

What Makes This Role Unique

Scale & Impact

  • Own a full P&L for a multi-million dollar partnership
  • Direct control over budget allocation and investment levels across channels
  • Your optimization decisions drive both immediate ROI and long-term partnership health

Strategic Complexity

  • Manage multiple brands with different customer profiles
  • Navigate the intersection of B2B partnership management and B2C performance marketing
  • Balance partner relationships with data-driven optimization
  • Influence partner marketing strategy while ensuring Agoda profitability targets

Channel Mastery & Technical Growth

You'll oversee the full marketing funnel:

  • Metasearch (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak) — optimize bidding strategies, feed management, price competitiveness
  • Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing) — keyword strategy, campaign structure, budget optimization
  • App Marketing (Google ACi, Apple ASA) — drive app adoption in key markets
  • Emerging Channels (SEO, email/CRM, customer marketing) — build new growth drivers
  • Advanced SQL for booking analysis and channel performance tracking
  • A/B testing and experimentation methodology with clear measurement frameworks
  • Marketing analytics including attribution modeling and incrementality measurement

Cross-Cultural Collaboration

  • Weekly syncs with partner marketing team
  • Joint planning and collaborative problem-solving
  • Navigate cultural nuances in partnership management

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Development
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 2-3 marketing specialists
  • Set team priorities and OKRs aligned to partnership goals
  • Conduct performance reviews and career development conversations
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and accountability
  • Strategic Marketing Leadership & P&L Ownership
  • Set overall marketing strategy and influence ROI targets; optimize investment levels to ensure we hit partnership goals
  • Guide team on channel strategies and ensure execution excellence
  • Own the full marketing P&L for the partnership
  • Design experimentation roadmap to validate strategic hypotheses
  • Monitor channel health and guide team to drill into anomalies or opportunities
  • Oversee dashboard/reporting development and team analytics capability
  • Analytics Strategy & Insights
  • Define analytics roadmap and experimentation strategy for the team
  • Write SQL queries to answer strategic business questions and guide team on complex analysis
  • Guide team on measurement frameworks and experiment design
  • Synthesize insights into executive-ready recommendations with business impact quantification
  • Build team capability in analytics and experimentation
  • Strategic Planning & Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Develop annual marketing roadmap and quarterly plans aligned to partnership goals
  • Lead weekly syncs with partner marketing leadership
  • Present quarterly business reviews to Agoda leadership (Director/VP level)
  • Own the annual planning process and budget allocation across channels
  • Partner with Agoda's commercial and product teams on partnership optimization
  • Pitch strategic initiatives to partner executives and navigate differing viewpoints with influence and data
  • Program & Project Management
  • Lead large, multi-workstream initiatives end-to-end
  • Build detailed project plans with risk mitigation and milestone tracking
  • Establish governance cadence and reporting mechanisms
  • Ensure disciplined execution across markets and teams

Requirements

We're looking for candidates who demonstrate:

  • Analytical & Technical Skills
  • SQL proficiency (daily usage for analysis; comfortable working with multiple tables and complex joins)
  • Strong analytical thinking with ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Comfort with marketing analytics tools (Google Ads, attribution platforms, dashboards)
  • Bonus: Experience with experimentation design and statistical analysis
  • 7-10+ years in marketing, growth, or analytics roles
  • Marketing Channel Knowledge
  • Understanding of performance marketing fundamentals (PPC, metasearch, app marketing, or SEO)
  • Experience optimizing marketing campaigns toward ROI/profitability targets
  • Familiarity with attribution models and incrementality measurement
  • Background in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing analytics preferred
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • 5+ years people management experience or demonstrated team leadership
  • Ability to influence without direct authority in a matrix organization
  • Executive communication skills — comfortable presenting to VP/Director level stakeholders
  • Required: Complex stakeholder management including partner relationships at senior levels
  • Cultural sensitivity for cross-border collaboration
  • Execution Excellence
  • Exceptional project management discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
  • Strong attention to detail without losing strategic altitude
  • Business Orientation
  • Understands P&L drivers and growth mechanics
  • Makes data-informed decisions
  • Focused on impact, not activity

What We Offer

Ownership & Impact

  • You're not executing someone else's strategy — you're owning the outcomes
  • Test new ideas, run experiments, see direct impact on partnership performance
  • High visibility to leadership; your metrics are partnership KPIs

Learning Environment

  • Work with Agoda's best-in-class marketing practices
  • Experimentation culture with clear measurement and learning
  • Complex, ambiguous problems that build problem-solving skills

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotel team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for the overall management of the hotel's accounting records and financial reports, ensuring compliance with company, owner, statutory, and fiscal requirements and timetables. As a Director of Finance, you’re not just overseeing all hotel financial operations – you’re a strategic business partner who works alongside the business, supporting and advising on strategic and operational decision-making through insights that drive better business performance.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Drive financial strategy: Oversee all financial operations, ensuring alignment with the hotel’s strategic goals to optimize profitability and efficiency
  • Oversee financial planning and analysis: Direct the preparation of annual plans, projections, and budgets, providing financial insights to support business decisions
  • Advise hotel leadership: Serve as the primary financial advisor to hotel management, ownership, and department heads, offering data-driven recommendations to enhance financial performance
  • Ensure financial compliance: Uphold adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and safeguard hotel assets through strong financial controls
  • Optimize financial reporting: Oversee systems and processes to drive accuracy, efficiency, and transparency in financial reporting.
  • Monitor and approve financial transactions: Oversee and authorize hotel sales, purchases, salaries, and expenses to maintain fiscal responsibility and operational efficiency
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • University degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in hotel finance, including 3+ years in a leadership role
  • Professional accounting qualification preferred
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • Proficient in hotel systems such as PEP, Birch St, Navision, Agilysys, etc.
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • Deep understanding of financial controls, compliance, and reporting standards
  • Proven ability to lead teams and collaborate across departments

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Commercial Credit Risk Analyst

This role sits within the B2B Finance Credit team, acting as a key interface between Sales, Commercial Finance, Partner Finance, Accounting and Group Treasury. You will support some of our largest global travel partners and play a central role in strengthening the financial governance of our growing credit programme.

This position will suit a candidate with strong analytical capability, excellent communication and negotiation skills, and proven experience managing large and complex partner portfolios (50M+ credit exposure) as long as small travel businesses. You will be a trusted business partner who can influence senior stakeholders internally and externally, while confidently assessing financial risk and resolving complex issues.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and manage a portfolio of high-value partners, including complex credit arrangements, significant credit limits and large multi-currency exposures.
  • Assess and recommend credit limits through detailed financial analysis, including interpretation of balance sheets, cash flow statements and group structures.
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with major travel partners—acting as their core finance point of contact for risk, payment performance, and commercial discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product & Tech and Commercial Finance to support strategic growth while ensuring governance and risk mitigation.
  • Resolve complex finance issues involving unallocated cash, disputes, reconciliation gaps, or operational blockers impacting receivables.
  • Drive negotiations on collateral, payment terms, and risk-based decisions with large partners, balancing commercial opportunity with financial protection.
  • Support our credit insurance programme, with an effective management of coverage gaps.
  • Strengthen collections processes and identify opportunities to reduce ageing, improve forecasting accuracy, and optimise partner payment behaviour.
  • Evaluate and store partner financial information, ensuring completeness, accuracy and compliance with internal controls.
  • Support the Credit Risk Director in developing and updating Credit Management Policies, ensuring they reflect evolving business strategy and risk appetite.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in credit control, credit risk or corporate finance, with a focus on large B2B portfolios or high-risk accounts.
  • Proven ability to interpret financial statements, assess business models and form clear risk opinions.
  • Experience setting or reviewing credit limits of high amounts is highly desirable.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex issues, and dispute, think critically, and manage escalations with a calm, solutions-driven approach.
  • Strong relationship-building skills across functions and cultures.
  • High attention to detail and ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong system adaptability (experience with AI, Power BI Power Query is a plus).
  • Experience in business partnering roles or environments where finance must collaborate closely with commercial teams.
  • Knowledge of B2B business models, credit insurance, securitisation or collateral management is advantageous.
  • English speaker
  • Travel experience desirable

Please note that this role is only available in the following locations: Madrid, in alignment with our flexible work model which requires employees to be in-office at least three days a week. We are unable to offer relocation assistance for this role.

The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €43,000.00 to €60,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €69,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

The Vice President, Public Relations, Communications & Activations, CALA, is a senior continent leader responsible for setting the strategy and operating model for public relations, executive communications, internal communications, activations, reputation management, and earned-media storytelling across the Caribbean and Latin America. The role serves as a strategic advisor to the Chief Commercial Officer, CALA senior leadership, Global Communications & Public Affairs, brand leadership, owners, and market teams to ensure CALA’s narrative advances Marriott International’s enterprise priorities, regional growth agenda, and commercial performance objectives.

This leader translates global enterprise, brand, loyalty, development, and commercial strategies into locally relevant communications platforms, market activations, and visibility plans that support demand generation, owner and franchisee value, hotel openings and conversions, customer engagement, loyalty growth, and CALA’s portfolio priorities across Luxury, Premium, Select, All-Inclusive, and emerging brand segments.

The Vice President leads the CALA PR and discipline, including the Public Relations Center of Excellence, agency ecosystem, budget governance, measurement framework, and team capability. The role is accountable for setting clear priorities, building scalable resources and standards, strengthening executive and market counsel, and delivering measurable impact through earned media, share of voice, reputation, engagement, and business contribution.

Location: CALA Continent Office in Plantation, FL or other CALA Countries.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in public relations, communications, journalism and/or marketing required; advanced degree in Business or related area preferred
  • MBA or similar advanced degree a plus
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in public relations, international consumer marketing, social media and/or field operations/marketing required
  • International and US media relations required
  • International marketing experience preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to balance the interests and demands of multiple senior-level stakeholders
  • Proven experience leading teams, agencies, budgets, and senior stakeholder engagement in a complex, matrixed, multi-market organization
  • Experience providing communications counsel to senior executives and influencing enterprise, continent, owner, and property stakeholders preferred
  • Continent or global experience across diverse markets and cultures strongly preferred; hospitality, travel, luxury, lifestyle, or consumer brand experience a plus
  • Strong knowledge of hospitality industry preferred; on-property experience a plus
  • Excellent oral and written English and Spanish skills required. Portuguese language proficiency a plus.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Set and lead the continent-wide strategy, priorities, governance, and operating model for PR, communications, executive visibility, activations, and reputation management in alignment with Marriott International and CALA business priorities.
  • Serve as a senior strategic communications advisor to the Chief Commercial Officer, CALA President, senior continent leaders, Global Communications & Public Affairs, and other enterprise stakeholders on media strategy, reputational risk, stakeholder priorities, and executive positioning.
  • Translate global enterprise, brand, loyalty, development, and commercial strategies into CALA-relevant narratives, communications platforms, media opportunities, and market activations across the region.
  • Lead reputation-building, earned media, executive visibility, influencer engagement, partnerships, and brand storytelling initiatives that strengthen Marriott’s leadership position and relevance across CALA.
  • Support Luxury, Premium, Select, All-Inclusive, Loyalty, Partnerships, and Development growth strategies by shaping differentiated communications platforms, brand narratives, executive storytelling, and market visibility plans.
  • Partner across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, Loyalty, Development, Owner & Franchise Services, Operations, and property leadership to connect communications, PR, and activations to demand generation, hotel openings, conversions, owner priorities, development momentum, customer engagement, and revenue growth.
  • Oversee activations to effectively support commercial priorities, brand strategy, customer engagement, loyalty growth, and market-level business objectives.
  • Lead internal communications and executive communications efforts across the region, positioning CALA senior leadership as industry voices through interviews, development news, and broader CALA business storytelling.
  • Lead regional crisis, issues management, and reputation response in partnership with continent, global, legal, HR, operations, ownership, and property stakeholders.
  • Serve as a senior communications partner and PR advocate with owners, General Managers, GSO, and property leaders, providing counsel and strategic guidance on reputation, visibility, and brand storytelling opportunities.
  • Liaise with GCPA, global Government Affairs, and Corporate Social Responsibility to ensure alignment with HQ communications and amplify the region’s business, community, sustainability, and social impact narratives.
  • Utilize a strong network of media, travel industry, business, and partner contacts to identify and expand visibility opportunities for the region.
  • Oversee the CALA Public Relations Center of Excellence, agency ecosystem, communications resources, and own the Communications + PR budget, setting priorities, strengthening capabilities, managing performance, and ensuring consistent execution across markets, brands, and properties.
  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing communications and PR organization, ensuring talent depth, clear accountability, succession readiness, and effective collaboration across markets, disciplines, agencies, and enterprise teams.
  • Establish disciplined resource, agency, and budget governance to ensure investment decisions are aligned to CALA’s business priorities, market opportunities, brand standards, and measurable impact.
  • Establish, track, and report KPIs for the discipline, including earned media, share of voice, awareness, engagement, reputation, and commercial impact.

MANAGEMENT COMPETENCIES

Leadership

  • Adaptability – Leads through ambiguity, complexity, and change across a highly matrixed, multi-market environment; anticipates shifts in business priorities, market dynamics, stakeholder needs, and reputational risk; and mobilizes teams and resources with clarity, resilience, and speed.
  • Communication – Demonstrates executive presence and communicates with clarity, credibility, and influence across senior leaders, owners, enterprise partners, media, agencies, and market teams; shapes complex issues into compelling narratives that build alignment, confidence, and action.
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making – Makes sound, timely decisions on complex business, communications, and reputation matters by balancing data, enterprise priorities, market realities, owner and customer impact, risk, and long-term brand value; gains alignment and drives disciplined execution.
  • Executive Presence and Professional Demeanor – Represents the company and the continent with confidence, discretion, judgment, and credibility; models Marriott’s values and builds trust with senior executives, owners, partners, associates, and external stakeholders.

Managing Execution

  • Building and Leading Teams – Builds, aligns, and inspires high-performing teams across disciplines, markets, agencies, and enterprise partners; creates clarity of purpose, accountability, collaboration, and shared ownership of continent-wide priorities.
  • Driving for Results – Sets clear priorities, measures progress, removes barriers, and delivers outcomes that advance CALA’s business, commercial, reputation, brand, owner, and customer objectives; holds self and others accountable for disciplined execution and measurable impact.
  • Planning and Organizing – Establishes integrated plans, governance, resources, and operating rhythms that translate strategy into execution across the continent; prioritizes investments, agency support, market needs, and stakeholder engagement to deliver against the highest-value opportunities.

Building Relationships

  • Enterprise and Coworker Relationships – Builds trusted, productive relationships across continent, global, discipline, property, and corporate teams; influences without direct authority and creates alignment across diverse priorities, functions, and geographies.
  • Customer, Owner, and Stakeholder Relationships – Develops and sustains relationships grounded in a deep understanding of customer, owner, franchisee, partner, and market needs; uses stakeholder insight to shape communications strategies that strengthen trust, relevance, and business value.
  • Global and Continent Mindset – Operates effectively across cultures, languages, markets, and business models; leverages diverse perspectives to strengthen innovation, engagement, reputation, and performance while ensuring CALA priorities are connected to Marriott’s enterprise direction.

Generating Talent and Organizational Capability

  • Organizational Capability – Designs and evolves the communications, PR, and activation operating model, team structure, agency ecosystem, processes, and governance to support business growth, scalability, consistency, and performance across the continent.
  • Talent Management – Attracts, develops, coaches, and retains diverse talent; builds succession strength, leadership capability, and clear accountability across teams; creates an inclusive environment where associates can perform, grow, and contribute to CALA’s priorities.

Learning and Applying Professional Expertise

  • Applied Learning – Demonstrates curiosity and disciplined learning; applies insights from business performance, media trends, customer behavior, owner feedback, technology, and market dynamics to improve strategy, capability, and outcomes for self and others.
  • Business Acumen – Uses financial, commercial, customer, owner, brand, loyalty, development, and market insights to shape strategy, prioritize resources, assess tradeoffs, and deliver communications and activation plans that support business growth and enterprise value.
  • Technical Acumen – Applies deep expertise in public relations, executive communications, internal communications, media relations, reputation management, issues/crisis response, activations, storytelling, agency governance, and measurement to advance CALA and Marriott International priorities.
  • Communications and Media – Maintains senior-level understanding of the evolving media, digital, social, influencer, business, travel, and consumer landscape; uses this knowledge to shape reputation-building, executive visibility, and storytelling strategies that are locally relevant and globally aligned.
  • Executive Expression and Comprehension – Listens actively, interprets complex business and stakeholder needs, and communicates with precision, creativity, and judgment across written, verbal, visual, and executive forums.

Executive Functional Competencies – Demonstrates the advanced judgment, analytical discipline, digital fluency, communication excellence, and stakeholder management capabilities required to lead a senior, continent-level function.

  • Digital and Technology Fluency – Uses relevant digital, communications, collaboration, analytics, and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, storytelling, measurement, governance, and decision-making.
  • Analytical Reasoning – Interprets performance data, media metrics, customer and owner insights, financial indicators, and market trends to identify opportunities, evaluate impact, and guide strategic decisions.
  • Listening and Stakeholder Insight – Listens for business context, stakeholder priorities, risk signals, and market nuance; uses insight to shape strategy, messaging, counsel, and engagement.
  • Comprehension and Judgment – Quickly understands complex written materials, business issues, policies, market context, and stakeholder perspectives; applies sound judgment to synthesize implications and determine appropriate action.
  • Executive Writing – Produces clear, concise, audience-appropriate written communications for senior leaders, owners, associates, media, partners, and enterprise stakeholders; adapts tone, message, and format to purpose and audience.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com, established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 50 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspires to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Build and grow Trip.com's Attractions business in France through strategic partnerships with tourism venues. The role owns attraction acquisition, contracting, onboarding, account growth, and renewal across museums, landmarks, theme parks, zoos, aquariums, observation decks, cultural institutions, and other ticketed venues, securing differentiated products, competitive pricing, reliable availability, and strong content that generate incremental GMV, expand online distribution, and improve the traveler experience.


Why this role:

  • Own the growth of Trip.com's Attractions business in France, one of Europe's largest and most diverse visitor-attraction markets.
  • Build senior relationships with major attraction groups, independent venues, museums, monuments, theme parks, cultural institutions, and public-sector stakeholders.
  • Drive measurable results across attraction acquisition, product activation, online distribution adoption, incremental GMV, and strategic account growth.


In this Role, you’ll:

Market Strategy and Attraction Acquisition

  • Develop France market and category plans using sales data, traveler demand, market trends, and competitor activity; build a qualified pipeline across priority destinations and attraction categories.
  • Source, sign, and activate high-potential museums, landmarks, theme parks, zoos, aquariums, observation decks, cultural institutions, and other ticketed attractions.
  • Lead commercial proposals and contract negotiations covering commissions, net rates, pricing, inventory, timed-entry capacity, allotments, cut-off times, cancellation terms, content, marketing support, and renewals.

Key Account Growth and Digital Distribution

  • Own strategic attraction relationships through regular reporting, senior stakeholder engagement, joint business reviews, performance plans, and disciplined renewal management.
  • Improve product coverage, exclusivity, price competitiveness, ticket and timeslot availability, content quality, booking conditions, conversion, and distribution performance across priority accounts.
  • Help attraction partners expand online sales and connect digital distribution through stronger channel connectivity, optimized inventory, digital content, promotions, and data-led commercial plans.

Onboarding and Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate Operations, Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, and Marketing to deliver efficient contracting, connectivity, content setup, ticket validation, product onboarding, testing, and launch readiness.
  • Resolve booking, redemption, and service issues quickly, maintain partner health and service standards, and ensure reliable fulfillment and a strong traveler experience after launch.

Strategic Partnerships and Destination Development

  • Identify and execute scalable commercial projects, including attraction-group agreements, exclusive products, city passes, bundles, seasonal programs, destination campaigns, and new distribution opportunities.
  • Build relationships with tourism boards, destination organizations, leading booking and ticketing systems, industry associations, and other ecosystem partners; translate market insights into new supply and market-share opportunities.


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • At least 3 years of B2B sales, business development, key account management, or strategic partnership experience in attractions, ticketing, OTAs, travel technology, tourism, or a related sector.
  • Proven success acquiring and growing attraction, venue, cultural-institution, or travel-supplier partnerships through complex commercial and contract cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Native or full professional proficiency in French plus fluent English, with strong written, presentation, and senior stakeholder communication skills.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage GMV, pricing, inventory, conversion, account plans, and partner economics using data.
  • Highly organized, resilient, and hands-on; comfortable coordinating commercial, technical, operational, legal, and marketing workstreams in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Able to travel frequently across France for attraction meetings, trade events, onboarding, product reviews, and issue resolution.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships with leading French attraction groups, museums, monuments, theme parks, cultural institutions, tourism boards, or booking-system partners.
  • Experience with booking and ticketing systems, channel management, API integrations, product onboarding, and OTA distribution operations.
  • Understanding of timed entry, capacity and inventory management, yield, ticket validation, voucher redemption, and on-site attraction operations.
  • Experience helping venues increase online sales adoption and scale a successful attraction or destination partnership playbook across multiple markets.


Why Trip.com Group

As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. At Trip.com Group, we are here to support you in and out of the workplace, enabling you to explore and embrace more possibilities and pursue a dream life.


What’s more?

  • A fast-growing enviroment that offers strong potential for career growth and encourages bold ideas.
  • We focus on cutting-edge technology to provide some of the best platforms and resources for you to do your best work.
  • We encourage internal talent movement and provide global opportunities across functions, business units or regions for you to accelerate your career advancement.
  • Thrive in a talented, supportive team with genuine, rigorous, and focused individuals who can inspire you from day one.
  • Enjoy flexible working arrangement and various engagements outside of work that make your life at Trip.com Group Fulfilling.

Click the link to learn more about “This Is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!”


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity

The Performance Marketing team is looking for a strategic and data-driven Senior Manager to lead the marketing function for one of Agoda's most strategic partnerships, owning the P&L, leading a team, and driving partnership strategy.

This partnership generates millions in annual revenue across multiple whitelabel brands serving millions of travelers globally.

This position sits at the intersection of strategic thinking and operational excellence — someone who can lead a team, shape marketing strategy, influence partnership direction, and drive measurable business impact through data-driven decision-making and complex stakeholder management.

We're looking for a proven leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds clarity through frameworks, and can lead complex cross-functional initiatives with discipline and influence, earning strong stakeholder trust and executive confidence.

As a key player in the marketing and partnership ecosystem, you will work closely with partner marketing leadership, regional business development teams, and Agoda's commercial and product teams to ensure marketing strategies align with business priorities and contribute directly to revenue goals. You'll be responsible for end-to-end marketing leadership for the partnership.

What Makes This Role Unique

Scale & Impact

  • Own a full P&L for a multi-million dollar partnership
  • Direct control over budget allocation and investment levels across channels
  • Your optimization decisions drive both immediate ROI and long-term partnership health

Strategic Complexity

  • Manage multiple brands with different customer profiles
  • Navigate the intersection of B2B partnership management and B2C performance marketing
  • Balance partner relationships with data-driven optimization
  • Influence partner marketing strategy while ensuring Agoda profitability targets

Channel Mastery & Technical Growth

You'll oversee the full marketing funnel:

  • Metasearch (Google Hotel Ads, TripAdvisor, Trivago, Kayak) — optimize bidding strategies, feed management, price competitiveness
  • Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing) — keyword strategy, campaign structure, budget optimization
  • App Marketing (Google ACi, Apple ASA) — drive app adoption in key markets
  • Emerging Channels (SEO, email/CRM, customer marketing) — build new growth drivers
  • Advanced SQL for booking analysis and channel performance tracking
  • A/B testing and experimentation methodology with clear measurement frameworks
  • Marketing analytics including attribution modeling and incrementality measurement

Cross-Cultural Collaboration

  • Weekly syncs with partner marketing team
  • Joint planning and collaborative problem-solving
  • Navigate cultural nuances in partnership management

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Development
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 2-3 marketing specialists
  • Set team priorities and OKRs aligned to partnership goals
  • Conduct performance reviews and career development conversations
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and accountability
  • Strategic Marketing Leadership & P&L Ownership
  • Set overall marketing strategy and influence ROI targets; optimize investment levels to ensure we hit partnership goals
  • Guide team on channel strategies and ensure execution excellence
  • Own the full marketing P&L for the partnership
  • Design experimentation roadmap to validate strategic hypotheses
  • Monitor channel health and guide team to drill into anomalies or opportunities
  • Oversee dashboard/reporting development and team analytics capability
  • Analytics Strategy & Insights
  • Define analytics roadmap and experimentation strategy for the team
  • Write SQL queries to answer strategic business questions and guide team on complex analysis
  • Guide team on measurement frameworks and experiment design
  • Synthesize insights into executive-ready recommendations with business impact quantification
  • Build team capability in analytics and experimentation
  • Strategic Planning & Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Develop annual marketing roadmap and quarterly plans aligned to partnership goals
  • Lead weekly syncs with partner marketing leadership
  • Present quarterly business reviews to Agoda leadership (Director/VP level)
  • Own the annual planning process and budget allocation across channels
  • Partner with Agoda's commercial and product teams on partnership optimization
  • Pitch strategic initiatives to partner executives and navigate differing viewpoints with influence and data
  • Program & Project Management
  • Lead large, multi-workstream initiatives end-to-end
  • Build detailed project plans with risk mitigation and milestone tracking
  • Establish governance cadence and reporting mechanisms
  • Ensure disciplined execution across markets and teams

Requirements

We're looking for candidates who demonstrate:

  • Analytical & Technical Skills
  • SQL proficiency (daily usage for analysis; comfortable working with multiple tables and complex joins)
  • Strong analytical thinking with ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Comfort with marketing analytics tools (Google Ads, attribution platforms, dashboards)
  • Bonus: Experience with experimentation design and statistical analysis
  • 7-10+ years in marketing, growth, or analytics roles
  • Marketing Channel Knowledge
  • Understanding of performance marketing fundamentals (PPC, metasearch, app marketing, or SEO)
  • Experience optimizing marketing campaigns toward ROI/profitability targets
  • Familiarity with attribution models and incrementality measurement
  • Background in digital marketing, growth marketing, or marketing analytics preferred
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  • 5+ years people management experience or demonstrated team leadership
  • Ability to influence without direct authority in a matrix organization
  • Executive communication skills — comfortable presenting to VP/Director level stakeholders
  • Required: Complex stakeholder management including partner relationships at senior levels
  • Cultural sensitivity for cross-border collaboration
  • Execution Excellence
  • Exceptional project management discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
  • Strong attention to detail without losing strategic altitude
  • Business Orientation
  • Understands P&L drivers and growth mechanics
  • Makes data-informed decisions
  • Focused on impact, not activity

What We Offer

Ownership & Impact

  • You're not executing someone else's strategy — you're owning the outcomes
  • Test new ideas, run experiments, see direct impact on partnership performance
  • High visibility to leadership; your metrics are partnership KPIs

Learning Environment

  • Work with Agoda's best-in-class marketing practices
  • Experimentation culture with clear measurement and learning
  • Complex, ambiguous problems that build problem-solving skills

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Hotel Manager, you’re not just overseeing day-to-day hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Manage hotel operations: Oversee the overall functioning of the property, with direct oversight of operational performance.
  • Act as the General Manager delegate: Assume full operational leadership responsibilities in the absence of the General Manager
  • Maximize performance and satisfaction: Drive operational efficiency, profitability, and service excellence to ensure a high level of guest and team member satisfaction. Partner with commercial and finance leadership to maximize sales opportunities and financial control
  • Oversee quality and service initiatives: Implement and manage daily quality assurance processes to enhance the guest experience and ensure alignment with brand standards
  • Communicate with key stakeholders: Partner with hotel owners and corporate leadership to align business goals and operational strategy
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

The People Product & Tech Team supports Expedia Group’s people strategy by creating experiences, programs, and tools that help our employees grow, contribute, and succeed.

Within this organization, the Workday Platform Engineering team enables scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions across the employee lifecycle and enterprise operations. We partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, Product, and Technology leaders to improve platform adoption, deliver meaningful business outcomes, and continuously evolve the Workday ecosystem.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of 10 - 12 Workday engineers, integration developers, and platform specialists.
  • Own the delivery and operation of Workday capabilities, including HCM, Recruiting, Talent, Learning, Compensation, Payroll, Security, Reporting, Prism, Extend, and Integrations.
  • Define and execute the Workday platform roadmap with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Promote platform reliability, security, performance, scalability, and operational excellence.
  • Lead large-scale implementations, enhancements, releases, and transformation initiatives.
  • Establish engineering standards, integration patterns, governance, and best practices.
  • Oversee team capacity, workforce planning, performance development, and career growth.
  • Partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into technology solutions and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion automation, innovation, and continuous improvement across the Workday ecosystem.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to use AI to provide a better user experience or efficiencies back to our teams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on Workday capabilities, architecture, and industry trends.

Required

Experience and Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in Workday, HR technology, enterprise applications, or platform engineering.
  • 3+ years of experience leading technical teams.
  • Deep expertise in Workday architecture, configuration, integrations, security, reporting, and platform operations.
  • Proven experience leading Workday implementations, transformation programs, or optimization initiatives.
  • Proficient stakeholder management, communication, and strategic planning skills.
  • Experience delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives in Agile environments.

Preferred

  • Workday certifications in HCM, Integrations, Security, Payroll, Prism, Extend, or related modules.
  • Experience integrating Workday with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams.
  • Experience aligning technology investments with enterprise workforce and business strategies.

The ideal candidate is a strategic Workday technology leader who combines deep platform expertise with inclusive people leadership, influences senior stakeholders effectively, and builds strong teams while delivering business-critical HR and Finance technology outcomes.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $184,500.00 to $258,000.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $295,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.
