job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com, established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 50 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspires to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Build and grow Trip.com's Activities & Day Tours business across the UK and Nordic region. The role owns supplier acquisition, contracting, onboarding, account growth, and renewal across local experiences, city tours, day trips, sightseeing, transfers, food and beverage experiences, cruises, and outdoor activities, securing differentiated products, competitive pricing, reliable availability, and strong content that generate incremental GMV and improve the traveler experience


Why This Role:

  • Own the growth of Activities & Day Tours across the UK and Nordic region, covering mature city destinations and high-value nature-led experiences.
  • Build senior relationships across the regional experiences ecosystem, from tour operators and DMCs to sightseeing, transport, cruise, food and beverage, and outdoor-activity providers.
  • Drive measurable results across supplier acquisition, product activation, competitive supply, incremental GMV, and strategic account development.


In this Role, you’ll:

Market Strategy and Supplier Acquisition

  • Develop market and category plans for the UK and Nordic countries using sales data, customer demand, market trends, and competitor activity; build a qualified pipeline across priority destinations and product categories.
  • Source, sign, and activate high-potential tour operators, DMCs, local experience providers, sightseeing companies, transport and cruise operators, and other activities suppliers.
  • Lead commercial proposals and contract negotiations covering commissions, net rates, pricing, inventory, capacity, cut-off times, cancellation terms, content, marketing support, and renewals.

Key Account Growth and Product Competitiveness

  • Own strategic supplier relationships through regular reporting, senior stakeholder engagement, joint business reviews, performance plans, and disciplined renewal management.
  • Improve product coverage, exclusivity, price competitiveness, inventory availability, content quality, booking conditions, conversion, and distribution performance across priority accounts.
  • Develop joint business and marketing plans with key suppliers, including promotions, merchandising, seasonal campaigns, and destination-led growth initiatives.

Onboarding and Operational Excellence

  • Coordinate Operations, Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, and Marketing to deliver efficient contracting, connectivity, content setup, product onboarding, testing, and launch readiness.
  • Resolve booking and service issues quickly, maintain supplier health and service standards, and ensure reliable fulfillment and a strong traveler experience after launch.

Commercial Projects and Destination Development

  • Identify and execute scalable commercial projects, including exclusive product launches, seasonal programs, destination campaigns, bundles, and new distribution opportunities.
  • Build relationships with tourism boards, DMCs, booking systems, industry associations, and other ecosystem partners; translate regional market insights into new supply and market-share opportunities.


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • At least 3 years of B2B sales, business development, key account management, or strategic partnership experience in tours and activities, OTAs, travel technology, tourism, or a related sector.
  • Proven success acquiring and growing tour-operator, DMC, activity-provider, or travel-supplier partnerships through complex commercial and contract cycles.
  • Full professional proficiency in English, with strong written, presentation, and senior stakeholder communication skills.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage GMV, pricing, inventory, conversion, account plans, and supplier economics using data.
  • Highly organized, resilient, and hands-on; comfortable owning both new business development and long-term account growth across multiple markets in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Able to travel frequently across the UK and Nordic countries for supplier meetings, trade events, onboarding, product reviews, and issue resolution.

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships with leading UK or Nordic tour operators, DMCs, local experience providers, sightseeing companies, tourism boards, or booking-system partners.
  • Experience across multiple product categories, including day tours, city sightseeing, food and beverage experiences, transfers, cruises, outdoor activities, and cultural experiences.
  • Familiarity with booking-system connectivity, channel management, API integrations, product onboarding, and OTA distribution operations.
  • Professional proficiency in a Nordic language and experience scaling a successful activities or destination playbook across multiple European markets.



Why Trip.com Group

As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. At Trip.com Group, we are here to support you in and out of the workplace, enabling you to explore and embrace more possibilities and pursue a dream life.


What’s more?

  • We encourage internal talent movement and provide global opportunities across functions, business units or regions for you to accelerate your career advancement.
  • Thrive in a talented, supportive team with genuine, rigorous, and focused individuals who can inspire you from day one.
  • Enjoy flexible working arrangement and various engagements outside of work that make your life at Trip.com Group Fulfilling.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

About Global Crisis Operations At Expedia Group

Expedia Group's Global Crisis Operations function was built from the ground up to provide coordinated, intelligence-driven crisis response across EG's portfolio of brands, including Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, and others. Our team spans Seattle, London, and Gurgaon, providing continuous global coverage across natural hazard events, geopolitical crises, aviation disruptions, public health events, and emerging threats.

We operate as a cross-functional hub, working daily with Finance, Legal, Government Affairs, Communications, Customer Operations, and a standing Crisis Tiger Team, to ensure EG can protect travelers and respond to disruption with speed, accuracy, and care.

What You'll Do

Crisis Monitoring and Assessment

  • Monitor global threat intelligence feeds, meteorological data, geopolitical risk sources, and open-source information streams to identify emerging crisis events in real time.
  • Assess severity, scope, and traveler impact of events including but not limited to tropical cyclones, earthquakes, wildfires, floods, civil unrest, armed conflict, terrorism, and mass casualty events.
  • Apply structured analytical frameworks to distinguish developing situations from noise, and escalate at the right threshold with clear impact assessments.
  • Maintain situational awareness across multiple concurrent events, producing concise internal intelligence summaries for leadership and cross-functional partners.

Response Operations

  • Execute crisis response actions within established SLAs, including activating traveler communication workflows, updating flex waiver policies, and coordinating with airline and hotel partner relations teams.
  • Participate in and help facilitate cross-functional war room syncs during active crisis events, driving toward clear actions, owners, and timelines.
  • Support the development and deployment of proactive in-app and email traveler messaging, applying governance frameworks to determine notification thresholds.
  • Coordinate with Customer Operations, Trust and Safety, Legal, Government Affairs, and Communications stakeholders to align on response posture.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Contribute to monthly and quarterly crisis operations metrics narratives, including executive-level summaries covering event volume, response performance, and trend analysis.
  • Perform post-event reviews to identify process gaps, near-misses, and improvement opportunities; document findings in standardized formats.
  • Maintain and improve crisis event logs, SharePoint trackers, and internal knowledge bases to ensure institutional knowledge is retained and searchable.
  • Produce clear, concise performance reports for leadership audiences, translating operational data into narratives that support decisions about resourcing, thresholds, and process improvements.

Data and Exposure Analysis

  • Query traveler booking, itinerary, and operational data to quantify how many travelers are in an affected area, what products they hold, and what remediation options are available, using SQL across EG's internal data platforms including Trino and Querybook.
  • Build and maintain exposure trackers that give leadership a real-time picture of traveler and partner impact during an active event, updated as the situation evolves.
  • Translate raw data into clear escalation inputs: how many travelers are affected, what is the financial exposure, what decisions are time-sensitive, and what actions are already in motion.
  • Identify patterns across historical crisis events to inform threshold definitions, SLA calibration, and playbook updates.

AI in Crisis Operations

Expedia Group is actively investing in AI-assisted operations and expects analysts to be fluent, practical users of AI tools in their day-to-day work. In this role, that means the following.

  • Use AI tools to accelerate monitoring and signal detection across large volumes of threat intelligence, news, and meteorological data, reducing the time between event onset and first assessment.
  • Leverage AI-assisted drafting to produce first-pass traveler communications, leadership updates, and situation summaries faster, while owning the review, accuracy, and final judgment on every output before it goes out.
  • Apply AI tools to impact analysis tasks including trend detection, exposure pattern recognition, and historical event comparison, using outputs to sharpen the quality and speed of escalation decisions.
  • Contribute to the team's AI adoption efforts by sharing what works, flagging what does not, and helping build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that raise the floor for the whole team.

Process and Governance

  • Use ServiceNow to manage the full lifecycle of crisis incidents end to end, from initial logging and classification through active monitoring, stakeholder updates, escalation tracking, and closure, ensuring every event has a complete, auditable record.
  • Contribute to the development and upkeep of Standard Operating Procedures, runbooks, and response playbooks across natural hazard and geopolitical event types.
  • Identify gaps in existing policies and escalate with clear, evidence-based recommendations to senior team members and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support onboarding of new analysts by sharing operational knowledge, reviewing their work, and modeling strong analytical and communication standards.

Required

Who You Are

  • 3 to 5 years of professional experience in one or more of the following disciplines: operational meteorology, geopolitical risk analysis, security operations, emergency management, or crisis response.
  • Demonstrable ability to assess and communicate complex, fast-moving situations clearly and concisely, in writing and verbally, to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in or closely with a 24/7 operations environment, with comfort managing competing priorities under time pressure.
  • Strong data skills: comfortable writing and adapting SQL queries, building trackers and dashboards in Excel or Sheets, and translating raw metrics into clear recommendations. The ability to extract signal from operational data quickly is a core part of this job.
  • Active use of AI tools in a professional setting, including large language models, AI-assisted monitoring or summarization tools, or automated alerting systems. You do not need to be an AI engineer, but you should be using AI regularly to work faster and better, and be able to speak to how.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Excel), Confluence, and Jira or equivalent ticketing platforms.
  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, International Relations, Political Science, Security Studies, Geography, Emergency Management, or a closely related field is required. Candidates with 6 or more years of applicable professional experience in crisis operations, emergency management, meteorology, geopolitical risk, or a related discipline will be considered equivalent in place of a formal degree.

Preferred

  • Experience with commercial threat intelligence platforms such as Crisis24, NC4, Everbridge, or OSAC, or meteorological data services such as The Weather Company, DTN, or StormGeo.
  • Background in travel, hospitality, aviation, or a platform or marketplace business where the customer population is globally distributed and mobile.
  • Familiarity with airline disruption frameworks including IRROPs, Event Waivers, and ASCs, or hotel flex policy structures.
  • Experience with CRM or case management platforms such as ServiceNow or Salesforce, including hands-on incident or case logging, queue management, and status tracking. Familiarity with managing a case through its full lifecycle from open to close is a meaningful advantage in this role.
  • Professional certification in emergency management (CEM, AEM), security (CPP, PSP), or a related discipline.

What Sets You Apart

The best candidates for this role think in systems, not checklists. You understand that a Category 4 storm making landfall in Cancun is not just a weather event. It is a cascade of flight cancellations, hotel evacuations, stranded travelers, partner relations calls, and leadership questions that all hit simultaneously. You have been in that kind of environment before. You know how to stay calm, communicate clearly, and keep others oriented when things are moving fast.

How a Strong Analyst Operates At EG

Crisis operations does not reward hesitation. The value this role delivers comes from the speed and accuracy of judgment under pressure. A strong analyst at EG does the following.

  • Recognizes early signals and assesses what requires immediate attention, distinguishing developing situations from background noise before others have flagged them.
  • Prioritizes traveler safety, material exposure, and time-sensitive decisions above completeness, because in crisis work a good decision now is almost always better than a perfect decision later.
  • Moves from information gathering to recommendation and action quickly, without waiting to be asked what the next step is.
  • Escalates early when delay could increase traveler, partner, operational, or reputational impact, and escalates with enough context that the person receiving it can act immediately.
  • Maintains momentum across handoffs, approvals, communications, and follow-up, treating every open thread as their responsibility until it is formally closed or handed to a named owner.
  • Stays calm and accurate under pressure, because the organization takes its cue from how the analyst communicates, and panic or imprecision in a crisis brief is its own kind of risk.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

Company Description

Set amidst the Asian Medical Hub of Mount Elizabeth Hospital, Ibis Singapore Novena is located at the outskirts of Singapore’s city centre. The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the United Square and Velocity Mall. It is a 15-minute drive from the popular Orchard Road and the Central Business District.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Close interaction with the hotel’s senior management.

Takes part in determining budget and strategy & is accountable for its implementation.

He/she is responsible for pricing strategy and for optimizing inventory.

Must provide a global perspective on Revenue Management to the whole hotel.

Organization and monitoring of all affairs concerned to the position.

Proper grooming at all times.

Attend trainings as per schedule.

Show fullest cooperation and respect within the team and other departments.

Is aware of the daily activities and has product knowledge of all the hotel facilities

Supports the budgetary process and the yearly strategy.

Devises the yearly budget per segment, per day.

Determines sales strategy.

Determines yearly rate tables for all market segments.

Develops and steers the hotel’s Revenue strategy.

Prepares forecasts and chairs the Revenue meeting

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Taiwan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok or Shanghai office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week / Relocation support will be provided).

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Taiwan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Taiwan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Taiwan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Taiwan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 5+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for decades led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. Today, nothing is more important than the health and safety of our customers and employees. Since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, Delta has moved quickly to transform the industry standard of clean while offering customers more space across the travel journey. Headquartered in Atlanta, Delta serves nearly 200 million people every year, taking customers across its industry-leading global network to more than 300 destinations in over 50 countries. Through innovative partnerships with Aeromexico, Air France-KLM, Virgin Atlantic, Korean Air, LATAM and WestJet, Delta has brought more choice and competition to customers worldwide.

Delta seeks Undergraduate Interns for the Commercial Strategy Analyst (CSA) Program Internship. This paid Summer 2027 internship program is designed to accelerate the development of high-potential analysts by deepening their understanding of Delta’s business, expanding their skills and providing opportunities to develop leadership capabilities. Successful interns may be offered a full-time job upon completion of their internship based on their performance.

Employment Opportunities For The Commercial Strategy Intern Include

Network Planning

Craft route structures, analyze new city and route opportunities, and determine capacity response to

competitive actions.

Revenue Management

Optimize Delta revenue through valuing passengers, forecasting future demand & initialing pricing actions.

Global Sales & Cargo

Analyze the financial contribution of corporations and agencies or optimize revenue for Delta’s cargo

network.

Customer Experience & Design

Refine the customer experience at the airport and onboard through improvements to technology,

products & services.

Digital

Power the travel journey with world-class Digital experiences that empower, engage, and inspire our customers and our people.

Marketing

Build Delta’s brand strategy and develop marketing campaigns and communications.

Loyalty

Grow the loyal customer base and premium revenue through the SkyMiles program and AMEX co-brand

Reservations

Propose recommendations for process improvements and a better customer experience for call centers

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • You are a rising senior in an undergraduate program with a graduation date of Spring/Summer 2028.
    • Candidates who have graduated and are employed full-time will not be considered.
  • Must be enrolled as a full-time student pursuing an undergraduate degree in a 4-year academic institution.
  • At least a 3.0 GPA on a 4-point scale.
  • This position requires student to work full-time during the Summer 2027 semester. Student cannot actively take any courses (inclusive of online or in-person) and work as a Co-op/Intern at the same time, which may delay graduation by 1-2 semesters.
  • Must be able to work onsite in our Atlanta, GA office for the duration of the Co-op.
  • Working as a Co-op/Intern does not guarantee a full-time opportunity at Delta Air Lines upon graduation. This position is intended to provide educational and professional work experience to prepare the student for the workforce.
  • You have demonstrated the ability to interpret data, use it to form concrete business actions, and present findings.
  • You are a creative problem solver with a familiarity of economic concepts.
  • You can work in a time-sensitive environment and effectively prioritize tasks.
  • You thrive in team settings. You collaborate well, learn from others, and use your skills to help them.
  • You are a proactive, clear communicator.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.
What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Ideal candidates have demonstrated to be a collaborator and creative problem-solvers.
  • Prior Internships/Co-Op/Extracurricular experiences are recommended
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Tableau, SQL, Delta internal tools and software preferred

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

With over 100,000 Delta employees across the globe, our culture is rooted in a shared commitment to living our values – Honesty, Integrity, Respect, Perseverance and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. When you join Delta, you truly begin the journey of your lifetime!

  • Domestic and International (standby) flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Access to over 500 discounts and specialty savings through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals, pet health services, Apple product discounts, exclusive tickets to sports games and more
  • Competitive pay for students based on their working hours
  • Eligible for pay on Holidays that are observed in your dedicated work area
  • Once in a lifetime experience through Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • Programs to engage with community service and sustainability
  • Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • On-site campus amenities include Starbucks, Gym, Emory Clinic, Walmart pharmacy and store, healthy dining options through Sodexo, edible garden and mental health coach
  • Backup dependent care services offered for 25 days highly subsidized by Delta
  • Housing Stipend available for students who reside more than 50 miles from work location

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Reporting to the Regional Vice President, Franchise Performance, the Manager, HERO Operations supports the engagement and activation of Brand Programs and Initiatives through the day-to-day direction and development of a team of HERO Coordinators.

The Manager, HERO Operations directs the HERO team within an assigned region, ensuring consistent franchisee support while fostering a collaborative, productive, and high-performing culture focused on delivering quality service. The job supports the onboarding and development of HERO Coordinators and, in coordination with the Regional Vice President, recommends talent decisions to help ensure the HERO team effectively implements Brand Programs and Initiatives that elevate Guest Satisfaction, Program Engagement, and Franchise Support Efficiency across a portfolio of midscale, upper midscale, and upscale properties.

Through the direction of the HERO team, the Manager, HERO Operations ensures hotels actively participate in Brand Programs and Initiatives by providing operational support, connecting hotels with the appropriate Choice resources, and maintaining clear, consistent communication between HERO Coordinators and Franchise Performance Directors to deliver quality franchisee support, strengthen owner engagement, and support initiative adoption.

The Manager, HERO Operations serves as a first-line escalation point for recurring and moderately complex franchise support issues and ensures HERO Coordinators maintain thorough documentation and clear, consistent communication, providing regular status updates to the Regional Vice President on team operations, owner engagement, and support trends. During periods of business need and as directed by the Regional Vice President, the Manager may directly support an assigned portfolio of hotels to ensure continuity of franchise support and service delivery.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Team Leadership

  • Direct and develop a team of HERO Coordinators committed to delivering quality franchisee support, operational excellence, and consistent service delivery.
  • Support the onboarding of new HERO Coordinators and recommend candidates for hire, retention plans, and onboarding approaches to the Regional Vice President for review and approval.
  • Foster a collaborative and accountable team culture through day-to-day coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback.
  • Develop the capabilities of the HERO team through education on Choice programs, initiatives, systems, franchise support resources, and operational best practices.
  • Assign daily tasks, monitor workloads, and balance resources across the HERO Coordinator team to ensure consistent service delivery, escalating resource or performance concerns to the Regional Vice President as needed.
  • Ensure HERO Coordinators deliver positive owner satisfaction through proactive communication, Brand Program activation, timely problem resolution, and effective execution of Brand Programs and Initiatives.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for HERO Coordinators requiring support or guidance on recurring challenges, escalating novel or more complex issues to the Regional Vice President.
  • Provide regular status updates to the Regional Vice President on team performance, daily operational activities, owner engagement, and HERO Coordinator development needs.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve HERO service delivery, operational effectiveness, and franchisee support, seeking Regional Vice President guidance and approval before implementation.

Franchisee Support

  • Support HERO Coordinators in establishing collaborative and professional business relationships with hotels.
  • Coordinate with Franchise Performance Directors to monitor hotel action plans resulting from Service, Profitability, or Total Business Review visits, ensuring HERO Coordinators provide timely feedback and report analysis to Directors prior to hotel visits.
  • Support HERO Coordinators in maintaining current knowledge of Brand Standards, effectively communicating franchise value propositions, and confirming enabling tools are in place to improve hotel profitability, revenue growth, and guest experience.
  • Execute communication protocols and support strategies as directed by the Regional Vice President during crises or disasters, ensuring the HERO Coordinator team is informed and responsive.
  • Support HERO Coordinators in monitoring owner satisfaction, guest satisfaction, and Brand Program implementation and provide regular summaries of recurring trends to the Regional Vice President.
  • Compile and review franchisee feedback, operational trends, and recurring support issues, and provide findings and recommendations to the Regional Vice President for further communication to Brand Operations and Centers of Excellence.
  • Escalate moderately complex or recurring franchise support issues to the Regional Vice President when they exceed standard support protocols or require additional coordination.
  • During staffing transitions, vacancies, or other business needs, and as directed by the Regional Vice President, directly support an assigned portfolio of hotels to ensure consistent franchise support and service delivery.

Operationalization and Execution of Brand Programs

  • Execute the implementation of new Brand Standards, initiatives, and programs through the HERO team, following established protocols and direction from Franchise Performance leadership.
  • Coordinate with Franchise Performance Directors and as directed by the Regional Vice President, with Brand and cross-functional business partners to ensure supporting documentation, systems, and electronic resources are accurately and consistently communicated to HERO Coordinators.
  • Participate in the Voice of Franchisee communication process, providing feedback to improve franchise communications and ensure messaging is clear, timely, and actionable.
  • Compile and communicate franchisee trends, operational challenges, and program feedback to the Regional Vice President for distribution to Franchise Performance leadership and Brand Operations.
  • Provide input representing the HERO Operations team's perspective and franchisee feedback to the Regional Vice President to inform cross-functional initiatives.
  • Ensure HERO Coordinators effectively support midscale, upper midscale, and upscale hotels in utilizing Choice applications, systems, programs, and resources.
  • Coordinate with Franchise Performance Directors to ensure newly onboarded hotels are accurately represented within Choice systems and applications, escalating system issues to the Regional Vice President as needed.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to improve operational efficiency, franchisee support processes, and the overall effectiveness of the HERO Operations team, seeking Regional Vice President review and approval prior to implementation.

Skills, Educational Background And Experience

  • Associate College Degree or Bachelor's Degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hotel or hospitality operations experience, with Choice branded hotel experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience coaching, developing, and supervising a team preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting the onboarding and development of team members.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong coaching, mentoring, and supervisory skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to support team accountability and maintain collaborative working relationships with direct partners.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficient in the use of MS Office applications, such as Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
  • Must be able to model Choice's Values in order to be bold, be quick, listen, be curious, and act with integrity.
  • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $81,310.00 - $95,659.00. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
Overview

Enterprise Mobility is currently looking for an Accountant to join our team in Strongsville, OH. The Administrative office oversees the accounting functions for the Northern Ohio market of Enterprise Mobility, operating Alamo Rent a Car, Enterprise Rent-A-Car and National Car Rental. We offer a full-cycle accounting experience (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Audit and Tax) for our employees and work hard to train them to be future business leaders. This is a career path position which would be ideal for an individual looking to grow and be promoted to management positions within the company.

The Accountant position is responsible for financial statement preparation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, tax compliance, audit, among other duties and responsibilities. The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Java Senior Software Engineer in the Technology Team you will be in charge of:

  • Have meaningful experience being in a Senior Engineer role driving technical work for other engineers. You stay up-to-date on industry trends and understand how to apply them.

  • Improve code structure and architecture, taking care of testability and maintainability, and identifying opportunities for technical investments to help the team meet the objectives.

What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Deep understanding of software engineering concepts such as OOP, functional programming, concurrency, data structures, design and architecture patterns, databases, APIs etc.;
  • Experience working with the entire software development cycle, including deploying to production and testing (both unit and integration), as well as Cloud and Continuous Delivery environments;

  • Strong focus on quality, and a technical excellence mindset;
  • Excellent communication skills and an open mind to reach agreements for the benefit of the team and your stakeholders;

  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Organization- ALGV/HIC/AMS/UVC Corporate Office

Summary

The Opportunity

Hyatt Hotels Corporation seeks an enthusiastic Regional Director of Commercial Performance to join our Commercial Regional team. In this role, you will be collaborating closely with the broader Revenue, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance and Communications teams, where you’ll be instrumental in continuing to make Hyatt a leading hospitality company. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Work-life benefits including wellbeing initiatives

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results driven and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

________________________________________

The Role

The Regional Director of Commercial Performance is responsible for driving commercial performance across a portfolio of hotels within the assigned region through strategic leadership of sales, revenue management, distribution, marketing, and business development initiatives. This role partners closely with property leadership and ownership / asset management groups to develop and execute commercial strategies and plans that maximize revenue, market share, profitability, and brand positioning, while adapting priorities and execution to the specific needs and business objectives of each hotel. The position serves as a key regional advisor and commercial leader, ensuring disciplined implementation, accountability, and sustainable topline growth while maintaining and leveraging strong owner relationships.

Qualifications

Experience Required:

  • 8–10 years industry experience in hospitality, commercial strategy, sales, revenue management, or related disciplines
  • Experience working in regional or multi-unit commercial operations preferred
  • Advanced knowledge of hotel commercial systems, revenue management tools, marketing, digital and CRM platforms preferred

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree level qualification or equivalent experience (10+ years) required
  • Experience with function-specific hotel systems
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Strong analytical, leadership, and strategic planning capabilities
  • Demonstrated experience leading commercial teams in a multi-property or regional environment
  • Proven ability to drive revenue growth and achieve commercial performance targets
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

________________________________________

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. 新規ホテル開業コマーシャルマネージャーは、日本＆マイクロネシア担当のコマーシャル部門ディレクターを支援し、新規ホテルの開業およびホテルのコンバージョン・統合に伴う商業活動を管理する責任を負います。また、セールス、マーケティング、PR、チャネル、流通、リレーションシップマネジメントの各部門の活動を調整し、ライフサイクル＆グロースチームと緊密に連携します。

日々の業務

ホテル開業マネージャー（HOM）において、コマーシャルチームのクリティカルパストタスクを推進し、すべてのタスクが期限内に、適切な担当者またはチームによって完了され、関連ツールが効果的に活用されるよう確保します。

日本＆マイクロネシアのセールス・マーケティング担当ディレクター、コマーシャル担当ディレクター／エリア・セールス・マーケティング担当ディレクターと連携し、新規ホテル開業に向けた開業前セールス・マーケティング計画およびプラットフォームを策定・実施することで、ホテル開業の商業的アジェンダを推進する。この際、セールス担当ディレクター、レベニュー管理担当ディレクター、マーケティング管理担当ディレクター、ならびにディストリビューション・リレーションシップ・マーケティングチームの支援を受け、連携して取り組む。新規開業ホテルのコミュニケーション、営業、マーケティング、PR、ディストリビューションマーケティング、およびレベニュー管理活動を、コマーシャル・ディレクター／エリア・セールス＆マーケティング・ディレクターと調整するとともに、ホテルと施設上層部との間で連携を図る。

開業後3ヶ月間のホテルの立ち上がり状況と業績の伸びを監視し、戦略会議においてビジネスを最大化するための提言を行うとともに、客室単価および稼働率の目標達成を確実にするため、営業・マーケティング担当ディレクターに対し、効果的な営業・マーケティング戦略および活動の策定に向けた指針を示す。

IHGの営業手法に基づき、営業ツールや標準業務手順書（SOP）の導入状況および活用状況を測定・監視し、グローバルおよび地域チームからのベストプラクティスの共有を促進する。

募集要項

学歴

マーケティングまたはビジネス分野の学位、または同等の国際的な学位を有することが望ましい

業界外の知識を有し、継続的な学習を通じて最新のトレンドを把握していること

国際的なホテルブランドにおける戦略的な営業・マーケティングの経験

期限を守ることができる

IHGのシステムに関する実務知識が豊富であり、IHGネットワーク内での成果を理解し、推進する能力がある

市場および多様な地域での事業展開の背景について深い理解を持っている

ビジョンを理解し、それを現実のものとして実行に移すことができる、強力なリーダーである

効果的に成果を上げるために、創造的に問題を解決できる

強固で信頼できる関係を構築できる。忍耐強く、かつ粘り強い

Role Purpose

This role is responsible for the supporting the Directors of Commercial in region to manage the commercial activity for new hotel openings and hotel conversions / integration, coordinating activities of all functions of sales, marketing, PR, Channels, distribution and relationship management – working closely with Lifecycle & Growth teams.

Key Accountabilities

  • Drive the Commercial Team critical path tasks in Hotel Opening Manager (HOM) ensuring all tasks are completed on time, by the correct person or team and the relevant tools have been effectively utilized.
  • Works closely with the Lifecycle and Growth global and regional teams to ensure any applicable processes, tools and procedures can be consistently applied in all openings and conversions.
  • Drive the Hotel Openings commercial agenda by working with the on-property Director of Sales and Marketing, Director Commercial/Area Director of Sales and Marketing to develop and implement the pre-opening Sales and Marketing Plan and platforms for new hotel openings in the region supported by and, in conjunction with, the Director of Sales, Director of Revenue Management and Director of Marketing Management and Distribution and Relationship Marketing Teams across the region. Co-ordinate the communication and sales, marketing, PR, distribution marketing and revenue management activity for new opening hotels with the Director, Commercial/Area Director of Sales and Marketing and between hotel and above property functions.
  • Monitor pick up and ramp up of the hotel in the first 3 months of opening and provide inputs in strategy meetings to maximize business and provide direction to Directors of Sales and Marketing in the development of effective sales and marketing strategies and activities to ensure rate and occupancy objectives are achieved.
  • Support the Directors of Commercial and the Area Directors of Sales & Marketing to roll out and embed any new commercial tools or processes in the business.
  • Measure and monitor the adoption and utilization of commercial tools and SOP, from IHG way of Sales and facilitate the sharing of Best Practices from global and regional teams

Key Skills & Experiences

Educational Attainment

  • Degree or equivalent international degree in Marketing or Business desired
  • Is able to demonstrate external industry knowledge and continuous learning, keeping up to date with current trends Critical Expertise & Experience
  • International hotel brand strategic sales and marketing experience
  • Experience in Hotel Sales and Marketing in a senior management role
  • Clear project management capability
  • Has experience participating in an industry task force

Required Skills

  • Establishes goals and objectives and sets performance targets
  • Ability to manage and coordinate multiple tasks
  • Partnership driven, able to collaborate and rally multiple stakeholders to deliver to deadlines and activity.
  • Can meet deadlines
  • Good working knowledge of IHG systems and the ability to understand and drive outcomes within the IHG network
  • Has a deep understanding of the markets and the context of operating in a diverse region
  • A strong leader, who can understand the vision and how to translate this into reality and execution
  • Is able to creatively solve problems in order to deliver effectively
  • Builds strong and credible relationships. Is patient, yet persistent
  • Culturally aware

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Your mission

GetYourGuide is looking for a Director of Lifecycle & CRM to set the vision for how we use communication and engagement with our customers throughout their journey with us, over multiple trips, to increase our value as a marketplace to them. This role is accountable for setting the lifecycle strategy and owning the canonical standards for customer segmentation, journeys and states, and messaging architecture.

Along with a talented group of leaders across Creative, Data, Marketing, Product and UX, you will build the operating system and guardrails that empowers teams to bring your vision to reality and ensures we deliver a consistent, high-quality, customer-first experience as well as incremental customer lifetime value (CLV) to the business.

What You’ll Do

Set the lifecycle strategy and own key lifecycle definitions

  • Define the end-to-end lifecycle vision and maintain a multi-quarter roadmap across multiple directly managed and stakeholder teams to drive repeat bookings, next trip, churn prevention, and winback
  • Working with key stakeholders, set standard definitions for customer segmentation, customer state, journey stages, and messaging framework that are leveraged across functions
  • Build a shared data language of Lifecycle by defining KPIs and success for the domain
  • Own lifecycle budgets and investment strategy

Create platforms and operating systems that power Lifecycle success

  • Raise the bar on personalization and relevance, creating a clear vision around customer data, content and messaging that speaks contextually, empathetically and one-on-one with our customers.
  • Partner with Brand, Creative, and UX to build scalable content systems that improve quality and speed of experimentation across the organization.
  • Partner with Data and Product to build a customer platform that teams can use across the journey to improve relevancy of touchpoints
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure lifecycle moments are integrated into the product

Build a world-class CRM operations platform

  • Lead a stellar experimentation-driven operation, including setting the standard for good experimentation design, A/B test setup, reviewing conclusions critically and upholding high statistical and customer insight standards throughout all workstreams.
  • Establish standards on QA, deliverability, compliance/consent, preference management, incident response, etc and partner with Engineering to create the tools and platform to achieve technical excellence.
  • Partner with Engineering and Data to design event strategy, data flows and instrumentation.

Lead and influence a high-performing org

  • Help build and lead a world-class lifecycle team
  • Directly manage a CRM marketing team - design roles, hire and develop talent, and maintain a high performing team and culture that is driven by data, experimentation and quality.
  • Influence and align cross-functional leaders in Product, Data, Creative, UX, Brand, Marketing, Pricing and Engineering
  • Establish and manage the strategic and governance processes with the cross-functional leadership to maintain agility and executional success

What Success Looks Like (first 12 Months)

  • A clearly articulated lifecycle north star with defined customer segmentation, a customer-state model, and prioritization framework adopted across stakeholders.
  • A unified journey architecture across channels with collision management, governance, and systems driving meaningful improvements in customer experience.
  • A clear playbook on experimentation and incrementality
  • Meaningful progress on operations excellence - implementation of a robust event strategy, instrumentation, data / tracking reliability and measurement.
  • And, ultimately, demonstration of accelerated incremental CLV

Your toolkit

  • 10+ years in lifecycle/CRM/growth marketing or product, with at least several years leading scaled teams in a consumer, marketplace, travel, and/or brand-led tech environment.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership—able to align Product/UX, Marketing and Data under a shared vision and roadmap.
  • Proven track record owning an end-to-end lifecycle system that drove measurable, incremental business impact (not just opens/clicks).
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership—able to align Product/UX, Marketing and Data under a shared vision and roadmap.
  • Deep experience in multi-channel CRM (email, push, in-app, SMS/WhatsApp) and building journeys tied with product flows and touchpoints
  • Operational excellence: understands and manages modern CRM stacks and critical technical performance metrics.
  • Comfort working with technical partners on event schemas/instrumentation and turning messy data realities into a practical, staged plan.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction To The Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Make An Impact!

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager who is skilled at understanding market and customer needs and leveraging that to influence product strategy and roadmap. You know how to build strategic go-to-market plans and execute on them with cross-functional teams to drive growth. You are commercial minded and have expertise working with enterprise sales to grow the business.

Ready for your next challenge? Join our team of passionate product marketing professionals and grow your career.

The B2B Product Marketing Manager will be responsible for driving growth for a suite of products. Critical for success is a deep understanding of our customers’ business and their needs and to influence and optimize our product roadmap so we can bring more value.

In This Role You Will

  • Develop deep market, partner, traveler and competitive insights to inform strategy and positioning of your product
  • Lead go-to-market roadmap planning, securing buy-in from leadership helping bring clarity and alignment
  • Identify key levers for product growth, working with Product, Commercial and Analytics teams
  • Build a feedback loop, that brings in experiences of our customers and from the field to help us iterate and improve our position
  • Plan and execute on commercial team readiness, developing materials and managing ongoing updates, in partnership with the Sales Enablement team
  • Create benefit-based marketing assets such as pitch decks and demos with compelling stories for commercial teams to engage partners

Working as a product marketer in a complex global organization, preferably in the B2B enterprise technology space, you are seeking a new place to employ your 5+ years in product marketing, strategy product management, portfolio marketing or a related discipline.

Experience And Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to impact product strategy and roadmap, leveraging a deep understanding of customer needs.
  • Executive presence with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of a complex organization
  • Commercial minded, skilled at driving growth through a variety of approaches, including account-based marketing
  • Adept at authoring and implementing product positioning and go-to-market plans
  • Master storyteller who knows how to craft messaging that clearly communicates value to the audience
  • Curious mindset, relying on data and insights to make decisions and pushing boundaries to strive for excellence
  • Highly collaborative, serving as the glue to bring together teams, driving toward accountability, visibility and clarity in everything we do

The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $104,000.00 to $145,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $166,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

job.job_description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a Senior Analyst, Brand Strategy & Measurement to help build and run measurement programs that evaluate the impact of KAYAK's brand marketing investments across global markets. You'll be a key contributor to how KAYAK understands, measures, and improves brand marketing performance — partnering with marketing, media, analytics, and external measurement partners to generate insights that shape investment decisions and improve business outcomes across regions. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone energized by turning complex data into clear stories and who wants their work to have a direct impact on how a global brand grows.

This position is required to work from our Norwalk, CT office 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Partner with regional marketing and media teams to define measurement priorities, establish KPIs, build learning agendas, and align measurement approaches with business objectives.
  • Develop structured testing roadmaps across channels and campaigns, selecting the most appropriate methodologies based on the business question, available budget, and data availability.
  • Design and support measurement programs including incrementality testing, geo holdouts, brand lift studies, media mix modeling (MMM), and other experimental approaches.
  • Collaborate across teams to implement measurement plans, monitor progress, and ensure findings are translated into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Translate complex analyses into compelling narratives that connect marketing performance to business outcomes and inform future investment decisions.
  • Partner with external analytics agencies and measurement vendors to define data requirements, ensure successful delivery of data inputs, and support the execution of measurement studies.
  • Own the day-to-day management and analysis of KAYAK's global brand tracking program, including vendor coordination, study implementation, and insight generation.
  • Monitor key marketing and business performance indicators, identifying trends, opportunities, and risks across markets.
  • Conduct analyses to support strategic decision-making, annual planning, performance diagnosis, audience understanding, and investment optimization.
  • Contribute to the evolution of KAYAK's measurement framework by identifying new methodologies, tools, and opportunities to improve how we understand marketing effectiveness.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 4–6 years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, paid media, strategy, or a related analytical function — ideally within a consumer technology, travel, or digital-first environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are also considered.

Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of the Legal, Compliance & Secretariat Department (“LCS”) in the Corporate Planning Division of SIA. Supporting the Legal & Compliance (Data Protection) Team, he/she will undertake data privacy compliance work for the Singapore Airlines Limited (“SIA”) group of companies, especially with respect to the Singapore Personal Data Protection Act and global privacy laws, and advise on contentious matters involving SIA.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Either

  • a specialist personal data privacy lawyer; or
  • a general commercial litigation lawyer with data privacy law experience or qualifications, e.g. Certified Information Privacy Professional qualifications.

Key Responsibilities Include

Regulatory compliance

  • Advise business units on personal data protection matters (including legal risks and/or implications of business decisions), and offer appropriate solutions, if possible;
  • Work with business units to evaluate, implement and monitor internal personal data protection compliance policies, procedures, controls and/or remediation measures, as may be needed from time to time;
  • Promote and update the personal data protection compliance programme periodically; and
  • Manage and respond to data subject access requests and privacy related complaints or disputes.

Contentious / Advisory

  • Manage actual and potential civil litigation matters involving SIA in Singapore and overseas such as privacy or IP related litigation, including internal reviews and investigations relating to those matters and managing outside counsel;
  • Advise on the handling of passenger claims; and
  • Advise on compliance with production orders / requests made by law enforcement agencies / regulatory authorities in Singapore and overseas.

Requirements

  • A law degree from a reputable university in Singapore or a Commonwealth jurisdiction,
  • At least two (2) years of legal experience gained in a reputable law firm or in-house, and
  • Excellent drafting skills.

    • intellectual property.
  • Admission to the Singapore Bar is not required.

    • communicate with people effectively in a dynamic environment in SIA and its unlisted subsidiaries.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
