job.job_description:
PR & Communications Executive | HYBRID Heathrow area


Travel obsessed? Big tech fan? Hey, you’re in good company. If you want to be part of the industry that makes the world go round, then look no further.

Travelport is the brains behind lots of your travel bookings- plane, car or hotel. Our technology is used to book that magical holiday, infamous bachelorette party or long overdue school reunion. While we can’t solve mosquito bites or lost luggage, we can simplify a lot of the technical parts of travel, and we’re looking for the best thinkers to help us do it.

We’re hiring right now for a Social Media & Communications Executive! Search for #Travelport on LinkedIn and hear from our amazing team.

How you’ll make an impact:

Travelport is looking for a PR & Communications Executive to support our External Communications team as we continue to strengthen Travelport’s voice in the travel technology market.

This is a hands-on role for an ambitious early-career communications professional who is interested in media relations, technology storytelling, thought leadership, and events. You will support day-to-day press office activity, media monitoring, media materials, speaking opportunity submissions, event logistics, and the amplification of earned media through close collaboration with our Digital and Social team.

As AI and large language models increasingly shape how people discover and understand brands, credible earned media, expert commentary and consistent external messaging matter more than ever. This role will help Travelport extend the reach of its external narrative and strengthen its position as a travel technology leader.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is curious, collaborative, organised and keen to build a career in PR and communications within a global B2B technology business.

Key responsibilities

Media relations and press office support

  • Support the Head of External Communications with day-to-day media relations and press office activity.
  • Monitor media coverage and industry news, identifying relevant developments, opportunities and risks.
  • Maintain and update media lists, journalist contacts, and coverage trackers.
  • Draft and edit media materials, including press releases, media pitches, briefing notes, reactive statements, talking points, and award submissions.
  • Support journalist follow-ups, media outreach, and the coordination of media enquiries.
  • Help gather information, proof points, approvals and stakeholder input for external communications activity.
  • Support the preparation of interview briefing materials, Q&As and follow-up content.
  • Provide reliable day-to-day support when the Head of External Communications is not available.

Thought leadership, speaking opportunities, and awards

  • Research relevant speaking opportunities, awards, media features, podcasts, panels and industry platforms.
  • Support the development of speaker submissions, award entries, abstracts, biographies and briefing materials.
  • Work with Brand, Product Marketing, and Market Insights colleagues to gather supporting proof points and messages.
  • Support the amplification of thought leadership, executive visibility and earned media opportunities across relevant channels.

Event communications and logistics support

  • Support PR and communications activity around key Travelport events, customer events, trade shows and industry moments.
  • Work with the Events team to help coordinate event-related materials, deadlines, approvals and logistics.
  • Support the preparation of event briefing documents, speaker notes, run-of-show materials, messaging documents and stakeholder packs.
  • Help coordinate event-related content needs, including speaker bios, session descriptions, and communications materials.
  • Support media or speaker attendance where relevant, including press invites, media lists, briefing notes and follow-up.
  • Help gather post-event coverage, content, photographs, quotes and follow-up materials.

PR amplification and social alignment

  • Collaborate with the Digital and Social team to identify opportunities to amplify earned media, announcements, events, speaking opportunities and thought leadership.
  • Identify where media coverage, event moments, and executive visibility can be extended through owned and social channels.
  • Support joined-up planning between PR, social, events and campaign activity.

Copy writing and content development

  • Draft clear, concise and engaging copy for media materials, event materials, briefing notes, web updates, award entries and communications content.
  • Translate complex travel technology, product or industry themes into accessible, audience-relevant messaging.
  • Ensure copy is accurate, well-structured and aligned with Travelport’s tone of voice, brand standards and messaging priorities.
  • Help repurpose external communications content for use across internal, owned and partner channels where appropriate.
  • Use AI tools appropriately to support research, drafting, editing and productivity, while maintaining high standards of accuracy, judgement and brand alignment.

Measurement, monitoring and reporting

  • Support media monitoring, coverage tracking and reporting.
  • Help measure the reach, relevance and quality of earned media activity.
  • Track speaking opportunities, award submissions, event-related PR activity and media outcomes.
  • Help identify what is working well and where we can improve external visibility, message consistency and PR amplification.
  • Stay curious about trends in PR, travel technology, B2B communications, AI, and LLM discovery.

Could this be you?

  • Early-career experience in PR, communications, journalism, content marketing, events communications or a related field.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt copy for different audiences, formats and channels.
  • Interest in technology, travel, AI, digital commerce or B2B marketing.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable supporting externally visible content that requires accuracy, judgement and care.
  • Proactive, curious and willing to get stuck in.
  • Good judgement and a willingness to learn from senior communications and marketing colleagues.


Desirable experience

  • Good understanding of how earned media, expert commentary and third-party credibility can shape brand reputation.
  • Familiarity with media monitoring, journalist databases, PR tools or coverage reporting.
  • Experience drafting press releases, media pitches, briefing notes, award entries or speaking submissions.
  • Experience supporting events, speaker logistics, briefing materials or event communications.
  • Understanding of how earned media and credible external sources influence AI/LLM discovery and brand visibility.
  • Experience using AI tools to support research, drafting, editing or content repurposing.

Personal attributes

  • A natural writer who enjoys turning complex topics into clear, engaging content.
  • Curious about technology, travel and the changing media landscape.
  • Organized, proactive and detail-oriented.
  • Calm under pressure and able to support time-sensitive communications activity.
  • Commercially aware, with an interest in how communications supports reputation, customer engagement and business growth.


What’s in it for you?

Our benefits package includes:

Competitive base salary, 25 days annual leave per annum, hybrid working model (2 days per week at our global HQ in Langley, Berkshire), pension contribution, private medical, life assurance and personal travel insurance and more!

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, then we’d love to hear from you.

Our application process is quick, easy, and hassle-free — apply in just a few minutes!

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

We believe that we are better together, and at Tripadvisor we welcome you for who you are. Our workplace is for everyone, as is our people powered platform. At Tripadvisor, we want you to bring your unique perspective and experiences, so we can collectively revolutionize travel and together find the good out there.

Tripadvisor is the world’s largest online travel site, visited by 390 million travellers each month, and our Experiences business, Viator, is a fast-evolving and highly data-driven part of the organisation.

At Viator, data is at the heart of how we build great products. We use it to understand our customers, improve decision-making, and drive measurable business impact.

About The Role

As a Senior Manager of Product Data Science, you will be a key leadership figure within the Product Data Science organisation, responsible for building and scaling a high-performing team of Analysts and Data Scientists embedded within Product domains.

You will not only deliver impact through your team, but also raise the overall analytical and technical bar of the organisation, ensuring data science, experimentation, and product analytics are consistently applied at a high standard across multiple product areas.

You will act as a force multiplier for decision-making quality, improving how Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams use data to shape strategy, prioritise work, and evaluate impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of Product Analysts and/or Data Scientists, ensuring consistently high performance, strong technical standards, and clear ownership of impact.
  • Drive effective goal-setting, planning and execution processes across Product Data Science, bringing leadership and discipline to OKRs, prioritisation and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Set and continuously raise the bar for analytical quality, experimentation rigour, and data science application across your teams, ensuring outputs are robust, actionable, and decision-oriented.
  • Act as a senior technical and strategic leader, reviewing and shaping high-impact analytical work, experimentation design, and advanced modelling approaches where required.
  • Partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Commercial leaders to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and ensure data science is embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical and data science problems, ensuring your team delivers clear, commercially meaningful recommendations.
  • Drive adoption of scalable analytical frameworks, experimentation standards, and AI-enabled tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and speed of decision-making across teams.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, segmentation, and customer understanding, ensuring statistical and analytical rigor across the organisation.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with Data Platform, Data Engineering and other central data functions, ensuring the team can effectively leverage shared capabilities while influencing the long-term data ecosystem.
  • Build and evolve the team’s capability through hiring, coaching, and performance management, ensuring strong technical depth and leadership within the function.
  • Identify and remove systemic blockers to high-quality analytics delivery, improving tooling, processes, ways of working and organisational effectiveness across Product Data Science while leading change that enables the team to scale.
  • Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across multiple product domains, ensuring clarity, prioritisation, and strong decision-making discipline.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalise crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics or data science capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build strong relationships and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Platform and other central functions, often without direct authority.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Experience working within a high-scale technology company, marketplace, e-commerce business, or travel technology organisation.
  • A strong technical background in Product Data Science, Data Science, Experimentation, or Machine Learning before moving into leadership roles.
  • Experience building and scaling experimentation platforms, measurement frameworks, self-service capabilities, or data products.
  • Experience applying AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, or automation technologies to improve analytics productivity and decision-making effectiveness.
  • Experience leading organisational change, improving analytical maturity, and raising standards across multiple teams or functions.
  • A reputation for raising the standard of thinking, execution, and decision-making in every team and organisation you join.

Why work for Accor?

Job Description

About you

As a commercially driven and relationship-focused sales professional, you bring energy, enthusiasm and a genuine passion for hospitality. You thrive on building connections, uncovering new opportunities and turning conversations into business. With a strong understanding of the corporate, conference, groups, MICE and events landscape, you are confident representing the hotel in the marketplace and building lasting partnerships with clients, agents and industry stakeholders.

You’re proactive, organised and results-focused, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities while keeping your eye on the bigger picture. Your strong communication and negotiation skills, combined with a natural ability to collaborate across teams, allow you to confidently drive business and deliver exceptional experiences. Most importantly, you bring a positive attitude, commercial mindset and a desire to make things happen.

What you will be doing?

You will play a key role in driving sales and business growth across the hotel with a focus on conference, groups, corporate, MICE, wholesale and inbound markets. You will develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, while actively identifying and securing new business opportunities through networking, prospecting, client engagement and industry events.

Your role will include managing and growing key accounts, developing strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents and business partners, and maximising opportunities across our dual-brand hotel offering. You will work closely with the Revenue, Reservations and Conference & Events teams to convert opportunities and deliver seamless client experiences from enquiry through to event completion.

You’ll also represent the hotel at client meetings, trade shows and industry events, maintain an active sales pipeline and accurate CRM records, and provide regular reporting on sales activity and performance.

Located at Melbourne Airport, with two hotel brands, extensive conference and event facilities and a unique position in one of Melbourne’s busiest business and travel hubs, this is an exciting opportunity to make your mark and help grow our conference and events business.

Bring your energy, build great relationships and let’s make business happen!

Additional Information

Our Hotel

The Novotel & ibis styles Melbourne Airport is a new dual-branded property. With a total of 464 rooms - 248 in Novotel Melbourne Airport and 216 in ibis Styles Melbourne Airport, this dynamic new development is just steps from Terminal 4, Melbourne Airport, offering convenience and comfort for travellers and professionals alike.

Our guests can enjoy a selection of food & beverage venues: Boccata, meaning “mouthful” in Italian, celebrates the city’s migrant heritage and marries Italian favourites with local, contemporary touch. Amber State Taphouse & Kitchen is the ideal gathering place that celebrates the joy of getting together through the Aussie tradition of barbecue and beer – with craft beers on tap, wines, and cocktails. Small holdings featuring the classic Melbourne cafe culture with a range of delightful baked pastry treats, gourmet breakfast dishes, superb sandwiches and specialty coffee.

In addition to our exceptional food and beverage venues, the Novotel & ibis styles Melbourne Airport features premier event spaces designed to accommodate everything from intimate meetings to grand receptions. Our elegant ballroom can host up to 480 guests for a cocktail-style event or 240 for a seated banquet and can be effortlessly divided into Ballroom 1, 2, and 3, providing flexible configurations to suit any occasion, whether it’s a conference, workshop, product launch, or celebration. For guests seeking a productive environment, Aerofoil, our premium co-working space, offers a stylish and comfortable setting ideal for catching up on work between flights, hosting important meetings, or staying connected on the go.

This is a village centre supporting the airport community as a place to gather and socialise for everyone who travels and works from the airport precinct.

What is in it for you?

  • Learning programs through our “Learn your Way” Academy platforms, ongoing training and development opportunities (self-pace, virtual webinars, face to face)
  • ALL Heartist, Employee benefit card, offering discounted accommodation, food and beverage at Accor properties worldwide.
  • Complimentary car parking.
  • Mental health and well-being support initiatives.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team

The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team. We serve as the backbone for CEG’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role is within the Partner Excellence team, which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end partner experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both partner-facing and agent-facing journeys.

The Opportunity:

This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global partner excellence programmes with a focus on complex system support in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on: (i) process optimization and PX improvements across the post‑booking partner journey, (ii) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, (iii) collaboration with product and commercial teams to drive structural changes and (iv) reduce partner effort and CEG cost‑to‑serve, unlock commercial value from partner support insights

You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives

  • Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning commercial enablement and process excellence initiatives.
  • Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: partner satisfaction (e.g., PSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.

Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements

  • Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.
  • Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics.

Drive Commercial driven Solutions & Insights in Operations

  • Partner with Product Management / Technology /CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving complex systems support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer, partner and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, post-booking APIs).

Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team

  • Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
  • Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the Partner Excellence team.
  • Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
  • Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Experience & Background

  • At least 8–10+ years of experience in project/program management, strategy & operations, commercial excellence, process improvement, management consulting, or similar fields.
  • Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading and influencing complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions.
  • Comfort working with or overseeing workflow / automation / agent guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product/Engineering/Data teams. Coding ability is a plus(you have to be willing to learn)
  • Exposure to AI/ML‑driven solutions in an operational or PX context (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, routing, classification, or decision support tools) is a strong plus.

Commercial Excellence, Process, And Delivery Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and transformation, ideally in commercial, operations or customer support environments.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel, structure complex problems, and orchestrate cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience defining and driving improvements in KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, SLAs, handle time, productivity, or cost‑to‑serve.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, dynamic, multicultural environment, comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation in a high‑velocity setting.
  • A growth mindset and positive attitude: proactive, hands‑on, detail‑oriented, and with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Eagerness to pitch new ideas, take initiative, and seek out opportunities for improvement; comfortable giving and receiving feedback.
  • Professional experience with Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with collaboration and project tracking tools is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package (relocation support and visa support provided for successful overseas candidates)
  • Exciting, high‑impact career opportunity with a major global OTA, including potential moves between teams and global locations. You will interact with departmental senior leadership regularly.
  • Dynamic, multinational tech environment with colleagues from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities through corporate learning programs.
  • Modern office space and convenient location at the heart of Bangkok Metropolitan, Hub of Asia.

job.job_description:
Application Deadline: 30 September 2026

Department: Service Delivery

Location: Manchester M90 5AF (FLIGHT)

Description

Who are we?
Dnata is one of the world’s largest air and travel services providers. We provide a comprehensive range of inflight catering, onboard retail, supply chain and logistics services at all major and regional airports across the UK. Dnata Catering provide expertly crafted inflight catering services, delivering fresh and high-quality meals at major and regional airports across the UK. As the leading Halal caterer in the UK, we also provide tailored experiences to meet each customer’s unique needs. We’re a leader in VIP catering, offering bespoke inflight to private and charter clients.

The Role

The Service Delivery Shift Leader is responsible for leading frontline operational teams to deliver safe, secure, compliant, and efficient services within a transport environment. The role ensures that daily schedules, customer requirements, safety standards, regulatory obligations, and service performance targets are met across the shift.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, motivate, and support operational colleagues throughout the shift, ensuring duties are allocated clearly and completed to the required standard.
  • Monitor daily work schedules, flight or transport movements, turnaround activity, and operational priorities.
  • Take prompt corrective action when delays, disruptions, resource gaps, equipment issues, or service failures occur.
  • Ensure all activities are carried out in line with company procedures, health and safety requirements, aviation security rules, transport regulations, and local airport or site instructions.
  • Maintain effective communication with internal teams, airline or transport partners, customer service teams, suppliers, and management.
  • Conduct shift briefings, handovers, toolbox talks, and operational updates to ensure colleagues understand priorities, risks, and performance expectations.
  • Support incident reporting, hazard identification, near-miss escalation, and follow-up actions to maintain a safe working environment.
  • Ensure vehicles, equipment, radios, systems, and operational documentation are used correctly and any defects are reported promptly.
  • Promote excellent customer service, ensuring issues are dealt with professionally and escalated when they cannot be resolved at shift level.


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

The post holder must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, security, and compliance at all times. This includes monitoring operational areas, challenging unsafe behaviour, following airside or landside access requirements, supporting audit readiness, and ensuring that all colleagues work within approved procedures. The role requires confidence in escalating risks, recording incidents accurately, and supporting corrective actions following operational disruption or non-compliance.

  • Experience in aviation, transport, logistics, ground handling operations, or a similar fast-paced service environment.
  • Ability to lead a team during busy, time-critical, and safety-sensitive operations.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to provide clear instructions and effective shift handovers.
  • Good understanding of health and safety, security, compliance, and operational procedures.
  • Confident problem-solving skills with the ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities, resources, and changing operational demands.
  • Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering reliable and professional service.
  • Basic IT literacy, including the ability to use operational systems, email, reporting tools, and shift documentation.
  • Flexible approach to working hours, including early starts, late finishes, weekends, and public holidays where required.
Key Performance Measures

  • Shift tasks completed safely, accurately, and on time.
  • Compliance checks, briefings, reports, and handovers completed to the required standard.
  • Operational disruption managed effectively with timely escalation.
  • Team attendance, productivity, conduct, and service standards maintained.
  • Customer, airline, transport partner, and stakeholder expectations supported professionally.
  • Safety hazards, equipment defects, and incidents reported and followed up appropriately.
Working Conditions

This role operates in a shift-based aviation and transport environment where priorities can change quickly due to flight schedules, vehicle movements, weather, operational disruption, or customer requirements. The post holder may be required to work airside.



Benefits

What's in it for you?
  • An opportunity to be part of the Emirates global family.
  • Free breakfast, lunch and dinner on site
  • Free tea and coffee
  • Simply health Plan
  • Refer a Friend Scheme
  • Discounted gym membership at over 2000 gyms nationwide
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Opportunity to enhance your learning through our inhouse apprenticeship programme

dnata Catering UK is committed to protecting your personal data. Any information you provide during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Notice and used solely for recruitment purposes. We are seeking an ambitious, experienced Online Marketing Analytics Manager to join our Marketing Performance organization in Barcelona. In this role, you will lead and continue building a talented team of analysts, drive our advanced analytics and AI agenda, and turn complex data into strategic growth for our global business.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform...

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, exciting challenges, and a transparent view of how your work directly contributes to our global company goals and our customers. As our Online Marketing Analytics Manager, you will be in charge of:

  • Shaping the Strategy: Define and execute the analytics and reporting strategy for our online marketing campaigns, ensuring long-term value generation through deep, actionable insights and data-driven decision-making.
  • Pioneering AI & Automation: Champion the strategic adoption and implementation of AI within our marketing analytics ecosystem. You will leverage predictive modeling and intelligent automation to transform raw data into forward-looking insights, keeping us at the absolute cutting edge of marketing innovation.
  • Driving Innovation: Design, track, and analyze experiments while helping build a continuous "test and learn" agenda across marketing channels.
  • Leading & Mentoring: Manage a team of analysts—leading, supporting, coaching, and guiding them. You will set clear expectations and ensure they are fully equipped to succeed by providing them with the necessary business context, tools, and hands-on guidance to deliver robust, high-impact insights.
  • Solving Complex Business Problems: Translate complex business questions into functional analyses. Extract, manipulate, and model data from diverse sources using Python, R, or SQL, and collaborate with stakeholders to bring your insights to life.
  • Performance Reporting: Report on overall campaign performance to senior management, evaluating success and delivering clear insights from multiple analytical angles.


How You Will Do It

Our Ways of Working and Core Mindset

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand business requirements by working closely with key stakeholders, combining their needs with your deep knowledge of digital marketing analytics and statistics to build best-in-class practices.
  • Impact-Driven Prioritization: Effectively prioritize projects and requests to drive consistent progress against our Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).
  • Agile Execution: Work and adapt in a fast-paced, agile, and lean environment focused on delivering continuous value to our customers.
  • Strategic Focus: Manage multiple selected projects simultaneously without losing sight of the "big picture."
  • Culture of Growth: Empower and develop junior team members, fostering a supportive environment and contributing positively to our shared growth mindset.


What you need to succeed:

Your Profile, Skills, And Experience

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions! You will have the opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact on our business. Here is what we are looking for:

Core Requirements:

  • Education: Degree in a quantitative or technical field (such as Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline).
  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent analytical thinking, with fluency in data analysis and a proven ability to translate complex data into compelling stories (data storytelling).
  • Curiosity & Proactive Ownership: Naturally curious and highly proactive, with a relentless drive to dig beneath the surface, solve complex business challenges, and take full ownership of end-to-end outcomes.
  • Business Acumen: Exceptional business intuition and context-awareness. Proven track record of grounding analysis in core business metrics and translating goals into actionable strategies that prioritize real trading impact over technical complexity.
  • Proven Track Record: Solid professional experience in digital marketing analytics roles, with prior experience mentoring or managing other analysts.


Technical Toolkit:

  • Strong proficiency in writing SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Experience or knowledge working with Python, R, or similar programming languages for data manipulation and statistical analysis.
  • Experience building dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio/DataStudio, Tableau, PowerBI).
  • Statistical Foundation: A solid understanding of statistical techniques for interpreting summary metrics, assessing confidence intervals, and conducting hypothesis testing (A/B testing).
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail. You are highly collaborative and thrive on giving and receiving feedback.
  • Language: Fluency in English (both written and verbal).


Good to have

  • Domain Expertise: A strong understanding of digital marketing and marketing/ad-tech ecosystems (including tracking, conversion funnels, and core marketing KPIs).
  • Agile Frameworks: Familiarity working within agile or lean frameworks.
  • Advanced Marketing Methodologies: Exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Causal Inference, or multi-touch attribution frameworks.
  • AI & ML Applications: Practical experience applying machine learning algorithms or AI tools to marketing problems (e.g., customer lifetime value modeling, predictive churn, automated insights).


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Director of Sales / Assistant Director of Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

KAYAK is looking for a strategic Senior Director, Media Planning & Buying to shape how we invest in media across markets and channels. You will partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Analytics, Finance, Product and Commercial teams to build effective, measurable campaigns that support audience growth and business outcomes.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office 3 days per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Define and lead KAYAK’s multi-market media planning and buying strategy across offline and digital channels.
  • Own annual and quarterly media planning cycles, including budget allocation, forecasting, pacing, optimization and performance reviews.
  • Develop integrated media plans spanning TV and video, out-of-home (OOH), radio, paid social, display, programmatic, search and other relevant channels.
  • Balance brand impact, audience growth, efficiency and measurable business results across media investments.
  • Establish measurement frameworks and feedback loops to evaluate reach, effectiveness, incrementality, efficiency and return on investment.
  • Partner with Analytics and external measurement providers on attribution, incrementality testing and media mix modeling.
  • Use campaign performance, consumer insights, competitive intelligence and market trends to develop clear investment recommendations.
  • Manage strategic relationships with media agencies, publishers, broadcasters, technology partners and other vendors.
  • Collaborate with Creative and Brand teams to translate audience and media insights into compelling, channel-appropriate campaigns.
  • Partner with Finance, Product, Growth and Commercial leaders to align media investment with business priorities and communicate trade-offs clearly.
  • Lead, coach and develop media professionals while building strong working practices across distributed, cross-functional teams.

Please Apply If You Have

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in media planning and buying, including responsibility for multi-market campaigns and substantial budgets.
  • Proven track record of using media investment to drive measurable brand awareness growth while delivering strong ROI and business results.
  • Demonstrated expertise across offline and digital media, including TV/video, out-of-home, radio, paid social, display, programmatic and search.
  • A track record of developing and executing integrated media strategies that deliver measurable business results.
  • Experience leading annual and quarterly media planning cycles, including budget allocation, forecasting, pacing, optimization, vendor negotiation and performance evaluation.
  • Strong knowledge of marketing measurement, including KPI development, incrementality testing, attribution, media mix modeling (MMM) and ROI or ROAS analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills and the ability to use data to develop clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Experience hiring, managing, coaching and developing high-performing media or marketing teams.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior agencies, publishers, broadcasters, technology partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex media decisions to senior audiences.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Economics, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits And Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • No meeting Fridays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch 2 days per week
There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this Massachusetts-based role is $185,000-215,000.00, not inclusive of annual bonus and recurring RSU grants.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem—we’ve got you.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

We believe that we are better together, and at Tripadvisor we welcome you for who you are. Our workplace is for everyone, as is our people powered platform. At Tripadvisor, we want you to bring your unique perspective and experiences, so we can collectively revolutionize travel and together find the good out there.

Tripadvisor is the world’s largest online travel site, visited by 390 million travellers each month, and our Experiences business, Viator, is a fast-evolving and highly data-driven part of the organisation.

At Viator, data is at the heart of how we build great products. We use it to understand our customers, improve decision-making, and drive measurable business impact.

About The Role

As a Senior Manager of Product Data Science, you will be a key leadership figure within the Product Data Science organisation, responsible for building and scaling a high-performing team of Analysts and Data Scientists embedded within Product domains.

You will not only deliver impact through your team, but also raise the overall analytical and technical bar of the organisation, ensuring data science, experimentation, and product analytics are consistently applied at a high standard across multiple product areas.

You will act as a force multiplier for decision-making quality, improving how Product, Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams use data to shape strategy, prioritise work, and evaluate impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of Product Analysts and/or Data Scientists, ensuring consistently high performance, strong technical standards, and clear ownership of impact.
  • Drive effective goal-setting, planning and execution processes across Product Data Science, bringing leadership and discipline to OKRs, prioritisation and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Set and continuously raise the bar for analytical quality, experimentation rigour, and data science application across your teams, ensuring outputs are robust, actionable, and decision-oriented.
  • Act as a senior technical and strategic leader, reviewing and shaping high-impact analytical work, experimentation design, and advanced modelling approaches where required.
  • Partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Commercial leaders to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and ensure data science is embedded in strategic decision-making.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical and data science problems, ensuring your team delivers clear, commercially meaningful recommendations.
  • Drive adoption of scalable analytical frameworks, experimentation standards, and AI-enabled tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and speed of decision-making across teams.
  • Champion best practices in experimentation, causal inference, segmentation, and customer understanding, ensuring statistical and analytical rigor across the organisation.
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with Data Platform, Data Engineering and other central data functions, ensuring the team can effectively leverage shared capabilities while influencing the long-term data ecosystem.
  • Build and evolve the team’s capability through hiring, coaching, and performance management, ensuring strong technical depth and leadership within the function.
  • Identify and remove systemic blockers to high-quality analytics delivery, improving tooling, processes, ways of working and organisational effectiveness across Product Data Science while leading change that enables the team to scale.
  • Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across multiple product domains, ensuring clarity, prioritisation, and strong decision-making discipline.

Skills & Experience

  • Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organization.
  • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Expert Level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modeling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandit, and a wide range of machine learning techniques (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering).
  • Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement, and operationalise crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.
  • Strategic Influence: A proven track record of driving strategic impact through proactive and collaborative approach with the proven ability to lead technical discussions, drive product strategy, and communicate complex insights effectively to cross-functional partners (e.g., Product, Engineering, Design).
  • Scaling Impact: Experience scaling analytics or data science capabilities, driving impact through the creation of automated processes, self-service tools, or data products.
  • Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, your previous experience will demonstrate the analysis of available facts, evidence, observations, and arguments in order to form a judgment by the application of rational, skeptical, and unbiased analyses and evaluation.
  • Leadership: Outstanding leadership skills, with experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing teams of analysts or data scientists.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire cross-functional partners at all levels.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build strong relationships and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Platform and other central functions, often without direct authority.
  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

  • Experience working within a high-scale technology company, marketplace, e-commerce business, or travel technology organisation.
  • A strong technical background in Product Data Science, Data Science, Experimentation, or Machine Learning before moving into leadership roles.
  • Experience building and scaling experimentation platforms, measurement frameworks, self-service capabilities, or data products.
  • Experience applying AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, or automation technologies to improve analytics productivity and decision-making effectiveness.
  • Experience leading organisational change, improving analytical maturity, and raising standards across multiple teams or functions.
  • A reputation for raising the standard of thinking, execution, and decision-making in every team and organisation you join.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group helps travelers around the world make informed, cost-effective bookings and enables partners to connect their offerings with users through the aggregation of comprehensive travel-related content and resources, and an advanced transaction platform of apps, websites, and 24/7 customer service centers — including four Customer Service Centres in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing service in 19 languages.


With more than 30,000 employees across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, Trip.com Group is one of the best-known travel groups in the world, with the mission "to pursue the perfect trip for a better world."


Location & Workplace Type

  • Location: Los Angeles, New York City, Orlando, or Vancouver
  • Workplace Type: Hybrid


In this role, you will get to

  • Have end-to-end ownership of new hotel chain acquisitions and existing hotel chain management; understand partners' strategy and objectives and help grow revenue
  • Initiate, develop, and manage mutually beneficial relationships with key stakeholders in assigned chain accounts, and orchestrate discussions with senior executives around their business needs
  • Take a customer-centric approach to everything you do — ensure hotel chain content, rates, availability, and products offer the best value to Trip.com customers
  • Own full account management including performance tracking, production optimization, workshops, and issue resolution to drive mutual performance objectives, annual targets, and milestones globally
  • Conduct data research & analysis and routine performance review meetings with VP, SVP, and C-level hotel chain stakeholders across geographies to ensure positive financial contribution
  • Initiate new regional projects and accelerate global projects to promote brand awareness, business strategy, and product benefits to hotel chain partners
  • Coordinate across internal teams — platform, product, service, and marketing — to achieve account expectations and maximize performance; map prospective accounts by organizational structure, people, and technology
  • Other assigned tasks based on business need


What you will need to succeed

  • 5+ years of expertise in business development, strategic account management, or revenue/yield management in the online travel or hospitality industry
  • Fluent in English
  • Valid working permit/visa in the US (no sponsorship)
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field
  • Proactive with a strong sense of ownership
  • Strong negotiation and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels
  • Strong strategic thinking, creativity, and the ability to drive and manage change
  • Professional presentation skills
  • Strong business knowledge of the hotel chain industry and connectivity
  • Team player with a driven "get it done" attitude
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint
  • Willing to travel based on business needs


Behavioral Requirements:

  • A desire to learn new things and improve yourself
  • Integrity is fundamentally important to you
  • You want to make a travel experience better for everyone
  • You are naturally inspiring


What We Provide

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Public Holidays
  • Sick Leave
  • Paid Time Off


Pay Transparency

The annual total pay range for Key Account Manager roles is $80,000 – $130,000 (base salary and variable incentive, where applicable). The range top could be higher for above-target performance, with potential to increase further based on sustained performance. Final offers vary based on the comprehensive competency assessment completed during screening and interviews, and factors including qualifications, skills, experience, and location. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respects team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it is a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What's more?

  • Our rapid global business growth offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and across multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and our global job rotation program enables you to pursue a global career path and make a global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in leadership capability, soft skills, and professional expertise
  • We encourage flexible work arrangements
  • We have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team: 

The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family. 

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner who will help us strategically yet grow our world-class team in Japan and other countries across the globe. You should be passionate about recruiting first-rate talents that will add value to the business. Partnering with senior management (including Country Director/SR Director/AD), you will be critical to creating a seamless recruiting process to help Agoda scale our business globally.

In this Role, you'll get to

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their business objectives and hiring needs. Develop the recruitment strategy and ways to build a talent pipeline accordingly.
  • Own the full-cycle recruitment process ensuring a seamless, uniform, and positive candidate experience.
  • Build your network with high-potential talents to ensure that the business has access to the best talent in the market, working comfortably on a global level.
  • Engage in creative talent mapping efforts for the purposes of building our candidate pipeline as well as to provide market intelligence to the business.
  • Work on recruitment projects and training to improve the standard for hiring within the organization

Must-Have

  • 8+ years of end-to-end recruitment experience, ideally in a fast-growing technology, product, or similarly dynamic environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including clear communication, proactive updates, expectation management, and the ability to influence hiring managers and senior leaders using data and market insights.
  • Exceptional sourcing skills, with a proven ability to build strong top-of-funnel pipelines in challenging and competitive talent markets.
  • A strong problem-solving mindset, with the ability to identify root causes, propose practical solutions, and create clear action plans when pipelines are challenging.
  • Experience hiring across different levels, from early-career talent through to leadership roles, including negotiating complex compensation packages and successfully closing candidates.
  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to analyze recruitment metrics, generate useful insights, and translate them into recommendations for Japan leaders.
  • Excellent communication, listening, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong proficiency with recruitment and productivity tools, such as LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, Greenhouse, and Microsoft Office.
  • A proactive and continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and drive recruitment process improvements.
  • A passion for recruitment and delivering an excellent candidate experience.
  • Proficiency in Japanese and English is required

Good-to-Have

  • Experience in both agency and in-house recruitment environments.
  • Experience partnering with senior leadership on strategic recruitment initiatives.
  • Experience using recruitment data to identify market trends and inform workforce or hiring strategies.
  • Proven ability to take initiative and lead cross-functional projects from planning through to completion.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Join Delta Air Lines As a Reservations Co-Op And Help Shape The Future Of Customer Care. You’ll Work On High-impact Projects That Improve The Servicing Experiences For Millions Of Customers While Gaining Hands-on Experience In Data Analytics, Process Improvement, Product Management, Or Statistical Modeling. While Co-oping In Reservations You’ll Gain

  • Real-world experience in a Fortune 100 company
  • Experience presenting to an executive audience
  • Mentorship and networking opportunities

What is Reservations?

The Reservations department serves as a key point of contact for customers before, during, and after their travel experience. This co-op opportunity is based at our General Offices (GO) and functions as a back-office support role. In this position, you will support the department by partnering closely with our Customer Engagement Centers and providing essential behind-the-scenes assistance that enhances both the customer experience and the effectiveness of our frontline agents.

Job Summary

As a Reservations Co-Op, you will act as an internal consultant within the department, leading semester-long projects that support divisional strategies and business objectives. These initiatives often involve cross-functional collaboration to identify opportunities, improve processes, and deliver solutions that benefit both customers and employees. Co-ops apply strong critical thinking and interpersonal skills to perform tasks such as:

  • Resolve product, process, and project-related issues and risks
  • Perform data analysis and collection
  • Identify and recommend process improvements and operational efficiencies

These projects are often complex and may involve exposure to sensitive or confidential information and present moderate financial risk. The final project deliverable is a capstone presentation given to division leaders highlighting project lessons learned, impacts made, and recommendations going forward.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Must be currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree
  • Must not be enrolled in any classes, either remote or on-campus, during the duration of the program
  • Must be able to work 16 consecutive weeks
  • Must be able to come into Corporate Headquarters in Atlanta 4 times per week
  • Must be able to commit to three rotations prior to finishing undergraduate degree (any combination of spring, summer, and fall)
  • A strong team player, detail oriented, and perform well under pressure
  • Conveys professional image to all levels of associates
  • Proficient in MS Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
  • Must be willing to travel as required
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills highly preferred
  • Possess technical skills, with an emphasis on SQL and any programming language
  • Possess business skills such as business modeling, project management, or competitive analysis
  • Completion or pursuit of Database, Basic Programming, User Interface courses
  • Data visualization tool knowledge (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with simulation, modeling and statistical analysis software
  • Delta Air Lines recognizes and values diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Der Hauptsitz unseres 1957 gegründeten Unternehmens ist in St. Louis (USA), aber unser globales Netzwerk erstreckt sich auf mehr als 90 Länder. Dann hast du einen ersten Eindruck von uns und was wir bewegen!

Du bist stolz darauf, auch bei mehreren Aufgaben gleichzeitig den Überblick zu behalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Qualifications

Kommunikative Fähigkeiten sind uns wichtig, Unternehmergeist und Teamfähigkeit wissen wir sehr zu schätzen. Erste Erfahrungen im Verkauf und Kundendienst sind garantiert von Vorteil. Aber vor allem solltest du motiviert sein und Lust dazu haben, deinen Kunden einen exzellenten Service zu bieten.

job.job_description:
Job Description

The Director, Culinary - South East Asia (SEA) is a hands-on, hotel-facing role responsible for driving food & beverage (F&B) performance across the region by making the food better. The person in this role will spend significant time on property, in kitchens, and working side by side with hotel culinary and F&B teams to build restaurants and food experiences that guests choose to come back for, and that the local community genuinely loves.

A central focus of this role is elevating breakfast across the portfolio, turning a daily routine into a genuine point of differentiation and guest satisfaction. Beyond breakfast, the Director of Culinary will champion the culinary execution of signature, concept-led restaurants, ensuring the food experience brings each concept to life with quality, consistency and relevance. The role will bring an entrepreneurial, owner-operator mindset to restaurant performance and turnaround, driving sustainable commercial returns, while also raising the ambition and execution of culinary events and experiences to create memorable moments that differentiate our hotels from their competitors and support the delivery of outstanding event experiences, a key strategic focus across the region.

This role requires extensive travel across SEA and a willingness to work directly and practically alongside hotel teams, general managers and owners to identify what is holding an outlet back and to fix it.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

  • Work directly with trading hotels across SEA to lift F&B and restaurant performance, spending extensive time on property rather than managing remotely.
  • Elevate the breakfast offering across the region, developing it as a distinct area of guest satisfaction and commercial opportunity.
  • Partner with hotel culinary and F&B teams to improve food quality, menu execution and kitchen standards as the foundation for great restaurant experiences.
  • Identify underperforming F&B concepts and take an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach to rebuilding them, from food and concept through to guest experience.
  • Build restaurants and food experiences with genuine local relevance, so that outlets are supported by the local community, not only hotel guests.
  • Support hotels in translating culinary improvements into commercial results, working closely with hotel leadership on the link between food quality, F&B revenue and profit.
  • Act as a working culinary resource for hotels during openings, renovations and concept refreshes, providing on-the-ground execution support.
  • Share practical culinary best practice across markets, helping hotel teams learn from what is working elsewhere in the region.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, F&B - SEA and the broader Brand F&B team to ensure culinary work is aligned with the region's wider F&B strategy.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years' experience in F&B or culinary leadership, including significant time working directly in hotel or restaurant kitchens.
  • Culinary training or equivalent hands-on professional experience.
  • Proven track record of improving restaurant or F&B performance through hands-on culinary and operational involvement.
  • Experience across multiple markets in SEA strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with hotel GMs, owners and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to travel extensively across SEA around 50 to 60%.
  • A genuine, hands-on mindset, comfortable working in a fast paced, high volume environment.
  • An entrepreneurial, owner-operator approach to building and fixing restaurants and food offerings.
  • Strong commercial instincts, with an understanding of how food quality translates into guest satisfaction and revenue.
  • High energy and willingness to travel extensively, with comfort operating across many hotels and markets in a short space of time.
  • Strong influencing and relationship-building skills, able to earn the trust of hotel chefs, GMs and owners quickly.
  • Deep understanding of South East Asian food culture and the ability to translate local relevance into restaurant concepts.
  • Practical problem-solving ability, able to diagnose what is wrong with an underperforming outlet and act on this.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Proven experience in regional or multi-property leadership roles.
  • Strong background with luxury or lifestyle hospitality brands, including delivering large-scale events and high-profile activations.
  • Other languages to support SEA region considered a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.
