At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

At the B2B division, we provide the scale, innovative technology, and supply of Expedia Group to businesses looking to take on the world of travel. Through these partnerships, we power experiences for millions of consumers globally, helping drive brand loyalty and growth for our partners and Expedia Group. We are the largest and fastest-growing travel affiliate network, working with over 10,000 partners in 33 countries to turn their web traffic into hotel bookings and loyal customers.

FinTech is one of the technology capabilities we provide to B2B partners, helping them deliver travel booking experiences through Expedia Group’s technology solutions.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, develop, and deliver high-quality software features and services that power the Credit platform for our partners globally
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code across the full software development lifecycle, primarily using Java/Kotlin.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decisions that shape the direction of the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues, ensuring platform reliability and performance.
  • Review code from peers and provide constructive technical feedback to foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to the improvement of engineering practices, tooling, and processes within the team.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams across Expedia Group to deliver end-to-end B2B experiences for our travel agent partners.

Experience And Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong background in designing and building scalable, distributed systems.
  • Experience with JVM-based languages such as Java, Kotlin.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and system design principles.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, containerisation with Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Proficient communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, cross-functional team environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work both collaboratively and autonomously in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our Metasearch design team. You’ll focus primarily on Ads and help design experiences for travelers, advertisers, and partner teams. Your work may also span related products such as SEO, Affiliates, and B2B dashboards. We welcome candidates who have developed their skills through different paths and can demonstrate strong product judgment through their work.

This position requires you to commute to our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 times per week.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile across the Ads team and platforms, from early concepts and rapid prototypes through to delivery within an agile team.
  • Work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to translate user needs and business goals into design decisions that improve outcomes for both travelers and advertising partners.
  • Communicate design rationale and success criteria clearly to cross-functional partners to build shared understanding and alignment across product and engineering.
  • Plan and conduct qualitative user research; use analytics and experiment results alongside research findings to iterate on your product area.
  • Raise the quality bar for the team through high-quality, well-reasoned design work, and offer constructive feedback that helps other designers grow.

Please Apply If You Have

  • +4 Years of Experience designing digital products from early exploration through delivery and iteration, with a portfolio that includes both consumer-facing and platform or admin product work.
  • Strong UX and interaction design skills — including typography, visual hierarchy, and interaction patterns — applied to solve complex product challenges.
  • Proficiency with modern design, prototyping, and AI-assisted tools such as Figma, with experience contributing to shared design systems.
  • Familiarity with the full product development process and the ability to ship features in an environment that moves quickly and experiments often.
  • Comfort working with data: using analytics, experiment results, and qualitative research together to inform decisions and evaluate impact after launch.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to break down complex problems and present your thinking to a range of audiences.
  • The ability to drive your own work forward independently while staying connected to the team and asking for input when it matters.
  • A curiosity to learn and a willingness to adapt as new challenges emerge.
  • A working understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices.

Nice To Have

  • Experience designing advertising, partner-facing, platform, administrative, or B2B products.
  • Experience contributing to or working with shared design systems.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design or research tools.
  • Education in Design, HCI, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.

Benefits And Perks

  • Company-wide week off each year

  • Generous paid vacation plus time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans
  • Free lunch two days per week
  • Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off, including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays, and paid holidays; and parental leave benefits.

Inclusion

job.job_description:
Product Marketing Manager I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

This role owns key aspects of commercial strategy, go-to-market, and narrative for how Viator grows value across its supply organisation — shaping strategy alongside Commercial and Product teams, not just executing it, and turning that strategy into positioning and enablement that suppliers understand, trust, and act on. It sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, product, and supplier-facing marketing, and is accountable for making sure Viator's most important supply-side initiatives are right, and that they land with operators, not just internally.

The strength of any supply-side initiative starts with whether the strategy behind it is right — and that requires someone close enough to the evidence to shape it, not just market it after the fact. This role brings senior commercial marketing capability that can build strategy, ground it in original research, and carry it through to execution that lands with operators.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position in London, UK. Travel to company offices is expected 1-2 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy Development: Build strategy and identify key initiatives to enable us to meet our company goals - bringing a point of view on what Viator should do next and why, backed by evidence rather than assumption.
  • Independent Research & Insight: Run research into supplier behaviour, needs, and market dynamics - designing and conducting the work directly rather than relying solely on other teams' output and use it to shape strategy before it's built.
  • Product Roadmap Influence: Work as a key partner with product, using supplier insight and data to actively guide what gets built and prioritised.
  • Commercial GTM Ownership: Take supply-side commercial strategy such as pricing, promotions, incentive structures, new programs and turn it into positioning and launch plans that suppliers act on, from first announcement through adoption.
  • Supplier Growth Strategy: Partner with Commercial teams to translate operator insight into marketing and product initiatives that measurably grow supplier earnings and engagement.
  • Lifecycle & CRM Strategy: Shape supplier lifecycle CRM programs so that engagement, retention, and reactivation efforts stay aligned to what's commercially important right now.
  • Initiative Launch & Rollout: Lead the end-to-end rollout of major supply-side initiatives - sequencing, localisation where relevant, and adapting positioning and enablement to what actually works for the operators it's aimed at, rather than exporting a single playbook.
  • Competitive & Market Intelligence: Track how competitors win and retain supply, and turn that into a sharper Viator offering.

Skills And Experience

  • 8+ years in product marketing, with experience owning commercial or GTM strategy
  • Experience influencing product roadmap as a peer to product teams, backed by evidence.
  • Strong grasp of two-sided marketplace dynamics.
  • Comfortable working directly with data science/analytics and core metrics.
  • Sharp GTM and positioning craft — turns ambiguous strategy into messaging people act on.
  • Experience across more than one stage of a supplier/partner lifecycle.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta, we connect people and cultures, power extraordinary experiences, and shape the future of travel. Here, you'll work on complex challenges on a global scale, using augmented intelligence to build emerging technologies, amplify human potential and continuously grow the skills that keep you at the forefront of what's next.

The Salesforce Center of Excellence ensures Salesforce solutions across the enterprise are secure, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Delta's technology strategy. We are seeking a technologist who happens to be an expert in Salesforce, not a Salesforce expert whose experience ends at the platform boundary.

As a Senior Process Architect, you will serve as a technical leader for Delta's Salesforce ecosystem. You will design enterprise-scale solutions, establish engineering standards, mentor technical teams, and govern architectural decisions across critical platforms. This role combines architecture leadership with hands-on development, requiring both strategic thinking and technical depth.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Governance

  • Design and govern scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce solutions aligned with Delta's enterprise technology strategy.
  • Serve as the technical authority and final approver for significant Salesforce architecture and integration decisions.
  • Partner with fellow Process Architects and the Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) to define and evolve enterprise standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and guide teams toward solutions that meet business needs without creating unnecessary complexity or technical debt.
  • Drive a platform-first architecture approach that leverages native Salesforce capabilities while meeting Delta’s enterprise standards for security, scalability, and reliability.

Engineering & Integration

  • Design and review integrations using APIs, event-driven architectures, middleware, and cloud-native integration patterns.
  • Contribute hands-on development in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and related technologies to maintain technical depth and engineering credibility.
  • Reduce technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural risk across the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and champion the practical use of AI to improve software delivery, developer productivity, and solution quality.

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor developers, administrators, architects, and technical leads while raising the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of engineering across Delta's Salesforce ecosystem
  • Lead architecture reviews, design workshops, and code reviews while influencing technical direction through expertise, collaboration, and data-driven decision making.
  • Support critical production incidents, lead root cause analysis, and drive improvements that strengthen platform reliability, operational resilience, and business outcomes.
  • Act with urgency, ownership, and accountability in support of Delta's operational objectives.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 8+ years of software engineering, solution architecture, or enterprise platform experience, including 7+ years designing and delivering Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments.
  • Deep understanding of software architecture principles, object-oriented design, distributed systems, integration patterns, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning multiple applications and integrated systems while balancing delivery goals and maintaining long-term architectural quality.
  • Experience serving as a technical governance authority for complex solutions, including architectural approval responsibilities and influencing technical direction across multiple teams without managerial authority.
  • Strong understanding of source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and modern release management practices using tools such as GitLab and Copado.
  • Hands-on experience developing solutions with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, Agentforce, Service Cloud, and Salesforce security models.
  • Expert knowledge of Salesforce architecture, platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices. (Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, CRM Analytics, Experience Cloud)
  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complex systems and drive adoption of shared standards across multiple teams and business domains.
  • Experience applying AI technologies to improve software delivery, engineering productivity, or business outcomes.
  • Strong experience designing and supporting enterprise integrations using REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, middleware solutions, and ETL technologies.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and services in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Salesforce Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification.
  • Experience with enterprise integration and event-streaming platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Azure Integration Services, or similar technologies.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards and governance practices for large development organizations.
  • Experience within airline, transportation, logistics, or other operationally critical industries.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Job Description

The iconic Hilton Anatole, the only Hilton Corporate-Managed property in Dallas, is seeking an Assistant Director of Sales. This role will lead a team of five Sales Managers, oversee the Texas Corporate Group market (401+ peak room nights), and manage key VIP and high-profile accounts.

With 1,606 guest rooms and 600,000 square feet of meeting space, this is an outstanding opportunity to join one of Dallas' most prestigious hotels and grow your career with Hilton.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As an Assistant Director of Sales, you’re not just supporting the hotel’s sales strategy – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Drive sales within a key market segment: Manage a designated vertical market, applying expert sales skills to qualify leads, conduct outreach, deliver compelling proposals, and close business to meet revenue goals
  • Support strategic sales planning: Contribute to the hotel’s annual commercial strategy, aligning sales activities with business objectives, and collaborating with the broader commercial team to optimize performance
  • Execute targeted sales initiatives: Represent the hotel at tradeshows, client events, and sales calls; maintain a robust pipeline and develop plans to secure short- and long-term business
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Support sales performance and processes: Align day-to-day team activities with strategic goals by reinforcing business processes that drive revenue across Rooms, Catering, and Events
  • Track performance and market trends: Monitor business metrics, analyze the competitive landscape, and adjust tactics to meet evolving customer needs and market dynamics
  • Inspire and develop the team: Recruit, train, supervise, and mentor team members; conduct performance evaluations, provide professional development opportunities, and recognize achievements to build, engage and retain an engaged and high performing team

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

At Tripadvisor Experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision-making.

As a Product Data Scientist, you’ll be the analytical backbone of one or more product pods. You’ll own measurement and reporting, support experimentation, and surface the insights that drive product decisions — while actively developing your skills in more advanced analytics methods. This is a role for someone with strong foundational data science skills who is energised by the opportunity to grow.

What You’ll Do

Experimentation

  • Design and analyse A/B tests across Viator’s marketplace, applying sound statistical methods to interpret results and support confident decision-making
  • Champion experimentation best practices: power calculations, guardrail metrics, and multiple testing corrections.
  • Develop your mastery of causal inference and advanced experimentation techniques (e.g., difference-in-differences, propensity scoring, synthetic controls) as you apply them to answer questions that can't be randomized — such as measuring the impact of pricing changes on supplier retention or the long-term effect of personalization on traveler LTV.

Strategic Analysis & Measurement

  • Own the measurement framework for your product area: define key metrics, build the instrumentation to track them, and surface insights that move the needle.
  • Conduct exploratory analyses and deep dives into our data, using various data science approaches, to inform product decisions; for example, using tree-based or regression modeling to identify signals of high LTV
  • Enable self-service through scalable datasets, metrics, dashboards and reporting frameworks
  • Translate analytical outputs into actionable insights and clear product recommendations: not just ‘here’s the data,’ but ‘here’s what it means for the next sprint and how we should test it.’

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Act as a thought partner with product managers and engineers to ensure the right data questions are being asked
  • Translate analyses into clear narratives that are accessible to non-technical audiences — emphasising actionable insights and ‘so what’ over technical detail.
  • Be a champion of unbiased, rigorous analysis — including when the data doesn’t support a stakeholder’s hypothesis; willingness to be the voice of inconvenient truths is a core expectation of this role.

What You’ll Bring

  • Several years in a data science, analytics, or quantitative research role at a data-driven organization; strong product analysts who are actively upskilling in data science methods are encouraged to apply
  • Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience querying and manipulating large datasets
  • Proficiency with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Looker or equivalent)
  • Experience with the full A/B testing process, from test design to results interpretation
  • Some proficiency in Python for analysis, experimentation and exploratory modeling
  • A track record of using data insights to influence product or business decisions
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can define a question when it isn’t handed to you, and you’re energised by incomplete information rather than paralysed by it
  • A growth mindset: you’re actively upskilling in more advanced analytics methods and always willing to learn new tools and techniques

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to more advanced statistical methods and causal inference techniques — e.g. propensity scoring, synthetic controls, difference-in-differences, Bayesian approaches
  • Familiarity with LLMs or NLP tooling for analytics use cases (e.g., content classification, dataset enrichment)
  • Experience in travel or e-commerce; understanding of two-sided marketplace dynamics, geo-based demand variation, or supplier/consumer trade-offs

Remote

job.job_description:
Senior CRM Marketing Specialist

Location: Hybrid/Remote in the UK | Department: CRM Marketing | Employment Type: Full-Time

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

About The Role

We’re looking for a highly technical CRM marketer to design, build, and optimize sophisticated lifecycle programs across multiple channels.

You’ll serve as a Braze subject matter expert, owning the end-to-end execution of CRM programs—from audience segmentation and journey architecture to personalization, experimentation, and technical troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable architecting complex Braze Canvases, building Content Card experiences, writing advanced Liquid personalization logic, and solving technical problems independently.

Experience with SMS and WhatsApp is a plus as we continue to expand our omnichannel capabilities.

What You’ll Do

Own lifecycle strategy and automation architecture

  • Design and build scalable, multi-touch customer journeys that drive meaningful business outcomes.
  • Architect and optimize lifecycle programs across Email, Content Cards, and in-product experiences.
  • Modernize existing journeys through structured experimentation and continuous optimization.

Build and execute CRM programs in Braze

  • Serve as a Braze subject matter expert.
  • Build and manage Campaigns, Canvases, and Content Cards.
  • Create advanced personalization using Liquid.
  • Configure dynamic content, audience segmentation, and behavioral triggers.

Troubleshoot and solve technical problems

  • Investigate and resolve issues related to audience qualification, journey logic, personalization, data discrepancies, and campaign performance.
  • Partner with Analytics, MarTech, and Engineering teams to diagnose integration and data flow issues.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement scalable solutions.

Drive experimentation and performance optimization

  • Design A/B tests with clear hypotheses and measurable success criteria.
  • Analyze performance data to improve audience targeting, customer journeys, and content effectiveness.
  • Share insights and recommendations with stakeholders.

Partner across the business

  • Collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Product, Analytics, Engineering, Creative, Sales, and Customer Success teams.
  • Translate business goals into effective CRM strategies.
  • Act as a trusted CRM expert and strategic partner across the organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation experience, preferably in a B2B environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Braze experience.
  • Deep expertise building and managing Braze Canvases.
  • Advanced proficiency with Liquid personalization.
  • Experience designing complex lifecycle automation programs.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills.
  • Excellent project management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with SMS and/or WhatsApp programs.
  • Working knowledge of SQL.
  • Experience working with APIs, customer data platforms (CDPs), or data warehouses.
  • Experience supporting global and multilingual campaigns.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and applying AI to CRM workflows.

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.

  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.

Traveler first

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

This strategic leader will be responsible for system-wide Onboard Service (OBS) program management and execution of special programs across the network worth ~$120M annually. These programs will vary from Continuous Improvement, Lean methodology, process efficiencies, operational support and

guidance, resource planning/optimization, cost savings initiatives, data analysis, and driving productivity. The Process Engineering Specialist will be expected to design and facilitate roll outs for catering vendors and OBS leaders for various process improvements and overall OBS initiatives. This position requires

program management and change management skills to ensure successful completion of each initiative. This leader will be expected to become an expert in internal programs such as IFX, GP4, and O2P. They will develop systems of tracking and compliance of project plans. They will also be expected to engage

with all OBS and In-Flight Services (IFS) leaders to implement continuous improvement and cost savings ranging from $50-100M annually.

How you’ll help us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities):

The team coordinates with leadership from multiple Business Units across OBS, Finance, and IFS, including Directors, Managing Directors, and Vice President levels. Responsible for interfacing with catering operations local management, vendors, Finance, Information Technology, Flight Crew, and Airport Customer Service on strategic programs. The Process Engineering Specialist will also be responsible for developing and presenting strategic business cases, ROI justifications, and delivering projects on time / under budget. In some cases, they will be responsible for testing content and usability, and partnering with Delta Technology and other parties to troubleshoot any issues.

Summary Of Responsibilities (including But Not Limited To)

  • Responsible for strategic planning and Project Management for OBS projects and initiatives.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify and drive process and specification modifications to gain efficiencies and reduce cost.
  • Build presentations and one-pagers to summarize and present project initiatives, business cases, ROIs, new initiative proposals, process/operations and cost impact analysis, and overall project presentation materials.
  • Develop reporting and dashboards for station performance, financial savings, attrition, and other meaningful performance factors. Capture and monitor variance to target and recovery planning.
  • Drive accountability and escalate performance degradation in a timely manner.
  • Locate and extract data from a variety of sources for use in analysis.
  • Work to develop improvements to the framework and methodology of the Resource Planning model and application. Serve as a SME for Resource Planning.
  • Focus on transformational changes and approaches to maximize impact of process enhancements.
  • Facilitate Lean workshops and discussions with operational teams, leaders, and business partners to identify areas of opportunity, reduce waste, and incorporate process improvements from a productivity, financial, and safety perspective.
  • Influence change without authority internally and externally to drive improvement and to achieve desired operational changes for internal and external customers.
  • Drive solution-based recommendations and improvements to ensure integrity and success of the catering operation and its processes.
  • Interpret and report performance metrics to key stakeholders internally and externally to drive accountability and escalate performance degradation in a timely manner.
  • Oversee process for ensuring compliance of new launches, specification changes, and build process/assembly changes.
  • Responsible for technical support, training, and will serve as ongoing Subject Matter Expert of OBS systems and tools.
  • Support the OBS division, encompassing but not limited to: Food Safety, Ramp Safety/Security, Daily reporting, Audits, Dispatch, and Provisioning Technology.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of all information, including but not limited to data, contracts, internal discussions, ideas, theories, and proposals.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • BS degree or equivalent work experience required.
  • A minimum of 7 years work experience including process engineering, program management, business case development, and change management is preferred.
  • Analytical, process-driven, solution-oriented, multi-task capable, and demonstrated ability to work well with others in a fast-paced time-sensitive environment.
  • Sound organizational and planning skills, excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong interpersonal skills, and a proven ability to make intelligent business decisions.
  • Highly proficient computer skills, including advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word are required.
  • Strong analytical skills, keen attention to detail, and project management experience.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high visibility environment where accuracy of work product is paramount.
  • Schedule flexibility to support quick-turn deadlines and time sensitive requests aligning with operational needs.
  • Embrace diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Consistently prioritize safety and security, of self and others, at all times.
  • Show initiative and self-direct work with minimal direction.
  • Willing and able to travel, depending on need.
  • Ability to interact effectively and appropriately with management and employees at all levels.
  • Interest in transformational change, leadership growth, a track record of servant leadership, and ability to influence without authority.
  • Must be a strong team player, detail-oriented, and perform well under pressure.
  • Must convey a professional image with an ability to lead, manage, and communicate to all levels of associates in a team environment.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • BS degree or higher in Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or similar degree.
  • Experience with automation, facility design, and manufacturing processes and equipment at large production plants and high-volume assembly operations.
  • Familiarization with CAD drawings, cut sheets, construction drawings, and layouts.
  • Knowledge of Theory of Constraints, Design for Manufacturing, and Just In Time methodologies.
  • Certification and relevant work experience in Lean Continuous Improvement.
  • Provide sample work product and robust references upon request.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
Are you ready to turn your love of travel into a career that takes you further than you ever imagined personally and professionally? Your Flight Centre journey is uniquely yours - and we’re here to champion it, celebrate it, and help it take flight. As a Flightie you’re not just building a career - you’re shaping a life filled with purpose, connection, and discovery. If you’re looking for the next stamp in careers passport - we’re looking for Sales Travel Consultants across Australia who are keen to dazzle, discover and delight our customers! Navigate your career. Explore the world.

What you’ll be doing - where your passion will meet purpose!

  • Work full-time, on-site in one of our retail stores on a rotating roster across a 7-day trade
  • Plan itineraries, book travel and convert enquiries into bookings in person, over the phone and via email for our customers
  • Work towards individual KPIs and sales targets where you’ll sell the whole holiday including flights, accommodation, car hire, tours, travel insurance, cruises, transfers and more
  • Build a customer base of new and returning customers from regular domestic bookings to lavish international holidays and everything in between
  • Be the expert! Assist our customers with their travel related questions including visas, best time of year to travel, what to pack, where to eat, what to avoid, you name it!
  • Enjoy a base wage plus an uncapped incentive payment structure where you earn a percentage of every sale, your pay is completely uncapped!

What we’re looking for - do you have the travel bug?

  • You’re a seasoned traveller with a history of international destinations (and even more on your bucket list!) and you’re the go-to person in your circle for travel recommendations, tips and tricks
  • Great organisational skills - you’re the type to take notes, manage your calendar well and are quick to respond to your customer’s phone calls and emails
  • Determination to meet your sales targets and KPIs while balancing your workload in a high-pressure environment (think customers lining up, phones ringing, email inbox filling!)
  • Enthusiasm, passion and a warmth that makes our customers want to book with you every time!
  • A savviness with computers, ready to toggle between various complex systems when finding the right flight and package options for your customer

What you will gain from a career with Flight Centre - let’s unpack the benefits!

💲 We'll boost your wage to $65K equivalent for your first 90 days while you learn the ropes! Average earnings for a Travel Consultant in their first year are $70K, while Senior Consultants average $100K and Team Leaders average $138K annually - including superannuation and penalty rates.

🌏 Become a true expert – access industry travel discounts and qualify for sponsored ‘Familiarisation Trips’ to explore new destinations and products around the world 

💎 Brightness of Future: Career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses across the globe - we promote from within   

🎉 Social: Embrace the famous Flight Centre culture at our Reward & Recognition events throughout the year including our most popular events on the calendar Global Gathering and EOFY Celebration

🎓 Get qualified for free with a Certificate 3 & 4 in Travel & Tourism (worth 20k!) through Australian Apprentice Training - you may also be eligible to receive direct financial support while you study 

🌈 Thrive in a workplace that embraces individualism – come as you are!  

💛 Be part of a workplace committed to reconciliation through our Reconciliation Action Plan - we proudly support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander inclusion, cultural safety, and dedicated cultural leave

Okay, I’m in!

Are you keen to join our team of Flighties? Hit apply now for your application to be read by a real human, no AI here! If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to have a 15-minute phone interview with one of our dedicated team of recruiters. Get ready to work, travel and grow.

Why is Flight Centre such a great place to work?

We are devoted to being a global employer of choice by nurturing our legendary culture - focused on our people and infused with adventure and accountability. We uplift and support our team through a compelling Employee Value Proposition that offers exciting career and travel opportunities, fantastic benefits, a meaningful sense of purpose and well-deserved recognition.   • Must be enrolled as a full-time student pursuing an undergraduate degree in a 4-year academic institution
  • At least a 3.0 GPA on a 4-point scale
  • This position requires the student to work full-time during the Summer 2027 semester. The student cannot actively take any courses (inclusive of online or in-person) and work as an Intern at the same time, which may delay graduation by 1-2 semesters
  • Must be able to work onsite in our Atlanta, GA office for the duration of the internship
  • Working as an Intern does not guarantee a full-time opportunity at Delta Air Lines upon graduation. This position is intended to provide educational and professional work experience to prepare the student for the workforce
  • Ideal candidates have strong analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Intellectual curiosity and a drive for innovation, continuous improvement, and learning
  • Ability to transform complex analyses into clear business recommendations and communicate them effectively to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Demonstrated initiative, ownership, and the ability to independently move work forward with limited direction
  • Proven ability to incorporate feedback, build relationships across teams, develop a strong professional network, and influence outcomes through collaboration
  • Desire to develop leadership skills and apply structured problem-solving techniques to address complex business challenges

Additional Best Practices

In This Role

  • You should be able to listen and learn from people from many different perspectives
  • You should be able to handle shifting priorities that come from business needs

  • Backup dependent care services offered for 25 days highly subsidized by Delta

job.job_description:
Company Description

An oasis immersed in well-being and nature, Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property in Singapore. Located on a clifftop, the new resort on Sentosa Island features 62 contemporary private pool villas surrounded by tropical gardens and views over the South China Sea.

Ranging from 230 square metres in size, each villa is a sanctuary for extended stays. As part of Raffles’ legendary welcome, guests will experience signature markers enlivened by the famous Raffles Butlers and a sustainably created Sentosa Sling.There will be five dining establishments, a spa offering next-generation wellness and a grand ballroom.

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Cluster Assistant Director of Sales, Weddings is responsible for driving the wedding business for Raffles Sentosa Singapore, creating exceptional and personalised experiences for couples and their guests while achieving revenue and business objectives.

The role will lead the end-to-end wedding sales journey, from enquiry and consultation through to contracting and handover, while building strong relationships with clients, wedding planners, event partners, and key stakeholders. The position requires strong commercial acumen, a passion for luxury hospitality, and the ability to create memorable experiences that reflect the distinctive Raffles brand.

What You Will Be DOING

  • Drive wedding sales revenue and achieve agreed financial targets for Raffles Sentosa Singapore.
  • Develop and execute strategies to grow the wedding business, including local, regional, social, and luxury wedding segments.
  • Manage wedding enquiries from initial contact through consultation, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and final handover to the Events Operations team.
  • Conduct personalised wedding consultations and venue showcases, understanding each couple's vision and translating it into a bespoke Raffles experience.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with couples, wedding planners, event agencies, luxury partners, and other key business partners.
  • Proactively develop new wedding leads through networking, referrals, partnerships, events, showcases, and industry contacts.
  • Prepare compelling proposals, quotations, packages, and contracts tailored to clients' requirements.
  • Negotiate confidently with clients while protecting hotel revenue, profitability, and commercial interests.
  • Work closely with Culinary, Events Operations, Butler Services, Rooms Division, and other departments to ensure seamless delivery of weddings.
  • Ensure accurate forecasting, pipeline management, sales reporting, and follow-up of all wedding opportunities.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, wedding trends, and client preferences to identify new business opportunities.
  • Develop creative wedding packages and initiatives that strengthen Raffles Sentosa Singapore's positioning within the luxury wedding market.
  • Maintain accurate records of all enquiries, client interactions, proposals, contracts, and business activities in the relevant systems.
  • Attend wedding fairs, showcases, networking events, site inspections, and client meetings to promote the hotel and generate business.
  • Ensure a smooth and detailed handover from Sales to Events Operations, maintaining clear communication on client expectations and commitments.
  • Support the Director of Events Sales in developing annual sales strategies, budgets, and business plans.

Ensure all business is conducted in accordance with hotel policies, Accor standards, and relevant legal and compliance requirements.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Sales & Marketing, Events Management, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in luxury hospitality, events, wedding sales, catering sales, or a similar role.

Additional Information

Experience

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We serve as consultants, offering strategic advice on how best to excel on Agoda’s commercial platform. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. With the help of industry-leading technology, we work and collaborate globally to bring together the best ideas from diverse perspectives. The SAM team invests in long-term relationships that spans borders and cultures and results in incredible value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers. 

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be the main contact between our accommodation partners and Agoda, with the responsibility of nurturing the relationship with our key supply partners and driving mutual growth. A key responsibility in developing our business is the ability to identify and acquire new sources of supply and product offerings within an assigned territory while maintaining existing relationships.  

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Builds and owns the long-term relationship (through proactive and reactive engagement) between Agoda and their strategic and/or key accounts (comprised of top producing hotel partners).
  • Is responsible for the maintenance and improvement of the performance of their accounts, typically from a portfolio of the top producing properties for the country
  • Proactively engages Agoda's supply partners, utilizing exemplary Strategic Account Management (SAM) approaches and practices to drive mutual growth and maximize value.
  • Actively manages supply partners, providing consultative services and tailor-made solutions to hotel partners to improve mutual revenue growth.
  • Demonstrates a data driven and consultative approach to prioritizing tasks and delivering pitches that lead to high conversion for each hotel partner.
  • Maintains meaningful & high-frequency engagement with supply partners, including a minimum of one face-to-face interaction a quarter.
  • Responds to the needs and requests of hotel partners in a timely and effective manner.
  • Is capable of handling both input and output KPIs and achieves their individual KPIs with minimal supervision from an Area Manager.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in business development and/or account management
  • Strong interpersonal skills & ability to influence both external / internal stakeholders
  • Experience in internet/e-commerce preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Team player with a professional “get it done” attitude and work ethic
  • Proven success in acquiring, building & maintaining long term customer relationships
  • Adapts well to change and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to create new, innovative ideas
  • Strong Proficiency in English and fluent in Thai

 

It’s Great if you have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree
  • Experience in Travel industry

Job Title

Functional Architect

Summary Of The Role

Be a functional and/or technical expertise entry point in Offer Optimization products, specifically Dynamic Pricing, for complex and cross functional/department solutions analysis/recommendation. This is a hybrid position and would you require you to be in the office 50% of the time.

Common Accountabilities

  • Proficient in technical knowledge to ensure team performs at a high level. Is recognized as a leader in own area and may formally train Specialists/Senior Specialists.
  • Understands how main business drivers may impact on own area. Can assess complex problems with broad impact on the activity, improve processes, recommend solutions and risk mitigation plans. Able to communicate complex information.
  • Works with a high level of autonomy, based on management directions. Leads projects or contributes to broad cross-functional projects.
  • May contribute to planning of resources and budget.

Solution Definition and Implementation

  • Be involved in pre-sales or upsell activities.
  • Interact with Product Managers or and directly with the customers to ensure a full understanding of the business needs and customer constraints. Combine focus on customer expectations and integration of Amadeus strategy for any proposal.
  • Contribute to break vision down into achievable actions while keeping global consistency and feasibility over areas.
  • Present solution recommendations to all stakeholders with the ability to explain complex technical information in simple ways to a diverse audience.
  • Responsible for planning, conducting and directing the analysis of highly complex business problems.
  • Scope and size the mission, define deliverables. Involve and coordinate PDA, DEV teams when gaps are identified. Coordinate the activity of other technical consulting analysts for large projects/services. Define action plans and guidelines
  • Conduct in-depth reviews of client business activity including processes, tools, skills/knowledge, organization, structure, strategy and objectives. Understands a broad spectrum of the company's technology to deliver part of a detailed technical design, which meets customer requirements.
  • Assist customers in solution definition and implementation.
  • Monitor business impact of implemented actions on business performance and efficiency and identify additional improvement opportunities.
  • Provide detailed feedback on the clients’ daily usage of the systems and on identified limitations to Product.

Management and Product Definition teams

  • Help sustaining the quality of the products, as used by our customers, hand in hand with Product Definition and Developer teams. Influence the internal product evolution based on feedback collected by translating customer needs and feedback into detailed business requirements.
  • Foster the conversation among teams within the train and program to ensure a clear understanding of the requirements and consistent product solutions.
  • Go beyond own domain of expertise, embrace a wider scope. Investigate all the impacts on Amadeus Solutions and Products that are provided to clients and ensure that they are properly handled and solved by the accurate teams
  • Conduct in-depth reviews of client business activity including processes, tools, skills/knowledge, organization, structure, strategy and objectives.
  • Build a network of POCs in various functional areas.

Customer relationship management

  • Develop a trusted advisor relationship with Key Stakeholders and executive sponsors.
  • Support Customers in understanding the Amadeus organization, processes, and solutions, including the gaps/changes delivered in the context of the project.
  • Work together with Customers to influence the transformation of their Change Management processes from a waterfall approach to an Agile mentality. Encourage the implementation of small-scale experiments and prototypes to build trust and confidence, decrease risk and guarantee continuous value delivery.
  • Collaborate in the preparation workshops and the regular SAFE (Scaled Agile Framework) ceremonies in each Program Increment.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

What We Can Offer You

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, has an opportunity for a Data Scientist 3, Applied AI, on the Data Science team. You will play an integral role in developing predictive analytics and applied AI capabilities in support of key corporate initiatives. Our cross-functional team of data scientists and engineers develops and deploys statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and AI solutions that drive business decisions and interactions with our customers.

The team partners with leaders across the enterprise to deliver end-to-end data science solutions for Marketing, Loyalty, Global Sales, Finance, Franchise Development, eCommerce, and Brands. Examples include customer lifetime value, hotel performance forecasting, site selection, and generative AI applications. In addition to building models, the Data Scientist will contribute to upskilling the team, provide guidance on data sources for ingestion to improve modeling effectiveness, and collaborate with the Data Delivery and IT teams to ensure Choice’s AWS analytics platform can meet future state needs for machine learning, generative AI, and predictive analytics.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead modeling initiatives that drive enterprise decisions, working with stakeholders to solve strategic and operational needs with statistical models and AI.
  • Deliver timely ad hoc analyses and product presentations, including geospatial analyses, that communicate insights to stakeholders.
  • Work with IT and the Data Delivery teams to enhance infrastructure needed to support real-time, machine learning, and generative AI modeling capabilities
  • Deploy solutions using AWS services such as Redshift, Athena, S3, SageMaker AI, Bedrock, and AgentCore.
  • Research cutting-edge methodologies and contribute to upskilling the overall team’s capabilities, including the use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, which are core to how the team prototypes, codes, and performs analysis day to day.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Employment Experience

  • 5+ years of analytical experience, with a background in predictive modeling and statistical techniques such as regression, segmentation and clustering, and time series analysis
  • Hands-on experience building with large language models (LLMs)

Technical Skills

  • Experience with Machine Learning approaches and techniques such as decision trees, gradient boosted models, and neural networks, including standard data preparation and model evaluation practices
  • Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows
  • Comfort with (or strong enthusiasm to adopt) AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code; agentic coding workflows are a major part of our day-to-day work
  • Working knowledge of Python/R and SQL, along with Git version control and code review practices
  • Familiarity with the ML and AI model development lifecycle from prototyping through deployment and monitoring in production
  • Comfortable with lightweight data engineering, data quality monitoring, data profiling, and preparing datasets
  • Knowledge of AWS services such as Redshift, Athena, S3, Lambda, SageMaker AI, Bedrock, and AgentCore; AWS certification is a plus
  • Experience with geospatial analytics and tools (e.g., ArcGIS, GeoPandas, PostGIS) is a plus
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Must be an energized self-starter who can work independently and who drives for results
  • Ability to evaluate business trends and develop successful solutions that enhance business performance
  • Effectively partner with business stakeholders to ensure integrated and timely insights to the enterprise
  • Has strong intellectual curiosity and is an active learner, able to enhance personal, professional, and business growth through new knowledge and experiences.
  • Results oriented; delivers results under difficult conditions and demonstrates balanced judgment under pressure
  • Writes clean, clear, and well-documented code that others can read, maintain, and build on
  • Good communication skills, including oral (one on one and presentations to large audiences) and written

Education Requirements

  • Master’s Degree in Data Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research or other quantitative field

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

The salary range for this position is $114,907-135,000. Pay ranges listed are what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. Actual pay may be higher or lower and ranges may be adjusted in the future. Pay positioning within the range is influenced by factors including—but not limited to—education, experience, skills, certifications, performance, geographic location, business needs, seniority, and travel requirements.

LOCATION & WORK SCHEDULE:

This role is based at our corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, and follows a hybrid work schedule, requiring regular in-office collaboration alongside remote work flexibility.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a MICE Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

As a MICE Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving the growth and success of the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Events (MICE) segment for the hotel. You will proactively identify and secure new business opportunities, manage key client relationships, and position the hotel as a preferred venue for meetings and events. Working closely with internal departments, you will focusing on delivering exceptional customer experiences while achieving revenue and sales targets.

  • Identify New Business Opportunities: Analyse local market trends and competitor activity to identify new leads, uncover emerging opportunities, and recommend strategies that support future and repeat business growth.
  • Develop and Grow Customer Accounts: Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients and key stakeholders, travelling within the UK as required to generate new business and increase market share across all revenue streams.
  • Negotiate and Secure Business: Prepare tailored proposals and negotiate competitive packages with corporate clients to maximise revenue while meeting customer needs.
  • Support Business Strategy: Work within established commercial strategies while proactively identifying opportunities to expand business and improve performance.
  • Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with operational and commercial teams to create exceptional guest experiences and deliver comprehensive sales programmes that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Represent the Hotel at Industry Events: Attend sales events, networking opportunities, exhibitions, and industry functions to strengthen relationships, promote the hotel, and generate leads.
  • Provide Reporting and Business Insights: Produce accurate and timely reports for the Senior Management Team, including sales activity, appointments, business leads, and conversion performance.
  • Deliver Excellent Customer Service: Respond to customer enquiries promptly and professionally, ensuring a high standard of service throughout the sales journey

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 3-5 years in hospitality sales with strong MICE experience.
  • Proven track record in account management and revenue growth.
  • Exceptional leadership and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to analyze market trends and develop innovative strategies.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of global MICE trends and digital event solutions.

Qualifications

What’s the job?

As Assistant Finance Manager, you will be the key day-to-day Finance leader based at Kimpton Vividora Barcelona, working closely with and reporting to the Cluster Director of Finance, who oversees the financial leadership of Barcelona and Mallorca.

You will act as the right hand of the Cluster Director of Finance, taking strong ownership of the daily financial and accounting operation of the Barcelona hotel. Your role is to ensure that reporting, controls, reconciliations, credit, accounts payable and receivable, cash management, budgeting and forecasting processes are accurate, timely and robust, allowing the Cluster Director of Finance to focus effectively on the strategic and cluster responsibilities of both properties.

This role goes beyond accounting. We are looking for a hands-on finance leader and business partner who understands hotel operations, uses financial analysis and data to anticipate issues and opportunities, and helps department heads make better business decisions.

People leadership is equally important. You will help lead, organise and develop the Finance team, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, efficiency and continuous professional growth.

Finance Leadership & Cluster Partnership

  • Act as the day-to-day Finance lead for Kimpton Vividora Barcelona, partnering closely with the Cluster Director of Finance.
  • Oversee the hotel's financial operations, ensuring accuracy, compliance and timely execution.
  • Support consistent financial processes, controls and best practices across the cluster.
  • Identify and communicate financial risks, opportunities and performance trends.

People & Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Plan, prioritise and monitor team workload and performance.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, training and succession planning.
  • Promote cross-functional collaboration and strong relationships across departments.
  • Lead by example with integrity, professionalism and attention to detail.

Accounting, Month-End & Financial Reporting

  • Lead month-end closing activities and ensure timely, accurate financial reporting.
  • Oversee balance sheet reconciliations and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Review financial performance and provide meaningful variance analysis.
  • Ensure proper recording and classification of revenues and expenses.
  • Support monthly reporting requirements for management, ownership and IHG.

Budget, Forecast & Business Planning

  • Support the preparation of budgets, forecasts and business plans.
  • Partner with department heads to develop realistic financial projections.
  • Analyse performance versus Budget, Forecast and Prior Year.
  • Identify opportunities to improve profitability, productivity and cost efficiency.

Business Partnering & Profitability

  • Act as a trusted financial business partner to hotel leadership.
  • Provide actionable financial insights to support decision-making.
  • Promote financial awareness and accountability across departments.
  • Challenge assumptions and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

AR/AP/Controls/Audit

  • Oversee Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and cash management processes.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions.
  • Protect company assets and maintain the highest standards of ethics and confidentiality.

Systems & Continuous Improvement
