job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

GetYourGuide is building the world’s leading platform for travel experiences. Our B2B brand is the face of that business to thousands of suppliers globally — and we’re looking for a Senior Brand Designer to own the craft that makes it exceptional.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the primary designer on B2B brand work — executing at a high level across campaigns, events, product touchpoints, and brand systems. You will set the visual standard for the B2B design team and for freelancers and agencies you work alongside.

This role sits within Creative Studio, reporting to the Design Lead, and works in close collaboration with Creative Strategy B2B and Strategic Operations. Craft is the foundation of this role — creative excellence is the goal. Your ownership is craft and creative: the design decisions and execution that make the work exceptional, and the relentless push to raise what “good” looks like. Beyond craft, you bring creativity and a drive for creative excellence, elevating the work of everyone in Creative Studio, including the freelancers and agencies you work alongside.

Your mission

  • Campaign work — 360 campaigns including our flagship supplier product release, our annual industry research publication, and seasonal campaigns across supplier-facing channels.
  • Events — our flagship supplier summits bringing together B2B suppliers in Berlin, Bangkok, and Sydney, plus tradeshows and field events across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. You own the visual identity for bespoke events end-to-end.
  • Brand systems — extending and applying the B2B brand guidelines across all touchpoints; building playbooks, templates, and toolkits that allow the team to scale without starting from scratch.
  • Product x Brand integration — aligning B2B brand expression with product surfaces, marketing UI, and the supplier website.

Your toolkit

We are looking for a designer whose work is immediately recognisable for its quality and creativity: someone who actively pushes creative excellence forward and raises the bar in every file they open.

  • 5+ years of brand design experience, with a strong portfolio spanning campaigns, identity, and systems.
  • Exceptional execution across both digital and print — you are as comfortable designing a hero visual as you are building a scalable template system.
  • Highly organized, with experience working in a fast-moving in-house team, managing multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing quality.
  • Proven ability to brief and elevate freelancers and agencies through the quality of your own work.
  • Fluency in Figma; experience working within and extending established brand systems.
  • Proven experience building scalable design systems — templates, guidelines, and toolkits that allow teams to execute consistently without starting from scratch.
  • Experience reviewing and art-directing website landing pages — you understand how brand expression translates to product surfaces and marketing UI.
  • A clear point of view on design — you bring a hypothesis to every brief and can articulate why your decisions serve the brand and the business.

You will thrive here if you default to showing work rather than describing it, you check in before moving and move fast once aligned, and you are energised by a brand that is still being built — and by the responsibility that comes with that.

Extras that give you an edge

  • You’re energized by AI: you make time to experiment, build intuition through hands-on trials, and translate discoveries into practical improvements in how you work.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development

And more…

We are actively recruiting a Director, Global Tax Accounting, to join our team. This role will have oversight and responsibility over the global tax accounting function and report directly to the Vice President of Tax.

The ideal candidate is a highly technical ASC 740 expert with 15+ years of progressive experience who possesses a strong change mindset. As a US-based multinational corporation, we need a leader with the ability to own and stay lock step with tax technical and regulatory changes in the jurisdictions in which we operate, as well as incorporate business changes unique to a quarter, while actively championing change.

In this role, you will own our global tax accounting strategy, moving beyond historical reporting to modernize our tax technology, streamline workflows, and act as a strategic advisor to leadership.

You will lead an outsourced tax provision function leveraging the broader global tax organization during interim and year-end close cycles to modernize our processes, mitigate risk, and navigate a rapidly evolving regulatory environment, with the ultimate goal of migrating to an insourced tax provision process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Global Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting (ASC 740)
  • Manage all tax accounting and financial reporting of taxes, including interim and annual calculations of the global tax provision, effective tax rate (ETR), tax reserves (ASC 740-10/FIN 48), and external tax disclosures (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, etc.).
  • Oversee the accurate and timely preparation, review, and disclosure of the global consolidated income tax provision (quarterly and annually) in accordance with ASC 740.
  • Responsible for update of the quarterly worldwide legal entity rolling forecast based on the WW forecast provided by FP&A, ensure proper inputs and review of the GAAP to statutory differences, update of permanent and material temporary differences for Tier 1 entities, and timely identification of discrete items for a given quarter for calculation of the EAETR and resulting journal entry.
  • Manage current and deferred tax reporting for all domestic and foreign legal entities pursuant to ASC 740. This includes valuation allowances, indefinite reinvestment assertions on outside basis differences, and foreign currency translation adjustments.
  • Lead the tax component of SEC filings (Form 10-K, 10-Q), ensuring impeccable footnotes, MD&A disclosures, and compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404) internal controls.
  • Manage complex multinational tax accounting issues, including valuation allowances, uncertain tax positions (ASC 740-10/FIN 48), and business combinations.
  • Regulatory Modernization: Monitor, evaluate, and implement accounting workflows for recent and evolving tax laws, specifically OECD Pillar Two Global Minimum Tax, Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax (CAMT), changing international provisions (GILTI/NCTI, Subpart F, Foreign Tax Credits) and local country tax laws to assess their financial statement impacts.
  • Explain and discuss technical tax accounting items clearly with senior management, the CFO, and independent auditors.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Accounting on internal accounting method changes and new Accounting Standards (US GAAP/SEC) along with their related tax accounting implications.
  • Forecasting & Process Transformation (Change Mindset)
  • Dynamic Forecasting: Manage the forecast of interim and annual effective tax rates and cash taxes. Partner closely with FP&A to establish dynamic forecasting models broken down by legal entity.
  • Process & Technology Innovation: Actively drive tax accounting process improvements and technology transformation. Identify, champion, and implement advanced tax technology, automation tools, and data/analytics solutions to streamline the close engine and reduce manual risk, leveraging AI for effective data analytics.
  • SOX Excellence: Develop, maintain, and enhance a best-in-class SOX infrastructure, ensuring effective and practical internal controls and related SOX 404 documentation across all provision and compliance systems.
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Manage the day-to-day activities of the tax accounting function, providing high-impact leadership, development, and technical consultation.
  • Act as a visible, transformative senior leader responsible for developing forward-looking objectives, motivating team members across the tax function and fostering an agile team culture capable of navigating regulatory changes.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in corporate taxation, with a heavy emphasis on ASC 740. A combination of large public accounting (Big 4) and multinational public company industry experience is preferred.
  • Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in accounting is required (Master's in Tax or Accounting preferred). CPA certification is required.
  • Technical Excellence: Master-level technical expertise in all aspects of tax accounting (ASC 740) and US GAAP within large, consolidated corporations and complex multinationals.
  • Systems & Data Literacy: Proven track record in process improvement and the implementation of tax technology, data, and analytics tools. Hands-on experience maintaining and enhancing provision systems (e.g., ONESOURCE Tax Provision), ERP systems (e.g., SAP), and consolidation tools (e.g., HFM) is highly desired.
  • Leadership & Courage: Proven track record in leadership, team building, and change management. Ability to clearly explain financial risks, challenge the status quo, and make strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Communication: Well-developed written and oral communication skills, with a specific ability to translate complex international tax legislation into clear business impacts.

Desired Soft Skills

The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, a champion for continuous improvement, and an expert in critical thinking, analysis, and collaborative problem-solving.

  • Proactive, highly responsive, and resourceful when facing complex data challenges.
  • Highly flexible, motivated, and comfortable driving initiatives independently or within cross-functional teams.
  • Able to multi-task, prioritize effectively, and maintain composure under tight quarter-end deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively and build trust across all levels of the organization.

Benefits/Perks

  • Competitive compensation
  • Generous Paid Time Off (5 weeks PTO your first year!)
  • 4 days (one per quarter) of Volunteer Time Off (VTO)
  • Year-End break from Dec 26th – Dec 31st
  • We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and Wellness Programs
  • Paid parental leave
  • An infrastructure that allows flexible working arrangements
  • Formal and informal reward, recognition, and acknowledgment programs

Position Summary

The Manager, Performance Analytics, APEC is a full-time individual contributor role responsible for delivering commercial performance insights, scalable analytical framework & report, and executive-ready analytical narratives for the APEC Commercial Services Analytics team. The role delivers recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance routines, benchmarking reporting, revenue and commercial analytics, Annual Business Planning, goal setting, and strategic initiatives that help stakeholders monitor business performance, identify risks and opportunities, and drive fact-based commercial decisions across APEC.

This position partners closely with Commercial Services Analytics team members, market and regional stakeholders, and cross-functional partners to frame business questions, validate data, develop analytical approaches, and translate findings into clear, concise, and business-relevant insights. The Manager is expected to own assigned analytics deliverables from requirement clarification through analysis, visualization, stakeholder communication, and post-delivery refinement.

As an individual contributor, the role does not have direct people management accountability. However, the Manager is expected to provide horizontal mentoring, knowledge sharing, and analytical guidance to peers, junior team members, and interns where relevant. This includes helping others strengthen analytical thinking, reporting discipline, data storytelling, documentation practices, and business understanding, while contributing to a collaborative and high-quality analytics culture.

The role will also contribute to the development, maintenance, and enhancement of scalable reporting and visualization capabilities, including Tableau/Power BI dashboards and related analytical assets. Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, commercial acumen, stakeholder management, attention to detail, and the ability to convert complex data into practical insights and leadership-ready communication.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • 4-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, commercial analysis, revenue strategy, performance reporting, dashboard development, or a related analytical function.
  • Experience translating business questions into analytical requirements, conducting structured analysis, validating outputs, and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience working with corporate reports, dashboards, data preparation, reporting visualizations, and analytical summaries for leadership or business review routines.
  • Preferred: Working experience in Commercial, Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Customer, Travel, Hospitality, or related business intelligence environments.
  • Preferred: Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, APIs, automated data workflows, Power Platform, or related analytics tools.
  • Preferred: Experience guiding junior analysts, peers, interns, or cross-functional partners through analytical logic, reporting standards, documentation, or data storytelling.

Skills And Knowledge

  • Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to work with large datasets, identify trends, diagnose performance drivers, validate findings, and summarize insights clearly.
  • Ability to connect commercial performance, market dynamics, revenue trends, market share movement, and business context into practical analytical outputs and recommendations.
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate analysis into concise summaries, visual outputs, executive-ready materials, and business-facing narratives.
  • Ability to frame business questions, clarify analytical requirements, define success metrics, and determine practical approaches to support stakeholder decision making.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, consistency, governance, and quality.
  • Ability to independently manage recurring reporting deliverables, prioritize multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and maintain high-quality execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across Commercial, Revenue Strategy, Market, Regional, Global, and cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, with a proactive approach to follow-up, issue resolution, process improvement, and continuous learning.
  • Excellent command of the English language, with strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare leadership-ready materials and explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is essential.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL is required and familiarity with database environments such as Snowflake is preferred.
  • Experience with Power BI or Tableau, including dashboard development, data visualization, performance monitoring, report enhancement, and stakeholder self-service enablement.
  • Exposure to statistical analysis, forecasting, automation, Python, Power Platform, or related programming languages is advantageous.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Own assigned monthly and quarterly performance reporting deliverables for APEC Commercial Services Analytics, including data preparation, validation, analysis, interpretation, and summary of key trends.
  • Analyze commercial, revenue, benchmarking and performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, performance drivers, and areas requiring further review.
  • Translate analytical outputs into clear, concise, and business-relevant insights, narratives, and recommendations for internal stakeholders and leadership materials.
  • Maintain, enhance, and govern analytical reports, dashboards, and data assets used for commercial performance management and decision support.
  • Support the development and improvement of Tableau/Power BI dashboards and other visualization tools to strengthen performance monitoring, stakeholder self-service, and reporting efficiency
  • Prepare data extracts, analysis, charts, talking points, and supporting materials for leadership communication decks, business reviews, Annual Business Planning, goal setting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify business questions, define analytical requirements, align on assumptions, and ensure outputs are fit for purpose.
  • Conduct data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and quality checks to ensure accuracy and reliability of reporting outputs.
  • Lead assigned ad hoc analysis and special projects, including problem framing, analytical approach, stakeholder alignment, insight generation, and final deliverable preparation.
  • Contribute to process improvement, automation, and standardization opportunities that improve reporting efficiency, analytical quality, and repeatability.
  • Document reporting logic, data sources, assumptions, business definitions, and process steps to support continuity, transparency, and knowledge transfer.
  • Monitor recurring reporting processes and dashboard usability, recommending enhancements that reduce manual effort, improve stakeholder adoption, and strengthen decision support.
  • Provide horizontal mentoring and knowledge sharing to peers, junior team members, and interns where relevant, including guidance on analytical thinking, data validation, dashboard logic, documentation, and business storytelling.

About the Company

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is an award-winning global provider of innovative and cost-effective travel solutions spanning corporate, events, leisure, loyalty and wholesale travel. The company’s proven business strategy is underpinned by personalized service excellence supported by market leading technology solutions which deliver a return on investment to our customers. Headquartered in Australia with its Asia head office in Hong Kong, the company provides local service solutions to customers of all sizes across the world including Hong Kong, Singapore, China, Taiwan and Japan in Asia. CTM is an award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions to the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. Its proven business strategy combines personalized service excellence with client-facing technology solutions to deliver a return on investment to clients.


About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic, commercially driven and strategic leader to lead CTM's corporate sales growth across Asia. The General Manager, Corporate Sales, Asia will be responsible for developing and executing the regional corporate sales strategy, driving new business and revenue growth, strengthening key client relationships and leading a high-performing sales organisation across the region.


This is a hands-on regional leadership role. The successful candidate will personally drive strategic and high-value opportunities while providing the commercial direction, leadership and market insight needed to accelerate growth across Asia.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Growth:

  • Develop and execute CTM's corporate sales strategy across Asia, driving revenue, profitability and sustainable growth.
  • Set regional sales priorities, targets and KPIs, and build a strong pipeline through proactive business development.
  • Personally lead strategic, high-value sales opportunities, tenders and RFPs, particularly for multinational and regional clients.
  • Leverage global and local market capabilities to identify and convert regional growth opportunities.
  • Monitor market and competitive trends to strengthen CTM's position in Asia.


Commercial Performance & P&L Management:

  • Own the commercial performance of the Asia corporate sales business, including P&L, budgets, forecasting and resource allocation.
  • Monitor sales performance, pipeline conversion and financial results, identifying opportunities to improve productivity and profitability.
  • Provide senior leadership with clear updates on performance, opportunities, risks and recommendations.


Leadership & Organisation Development:

  • Lead, motivate and develop sales leaders and teams across Asia to achieve and exceed business targets.
  • Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer focus and continuous improvement.
  • Coach and develop sales leaders and high-potential talent to strengthen regional commercial capability.


Strategic Client & Business Development:

  • Build strong relationships with key multinational, regional and strategic corporate clients and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Lead major client negotiations, strategic accounts and complex sales opportunities, developing compelling TMC solutions and value propositions.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate regional and global corporate travel programmes.
  • Champion CTM's brand and represent the Company at key industry, client and regional events.


Regional & Global Collaboration:

  • Partner with global and local leadership to align Asia's commercial strategy and share best practices.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Technology, Finance and other functions to deliver effective client solutions and commercial strategies.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities and translate them into actionable growth initiatives.
  • Support strategic projects and other initiatives that contribute to CTM's regional and global objectives.


Market & Brand Leadership:

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the corporate travel and TMC landscape across Asia, including market trends, technology, supplier developments and changing customer expectations.
  • Champion CTM's brand and value proposition within the corporate travel market.
  • Represent CTM at key industry, client and regional events to strengthen market visibility, relationships and business opportunities.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities and translate them into actionable commercial strategies.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Support senior leadership on strategic initiatives that contribute to CTM's regional or global objectives.
  • Undertake other responsibilities as required to support the continued growth and development of the Asia corporate sales business.


Skills and Experiences

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in corporate sales, business development, corporate travel, TMC or a related B2B commercial environment.
  • At least 5 years of experience in senior sales, commercial or business development leadership, with a proven track record of leading teams and delivering significant revenue growth.

  • Excellent executive presence, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging C-suite clients.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Senior Software Developer will be responsible for the development of critical applications, while working with a team of developers. This role will design, develop, document, test and debug new and existing applications. Additionally, this role will build these applications with a focus on delivering cloud-based solutions. The individual will use groundbreaking technologies and enterprise grade integration software daily and will be relied upon to help take the team to the next level from a technological standpoint.

  • Manages and participates in full development life cycle including requirements analysis and design using Agile methodologies
  • Serve as technical expert on development projects
  • Write technical specifications based on conceptual design and stated business requirements
  • Support, maintain, and document software functionality
  • Identify and evaluate new technologies for implementation
  • Analyze code to find causes of errors and revise programs as needed
  • Managers and participates in software design meetings and analyze user needs to determine technical requirements
  • Collaborate & lead tech teams consisting of employees & vendor company contractors in planning and execution, serving as an technology leader 
  • Collaborate with end user to prototype, refine, test, and debug programs to meet needs

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Management Information Systems or related field 
  • 4+ years of experience in design, development, documenting, testing, and debugging of new and existing software systems and/or applications for market sale or large-scale proprietary software for internal use in an agile environment
  • 4+ years’ experience implementing AWS technologies (Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch, CloudFront, Cognito, route53, Dynamo DB, ECS, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway). Active MQ, RDS - Aurora Postgres, , Route 53,  Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, Cloudwatch, EFS
  • Experience with Cloud Automation Development Tool such as Git, Python/Bash/PowerShell Scripting 
  • Hands-on development and proficient excellence in backend API development using Node.js Java and Python (nice to have)
  • 4+ years’ experience in Java 25, Springboot 2.7 & 3, Node JS 9.5 & Angular 15, Python ; Code Repo: Github Cloud ; CI/CD (DevOps): Harness (1st Gen, Next Gen); Image Repo: Artifactory (Cloud) ; Container Orchestration: Kubernetes
  • Strong knowledg of Microsoft .Net Framework, Microsoft .Net Core, SLQ, NoSQL and Design Pattersn
  • Knowledge of APIs, JSON, XML, and OAuth
  • AI : Claude, Agentic AI or CoPilot in SDLC
  • Excellent knowledge of Object-Oriented systems design and Application Development
  • Web development, API integrations, Cloud technologies 
  • Experience in AI domains. 
  • Solid technical understanding of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), APIs, CI/CD, web technologies, and DevOps practices. 
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum or SAFe frameworks and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps). 
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and documentation abilities. 
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

The base pay range for this role is $112,480.00 to $146,540.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

We’re adventure seekers. Smile givers. Impact makers.
We believe in the power of travel. It broadens horizons for our customers, and for our people too. New places to live, new roles to explore, new communities to join. It’s yours for the taking.
We’re TUI, a leading global travel and leisure experience company that makes holiday dreams come true for people around the world.
We are one of the world’s leading tourism groups counting 1200 travel agencies and online portals, five airlines with around 130 aircraft, over 400 hotels, 16 cruise liners, digital platforms for tours and activities and most importantly over 60 000 colleagues around the world. What unites us is creating moments that enrich the lives of our 21 million customers.
Beside the unforgettable experience we provide our customers, we also believe in the good that tourism can bring and we care deeply about our environmental impact. The TUI Care foundation has projects in over 30 countries worldwide, building on the potential of tourism as a global force for development. The Foundation opens up new perspectives through education and training, empowers local communities to benefit from the success of tourism and engages in the protection of nature and the environment.
At TUI we simply say “Let’s TUI it”. For us, that means creating happiness. Tackling challenges every day together, with a positive, can-do attitude, and finding solutions even for the most unexpected situations. Our teams across TUI are just as diverse as our destinations. So whether you have lots of experience or none at all. If you want to work in an office or feel best in the field. No matter if you’re an accomplished tech whizz, an aspiring entertainer, or simply in love with flying.
There’s a place for you here.
job.job_description:
Bei der TUI Deutschland GmbH in Hannover bieten wir ab September 26 eine äußerst interessante und vielseitige Ausbildung zum Tourismuskaufmann (m/w/d) mit dem Schwerpunkt Reisevermittlung in unserem Reisebüros in Jever an.

UNSER ANGEBOT

  • Eine Ausbildung im größten globalen Touristikkonzern
  • Onboarding sowie weitere spannende Schulungen, Seminare und Workshops
  • Teilnahme an einer Seminarreise sowie einem mehrwöchigen Auslandseinsatz
  • Ein modernes Reisebüroumfeld und großartige Teammitglieder
  • Umfassende Weiterbildungsangebote sowie regelmäßige Teilnahme an Inforeisen
  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr sowie eine angemessene Ausbildungsvergütung (1032 € / 1.143 € / 1.287 € / Monat)
  • Weitere persönliche Benefits: Wir bieten großzügige Reisevorteile, umfangreiche Health & Wellbeing Angebote uvm.
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • Und was können wir von Dir lernen? Wir sind offen für Deine Ideen!

ZUR POSITION

Reisen und die Welt erkunden interessiert Dich? Du planst und organisierst Deine Reisen und den Urlaub Deiner Familie und Freunde immer selbst? Du suchst nach einer beruflichen Herausforderung und möchtest Dein Hobby gerne zum Beruf machen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Wir bieten Dir die Chance, für Deine Kunden außergewöhnliche Reiseerlebnisse zu planen, eigene Erfahrungen einzubringen und Dein Verkaufstalent auszubauen.

Deine Ausbildung Wird Folgendes Beinhalten

  • Beratung und Begeisterung unserer Kunden und Kundinnen
  • Planung und Verkauf von Reiseerlebnissen
  • Informationen rund um die Reise für die Kunden und Kundinnen individuell aufbereiten
  • Digitale Kommunikation in Verbindung mit modernenn Online-/Offline-Tools
  • Mitwirken an Marketing- und Social Media-Aktivitäten
  • Korrespondenz mit Kunden und Kundinnen und Leistungsträgern

ZU DIR

  • Abitur, Fachabitur oder Realschulabschluss
  • Flexibilität, Offenheit, und Serviceorientierung
  • Spaß an Teamarbeit, am Verkaufen und am Kontakt mit unseren Kunden und Kundinnen
  • Gutes mündliches und schriftliches Ausdrucksvermögen
  • Freude am Umgang mit moderner Technik und multimedialer Kommunikation
  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Verkauf oder in der Kundenbetreuung von Vorteil

Bitte bewirb Dich für einen Ausbildungsbeginn im September 2026 mit folgenden Unterlagen online:

  • Anschreiben
  • Lebenslauf
  • Kopie der letzten zwei Schulzeugnisse bzw. Kopie des Abschlusszeugnisses
  • Evtl. Praktikumsbescheinigungen, Zertifikate usw.

Wie geht es dann weiter?

  • Eingangsbestätigung: Deine Bewerbung wird sorgfältig geprüft.
  • So schnell wie möglich laden wir dich zu einem Gespräch ein, um dich persönlich kennenzulernen.
  • Finale Rückmeldung: Bei positiver Entscheidung erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot.
  • Start deiner neuen Karriere: Im September 2026 geht’s dann los – wir freuen uns auf dich!

Deine Einzigartigkeit kann unsere Inspiration für die Zukunft des Reisens sein. Wenn du mehr darüber erfahren möchtest, was Diversity & Inclusion für uns bedeutet, besuche einfach unsere DNA. Wir ermuntern Menschen mit Behinderung, sich zu bewerben.

job.job_description:
¡Únete a nuestro movimiento y defiende la cultura gastronómica! 💚

En TheFork creemos que las mejores cosas de la vida suceden alrededor de una mesa.

Como la plataforma de reservas de restaurantes líder en Europa, conectamos a la mayor comunidad de comensales fieles con sus restaurantes favoritos en todo el mundo. Impulsados por la innovación y una profunda pasión por la industria de la restauración, creamos experiencias gastronómicas únicas en 11 países.

Formamos parte del Grupo TripAdvisor y nos enorgullece construir una cultura diversa centrada en las personas, donde prosperan valores como el respeto, la responsabilidad (ownership), el crecimiento y el mejor juntos.

Si te apasiona la comida, la tecnología y generar un impacto real, tu lugar en nuestra mesa está reservado.

👉 Discover life at TheFork

Qué Harás

  • Gestionar el pipeline asignado y realizar prospección activa (llamadas en frío, visitas sin cita previa y reuniones presenciales) en Valencia y alrededores.
  • Seleccionar los restaurantes dentro del alcance basándote en las recomendaciones de marketing para programar y organizar tu agenda diaria/semanal de forma proactiva.
  • Representar de forma efectiva y profesional nuestra marca así como los valores de la misma (better together, ownership, growth, respect).
  • Explicar a los propietarios y responsables de restaurantes las oportunidades, características y beneficios de TheFork Manager para la gestión de su negocio.
  • Realizar el seguimiento continuo con los clientes hasta cerrar la colaboración y garantizar que el restaurante quede publicado on-line con éxito asegurando una buena comunicación con el resto de equipos involucrados en la venta.
  • Adaptar la estrategia de interacción para conocer las necesidades de cada restaurante, aportarles valor a sus planes de negocio y crear relaciones a largo plazo.
  • Alcanzar los objetivos de ventas mensuales y/o trimestrales con una distribución semanal adecuada a los tiempos de venta.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de operaciones de ventas, soporte a proveedores y gestión de cuentas para garantizar un ciclo de ventas fluido y eficiente.
  • Demostrar determinación, dinamismo y resiliencia ante los retos del día a día para llegar a los volúmenes de productividad requeridos.
  • Entender la cadena de valor B2B así como atender a los distintos stakeholders tanto externos e internos y velar por una experiencia de marca positiva.
  • Retención y fidelización de clientes durante los primeros meses de colaboración para asegurar una adopción sostenible en el tiempo.
  • Networking con los principales players del mercado así como entender nuestra propuesta de valor versus otros proveedores de Saas.

Quién Eres

  • Presentas entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en ventas B2B, preferiblemente en una empresa online y de forma presencial (face2face).
  • Experiencia en gestión de territorio y pipeline utilizando Salesforce u otra herramienta CRM.
  • Dominio fluido del español (nivel C2) y nivel intermedio-alto de inglés (B2).
  • El valenciano es un plus (no indispensable)
  • Es obligatorio poseer vehículo propio (coche o moto).
  • Se valorará positivamente la experiencia en el sector de la hostelería (hospitality).
  • Sólidas habilidades comunicativas aplicadas a la venta, negociación y cierre de operaciones.
  • Perfil hunter orientado a resultados, con una motivación constante por captar nuevos clientes y cold-calling.
  • Proactivo/a y autónomo/a, con capacidad para sacar adelante iniciativas sin supervisión constante.
  • Persona segura de sí misma, dinámica, flexible, organizada y capaz de trabajar con éxito en un entorno ágil y cambiante.

Qué Te Ofrecemos

  • 😄 Un equipo increíble
  • 🏠 Contrato indefinido (siempre viene bien en la vida)
  • ⚖️ Entorno de trabajo flexible (trabajo remoto)
  • 💸 Salario fijo competitivo y bonus
  • 🍕 Tickets restaurante por cada día laborable (porque sí, nos encanta probar nuestros mejores restaurantes)
  • 🌎 Equipos internacionales y un entorno multicultural repartido en 10 oficinas por toda Europa
  • 🤝 Entorno de trabajo altamente inclusivo
  • 🤸‍♀️ Beneficios de estilo de vida: reembolsos para gastos relacionados con actividades físicas y de ocio, apoyo familiar, viajes, etc.
  • 🎓 Programas de formación y desarrollo continuo
  • 😌 Acceso gratuito a la app Calm para ayudarte a cuidar tu bienestar mental dondequiera que estés
  • 🐣 Políticas dedicadas de baja por paternidad/maternidad y cuidados (12 semanas totalmente remuneradas)
  • ⏳ Un programa dedicado a ayudarte a conseguir el mejor equilibrio entre vida laboral y personal
  • 🏥 Seguro médico cubierto totalmente por la empresa
  • 👩‍🦽 Seguro de vida y de invalidez sin coste para el empleado
  • 🎤 Eventos de Team Building

All hiring happens through our careers site and official email. We do not text or ask for payment during the hiring process. Please report any suspicious messages immediately.

Our Mission: We make hotel travel possible for all. Wherever people go, Wyndham will be there to welcome them.

job.job_description:
Job description:

Why Wyndham?

By joining Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, you will play an integral role in our mission to make hotel travel possible for all. You’ll be part of the largest hotel franchise company in the world, where we strive to deliver the best value to our owners and guests. Most importantly, you’ll be entrusted to live our unique Count on Me culture, set by our core values of integrity, accountability, inclusive, caring and fun. At Wyndham, we provide all team members the opportunity to grow through best-in-class training and career development, leadership training, mentorship opportunities and educational support.  Supporting our team members is a top priority, which is why we offer competitive compensation and benefits, vacation, team member appreciation days, workplace flexibility and much more.  At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we value and embrace a culture of diversity, equity and inclusion that supports team members of all backgrounds and experiences. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The Role

Manager of FP&A is an integral role in the Strategic Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting process and will be responsible for providing support to Senior Leadership. This role will own the coordination and preparation of the forecasted Cash Flow and Capital Planning including meeting with leadership and key stakeholders to understand the long-term organizational implications. Further, this role will involve preparing necessary financial reporting on a weekly/monthly/quarterly and annual basis. This individual will assist in analyzing financial statements and results to be communicated to internal and external leadership. They will assist in preparing analyses and standard reports to Finance management as well as various corporate groups (Internal Reporting, External Reporting and Investor Relations). 

What you'll do
  • Coordination and preparation of the forecasted cash flow model. 
  • Assist in the preparation of monthly/quarterly reporting deliverables to finance management and Executive Committee including CFO and CEO Monthly Package Reporting.
  • Manage the preparation of monthly interest expense forecasts, foreign exchange analysis, and balance sheet FX exposure assessments.
  • Coordinating Finance Business Review process with regards to coordinating meetings and maintaining documentation.
  • Lead and coordinate SPAR financial aggregation and work with project managers and business partners to facilitate business case development. 
  • Track project financial readouts and ensure capital forecast is tracking towards expectations.
  • Preparation of ad hoc analysis ranging from collection analysis to operating statistics. 
  • Directly manage and mentor two analysts, providing guidance, performance feedback, and opportunities for professional development.
  • Oversee the day-to-day tasks of the senior analysts, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, data analysis, and adherence to deadlines.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment, encouraging the senior analysts to contribute ideas and actively participate in team projects and strategic discussions.
  • Conduct regular variance analysis, identifying and explaining deviations between actual results and forecasts.
You'll be successful if you have
  • Ability to work under pressure and at a fast pace while not sacrificing accuracy.
  • Capability to meet tight deadlines set by corporate and department heads.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt to changing requests, and be able to prioritize work.
  • Capability to work and complete tasks without continuous supervision.
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting, with a strong understanding of hospitality-specific KPIs such as ADR, RevPAR, and occupancy rates.
  • Proven ability to analyze and interpret financial data, providing actionable insights to drive revenue growth and cost optimization within the hospitality sector.
  • Experience in using revenue management software and ERP systems (e.g., Oracle, SAP) specific to the hospitality industry, along with advanced proficiency in Excel and business intelligence tools like Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong leadership skills, with a track record of managing cross-functional teams and collaborating with operations, sales, and marketing to align financial strategies with overall business objectives.
  • In-depth knowledge of market trends, competitive analysis, and risk management within the hospitality industry, with the ability to contribute to strategic planning and capital expenditure decisions.
Required Qualifications/Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field is required; an MBA or professional certifications such as CPA, CMA, or CFA are highly preferred.
  • 3-5 years’ progressive experience in financial planning and analysis, with at least 3 years in the hospitality industry or a closely related field.
  • Proven track record of leading financial initiatives and contributing to strategic business decisions within a capital-intensive, customer-focused environment.
  • Extensive experience with financial systems and tools, including ERP platforms like Oracle or Hyperion, and advanced Excel skills for complex financial modeling and data analysis.
  • Experience in collaborating with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to drive financial performance, with the ability to present financial insights to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
  • Prior experience managing direct reports preferred.

 

Company Overview

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is the world’s largest hotel franchising company by the number of properties with approximately 9,200 hotels across over 95 countries on six continents. Through our network of approximately 872,000 rooms appealing to the everyday traveler, Wyndham commands a leading presence in the hospitality industry. Headquartered in Parsippany, N.J. with offices around the world in London, Shanghai, Buenos Aires, Dubai and more, Wyndham employs more than 2,000 corporate team members worldwide who are dedicated to the Company’s mission of making hotel travel possible for all. Supporting thousands of franchisees and a growing global portfolio of 24 hotel brands—think household names like Wyndham, La Quinta, Ramada, Days Inn and Super 8—Wyndham team members are a widespread group of individuals with diverse interests and backgrounds. Our unique Count on Me culture, commitment to flexibility and core values of Integrity, Accountability, Inclusivity, Caring and Fun are just part of what continues to make Wyndham an award-winning best place to work.

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

 

Job Location: Parsippany - 22 Sylvan Way, 22 Sylvan Way, Parsippany, New Jersey  07054
Employment Status: Full-time

 

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. based positions only, the expected pay range for this position is $115,000 - $130,000 annually.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts carefully considers a wide range of factors when determining compensation such as work location, background, experience, and performance. Compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

 

In addition to the base pay, this role is eligible to receive an incentive payment pursuant to the Annual Incentive Plan with a 15% annual target, subject to the terms of the Plan.

 

Wyndham Hotels & Resorts is committed to attracting, motivating, and retaining talented team members who align with our company’s core values. We are proud to reward our full-time team members with comprehensive benefit programs and resources which include:

  • Health insurance with HSA and FSA options
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life/AD&D insurance
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage
  • 401(k) with generous company match
  • Vacation time- Accrue 2.019 hours of paid vacation per week
  • Paid holidays- 11 Core Scheduled Paid Holidays with potential additional paid days off as business operations and the calendar permit (e.g. in 2026, there is an additional 7 days of paid company closure).
  • Paid sick leave accrued as state and local laws require
  • Additional paid time off in the form of one volunteer day, bereavement time, as well as jury duty time.  

 

Participation in any of the benefit plans and programs made available to team members is subject to satisfaction of eligibility requirements. More information can be found on Our Benefits Page.  Wyndham Hotels & Resorts reserves the right to amend or terminate any benefit plan or program at any time in accordance with applicable law.

 

We are accepting applications for this position through 06/01/2026.

job.job_description:
About Us

 

Trip.com Group provides travelers worldwide with a comprehensive suite of travel products, services, and content. Listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group aims to become the world's leading online travel brand.

 

As the Market Manager for Global Chains Business, you are joining one of the most dynamic teams at Trip.com (USA). You will be responsible for managing and expanding the partnership and the relationships with strategic partners with a global reach. 

 

To succeed in this role, you must demonstrate advanced communication skills to manage across different levels of stakeholders internally at Trip.com and within our partner organizations. You will rely on your excellent interpersonal skills and previously demonstrated stakeholder management capabilities. You have the proven ability to execute via enhanced strategic, comprehensive, result-focused account plans to achieve success.

 

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

 

  • Promote Trip.com group awareness, global platform business strategy, and one-stop service to existing/new hotel chain partners.
  • Coordinate across Trip.com group internal teams, including platform, content team, product team, service team, and marketing team to achieve the account’s expectations and maximize performance. Map prospective accounts around organizational structure, people, and existing technology.
  • Establish the relationship with key stakeholders in the assigned accounts (Global Chains), and orchestrate discussions with senior execs around their business needs.
  • Be able to lead the accounts and drive mutual performance objectives, annual targets, and milestones globally.
  • In addition to full account management, including performance tracking, production optimization, workshop conducting, and issue-solving.
  • Be able to initiate new regional projects and accelerate the progress of global projects to promote brand awareness, business strategy, and product benefits to hotel chain partners.
  • Initiate, develop, and manage mutually beneficial relationships with chains and all the other stakeholders.
  • Conduct quarterly performance review meetings with the VP, SVP, and C-level in global hotel chain teams in different geographical areas to ensure the result in a positive financial contribution.
  • Skill to analyze the global chain partner at all different levels, from Global to regional, and from the local to the hotel level.

 

Key Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of working experience in relevant roles in a Strategic or Key Account Management position (preferably working in the OTA/hospitality/travel industry).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or above.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a logical mindset.
  • Ability to demonstrate professional presentation.
  • Ability to adjust different communication methods depending on the stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of the travel industry and channel distribution.
  • Result and Data-driven with strong analytical skills.
  • Hungry for success but humble.
  • Fluent in Excel, PowerPoint, and any other related software to help with day-to-day operations.
  • Fluent in English speaking and writing.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.

What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

Introduction to the Team

The Supply team builds and scales partner-facing technology that helps our partners succeed across the Expedia Group platform. We work at the intersection of product, engineering, and business operations to deliver reliable, high-impact solutions that improve partner experiences, enable growth, and support strategic initiatives across a global ecosystem.

Our team values strong ownership, technical excellence, collaboration, and customer focus. We solve complex problems at scale, move quickly with purpose, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. Joining Supply means working on products and platforms that directly influence partner success and contribute to Expedia Group’s broader mission.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and evolve full‑stack services and customer experiences, including system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
  • Implement high‑quality frontend and backend code, ensuring maintainability, observability, and operational excellence across multiple services and domains.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to translate business and customer requirements into robust technical solutions that can be reused across use cases.
  • Own and improve the end‑to‑end lifecycle of services and features, including development, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident resolution.
  • Apply data‑driven approaches to prioritize work, validate hypotheses, and continuously optimize system performance, reliability, and user experience.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in software development.
  • 5+ years of professional experience building and operating production software services and full‑stack applications (frontend and backend) within a team environment.
  • Proven ownership of services or components, including responsibility for design, implementation, quality, deployment, and operational health within a product or domain area.
  • Proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling, with experience applying these in real systems.
  • Hands-on experience with modern web technologies, frameworks, and service architectures, and familiarity with using AI-driven tools or workflows to enhance developer productivity or product capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and evolving multi‑service or multi‑component architectures, including well‑structured APIs, data models, and integration patterns across systems.
  • Demonstrated track record driving technical improvements at scale, such as performance tuning, resilience hardening, or reliability engineering for high‑traffic services and user interfaces.
  • Strong focus on operational excellence, including instrumentation, observability, alerting, and participation in on‑call or incident response to improve long‑term service health.
  • Ability to leverage experimentation, A/B testing, or analytics to make informed technical and product decisions and to validate the impact of delivered features.
  • Experience integrating or extending AI/ML‑enabled capabilities in applications or services, including responsible use of AI-driven components in full‑stack solutions and guiding teams on effective, safe adoption of AI tooling.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $146,000.00 to $204,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $233,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Company Description

HOTEL OVERVIEW

Strategically located in the heart of Singapore’s shopping, dining and entertainment districts and with the City Hall and Esplanade Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) train stations and other major transportation nodes at its doorstep, Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford are the gateway to explore Singapore’s landscapes at your convenience. With a total of 2,030 well-appointed guestrooms, both hotels also offer a distinct collection of 12 lifestyle and dining choices including Michelin-starred fine dining restaurant JAAN by Kirk Westaway, cutting-edge meeting space at Raffles City Convention Centre with 34 meeting rooms and one of Asia’s largest spas, Willow Stream Spa.

About Our Company

At Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford, we design career plans and unveil new professional perspectives through our various development programs. We shine when YOU shine. Come and be part of our dynamic team and experience immerse growth and career opportunities with us.

Job Description

The Assistant Manager, Loyalty & Partnerships Marketing is responsible for identifying, developing and managing strategic partnerships that drive revenue for Fairmont Singapore and Swissôtel The Stamford across Rooms, Food & Beverage and Spa. The role focuses on establishing commercial partnerships with banks, lifestyle brands and third-party distribution channels, while leading Intellectual Property (IP) collaborations, campaign execution, reporting and day-to-day partnership administration.

Purposes

We strengthen guest loyalty and foster partnerships that enhance the experience at Fairmont Singapore and Swissotel The Stamford.

Responsibilities

Strategic Partnerships Development

  • Identify, pitch and secure strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, travel platforms, lifestyle brands and other compatible partners
  • Develop commercial campaigns that drive incremental revenue across:
  • Guest Rooms
  • Restaurants & Bars
  • MICE
  • Spa
  • Manage relationships with key partners including banks, card issuers, travel platforms, member programmes and affiliate partners.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, marketing exposure and partnership benefits.
  • Explore new partnership opportunities to increase brand awareness and customer acquisition.
  • Review partnership performance and recommend optimisation opportunities.

Intellectual Property (IP) Partnerships

  • Lead the end-to-end planning and execution of licensed IP collaborations (e.g. Disney, Sanrio, DreamWorks or other global entertainment or lifestyle brands).
  • Identify and support the development of new IP partnership opportunities
  • Manage cross-functional project timelines and coordinate stakeholders across Marketing, Revenue Management, Operations, Procurement, Finance, Legal and external agencies to ensure successful campaign delivery.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with IP licensors and brand representatives, facilitating approvals for creative assets, merchandise, marketing collateral and promotional campaigns in accordance with licensing requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with all licensing agreements, royalty requirements, brand guidelines and approval processes throughout the partnership lifecycle.
  • Prepare and facilitate funding proposal submissions, grant documentation and post-campaign reporting for the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) or other funding agencies, where applicable.

Loyalty Programme Management & Marketing

  • Track and monitor hotel performance against annual ALL – Accor Live Limitless and Accor Plus Explorer membership enrolment targets, providing regular performance updates and recommending initiatives to drive acquisition.
  • Support hotel recruitment efforts by working closely with operational teams to increase loyalty enrolments through training, engagement initiatives and localised recruitment tools.
  • Coordinate with hotel departments and the Accor Plus team to facilitate the timely submission of member offers, ensuring accurate loading, campaign setup and promotional visibility across Accor Plus channels.
  • Manage the end-to-end execution of Accor Plus marketing campaigns, ensuring campaign assets, booking links, promotional content and member communications are delivered accurately and on schedule.
  • Liaise with Accor regional and local teams to maximise exposure of hotel offers through Accor Plus marketing channels, including EDMs, offer pages, digital platforms and member communications.
  • Act as the key liaison between the hotel, Accor regional teams and internal departments to ensure seamless execution of loyalty programmes and marketing initiatives.

Reporting & Commercial Analysis

  • Pull and analyse reports from hotel systems and partner platforms
  • Track campaign performance, redemption rates and revenue contribution
  • Prepare weekly and monthly business reports
  • Develop Powerpoint presentations for management and partner meetings, when required

Other Responsibilities

  • Maintain partnership agreements and documentation.
  • Coordinate contract approvals and internal signoffs.
  • Manage partner invoices and purchase requisitions.
  • Track campaign timelines and deliverables.
  • Maintain partnership calendars and renewal schedules.
  • Support budget tracking and accruals where required.
  • Always comply with hotel and department policies and procedures.
  • Assist with other Sales & Marketing projects assigned by the management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in partnerships, business development, marketing, loyalty programmes, or commercial marketing, preferably within the hospitality, travel, lifestyle, or luxury sectors.
  • Experience managing strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, lifestyle brands, or third-party partners is an advantage.
  • Strong business development, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills with a commercial mindset.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, marketing campaigns, and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel (PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP), PowerPoint, and Word. Experience with Power BI, CRM systems, and loyalty platforms is an added advantage.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and organisational skills.
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, and able to work independently while building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

It's Great if you have:

Revenue Generation

Hotel Partnership & Collaboration

Performance & Reporting

Salary Range

Earnings potential for this role is up to or above $100,000 in total cash compensation. This includes both the sales incentive plan and the annual base salary for the role. Sales incentives are variable based on performance.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Frontend Software Engineer to join our Convert Team in Barcelona or Madrid (Hybrid). In this role, you will be at the heart of what the customer experiences when searching and booking their travel on our e-commerce platform. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Frontend Software Engineer in the Convert area, you will be in charge of:

  • Build future-forward applications with a modern tech stack at its core. Our foundation is built on JavaScript, TypeScript, ReactJS, a design framework based on styled-components, and GraphQL for efficient data querying. We ensure code reliability through rigorous testing using Jest and React Testing Library, among others. This entire ecosystem is managed effectively with industry-leading tools including Rspack, npm, Babel, Docker, and many more!
  • Work with a distributed, scalable micro-services environment, where software gets deployed daily, with high-quality, clean code, SOLID principles and TDD;
  • Be part of a high-performing cross-functional team of 7-10 developers, POs, UXers, QAs, data scientists, etc, all sharing the same values and focus on the customer;
  • Develop powerful and advanced algorithms that are at the forefront of innovation in travel tech;
  • Leverage your technical excellence mindset to code solutions with the highest quality through good design, attention to detail and test quality, as well as challenge decisions to help all teams improve technical excellence;
  • Actively participate in the product definition and ideation processes;
  • Work in a fully agile organisation, using Kanban practices to deliver business value continuously;
  • Continuously learn and participate in workshops, hackathons and other events as we consider it key to be active within the IT community;
  • Own and monitor the performance of product and technical OKRs


Having a technical mindset is vital for us, which is why we promote:

  • Microservices platform and modular FE;
  • Powerful monitoring techniques using Datadog, BigQuery and Graphana;
  • Version-control systems like Git & Bitbucket;
  • Storybook using Design system made with emotion and styled system;
  • Clean code;
  • SOLID principles and TDD.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.

  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!
