job.job_description:
Organization- Dream Downtown

Summary

A Design-Driven Boutique Hotel in New York’s Meatpacking District

Located among the cobblestone streets, galleries, restaurants, boutiques, and cultural landmarks of Manhattan’s Meatpacking District, Dream Downtown combines bold design with thoughtful hospitality and distinctly New York energy.

The hotel’s iconic stainless-steel façade and porthole windows honor its history as the former National Maritime Union headquarters. Inside, guests discover loft-style accommodations, distinctive event spaces, elevated dining and nightlife, attentive service, and a signature glass-bottom pool.

Just steps away, guests can explore the High Line, Whitney Museum, Chelsea Market, Little Island, and the Hudson River waterfront. With its dynamic mix of art, culture, food, fashion, and nightlife, Dream Downtown places guests at the center of one of New York City’s most vibrant neighborhoods

Summary

The Assistant Director of Sales (ADOS) is a senior-level sales leadership position reporting directly to the Director of Sales & Marketing (DOSM). This role is designed for an experienced hospitality sales professional who is ready to expand their leadership capabilities and prepare for future advancement into a Director of Sales & Marketing role within a lifestyle hotel environment.

The ADOS is a key member of the hotel's commercial leadership team, balancing active selling and direct revenue production with the day-to-day leadership, development, and administrative oversight of the Sales department. The role requires a highly visible, full-time onsite presence to coach and support the sales team, strengthen internal and external partnerships, and drive revenue through strategic account management, business development, and market expansion.

A primary responsibility of this position is to carry, personally own, and achieve a Major Market group sales quota. The ADOS is expected to develop and convert Major Market group business, manage the related sales pipeline, and deliver measurable production against assigned group revenue goals while supporting the broader hotel commercial strategy.

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, disciplined sales execution, and the ability to foster trusted relationships across the hotel and in the marketplace. The ADOS serves as a bridge between commercial strategy and operational execution, ensuring alignment across teams and delivering exceptional client and guest experiences.

Primary Responsibilities

Major Market Group Sales & Revenue Generation

  • Carry and achieve an assigned Major Market group sales quota as a core individual production responsibility.
  • Personally prospect, solicit, negotiate, close, and grow Major Market group business in support of hotel revenue and profitability goals.
  • Build and actively manage a Major Market group sales pipeline, maintaining accurate account, opportunity, and forecast information in the hotel's CRM and sales systems.
  • Develop and execute account plans for high-value group accounts, including strategic prospecting, client engagement, site inspections, presentations, entertainment, and follow-up.
  • Provide strategic guidance on rate, date, space, concessions, and contract commitments for group opportunities.
  • Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts while developing, entertaining, and maintaining relationships with existing clients.
  • Assist the Sales team in achieving individual and annual revenue goals while remaining accountable for personal Major Market group production.
  • Develop compelling sales presentations, proposals, and site inspections that showcase the hotel's unique offerings.
  • Utilize brand promotions, marketing initiatives, sales programs, and available resources to maximize business opportunities.
  • Monitor travel industry trends, market conditions, and economic factors to identify opportunities and inform sales strategies.
  • Represent the hotel through community involvement, networking events, customer entertainment, industry organizations, trade shows, and business travel.

Sales Leadership & Team Development

  • Partner closely with the DOSM to execute strategic and tactical sales initiatives that support overall hotel revenue goals.
  • Lead, coach, mentor, and inspire a high-performing sales team while fostering accountability, engagement, and professional development.
  • Maintain a strong onsite presence to provide daily leadership, support, and guidance to Sales colleagues.
  • Assist with recruiting, hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, and retention efforts for Sales team members.
  • Conduct performance discussions and support colleague development plans and performance management initiatives.
  • Organize and lead sales meetings and participate in hotel leadership meetings as required.
  • Serve as Acting Director of Sales & Marketing in the absence of the DOSM.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Partnership

  • Foster strong partnerships between the Sales team and operational departments across the hotel.
  • Collaborate closely with Revenue Management, Events, Food & Beverage, Rooms Division, Finance, Engineering, and People & Culture to ensure seamless execution of business opportunities.
  • Promote a “One Hotel, One Team” culture built on communication, accountability, and mutual support.
  • Serve as a trusted business partner to department leaders, ensuring operational readiness and exceptional service delivery for clients and guests.
  • Build and maintain strong external relationships with clients, community partners, and industry stakeholders to strengthen the hotel's market presence.
  • Foster a culture of teamwork and collaboration that enhances colleague engagement and overall hotel performance.

Administrative & Operational Leadership

  • Provide administrative oversight for the Sales department, including payroll review and approval, scheduling, attendance administration, and time-off request management.
  • Partner with People & Culture on colleague relations, performance management, coaching, corrective action, and recognition initiatives.
  • Assist with annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic sales initiatives.
  • Monitor hotel financial performance relative to budget and forecast objectives.
  • Compile, review, and analyze departmental reports, including monthly and quarterly forecasts, booking pace reports, STAR reports, quota performance, and other sales metrics.
  • Participate in ownership meetings and executive leadership discussions as required.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and operational standards.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Markets of Focus

The ideal candidate will possess experience in one or more of the following Industry Segments:

  • Technology & Digital Services
  • Financial Services & Banking
  • Real Estate & Development
  • Government, Nonprofit, Associations & Media

How We Care For Our People

Our purpose sets us apart: to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it guides how we support one another as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the foundation of our success.

We're proud to have earned a place on Fortune's prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for ten consecutive years. This recognition reflects our commitment to creating an environment rooted in inclusivity, empathy, respect, and belonging, where every colleague feels valued and empowered to grow.

As a leader within our hotel, the Assistant Director of Sales plays an important role in fostering this culture by developing talent, building meaningful relationships, promoting collaboration across departments, and helping create an environment where colleagues can thrive both personally and professionally.

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of Hyatt's Culture of Care and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Well-being.

You are a collaborative, relationship-focused leader who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment. You are energized by developing people, building partnerships, carrying a meaningful Major Market group quota, and driving results through teamwork and accountability. You understand that success comes from fostering strong relationships across departments, maintaining a visible and engaged presence, and creating a culture that supports both colleague growth and business performance.

You are someone who:

  • Leads with integrity, professionalism, and accountability.
  • Builds trust and strong partnerships with colleagues, clients, and hotel leadership.
  • Enjoys mentoring and developing high-performing teams.
  • Embraces cross-functional collaboration and a “One Hotel, One Team” mindset.
  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on leadership and active selling.
  • Demonstrates strong business acumen and a consistent, quota-driven approach to sales.
  • Thrives in an onsite leadership role, engaging daily with colleagues, guests, and operational partners.
  • Is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

If you are passionate about hospitality, enjoy cultivating meaningful relationships, and are ready to take the next step toward a future Director of Sales & Marketing opportunity, we invite you to join our team and help shape the continued success of Dream Downtown.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: $106,300–$126,000 annually, plus eligibility to participate in an applicable incentive plan.

Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, skills, and overall fit for the position.

Work Location Requirement: This is a property-based leadership position. Candidates must be able to commit to a full-time onsite role , maintaining a visible and engaged presence at the hotel to support team development, operational partnerships, client engagement, and overall business performance.

Benefits Include:

  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Parental leave
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Employee assistance program
  • Career development opportunities
  • Colleague travel and hotel discounts

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives strengthen our teams and enrich the experiences we create for our guests.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of progressive hotel sales experience with a proven track record of driving revenue growth, carrying a sales quota, and achieving or exceeding sales goals.
  • Demonstrated experience producing Major Market group business and managing a group sales pipeline from prospecting through conversion and execution.
  • Experience within an upscale, luxury, lifestyle, or boutique hotel environment preferred.
  • Prior leadership or supervisory experience with demonstrated success coaching, training, mentoring, and developing sales professionals.
  • Experience managing key sales processes, including account qualification, referral generation, prospecting, business development, negotiation, and closing.
  • Strong understanding of hotel sales strategy, revenue management, forecasting, budgeting, and financial analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, negotiation, presentation, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Outstanding relationship-building skills with the ability to foster strong internal and external partnerships and create meaningful connections with clients, colleagues, and community stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across departments, influence outcomes through cross-functional relationships, and foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Experience supporting administrative functions, including payroll administration, scheduling, time-off management, colleague development, and performance management.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as hotel sales and CRM systems.
  • High-energy, results-driven, self-motivated leader with a passion for hospitality, exceptional customer service, and colleague development.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients, colleagues, ownership groups, and executive leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment.
  • Ability to maintain a full-time onsite presence and serve as a visible, engaged leader for the Sales team. This position requires daily interaction with colleagues, operational departments, hotel leadership, and clients to support team development, strengthen partnerships, drive revenue performance, foster collaboration, and ensure operational excellence.
  • Passion for building lasting relationships, developing talent, promoting cross-department collaboration, and contributing to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and exceptional guest experiences.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the sales team and ensure that the hotel’s revenue targets are met. This role involves developing and implementing sales strategies, building relationships with key clients, and overseeing the daily operations of the sales department. As a Complex ADOS Leisure Sales, you’re not just driving revenue growth across all hotel segments – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Shape and execute sales strategy: Develop and implement revenue-driving sales strategies across group, business transient, leisure transient, and catering segments, aligned with the hotel’s commercial goals and strategic plan
  • Drive revenue performance and profitability: Contribute to achieving revenue targets and profitability goals by optimizing pricing, improving business mix, and guiding forecasting accuracy
  • Lead business reviews and planning: Facilitate regular strategy and performance meetings while contributing to long-range commercial planning through analysis of performance trends, market shifts, and revenue opportunities
  • Ensure commercial alignment: Collaborate with revenue and marketing leaders to align sales tactics with pricing, distribution, and promotional strategies, and to support forecasting and rate strategies
  • Foster stakeholder relationships: Engage with Hilton Worldwide Sales, Convention and Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party travel partners, and key clients to drive demand, improve conversion, and support high-impact site visits and pre-convention meetings
  • Develop data-informed strategies: Track market and competitor activity to inform strategy and help maintain competitive positioning in group and transient segments
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Recruit new talent while driving team growth and engagement through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Degree qualifications in Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 5 years of experience in managing a hospitality proactive sales role preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a revenue-generating or commercial role within hospitality or travel.
  • Proven experience managing and developing high-performing sales or commercial teams.
  • Skilled in creating and presenting sales strategies to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Proficient in analyzing departmental financial data to inform strategic decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and capitalize on new business opportunities.
  • Experience working in matrixed environments across departments.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel operations.
  • Technical Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey systems) is a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Reporting directly to the General Manager, the Director of Operations is a key member of the Hotel Executive Committee and the senior operational leader of the hotel. The role provides strategic and hands-on leadership across Rooms, Food & Beverage, Culinary, Engineering, Security and other operational functions, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence and strong business performance.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with the General Manager in leading the overall hotel operation and execution of the hotel's business strategy.
  • Provide strategic and operational leadership across Rooms, F&B, Culinary, Engineering, Security and other hotel functions.
  • Drive guest satisfaction, service excellence and effective service recovery across the hotel.
  • Oversee Rooms and F&B performance, ensuring strong operational standards, productivity and profitability.
  • Drive revenue, cost management and resource optimisation in partnership with Finance and other key departments.
  • Lead, coach and develop the operational leadership team, fostering a high-performing and collaborative culture.
  • Ensure compliance with IHG brand standards, food safety, health and safety, security and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional projects and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance guest experience, productivity and profitability.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 10 years of progressive hotel operations experience, preferably within an international full-service hotel.
  • Previous experience as a Director of Operations, Hotel Manager, Executive Assistant Manager or equivalent senior operational leadership role.
  • Strong operational experience across Rooms and Food & Beverage, with a sound understanding of Culinary/Kitchen operations.
  • Proven track record managing large-scale hotel operations and multiple operational departments.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, labour management and departmental P&L.
  • Demonstrated success in driving guest satisfaction, operational standards and business results.
  • Strong leadership, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with an international hotel brand and familiarity with brand standards would be advantageous.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of the Hotel Executive Committee and play a key role in the hotel's overall business performance.
  • Lead a diverse range of hotel operations and make a direct impact on guest experience and profitability.
  • Develop and lead high-performing operational teams.
  • Work closely with the General Manager as the hotel's key operational counterpart and deputy.

What You Can Expect From Us

Join our extraordinary world and experience a place where you can be yourself, share your ideas, support your personal growth and wellbeing, and be a valued member of an inspirational team.

You will be rewarded with a suite of benefits that supports you and your family's wellbeing, including:

  • 5-days work week
  • Duty Meal
  • Uniforms/ Laundry Services
  • Birthday Off
  • Learning and Development Opportunities
  • Flexi Benefit
  • Insurance Coverage
  • 50% F&B discount at Hotel’s selected Restaurant
  • Special Employee rate at all IHG Hotels worldwide

We are proud to be IHG and we know you will be too. Visit http://careers.ihg.com/ to find out more about us.

Who We Are

At IHG, we’ve made a promise. As one of the world’s leading hotel groups, we’re here to deliver True Hospitality for Good. Making our guests and colleagues feel welcome, cared for, recognised and respected – wherever they are in the world. Want to be part of the journey?

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours!

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Growth Data Products (GDP) drives GetYourGuide's growth engine by transforming raw marketing data into reliable, self-service insights and automated decision systems. Our work spans every growth channel—Paid and Organic Search, Display Advertising, CRM and Lifecycle Marketing, Brand Marketing, Marketing Attribution, Experimentation, and Customer Lifetime Value measurement. We empower teams across the organization to make faster, smarter decisions at scale, turning data into actionable intelligence that fuels our mission to connect millions with unforgettable travel experiences.

Your mission

  • Define, develop, and fully own data products that drive measurable revenue impact across all GDP domains.
  • Translate growth strategies into technical roadmaps, aligning multiple squads and stakeholders around clear, measurable business outcomes.
  • Design, deploy, and monitor production machine learning pipelines in Python and Databricks to support bidding, targeting, and personalization use cases.
  • Raise the technical standard by introducing best practices, code quality standards, and robust observability within the data science and engineering teams.
  • Champion a culture of experimentation through A/B test design, causal-inference analysis, and frameworks for rapid iteration.
  • Advance customer lifetime value and attribution models that guide multi-million euro marketing investments.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure data products deliver tangible business value and strategic impact.

Your toolkit

  • Proven track record as a Staff or Principal Data Scientist (or equivalent) delivering cross-functional products that deliver significant business value.
  • Market and growth experience is essential, with strong domain knowledge in marketing analytics, customer acquisition, or revenue optimization.
  • Mastery of Python, SQL, and modern big-data tools such as Spark and Databricks, with comfort in shipping production-grade machine learning services.
  • Deep expertise in statistical testing, causal inference, and online experimentation frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience in marketing growth areas like paid search, CRM, or attribution modeling.
  • Advanced degree in a quantitative field (such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or Physics) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong communication skills that enable you to influence both technical and non-technical audiences across the organization.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience with cloud orchestration and CI/CD technologies such as AWS, Airflow, or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, MLflow, or large-scale feature-store architectures.
  • A record of mentoring senior individual contributors and fostering a culture of psychological safety across teams.
  • Publications or conference presentations on topics like large language models, agentic AI systems, or marketing technology innovation.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in-office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at-home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

The role

You’ll be the video specialist in a small creative studio with a big remit, helping shape how Sabre shows up through video across the business.

You’ll spend most of your time editing, working across everything from campaigns, social and events to product demos, customer content and internal communications. You’ll also bring motion graphics into the mix, advise teams on how to make their ideas work on screen, and help coordinate video projects from brief through to delivery.

The role reports in to our Head of Creative, working alongside designers, motion specialists and teams across the business. You'll ideally be based in London to attend on-location shoots in our Richmond office, but we’re open to candidates based elsewhere in the UK who can travel when needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit and deliver video content across campaigns, social, events, product demos, customer content and internal communications
  • Shape footage into engaging stories through strong editing, pacing, sound and visual treatment, adapting your approach from polished brand content to fast-moving, social-first edits
  • Create motion graphics that bring video content to life and reinforce the Sabre brand
  • Advise marketing teams and stakeholders on video concepts, formats, production approaches and what will work best for the audience and channel
  • Coordinate video projects from brief through to delivery, working with internal teams, freelancers, production partners and other suppliers where needed
  • Work closely with external creative agencies on video production, helping shape the creative approach and ensuring the final output meets the brief and the Sabre standard
  • Attend and support shoots when required, helping shape the creative approach and making sure the footage captured gives the edit what it needs

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong video editing skills and a portfolio that shows excellent storytelling, pacing and visual judgement
  • Excellent working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, with good working knowledge of After Effects and motion graphics
  • Experience taking video projects from brief through to final delivery, managing your own projects and keeping things moving
  • The ability to understand what a project needs creatively and translate that into a practical production approach
  • Good communication and project management skills, with the confidence to work with stakeholders who aren't video specialists
  • A collaborative, curious approach and a good understanding of what makes video work across different audiences, platforms and formats

Extra Skills

We're primarily looking for a strong video editor. If you also bring skills in areas such as filming, camera operation, advanced motion design, photography, 3D or AI video tools, we'd love to hear about them. Experience directing shoots or working with external production companies would also be valuable. Specialist skills that add breadth to the role may be reflected in the salary offered.

Benefits

Benefits that support you We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive pay and performance-based bonuses
  • Flexible work options
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage
  • Generous PTO and holidays
  • Strong retirement planning support
  • Family-friendly benefits
  • Professional development opportunities

job.job_description:
About the Company

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is an award-winning global provider of innovative and cost-effective travel solutions spanning corporate, events, leisure, loyalty and wholesale travel. The company’s proven business strategy is underpinned by personalized service excellence supported by market leading technology solutions which deliver a return on investment to our customers. Headquartered in Australia with its Asia head office in Hong Kong, the company provides local service solutions to customers of all sizes across the world including Hong Kong, Singapore, China, Taiwan and Japan in Asia. CTM is an award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions to the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. Its proven business strategy combines personalized service excellence with client-facing technology solutions to deliver a return on investment to clients.


About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic, commercially driven and strategic sales leader to drive CTM's corporate sales growth across Asia. The Head of Corporate Sales, Asia will lead regional business development, build and convert a strong sales pipeline, develop strategic corporate client relationships and strengthen CTM's position as a leading Travel Management Company (TMC) in Asia.


This is a hands-on regional leadership role. The successful candidate will personally drive new business and strategic opportunities while providing the leadership, direction and market insight needed to build a high-performing sales organisation and deliver sustainable growth across Asia.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Leadership & Business Growth:

  • Develop and execute the Asia corporate sales strategy to deliver revenue and growth targets.
  • Drive proactive prospecting, new business acquisition and a strong regional sales pipeline.
  • Personally lead strategic sales opportunities, tenders and RFPs, particularly with multinational and regional clients.
  • Identify market, customer and competitive opportunities to accelerate growth.


Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead, coach and motivate the sales team to achieve and exceed targets.
  • Set clear objectives and KPIs, drive accountability and build a high-performance sales culture.
  • Develop team capabilities in business development, consultative selling and strategic account management.
  • Identify and develop talent to support continued business growth.


Client & Business Development:

  • Build strong relationships with key corporate, multinational and regional clients and senior decision-makers.
  • Lead major client presentations, negotiations and strategic sales engagements.
  • Develop compelling TMC solutions and value propositions that differentiate CTM in the market.
  • Identify opportunities to win and consolidate regional and global corporate travel programmes.


Regional & Global Collaboration:

  • Partner with regional and global leadership to leverage CTM's network and capabilities and drive cross-market opportunities.
  • Work closely with local markets and cross-functional teams to deliver effective client solutions.
  • Share best practices and contribute to regional and global commercial initiatives.


Commercial Performance & Market Leadership:

  • Monitor pipeline, revenue, conversion and sales performance, providing accurate forecasts and market insights to senior leadership.
  • Manage sales resources effectively and identify opportunities to improve productivity and profitability.
  • Stay ahead of market trends and customer needs to strengthen CTM's competitive position and brand across Asia.
  • Represent CTM at key industry and client events to build market presence and generate new opportunities.
  • Support strategic projects and other initiatives that contribute to regional business growth.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Support senior leadership on strategic projects and initiatives that contribute to regional or global business objectives.
  • Undertake other responsibilities as required to support the continued growth of the Asia corporate sales business.


Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in corporate sales, business development, corporate travel, TMC or a related B2B commercial environment.
  • At least 3–5 years of experience in a senior sales or business development leadership role, with a proven track record of leading teams and delivering revenue growth.
  • Strong TMC/corporate travel experience, with good understanding of corporate buyers, travel solutions, technology and industry landscape.
  • Proven track record in new business acquisition, revenue growth, pipeline development and strategic account management.
  • Experience managing complex sales cycles, tenders/RFPs and multinational or regional corporate accounts.
  • Asia/ASEAN experience strongly preferred, ideally in a multinational or regional environment.
  • Ability to combine hands-on business development with strategic sales leadership, personally driving key opportunities while developing the team.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching and team development skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in sales targets, forecasting, budgets and performance management.
  • Strategic and market-oriented thinker with the ability to turn customer and market insights into practical growth strategies and results.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging senior decision-makers.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Willingness to travel across Asia.

Description

The Senior Manager of Quality Engineering within Information Technology will provide strategic leadership for the quality engineering organization, driving the vision, execution, and continuous evolution of enterprise quality practices across a portfolio of products, platforms, and technology initiatives. The position will lead multiple Quality Engineering teams and managers, ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable technology solutions that support business objectives and customer experience goals.

This role is accountable for defining and governing enterprise quality engineering strategies, standards, frameworks, and operating models that enable modern software delivery. The position will partner closely with senior technology and business leaders to integrate quality throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), leveraging automation, AI-enabled quality engineering, observability, and data-driven insights to improve software reliability, accelerate delivery, and reduce operational risk.

As a senior leader, this role will drive organizational quality transformation by advancing intelligent automation, continuous testing, predictive quality analytics, and engineering excellence practices across the enterprise. The position will oversee quality execution across large-scale programs and product portfolios while ensuring alignment with architectural standards, security requirements, regulatory obligations, and enterprise governance policies.

The role will continuously evaluate emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and industry best practices, establishing a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. This position is responsible for developing organizational capabilities, optimizing engineering productivity, and championing quality as a strategic business enabler across the enterprise.

  • Organizational Effectiveness / People:
  • Lead multiple Quality Engineering teams and managers, providing strategic direction, talent development, workforce planning, and organizational leadership across a portfolio of products and platforms.
  • Assess and align QA resource capacity, skillsets, and organizational structure to meet evolving testing demands, delivery priorities, and competency requirements.
  • Application Delivery/Support:
  • Define and execute enterprise quality engineering strategies, aligning quality objectives with business goals, product roadmaps, customer experience, and engineering transformation initiatives, ensuring a delightful experience for our customers.
  • Oversee end-to-end quality assurance lifecycle execution, including test planning, execution, validation, and user acceptance support across multiple teams.
  • Guide estimation, planning, and prioritization of testing efforts for new features, products, and platform capabilities.
  • Oversee execution of test plans across teams, ensuring timely delivery, adequate test coverage, and proactive mitigation of risks to project timelines and deliverables.
  • AI-Driven Innovation:
  • Drive AI-powered quality transformation, implementing Generative AI, Agentic AI, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation to improve software quality, delivery speed, and engineering productivity at scale.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Establish and govern enterprise-wide quality practices, standards, frameworks, and metrics that ensure consistent quality outcomes across Agile, DevOps, in on-premises and cloud-native environments.
  • Collaborate with development, product, and business stakeholders to support user acceptance testing, align validation criteria, and ensure business readiness for releases.
  • Technical Execution and Guidance:
  • Lead large-scale automation, continuous testing, and quality observability initiatives, integrating quality intelligence into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes, driving high standards for engineering excellence.
  • Establish and govern defect management practices, including defect tracking, prioritization, and resolution processes, ensuring timely remediation and high-quality outcomes.
  • High-Performance and Data-Driven:
  • Monitor and optimize organizational performance through data-driven insights, leveraging quality metrics, AI effectiveness measures, operational KPIs, and customer outcomes to continuously improve software reliability and engineering efficiency.
  • Identify and address systemic quality risks through proactive monitoring of testing progress, defect trends, and quality indicators, ensuring minimal impact to delivery timelines and product quality.
  • Strategic Leadership and Guidance:
  • Partner with senior technology and business leaders to influence investment decisions, manage quality risks, prioritize transformation initiatives, and drive measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

Minimum Experience:

  • 5+ years of management experience in Quality Engineering or IT leadership related role
  • 3+ years of experience implementing Test Automation framework
  • 3+ years of experience in supporting release automation (CICD) and application performance testing

5 Key Skills

  • Software Testing Strategy
  • Test Automation
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment
  • DevOps
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Management

Prevalent Skills: 

  • Test Case Design 
  • Software Test Case Management 
  • Test Environment Management 
  • Software Testing Strategy 
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment 
  • Test Automation 
  • Regulatory Compliance 
  • Agile Testing 
  • Programming/Scripting 
  • DevOps 
  • Continuous Improvement 
  • Project/Program Management 
  • Technical Reporting 
  • Test Auditing 
  • Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Management 

Emerging Skills

  • Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning 
  • Policy Design & Development 
  • Security Testing Strategy 
  • Cyber Risk Management 
  • Cloud Testing Strategy 

The base pay range for this role is $140,600.00 to $183,108.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

job.job_description:
About Us


Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Key Responsibilities


We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Key Account Manager to join our team and manage key customer accounts for our growing local chain. This is a critical role that will involve building and nurturing strong relationships with high-value customers, ensuring their satisfaction, and driving business growth within the region.


• Account Management: Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts, building and maintaining strong, long-lasting relationships with local businesses and partners.

• Customer Relationship Management: Develop an in-depth understanding of local chain needs, concerns, and goals to provide personalized solutions and exceptional customer service.

• Sales & Business Development: Identify new business opportunities within key accounts and work to expand product offerings or services. Proactively seek ways to drive revenue growth and improve account performance.

• Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (DC team, marketing, operations) to ensure smooth communication and execution of customer needs.

• Contract Negotiation & Pricing: Handle negotiations for renewals, upselling, and contract amendments while ensuring profitability and long-term partnerships for both Trip.com and partners.

• Problem-Solving: Address and resolve customer issues in a timely and efficient manner to maintain customer satisfaction and retention.

• Reporting & Analysis: Regularly report on account performance, sales trends, customer feedback, and competitor activity. Use data to propose solutions and strategies for improvement.

• Market Insights: Keep abreast of market trends, competitive landscape, and customer preferences to recommend changes and enhancements in product offerings.

• Customer Training & Support: Provide guidance to customers on product usage, new services, and best practices to enhance their experience with the brand.

• Have end-to-end ownership of new hotel acquisitions and existing hotel account management within your designated market. Actively identify high-potential prospect partners & grow the revenue of the existing portfolio in this region.

• Educate accommodation providers on the many unique features that the trip.com platform offers. Quickly and effectively identify the correct platform product for each of your accounts to maximize their revenue.

• Take a customer-centric approach to everything you do. Ensure hotels content, rates, availability, and products offer the best value to Trip.com customers

• Keep your properties up to date on the campaigns offered by the trip.com platform and ensure strong coverage of deals across your account portfolio

• Responsible for the assigned market, and conducting the data research and analysis (market, product, competitor, price, supplier, etc.)

• Provide market insights to the global headquarters to optimize the product design and sales directions for the success of global product localization.

• Other assigned tasks based on business need


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.

What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Click the link to learn more about What makes Trip.com Group a leading global travel service provider?



Click the link to learn more about This is a Trip Where Both Your Career and Life Can Flourish!



Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com



Have a good trip, and see you soon!

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s and other Booking Holdings brands’ non-accommodation partners and promote our top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s and Booking Holdings’ unique travel product portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek.  Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda and the other group companies, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant profits to the overall business. 

Location: This role requires you to be based in Bangkok, Thailand (with relocation support provide)

The Opportunity:

To utilize your technical expertise to support and drive Agoda’s B2B partnership growth by optimizing connectivity with the company’s largest B2B accommodation partners. Work with diverse internal teams and world-leading travel providers in Agoda’s B2B team, delivering innovative, scalable travel solutions at speed.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Drive the profitable growth of Agoda’s Strategic Partnerships/Travel Distribution business.
  • Manage end-to-end technical account management for Agoda’s largest B2B accounts.
  • Take full ownership of connection performance, including new builds, rebuilds, upgrades, day-to-day success rates, and ensuring optimal access to inventory, rates, rate plans, content, and availability.
  • Extract and analyze complex data sets to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (especially with Product Managers) to identify business needs and influence the design and prioritization of next-generation features.
  • Automate business processes to support operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues impacting client connectivity, ensuring seamless operations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to B2B clients, translating business needs into technical requirements.

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, engineering, or computer science field.
  • 4-6+ years of hands-on experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, or similar roles in technology or travel industries.
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to leverage data and insights to drive business strategy and decisions.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities across concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a self-starter mentality - able to identify opportunities, relentlessly drive growth, and push projects over the finish line.
  • Practical experience with API integrations/data transfers, with strong proficiency in SQL and Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

It's Great if you have:

  • In-depth understanding of technical integrations and system architecture.
  • Experience in travel technology, hospitality tech, or related industries.
  • Strong command of Python, XML, or data modeling concepts.

job.company_description:
Delta Air Lines (NYSE: DAL) is the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability and customer experience. Powered by our employees around the world, Delta has for a decade led the airline industry in operational excellence while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta Air Lines, connection is at the heart of everything we do and guides our every action. We strive to welcome and care for all our customers during their travels with us and aim to deliver an elevated experience.

We are seeking Customer Experience Specialists to join our high-energy call center-based team in Singapore. In this role, you will create memorable experiences for Delta customers by answering their calls in an efficient, courteous and accurate manner or by working on customer reservations and administration of customer travel needs through calculating the cost of the reservation, issuing of tickets and booking alternate flight schedules while meeting all Delta and U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) compliance requirements.

There are 100,000+ reasons to join Delta—every one of our employees has their own. Some of us want to explore new places. Some are here to explore our own career potential. Some are curious about other cultures, while others want to make a difference where they are. There’s a whole world out there—and another one right here within Delta. Which means that whatever keeps you climbing, you’ll discover it with us. We are looking for motivated individuals to join our growing team!

Summary Of Responsibilities (not Comprehensive Of All Tasks)

Customer Experience Specialists connect with customers via phone and create an experience where customers know they have been heard and understood and feel valued and important.

In this position, you will have to: 

  • Work 5 days within Monday to Sunday
  • Answer calls in an efficient, courteous, and accurate manner 
  • Assess customer needs 
  • Offer solutions and additional products 
  • Interact with a globally diverse group of customers and colleagues 
  • Build customer relationships and ensure timely response and resolution of issues
  • Perform all jobs related to effective customer service to our passengers regarding their flight arrangements with our airline.
  • Sell travel related services and promote credit card vendor partner products 
  • Optimize booking opportunities and promoting member retention and loyalty
  • Have a professional attitude with excellent dependability, flexibility in a fast-paced environment, and the ability to handle stressful situations 
  • Able to learn and react quickly 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Embraces diverse people, thinking and styles
  • Consistently makes safety and security, of self and others, the priority
  • Must be a Singapore citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident
  • We are looking for individuals that have an excellent command of spoken and written business level of English
  • Computer skills and comfort with navigating software applications, email, instant messaging, and internet searches
  • Excellent telephone etiquette, good written and verbal communication skills
  • You will be accountable for meeting individual Key Performance Indicator (KPIs) and team goals.
  • Must have a flexible schedule as this position will require you to work weekends, holidays

Employees will have future opportunities to progress to specialty teams that respond to customer escalations or resolve complex international ticketing issues. As Delta continues to offer new ways for our customers to connect with us, Specialists may also have opportunities to assist customers via Twitter, Facebook, or other emerging social media platforms. 

Compensation and Training: 

The starting pay for this position effective October 1, 2025 is SGD 3,154 per month. Oct 1, 2026 onwards the starting pay is SGD 3,209 per month. The position is also eligible for performance-based incentives after six months' probation period, shift allowances, monthly rewards if the company meets Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and annual pay increases. 

Successful candidates will participate in a comprehensive classroom and on-the-job training. Classroom training includes instruction, observation, exams and performance measures. 

After training, we will assign new employees to a shift that may be significantly different than your training shift and will include two consecutive days off, likely midweek. New employees will remain on that shift until the employee is eligible to bid on a shift they select. New hires are eligible to bid on a new shift during the first shift bid following completion of new hire training. Swaps will be available after shift bid are finalized to allow flexibility for employees to manager their work schedules.

Employees bid on preferred shifts every 3-4 months.  New hires are often awarded AM shifts with midweek days off until they are able to hold different shifts based on seniority.  Delta is a 24/7 operation, and we will always have customers that need us. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Preferred Diploma holders and above and/or have relevant work experience in a contact centre environment

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Opportunities to earn additional monthly performance incentive after completing the six-month probation period
  • Industry-leading profit sharing
  • A diverse & inclusive culture of People Engagement and an Environment of Open Door Policy
  • Comprehensive health & wellness benefits including medical, dental, and life benefits
  • Paid training includes instruction, observation, exams and performance measures
  • Unlimited flight benefits on Delta & Discounted Fares on Other participating Airlines under the Zonal Employee Discount Program
  • Career development programs are available for your long-term career goals
  • Exclusive access to 12 free mental health counseling sessions per year for employees and their household members

If you believe you are the one we are seeking, apply here and attach your resume giving full details of qualifications, experience as well as current and expected salary.

Job Description

What will I be doing?

As a Wedding Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving wedding sales by identifying new business opportunities, managing client relationships, coordinating with internal departments, and delivering exceptional service to ensure memorable wedding experiences while achieving departmental revenue goals.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Develop and implement sales strategies to maximize wedding revenue and achieve departmental targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities and generate sales leads through networking, referrals, and business partnerships.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing wedding clients.
  • Conduct venue tours and wedding consultations, presenting the hotel's facilities, wedding packages, and services.
  • Prepare proposals, quotations, contracts, and other sales documentation accurately and promptly.
  • Negotiate wedding packages and contractual terms while maximizing hotel profitability.
  • Coordinate closely with the Events, Banquet, Culinary, Front Office, and other operational departments to ensure smooth event execution.
  • Maintain accurate records of client interactions, sales activities, and business opportunities using the hotel's sales systems.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify new business opportunities.
  • Participate in wedding fairs, promotional events, and marketing activities to enhance brand awareness.
  • Provide timely sales reports, forecasts, and business updates to the Director of Sales and senior management.
  • Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the sales journey to encourage repeat business and referrals.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build lasting client relationships.
  • Proven sales and business development skills with a customer-focused approach.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of computer literacy, including Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and CRM or sales management systems.
  • Ability to work under pressure and consistently achieve sales targets.
  • Fluency in Japanese is required

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • Previous experience in Wedding Sales, Event Sales, or Hospitality Sales.
  • Experience working in a luxury hotel or wedding venue.
  • Knowledge of the Japanese wedding market and current industry trends.
  • Established relationships with wedding agencies, planners, or related business partners.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

job.job_description:
Reporting to the Portfolio General Manager, this is a significant senior leadership appointment at InterContinental Sydney, with the opportunity to shape the commercial future of one of Australia’s most iconic luxury hotels while providing strategic commercial influence across our broader luxury hotel portfolio.

Portfolio Director of Commercial

With primary commercial accountability for InterContinental Sydney, you will lead the development and execution of an integrated, total-hotel commercial strategy encompassing Sales, Marketing, Revenue Strategy, Reservations, Distribution and market positioning. Your mandate is to optimise revenue, profitability, market share and long-term brand value, while further strengthening InterContinental Sydney’s position within Sydney’s highly competitive luxury hotel market.

A critical requirement of the role is the ability to understand and optimise the hotel’s business mix across all key market segments. You will understand not only how individual segments perform, but how they interact, where displacement occurs and how the optimal mix should evolve in response to demand, compression, profitability and strategic priorities.

You will bring strong revenue management capability and commercial acumen, confidently interpreting demand, pace, forecast, pricing, market share, channel contribution and competitive performance. In partnership with Revenue Management, you will challenge and influence pricing, inventory deployment, segmentation and distribution strategies to maximise both RevPAR and total hotel profitability.

Marketing leadership will be equally critical. You will shape an integrated luxury marketing strategy that builds brand desirability, strengthens the positioning of the hotel and its venues and ensures marketing investment delivers measurable commercial outcomes. You will bring together brand, digital, content, partnerships, PR and performance marketing to build demand and strengthen InterContinental Sydney’s position in the luxury market.

The role requires a holistic approach to total hotel revenue, identifying opportunities across Rooms, MICE, Food & Beverage and bespoke signature experiences. You will connect commercial performance with the hotel's broader luxury positioning, ensuring revenue generation and brand development work together.

As part of your broader portfolio role, you will provide high-level strategic commercial support and guidance to the Directors of Sales & Marketing at InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef and InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort, sharing commercial insight, expertise and best practice to strengthen strategy and capability across the portfolio.

This is a highly strategic yet hands-on leadership role, where you will build and inspire a high-performance commercial culture defined by accountability, collaboration, innovation and exceptional results. You will bring our “Inspire Incredible” ambition to life, challenging your team to think differently, elevate performance and set new benchmarks for commercial excellence in luxury hospitality.

What You Will Bring

  • Significant senior commercial leadership experience within the luxury hotel sector, ideally gained within a complex, high-volume, multi-revenue-stream hotel or resort environment with proven success in delivering revenue growth, market share, profitability and brand positioning.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute an integrated commercial strategy, while challenging established thinking and identifying new revenue opportunities.
  • Deep understanding of Australian market, hotel segmentation and business-mix optimisation, international luxury feeder markets and global demand channels.
  • Exceptional revenue management and financial acumen with the ability to translate complex performance data into clear commercial actions.
  • Significant marketing strategy experience with the ability to evaluate marketing investment against measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively with hotel owners and senior corporate stakeholders, presenting commercial performance, strategy, investment recommendations, risks and opportunities with credibility and influence.
  • Proven ability to build, lead and develop high-performing commercial teams, establish clear accountability and develop future commercial leaders.

What We Offer

  • A career-defining opportunity to shape the commercial future of one of Australia’s most iconic luxury hotels.
  • Genuine influence across a portfolio of three distinctive luxury properties.
  • The opportunity to lead, shape and develop a talented, high-performing commercial team.
  • Exposure to a complex, high-profile hotel business, ownership group and senior corporate stakeholders.
  • Competitive senior leadership salary package, performance bonus and extensive IHG benefits and perks.
  • Access to IHG’s global network of more than 7,000 hotels, with significant opportunities for continued career growth and development.

This is an opportunity to do more than lead a commercial function. It is an opportunity to shape the strategy, build the brand, drive the growth and make your mark on one of Australia’s most iconic luxury hotels.

If you are ready to define what comes next for InterContinental Sydney, we would love to hear from you.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

About The Journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in over 50 countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

  • Accounting
  • Banquets
  • Culinary
  • Event Operations
  • Event Planning
  • Facilities Management/Engineering
  • Food & Beverage Operations
  • Front Office/Front Desk
  • Information Technology
  • Rooms Operations
  • Sales

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Each individual’s Voyage journey is unique, spanning 12 months dependent upon your career interests, passions, goals, and location. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The Experience You’ll Gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

  • Cultivate customer relationships
  • Be a champion for innovation within the organization
  • Get exposure to managing projects & people
  • Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
  • Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership. These are material job duties of this position. Your background may have a direct, adverse, and negative bearing on the duties and responsibilities of this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment.

Ready to embark?

Qualifications

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated from a university or hotel school within the past 24 months. Other qualifications include:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent higher level education required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary)
  • Superior critical-thinking & interpersonal communication skills
  • The ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively
  • The ability to self-manage & be a self-starter
  • A real desire for personal & professional growth
  • Work authorization in the country you apply

Those currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date between December 2026-August 2027 may also be considered.

Visit MarriottU.com

We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s and Booking Holdings’ unique travel product portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek.  Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda and the other group companies, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant profits to the overall business. 

Location: This role requires you to be based in Bangkok, Thailand (with relocation support provide)

The Opportunity:

To utilize your technical expertise to support and drive Agoda’s B2B partnership growth by optimizing connectivity with the company’s largest B2B accommodation partners. Work with diverse internal teams and world-leading travel providers in Agoda’s B2B team, delivering innovative, scalable travel solutions at speed.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Drive the profitable growth of Agoda’s Strategic Partnerships/Travel Distribution business.
  • Manage end-to-end technical account management for Agoda’s largest B2B accounts.
  • Take full ownership of connection performance, including new builds, rebuilds, upgrades, day-to-day success rates, and ensuring optimal access to inventory, rates, rate plans, content, and availability.
  • Extract and analyze complex data sets to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (especially with Product Managers) to identify business needs and influence the design and prioritization of next-generation features.
  • Automate business processes to support operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues impacting client connectivity, ensuring seamless operations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to B2B clients, translating business needs into technical requirements.

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, engineering, or computer science field.
  • 4-6+ years of hands-on experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, or similar roles in technology or travel industries.
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to leverage data and insights to drive business strategy and decisions.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities across concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a self-starter mentality - able to identify opportunities, relentlessly drive growth, and push projects over the finish line.
  • Practical experience with API integrations/data transfers, with strong proficiency in SQL and Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

It's Great if you have:

  • In-depth understanding of technical integrations and system architecture.
  • Experience in travel technology, hospitality tech, or related industries.
  • Strong command of Python, XML, or data modeling concepts.
