job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

At Delta, we connect people and cultures, power extraordinary experiences, and shape the future of travel. Here, you'll work on complex challenges on a global scale, using augmented intelligence to build emerging technologies, amplify human potential and continuously grow the skills that keep you at the forefront of what's next.

Our Digital Site domain is seeking a Senior Technical Product Engineer who combines the technical depth of an engineer, the customer obsession of a product manager, and the analytical mindset of a growth leader. This role is responsible for driving digital customer experience improvements, product innovation, experimentation, platform modernization, and measurable business outcomes across web, mobile, APIs, and enterprise platforms. The ideal candidate is highly technical, deeply data-driven, and passionate about solving customer problems at scale. They can translate business strategy into product requirements, partner with engineering teams to deliver solutions, and use analytics to continuously improve customer outcomes and business performance. This role is inspired by modern product leadership principles emphasizing growth, customer-centricity, AI-powered product development, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Execution
    • Own end-to-end delivery of digital product capabilities from ideation through production release.
    • Define product vision, roadmaps, business cases, success metrics, and prioritization frameworks.
    • Translate customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints into actionable product requirements.
    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on conversion, engagement, task accomplishment, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Technical Product Leadership
    • Partner with engineering, architecture, UX, analytics, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions.
    • Lead requirements definition for APIs, microservices, system integrations, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise applications.
    • Evaluate technical trade-offs and guide solution design decisions with engineering teams.
    • Support modernization initiatives involving cloud platforms, AI/ML capabilities, customer data platforms, personalization engines, and digital experience platforms.
  • Data, Analytics & Experimentation
    • Define KPIs, success metrics, instrumentation requirements, and experimentation plans.
    • Use customer behavior analytics, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and operational metrics to drive decision-making.
    • Identify growth opportunities through customer journey analysis and experimentation.
    • Build executive-level insights and recommendations backed by quantitative and qualitative data.
  • Customer Experience & Growth
    • Champion customer-centric product design and usability improvements.
    • Drive initiatives that improve conversion, retention, self-service adoption, and digital engagement.
    • Partner with UX teams to identify and eliminate customer friction points.
    • Leverage customer feedback, analytics, and market research to prioritize high-impact opportunities.
  • AI & Emerging Technology Adoption
    • Evaluate and implement AI-driven product opportunities.
    • Partner with engineering teams to identify automation and operational efficiency improvements.
    • Apply modern product development practices using AI-assisted tools, rapid prototyping, and experimentation techniques.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Influence stakeholders across business, technology, operations, and executive leadership.
    • Facilitate roadmap discussions, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and release readiness.
    • Communicate product strategy, progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
    • Mentor junior product and engineering team members.
What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related experience.
  • Experience working with APIs, cloud technologies, distributed systems, and enterprise-scale digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated success improving measurable customer and business outcomes through data-driven product decisions.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and executive communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, Scrum, and modern engineering practices.
  • 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Growth mindset and experimentation-first approach.
  • Passion for AI, modern product management, and continuous learning.
  • Ability to connect strategy, technology, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Exceptional product thinking and customer empathy.
  • Experienced in iterative and incremental product delivery
  • Experience with agile processes including scrum and comfortable running scrum ceremonies
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in eCommerce, travel, fintech, marketplace, loyalty, digital commerce, or consumer-facing digital products.
  • Experience with AI-enabled products, personalization platforms, experimentation frameworks, or customer data platforms.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with customer journey mapping, product growth frameworks, and conversion optimization.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
  • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave

At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.

Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Your mission

The Brand Strategy Lead owns the quality, consistency and distinctiveness of GetYourGuide's brand, partnering closely with Analytics, Customer Insights, Product, and Supply to keep the brand coherent globally and relevant locally.

Please note this role is a individual contributor and will not be leading a team but leading and owning the brand frameworks and positioning.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the brand framework - narrative, positioning and USPs. Define what GetYourGuide stands for, what associations it is and is not building, and how the organisation reads progress against them.
  • Know the market and the customer, globally and locally. Track competitive dynamics, category shifts, and how the Modern Explorer is changing, and turn genuine local differences into shared knowledge instead of market-specific narratives.
  • Turn strategy into something the org can act on. Build the chain from barrier → narrative angle → proof points → recommended levers, and keep the messaging hierarchy and narrative repository current as the source of truth for what's in, out, and true.
  • Make the brand a resource, not a gatekeeper. Package strategy so Product, Supply, Analytics, Customer Insights, and other teams can act on it directly, and bring narrative and CVP input into their roadmaps early enough to shape decisions.
  • Contribute to, and where relevant own, brand programs that build proof points. Identify and help shape the research, partnerships, or flagship initiatives that generate real evidence for the narrative, working with Activation and other teams to bring them to life.
  • Define how the org knows the brand is working. Own the brand health and equity measurement framework — the scorecard that shows whether the narrative is landing, not just whether it shipped.

You’ll be successful if you have

  • Judgment and taste, the confidence to make narrative calls without a rulebook, and the discipline not to over-document strategy instead of deciding.
  • Sharp analytical instincts, comfortable working with data and research directly, and skilled at turning market and customer understanding into strategic implications.
  • Creativity and cultural fluency, a feel for what's shifting in culture and category, and the instinct to find a fresh, distinctive angle on the CVP instead of defaulting to convention.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder skills, the emotional intelligence to build trust across Product, Supply, Analytics, and Creative, and get them to act on a shared narrative.
  • Great communication skills, able to turn ambiguous strategic input into a clear, actionable plan that people outside the strategy team can build against.
  • Program management experience across various functional teams
  • Excellent written and spoken communication in English; additional languages are a plus.

Experience Preferred

  • 8 years+ Brand strategy experience: meaningful experience in brand strategy, positioning, or narrative development, ideally across multiple brands and markets.
  • Agency experience is a plus.
  • Experience working with data analytics and insight to direct research and translate insights into brand decisions.
  • Senior IC track record, comfort operating as a senior individual contributor with no direct reports — influence here comes from the quality of the thinking, not from headcount.

How We’ll Measure Impact

  • Quality and consistency of our Brand Narrative across the organisation
  • Brand health targets defined with leadership and tracked transparently.
  • Successful collaboration & influence of internal teams (creative, supply, product, care).

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Model “Get the Right Results, the Right Way” through sound judgment, transparency, integrity, and ethical decision-making.

Implementation Planning and Organizational Readiness

  • Lead assigned Customer Care implementations from planning through readiness, launch, stabilization, transition, and closure.
  • Translate approved business, product, operational, and technology requirements into integrated implementation and training plans.
  • Define scope, milestones, deliverables, functional owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
  • Own implementation-specific organizational-readiness criteria and assessments.
  • Evaluate readiness across people, processes, training, knowledge, Quality, technology, communications, staffing, leadership support, and partner-site capability.
  • Ensure readiness gaps have clear owners, actions, target dates, mitigation plans, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare readiness summaries and go-live recommendations for Support Services and operational leadership.
  • Develop launch, support, escalation, contingency, and stabilization plans.
  • Maintain implementation records and reporting in accordance with established portfolio and Jira-governance standards.

Train-the-Trainer and Trainer Certification

  • Own the train-the-trainer strategy and execution for implementations across Flight, Hotel, and Rental Car.
  • Determine trainer prerequisites, preparation requirements, certification standards, and implementation-specific expectations.
  • Facilitate or oversee train-the-trainer sessions for internal and external contact center trainers.
  • Validate trainer subject-matter knowledge, system proficiency, facilitation capability, scenario application, and operational readiness.
  • Develop and maintain trainer assessments, observation practices, certification criteria, and supporting documentation.
  • Establish remediation and recertification requirements when trainers do not meet readiness standards.
  • Monitor trainer performance during initial delivery and provide targeted coaching, feedback, and reinforcement.
  • Document trainer-readiness results, certification decisions, identified risks, and required actions.
  • Ensure train-the-trainer practices support consistent delivery across sites, regions, and contact center partners.

Flight and Travel Expertise

  • Apply deep Flight knowledge to planning, curriculum validation, train-the-trainer, readiness assessment, and launch support.
  • Ensure Flight training addresses airline policies, fare rules, ticketing, exchanges, refunds, cancellations, schedule changes, irregular operations, and escalation procedures.
  • Evaluate whether trainers and learners can accurately apply complex Flight requirements to realistic customer scenarios.
  • Identify customer, financial, compliance, and operational risks associated with Flight knowledge, system, workflow, or readiness gaps.
  • Apply strong travel-agent knowledge across Hotel and Rental Car products, policies, workflows, servicing models, and customer scenarios.
  • Identify differences and dependencies among Flight, Hotel, and Rental Car that may affect curriculum, delivery, technology, Quality, or partner readiness.
  • Maintain current knowledge of travel operations, systems, product changes, and emerging capability requirements.

Training and Functional Readiness

  • Partner with Instructional Design to ensure curricula, facilitator guides, learner materials, assessments, simulations, and job aids are ready for implementation.
  • Provide Flight, Hotel, Rental Car, and operational feedback regarding curriculum accuracy, usability, sequencing, and implementation risk.
  • Partner with Knowledge Management to ensure required procedures, policies, knowledge articles, and performance-support materials are approved and accessible.
  • Partner with Training Operations on trainer assignments, delivery capacity, learner schedules, classroom execution, nesting, and long-term ownership.
  • Partner with Quality on scorecard readiness, calibration, proficiency measures, early-tenure monitoring, and post-launch performance.
  • Partner with Product and Technology on requirements, system access, training environments, testing, defects, deployment timing, and operational support.
  • Partner with Learning Operations and Change Enablement on system assignments, Jira requirements, communications, stakeholder impacts, and adoption support.
  • Coordinate site-specific implementation plans while maintaining alignment with Priceline standards.

Partner-Site Readiness

  • Serve as a primary implementation and training contact for external contact center partners.
  • Assess site readiness across trainer capability, learner prerequisites, classroom infrastructure, technology access, staffing, leadership support, and nesting.
  • Communicate requirements, milestones, risks, decisions, and readiness expectations clearly and consistently.
  • Facilitate partner feedback and ensure relevant operational considerations are incorporated into implementation plans.
  • Escalate readiness concerns that could affect training effectiveness, customer experience, compliance, or launch success.
  • Promote consistent training and certification practices while accounting for legitimate market, language, and operational differences.

Launch, Stabilization, and Transition

  • Coordinate training-related launch, command-center, and hypercare activities when required.
  • Monitor trainer, learner, operational, Quality, technology, and customer indicators during launch and stabilization.
  • Track training completion, knowledge attainment, certification, graduation, proficiency, early-tenure Quality, productivity, and speed to competency.
  • Identify whether implementation gaps result from curriculum, trainer capability, facilitation, systems, knowledge, operational support, or learner proficiency.
  • Coordinate issue resolution and maintain visibility into severity, ownership, timing, and customer or business impact.
  • Determine when implementation and training stabilization criteria have been achieved.
  • Formally transition ongoing training ownership to the Senior Manager, Quality & Capability Development and Training Operations.
  • Ensure the receiving teams have the curriculum, documentation, trainer records, performance findings, outstanding actions, reporting, and support processes needed for ongoing execution.

Implementation Measurement and Improvement

  • Define implementation success measures with Quality, Training Operations, Operations, and other functional leaders.
  • Evaluate readiness, launch execution, trainer certification, learner proficiency, and stabilization outcomes.
  • Develop implementation dashboards, readiness summaries, risk reports, and leadership recommendations.
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews and document results, lessons learned, unresolved actions, and improvement opportunities.
  • Provide sustained performance findings to Quality and Training Operations for continued analysis and intervention.
  • Provide governance and process lessons to Learning Operations and Change Enablement for incorporation into future standards, workflows, and communications.
  • Improve train-the-trainer, certification, readiness, launch, and transition practices based on implementation outcomes.

People and Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop assigned team members, trainers, implementation resources, and workstream leads.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for readiness and implementation deliverables.
  • Build productive relationships with internal leaders, external partners, trainers, subject-matter experts, and operational stakeholders.
  • Influence decisions across functional and organizational boundaries.
  • Communicate complex travel and implementation information clearly to operational, technical, partner, and executive audiences.
  • Create an environment of transparency, shared accountability, constructive challenge, and disciplined execution.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, learning and development, organizational development, operations management, project management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered in lue of education.
  • Seven or more years of progressively responsible experience in travel contact center operations, training, learning implementation, operational readiness, or a related discipline.
  • Five or more years of experience leading training implementations, train-the-trainer programs, trainer certification, or large-scale learning deployments.
  • Three or more years of leadership experience, including direct people leadership or formal responsibility for trainers, implementation teams, or complex workstreams.
  • Deep demonstrated knowledge of Flight servicing and training, including airline policies, fare rules, ticketing, exchanges, refunds, cancellations, schedule changes, irregular operations, and escalation practices.
  • Demonstrated travel-agent knowledge across Hotel and Rental Car products, servicing models, policies, workflows, and customer scenarios.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating trainer readiness and establishing certification, remediation, and recertification requirements.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into training, knowledge, Quality, technology, operational, and readiness plans.
  • Experience supporting multi-site, outsourced, BPO, or global contact center operations.
  • Experience managing implementations through planning, curriculum readiness, train-the-trainer, delivery, nesting, launch, stabilization, and transition.
  • Experience using learning and operational data to evaluate readiness, proficiency, and implementation performance.
  • Experience with airline reservation systems, Global Distribution Systems, Flight servicing platforms, or comparable travel technology is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Google Workspace, learning-management systems, and virtual-training platforms.

The salary range for this position is CAD $100k to $120k

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 year’s experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Property Operations

  • Develops an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
  • Reviews Owner Engagement Survey results and other data to identify areas of improvement and create action plans for improvement.

  • Tours building on a regular basis speaking with employees and Owners to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
  • Reviews findings from Owner Engagement Survey results with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken. Develops action plan for improvement and is accountable for outcomes.
  • Works with team to put sustainable work processes and systems in place that support the execution of the strategy.
  • Reviews reports and financial statements to determine residential operations performance against budget.
  • Creates draft annual budgets and works with the designated board member for to gain approval for board presentation.
  • Develops and communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
  • Manages luxury condominium facilities, including physical plant with attention to protection of the investment and plans to increase its value through superior care.
  • Verifies the residences operations meet Owner’s needs, verifies employee satisfaction, focuses on managing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department.
  • Identifies and corrects building and service defects while providing increase in value.
  • Implements high standards for all aspects of life safety, loss prevention, unit owner identity and privacy protection.

Leading Operations Teams

  • Verifies employees are treated fairly and equitably.
  • Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.
  • Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily operations meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with Owners and Residents.
  • Develops and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.
  • Implements training programs related to property management reinforcing constant quality service.

Managing Relationships with Property Stakeholders

  • Prepares for and leads board meetings and provides meaning or context to the operational and financial results.
  • Establishes relationship with owner as a business partnership and supports the relationship between the General Manager and the owner.

Managing Profitability

  • Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.
  • Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establish ways to improve the departments’ financial performance.
  • Leads cost containment efforts within operations including organizational restructuring when necessary.
  • Focuses on maintaining profit margins without compromising Owner or associate satisfaction.
  • Identifies key drivers of business success and keeping Residences leadership focused on the critical few to achieve results.
  • Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the Owners and employees and provides a return on investment.

Managing The Owner Experience

  • Creates an atmosphere in all common areas that meets or exceeds Owner expectations.
  • Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the Residences leadership teams.
  • Verifies core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.
  • Establishes and maintaining open, collaborative relationships with direct reports and entire Residences operations team. Instructs direct reports do the same for their team.
  • Interfaces with Owners on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

MIRJ

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

About the Role:

The purpose of the role is to manage the customer service lifecycle and provide professional, timely, helpful, high quality and consistent customer service both technical and non-technical before, during and after the customer's needs are met. They provide practical hands-on Coaching and Mentoring. They support infrastructure, service desk staff, processes and data to ensure the effective and efficient use of technology and deliver high-quality IT services that meet the needs of the region and its users. They ensure that IT service delivery is consistent, reliable, and aligned with best practices ITIL.


Knowledge, Skills and Experiences:


Customer Service Management:

  • Manage the customer service lifecycle, ensuring high-quality service at all stages.
  • Support both technical and non-technical customer inquiries and issues.
  • Ensure the team’s timely resolution of customer issues, maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.


Customer Service and Communication:

  • Communicate complex technical issues to non-technical users in a clear and concise manner.
  • Act as the primary interface between the service desk and stakeholders.
  • Provide regular updates to users on ticket status and resolution timelines.
  • Monitor user satisfaction, ensuring the team provides excellent customer service.


Mentoring and Coaching:

  • Serve as a point of contact for service desk analysts, providing guidance and mentoring.
  • Assist with onboarding, training, and upskilling service desk and managed service provider staff.
  • Delegate tasks effectively and provide performance feedback to team members when required.


Technical Support and Troubleshooting:

  • Manage escalated service requests and incidents, ensuring timely resolution.
  • Collaborate with managed service provider(s) and vendors to resolve issues where necessary.
  • Partner with Security on incident response and compliance in the service management space.


IT Infrastructure Management:

  • Align regional IT infrastructure with global standards and CTM business objectives.
  • Oversee the maintenance and upgrade of cloud, IT systems, networks, and infrastructure.
  • Ensure the security standards for IT systems and data is adhered to.


Incident and Problem Management:

  • Monitor, assign and respond to service desk tickets promptly, ensuring SLA compliance.
  • Lead root cause analysis efforts for recurring incidents and recommend permanent solutions.
  • Create, manage, and update problem records, escalating persistent or high-priority issues appropriately.
  • Identify patterns in incidents and work on proactive measures to reduce service disruptions.
  • Collaborate with other IT teams for incident management, root cause analysis, and long-term solutions to recurring issues.


Service Desk Operations:

  • Oversee day-to-day service desk operations to ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.
  • Close the process gaps, manage escalations and communicate effectively with stakeholders on high-priority or complex issues.
  • Prioritize and assign tasks to team members ensuring that service requests and incidents are addressed within agreed service level agreements.


Service Desk Process Improvement:

  • Analyse service desk metrics to identify areas for process improvements and efficiency gains.
  • Provide recommendations on improving IT service delivery and customer experience.
  • Contribute to developing best practices, operating procedures, and standards across the service desk.
  • Participate in service improvement projects to meet organisational goals.


Knowledge Management:

Reporting and Metrics:

  • Generate and analyse service desk performance reports, identifying trends and areas of improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with SLA.
  • Provide regular status reports on open incidents, tickets, and key performance metrics.


Vendor Management:

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with vendors to foster collaboration and resolve issues.
  • Ensuring that vendors comply with our SOP and procedures.
  • Regularly assessing vendor performance through metrics such as delivery times, service quality, and customer service.


Skills:

  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.

  • Proficient in ITIL best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.
  • Technical proficiency in relevant IT infrastructure and service desk tools.


Experience:

  • Experience in IT service analysts or a similar role.
  • Experience with ITIL or similar IT service management frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team of IT professionals.
  • Experience in vendor management and negotiation.


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of ITIL best practices and frameworks.
  • Knowledge of IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, and security.
  • Understanding of customer service principles and practices.
  • Familiarity with service desk software's and tools.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, a related field or relevant industry experience.

About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Act as the key risk control business partner for assigned business units, understanding their products, customer journeys, risk appetite, and commercial goals.
  • Own and align fraud, chargeback, approval-rate, and other risk KPIs across business, Risk Operations, and Corporate teams; translate data into actionable insights.
  • Lead regular business reviews to identify emerging risks, performance gaps, and optimization opportunities, driving mitigation plans and accountability.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Fraud Operations, Product, Data/Analytics, Legal, and Compliance to prioritize risk use cases, improve controls, and resolve issues.
  • Capture business and customer pain points to inform fraud tooling, rules, models, processes, and product roadmaps while balancing risk, revenue, and customer experience.
  • Monitor regional fraud trends and localized customer behaviors across the OTA industry, recommending market-specific risk prevention and control strategies.
  • Lead cyber-fraud incident identification and containment, and ensure fraud prevention platforms and frameworks remain scalable and aligned with global expansion.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in fraud/risk, payments, e-commerce, customer success, business partnering, product, or operations roles.
  • Proven experience partnering with internal stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Operations, or other business functions and driving alignment without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with hands-on experience using SQL, BI tools, or dashboards to diagnose issues and support business decisions.
  • Solid understanding of online fraud, chargebacks, payment flows, and risk controls; experience with fraud tools or rules engines is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex risk concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Strong ownership and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver initiatives independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in fintech, travel, e-commerce, digital marketplaces, or shared-services/COE environments is preferred; Python/R and tools such as Accertify, Riskified, or LexisNexis are a plus.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.

  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s and other Booking Holdings brands’ non-accommodation partners and promote our top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s and Booking Holdings’ unique travel product portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek.  Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda and the other group companies, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant profits to the overall business. 

Location: This role requires you to be based in Bangkok, Thailand (with relocation support provide)

The Opportunity:

To utilize your technical expertise to support and drive Agoda’s B2B partnership growth by optimizing connectivity with the company’s largest B2B accommodation partners. Work with diverse internal teams and world-leading travel providers in Agoda’s B2B team, delivering innovative, scalable travel solutions at speed.

In this Role, you'll get to:

  • Drive the profitable growth of Agoda’s Strategic Partnerships/Travel Distribution business.
  • Manage end-to-end technical account management for Agoda’s largest B2B accounts.
  • Take full ownership of connection performance, including new builds, rebuilds, upgrades, day-to-day success rates, and ensuring optimal access to inventory, rates, rate plans, content, and availability.
  • Extract and analyze complex data sets to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (especially with Product Managers) to identify business needs and influence the design and prioritization of next-generation features.
  • Automate business processes to support operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Identify and resolve technical issues impacting client connectivity, ensuring seamless operations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to B2B clients, translating business needs into technical requirements.

What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, engineering, or computer science field.
  • 4-6+ years of hands-on experience in technical account management, solutions engineering, or similar roles in technology or travel industries.
  • Demonstrated strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to leverage data and insights to drive business strategy and decisions.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities across concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a self-starter mentality - able to identify opportunities, relentlessly drive growth, and push projects over the finish line.
  • Practical experience with API integrations/data transfers, with strong proficiency in SQL and Excel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

It's Great if you have:

  • In-depth understanding of technical integrations and system architecture.
  • Experience in travel technology, hospitality tech, or related industries.
  • Strong command of Python, XML, or data modeling concepts.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Hotel Manager, you’re not just overseeing day-to-day hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Manage hotel operations: Oversee the overall functioning of the property, with direct oversight of operational performance.
  • Act as the General Manager delegate: Assume full operational leadership responsibilities in the absence of the General Manager
  • Maximize performance and satisfaction: Drive operational efficiency, profitability, and service excellence to ensure a high level of guest and team member satisfaction. Partner with commercial and finance leadership to maximize sales opportunities and financial control
  • Oversee quality and service initiatives: Implement and manage daily quality assurance processes to enhance the guest experience and ensure alignment with brand standards
  • Communicate with key stakeholders: Partner with hotel owners and corporate leadership to align business goals and operational strategy
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
The Sr. Analyst, Operations Analytics & AI Innovation supports the Americas Operations organization through reporting, data analysis, AI-enablement, and actionable business insights. This role partners with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical needs, identify practical opportunities for AI, and to help turn ideas into tools, workflows, and analyses that improve operational performance. 

The Sr. Analyst will leverage tools including SQL, Tableau, Tableau Prep, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Excel, and emerging AI/automation tools to translate business questions into accurate, timely, and meaningful reporting, insights, and AI-enabled solutions that supports operational performance and leadership decision-making.

Your day to day

Reporting & Operational Support

  • Support recurring and ad hoc reporting and analytical requests across the Americas Operations organization. 
  • Partner with business stakeholders to clarify requirements, understand business needs, define expected outputs, and deliver timely reporting and AI support. 
  • Analyze operational trends, user behavior, and business performance data to provide actionable insights to leaders. 
  • Translate data into clear findings and effectively communicate updates, insights, and recommendations to leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

AI Innovation & Workflow Enablement

  • Help identify, create, and manage a growing portfolio of AI projects 
  • Support the day-to-day execution of AI Innovation work across the Americas Operations organization, helping operationalize projects from concept to practical application. 
  • Support intake and prioritization of new ideas and requests from across the organization, helping focus efforts on the highest-impact opportunities. 
  • Partner with the analytics manager and business stakeholders to understand how AI can support day-to-day reporting, analysis, dashboarding, and decision support. 

Reporting Maintenance & Data Quality

  • Maintain existing operational reports, dashboards, queries, and recurring data outputs to ensure continued accuracy, reliability, and usability. 
  • Monitor reporting outputs and identify potential data quality, functionality, automation, or performance issues. 
  • Troubleshoot reporting issues, query errors, and data discrepancies, partnering with stakeholders and technical teams as needed to determine root causes and support resolution. 
  • Perform routine data validation and quality checks to ensure reporting outputs are complete and accurate. 
  • Enhance executive dashboards through automation, streamlined data preparation, and AI-driven insights where appropriate. 

Reporting, Analytics & AI-Enabled Development

  • Develop new reports, dashboards, queries, and analytical outputs with guidance based on defined business requirements. 
  • Use SQL, Tableau, Tableau Prep, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Excel, and relevant AI/automation tools to support reporting, data preparation, visualization, and operational analysis. 
  • Translate business questions into clear, actionable reporting and analytical deliverables. 
  • Analyze emerging trends in technology, products, markets, and competitors to inform roadmap recommendations and identify opportunities for operational improvement. 
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback to refine reporting, dashboards, and AI-enabled workflows to improve usability and business impact. 

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to simplify reporting processes, automate recurring outputs, redesign workflows, and improve reporting efficiency. 
  • Support enhancements to existing reports, dashboards, and AI-enabled tools based on evolving stakeholders and business needs. 
  • Contribute to reporting documentation, process consistency, and the adoption of analytics and AI resources across the organization. 
  • Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly across teams to help align stakeholders and support execution. 

What we need from you

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail. 
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workflows, prioritize effectively, and deliver against deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Ability to communicate data, findings, and technical information clearly to leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and technical teams. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities such as pivot tables, XLOOKUPs, formulas, and data analysis. 
  • Experience with Tableau and Tableau Prep. 
  • Experience working with Google Cloud Platform or similar cloud-based data environments. 
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to review, maintain, and modify existing queries. 
  • Ability to learn new reporting tools, data sources, AI tools, and business processes. 
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, or data visualizations.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have six Customer Service Centres for Trip.com, established in Japan, Korea, the UK, Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 35 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 50 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspires to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Join Trip.com's France team and help shape the future of one of our fastest-growing European markets. Working across marketing, CRM, product and partnerships, you'll have the opportunity to build and deliver innovative campaigns that drive customer growth, engagement and loyalty. If you're passionate about travel, data-driven marketing and creating exceptional customer experiences, you'll thrive in our fast-paced, international environment while collaborating with teams across Europe and Asia.


In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Plan, develop and execute integrated marketing, CRM and product marketing campaigns (e.g., platform-wide, seasonal, destination-specific and lifecycle campaigns) across various channels, including email, push notifications, in-app messaging, social media, paid advertising and partner marketing, to drive customer acquisition, engagement, retention, repeat bookings and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Develop and execute local social media campaigns in collaboration with regional and global teams, creating engaging content and activations that strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement and campaign performance across owned and paid channels.
  • Analyze customer data, CRM performance, marketing performance and market trends to inform campaign strategy and ensure continuous improvement. Leverage A/B testing, attribution models, customer segmentation and performance metrics to optimize campaigns and achieve key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Own the CRM campaign calendar for the French market, working closely with regional CRM teams to plan, execute and optimise lifecycle communications aligned with commercial priorities, strategic partnerships and key trading moments.
  • Partner with Product and regional teams to support product marketing initiatives, including the launch and adoption of new features, payment solutions, loyalty propositions and customer experiences. Translate product capabilities into compelling customer-facing campaigns and messaging.
  • Work closely with design teams to ensure campaigns are on-brand, visually compelling and aligned with the customer journey. Provide feedback on creative briefs and collaborate on messaging strategies.
  • Manage and track campaign budgets, ensuring efficient use of resources and maximizing ROI. Monitor spend across multiple channels and adjust strategies as needed to stay within budget.
  • Provide regular campaign performance reports and actionable insights to senior leadership, highlighting key learnings and recommendations to optimise future initiatives.
  • Work with various internal stakeholders, including Product, CRM, Design, regional marketing managers and business leaders, to align on campaign objectives, product launches, customer engagement strategies and delivery timelines.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activities and emerging marketing technologies to ensure Trip.com stays ahead of the curve in campaign innovation and customer engagement.


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • 3+ years in marketing campaign execution, ideally within the travel or related industry. 
  • Experience planning and delivering integrated multi-channel campaigns from concept through execution and performance analysis.
  • A creative thinker with attention to detail and the ability to thrive in dynamic environments. 
  • Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns, meet deadlines, and handle competing priorities effectively. 
  • Strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting campaign performance, customer behaviour and commercial data to drive continuous optimisation.
  • Familiarity with CRM tools, email marketing platforms, and social media management tools. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across local and international teams.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, or a related field. 
  • Comfortable using AI-powered tools to improve productivity, content creation, campaign planning and marketing workflows.
  • Native or fluent French is essential for developing culturally relevant campaigns and customer communications. 
  • A passion for travel and creating exceptional customer experiences, with curiosity to explore new marketing technologies, channels and ideas.


Why Trip.com Group

As a world leading company in travel industry, we provide a platform for our talent to unleash their power, make a global impact, and achieve a successful career. As an international team, we're dedicated to create a space where open communication and mutual respect is encouraged. At Trip.com Group, we are here to support you in and out of the workplace, enabling you to explore and embrace more possibilities and pursue a dream life.


What’s more?

  • A fast-growing enviroment that offers strong potential for career growth and encourages bold ideas.
  • We focus on cutting-edge technology to provide some of the best platforms and resources for you to do your best work.
  • We encourage internal talent movement and provide global opportunities across functions, business units or regions for you to accelerate your career advancement.

job.job_description:
We are seeking a Senior Principal, Sales & Account Management to join our global Airline Tech team, where innovation knows no borders. This team drives go-to-market strategies for modern airline software like the Sabre Mosaic offer and order platform across Japan. By helping carriers modernize legacy systems, we enable airlines to deliver personalized passenger experiences and grow high-margin revenue. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity and commitment so we can all win together.


As Senior Principal, Sales & Account Management, you will lead commercial strategy and executive growth across key Japanese airline accounts. You will operate with broad autonomy to guide carriers through retail transformations, challenge traditional distribution models and align local market needs with global technology roadmaps. This role requires executive presence, sharp business judgment and deep domain expertise.


What you'll do

  • Lead commercial negotiations and deal strategies for Sabre Mosaic offer and order solutions across top-tier Japanese airlines.
  • Drive software adoption to help carriers modernize commercial operations and increase profitability.
  • Guide executive stakeholders through complex retail transformations to align platform capabilities with long-term commercial goals.
  • Collaborate with global product and engineering teams to ensure Japanese market requirements shape technology roadmaps.
  • Build long-term commercial relationships with senior airline leaders across the Japanese market.
  • Use generative artificial intelligence and workflow automation to streamline deal modeling, accelerate account planning and sharpen decision-making.


What you'll bring

  • Minimum 10 years of commercial sales or account management experience in travel technology, airline IT or software as a service (SaaS).
  • Deep expertise in airline technology solutions like Passenger Service Systems (PSS) or proven success selling complex enterprise software solutions to airlines in Japan.
  • Good understanding of modern airline retailing concepts, including offer and order management, New Distribution Capability (NDC) and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) is preferred.
  • Native-level Japanese and business-level English communication skills to influence senior airline executives and cross-functional global teams.
  • Proven ability to lead high-value commercial discussions, navigate complex organizational structures and build executive alignment.
  • Practical experience using generative artificial intelligence, automation or analytics tools to increase productivity and elevate commercial strategy.
  • Located in the Tokyo Metropolitan area due to the proximity to key customer’s headquarters.


Benefits that support you

We know support looks different for everyone. That is why Sabre offers benefits beyond medical and financial coverage, with programs designed to support your well-being, growth and life outside work:

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives, where applicable
  • Remote working arrangements for employees in Japan, based on current company policy and business needs
  • Health insurance, pension and other social insurance coverage in line with Japanese requirements
  • Paid annual leave, public holidays and other statutory leave
  • Childcare, family care and parental leave support


シニアプリンシパル

営業・アカウントマネジメント

航空業界向けテクノロジーソリューション（日本担当）

募集概要

Sabreのグローバル航空テクノロジーチームでは、日本市場を担当する**シニアプリンシパル（営業・アカウントマネジメント）**を募集しています。

本ポジションは、シニアレベルの個人貢献職として、日本の主要航空会社との戦略的な関係構築、事業拡大、ならびに大規模な商談の推進を担います。

当チームは、次世代航空リテーリングプラットフォーム「Sabre Mosaic」をはじめとするソフトウェアソリューションを通じて、航空会社のデジタルトランスフォーメーションを支援しています。レガシーシステムの刷新、リテーリング機能の高度化、顧客体験の向上、収益性の改善に向けて、グローバル規模で取り組んでいます。

日本市場における顧客ニーズを深く理解し、地域の事業戦略とグローバルの製品戦略を結びつける、重要なポジションです。


ポジション概要

本ポジションでは、日本の主要航空会社に対するアカウント戦略を策定し、中長期的な事業成長と顧客価値の最大化をリードしていただきます。

顧客企業の経営層や意思決定者と信頼関係を構築し、航空会社の事業課題や変革方針を理解したうえで、Sabreの製品・サービスを活用した提案を行います。

また、日本市場特有の要件や商習慣を、アジア太平洋地域およびグローバルの製品、営業、エンジニアリング、デリバリーチームへ共有し、製品戦略や開発ロードマップにも影響を与えていただきます。

高い裁量のもと、以下の領域を中心に業務を推進していただきます。

  • 日本市場における主要顧客のアカウント戦略
  • 大規模かつ複雑な商談および契約交渉
  • 既存顧客との関係強化および事業拡大
  • 航空会社のリテーリング変革およびシステム刷新
  • 日本市場とグローバル組織との連携


主な業務内容

  • 日本の主要航空会社に対する中長期的な営業戦略およびアカウントプランを策定する。
  • Sabre Mosaicを含むOffer & Orderソリューションの提案活動を推進する。
  • 顧客企業の経営層、事業責任者、IT部門、調達部門などとの商談を主導する。
  • 大規模案件における提案、価格交渉、契約条件の調整、社内承認プロセスをリードする。
  • 顧客の商業戦略、業務課題、システム環境を理解し、最適なソリューションを提案する。
  • 航空会社のデジタルトランスフォーメーション、リテーリング改革、収益改善に向けた取り組みを支援する。
  • 既存顧客との関係を深め、追加提案や新たな事業機会の創出を推進する。
  • 日本市場の要件や顧客からのフィードバックを、グローバルの製品およびエンジニアリングチームへ共有する。
  • 製品戦略、開発ロードマップ、導入方針の検討に、日本市場の視点を反映する。
  • アジア太平洋地域およびグローバルの営業、製品、法務、財務、デリバリーチームと連携する。
  • 必要に応じて、生成AI、業務自動化、データ分析などの新しいテクノロジーを活用し、アカウント戦略や案件管理の高度化を図る。


応募資格

必須要件

  • 旅行テクノロジー、航空IT、エンタープライズソフトウェア、またはSaaS業界における、10年以上の営業もしくはアカウントマネジメント経験。
  • 日本の航空会社向け営業経験、または航空・旅行業界におけるエンタープライズソフトウェア販売の実績。
  • 大手法人顧客に対する中長期的なアカウント戦略の策定および実行経験。
  • 顧客企業の経営層や意思決定者との関係構築および商談経験。
  • 高額かつ複雑な案件における提案、交渉、契約締結の経験。
  • 複雑な組織環境において、複数の社内外ステークホルダーを巻き込みながら案件やプロジェクトを推進した経験。
  • 日本語ネイティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力。
  • 英語によるビジネスコミュニケーション能力。
  • 東京都市圏に居住している方、または居住可能な方。


歓迎要件

  • Passenger Service Systems（PSS）などの航空会社向け基幹システムに関する知識または経験。
  • Offer & Order Managementに関する知識。
  • NDC（New Distribution Capability）に関する知識。
  • API連携やクラウド型ソリューションに関する理解。
  • 航空会社の予約、発券、在庫、収益管理、顧客管理、販売流通などの業務知識。
  • 航空会社のシステム刷新または大規模な変革プロジェクトに関与した経験。
  • 生成AI、業務自動化、データ分析ツールなど、新しいテクノロジーを業務へ取り入れる意欲。


求める人物像

  • 顧客との長期的な信頼関係を重視できる方。
  • 日本の商習慣を理解しながら、グローバルな組織環境で業務を推進できる方。
  • 複雑な課題を整理し、実行可能な提案へ落とし込める方。
  • 社内外の異なる意見を調整し、合意形成を進められる方。
  • 高い当事者意識を持ち、自律的に業務を進められる方。
  • 市場やテクノロジーの変化に関心を持ち、継続的に学ぶ姿勢を持つ方。


勤務形態

  • 日本国内でのリモートワークを基本とします。
  • 顧客訪問、商談、社内会議などのため、必要に応じて東京都内への出張があります。
  • 業務上の必要に応じて、日本国内および海外への出張が発生する場合があります。
  • 勤務形態は、会社方針および事業状況に基づき変更となる場合があります。


福利厚生

Sabreでは、一人ひとりに最適なサポートが異なると考えています。社員の健康、キャリア形成、そして仕事以外の生活も含めて支援する充実した福利厚生制度をご用意しています。

  • 業績に応じたインセンティブを含む競争力の高い報酬制度。
  • 日本国内におけるリモートワーク制度（会社方針および事業状況に基づく）。
  • 健康保険、厚生年金を含む各種社会保険完備。
  • 年次有給休暇および法定休暇制度。
  • 育児休業、介護休業、家族支援制度。

Reports directly to Property Sales Leader (ASL or DOS/DOSM) and works closely with the hotel General Managers, focuses on sales driven tasks. May work with Local Sales and U.S. Account Sales/GSO teams to drive production from targeted high priority accounts including maximizing special corporate business within the represented market place.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Preferred:

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

job.job_description:
Now boarding: Your career in travel is ready for take-off.

Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is undergoing an exciting period of growth as worldwide travel returns. If you’re ready to embark on a career with a global leader in business travel, we want to hear from you.

At CTM, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We know that our diverse team is the reason CTM is the award-winning TMC we are today, which is why recruiting like-minded travel enthusiasts is an important part of our business’ success and growth.


About CTM

CTM is an award-winning provider of travel service solutions spanning corporate, events and sports markets. Headquartered and founded in Australia, CTM has offices all around the world, including Europe, Asia, North America, Australia and New Zealand. www.travelctm.co.uk


About the Role

The Risk and Compliance Manager reports to the Head of Legal and is responsible for establishing, leading, and overseeing the risk and compliance framework for CTM UK/EU. This role ensures the organisation meets all relevant UK regulatory, contractual, and ethical obligations, as well as internal governance policies, while proactively identifying and mitigating operational, financial, regulatory, reputational and supplier risks inherent in the corporate travel sector.


The position plays a critical part in maintaining trust with corporate clients, travellers, suppliers, and regulators, and in enabling responsible business growth.


✔ Delivers contractual obligations and transparent reporting

✔ Meets UK travel regulations (IATA, ATOL, when applicable)

✔ Maintains safe, legal relationships with suppliers

✔ Follows UK bribery, competition, and tax requirements

✔ Trains staff to operate to UK corporate travel standards



Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience managing risk registers and compliance frameworks.
  • Excellent relationship management and communication skills and stakeholder management
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and organisational abilities.
  • Ability to manage complex regulatory environments and interpret legal requirements pragmatically.
  • High integrity, sound judgement, and confidentiality.
  • 5–10 years of experience in compliance, risk, or governance, preferably within a TMC, travel sector organisation, or regulated service industry.
  • Experience working with large corporate clients and their audit/compliance requirements.
  • Desirable: Good understanding of UK travel industry regulations (ATOL, IATA) and strong knowledge of corporate travel operations, GDS/OBTs, and business travel processes.

-Experience with ATOL/IATA accredited environments.

-Background in GDS, travel technology, or corporate travel operations.



Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Governance, Policies & Controls

2. Risk Management

3. Regulatory Compliance

4. Corporate Client, Contract, and SLA Compliance

5. Supplier and Partner Compliance

6. Operations

7. Financial & Reporting Compliance

8. Reporting & Governance

9. Leadership, Training & Culture


Join our crew and help CTM take flight. Apply now and pack your skills for a business travel journey that promises growth, discovery and plenty of first-class moments.



What to expect from the recruitment process

  • Every hire starts with a chat with our Talent Acquisition team, if your profile is selected you will be contacted by phone or email (please check your spam folder);
  • Then, if you are progressing, the hiring manager will invite you to an interview, usually on Teams;
  • If you are successful we will invite you to our office for a final stage interview.


Wherever possible we will provide you with feedback, however we are a small team and often we won't be able to do so until after we fill the vacancy.



CTM is a responsible employer and is dedicated to conduct thorough right to work checks in the interests of both parties, candidates and the company. Candidates selected and invited to an interview will be invited to a mandatory 15 min call with the TA lead to produce their RTW documents. This call is a mandatory step for all candidates regardless of their RTW status. This call is confidential and conducted by HR professionals only.



CTM is an equal opportunity employer. We want to make sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know: as a Disability Confident Employer, we’re here to support you in any way we can. Do not hesitate to connect with our Recruitment team if you need to discuss arrangements.



Reward & Recognition

Our learning platform CTM Learning, our annual conference the All Stars, our High-Performance programme and a global leadership programme.


Employee Wellbeing and Flexibility

Our wellbeing platform Vitality, our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), our new private healthcare Medicash + our mental health first aiders.


Most of our roles offer a hybrid working pattern, with 3 days per week in the office. Where permitted and depending on the role, we can offer flexible start and finish times to suit your other commitments and support a healthy work-life balance. We are committed to finding a setup that works for you and the business.


Sustainability Focus

Principles of Governance, People, Planet, and Prosperity, CTM’s Sustainability Strategy identifies material issues and outlines initiatives to achieve this.



CTM is the Data Controller with respect to the personal information you provide during your application. We will use this information solely to process your application, and our legal basis is that you are considering taking up an employment contract with us. We may share this information with our parent company in Australia, but otherwise we will not disclose it to any other organisation. If you take up employment with us, we will keep the information for the duration of your employment, otherwise we will destroy it 2 months after the post is filled.

All the information that we ask for in application forms has to be completed for your application to go ahead. There is no profiling or automated decision making applied to the personal information you supply. You have all the legal rights with your personal data as laid out in the General Data Processing Regulation (GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018, including the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office. Our Data Protection Officer may be contacted at EU.DPO@travelctm.com

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration.

We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. We are a skillful, driven, and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

The Opportunity

As Director, Content and Product Operations, you will play a key leadership role in analyzing customer and product data to determine business value and priorities, setting the strategy, roadmap and KPIs to deliver efficient and effective operations. You will build and manage multiple large teams in a fast-paced, international environment.

You will lead your teams in execution, collaborate closely with product managers and IT on A/B experiments and reporting, and coordinate with accommodation supply, connectivity, strategic partnerships, and customer support teams to ensure operational excellence.

This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand, reporting to the VP of Product, and is open to candidates worldwide. We will assist you with visa and relocation, ensuring a smooth transition to working and living in Bangkok.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute content and product operations strategies to support Agoda’s business goals.
  • Set content and data priorities based on customer needs and business value.
  • Establish and track KPIs to measure business impact and operational performance.
  • Create and manage roadmaps and project plans for key initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Technology, and Supply, to deliver effective content solutions.
  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Monitor and improve content systems and processes for efficiency and quality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the content supply chain.

Experience Required

  • 10+ years of experience in driving Operations for large organizations
  • At least 6 years of direct management experience, including leading teams of 20 or more
  • Experience managing teams in the e-commerce or technology/internet space
  • Proven ability to set and execute content or operational strategy to drive business results
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making; SQL expertise a plus
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing operational workflows and resourcing, both automated and manual, to achieve business goals

Proposer un hébergement sur-mesure au sein du réseau des résidences Orfea et des prestataires hôteliers pour une activité d 1.3 million de nuitées/an. Offrir des solutions clef en main pour l'organisation de réunions et de séminaires.

Engagement, coopération, satisfaction client, sens de l'hospitalité.

Au-delà de l'exigence sur les fondamentaux Accueil, Confort, Propreté, Orfea s'assure du développement des compétences de ses collaborateurs, en proposant des parcours formations adaptés et sur-mesure aux besoins des équipes.

Qualifications

Issu(e) d'une formation Bac +2 ou Bac +3 en hôtellerie, vous disposez d'expériences réussies en hôtellerie et/ou dans le secteur du service ? Orienté(e) 100% satisfaction client, rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous êtes prêt à relever un nouveau challenge au service d'une clientèle exigeante ? Alors rejoignez-nous !
