No two nights are the same - you might be settling in a late arrival, calming a frustrated guest, or working through an unexpected system issue.

You'll keep a close eye on the audit as it comes together, ready to step in if something doesn't add up.

When required, you'll step into the Night Manager's role directly — making confident, independent decisions to keep the hotel well supported through the night.

You’ll primarily be responsible for:

Guest Experience & Operations

  • Lead the overnight Front Office operation, ensuring guests receive prompt, professional and personalised service.
  • Respond to guest concerns and operational issues, using sound judgement to resolve matters or escalate appropriately.
  • Oversee Reception, Concierge and Porter operations and ensure service standards are consistently maintained.
  • Monitor Front Office and public areas, addressing presentation, maintenance, safety or operational issues promptly.
  • Ensure VIP, regular and IHG Rewards guests receive appropriate recognition and benefits.
  • Champion IHG Rewards enrolment, brand standards and True Hospitality service behaviours.
  • Conduct effective overnight handovers and communicate key operational matters to the day team.
  • Ensure all hotel health, safety, security, compliance and brand requirements are followed.

People

  • Lead, coach and support Front Office colleagues, providing regular feedback and guidance to build capability and performance.
  • Ensure colleagues have the training, tools and resources required to deliver their roles confidently.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, development and succession planning within the Front Office team.
  • Promote teamwork and effective communication across Front Office and wider hotel departments.
  • Support the management of performance, conduct and other people matters in line with hotel policies and procedures.

Financial

  • Complete and/or oversee the night audit and preparation of daily financial reports.
  • Reconcile revenue, transactions, guest accounts and cashier balances, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
  • Monitor guest credit, billing instructions and financial transactions in line with hotel policies and controls.
  • Support labour management, rostering and timesheet approvals in line with business requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to maximise revenue through upselling, walk-ins and other Front Office revenue streams.
  • Maintain accurate cash handling and audit records.

Responsible Business

  • Promote a safe environment for guests and colleagues and respond appropriately to hazards or incidents.
  • Ensure health, safety, security and wellbeing procedures are followed and required actions are addressed.
  • Support a culture of responsible and compliant hotel operations.

Rattaché à l’Adjoint Directeur des Ressources Humaines, le Coordinateur Ressources Humaines assure l’ensemble des missions du service : administration du personnel, gestion des recrutements, suivi de la formation, qualité de vie au travail.

GESTIN DU RECRUTEMENT ET FIDELISATION DES TALENTS

ADMINISTRATION DU PERSONNEL

en collaboration avec l’Adjoint Directeur des Ressources Humaines

  • Gérer le suivi administratif et les dossiers du personnel, de l’embauche à la sortie de l’Entreprise.

en collaboration avec le Chargé des Ressources Humaines et l’Adjoint Directeur des Ressources Humaines

FORMATION

en collaboration avec le Responsable Recrutement et Formation

  • Assister le Responsable Recrutement et Formation dans le pilotage des projets : identification des besoins, développement des compétences, gestion administrative des dossiers.

COMMUNICATION INTERNE, TAKE CARE, QUALITE DE VIE AU TRAVAIL

  • Contribuer au développement des actions de communication interne et de « Qualité de vie au travail », dans le cadre la politique de l’entreprise : mettre en place des initiatives en lien avec la culture d’entreprise et les responsabilités sociétales de l’entreprise.

Ce descriptif de poste est non exhaustif. Le titulaire peut être amené à accomplir d’autres missions.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

De préférence, un diplôme supérieur en Ressources Humaines ou en Hôtellerie, dont une expérience de 2 ans dans la Gestion des Ressources Humaines.

  • Connaissances informatiques : maîtrise du Pack Office
  • Connaissances des procédures, des principes RH et des bases en droit du travail
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais indispensable (oral et écrit)
  • Relationnel et écoute
  • Esprit d’équipe

  • Rigueur et sens de l’organisation
  • Autonomie et initiative
  • Ouverture d’esprit et créativité
  • A l’aise dans un environnement de travail dynamique et rapide

AVANTAGES :

  • Rémunération sur 13 mois
  • De 34000€ à 36000€ par an

  • Indemnité nourriture

job.job_description:
Peppers Seaport Hotel is located just 5 minutes from the heart of Launceston, situated within the lively dockside precinct. This contemporary property offers a range of studio rooms and apartment style suites with balconies and views overlooking the seaport marina or historic township. On your days off, take time out and immerse yourself in nature, take in the picturesque coastline, or sample some of the finest produce and wines in the renowned food and wine region of the Tamar Valley.

An exciting opportunity exists for a motivated and organised Sales Executive to join our team in a part-time capacity. This role will be based at Peppers Seaport while also providing support to Peppers Silo Hotel. Reporting to the Sales & Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in driving corporate and events business, nurturing client relationships and delivering exceptional conferencing and event experiences.

Purpose

As a Sales Executive, you will be a key ambassador for the hotels, supporting the growth of corporate, conference and events business across both properties. You will assist with sales activities, business development initiatives and event coordination, helping to create meaningful client relationships while delivering seamless experiences from enquiry through to event delivery.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, conference organisers and event stakeholders.
  • Manage sales enquiries, pipeline activity and client follow-up to maximise conversion and revenue outcomes.
  • Identify and convert new business opportunities through prospecting, networking and account development activities.
  • Support the planning and coordination of conferences, meetings and events, ensuring seamless delivery and exceptional client experiences.
  • Manage a small portfolio of corporate and agency accounts while supporting account reviews, rate negotiations and retention activities.
  • Coordinate and host client site inspections and familiarisations across both properties.
  • Maintain accurate client records, sales activities, reporting and opportunities within CRM systems.
  • Represent the hotels professionally at networking events, industry functions and client meetings when required.

Skills & Experience

  • Previous experience in hotel sales, conference & events, reservations or hospitality operations is highly regarded.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with a genuine passion for customer service and creating memorable experiences.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using hotel PMS, CRM or event management systems is highly regarded.
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Confident working independently while contributing positively to a collaborative team environment.
  • A proactive and commercially minded approach with a willingness to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
  • Knowledge of the Tasmanian corporate, tourism or events market will be highly regarded.

Accor Benefits

  • ALL Heartist Membership - Take advantage of discounts on accommodation and food & beverage worldwide!
  • Family & Friends Discounts - Available on a range of accommodation, services and events for those who mean the most to you
  • Accor Live Limitless (ALL) Loyalty Program - Earn status & reward points on your worldwide stays
  • Learn Your Way - Support your career development with access to Accor’s industry leading training platforms, Accor Academy and Typsy
  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide
  • Worldwide Opportunities - We are a world leading hotel operator! With over 400 hotels in the Pacific and more than 5,000 across 110 countries, offering limitless opportunities to grow your career

At Accor, we welcome you as you are. We help you grow and learn, so that work brings purpose to your life. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Accor is an inclusive company, building diverse teams across the globe.

Everyone has a story and we want to learn yours. We invite you to APPLY NOW.

job.job_description:
Mantra Esplanade Cairns sits within a prime location, walking distance to the swimming lagoon, pier and marina and a variety of restaurants, bars and cafes right at its door. Offering an extensive range of hotel, one and two bedroom apartments, pool, spa and fully equipped exercise room, Mantra Esplanade Cairns attracts both leisure and corporate visitors to the region. Enjoy a truly tropical lifestyle where on your days off you ca explore neighbouring islands, take a trip out to the Great Barrier Reef or enjoy the slower pace of a local market or two.

Purpose

As a Reservations Agent, you play a crucial role in assisting our hotel guests from their initial inquiry to their arrival. Think of yourself as the go-to expert for room availability, rates, and the wonderful experiences our hotel offers. You bring a touch of excitement by suggesting enticing upgrades; all while working seamlessly with our outstanding teams to ensure a smooth and enjoyable guest experience.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Manage reservations made via phone, email, and online platforms, providing guests with accurate information on room availability, rates, and special offers
  • Be the first point of contact for our guests, addressing inquiries, answering questions, and assisting with reservation modifications and cancellations
  • Allocate rooms based on guest preferences, availability and business demands, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay
  • Safely and securely handle payment transactions, verifying billing details for accuracy
  • Suggest room upgrades, offer special amenities, and fulfil specific guest requests to elevate their stay
  • Maintain meticulous reservation records to monitor room availability and ensure smooth check-ins and check-outs
  • Assist in resolving guest complaints or issues related to reservations, billing, or room assignments

Skills And Experience

  • Customer service-oriented with exceptional communication skills
  • Previous experience in a similar role in the hospitality industry is preferred
  • Proficiency in using reservation and property management systems is a plus
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure
  • Team player with a positive attitude and willingness to go the extra mile

Accor Benefits

  • ALL Heartist Membership - Take advantage of discounts on accommodation and food & beverage worldwide!
  • Family & Friends Discounts - Available on a range of accommodation, services and events for those who mean the most to you
  • Accor Live Limitless (ALL) Loyalty Program - Earn status & reward points on your worldwide stays
  • Learn Your Way - Support your career development with access to Accor’s industry leading training platforms, Accor Academy and Typsy
  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide
  • Worldwide Opportunities - We are a world leading hotel operator! With over 400 hotels in the Pacific and more than 5,000 across 110 countries, offering limitless opportunities to grow your career

job.job_description:
Wonil Hotel - Handwritten Collection, situated in the heart of Perth along the banks of the Matilda Bay’s Swan River. Wonil Hotel Perth offers a range of 66 spacious, modern apartment-style hotel rooms and West Kitchen & Bar, an 80-seater restaurant with a Western Australian food and wine focus, along with an outdoor terrace designed to host unique events for up to 100 guests. On your days of leisure, uncover Perth's thriving artistic side, showcased through its dynamic street art and cultural hubs. Delight your senses with visits to local wineries and artisanal food producers, or embark on adventures along the endless sandy shores.

Purpose

As Sales & Events Manager, you will bring your experience from working in events and or sales in a hotel or hospitality environment to nurture and develop current and new business opportunities. Your responsibilities encompass proactive sales efforts, building brand awareness and fostering partnerships whilst promoting the Wonil brand.

About The Role

  • Salary range $80,000 - $85,000 + 10% Bonus Scheme
  • Fantastic opportunity for a seasoned Conference & Events or Sales Coordinator with a strong background in Hospitality and hotels seeking their next career step
  • You will have the chance to shape and develop the role in a supportive environment, making it truly your own!

Primary Responsibilities

  • Forge and nurture positive connections with clients, event planners, and organisers to secure bookings and foster repeat business
  • Explore new business opportunities across all market segments through thorough market research
  • Offer revenue and room night data and conduct regular quarterly reviews with key account contacts
  • Craft customised event proposals and finalize contracts with clients, encompassing terms, pricing, and event specifics
  • Negotiate terms and conditions for RFPs, groups, and events
  • Be the face of Wonil, representing the brand at trade shows and networking events, while also conducting site inspections alongside clients

Skills And Experience

  • Demonstrated prior experience in Conference & Events or Sales Coordination, coupled with a robust proficiency in engaging and negotiating with stakeholders

Company Description

Pullman Phuket Karon Beach Resort is set in 75 acres of beautiful lush tropical gardens. Set near the Big Buddha and along the golden sands of peaceful Karon Beach, with 8 dining outlets for all tastes, 24 hour fitness center, 3 tennis courts and 2 squash courts for our active guests. With 5 outdoor swimming pools one sporting a water slide for kids, this resort is perfect for families or couples. The large pillar less Grand Ballroom, additional meeting rooms and outside space are perfect for hosting events.

Job Description

The Director of Engineering will provide leadership, guidance and direction in achieving the hotel’s vision and mission. Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Engineering will be responsible for implementing Accor engineering and work standards and overseeing the engineering operations.

What you will be doing

  • Oversee the engineering department with attention to details and follow-up to ensure satisfactory completion of tasks and projects
  • Maintain all equipment and systems in correct operational status including but not limited to Accor MEP standards, Fire & Life Safety standards, Risk Management, environmental standards, expenditures and project management
  • Ensure proper completion of the Preventive Maintenance Program for guest rooms, public areas, and safety systems while working closely with the Rooms Division, Food & Beverage Department, Security, purchasing and other operational departments
  • Maintain all mechanical rooms inclusive of Boiler Plant, chilled water circulation, air handling units, fan coils, VAVs, motors, pumps …etc.
  • Prepare and control of the monthly and annual engineering department budget
  • Experience in yearly engineering-budget preparations and monthly forecasting of the department’s expenses
  • Forecast and manage the hotel energy and water usage and all the associated costs
  • Prepare CAPEX expenditures for the engineering department and assist all other departments in preparing their CAPEX needs
  • Identify issues and provide solutions, inclusive of outsourcing and managing 3rd party companies
  • Identify, budget for and manage projects related to renovations and or replacements within the hotel
  • Run landscaping both summer and winter operations
  • Pool operations knowledge inclusive of water treatment
  • Understand water treatment for closed systems and maintains all the related logs for testing of chemicals balance and legionella control.
  • Work closely with the purchasing department to source the best products for the least cost
  • Monitoring the Hotel's Energy consumption on daily and monthly basis
  • Ensuring prompt and/or immediate response to maintenance requests from our guests, employees, and management of the Hotel
  • Recruiting, scheduling, payroll, performance appraisals and reviews, training and development of all engineering colleagues
  • Coordinate and complete all audits related to engineering and risk management
  • Responsible for departmental health and safety, training programs, statutory compliance
  • Manage the hotel emergency response team in coordination with Security and hotel management
  • Coordination and management of outside contractors
  • Ensure hotel compliance with all City and State regulations and ordinances
  • Actively participate in the Hotel's Energy Management, Occupational Health & Safety, and Environmental programs.
  • Lead and support a diverse team in the operations and maintenance of the hotel including: general maintenance, HVAC, kitchen repairs, carpentry, electrical, plumbing and grounds
  • Set up and attend monthly departmental meetings for the engineering employees
  • Manage at hotel level ACCORs Energy/Sustainability Programs and champion the Planet21 committee
  • Be available on an ‘on-call’ basis during off hours for emergency situations
  • Attend to all requests from the General Manager

Qualifications

Your experience and skills include:

  • Bachelors’ degree in the engineering field with a minimum of 5+ years’ experience in a similar position in a hotel
  • Team player and a proven team builder.
  • Professional Engineer Designation an asset
  • Knowledgeable in all municipal codes, City codes, State regulations, OSHA regulations as well as the Fire Department requirements and building testing.
  • Proven negotiation skills with 3rd parties and contractors
  • Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with the ability to be flexible, and to work well under pressure.
  • Must be computer literate and familiar with computerized maintenance systems
  • Must lead by example by displaying a high standard of performance with the ability to communicate these expectations to the team to achieve above expectation results.
  • Hours of work and days off will vary according to business demands.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, upscale, luxury hotel at a downtown location that caters to leisure, meetings & conference environments.

Language Skills

  • Fluent spoken and written English
  • Fluent in Thai Language - Written, Spoken and Reading

At Pullman Phuket Karon Beach Resort, we believe in creating memorable experiences for our guests while fostering a collaborative, innovative, and people-focused culture. If you are passionate about hospitality, leadership, and delivering exceptional dining experiences, we would love to hear from you.

Under the supervision of a Lead Manager, manage all administrative tasks related to the lifecycle of franchise license agreements within an assigned territory. Responsibilities include reviewing and processing applications, preparing and executing agreements, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and maintaining accurate records. Serve as the primary contact for franchise applicants and existing franchisees, coordinating with internal teams throughout the process. Issue and execute license agreements and related legal documents, issue compliance documents, and track franchise data to ensure complete and accurate documentation. Maintain and update information in the company’s global database (GOLS). Represent the company in licensing matters such as negotiating comfort letters, collecting contract data, and managing fees. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with strong organizational and communication skills who wants to contribute to the growth of IHG’s franchise system.

Your day to day

  • Act as liaison with the Development team to issue new development, conversion, change of ownership, and relicensing license agreements to applicants.
  • Conduct all aspects of the franchise license workflow, including collecting license agreements and franchise application fees.
  • Receive and review all documents relating to entities with equity interest in the license; verify licensing data (dates, signatures, forms) and send documents for internal approvals (Credit, Risk Management, Development, Openings, AD&C/PIP, Franchise Approval Committee, Legal). Follow up to ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Enter and maintain franchise license data in GOLS (company database), updating status changes and retention records throughout the license term.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies; collaborate with Legal to meet local, state, and federal requirements.
  • Conduct background checks and due diligence on potential franchisees.

job.job_description:
Description du poste

Responsable Restauration H/F

Le Saint-Gervais Hotel & Spa – Handwritten Collection, aux côtés du Novotel Megève Mont-Blanc, fait partie d’une collection d’hôtels de montagne ouverts toute l’année.

Situé au cœur du village de Saint-Gervais-les-Bains, l’hôtel allie élégance, confort et authenticité et accueille une clientèle aussi bien loisirs que professionnelle.

Acteur clé du tourisme d’affaires en montagne, l’hôtel propose des espaces modulables adaptés aux séminaires et aux événements professionnels, avec des salons équipés, des hébergements de qualité et une offre de restauration sur mesure permettant d’organiser des événements clés en main.

Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où hospitalité, performance et esprit d’initiative sont essentiels. Vous contribuerez activement au développement d’une restauration italienne raffinée et généreuse, mettant à l’honneur l’authenticité, le savoir-faire et les saveurs de l’Italie, dans un cadre d’exception au cœur des Alpes.

L’hôtel en quelques chiffres

  • 75 chambres
  • Bar lounge Le Marie Paradis : 50 places
  • Restaurant L’Avanti : 120 places assises + terrasse

LA MISSION

En tant que Responsable Restauration, rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous supervisez l’ensemble des activités liées à la restauration : restaurant, bar, room service, petit-déjeuner et banquets.

En collaboration avec le Chef de Cuisine, vous êtes garant(e) de la rentabilité du département, en maximisant les revenus et en optimisant les coûts.

Votre rôle est essentiel pour garantir la satisfaction des clients et des équipes, tout en maintenant un niveau de performance opérationnelle élevé. Vous êtes également force de proposition pour faire évoluer l’offre en fonction des tendances du marché, des attentes des clients et des objectifs de l’établissement.

RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

  • Techniques métier & relation client
  • Superviser l’ensemble des services de restauration et garantir leur bon fonctionnement au quotidien.
  • Élaborer les budgets et adapter l’organisation des ressources en fonction des prévisions d’activité et de la stratégie commerciale.
  • Analyser les attentes et les évolutions des besoins clients afin d’ajuster l’offre et d’améliorer continuellement l’expérience client.
  • Garantir la satisfaction des clients et des collaborateurs, tout en veillant à la compétitivité et à la rentabilité du département.
  • Prendre en charge les situations clients complexes et mettre en place des actions correctives et préventives.
  • Participer aux inventaires et veiller au respect des procédures comptables.
  • Incarner et promouvoir l’esprit Heartist dans l’ensemble des interactions avec les clients et les collaborateurs.
  • Management & leadership
  • Créer un climat de travail motivant, bienveillant et fédérateur.
  • Appliquer et faire respecter les politiques, procédures et standards internes.
  • Piloter l’activité en favorisant un environnement de travail propice à l’atteinte des objectifs.
  • Identifier et gérer les problématiques de performance au sein des équipes opérationnelles.
  • Participer aux réunions avec les chefs de service et contribuer activement à leur préparation et à leur bon déroulement afin de garantir une coordination efficace.
  • Participer au recrutement des équipes : entretiens, sélection et intégration des collaborateurs.
  • Former, accompagner, évaluer et faire progresser les responsables et collaborateurs du service, conformément aux standards de l’entreprise.
  • Communiquer efficacement avec l’ensemble des membres de l’équipe et favoriser la circulation de l’information.
  • Inspirer les équipes par l’exemplarité, respecter les codes de l’établissement et être garant(e) de l’image et de l’attitude professionnelle des collaborateurs.
  • Adopter un management collaboratif et responsabilisant, favoriser le développement des compétences et promouvoir la diversité et l’égalité.
  • Veiller au respect des chartes Accor et des obligations légales en vigueur.
  • Favoriser et piloter la mise en avant du département restauration sur les réseaux sociaux, en collaboration avec les équipes concernées.
  • Gestion & performance
  • Piloter l’atteinte des objectifs financiers du département dans le respect des procédures internes.
  • Développer les ventes et identifier les leviers permettant d’optimiser le chiffre d’affaires.
  • Assurer un suivi rigoureux de la facturation et des encaissements, en distinguant les différentes sources de revenus : groupes, individuels, bar et room service.
  • Participer aux inventaires et assurer un suivi régulier des consommations et des coûts.
  • Privilégier l’utilisation des fournisseurs référencés par Accor, dans le respect des procédures du groupe.
  • Analyser les indicateurs de performance et mettre en place les actions nécessaires pour améliorer la rentabilité du département.
  • Hygiène, sécurité & responsabilité sociétale
  • Veiller au respect des normes et réglementations locales en matière d’hygiène, de santé et de sécurité.
  • Garantir la propreté des espaces de travail ainsi que le bon fonctionnement et l’entretien du matériel mis à disposition.
  • Connaître et faire appliquer les consignes relatives à la sécurité et à l’évacuation incendie.
  • Respecter et promouvoir la politique RSE de l’établissement et ses engagements environnementaux.
  • Participer activement à la démarche de labellisation Clef Verte, actuellement en cours de validation.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Expérience

  • Vous justifiez d’une expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans la gestion d’une activité de restauration, idéalement dans l’hôtellerie ou dans un environnement similaire.

Compétences

  • Forte capacité à travailler en équipe et à prendre des initiatives.
  • Excellente maîtrise du pilotage opérationnel, de la budgétisation et des prévisions d’activité.
  • Solides compétences en conception d’offre, marketing et développement des ventes.
  • Sens aigu du service client et excellentes qualités de communication, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Aptitude à encadrer, former et développer les compétences des équipes.
  • Capacité à déléguer, responsabiliser et encourager la prise d’initiative.
  • Excellente organisation et grande rigueur.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et capacité à piloter la performance à partir d’indicateurs clés.
  • Leadership naturel, sens du collectif et goût du terrain.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Rejoindre le Saint-Gervais Hotel & Spa – Handwritten Collection, c’est intégrer une équipe dynamique et passionnée et prendre part à un projet hôtelier de montagne innovant, évolutif et ouvert toute l’année.

Vous évoluerez dans un cadre de travail exceptionnel, au cœur des Alpes, et participerez activement au développement d’une offre de restauration italienne de qualité, au sein d’un groupe hôtelier international.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management et la recherche de performance ? Vous souhaitez contribuer à faire vivre une expérience restauration authentique et mémorable à nos clients ?

Rejoignez-nous et faites partie de l’aventure !

Management license for Condominiums, as applicable.

Preferred:

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Property Operations

  • Works with the Guidance team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
  • Reviews Owner engagement survey and prepares yearly action plan comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

  • Tours building on a regular basis speaking with associates, owners, and Board of Directors to understand business needs and assess operational opportunities.
  • Works with team to put sustainable work processes and systems in place that support the execution of the strategy.
  • Reviews reports and financial statements to determine whether the residential property is performing against the budget.
  • Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.
  • Manages luxury condominium facilities and all departments working within the building, including physical plant with attention to protection of the investment and plans to increase its value through superior care.
  • Serves as a Liaison to Association shared services Directors (e.g., Loss Prevention, Human Resources, Accounting, Housekeeping).
  • Identifies and corrects building and service defects while providing an increase in value.
  • Implements high standards for all aspects of life safety, loss prevention, unit owner identity, and privacy protection.
  • Maintains complete inventory of: Unit owners’ information, parking and storage spaces, monthly Association common dues, Owners’ monthly/quarterly newsletter, hotel features, services, and hotel restaurant food concepts and information.
  • Maintains complete knowledge of and complies with all hotel and residence policies and procedures.

Leading Operations Teams

  • Verify associates are treated fairly and equitably.
  • Celebrates successes and officially recognizes the contributions of team members.
  • Fosters associate commitment to providing excellent service, participating in daily stand-up meetings, and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees.
  • Develops and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.
  • Implements training programs related to property management reinforcing constant quality service.

Managing Relationships with Property Stakeholders

  • Attends owners and Board meetings and provides monthly reports and financial statements to the Board of Directors.

  • Promotes constructive collaboration through education, communication, and innovation.

Managing Profitability

  • Works with direct reports to determine areas of concern and establish ways to improve the departments’ financial performance.
  • Prepares and operates within the constraints of the residences’ annual budget.
  • Identifies key drivers of business success and keeps leadership focused on the critical few to achieve results.
  • Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target resident owner and employees and provides a return on investment.
  • Provides timely reporting of financial performance and projections to the Board.
  • Guides the Board on appropriate property management requirements and governance compliance.

Managing The Owner Experience

  • Creates an atmosphere in all Residential common areas that meets or exceeds owner’s expectations.
  • Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the leadership teams.
  • Verifies core elements of the service strategy are in place to produce the desired results.

  • Interfaces with customers (e.g., owners, vendors, guests), on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels, and overall satisfaction.
  • Handles owner’s complaints by following the instant pacification procedure and verifying guest satisfaction.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

  • Verifies that regular, ongoing communication is happening in Operations (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings).

  • Verifies that property policies are administered fairly and consistently; disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.
  • Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Champions change manages the implementation of brand and regional business initiatives and communicates follow-up actions to the team, as necessary.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Delta Air Lines is seeking a Specialist to assist with accounting and the monthly close process. The successful candidate will:

  • Have a working knowledge of GAAP and how it is applied to accounting processes
  • Understand control processes, work directly with internal and external auditors to provide requested information and support, and be able to assist with and perform annual risk assessments
  • Prepare accounting entries through the use of source information, data models, research in financial systems or other data
  • Perform monthly balance sheet account reconciliations, general ledger research, and variance analysis
  • Review and document controls and accounting processes, while seeking out opportunities to automate, increase efficiency, and streamline existing processes
  • Review and summarize accounting implications of documents including contracts, leases, and other legal documents
  • Apply technical research to understand business processes throughout the organization and implement accounting processes and controls
  • Facilitate internal and external reporting processes including monthly preparation and quality control of financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow), internal reporting packages, and 10Q/10K disclosures

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Licensed CPA
  • Minimum three years relevant experience (e.g., public accounting with a Big 4 or other top tier firm and/or corporate accounting / financial reporting)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate and build working relationships at all levels of the organization
  • Continuous improvement mindset, looks for ways to improve process efficiency and demonstrates flexibility in a changing environment
  • Positive attitude and inquisitive approach to problem solving
  • A proven ability to work in a team environment and should be detail-oriented, self-directing, and have the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with a focus on deadlines
  • Consistently prioritize safety and security of self, others, and personal data
  • Embrace diverse people, thinking, and styles
  • Possess a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Undergraduate degree in accounting or business
  • Advanced degree in accounting or business
  • Experience with Delta’s financial tools such as SAP, FCCS, BlackLine, Oracle, Nakisa, Tableau, Alteryx, Microsoft Suite including Power BI and/or SQL

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.

Benefits

Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, paid personal time, maternity and parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

job.job_description:
What is the job?

マーケティングディレクターは、ホテル全体のマーケティング戦略を策定・実行し、ブランド認知度、需要創出、売上、マーケットシェア、収益性の最大化を推進する責任を担います。

デジタルマーケティング、SNS、広報（PR）、コンテンツ、パートナーシップ、各種キャンペーン、ゲストコミュニケーションなど、幅広いマーケティング施策を統合し、効果的に展開していきます。

本ポジションには、リゾート市場、顧客セグメンテーション、国内外のマーケット、デジタルマーケティング、 ホテルの販売・流通チャネル、および収益につながるマーケティング戦略に関する深い理解が求められます。

Your day to day

  • マーケティング戦略（Marketing Strategy）

年間マーケティングプランを策定・実行する。

客室およびF&B売上の向上につながるマーケティング戦略を策定する。

ターゲットマーケットおよび新規ビジネス機会を特定する。

市場動向および競合他社の活動を分析・モニタリングする。

マーケティングカレンダーを管理する。

  • デジタルマーケティング（Digital Marketing）

ホテル公式ウェブサイトおよびオンラインマーケティング活動を管理する。

デジタル広告キャンペーンの企画・運営を行う。

公式サイトからの直接予約およびウェブサイトのコンバージョン率向上を推進する。

デジタルマーケティングのパフォーマンスおよびROIを分析・管理する。

  • SNS・コンテンツ（Social Media & Content）

ホテルのSNS戦略およびコンテンツカレンダーを策定する。

SNSキャンペーンおよびプロモーションを管理する。

写真・動画撮影の企画・手配・進行を行う。

ホテル、レストラン、施設、アクティビティ、体験などの魅力を発信する効果的なコンテンツを制作する。

  • 広報・PR（Public Relations）

ホテルの認知度・露出を高めるためのPR活動を企画・実行する。

メディアとの良好な関係を構築・維持する。

ポジティブなメディア露出につながる機会を発掘する。

プレスリリース、メディア招請、FAMトリップ、インタビュー等を企画・調整する。

  • キャンペーン・プロモーション（Campaigns & Promotions）

季節ごとのキャンペーンおよびホテルプロモーションを企画・実施する。

SalesおよびRevenue Managementと連携し、キャンペーンの効果を最大化する。

国内外の主要マーケットを対象としたキャンペーンをサポートする。

キャンペーン結果を分析し、改善施策を実施する。

  • ブランドマネジメント（Brand Management）

すべてのマーケティング活動がブランド基準に沿って実施されるよう管理する。

すべての販売・コミュニケーションチャネルにおいて、一貫したホテルブランドの発信を維持する。

ホテル独自の強み（Unique Selling Points）およびリゾートならではの体験価値を明確に発信する。

  • パートナーシップ（Partnerships）

航空会社、旅行会社、観光関連団体、メディア、インフルエンサー、地域企業等とのパートナーシップを構築・強化する。

必要に応じて、インフルエンサーやKOLを活用したプロモーション活動を企画・実施する。

ホテルの認知度・露出向上につながる共同マーケティングの機会を創出する。

  • 予算管理（Budget Management）

年間マーケティング予算を策定・管理する。

マーケティング関連費用を適切に管理・コントロールする。

マーケティング活動のROIおよび効果を測定・分析する。

  • チームマネジメント（Team Leadership）

マーケティングチームをリードし、メンバーの成長を支援するとともに、チーム目標の達成を推進する。

明確な目標およびKPIを設定し、進捗を管理する。

外部マーケティングエージェンシーおよびマーケティングパートナーを管理する。

  • 部門横断的な連携（Cross-Department Collaboration）

Sales、Revenue Management、Reservations、F&B、Operationsなどの各部門と緊密に連携する。

マーケティング活動がホテルの売上・収益および事業目標の達成につながるよう推進する。

ホテル全体のCommercial Strategyおよび事業計画の策定・実行に参画する。

応募資格・経験（Qualifications & Experience）

売上目標を達成・超過した実績があること

高い交渉力、コミュニケーション能力、リーダーシップを有すること

ホテル、旅行、またはサービス業界での経験があれば尚可

戦略的思考力および高い商業的感覚（Commercial Acumen）を有すること

優れた人間関係構築力およびプレゼンテーション能力

データに基づいた意思決定ができること

スピード感があり、競争の激しい環境においても柔軟かつ積極的に業務を遂行できること

ビジネス英語可能な方

What is the job?

The Director of Marketing is responsible for developing and executing the hotel’s overall marketing strategy to maximize brand awareness, demand generation, revenue, market share, and profitability. The Director of Marketing will develop integrated marketing initiatives across digital, social media, public relations, content, partnerships, campaigns, and guest communications. The role requires a strong understanding of the resort market, customer segmentation, domestic and international source markets, digital marketing, hotel distribution, and revenue-driven marketing.

Your day to day

  • Marketing Strategy

Develop and execute the annual marketing plan.

Create marketing strategies to increase room and F&B revenue.

Identify target markets and new business opportunities.

Monitor market trends and competitor activities.

Manage the marketing calendar

  • Digital Marketing

Manage the hotel website and online marketing activities.

Plan and manage digital advertising campaigns.

Improve direct bookings and website conversion.

Monitor digital marketing performance and ROI.

  • Social Media & Content

Develop the hotel’s social media strategy and content calendar.

Manage social media campaigns and promotions.

Coordinate photo and video shoots.

Create engaging content to promote the hotel, restaurants, facilities, and experiences.

  • Public Relations

Develop PR activities to increase hotel exposure.

Maintain relationships with media

Identify opportunities for positive media coverage.

Coordinate press releases, media visits, FAM trips, and interviews.

  • Campaigns & Promotions

Develop seasonal campaigns and hotel promotions.

Work with Sales and Revenue Management to maximize campaign performance.

Support campaigns for key markets such as domestic and international guests.

Measure campaign results and make improvements.

  • Brand Management

Ensure all marketing activities follow brand standards.

Maintain consistent hotel branding across all channels.

Communicate the hotel’s unique selling points and resort experiences.

  • Partnerships

Develop partnerships with airlines, travel agencies, tourism organizations, media, influencers, and local businesses.

Plan influencer and KOL activities when appropriate.

Develop co-marketing opportunities to increase hotel exposure.

  • Budget Management

Manage the annual marketing budget.

Control marketing expenses.

Measure the ROI and effectiveness of marketing activities.

  • Team Leadership

Lead, develop and support the Marketing team in achieving their goals.

Set clear objectives and KPIs.

Manage external agencies and marketing partners.

  • Cross-Department Collaboration

Work closely with Sales, Revenue Management, Reservations, F&B, and Operations.

Ensure marketing activities support hotel revenue and business objectives.

Participate in commercial strategy and business planning.

Qualifications & Experience

Proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets

Strong negotiation, communication, and leadership skills

Experience In Hospitality, Travel, Or Service-driven Industries Preferred

Strategic thinking and commercial acumen

Excellent relationship-building and presentation skills

Data-driven decision making

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, competitive environment

Ability to communicate effectively in Japanese

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Job Summary

Responsible for proactively soliciting business. The position is accountable for handling large group or other customer segments related to opportunities with significant revenue potential. Actively up-sells each business opportunity to maximize revenue for individual properties. Aligns customer profile with the appropriate product. Achieves personal and team related revenue goals. Turns business over properly and in a timely fashion for proper service delivery in accordance with brand standards. Creates opportunities to grow the account base through customer interactions.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Required:

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 5 years’ experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 3 years of experience in sales and marketing or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Understanding Market Opportunities and Driving Revenue

  • Targets accounts, markets, or segments with heavy emphasis on proactive solicitation and account saturation.
  • Partners with counterpart to effectively manage the business opportunity.
  • Responds to and manages larger and more complex incoming opportunities for the property.
  • Identifies, qualifies and solicits new business to achieve personal and property revenue goals.
  • Focuses efforts on accounts with significant potential sales revenue.
  • Develops effective sales plans and actions.
  • Works with partners to develop creative ideas and proposals for events.
  • Maximizes revenue by upselling packages.
  • Understands the overall market - competitors’ strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc. and knows how to sell against them.
  • Closes the best opportunities based on market conditions and individual property needs.
  • Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
  • Handles complex business with significant revenue potential as well as significant customer expectations.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings. Activities include sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
  • Develops relationships within community to strengthen and expand customer base for sales opportunities.

  • Manages and develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.

Additional Responsibilities

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group helps travelers around the world make informed, cost-effective bookings and enables partners to connect their offerings with users through the aggregation of comprehensive travel-related content and resources, and an advanced transaction platform of apps, websites, and 24/7 customer service centers — including four Customer Service Centres in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing service in 19 languages.


With more than 30,000 employees across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, Trip.com Group is one of the best-known travel groups in the world, with the mission "to pursue the perfect trip for a better world."


Location & Workplace Type

  • Location: New York or Orlando
  • Workplace Type: Hybrid


In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Drive acquisition of new attraction, tour, and activity partners across the Americas, while managing and growing an existing portfolio of strategic supplier accounts; identify high-potential partners and unlock incremental revenue
  • Build strong, long-term supplier relationships by understanding partner needs and positioning the right Trip.com solutions to maximize product visibility, conversion, and revenue performance
  • Act as a strategic consultant to partners by educating them on Trip.com's platform capabilities, distribution ecosystem, marketing opportunities, and customer reach
  • Own account performance end-to-end, ensuring competitive pricing, strong product content, healthy availability, and customer-first product offerings
  • Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis across product, pricing, supplier landscape, and consumer trends to identify growth opportunities and market gaps
  • Partner with suppliers to drive campaign participation, promotional coverage, and merchandising opportunities across key sales moments and seasonal initiatives
  • Translate local market insights into actionable recommendations to support product localization, commercial strategy, and platform optimization
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with commercial, operations, product, and marketing teams in a fast-moving, global environment
  • Navigate ambiguity and solve operational or commercial challenges proactively, helping build scalable solutions


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • Fluent English communication skills (written and verbal) required; Mandarin and/or Spanish are strong assets
  • Valid working permit/visa in the US
  • 5+ years of experience in business development, account management, or revenue growth within tourism or e-commerce; OTA/travel marketplace experience a strong plus, with familiarity in attractions, tours, or destination experiences highly valued
  • Existing network with tourism boards, airlines, travel affiliates, attractions, or destination partners is a plus
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and execution-focused, with a strong ownership mentality; able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, overcome obstacles, and innovate under pressure
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment with the ability to create structure from complexity
  • Strong analytical skills, able to turn market and performance data into actionable business insights
  • Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills, with the ability to build clear and compelling pitch decks and business proposals
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM/account management tools
  • Comfortable with regular business travel and cross-time-zone collaboration


Behavioral Requirements:


  • Integrity-driven — you lead with honesty, accountability, and strong professional ethics.
  • Customer-obsessed — you’re passionate about making travel experiences better for everyone.
  • Innovative and growth-minded — you constantly look for smarter ways to grow the business and improve how things are done.
  • A self-starter — you take initiative, move fast, and create momentum without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • Globally minded — you thrive in multicultural, international environments and communicate effectively across teams and markets.
  • A natural relationship builder — you know how to influence, build trust, and develop strong partnerships with industry leaders.
  • Resilient and adaptable — you stay focused and effective in fast-changing, ambiguous, and high-growth environments.


What We Provide

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
  • 401(k) and company match
  • Public Holidays
  • Sick Leave
  • Paid Time Off


Pay Transparency

The annual total pay range for BD Manager roles is $80,000 – $110,000 (base salary and variable incentive, where applicable). The range top could be higher for above-target performance, with potential to increase further based on sustained performance. Final offers vary based on the comprehensive competency assessment completed during screening and interviews, and factors including qualifications, skills, experience, and location. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respects team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What's more?

  • Our rapid global business growth offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and across multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and our global job rotation program enables you to pursue a global career path and make a global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in leadership capability, soft skills, and professional expertise
  • We encourage flexible work arrangements
  • We have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

Expedia Group are looking for an accomplished Content Designer who prioritizes content-first thinking and demonstrates both UX writing precision and effective storytelling. As a member of the Experience Design team, you will collaborate globally across Product Design, Content Design, and Research to create cohesive, traveler-centered experiences. The Content Designer will demonstrate strong UX writing skills, expertise in content strategy, and a human-centered design approach. You will be required to work onsite 3 days in London and to send in a link to a portfolio with your CV.

  • Are you passionate about finding the right content solutions to meet users’ needs using research, data, and empathy?

  • Partner across product and research teams to drive content tests that measurably improve the customer experience; and identify, log, prioritize, and resolve content bugs across the portfolio.
  • Design efficient content solutions that scale for modularity, localization, reuse, and automation.
  • Have strong facilitation and presentation skills to clearly and confidently communicate the rationale for decision-making to team members and Leadership teams.


Essential:


  • Bachelor's degree in a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience in core areas such as UX writing, content audits and analysis, content mapping and modeling, information architecture, content planning and sourcing, conversational design, and storytelling. This is not a content marketing role.
  • A portfolio demonstrating your skills as a design thinker and experienced UX writer, with at least 5 years as a Content Designer or UX writer.
  • Ability to audit, analyze, structure, create, and design content for user-focused product experiences that meet traveler and business needs.
  • Strong ability to confidently present compelling rationales and narratives behind content decisions to peers, partners, and stakeholders such as Legal, Marketing, Security, Product, and senior leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate feedback and strategic direction into product content and to influence consensus-building across systems and brands.
  • Demonstrated curiosity to explore and apply emerging AI technologies, including prompt engineering and structured content, to enhance strategy and operational efficiency.

The Opportunity

At InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef, every day begins with ocean views and the spirit of true hospitality. Live, work, and thrive on one of the iconic 74 Whitsunday Islands, where a rewarding career meets an extraordinary island lifestyle—delivering and inspiring incredible experiences for our guests and colleagues alike.

Lead the experience. Drive the impact. Make Hayman Island your next adventure.

We’re looking for a collaborative and commercially minded Groups & Events Manager to take the reins of our Groups & Events team.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who knows that exceptional events are about more than flawless execution. You are about creating memorable guest experiences, building strong client relationships and delivering commercial results. With a strong background in Meetings & Events, and preferably hotel or resort operations, you’ll bring energy, creativity and a strategic mindset to every interaction.

You’ll lead a dynamic team, partner closely with key stakeholders, and turn client needs and customer insights into experiences that exceed expectations. At the same time, you’ll have your eye firmly on the bigger picture - driving revenue, maximising team performance and identifying opportunities to grow our Groups & Events business.

If you’re a confident people leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves bringing events to life and is motivated by both guest satisfaction and commercial success, this could be your opportunity to make your mark in one of Australia’s most extraordinary island destinations.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Manage the Groups & Events team to achieve revenue goals and provide a seamless experience for guests.
  • Utilize customer insights to enhance products and services, ensuring outstanding customer engagement.
  • Monitor and act on client feedback to enhance the customer experience.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and communicate client requirements effectively.
  • Manage financial aspects, including pricing strategies, profit goals, and budget planning.
  • Collaborate with the sales team.
  • Stay informed about competitor activities and industry trends to influence our strategy.
  • Promote responsible business practices and uphold company policies.

Salary rate $90,000.00 + super

See Yourself in Our Team

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Experience in Meetings & Events, hotel or resorts highly desirable
  • Supervisory experience in sales/catering team management
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher education in hospitality or related field
  • Ability to manage diverse stakeholders
  • Proactive in building strong relations with stakeholders
  • Strategic and tactical thinker
  • Effective at goal setting and project delivery
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong organizational, written, and communication skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects
  • Must be eligible to work in Australia

Live the Island Life

  • Join a vibrant and diverse team, making lifelong friendships, and become part of an unforgettable island community.
  • We make island living convenient and affordable with subsidised staff accommodation and meals. We also offer dedicated staff facilities - pool, beach, gym, bar, diner, laundry, and more.
  • Enjoy swimming, snorkelling, hiking, kayaking, and exploring the Whitsundays after your shift or on your days off.
  • Your commute ends in paradise, with beautiful beaches and breathtaking ocean views just moments away.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for career growth, training, and professional development.
  • Enjoy exclusive employee, friends, and family discount rates across our InterContinental Hotels & Resorts properties worldwide.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we believe great hospitality starts with great people. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. Job Summary

Acts as the on-property liaison for group sales within the pre-defined peak room parameters for Property Sales. Contracts and closes group business in addition to conducting site inspections. Verifies business is turned over properly and in a timely fashion for quality service delivery. Achieves group revenue goals by actively up-selling each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and drives customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred

  • Large group sales experience.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

  • Achieves group revenue goals by responding to incoming group/catering opportunities for the property that are within the pre-defined peak room parameters.
  • Understands the overall market (e.g., competitors’ strengths and weaknesses, economic trends, supply and demand etc.) and knows how to sell against them.
  • Closes the best opportunities for the property based on market conditions and property needs.
  • Uses negotiating skills and creative selling abilities to close on business and negotiate contracts.
  • Achieves group revenue goals by actively up-selling each business opportunity to maximize revenue opportunity.
  • Partners with Area Sales to identify new group/catering business and achieve personal and property revenue goals.
  • Acts as the on-property liaison for group events over the Group Sales peak room parameters of the Sales Office.
  • Develops group sales revenue and operation budgets, and provides forecasting reports.
  • Works with the management team to create and implement a group sales/marketing plan addressing revenue, customers, and market.
  • Assists with selling, implementation, and follow-through of group sales promotions.
  • Attends pre- and post-convention meetings to understand group needs, obtain feedback on quality of product (e.g., rooms, meeting facilities and equipment, food and beverage), service levels, and overall satisfaction.
  • Provides accurate, complete, and effective turnover to Event Management.
  • Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.
  • Conducts site inspections, as required.
  • Monitors same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control hotel occupancy.
  • Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
  • Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g.,., MHR Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, RHR Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning Meeting).
  • Verifies that the property implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of service.
  • Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Verifies successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses, and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Builds and strengthens relationships with existing and new customers to enable future bookings through sales calls, entertainment, FAM trips, trade shows, etc.
  • Develops relationships within the community to strengthen and expand customer base for group/catering sales opportunities.
  • Works collaboratively with off-property sales channels (e.g., Group Sales within the Sales Office, Area Sales, EST) to verify the property needs are being achieved and the sales efforts are complementary, not duplicative.
  • Partners with Event Management and/or Operations in providing a customer experience that exceeds the customer’s expectations.
  • Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and verifying their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
  • Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and drives customer loyalty by delivering service excellence throughout each customer experience.
  • Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
  • Gains understanding of the property’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during, the program/event.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. Marriott International considers for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that’s synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Company Description

Discover Sofitel Sydney Wentworth – Where Heritage Meets Modern Luxury

Following an extraordinary transformation, Sofitel Sydney Wentworth has entered a new era of luxury. As Sydney's first international five-star hotel, we blend heritage, elegance and contemporary sophistication to create exceptional experiences for guests from around the world.

Following an extensive transformation, the hotel features 436 beautifully redesigned rooms and suites, Club Millésime, 14 versatile event spaces including one of Sydney’s largest ballrooms, and award-winning dining across Tilda, Bar Tilda, Delta Rue and Wentworth Bar.

Our Reservations team plays a key role in the guest journey, creating exceptional experiences from the very first interaction and ensuring every stay starts seamlessly.

Job Description

As a Reservations Agent, you’ll be the first point of contact for many of our guests, managing enquiries and reservations with a balance of efficiency, accuracy and genuine care.

You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Managing guest enquiries across phone, email and online channels, providing warm, professional and knowledgeable service.
  • Handling reservations from start to finish, including new bookings, amendments, cancellations, special requests and guest preferences.
  • Maximising revenue by confidently recommending room upgrades, packages, dining experiences and other hotel offerings based on guest needs.
  • Converting enquiries into bookings by understanding availability, rates, promotions and hotel offerings.
  • Maintaining accurate records across reservation and property management systems, ensuring all guest information and requests are captured correctly.
  • Collaborating across the hotel with Front Office, Revenue, Sales, Food & Beverage and other teams to ensure guest requests are communicated and delivered effectively.
  • Representing the Sofitel brand by consistently delivering refined, attentive and personalised service that reflects our luxury positioning.

Qualifications

About You

  • Previous experience in a hotel reservations, front office, guest services or similar hospitality role is highly regarded.
  • A genuine passion for luxury hospitality and delivering personalised, memorable guest experiences.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and confidently engage with guests from diverse backgrounds.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to manage multiple enquiries and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commercially minded with a natural ability to identify upselling opportunities and confidently promote room upgrades, packages and hotel experiences.
  • A positive, team-oriented approach with a willingness to collaborate across departments and consistently uphold Sofitel’s luxury service standards.

Additional Information

Why Join Sofitel Sydney Wentworth?

At Sofitel Sydney Wentworth, you'll be part of an iconic hotel entering a new chapter. We invest in our people, celebrate success and provide opportunities to build a rewarding career within one of the world's leading luxury hospitality brands.

Our Benefits Include

  • Global discounts on accommodation, dining, bars and more across 100+ Accor hotels and partner venues worldwide
  • Generous leave entitlements, including birthday leave and up to 12 weeks parental leave
  • 30% team member dining discount across our signature venues: Tilda, Bar Tilda, Delta Rue and Wentworth Bar
  • Career development opportunities within a globally recognised luxury hospitality brand
  • Ongoing learning and development, working alongside industry leaders
  • Onsite perks including complimentary dry cleaning, $2 barista-made coffee, a $5 staff lunch buffet, and discounted city parking
  • A complimentary hotel stay package to celebrate your work anniversary
  • Free 24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Program for confidential wellbeing support If you’re passionate about hospitality, service excellence, and innovation, we want to hear from you!

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. We offer reasonable adjustments to support you. If you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process, you're welcome to let us know.

Please note that full working rights in Australia are required for this role.

Your day to day

戦略立案・ブランドマネジメント（Strategic Planning & Brand Management）

・売上および稼働率目標を達成するため、年間マーケティングプラン、予算、キャンペーンを策定・実行する。

・リゾートの強み（立地、施設、サービス、体験等）を明確に訴求し、国内・地域・海外市場における効果的なポジショニング を確立する。

・すべてのマーケティングコミュニケーションにおいて、ブランドボイス、ブランドアイデンティティ、ゲスト体験基準との一貫性を確保する。

パートナーシップ・広報（Partnerships & Public Relations）

・DMO（観光地域づくり法人）、インフルエンサー、メディア等との関係を構築・強化する。

・メディア掲載やブランドのファン・支持者の拡大につなげるため、プレスツアー、FAMツアー、リゾートイベント等を企画・実施する。

コンテンツ・クリエイティブディレクション（Content & Creative Direction）

・客室、レストラン、イベント、アクティビティ等の魅力を効果的に訴求するため、写真・動画撮影を企画・実行する。

・パンフレット、販促ツール、デジタルコンテンツ等の制作を行う、または制作会社・関係者をディレクションする。

・キャンペーン、プロモーション、季節ごとの商品・サービスに合わせたコンテンツカレンダーを作成・管理する。

データ・パフォーマンス分析（Data & Performance Analysis）

・定期的にマーケティング活動の実績をレポートし、経営層に対して具体的な改善提案やアクションにつながる分析・インサイトを提供する。

・市場動向、競合他社の戦略、ゲストの行動・ニーズを継続的に分析し、マーケティング施策の改善・最適化につなげる。

Strategic Planning & Brand Management

・Develop and execute annual marketing plans, budgets, and campaigns to achieve revenue and occupancy targets.

・Clearly communicate the resort’s unique strengths, including its location, facilities, services, and experiences, and establish effective positioning across domestic, regional, and international markets.

・Ensure consistency with the brand voice, brand identity, and guest experience standards across all marketing communications.

Partnerships & Public Relations

・Build and strengthen relationships with DMOs (Destination Management Organizations), influencers, media partners, and other stakeholders.

・Plan and execute press trips, familiarization (FAM) tours, and resort events to generate media coverage and expand brand awareness and advocacy.

Content & Creative Direction

・Plan and coordinate photography and video productions to effectively showcase guest rooms, restaurants, events, activities, and other resort offerings.

・Create marketing collateral, promotional materials, and digital content, or manage external agencies and stakeholders responsible for content production.

・Develop and manage content calendars aligned with campaigns, promotions, and seasonal products and services.

Data & Performance Analysis

・Regularly report on marketing performance and provide management with actionable insights, recommendations, and improvement opportunities.

・Continuously analyze market trends, competitor activities, guest behavior, and customer needs, and optimize marketing strategies based on findings.

・Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing initiatives to maximize return on investment (ROI).

What we need from you

応募資格（Qualifications）

・ホテル、旅行、ラグジュアリーブランド等でのマーケティング経験があれば尚可。

・優れたコミュニケーション能力、リーダーシップ、プロジェクトマネジメント能力を有すること。

・クリエイティブな発想力と分析的思考力を兼ね備え、データに基づくインサイトを理解・活用できること。

・マーケティング分析ツールの使用経験・知識を有すること。

・コアコンピテンシー（Core Competencies）

・ゲスト中心の思考（Guest-Centric Mindset）

ゲストのセグメントやニーズを理解し、それぞれに適したメッセージやマーケティング施策を展開できること。

Role Purpose

As Rooms Division Director you’ll lead the front office and housekeeping departments to ensure a memorable guest experience is delivered and departmental revenue and profit goals are met - always following safety and compliance requirements and local policies and procedures.

Key Accountabilities

People

  • Direct everyday activity, plan and assign work work ensuring you always have the right staffing numbers   
  • Develop your team and improve their performance through coaching and feedback, and create performance and development goals for colleagues - recognise good performance 
  • Train colleagues to make sure they hit hotel revenue goals to the standards we expect and have the tools they need to work effectively 
  • Recommend or initiate any HR elated actions where needed  
  • Drive a great working environment for teams to thrive - connect departments to create sense of one team  
  • Interact with outside contacts: guests, vendors, and other contacts as needed 
  • Develop and maintain great working relationships with key clients and outside contacts to increase revenue 

Financial

  • Oversee night audit function and preparation of daily financial reports. 
  • Prepare and submit statistical, performance, and forecast analyses and reports as required. 
  • Maintain procedures for security of monies, credit and financial transactions, guest security, and inventory control
  • Use company systems and processes to maximise revenue. Develop plans to increase occupancy and ADR through walk-ins and upselling at the front desk 
  • Hit all personal/team sales goals and maximise profitability 
  • Help prepare the departmental budget and financial plans including the hotel marketing plan

Guest Experience

  • Provide guests with information (example: loyalty programmes, area attractions, restaurants, facility information) to enhance their experience 
  • Schedule conventions and/or business group activities at the hotel and coordinate with other hotel-level departments to facilitate services agreed upon by the sales office and prospective clients 
  • Communicate to appropriate departments all pertinent information requirements and special needs for arriving VIP’s, large groups and other key guests 
  • Lead marketing efforts to up sell guests on hotel services, offerings, and amenities 
  • Ensure front office staff provides guests with prompt service, professional attention and personal recognition 
  • Ensure guests are greeted upon arrival and make time to interact effectively with guests. Respond appropriately to guest complaints, solicit feedback and build relationships that drive continuous improvements in guest satisfaction.  
  • Conduct routine inspections of the front office and public areas and take immediate actions to correct any deficiencies 
  • Ensure that guest satisfaction data is analysed and that plans are developed and implemented to achieve established goals 
  • Communicate to appropriate departments all pertinent information related to the expected arrival and departure of VIP’s and other key guests, or other special guest needs 

Responsible Business

  • Work closely with key business leaders, officials, and representatives of local community groups within the city to ensure constant high-profile exposure for the hotel
  • Effectively communicate and market aspects of the hotel that are sustainable or “green” and use information to gain new business opportunities
  • Act as a central communications point during emergency/crisis situations; develop and maintain relationships with local fire, police, and emergency personnel.  
  • Develop awareness and reputation of the hotel and brand in the local community and promote team member involvement in community outreach efforts. 
  • Work with advertising agencies, consulting firms, and vendors to maximise advertising investments and ensure ads represent brand identity
  • Raise the awareness and reputation of your hotel and the brand locally – occasionally acting as hotel representative for media related enquiries
  • Identify improvements to marketing activities and overall hotel sales performance and work with other departments 
  • Ad-hoc duties – unexpected moments when we have to pull together to get a task done 
  • Regularly audit all financial transactions to ensure governmental regulations and data privacy requirements are met. 
  • Perform other duties as assigned. May also serve as manager on duty. 

Accountability

This is the top rooms division job in a large, luxury, resort, or major flagship hotel with an extensive range of facilities and services, demanding competitive pressures, and a large number of VIP and key guests. Directly and indirectly supervises a large number of front office and housekeeping employees

Key Skills & Experiences

  • Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Administration, Business Administration 
  • Four years of guest service/hotel experience with two years in a management capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • Must speak local language (s)  
  • Other languages preferred

The salary range for this role is $100K to $125K. This job is also eligible for bonus pay.
