As Training Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and its strategic planning and development and ensure all directives, practices and initiatives are implemented, embraced, adopted within the hotel.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Training Manager for the Six Senses London pre-opening team, I will lead our training and development strategy, manage its implementation and measure its impact. Assume full responsibility for the set-up and efficient operation of the learning function to provide exceptional products and services training within brand operating standards. My key role is to develop and design new training programs and/or evaluate, modify and improve existing programs based on the property’s needs. I will identify training and development needs within the organization through job analysis, performance reviews and regular consultation with other managers.

The duties and responsibilities will include:

  • Ensure strategic alignment of the training department with business goals.
  • Evaluate individual organization performance to ensure training is meeting business needs and improving performance.
  • Develop and deliver training programs that meet business needs and optimize training processes for efficiency.
  • Manage the delivery of training and development programs using knowledge of the effectiveness of methods such as classroom training, demonstrations, on-the-job training, meetings, conferences, and workshops that is easily understandable and in a way that motivates them.
  • Plan, develop and organize training sessions and implement testing and evaluation procedures for in-house courses.
  • Develop and organize training manuals, multimedia visual aids, and other educational materials involved in the strategic planning, resource allocation and coordination of training delivery.
  • Continually amend the training and development programs as necessary, to adapt to the changes that occur in the work environment.
  • Arrange training programs for trainees from local and overseas hotel schools and maintain/update all training records.
  • Provide updated information on relevant external courses for hosts.
  • Work with the Corporate Office to produce training and development programs that are satisfactory to all relevant parties such as line managers, accountants and senior managers.
  • Help schedule events, activities and team gatherings with the collaboration of my team and communicate any activities to hosts.
  • Continually focus on Talent Development for our property.
  • Constantly assess training and development practices to remain relevant and effective.
  • Conduct orientation sessions and arrange on-the-job training for new hires.
  • Instill a cost-focused philosophy through training and education.
  • Operate the property consistent with all legal, statutory and financial requirements and documentation, reporting systems, contractual obligations, security and safety protocols, communications, product and service standards, host management practices and budgetary controls are implemented, reviewed and maintained to ensure the successful operation of the hotel.

Qualifications

To execute the position of Training Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:

  • Possess some college plus 3 years of related training experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management or related field and more than five years’ experience in a similar trainings/operations role, preferred.
  • Proficient in computer use, including experience with Microsoft Office suite and Learning Management Systems. Use of Oracle LMS beneficial but not required.
  • Highly creative with proven experience designing and implementing training programs in accordance with operational and business needs.
  • Pre-opening hospitality experience strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in English and Hebrew.
  • I must have the legal right to work in Israel at the time of application.

Outreach to relevant candidates will commence in September 2026

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for a Training Manager at Six Senses Tel Aviv. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

We are looking for an authentic and passionate Spa Operations Manager to join us at Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel & Spa and embrace your unique, best self to provide our guests with heartfelt human connections!

At Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel & Spa we want to deliver a ridiculously personal service to all our guests. As Glasgow’s only 5 Star Hotel, our team are focussed on providing our guests with the very best experience and making heartfelt human connections.

As the Spa Operations Manager, you’ll be 100% you, bringing your authentic personality to everything you do; be the ultimate host, confidently leading yourself and making creative decisions that elevate every interaction; and spark joy, using every tool available to craft meaningful and memorable experiences.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day operation of the spa, ensuring an exceptional experience for our guests while maintaining high standards across the team and facilities.

You’ll lead and support a team of Receptionists, Spa Attendants and Night Cleaners, overseeing recruitment, training, performance and development. You’ll also manage the spa diary through Trybe, working closely with third-party partners including Spa Breaks, SpaSeekers and itison to maximise bookings and deliver a seamless guest journey.

A key part of the role will be overseeing pool plant operations and pool testing, ensuring all checks, records and compliance requirements are consistently maintained.

This is a hands-on operational role for someone who is organised, commercially aware and passionate about delivering an outstanding spa experience.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years in a management role in a luxury spa
  • Recognised qualifications in pool plant operations and pool testing
  • Strong leadership, organisation, and communication skills
  • Passion for guest satisfaction and high-quality service delivery

Joining the Kimpton family isn’t just about providing our guests with excellent service, we also have secured a spot in Fortune’s ‘100 best companies to work for’ 7 times since 2009, and it is no surprises why! We can offer you…

Financial security – Competitive Salary, guaranteed hours, a free meal on shift, paid holidays, subsidised unsocial hour travel support and enhanced sick pay plus access to Wagestream - a financial wellbeing app giving you the opportunity to save, track and withdraw your pay as you earn it.

Growth and development – Extensive training, opportunities for career progression across the world, plus 2 paid days volunteering per year with a cause of your choice.

Colleague perks - Worldwide discounted room rates and discounted F&B whilst on employee rate (IHG has over 6,000 hotels and growing), plus generous friends and family rate. Discounts through our portal on your supermarket shop, experiences and loads of retailers on our perk’s portal.

Wellbeing – Generous maternity/paternity pay, employee assistance programme available 24/7 and access to mental health first-aiders

Hotel specific benefits – Generous discounts in our F&B outlets, our newly refurbished Spa within Kimpton Blythswood and Champagne Central Bar in our sister property voco Grand Central (*must be booked according to processes) Subsidised city centre parking, plus a variety of different gifts on milestone occasions to celebrate with you!

If you are someone who likes to march to the beat of their own drum and wants to join a company which encourages authentic individuality, apply today!

You must meet the legal requirements to work in the UK.

IHG has been recognised as a ‘Best Employer 2025’ in the UK by Mercer.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Notre hôtel ibis de 120 chambres accueille une clientèle mixte affaires et loisirs, 7j/7. L'établissement dispose d'un restaurant et d'un bar et d'espaces séminaires. Une équipe d'une vingtaine de collaborateurs fait vivre la maison au quotidien.

Description du poste

Rattaché(e) directement au Directeur / à la Directrice de l'hôtel, vous êtes son bras droit sur l'exploitation. Vous pilotez au quotidien l'activité hébergement, réception et restauration, garantissez la qualité de l'expérience client et assurez l'intérim de la direction en son absence.

Vos missions

Exploitation & hébergement

  • Superviser l'activité de la réception : accueil, check-in/check-out, gestion des arrivées et départs, traitement des demandes clients
  • Élaborer et suivre les plannings de la réception, veiller au respect de la législation du travail et à l'optimisation de la masse salariale
  • Coordonner l'interface réception / étages / F&B pour garantir la fluidité des opérations et la disponibilité des chambres
  • Contrôler la propreté et l'état des chambres et des espaces communs en lien avec la gouvernante et le prestataire de nettoyage
  • Veiller à l'application des standards de la marque ibis et des procédures internes (sécurité des personnes et des biens, hygiène, registre de sécurité)

Restauration & bar

  • Superviser l'exploitation du restaurant et du bar : service petit-déjeuner, restauration du soir, room service et prestations séminaires
  • Garantir le respect des standards de la marque, de la carte et des engagements qualité sur l'ensemble de l'offre F&B
  • Veiller à l'application stricte des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP, plan de maîtrise sanitaire, traçabilité, relevés de températures)
  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance F&B : chiffre d'affaires, ticket moyen, taux de capture, ratio matières et coûts de personnel
  • Piloter les achats, les commandes fournisseurs et les inventaires en lien avec le chef de cuisine et le responsable de salle
  • Coordonner l'organisation des séminaires et événements : pauses, déjeuners, cocktails, en lien avec le service commercial
  • Contribuer au développement de l'activité restauration auprès de la clientèle extérieure et locale

Qualité & e-réputation

  • Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction client (RPS / enquêtes qualité) et animer les plans d'action correctifs
  • Traiter les réclamations clients avec réactivité, en direct comme en ligne
  • Rédiger et suivre les réponses aux avis clients sur les plateformes (Booking, Google, TripAdvisor) et piloter les scores e-réputation

Commercial & revenu

  • Contribuer à l'optimisation du taux d'occupation et du RevPAR en lien avec la direction et le revenue management
  • Suivre les canaux de distribution, la parité tarifaire et les disponibilités
  • Assurer le suivi des clients grands comptes locaux et le développement de la clientèle de proximité

Management & gestion

  • Encadrer, former et faire monter en compétences les équipes (recrutement, intégration, entretiens, montée en polyvalence)
  • Animer les briefings quotidiens et fédérer les équipes autour des objectifs de l'hôtel
  • Participer au suivi budgétaire : contrôle des coûts, achats, gestion des stocks, clôtures et reporting
  • Contrôler la facturation, les encaissements et la gestion des débiteurs

Intérim de direction

  • Représenter la direction et assurer la continuité de l'exploitation en son absence

Conditions & avantages

  • CDI temps plein, horaires variables incluant week-ends et jours fériés selon planning
  • Rémunération : 30 000 à 34 000 € brut annuel selon profil et expérience, complétée de primes sur objectifs
  • Carte Heartist® : tarifs collaborateurs sur plus de 5 500 hôtels du groupe Accor dans le monde, ainsi que sur les restaurants et activités partenaires
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise et prévoyance
  • Programme de formation Accor

Qualifications

Formation en hôtellerie-restauration (BTS, licence ou école hôtelière) ou expérience équivalente

  • Expérience confirmée de 2 à 3 ans minimum en réception hôtelière et/ou restauration, dont une première expérience réussie en management d'équipe (chef de réception, responsable hébergement ou adjoint de direction)
  • Une expérience ou une bonne connaissance de l'exploitation F&B (restaurant, bar, séminaires) est un atout apprécié
  • Maîtrise d'un PMS hôtelier (la connaissance d'Opera est un plus) et bonne aisance avec les outils bureautiques
  • Français et anglais courants
  • Sens du service et de l'accueil, leadership de terrain, exemplarité
  • Rigueur, organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les priorités et les imprévus
  • Aisance avec les chiffres et goût pour la performance économique

Informations supplémentaires

Hôtel Franchisé / Groupe familial

As the world’s largest family of luxury hotels, we all take great pride in being genuine ambassadors of the InterContinental® brand.

Shaped by decades of international know-how and local insights, our passion for luxury travel spans cultures and customs. Inspiring us to create warm and sophisticated experiences for those seeking a richer perspective on the world. Each of our hotels cultivates a distinctive style and ambience where we embrace every opportunity to give our guests a personal and enriching experience.

Welcome to the height of luxury, where heritage wonder and contemporary flair collide. Centrally positioned in the heart of Circular Quay, InterContinental Sydney extends breathtaking panoramic views of the Sydney Opera House and Sydney Harbour Bridge.

Set within the beautifully restored Treasury Building of 1851, InterContinental Sydney is renowned as one of the city’s prized icons. With 509 guest rooms including 28 luxury suites, an award-winning and world class Club InterContinental lounge and vibrant dining venues, a complete five-star experience awaits.

Ready to make the move from Rooms Division Manager to Director of Rooms?

Due to an internal promotion, we are inviting applications for the opportunity to join the world’s most international luxury hotel brand as Director of Rooms InterContinental Sydney.

Whether you are an established Director of Rooms looking for your next challenge, or an accomplished Rooms Division Manager ready to step into a broader leadership role, this is an opportunity to lead a significant Rooms operation within one of Australia’s most iconic luxury hotels – and position yourself for the next stage of your hotel leadership career.

Located in the heart of Circular Quay, InterContinental Sydney combines heritage with contemporary luxury, the hotel features 509 guest rooms including 28 luxury suites, a world-class Club InterContinental, distinctive dining experiences and spectacular views across Sydney Harbour.

The Role – Inspire Incredible

Reporting to the Director of Operations, you will lead the overall Rooms Division encompassing Front Office, Concierge, Guest Services, Housekeeping and Club InterContinental.

Leading a division of approximately 90 colleagues, including an experienced team of department leaders, you will set the direction for the Rooms experience, develop your leaders and create an environment where our teams can perform at their best.

This is a hands-on and highly visible operational leadership role. You will be present across the hotel, connected to your teams and our guests, while maintaining a strong focus on the performance and continuous improvement of the Rooms Division.

You will lead through your department heads, building capability and creating a high-performance culture defined by accountability, collaboration, development and exceptional guest experiences. You will bring our “Inspiring Incredible” ambition to life, developing confident leaders and engaged teams who take ownership of the guest experience.

Operational and commercial performance will be central to your role. You will drive Rooms Division results across guest experience, quality standards, labour and productivity, departmental profitability, operational efficiency and revenue optimisation, using data and guest insights to identify opportunities and continually improve performance.

You will work closely with leaders across the hotel to ensure the Rooms experience is seamlessly connected to the broader guest journey, while building strong relationships and collaboration across departments.

A Role With a Future

For the right person, this role represents much more than your next Rooms position.

The Director of Rooms role provides the opportunity to broaden your experience across a large and complex luxury hotel operation, strengthen your commercial, financial, people and operational leadership capability and prepare yourself for broader hotel leadership responsibilities.

We are recruiting this position following an internal promotion which reflects our commitment to developing talent and creating genuine career pathways.

For an ambitious hotel leader, this role is well positioned within our talent pipeline towards future Director Operations and Hotel Manager opportunities within IHG Hotels & Resorts.

We are open to hearing from both established Directors of Rooms and high-performing Rooms Division Managers ready to take the next step.

You will bring:

  • Significant Rooms leadership experience within a luxury, upper-upscale or comparable high-volume hotel environment.
  • Strong operational experience across multiple Rooms disciplines, with demonstrated understanding of both Front Office and Housekeeping operations.
  • Experience leading through department managers, developing leaders and building engaged, high-performing teams.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, with experience managing labour, productivity, budgets, departmental profitability and operational performance.
  • A proven track record of delivering exceptional guest experiences while improving operational effectiveness.
  • A strong understanding of luxury hospitality and the ability to translate brand and service standards into genuine, personalised guest experiences.
  • The ability to balance the needs of the guest, your people and the business within a complex, high-volume operation.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple hotel departments.
  • A visible, hands-on leadership style – you enjoy being in the operation, engaging with guests, supporting your leaders and understanding what is happening across your division.
  • The ambition and potential to continue developing towards broader Director Operations and Hotel Manager
  • You will require full and unrestricted Australian working rights, or appropriate working rights with the ability to meet sponsorship requirements.

What We Offer

  • A significant Rooms leadership opportunity within one of Australia’s most iconic luxury hotels.
  • A genuine development pathway towards future Director Operations, EAM ,Hotel Manager and broader hotel leadership opportunities.
  • The opportunity to lead a complex Rooms Division encompassing 509 rooms and suites and approximately 100 colleagues.
  • The opportunity to work alongside and learn from an experienced senior hotel leadership team.
  • Significant investment in your ongoing leadership and career development.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Exceptional IHG colleague discounts on accommodation, food and beverage around the world.
  • Paid Birthday Leave.
  • Enhanced parental leave.
  • Proactive paid wellness and mental health days.
  • Access to career opportunities across IHG Hotels & Resorts’ global network of 7,000+ hotels.

Lead The Experience. Develop The People. Drive The Performance

If you are an ambitious Rooms leader ready for greater scale, greater responsibility and the opportunity to take an important next step in your hotel leadership career, we would love to hear from you.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Job Summary

Functions as the property’s strategic financial business leader. The position champions, develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 2 years experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

  • Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

  • Develops means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
  • Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.
  • Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.
  • Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
  • Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
  • Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans
  • Creates the annual operating budget for the property.
  • Provides analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers.
  • Implements a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
  • Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.
  • Analyzes financial data and market trends.
  • Leads the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction.
  • Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.
  • Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.

Leading Finance & Accounting Teams

  • Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
  • Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
  • Leverages strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the property's strategies and to lead own team.
  • Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
  • Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers' clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
  • Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

  • Attends meetings and communicating with the owners, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
  • Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).
  • Advises the GM and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/financial issues.
  • Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.
  • Manages communication with owners in an effective manner.
  • Manages property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand SOPs and owner requirements.
  • Facilitates critique meetings to review information with management team.

Developing and Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals

  • Ensures Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
  • Monitors all taxes that apply, ensuring that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
  • Submits reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines.
  • Develops and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
  • Improves profit growth in operating departments.
  • Reviews audit issues to ensure accuracy.

Managing Projects and Policies

  • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Reconciles balance sheet to ensure account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with SOPs.
  • Ensures that the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
  • Ensures compliance with management contract and reporting requirements.
  • Ensures compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).
  • Ensures compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

  • Ensures team members are cross-trained to support successful daily operations.
  • Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
  • Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.
  • Ensures new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
  • Creates appropriate development plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
  • Conduct performance review process for employees.
  • Participates in hiring activities as appropriate.

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. セールス・マネージャー

インターコンチネンタル札幌では、世界基準のホスピタリティと革新的なサービスで、国内外のゲストに記憶に残る体験を提供しています。このたび、旅行代理店・法人顧客・エージェント向けのセールス活動を担うセールス・マネージャーを募集しています。新規開拓と既存顧客との関係強化の両方を担い、ホテルの魅力を最大限に伝える重要なポジションです。ダイナミックなチームの一員として、成長と成果を実感できる環境です。

主な業務内容：

セールス活動と関係構築：

宿泊プラン、イベントパッケージなど、ホテル商品の提案・販売を担当

旅行代理店、法人クライアント、エージェントとの関係構築・維持

新規ビジネス機会の開拓と顧客ポートフォリオの拡大

戦略実行とマーケティング連携：

セールス＆マーケティングディレクターと連携し、セールス戦略の実行

市場動向や競合分析をもとにしたアプローチ方法の策定

セールスパフォーマンスの分析と改善施策の提案

イベント・外部対応：

大規模イベントの提案、計画、実施サポート

見本市やビジネスミーティング、展示会への参加

クライアント訪問やプレゼンテーション実施によるホテルの認知拡大

チーム内外の連携：

社内の関連部署（宿泊・料飲・イベント部門など）との連携強化

ゲスト満足度の最大化に向けたサービス提案と実行

求める経験とスキル：

セールス職としての実務経験（2〜3年以上）

ホテル業界または観光業界での営業経験があれば尚可

日本語・英語ともにビジネスレベルでの会話・読み書き能力

優れたコミュニケーション力と交渉力

自主性を持って業務を推進できる方、チームプレイヤーである方

中国語、韓国語などの多言語スキルがあれば尚歓迎

ホスピタリティ業界のトレンドやサービスに関する知識

勤務条件・待遇：

雇用形態： 正社員（試用期間あり）

勤務時間： 実働8時間（休憩1時間）、シフト制／月10日休暇

休日・休暇： 月10日休暇、有給休暇、誕生日休暇

賞与： 有

昇給： 有

交通費： 全額支給(4万円まで）

福利厚生：

IHGグループホテルでの宿泊および飲食の社員割引

Researches and solicites confirmed citywide convention business that needs headquarter and overflow hotel blocks in the market. Handles opportunity management tasks for citywide events and pull through citywide group business for properties in the market.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing, guest services, front desk, or related professional.

OR

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; no work experience required.

Preferred:

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management.
  • Convention hotel and/or convention visitor bureau experience.
  • Citywide sales and/or association experience.
  • Enterprise Sales Team experience.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

  • Develops annual marketing game plan to confirm that local Marriott brands have a full presence in citywide conventions.
  • Solicits customers who use Marriott brands in alternating convention cities to use local Marriott properties in the market
  • Researches and solicits show affiliate groups to use the housing bureau services in order to maximize housing room block commitment.
  • Secures list of approved affiliates from citywide host and work with catering/event internal partners to market food and beverage (e.g., catering) facilities to citywide affiliates.
  • Handles proposals and site inspections and negotiates services of hotels for each business opportunity.
  • Grows account preference, loyalty and share through the effective use of reviews and critiques from previous conventions.
  • Promotes properties via marketing channels to citywide exhibitors and affiliates.
  • Handles opportunity management tasks for citywide events and pull through citywide group business for properties in the market.
  • Communicates, through turnover, all contractual terms and needs of the customer once a contract is signed to verify that convention contract terms are met.
  • Works with event and housing coordinators at each property to verify that planning and room block management is always current.
  • Develops relationships with housing on-property contacts once the event is turned over to each property.
  • Maintains calendar for each property of citywide participation.
  • Maximizes use of convention calendar to deliver timely, accurate information of citywide demand (e.g., current and future) to stakeholders.
  • Understands the needs of each property and their revenue strategy. Partners with the Director of Group Strategy and/or Room Inventory Manager to strategically price hotels in the market to win market share and grow revpar year over year.

  • Achieves revenue and sales goals at each property as defined by Market leadership.
  • Develops and achieves operating budgets and manages controllable expenses.
  • Contributes to the team goal at each property.
  • Drives short term and future business at each property.
  • Drives revenue via multi year contract plan, where appropriate.
  • Uses financial contributions from each property for marketing programs and tools.
  • Leverages methodologies, technical and business knowledge across the market.
  • Anticipates and identifies business opportunities and challenges and responds with a profitable strategy that aligns with overall business direction.
  • Increases local penetration to optimize demand across all brands and satisfy important property needs.
  • Leverages all available sales channels, (e.g., marriott.com, group and transient intermediaries, field sales, worldwide reservation offices, etc) in an effort to optimize sales revenues.
  • Focuses on promoting local properties via marketing channels to citywide exhibitors and affiliates and work with the Director of Group Strategy and/or Rooms Inventory Manager to strategically price properties in the local market to win market share and grow RevPar.
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

job.job_description:
The Role


As a Customer Service Advisor, you’ll be the voice of Trip.com - helping travelers with everything from hotel bookings to flight queries while delivering exceptional service across phone, chat, and email.


﻿Why You’ll Love Working Here


  • 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays)
  • 3 extra days for parents/guardians, plus long service leave after 10+ years
  • $600 USD in Trip Coins annually to spend on your next adventure
  • Monthly bonuses & $450 USD refer-a-friend scheme
  • Health cash back plan for dental, optical, physiotherapy, massages & more
  • Employee Assistance Program, wellbeing support & enhanced sick pay
  • Enhanced family policies (maternity, paternity & adoption)
  • Life insurance worth 4x your annual salary
  • Hybrid working options (based on performance)
  • Free on-site gym or discounted memberships at Nuffield Health & PureGym
  • Continuous learning & genuine career development opportunities
  • Birthday & service anniversary celebrations with gift cards and cake
  • Regular team events, social activities, and recognition programmes.
  • Fun team days with seasonal and cultural celebrations, work anniversaries, games, prizes, awards, free lunches and sweet treats!


Core Info - READ BEFORE YOU APPLY


Location: 1 Lochrin Square, Edinburgh. This is NOT a remote role so you should be within commutable distance

Salary: £26,800 + Monthly performance bonus

Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours a week.

Hybrid: Our hybrid model is 3 days in office, 2 days from home after training

Training: First 20 weeks paid training. Mon - Fri / 8am - 4:30pm

Language: This role requires spoken and written fluency in English and Arabic

RTW: You will need the right to work in the UK without sponsorship (now or in the future) as we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.


About Us


Since 2014, Trip.com 's Customer Support Centre has expanded to include 15 global customer support centres worldwide. By collaborating across all our global sites, we are able to provide customer support in more than 20 languages and across 13 product lines, catering to the diverse needs of travellers around the world.


With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, and Customer Service Centres in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, we provide 24/7 support in 19 languages. Our mission is simple: to make every journey the best it can be, at the best possible price.


What You’ll Do


  • Deliver outstanding customer service with empathy and professionalism via phone, chat, and email, across Arabic and English lines.
  • Take ownership of customer concerns, resolving travel-related issues end-to-end.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently across multiple channels.
  • Collaborate within a supportive team to achieve KPIs and service targets.
  • Share ideas to improve customer experience and internal processes.
  • Represent and represent the Trip.com culture in every interaction.


What You’ll Bring


  • Previous customer service experience, ideally in a contact centre environment.
  • Fluent in English and Arabic (written and verbal).
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with resilience under pressure.
  • Ability to handle multiple web chats with fast, accurate typing.
  • Confident working towards and achieving KPIs / Targets.
  • Motivated, adaptable, with eagerness to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable navigating systems and CRM tools to resolve queries efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Travel & Tourism industry experience – desirable but not essential


Culture


At Trip.com, our culture is all about people, we're a truly global and multicultural workforce with team members from over 30 countries. We strive to foster a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and inspired to grow. We enable you to unleash your full potential and make impact. With a real commitment to internal progression and promotion, your Trip.com journey could take you anywhere, many of our senior leaders started with us in this very role!


Find out more job opportunities at: https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

Descripción de la empresa

Upscale, 5 star hotel in Barcelona, Port Olimpic, being in the city centre, but only a few metres from the beach

A Sofitel Hotel in Barcelona! With an unbeatable location overlooking the sea and close to the beach, it is ideal for business and leisure travelers.

It has comfortable rooms, two pools and a gym. For meetings, it has fully equipped rooms that can hold up to 800 people.

Our service and commitment is focused on satisfying the needs of all our guests so that they can make the most of their stay in Barcelona. Barcelona, the city of Gaudí, is one of the most modern cities in the country, and not surprisingly, major technological congresses such as Mobile World are held in this city. Not everything is future, culture and history are essential to understand its people. The Sofitel hotel is located opposite Barceloneta, its most famous beach. A few minutes walk away is the Gothic Quarter, one of the main tourist attractions of Barcelona. It is well connected to the airport and the train station.

Descripción del empleo

  • Gestionar y procesar con precisión todas las solicitudes de reserva recibidas a través de los distintos canales de distribución, garantizando su atención dentro del mismo día hábil y conforme a los procedimientos y estándares de la marca.
  • Mantener un enfoque comercial orientado a maximizar la ocupación y los ingresos del hotel, asesorando a los huéspedes sobre la opción de alojamiento y los servicios que mejor se adapten a sus necesidades.

  • Verificar el cumplimiento de las políticas de tarifas, cancelaciones, modificaciones y depósitos aplicables a cada reserva.
  • Coordinar con los diferentes departamentos del hotel las solicitudes especiales de los huéspedes, garantizando una adecuada preparación para su llegada y una estancia memorable.

  • Mantener actualizado el inventario de habitaciones y asegurar el adecuado control de la disponibilidad en el sistema de gestión hotelera.
  • Resolver de manera ágil y profesional las incidencias relacionadas con reservas, escalando los casos que lo requieran al Supervisor de Reservas.
  • Gestionar grupos reservados de manera individual por los participantes, asegurando el cumplimiento de las condiciones pactadas y la correcta coordinación con las áreas involucradas.

Requisitos

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, con una marcada orientación comercial y capacidad para identificar oportunidades de venta.
  • Dominio del español, inglés y francés tanto hablado como escrito; el conocimiento de otro idioma será considerado un valor añadido.
  • Capacidad para establecer, mantener y fortalecer relaciones profesionales con clientes internos y externos, ofreciendo un servicio de excelencia.
  • Habilidad para trabajar de forma colaborativa y eficaz como parte de un equipo multidisciplinario.
  • Sólidas habilidades interpersonales, de negociación y resolución de problemas, con capacidad para tomar decisiones oportunas.
  • Alto nivel de organización, planificación y seguimiento de tareas, con atención al detalle.
  • Capacidad para gestionar eficientemente un alto volumen de llamadas, correos electrónicos, solicitudes y reservas, manteniendo la calidad y precisión en el servicio.
  • Marcada orientación al cliente, demostrando empatía, cortesía y profesionalismo, incluso en situaciones de alta demanda o presión.
  • Manejo del sistema de gestión hotelera Opera PMS.
  • Dominio de herramientas de Microsoft Office, especialmente Word, Excel y Outlook, a nivel intermedio o avanzado.

Información adicional

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Beneficios exclusivos en hoteles del grupo Accor en todo el mundo, para que disfrutes de experiencias únicas dentro de nuestra red internacional.
  • Retribución flexible con opciones como restaurante, transporte y mutua privada.
  • Parking para bicicletas y patinetes, con punto de carga.
  • Un entorno de trabajo dinámico, multicultural y motivador, rodeado de profesionales apasionados por la hospitalidad de lujo.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional, tanto dentro de la propiedad como en otros hoteles de la marca en cualquier parte del mundo.
  • Formación continua a través de nuestra plataforma Learn Your Way, diseñada para impulsar tu talento y tu crecimiento profesional.

Sustainability, Wellness, and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and ensure full knowledge and active participation of all our brand initiatives.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Spa Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation in the following:

  • Keeping abreast of industry trends and practices and updating knowledge and skills to improve the product and service offering.
  • Continually focus on the rejuvenation of the spa experience.
  • Spa treatments, exercise classes, and wellness facilities and equipment will be constantly assessed to remain relevant and in keeping with Six Senses wellness and sustainability practices.

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.

We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.



In this Role, you’ll get to


  • Leverage company protocols and appropriate tools to assist the local business team, delivering frontline business support to our global accommodation partners.
  • Stay abreast of corporate strategy shifts and continuously update business knowledge.
  • Address partner needs related to Trip.com system operations via phone, email, or online chat, directly engaging with customers when necessary.
  • Advocate for Trip.com's hotel management system to partner hotels.
  • Collaborate with other departments to enhance overall satisfaction among partners.
  • Undertake ad-hoc tasks as assigned by management.
  • Manage business inquiries from Trip.com's global accommodation partners, showcasing strong logical reasoning, business English proficiency, exceptional service orientation, and teamwork capabilities.
  • Utilize Excel and other office software to organize data, and swiftly adapt to new tools and systems.
  • Support internal quality assurance efforts and streamline team processes.


What you'll Need to Succeed


  • Bachelor's or higher, with proficiency in Thai & English for daily communication.
  • Strong service orientation, professional dedication, learning agility, positive attitude, and resilience under pressure.
  • Excellent teamwork skills and adaptability to shift work.
  • Prior experience in starred hotels, airline ticketing, or call centers is preferred.
  • English resume submission is highly encouraged.



Why Trip.com Group


We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?


  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions

This role supports partnership and marketing initiatives tied to the launch and ongoing management of a luxury credit card product, while also supporting design and activation of Luxury Group experiential efforts. The position is responsible for the end-to-end planning and execution of a portfolio of high-impact events, including bespoke cardmember experiences and brand-led activations that drive awareness, engagement, acquisition, and retention.

During the assignment, the Senior Manager will manage integrated marketing efforts —including campaign strategy, content development, partnership integration, and digital and social amplification, ensuring each activation delivers against both brand and business objectives. A strong emphasis is placed on creating innovative, experience-led storytelling that reflects the elevated positioning of The Luxury Group portfolio of brands.

This role requires close collaboration across internal stakeholders, including loyalty, partnerships, portfolio marketing, digital and social, and continent teams, as well as agency partners, bank partners and external collaborators. The individual will also partner closely with hotels and on-property teams to deliver locally relevant experiences with global brand consistency. This role will take direction and leadership from the Director of Luxury, Partnerships and Events and the Vice President of Global Cards.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience Required

  • 4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years’ experience in hospitality, luxury industry, partnerships, business development or brand marketing demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance
  • Proven track record of managing and scaling complex brand marketing or partnership programs
  • Demonstrated project leadership and management skills, including a demonstrated ability to lead multi-functional project teams to deliver concrete actions and results
  • Ability to successfully communicate complex ideas across the organization clearly in written and oral communication
  • Experience with luxury brands

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Luxury Project Management

  • Lead luxury experiential activations for The Ritz-Carlton, Luxury Group, and strategic partners, delivering high-impact, brand-aligned experiences that elevate storytelling and guest engagement.
  • Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies for a luxury credit card that support acquisition, engagement, retention, and brand prestige.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of approximately 10 credit card events, from concept through execution, including guest experience design, partner integration, and onsite management.
  • Support cross-channel campaign development, content, and storytelling across digital, social, partnerships, and experiential touchpoints, ensuring alignment with brand standards and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, hotels, and external partners to deliver cohesive marketing programs, support Luxury Group priorities, and provide guidance on credit card-related activations.
  • Manage budgets, timelines, and performance tracking to ensure programs are delivered efficiently and achieve defined KPIs.

Event Execution

  • Lead the ideation, planning, and execution of luxury credit card event activations, ensuring alignment with brand positioning, cardmember strategy, and an elevated guest experience.
  • Design and deliver event environments and guest journeys, including layouts, branding, furniture, décor, AV, and overall experience flow.
  • Manage end-to-end event logistics and onsite operations, coordinating with production partners, vendors, presenters, talent, and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.
  • Develop presentations, documentation, timelines, budgets, risk plans, and status updates to keep stakeholders aligned and accountable.
  • Measure event performance through KPIs, guest feedback, and business impact, while applying luxury event trends and learnings to continuously evolve activations.

Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams

  • Partner with Credit Card leads to develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that elevate key programs and drive acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Collaborate with The Ritz-Carlton Brand team to shape and support annual planning and ensure alignment on high-impact initiatives and storytelling
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Retail, Global Cards, and Portfolio Marketing to deliver cohesive campaigns, Marriott Moments packages, and cardmember communications

Managing Work, Projects, and Policies

  • Manage assigned projects and workstreams, ensuring deliverables, presentations, reports, and status updates are completed accurately and on time.
  • Create and deliver presentations, including credit card materials and brand immersion content for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Analyze data, evaluate results, and apply insights to solve problems and inform project decisions.
  • Merchandise projects work by sharing progress, updates, and results with field, continent, and cross-functional teams.
  • Support budget tracking for credit card marketing and events while accurately documenting project progress for key stakeholders.

調達マネージャー

InterContinental Sapporoでは、ホテル全体の調達・購買業務を担う調達マネージャーを募集しています。食材や備品の調達を通じて、ホテルのあらゆる部門と連携し、最高のゲスト体験を支えるやりがいのあるポジションです。

ホテルでの購買・調達経験をお持ちの方はもちろん、営業、仕入れ、サプライヤー管理、在庫管理などの経験を活かして新しいキャリアに挑戦したい方も歓迎します。調達業務の経験がなくても、「人と関わることが好き」「交渉や調整が得意」「食やホテル業界に興味がある」という方であれば、成長をしっかりサポートします。

これまでの経験を活かしながら、新しいラグジュアリーホテルで一緒にキャリアを築いていきませんか？

職務内容

  • ホテル全体の調達・購買業務を担当し、円滑なホテル運営を支える
  • 各部門と連携し、食材・飲料・備品・消耗品などを適切なタイミングで調達する
  • 発注、納品、検品、在庫管理を行い、必要な商品を安定して供給する
  • サプライヤーとの信頼関係を構築し、新たな調達先の開拓を行う
  • 価格・品質・納期を比較・交渉し、最適な購買を実現する
  • 北海道産の食材や商品の活用を推進し、ホテルならではの価値創出に貢献する
  • 購買予算・コスト・在庫を管理し、効率的で持続可能な運営をサポートする
  • 請求書や発注内容を確認し、正確な購買・会計管理を行う
  • 品質基準を維持しながら、業務改善やコスト最適化を推進する
  • シェフや各部門、サプライヤーと連携し、ホテル全体のオペレーションを支える

応募資格

  • ホテル・飲食業界または関連業界での購買・調達経験をお持ちの方歓迎
  • 営業、法人営業、仕入れ、サプライチェーン、在庫管理、店舗運営などの経験をお持ちの方も歓迎
  • 食材・飲料・ホテル備品に関する知識をお持ちの方歓迎
  • 優れた交渉力・コミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方
  • 数字を扱うことが得意で、コスト管理や在庫管理に興味のある方
  • チームワークを大切にし、多くの部署と協力しながら仕事を進められる方
  • 基本的なPCスキル（Excel、Word、Outlookなど）
  • 荷物の搬入・検品などの業務に対応できる方
  • 英語でコミュニケーションができる方は歓迎します

私たちが提供するもの

私たちは、あなたが成功するために必要なすべてを提供します。競争力のある給与、専門的・個人的なウェルビーイングを支える充実した福利厚生、制服貸与、IHGホテル宿泊割引、そして世界水準の研修制度をご用意しています。

InterContinental Sapporoでは、一人ひとりが自分らしく活躍できるインクルーシブな職場づくりを大切にしています。人種、肌の色、宗教、性別、性的指向、性自認、国籍、退役軍人の地位、障がいの有無に関わらず、すべての応募者・従業員に平等な機会を提供しています。

myWellbeingフレームワークを通じて、健康・ライフスタイル・職場環境のあらゆる面から従業員のウェルビーイング向上に取り組んでいます。

Procurement Manager

Do you enjoy building strong relationships, negotiating great value, and keeping operations running smoothly? Are you passionate about food, hospitality, and finding the right products at the right time?

We're looking for a Procurement Manager to join the team at InterContinental Sapporo. In this role, you'll work closely with departments across the hotel, ensuring our teams have the products, ingredients, and supplies they need to create exceptional guest experiences.

Whether you already have procurement experience in hospitality or have developed strong purchasing, supplier management, sales, or commercial skills in another industry, we'd love to hear from you. If you're eager to learn, enjoy working with people, and have a keen eye for quality and value, we'll provide the support and development you need to grow your career with us.

Bring your passion, curiosity, and ideas—and help shape one of Hokkaido's premier luxury hotels.

Job Description

  • Lead the hotel's procurement and purchasing activities to support smooth day-to-day operations
  • Partner with departments across the hotel to source food, beverages, equipment, and operating supplies
  • Manage purchasing, receiving, inspections, and inventory to ensure products are available when needed
  • Build strong relationships with suppliers while identifying new sourcing opportunities
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts, and delivery terms to achieve the best balance of quality, value, and service
  • Support local sourcing initiatives and help showcase the finest products and ingredients from Hokkaido
  • Monitor purchasing budgets, inventory, and costs to drive operational efficiency
  • Review purchase orders and invoices to ensure accurate purchasing and financial records

  • Candidates with strong commercial, supplier management, negotiation, or inventory management experience from other industries are also encouraged to apply

Description de l'entreprise

Au PULLMAN CANNES MANDELIEU, vous vivez la Côte d’Azur en grand : un panorama unique sur la mer, les pieds dans l’eau et du soleil pour vous ressourcer, des équipes attentives et chaleureuses pour vous accueillir et vous faire partager l’expérience Pullman.

Description du poste

Missions Générales

  • Respecter l'intimité du client lors de la réalisation de son travail
  • Tenir compte des habitudes des clients en séjour régulier et/ou de longue durée et respecte la prestation VIP.
  • Gérer les réclamations clients lorsque celles-ci n'ont pas été prises en charge par ses collaborateurs.
  • Etre garant, en permanence, de l'hygiène, de la qualité du nettoyage, du respect de la prestation de service (produits d'accueil...) et de la sécurité des locaux.
  • Veiller à ce que les chambres et les parties communes soient constamment propres et agréables.
  • Etre responsable des "pass" de l'étage et de leur bonne utilisation.
  • Superviser la maintenance des chambres avec le service Technique.
  • Veiller à la qualité de service des prestataires externes (location de linge, nettoyage...).

  • Veiller à l'implication et à la motivation de son équipe en tenant compte des attentes de chacun.

  • Veiller au bon comportement et à la tenue irréprochable du personnel placé sous sa responsabilité.

  • Gérer l'ensemble des dépenses relatives aux produits d'entretien et d'accueil.
  • Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts d'énergie.
  • Optimiser l'organisation de son service en veillant à l’adéquation entre les effectifs et la charge de travail.
  • Veiller à la mise à jour des tableaux de bord (état des chambres, stocks linge, produits d'accueil...), les analyser et mettre en place les plans d'actions.
  • S'assurer du respect des règles d'hygiène, de propreté et de sécurité des biens des clients.
  • Appliquer et faire appliquer les règles de sécurité de l'hôtel.
  • Veiller au respect les engagements de la "Charte Environnement" pris sur l'établissement.

Qualifications

  • Encadrer une équipe de femmes de chambre
  • Horaires matin, journée, soir

Informations supplémentaires

  • Parking public gratuit
  • Horaires de journée
  • Cafétéria
  • Uniforme fourni et entretenu sur place

job.job_description:
As Assistant Director of Finance, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others, and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness, and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and their strategic planning and development and ensure all directives, practices, and initiatives are implemented, embraced, and adopted within the hotel.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Assistant Director of Finance, I will assume responsibility for the efficient operation of the Finance department within Six Senses financial operating standards. I will work strategically with the Director of Finance to develop cohesive and productive goals for my department and establish procedures and guidelines to achieve them.

The duties and responsibilities will include:

  • Maintain effective management of the property’s credit practices.
  • Provide a flow of financial information and reporting to all divisions and departments to the Director of Finance or General Manager.
  • Work on the preparation of the annual budget and capital expenditure plan.
  • Monitor actual financial performance to budget.
  • Oversee financial transactions, including approval of purchase requisitions and orders, payments, petty cash, payroll, audit and other financial requests.
  • Work with the IHG Global Service Centre to ensure all processes are being followed and being done correctly on a timely basis.
  • Ensure internal controls are in place to provide compliance with financial, legislation and taxation requirements.
  • Liaise with external parties including payroll bureau, taxation consultants and external auditors; communicate and liaise with owners as required.
  • A high standard of personal appearance, grooming and hygiene, plus comprehensive knowledge of safety, security and emergency procedures will be maintained by myself and all hosts in line with brand and statutory requirements.
  • Ensure that interaction and communications between departments within the property are clear and effectively maintained to support the smooth running of the property.
  • Minimize payroll costs by maximizing productivity and efficient scheduling of hosts.
  • Prepare and submit legally required and confidential documentation related to the operation.
  • Complete accurately all corporate reporting requirements for the role.
  • Attend or conduct the designated meetings and briefings as instructed by my manager.
  • Perform any additional duties given to me by my manager.

Qualifications

To execute the position of Assistant Director of Finance, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:

  • Possess a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or equivalent and 5 years in hotel accounting, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  • Technical skills include advanced Microsoft Office - Word, Excel, Powerpoint, and Outlook.
  • Familiarity with hotel systems including POS, PMS, and CRM platforms strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in English and Hebrew.
  • I must have the legal right to work in Israel at the time of application.

Outreach to relevant candidates will commence in September 2026

The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities of an Assistant Director of Finance at Six Senses Tel Aviv. It is not and does not infer that the above is an inclusive and/or exhaustive list of the duties and responsibilities inherent in the position.

Six Senses Tel Aviv is an equal opportunity employer. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

job.job_description:
BreakFree Grand Pacific Resort is located on the picture perfect beachfront of Caloundra, with a range of one, two and three bedroom apartments and resort style pool it is a busy favourite for travellers seeking a leisurely break. There is plenty to keep you occupied during your down time. Visit one of the many shops, café’s or restaurants overlooking Pumicestone Passage or soak up the sun and surf across a range of the Sunshine Coasts finest beaches.

Purpose

As a Guest Service Agent, you will play a pivotal role as the friendly face and warm welcome that sets the tone for our guests' entire stay. Your responsibilities span from the moment they check in to the time they check out, ensuring that you are at the forefront of delivering exceptional hospitality and creating memorable experiences for our valued guests.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Roll out the red carpet of hospitality, ensuring every guest feels like a VIP from check-in to check-out
  • Confidant in communicating with guests and colleagues to ensure cohesive collaboration
  • Conquer challenges alongside guests, transforming dilemmas into success stories
  • Promote hotel amenities and services by having a deep understanding of products and offerings
  • Be the local legend, sharing information on neighbourhood hotspots and must-visit gems from your treasure trove of knowledge
  • Display proficiency in accurately handling reservations and managing guest accounts

Skills And Experience

  • Previous experience in hotel front desk operations is a valuable asset
  • Innovative approach to exceeding customer service expectations
  • Skilled at collaborating within teams, as well as working independently
  • Proven ability to multi task and thrive under pressure, supported by strong organisational and time management skills
  • Proficiency in both written and verbal communication
  • Available to work a variety of shifts including nights, overnights, weekends, and public holidays as required

Accor Benefits

  • ALL Heartist Membership - Take advantage of discounts on accommodation and food & beverage worldwide!
  • Family & Friends Discounts - Available on a range of accommodation, services and events for those who mean the most to you
  • Accor Live Limitless (ALL) Loyalty Program - Earn status & reward points on your worldwide stays
  • Learn Your Way - Support your career development with access to Accor’s industry leading training platforms, Accor Academy and Typsy
  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide
  • Worldwide Opportunities - We are a world leading hotel operator! With over 400 hotels in the Pacific and more than 5,000 across 110 countries, offering limitless opportunities to grow your career

At Accor, we welcome you as you are. We help you grow and learn, so that work brings purpose to your life. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Accor is an inclusive company, building diverse teams across the globe.

Everyone has a story and we want to learn yours. We invite you to APPLY NOW.

job.job_description:
Job Overview

At Holiday Inn Singapore Little India, you will be responsible for directing the activities of the Front Office, Reservations, Housekeeping, and Security & Risk departments to ensure the achievement of established quality and guest service standards, as well as departmental revenue and profit goals. You will adhere to governmental regulations concerning hotel emergency procedures, safety, and other compliance requirements, as well as brand standards and local policies and procedures. You will deliver a guest experience that is unique and brings the brand to life.

We want our guests to relax and be themselves which means we need team members to:

  • Be you – by being natural, professional and personable in the way you are with people
  • Get ready – by taking notice and using your knowledge so that you are prepared for anything
  • Show you care – by being thoughtful in the way you welcome and connect with guests
  • Take action– by showing initiative, taking ownership and going the extra mile

Duties And Responsibilities

FINANCIAL RETURNS:

  • Participate in the preparation of the annual departmental operating budget and financial plans. Monitor budget and control labor costs and expenses with a focus on rate strategy, building initiatives and inventory management.
  • Oversee night audit function and preparation of daily financial reports.
  • Prepare and submit statistical, performance, and forecast analyses and reports as required.
  • Maintain procedures for security of monies, credit and financial transactions, guest security, and inventory control.
  • Use company systems and processes to maximize revenue. Develop plans to increase occupancy and ADR through walk-ins and upselling at the front desk.
  • Champion ROI projects and Capex planning

PEOPLE:

  • Direct day-to-day staffing requirements, plan and assign work, and establish performance and development goals for team members. Provide mentoring, coaching and regular feedback to help manage conflict and improve team member performance.
  • Educate and train team members in compliance with brand standards, service behaviors, and governmental regulations. Ensure staff has the tools, training, and equipment to carry out job duties.
  • Promote teamwork and quality service through daily communication and coordination with other departments.
  • Recommend and/or initiate salary, disciplinary, or other staffing/human resources-related actions in accordance with hotel or company rules and policies.

GUEST EXPERIENCE:

  • Ensure all colleagues provides guests with prompt service, professional attention and personal recognition.
  • Ensure guests are greeted upon arrival and make time to interact effectively with guests. Respond appropriately to guest complaints, solicit feedback and build relationships that drive continuous improvements in guest satisfaction.
  • Conduct routine inspections of the public areas and rooms and take immediate actions to correct any deficiencies.
  • Ensure that guest satisfaction data is analyzed and that plans are developed and implemented to achieve established goals.
  • Communicate to appropriate departments all pertinent information related to the expected arrival and departure of VIP’s and other key guests, or other special guest needs.
  • Ensure cleanliness and condition standards and ways of clean methods are adhered to. Driving the culture of clean amongst the Rooms Division

RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS:

  • Regularly audit all financial transactions to ensure governmental regulations and data privacy requirements are met.
  • Act as a central communications point during emergency/crisis situations; develop and maintain relationships with local fire, police, and emergency personnel.
  • Ensure full compliance to Risk and Safety components – IHG and local law
  • Develop awareness and reputation of the hotel and brand in the local community and promote team member involvement in community outreach efforts.
  • Demonstrate Awareness of OH&S policies and procedures and ensure all procedures are conducted safely and within OH&S guidelines
  • Be aware of duty of care and adhere to occupational, health and safety legislation, policies and procedures
  • Be familiar with property safety, first aid and fire and emergency procedures and operate equipment safely and sensibly
  • Initiate action to correct a hazardous situation and notify supervisors of potential dangers
  • Log security incidents and accidents in accordance with hotel requirements
  • Perform other duties as assigned. May also serve as manager on duty.

ACCOUNTABILITY

This is the top room division job in a full-service hotel with an extensive range of facilities and services, demanding competitive pressures, and a large number of VIP and key guests. Directly and indirectly supervises a large number of front office, reservation, security/risk and housekeeping employees.

Qualifications And Requirements

Bachelor’s degree/higher education qualification/equivalent in Hotel Administration, Business Administration, or a related field, with a minimum of four years’ guest service/hotel experience, including at least three years of experience as a Front Office Manager (FOM), preferably with experience as a Rooms Division Manager (RDM). International hotel and Singapore hotel experience is preferred. Must speak the local language(s); additional languages are preferred.

Role Purpose

Support Global Intellectual Property activities primarily in the areas of enforcement of IHG's IP and defense of IHG against third party claims of infringement.

Key Accountabilities

  • Manage and lead Global IP Enforcement for company, including maintaining watch notices and evidence bank; developing, implementing and managing company's global brand protection and enforcement strategies, including domain/cyber enforcement, ensuring collaboration and communication for enforcement matters with key internal legal and business stakeholders. Assist the company domain name manager with domain name registration strategy for company trademarks in the top gTLDs and ccTLDs.
  • Manage preliminary global trademark search and clearance process for new trademarks; conduct online trademark searches and review, investigate and analyse results to provide clearance opinion to business under supervision of global IP counsel. Review and approval regional hotel names involving intellectual property implications in consultation with global IP counsel as necessary.
  • Serve as lead manager for Anaqua database to facilitate Global IP team training and utilization of Anaqua; facilitate tracking and reporting of company global brand protection and enforcement activities using Anaqua.
  • Manage company US copyright filings and maintain remaining company patent portfolio; manage company copyright compliance process working in conjunction with global IP counsel; maintain company Proper Use of IP guidelines for third parties.
  • Managing first line of communications and investigations in defensive actions for company when company is accused of trademark or copyright infringement by third parties.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Paralegal certificate required

Experience

  • 10+ years' experience as in-house trademark paralegal.
  • Experience with trademark management software such as Anaqua
  • Excellent judgment and excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills
  • High degree of interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Self-motivated; ability to work independently with minimal supervision

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !

Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Accor a une ambition forte : celle de réinventer l’expérience du voyage en mettant l’accent sur la personnalisation et une identité de marque forte. Y parvenir, est l'obsession de la Direction Digitale : une équipe dédiée à définir et mettre en œuvre le futur de l'Expérience des Produits Accor.

Rattaché au VP Product Design, votre rôle sera de définir et piloter la stratégie du Design System, et manager l’équipe de Design System Managers.

Votre Mission

job.job_description:
Company Description

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group's global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Job Description

This is where your greatest challenge awaits:

Join Astore, Accor's global procurement organization (GPO), designed to deliver value to hotels and partners through competitive sourcing, expert category management, digital purchasing solutions and a strong supplier ecosystem. Astore supports both Accor-branded and non-Accor customers in optimizing purchasing performance, enhancing operational efficiency and improving customer satisfaction.

Astore operates in a commercial environment where procurement adoption is not mandatory for the Accor hotel network, and where growth also depends on the ability to attract and develop third-party customers. The role therefore requires a strong ability to promote Astore's solutions, demonstrate their tangible value and build long-term customer trust — combining a farmer mindset to grow and retain the existing portfolio with a hunter mindset to identify, recruit and convert new business opportunities.

Your Mission

The Executive Director, Business Development Europe (excluding France), is responsible for driving the sustainable growth of Astore's business across the zone, maximizing customer satisfaction and delivering the regional P&L objectives.

Leading a multicultural team of 10 Business Developers across Europe, the role combines strategic leadership, commercial development and stakeholder influence to strengthen Astore's value proposition and accelerate customer adoption and recruitment across the region.

Acting as a key ambassador of Astore internally and externally, you ensure alignment between customers' expectations, business priorities and cross-functional initiatives.

Your Playground

  • Lead and develop a multicultural team of 10 Business Development experts across Europe
  • Drive business growth across 10 mature European markets (UK, Germany, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Switzerland, Portugal, Spain, Italy and Luxembourg) and emerging European growth zones (the Balkans, the Mediterranean, CEI, Central Europe, the Nordics and the Baltics), where the sourcing offer and customer approach still need to be developed
  • Manage a portfolio exceeding 2,000 hotels, including a significant base of non-Accor customers
  • Oversee ~€900M+ in annual purchasing volume, accounting for ~40% of the ENA (Europe and Northern Africa) region's total spend

Your Main Missions Are Structured Around 3 Pillars

  • Team Leadership & People Development
  • Define and communicate a clear vision, strategy and objectives for the Business Development zone
  • Coach, mentor and develop team members to maximize engagement, performance and career growth
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer centricity and continuous improvement
  • Drive excellence through effective performance management and regular business reviews
  • Promote the adoption of digital tools, CRM discipline and data-driven decision-making
  • Business Performance & Growth Management
  • Define and execute the regional business development strategy in alignment with Astore's ENA growth ambitions
  • Drive revenue, spend, capture rate and profitability growth across the customer portfolio
  • Acquire and develop new customers, including hospitality businesses operating outside Accor brands
  • Monitor business performance through KPIs, dashboards and market analysis
  • Identify growth opportunities, market trends and customer needs to continuously improve Astore's value proposition
  • Leadership, Influence & Strategic Stakeholder Management
  • Build strong relationships with hotel owners, investors, operators and key decision-makers
  • Influence senior internal stakeholders across Operations, Development, Finance, Marketing, Digital, Design & Technical Services and Procurement teams
  • Represent Astore at executive-level meetings, customer events and industry forums
  • Lead complex negotiations and strategic commercial discussions with key accounts

Qualifications

And you?

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Hospitality Management or a related field
  • Minimum 10 years of leadership experience in hospitality, procurement, sales, business development or related industries
  • Proven experience leading multicultural and geographically dispersed teams
  • Strong P&L management and commercial acumen
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities
  • Fluent in English; German is considered a plus

Additional Information

Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, At Accor

  • Remote work possible several days per week from France and flexible working options: work from home, our offices, or even our hotels and coworking spaces thanks to Worklib.

And also,

  • ALL - Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a "company bike" program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, up to 75%.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor, at no additional cost in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Not to mention attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, particularly those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, without distinction of gender, so dare to apply!

For us, recruitment is above all a story of encounters.

Does this role appeal to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • An initial discussion with our recruitment team to present the key elements of the role or guide you toward a position that may better suit you,
  • One or more interviews with managers and team members,
  • For certain roles, you may also be asked to complete a test or case study, as well as a questionnaire about your personality and motivations.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group culture, working environment, training program, and career prospects, as well as the different Group benefits.
  • Personalized feedback.
