Introduction to the Team


In B2B, we bring Expedia Group's innovative technology and distribution solutions to partners across the world. These businesses include global financial institutions, corporate managed travel, offline travel agents, global travel suppliers (like major airlines) and many more.


We are looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering to lead a team of talented engineers delivering scalable, reliable B2B technology solutions. In this role, you will own multiple technical domains, partner closely with product management, and build software that powers our partners' businesses on a global scale.


In this role, you will:

  • Lead and develop a team of 6–10 engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, and continuous growth.
  • Define team goals and connect them to broader business outcomes, aligning efforts across multiple teams working together.
  • Partner with product management to influence and deliver the product roadmap, balancing feature development, system maintenance, and team wellbeing.
  • Anticipate and resolve bottlenecks in cross-team workflows, coordinating process improvements and defining clear measures of success.
  • Advocate for software design best practices, operational excellence, and resiliency — including unit testing, SLA establishment, and scalability.
  • Research and recommend frameworks, cloud services, and architectural design patterns in line with Expedia Group's technology standards.
  • Bridge communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring proposals and technical issues receive appropriate consideration and timely resolution.
  • Evaluate team talent, identify skill gaps, and implement action plans to support goal achievement and professional development.
  • Develop capacity plans and resource strategies for teams of 10+, maintaining optimal full-time employee to contingent worker ratios.
  • Mentor both individual contributors and managers, sharing domain expertise and industry knowledge across cross-functional teams.


Experience and Qualifications


Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 8+ years of software engineering experience; or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 6+ years of software engineering experience; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 3+ years of people management experience, including performance managing individual contributors and recruiting engineering talent.
  • Proficiency across multiple programming languages and technologies, with a focus on JVM languages, and the ability to justify technology choices to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing distributed or geographically dispersed teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver solutions to complex business problems spanning multiple teams.
  • Proficient communication skills, with experience collaborating across senior-level, cross-functional organizations.
  • Experience in B2B technology environments, such as API platforms, partner integrations, or distribution solutions.



The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €70,000.00 to €98,000 Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €112,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Cluster Finance & Business Support Manager

Holiday Inn Perth City Centre & Holiday Inn West Perth

Travel is a journey. Let's make it a joy.

At Holiday Inn, we are all about creating welcoming, comfortable experiences for our guests, whether they're travelling for business, leisure, or somewhere in between. With smiles and service that make every stay special, we have been sharing the joy of travel since 1952.

We are now seeking an experienced and commercially focused Cluster Finance & Business Support Manager to provide financial leadership across two hotels in Perth: Holiday Inn Perth City Centre and Holiday Inn West Perth which are owned by Worldwide Hotels Group.

About The Role

This is an exciting leadership opportunity for an experienced finance professional to oversee the financial operations, reporting, compliance and commercial performance of two operating hotels.

As Cluster Finance & Business Support Manager, you will provide strategic financial leadership to both properties, ensuring strong financial controls, accurate reporting and informed business decision-making. You will work closely with the General Manager and hotel leadership team to identify opportunities for growth, maximise profitability and support long-term business success.

This role combines hands-on financial management with strategic business partnering, making it ideal for someone who enjoys influencing operational performance while maintaining exceptional financial governance.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the finance function across both hotel properties.
  • Provide strategic financial guidance and commercial support to both General Manager and Executive Leadership Team.
  • Prepare and manage annual budgets, forecasts, cash flow projections and long-term business plans.
  • Analyse financial performance and provide recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
  • Present monthly financial results, forecasts and key business insights to ownership representatives and senior stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with IHG financial policies, internal control procedures and statutory obligations.
  • Oversee month-end reporting, balance sheet reconciliations and financial reporting requirements.
  • Partner with department leaders to manage expenses, labour costs and departmental performance.
  • Manage payroll oversight, workforce optimisation reporting and financial risk management.
  • Lead relationships with the Business Support Centre (BSC), auditors, banking partners and external stakeholders.
  • Monitor cash flow, accounts payable and working capital to support business performance.
  • Support capital expenditure planning, investment analysis and asset management initiatives.
  • Champion compliance, governance and financial best practices across both hotels.
  • Lead, develop and support the finance team to achieve both individual and business objectives.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in a Manager of Finance, Assistant Director of Finance, Financial Controller or similar leadership role.
  • Hotel industry experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and reporting experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence decision-making through commercial insights and business partnering.
  • Experience managing financial controls, compliance and governance frameworks.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, mentor and develop teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and strong problem-solving capabilities.
  • Degree qualifications in Accounting, Commerce or Finance.
  • CPA, CA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • Advanced financial systems and Excel capabilities.

Why Join Us?

At Holiday Inn Perth City Centre and Holiday Inn West Perth, we offer much more than just a job. We provide a supportive environment that values wellbeing, collaboration and career growth.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package plus annual incentive opportunity.
  • Complimentary CBD car parking.
  • Flexible working arrangements where operationally appropriate.
  • Paid birthday leave.
  • Enhanced parental leave benefits.
  • Proactive Health Days.
  • Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities within IHG.
  • Complimentary duty meals.
  • Hotel accommodation discounts worldwide.
  • Food and beverage discounts.
  • Access to employee retail discount programs.
  • Paid annual leave and personal leave entitlements.

Ready to Start Your Journey With Us?

Join us and become part of the global IHG family. We work better together, support each other, do the right thing and welcome different perspectives.

If you are a commercially minded finance leader who enjoys driving business performance, building strong stakeholder relationships and supporting multiple properties, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help shape the future success of two outstanding Perth hotels.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Knowledge-

Skills

Attitude & Culture Fit

¿Quiénes somos?


En Hyatt creemos en el poder de pertenecer y en crear una cultura basada en el cuidado, donde nuestros colaboradores se convierten en una gran familia. Nuestro crecimiento continuo, junto con la incorporación de nuevos hoteles, marcas y líneas de negocio, abre la puerta a interesantes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional para nuestros colaboradores.


A medida que seguimos creciendo, nunca perdemos de vista lo más importante: las personas. Transformamos viajes en experiencias, encuentros en momentos memorables y empleos en verdaderas carreras profesionales.


En nuestro Hotel 4* AluaSoul Mallorca Resort, buscamos incorporar un/a Guest Experience.


Tu rol


Como Guest Experience, serás responsable de ofrecer una atención personalizada a los huéspedes, coordinando sus necesidades con los distintos departamentos del hotel, resolviendo incidencias con agilidad y empatía, informando sobre situaciones relevantes y promoviendo los servicios del establecimiento para garantizar una experiencia excelente y fomentar la fidelización de nuestros clientes.


¿Cuáles serán tus principales responsabilidades?


  • Hacer de nexo entre los huéspedes y los distintos departamentos del hotel para coordinar peticiones especiales.
  • Escuchar y resolver cualquier incidencia, asegurándote de que se gestione con rapidez y empatía.
  • Informar al resto del equipo sobre huéspedes VIP o situaciones relevantes que requieran atención especial.
  • Promover nuestros servicios y productos extra, siempre desde una actitud cercana y profesional.
  • Transmitir una imagen positiva y acogedora, generando vínculos de confianza y fidelidad con nuestros clientes.


¿Qué esperamos de ti?


* Imprescindible nivel alto de Inglés y alemán.

* Pasión por el trato y satisfacción de clientes.

* Alto nivel de compromiso e implicación.

* Persona organizada, exigente y resolutiva.

* Experiencia de 1 a 2 años, en un cargo similar en Hoteles 4*.

* Incorporación inmediata.


¿Qué ofrecemos?


  • Contrato Fijo Discontinuo.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Rejoignez Accor – une aventure professionnelle au cœur d'un groupe engagé, international et en transformation

Accor, leader mondial de l'hospitalité, présent dans plus de 110 pays avec 5 500 hôtels, vous ouvre ses portes, situées à Issy-les-Moulineaux.

C'est ici que convergent les expertises globales du Groupe : stratégie, finance, ressources humaines, juridique, technologies, marketing, développement durable, communication, audit, achats, etc.

Rejoindre Accor, c'est participer activement à la définition, à la structuration et à l'accompagnement de la transformation d'un groupe international, en lien direct avec les équipes opérationnelles dans le monde entier.

Description du poste

C'est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Rejoignez Astore, l'organisation d'achats globale (GPO) du Groupe Accor. Sa mission : générer de la valeur pour les hôtels et partenaires grâce à un sourcing compétitif, une gestion experte des catégories, des solutions d'achat digitales et un écosystème fournisseurs solide. Astore accompagne aussi bien les clients de marque Accor que des clients tiers dans l'optimisation de leur performance achats, l'amélioration de leur efficacité opérationnelle et de leur satisfaction client.

Astore évolue dans un environnement commercial où l'adoption du procurement n'est pas obligatoire pour le réseau hôtelier Accor, et où la croissance repose aussi sur la capacité à attirer et développer des clients tiers. Le poste demande donc une vraie capacité à promouvoir les solutions Astore, à en démontrer la valeur concrète et à construire une relation de confiance durable — en combinant un esprit "farmer" pour développer et fidéliser le portefeuille existant, et un esprit "hunter" pour identifier, recruter et convertir de nouvelles opportunités business.

Votre Mission

En tant que Directeur Executif, vous portez la croissance durable de l'activité d'Astore sur la zone, la satisfaction client et l'atteinte des objectifs de P&L régionaux.

Vous encadrez une équipe multiculturelle de 10 Business Developers à travers l'Europe. Le poste combine leadership stratégique, développement commercial et influence stakeholders pour renforcer la proposition de valeur d'Astore et accélérer l'adoption et le recrutement clients sur la région.

Véritable ambassadeur/ambassadrice d'Astore en interne comme en externe, vous assurez l'alignement entre les attentes clients, les priorités business et les initiatives transverses.

Votre Terrain De Jeu

  • Piloter et développer une équipe multiculturelle de 10 experts Business Development à travers l'Europe
  • Driver la croissance business sur 10 marchés matures (UK, Allemagne, Pologne, Pays-Bas, Belgique, Suisse, Portugal, Espagne, Italie, Luxembourg) et sur des zones de croissance émergentes (Balkans, Méditerranée, CEI, Europe Centrale, pays nordiques et baltes) où l'offre de sourcing et l'approche client restent à développer
  • Gérer un portefeuille de plus de 2 000 hôtels, incluant une base significative de clients non-Accor
  • Superviser plus de 900 M€ de volume d'achats annuel, soit environ 40% du spend total de la région ENA (Europe and Northern Africa).

Vos Missions Principales S'articulent Autour De 3 Piliers

  • Leadership & développement des talents
  • Définir et incarner une vision claire, une stratégie et des objectifs pour la zone Business Development
  • Coacher, mentorer et développer les membres de l'équipe pour maximiser engagement, performance et évolution de carrière
  • Cultiver une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, d'orientation client et d'amélioration continue
  • Piloter l'excellence via un management de la performance rigoureux et des business reviews régulières
  • Promouvoir l'adoption des outils digitaux, la discipline CRM et la prise de décision data-driven
  • Performance business & croissance
  • Définir et exécuter la stratégie commerciale régionale, en cohérence avec les ambitions de croissance ENA d'Astore
  • Driver la croissance du chiffre d'affaires, du spend, du capture rate et de la profitabilité sur le portefeuille client
  • Acquérir et développer de nouveaux clients, y compris des acteurs de l'hôtellerie hors marques Accor
  • Piloter la performance business via KPIs, dashboards et analyses de marché
  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance et les tendances marché pour enrichir en continu la proposition de valeur d'Astore
  • Leadership d'influence & gestion des stakeholders stratégiques
  • Construire des relations fortes avec les propriétaires d'hôtels, investisseurs, opérateurs et décideurs clés
  • Influencer les stakeholders internes seniors (Opérations, Développement, Finance, Marketing, Digital, Design & Technical Services, Procurement)
  • Représenter Astore lors de meetings exécutifs, événements clients et forums sectoriels
  • Porter des négociations complexes et des discussions commerciales stratégiques avec les comptes clés

Qualifications

Et vous ?

  • Diplômé d'un Bachelor ou d'un Master en Business, Hospitality Management ou domaine connexe
  • Minimum 10 ans d'expérience en leadership dans l'hôtellerie, le procurement, la vente, le business development ou secteurs connexes
  • Expérience confirmée dans le pilotage d'équipes multiculturelles et géographiquement dispersées
  • Solide gestion de P&L et sens commercial aiguisé
  • Capacité démontrée à influencer des stakeholders seniors et à driver le changement organisationnel
  • Excellentes compétences en communication, négociation et relationnel
  • Fort esprit d'analyse et de réflexion stratégique
  • Anglais courant requis ; l'allemand est un plus

Informations supplémentaires

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s'engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l'ensemble de nos projets.
  • Sur votre carrière
  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Un Talent Management dédié, une amélioration continue et des parcours de formation et d'évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.
  • Concrètement, chez Accor :
  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d'une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l'utilisation d'un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride.
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, à hauteur de 75%.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  • Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l'équipe,
  • Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu'un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  • Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l'environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

Cluster Sales & Marketing Manager

Holiday Inn Perth City Centre & Holiday Inn West Perth

Travel is a journey. Let's make it a joy.

At Holiday Inn, we are all about creating welcoming, comfortable experiences for our guests, whether they're travelling for business, leisure, or somewhere in between. With smiles and service that make every stay special, we have been sharing the joy of travel since 1952.

We are now seeking an experienced and commercially driven Cluster Sales & Marketing Manager to lead the sales and marketing strategy across two hotels in Perth: Holiday Inn Perth City Centre and Holiday Inn West Perth which are owned by Worldwide Hotels Group.

About The Role

This is an exciting leadership opportunity for a dynamic hospitality professional to drive revenue growth, increase market share and elevate brand presence across two hotel properties.

As Cluster Sales & Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for developing and executing innovative sales and marketing strategies that maximise occupancy, increase revenue and strengthen customer relationships. Working closely with the General Manager and hotel leadership team, you will identify new business opportunities, build strong partnerships and ensure both hotels remain competitive in the Perth market.

The successful candidate will bring a blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen and relationship-building skills, with a passion for delivering results and driving business success.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and implement sales and marketing strategies to achieve revenue, occupancy and market share targets across both hotels.
  • Identify and secure new corporate, government, leisure, group and event business opportunities.
  • Manage and grow existing client relationships to maximise account production and guest loyalty.
  • Conduct regular sales calls, client meetings and site inspections to promote both hotels.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity and performance data to identify growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Revenue Manager, Cluster General Manager, and Hotel Manager to support pricing strategies and business planning.
  • Develop and execute marketing campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and revenue generation.
  • Manage digital marketing initiatives, online presence, social media activity and promotional campaigns.
  • Represent both hotels at industry events, networking opportunities and community engagements.
  • Prepare sales forecasts, performance reports and business development plans.
  • Maintain strong relationships with IHG sales teams and key industry partners.
  • Ensure all sales and marketing activities align with IHG brand standards and business objectives.
  • Lead, coach and support team members while fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Contribute to budget planning and ensure effective management of sales and marketing expenditure.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in a Sales Manager, Business Development Manager, Director of Sales, Marketing Manager or similar hospitality leadership role.
  • Strong understanding of hotel sales, distribution channels and marketing strategies.
  • Demonstrated success in achieving revenue targets and growing market share.
  • Experience developing and managing strategic client relationships.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to interpret business performance data.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Experience with digital marketing, social media and brand activation initiatives.
  • A proactive and results-oriented approach with a passion for hospitality.
  • Experience within a branded hotel environment is highly desirable.
  • Full Australian working rights.

Why Join Us?

At Holiday Inn Perth City Centre and Holiday Inn West Perth, we offer much more than just a job. We provide a supportive environment that values wellbeing, collaboration and career growth.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package plus annual incentive opportunity.
  • Complimentary CBD car parking.
  • Mobile phone allowance
  • Paid birthday leave.
  • Enhanced parental leave benefits.
  • Proactive Health Days.
  • Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities within IHG.
  • Complimentary duty meals.
  • Hotel accommodation discounts worldwide.
  • Food and beverage discounts.
  • Access to employee retail discount programs.
  • Paid annual leave and personal leave entitlements.

Ready to Start Your Journey With Us?

Join us and become part of the global IHG family. We work better together, support each other, do the right thing and welcome different perspectives.

If you are a commercially focused sales and marketing professional who enjoys building relationships, developing innovative strategies and driving business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help drive the continued success of two outstanding Perth hotels.

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

The FP&A team plays a critical role in monitoring and driving the financial performance of the region.


As an FP&A Senior Analyst, you will lead the budgeting and forecasting cycles, deliver accurate monthly financial reporting, and provide insightful analysis to support strategic decision-making.


You will proactively monitor business performance, identify opportunities and risks, and partner with key stakeholders to drive corrective actions that ensure financial objectives are achieved and business performance is optimized.


Location: Paris or London


Main Accountabilities:


1. Budget & Forecast:

  • Lead the Budget and Forecast cycles for assigned Commercial functions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and strong alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Challenge business assumptions identifying cost saving opportunities.

2. Financial Reporting:

  • Produce monthly financial reporting packs, including variance analysis and key performance indicators.
  • Monitor actual performance vs. budget/forecast, highlighting key drivers, risks, and opportunities.

3. Business Partnering:

  • Act as a trusted finance advisor to the Commercial leadership team, ensuring strong financial discipline and accountability.
  • Support budget owners in understanding their financial performance and guide them on corrective actions when needed.
  • Support decision making with clear data-driven analysis and drive cost-efficiency initiatives.

The InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef will immerse you in the wonders of the Whitsundays, working in a five-star luxury environment which offers amazing career growth opportunities, professional training & development and provides a one-of-a-kind experience living and working in a tropical island paradise. We pride ourselves on a diverse and family friendly environment, and welcome applicants with primary school aged children as our island offers a State Primary School.

About The Role

Hayman Hair Salon is seeking a talented, passionate and experienced Hairdresser to join our Spa, Salon & Wellness team. This is a unique opportunity to work in a luxury island resort where no two days are the same. From creating beautiful bridal hairstyles and event looks to delivering exceptional colour, cutting and styling services, you will play an important role in our guests' experience.

As the salon operates with a single hairdresser, you must be confident working independently while remaining connected to and supported by the wider Spa & Wellness team. You'll be responsible for managing your own appointments, maintaining the salon, and delivering a consistently high standard of service.

The salon operates within the Spa & Wellness department, this is a dual Hairdresser and Reception role, requiring the successful candidate to also provide professional reception support as operationally required, including welcoming guests, managing appointments and enquiries, processing retail sales and guest transactions, assisting with guest arrivals and treatment check-ins, supporting day-to-day Spa & Wellness operations, and working collaboratively across both the salon and reception while confidently managing the salon independently to meet business needs.

Base rate $36.42 + penalties + loading

Essential Criteria

What we need from you

  • Qualified Hairdresser with relevant Australian-recognised qualifications
  • Minimum 5 years' industry experience preferred
  • Demonstrated experience with bridal hair, weddings and special event styling
  • Excellent cutting, colouring and styling skills
  • Ability to work confidently and independently in a sole hairdresser role
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Exceptional customer service and communication skills
  • Professional presentation and positive attitude
  • Ability to work within a broader team while independently managing the salon
  • Current Australian working rights

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience working with Kevin Murphy products
  • Makeup artistry qualifications or professional makeup experience highly regarded
  • Experience in luxury hotels, resorts or premium salons
  • Retail sales experience
  • Experience educating guests on professional home hair care

What We Offer

  • World class Staff Facilities including excellent accommodation, a dedicated staff pool, staff beach, two gyms, bar, diner, laundry, boutique shop and more.
  • An exciting and ever-changing Staff Event Calendar filled with an abundance of recreational activities such as tennis, yoga, meditation, Pilates, group bushwalks, cooking classes, BBQ’s, markets and much more.
  • Extensive career development opportunities with dedicated onsite trainers and an abundance of professional development including multi-hire programs, skills training and online IHG courses.
  • A great range of employee, friends, and family discount rates across more than 5,300 InterContinental Hotel & Resorts properties.

How To Apply

Please visit our Careers Page for all details regarding living and working on Hayman Island at: https://haymanisland.intercontinental.com/careers/ or click the ‘Apply Now’ button.

Applications close on 30 September 2026. We will be reviewing and conducting interviews throughout the advertising period. The application may close earlier if the position is filled.

Company Description

An oasis immersed in well-being and nature, Raffles Sentosa Singapore is the first all-villa property in Singapore. Located on a clifftop, the new resort on Sentosa Island features 62 contemporary private pool villas surrounded by tropical gardens and views over the South China Sea.

Ranging from 230 square metres in size, each villa is a sanctuary for extended stays. As part of Raffles’ legendary welcome, guests will experience signature markers enlivened by the famous Raffles Butlers and a sustainably created Sentosa Sling.There will be five dining establishments, a spa offering next-generation wellness and a grand ballroom.

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The Cluster Director of Commercial and Marketing is responsible for leading and driving the overall commercial strategy for Raffles Sentosa Singapore and Sofitel Singapore Sentosa. The role oversees Sales, Events, Weddings, Marketing and other commercial functions to maximise revenue, market share, profitability and brand positioning.

Working closely with the Cluster General Manager and key stakeholders, the Cluster Director of Commercial and Marketing will develop and execute integrated commercial strategies, identify new business opportunities, strengthen key partnerships and ensure the effective alignment of sales and marketing initiatives across both hotels.

The successful candidate will be a strategic and commercially driven leader with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality, revenue generation, brand positioning and market dynamics.

What You Will Be Doing

Commercial Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement the overall commercial and marketing strategy for Raffles Sentosa Singapore and Sofitel Singapore Sentosa Resort & Spa to achieve revenue, profitability and market share objectives.
  • Work closely with the Cluster General Manager to establish annual commercial priorities, sales and marketing plans, budgets and action plans.
  • Identify strategic, organisational and tactical initiatives to improve commercial effectiveness, efficiency and performance.
  • Lead the development and execution of initiatives to drive Rooms, Food & Beverage, Meetings & Events, Weddings and other revenue streams.
  • Continually assess market trends, competitor activity and customer behaviour to identify opportunities and adjust strategies accordingly.
  • Establish clear commercial objectives, performance indicators and reporting mechanisms to support informed decision-making.
  • Create a predictable sales model and drive accurate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasting.

Sales & Business Development

  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to the Proactive Sales, Reactive Sales, Events and Weddings teams.
  • Ensure the achievement and maximisation of Rooms and Banquet revenue, overall profitability and other agreed commercial targets.
  • Proactively identify, develop and secure new business opportunities across relevant market segments, with particular focus on luxury leisure, corporate, MICE, weddings and social events.
  • Establish effective solicitation and account management strategies to maximise revenue and yield.
  • Identify priority markets and accounts through market intelligence and research and ensure appropriate account coverage.
  • Monitor sales production and adjust account strategies, sales activities and priorities to achieve agreed objectives.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with the sales leadership team to evaluate sales performance, business mix, expenditure, profitability and opportunities for revenue enhancement.
  • Work closely with Accor Corporate, Global Sales and relevant partners to generate leads and improve conversion.
  • Represent the hotels at relevant local and international trade shows, exhibitions, sales missions and industry events.

Marketing & Brand Positioning

  • Lead the development and implementation of integrated marketing strategies that support revenue generation, brand awareness and commercial objectives.
  • Work closely with the Marketing team to develop effective demand-generation initiatives across relevant channels.
  • Ensure alignment between sales, marketing, communications, partnerships and brand strategies.
  • Strengthen the market positioning and visibility of Raffles Sentosa Singapore while ensuring all activities are aligned with the Raffles brand, standards and luxury positioning.
  • Oversee marketing campaigns and initiatives to drive qualified leads, customer acquisition, conversion and loyalty.
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and return on investment and adjust strategies where required.
  • Identify and develop strategic partnerships that enhance brand awareness and commercial opportunities.

Revenue Optimisation & Business Intelligence

  • Work closely with Revenue Management and other relevant stakeholders to maximise revenue, yield, profitability and market share.
  • Analyse business performance, market trends and customer data to identify opportunities and potential risks.
  • Ensure effective use of CRM, sales intelligence, business analytics and reporting tools.
  • Drive the development of meaningful commercial reports, forecasts and dashboards to support strategic decision-making.
  • Monitor conversion, pipeline performance, sales productivity and other key commercial indicators.
  • Recommend and implement corrective actions where performance is below expectations.

People Leadership

  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing commercial and marketing team.
  • Recruit, onboard, develop, motivate and retain capable and committed team members.
  • Provide clear leadership, direction, coaching and support to direct reports and their respective teams.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews and development discussions to support individual and team growth.
  • Ensure the commercial teams are equipped with the knowledge, skills and tools required to deliver exceptional results.

Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with operational and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between commercial strategies and operational capabilities.
  • Develop strong relationships with key corporate accounts, industry partners, Accor stakeholders and other relevant organisations.
  • Ensure effective communication of commercial priorities and strategies throughout the hotels.
  • Act as Project Lead for strategic commercial, organisational and process improvement initiatives as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum 8 to 10 years of progressive commercial leadership experience within luxury hospitality, with significant experience in Sales and Marketing.

Additional Information

  • Proven experience leading multi-functional commercial teams, including Sales, Events, Marketing and/or Revenue-related functions.
  • Strong understanding of luxury hospitality markets, customer behaviour and distribution channels.
  • Demonstrated track record of achieving revenue growth, market share and profitability targets.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to analyse business performance and translate insights into effective strategies.
  • Excellent leadership, people development and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong strategic planning, negotiation and business development capabilities.
  • Experience in managing MICE, corporate, leisure, weddings and social event segments will be an advantage.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong business relationships.
  • Highly organised, results-driven and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM, business analytics and relevant sales and marketing systems.
  • International luxury hospitality experience and familiarity with the Raffles or Accor ecosystem will be an advantage.

Job Title

Sales Principal Specialist

** ALL CVs MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH**

About The Business Area/Department

The Solutions Consultants team serves as a strategic bridge between sales, product, implementation, and the client. The team is responsible for understanding customer business needs, translating those needs into practical solution recommendations, and demonstrating how the organization’s technology and services can support operational goals, improve efficiency, and deliver measurable business value.

Summary Of The Role

The Senior Sales Representative, Technical Pre-Sales, is responsible for new logo acquisition and expansion of sales across their assigned territory. This role will focus on a consultative sales approach, helping clients understand the value of the Amadeus S&C Solutions and how these solutions can help drive value and efficiency for our customers.

In This Role You’ll

  • Collaborate with Account Executives in assigned territory to manage and grow the new sales pipeline for all S&C solutions (Delphi, MeetingBroker and all Peripheral Solutions)
  • Execute outreach campaigns, follow up with prospects, and close deals in territory.
  • Apply consultative selling best practices and maintain an accurate sales pipeline for forecasting accuracy.
  • Consistently achieve new sales revenue targets and support regional growth priorities.
  • Understand client business challenges and position strategies for our S&C solutions.
  • Deliver tailored product demos and value-driven presentations tailored to the customer’s needs.
  • Collaborate with Solution Consultant counterparts on complex deals where the customer can benefit from multiple Amadeus solutions.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitive landscape, and pricing models.
  • Clearly articulate the holistic value of Amadeus solutions versus competitors’ siloed offerings.
  • Serve as a thought leader in the meetings and events industry, sales and marketing group trends, etc.
  • Help to Influence product roadmap based on customer feedback, competitive landscape, and market needs.
  • Participate in sales kickoffs, training sessions, and promotional initiatives.
  • Work with Sales and Business Development to accelerate new sales pipeline and deal velocity.
  • Ensure Amadeus S&C Solutions are integrated into the entire Amadeus solution suite story.

About The Ideal Candidate

  • Experience with sales and catering software (preferred Delphi)
  • 5+ years in sales and revenue within the Hospitality and/or Hospitality SaaS Industry
  • Experience in hospitality sales and marketing or event sales.
  • Skilled in platform/Total Solution selling.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to demonstrate software in a storytelling manner.
  • Familiarity with hotel sales and marketing operations.
  • Familiarity with event operations.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and digital sales enablement platforms.
  • Willingness to travel.

What We Can Offer You

  • Get rewarded with competitive remuneration, individual and company annual bonus, vacation and holiday paid time off, health insurances and other competitive benefits.
  • Work hybrid at our Bogota office.
  • Professional development to broaden your knowledge and enhance your skills with on-line learning hubs packed with technical and soft skills training that allow you to develop and grow.
  • Enter a diverse and inclusive workplace, join one of the world’s top travel technology companies and take on a role that impacts millions of travelers around the globe.

Application Process

The application process takes no longer than 10 minutes!

Create your candidate profile, upload your Resume/CV and apply today!

Working At Amadeus, You Will Find

🎯 A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

🌎 A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.

🎓 Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.

🤗 A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.

💰 A complete rewards offer - Amadeus provides attractive remuneration packages, covering all essential components of a competitive reward offer, including salary, bonus, and benefits.

🌈 A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.

📈 A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.

Diversity & Inclusion

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience. 

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

job.job_description:
Tech that takes you places
We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact? Let’s go places together.

Drive the strategic initiatives that unlock new growth across CarTrawler’s commercial engine. This role sits right at the intersection of strategy and execution, shaping priorities, building winning go-to-market approaches and turning insight into action across our most important opportunities. Working closely with Commercial Leadership and cross-functional teams, you’ll lead high-impact, cross-functional strategic initiatives from ideation to implementation, ensuring alignment and measurable outcomes while bringing clear, board-ready storytelling to the moments that matter. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving complex commercial problems and enjoy influencing through data and crisp narrative, this is your runway.

This role can be based in Dublin or UK, with periodic travel to our Dublin headquarters to support important in-person meetings and collaboration.

Your Journey starts here!
What You’ll Do As a Commercial Strategy Lead

  • Strategic Responsibilities
  • Shape long-term commercial and partner strategies that drive sustainable growth and advance CarTrawler’s overarching strategic objectives
  • Develop winning go-to-market strategies to enter new segments and secure high-value partners, working closely with Commercial Leadership
  • Create differentiated business models, value propositions and prospect engagement strategies tailored to partner segments and regions
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Partnerships, Trading, Supply, Product, Marketing, Finance) to ensure strategies and GTM plans reflect market trends, prospect needs, and evolving platform capabilities
  • Embed AI-driven thinking and tooling into commercial workflows – improving decision-making, enhancing commercial modelling, and driving new ways of working across the Commercial organisation.
  • Core Responsibilities
  • Lead high-impact, cross-functional strategic initiatives from idea through to implementation, tracking alignment and measurable outcomes
  • Partner with Business Development to prioritise high-value opportunities, stress-test negotiation approaches, and help shape winning strategies
  • Build and refine high-quality commercial proposals with Product Marketing and stakeholders—clear, rigorous and tailored to the partner and segment
  • Deliver market, competitor, and win/loss insights that sharpen our commercial strategy and improve how we sell
  • Improve deal governance and commercial frameworks (pricing structures, modelling, rate cards, approvals, and proposition rules by segment/tier)
  • Create concise, insight-led updates for the Leadership Team and Board on pipeline performance, major opportunities, and strategic progress




What You’ll Bring To The Team

  • 3–5 years’ experience in strategy, commercial strategy or management consulting—ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including pricing, commercial modelling and evaluating revenue/profitability trade-offs
  • Excellent analytical problem-solving skills, able to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Confident communicator and storyteller, comfortable presenting to senior executives
  • Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across a matrixed organisation, challenging constructively and driving decisions forward
  • A pragmatic, ownership mindset, happy to work independently end-to-end and excited by using AI, data and automation to improve ways of working




Go on, give it a go!
We know that looking for a new job can feel a bit daunting but don’t let a touch of imposter syndrome hold you back. Even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you! Apply today to stay connected.

At CarTrawler, we’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone. No matter your background, identity, or life experience, if you’re passionate about what you do, you’ll be welcomed here.

Hybrid Working & Eligibility: Our hybrid working policy requires employees to work onsite at our CarTrawler Dublin office a minimum of 2 days per week.

Applicants must have an existing right to work in Ireland/UK without the requirement for employment permit sponsorship to be considered for this role.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job.job_description:
At InterContinental Hotels & Resorts® we want our guests to feel special, cosmopolitan and In the Know which means we need you to:

  • Be charming by being approachable, having confidence and showing respect.
  • Stay in the moment by understanding and anticipating guests’ needs, being attentive and taking ownership of getting things done.
  • Make it memorable by being knowledgeable, sharing stories and showing your style to create moments that make people feel special.

Your Day to Day

Digital Marketing

  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns across Rooms and Food & Beverage.
  • Manage paid media campaigns across Google, Meta, TikTok, Xiaohongshu and other relevant platforms.
  • Work with digital agencies to optimise campaign performance and return on investment (ROI).
  • Manage digital marketing budgets and campaign performance.Website & E-Commerce
  • Manage the hotel's website and ensure content is accurate and up to date.
  • Optimise the website, booking engine and SevenRooms booking journey to improve conversion.
  • Support website enhancements and digital projects.

OTA & Distribution

  • Manage digital marketing opportunities with OTA partners.
  • Ensure OTA content, promotions and digital assets are accurate and up to date.
  • Work with Revenue Management on digital distribution initiatives.
  • CRM
  • Manage audience segmentation and customer communications.
  • Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements.

Digital Analytics

  • Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, UTM governance and conversion tracking.
  • Monitor website, booking engine and SevenRooms performance.
  • Prepare regular reports on campaign performance, website traffic, conversion and digital revenue.

SEO

  • Manage SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) initiatives.
  • Monitor search performance and recommend improvements to website visibility.

Agency & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage digital agencies and technology partners.
  • Work with Revenue Management, Sales, Food & Beverage and Operations on digital initiatives.
  • Ensure digital activities comply with brand standards and data privacy regulations

What We Need From You

  • Degree or Diploma in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 4 years' experience in digital marketing, e-commerce or hospitality marketing.
  • Experience managing paid media campaigns across Google, Meta and other digital platforms.
  • Experience with website management, CRM and email marketing.
  • Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager and digital reporting tools.
  • Knowledge of SEO, website optimisation and digital analytics.
  • Familiarity with hotel booking engines, OTA platforms and SevenRooms is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, project management and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.
  • Experience in luxury hospitality.
  • Google Analytics, Google Ads or other relevant digital marketing certifications.
  • Experience working with digital agencies.

How Do I Deliver This

We genuinely care about people and we show this through living out our promise of True Hospitality each and every day. It’s what connects every colleague in all IHG® hotels.

Each IHG® hotel brand delivers True Hospitality in their own way, and at the heart of it all are specific, core service skills.

  • True Attitude: being caring, wanting to make positive difference, and building genuine connections with guest
  • True Confidence: having the knowledge and skills to perform your role, and giving guests the confidence that they can trust you, to help and support them during their stay
  • True Listening: focusing on what your guest is saying, picking up on body language that is often overlooked, and understanding what the guest wants and needs
  • True Responsiveness: is about providing guests with what they need, and doing so in a timely and caring manner

There’s so much more to the job than we can capture here. It’s simply about creating great experiences, doing the right thing and understanding people.

What We Offer

We’ll reward your hard work with a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package – including generous room and dining discounts, exceptional training opportunities and a strong support for your ongoing career development

Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve – visit www.http://careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.

IHG is an equal opportunity employer: Minorities / Females / Disabled / Veterans.

job.job_description:
Now boarding: Your career in travel is ready for take-off.


Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is undergoing an exciting period of growth as worldwide travel returns. If you’re ready to embark on a career with a global leader in business travel, we want to hear from you.


At CTM, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We know that our diverse team is the reason CTM is the award-winning TMC we are today, which is why recruiting like-minded travel enthusiasts is an important part of our business’ success and growth.


About CTM

CTM is an award-winning provider of travel service solutions spanning corporate, events and sports markets. Headquartered and founded in Australia, CTM has offices all around the world, including Europe, Asia, North America, Australia and New Zealand. www.travelctm.co.uk


About the Role

As an Accounts Receivable Officer, you will ensure the full end-to-end accounts receivable workflow is effectively managed, continuously identify opportunities to improve processes and systems, and ensure the team delivers a consistently high level of customer service to both internal and external customers.


Please note that this role is a fixed-term position for 12 months.


Responsibilities & Duties


  • Manage the end-to-end merchant services card settlement process, ensuring timely and accurate reconciliation of transactions.
  • Perform daily reconciliation, allocation, and investigation of card receipts and payments, resolving any discrepancies working closely with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage failed card transactions, including rejection resolution, customer communication, and payment recovery activities.
  • Process card recharges and monitor manual card payments, ensuring successful completion and prompt resolution of any issues.
  • Prepare and maintain regular reports on debtor balances, outstanding failed transactions, and recovery performance.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, financial procedures, and merchant service provider requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, controls, and operational efficiency.
  • Undertake additional duties and ad-hoc projects as required to support the wider Finance team.



Skills & Experience

  • 1 year experience in a Finance environment
  • Experience in card payments, merchant services, settlements, and reconciliation.
  • Ability to work with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues.
  • Good understanding of financial controls, compliance, and payment processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication, organisation, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage high-volume transactions and meet deadlines.
  • Proficient in Excel and financial/payment systems.
  • Flexible and able to support ad-hoc Finance projects and wider team requirements.


Join our crew and help CTM take flight. Apply now and pack your skills for a business travel journey that promises growth, discovery and plenty of first-class moments.


What to expect from the recruitment process

  • Every hire starts with a chat with our Talent Acquisition team, if your profile is selected you will be contacted by phone or email (please check your spam folder);
  • Then, if you are progressing, the hiring manager will invite you to an interview, usually on Teams;
  • If you are successful we will invite you to our office for a final stage interview.


Wherever possible we will provide you with feedback, however we are a small team and often we won't be able to do so until after we fill the vacancy.


CTM is a responsible employer and is dedicated to conduct thorough right to work checks in the interests of both parties, candidates and the company. Candidates selected and invited to an interview will be invited to a mandatory 15 min call with the TA lead to produce their RTW documents. This call is a mandatory step for all candidates regardless of their RTW status. This call is confidential and conducted by HR professionals only.


CTM is an equal opportunity employer. We want to make sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know: as a Disability Confident Employer, we’re here to support you in any way we can. Do not hesitate to connect with our Recruitment team if you need to discuss arrangements.


Reward & Recognition

Our learning platform CTM Learning, our annual conference the All Stars, our High-Performance programme and a global leadership programme.


Employee Wellbeing and Flexibility

Our wellbeing platform Vitality, our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), our new private healthcare Medicash + our mental health first aiders.

Most of our roles offer a hybrid working pattern, with 3 days per week in the office. Where permitted and depending on the role, we can offer flexible start and finish times to suit your other commitments and support a healthy work-life balance. We are committed to finding a setup that works for you and the business.


Sustainability Focus

Principles of Governance, People, Planet, and Prosperity, CTM’s Sustainability Strategy identifies material issues and outlines initiatives to achieve this.


CTM is the Data Controller with respect to the personal information you provide during your application. We will use this information solely to process your application, and our legal basis is that you are considering taking up an employment contract with us. We may share this information with our parent company in Australia, but otherwise we will not disclose it to any other organisation. If you take up employment with us, we will keep the information for the duration of your employment, otherwise we will destroy it 2 months after the post is filled.

All the information that we ask for in application forms has to be completed for your application to go ahead. There is no profiling or automated decision making applied to the personal information you supply. You have all the legal rights with your personal data as laid out in the General Data Processing Regulation (GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018, including the right to complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office. Our Data Protection Officer may be contacted at EU.DPO@travelctm.com

Company Description

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group's global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Job Description

This is where your greatest challenge awaits:

Within the Global Procurement Organization, you join the Category Management teams to own the Professional Services category strategy — Marketing, Communication, HR & Facility, Audit, Strategic Consulting, Travel & Translation — across all regions and brands.

Your Mission

As category owner, you define, deploy and continuously improve global category strategies across a broad, cross-functional scope. You lead sourcing, negotiation and supplier management to drive value creation, reduce risk and optimize cost, working hand in hand with brands and regions.

  • Define, deploy and continuously improve global category strategies for Professional Services: Marketing & Communication, HR & Facility, Audit / Financial Services (incl. CSRD), Strategic Consulting, Travel & Mobility, Translation, and other professional services
  • Manage 360° marketing agencies (branding, creative, social media, events, PR and influencer marketing), digital marketing & e-commerce services, market research and loyalty programs / sponsorships; support the procurement side of the marketing full-funnel project
  • Manage procurement for People & Culture services: recruitment, temporary workforce, learning & development, employee benefits, HR consulting and HR digital solutions
  • Oversee Facility Management services: workplace operations, maintenance, security, cleaning and space management
  • Lead Strategic Consulting services: business strategy development, market analysis, organizational transformation and high-level advisory support
  • Manage Travel & Mobility and Translation services, as well as other professional services (brand compliance & hotel audits, cross-functional and project-based expertise)
  • Lead sourcing initiatives, RFI/RFQ processes, negotiations and contract management
  • Manage supplier relationships, governance and performance reviews
  • Control category spend, budgets, savings delivery, compliance and risk management
  • Promote Group Procurement policies, processes and value proposition across regions and brands

Qualifications

And you?

Your Profile

  • Proven international experience as a Category Manager / Buyer
  • At least 2–3 years of total working experience in an international context
  • Required work experience in Professional Services, particularly Marketing & Communication
  • Relevant experience in negotiation and contract management
  • Hospitality experience is a plus

Your Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities, assessing risk and explaining complex issues concisely to business owners
  • Ability to translate business needs into procurement solutions and promote Group Procurement Policy adoption
  • Clear and impactful communication, adaptable across diverse stakeholders
  • Capacity to manage multiple priorities across regions

Languages

  • Fluent English required (daily working language)
  • French is a plus; any other language is an asset

Additional Information

Why join us?

And what are our commitments?

To the world

  • Accor is committed to the world around us, with a strong employer culture focused on the development of our 300,000 talents.
  • We adopt a continuous improvement approach to reduce the environmental impact of digital across all our projects.

To your career

  • We enable all our employees to maintain a healthy work-life balance and give them the means to shape their working environment in their own image.
  • Dedicated Talent Management, continuous improvement, and training and development paths are defined both individually and collectively so that we can grow together, every day.

Concretely, At Accor

  • Remote work possible several days per week from France and flexible working options: work from home, our offices, or even our hotels and coworking spaces thanks to Worklib.

And also,

  • ALL - Heartist® program: preferential rates and flash offers for unforgettable stays and experiences across all our Accor locations and with our partners worldwide.
  • Heartist® for Good volunteering program: 1 day offered during your working time to get involved with a non-profit organization.
  • A Social and Economic Committee (CSE) that supports you in financing your cultural and sports activities.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package for using an eco-friendly means of transportation or a "company bike" program in partnership with Zenride.
  • Coverage of urban public transport subscriptions between home and workplace, up to 75%.
  • Meal vouchers with a face value of €11.
  • A mandatory health insurance plan funded at 50% by Accor, at no additional cost in case of enrollment of your dependents.
  • Not to mention attractive working conditions with collaborative workspaces, restaurants, game areas, as well as well-being and sports spaces on site or through Gymlib.

Your talent and motivation are our only selection criteria.

We value the richness of diverse nationalities, personalities, and professional backgrounds.

We know how to adapt to the specific needs of our employees, particularly those with disabilities.

We encourage all applications, without distinction of gender, so dare to apply!

For us, recruitment is above all a story of encounters.

Does this role appeal to you? Apply, and we will offer you:

  • An initial discussion with our recruitment team to present the key elements of the role or guide you toward a position that may better suit you,
  • One or more interviews with managers and team members,
  • For certain roles, you may also be asked to complete a test or case study, as well as a questionnaire about your personality and motivations.
  • A final interview with our Human Resources team to discuss our Group culture, working environment, training program, and career prospects, as well as the different Group benefits.
  • Personalized feedback.

About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


The Business Development Manager, Distribution will be responsible for expanding and optimising the distribution network for Trip.com’s Attractions, Tours & Activities business. This role focuses on acquiring, managing, and growing partnerships with distribution partners (OTAs, affiliates, resellers, travel agencies, and platform partners) to drive supply visibility, transaction growth, and revenue performance across global markets. Open to location in Paris, London, Frankfurt and Berlin.


In this Role, you will do the following:

Distribution Partnership Development:

  • Identify, onboard, and manage strategic distribution partners, including OTAs, affiliates, travel agencies, Meta, and other B2B channels.
  • Develop scalable distribution strategies to increase exposure and sales of Attractions, Tours & Activities products across multiple markets.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, commission structures, and partnership agreements to ensure mutual growth and profitability.

Account Management & Growth:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned distribution partners, ensuring strong relationships and long-term collaboration.
  • Drive partner performance through joint business planning, promotions, and product optimisation initiatives.
  • Monitor partner KPIs, analyse performance data, and implement action plans to improve conversion, booking volume, and revenue.

Market & Product Strategy:

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Supply, Operations team) to align distribution strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Provide market insights on competitive landscape, pricing trends, and customer behavior to inform product and distribution decisions.
  • Support the localisation and market expansion of A&T, products across key source (Global) and destination markets (Europe).

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure smooth onboarding, API or system integration, and operational readiness of distribution partners.
  • Resolve partner-related issues efficiently, including content accuracy, inventory availability, pricing discrepancies, and operational escalations.


What you'll Need to Succeed

  • 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Partnerships, or Distribution, preferably within OTA, travel tech, tourism, or e-commerce industries.
  • Solid understanding of Attractions, Tours & Activities, distribution models, or B2B/B2B2C partnerships is highly preferred.
  • Experience working with channel managers or travel technology platforms is a strong advantage.
  • Strong commercial acumen with proven negotiation and deal-closing capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and drive business decisions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-cultural, and matrixed organisation.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus, depending on market coverage.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and highly motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Adaptable in multicultural and fast-paced environments
  • Passion for travel, experiences, and building scalable global partnerships.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.

What’s more?

We are looking for a dynamic Partner Experience Specialist to join our Asset Management Team. This is not just a job, it’s a career launchpad with a global hospitality leader.

Purpose

As a Partner Experience Specialist, you play a vital role within our Asset Management Team. Your friendly, diplomatic, and proactive approach is key to building and nurturing strong relationships with our apartment owners across a diverse portfolio of properties.

Your problem-solving skills and expertise will be instrumental in fostering connections with potential owners, serving as a brand ambassador to contribute to the growth and enhancement of our property portfolio.

Note: This position is internally referred to as Owner Relations Manager.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Relationship Management: Build and maintain deep, lasting trust with current apartment owners while establishing connections with potential investors and key building stakeholders.
  • Problem Solving & Investigation: Respond to inquiries from apartment owners regarding their investments, financial returns, and account structures. You will proactively investigate the details, analyse account data, and deliver clear, accurate resolutions.
  • De-escalation & Resolution: Effectively address and resolve complex inquiries or concerns. Your calm, empathetic approach will turn challenging situations into positive outcomes, protecting and enhancing Accor's premium brand reputation.
  • Industry Expertise: Develop and maintain a strong level of knowledge about the management letting options provided by Accor and relevant industry legislation.
  • Portfolio Growth: Drive brand expansion by implementing key strategies and initiatives to increase keys under Accor’s management.

Skills And Experience

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the natural ability to make people feel heard, valued, and respected.
  • Conflict Resolution: Confident in your ability to cultivate strong relationships, de-escalate friction, and implement solutions that fully rectify issues while enhancing service quality.
  • Organisation & Drive: Proven ability to multi-task, prioritise, and thrive under pressure, supported by strong administrative and time-management skills.
  • Qualifications: A current real estate sales certificate or transferable license is beneficial—but if you are still nearing completion or don't have it yet, we will sponsor you to complete it during your paid work hours!
  • Background Screening: Due to our obligations under Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism (AML/CTF) regulations, all successful candidates will participate in pre-employment background screening, including identity verification, a national police check, and a bankruptcy/insolvency search.

Accor Benefits

  • ALL Heartist Membership - Take advantage of discounts on accommodation and food & beverage worldwide!
  • Family & Friends Discounts - Available on a range of accommodation, services and events for those who mean the most to you
  • Accor Live Limitless (ALL) Loyalty Program - Earn status & reward points on your worldwide stays
  • Learn Your Way - Support your career development with access to Accor’s industry leading training platforms, Accor Academy and Typsy
  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide
  • Worldwide Opportunities - We are a world leading hotel operator! With over 400 hotels in the Pacific and more than 5,000 across 110 countries, offering limitless opportunities to grow your career

At Accor, we welcome you as you are. We help you grow and learn, so that work brings purpose to your life. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write, and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Accor is an inclusive company, building diverse teams across the globe.

Everyone has a story and we want to learn yours. We invite you to APPLY NOW.

About the Company


Corporate Travel Management (CTM) is an award-winning global provider of innovative and cost-effective travel solutions spanning corporate, events, leisure, loyalty and wholesale travel. The company’s proven business strategy is underpinned by personalized service excellence supported by market leading technology solutions which deliver a return on investment to our customers. Headquartered in Australia with its Asia head office in Hong Kong, the company provides local service solutions to customers of all sizes across the world including Hong Kong, Singapore, China, Taiwan and Japan in Asia. CTM is an award-winning provider of innovative and cost-effective travel management solutions to the corporate, events, leisure and loyalty travel markets. Its proven business strategy combines personalized service excellence with client-facing technology solutions to deliver a return on investment to clients.


About the Role


The Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for identifying targeted corporate travel opportunities and developing tailored sales strategies to drive business growth. This is more than a traditional sales role. Success comes from understanding a client's business, travel needs and strategic priorities, and developing the right travel solutions to create value for both the client and CTM.


The role takes a consultative, solution-led approach to sales — combining market insight, business understanding and CTM's service and product capabilities to deliver compelling solutions rather than relying on a hard-sell approach. The successful candidate will connect client business needs with the right travel solutions, identify growth opportunities and build strong, long-term corporate relationships.


Primary deliverables.

  • Research, formulate and prepare sales strategies and account acquisitions plans to attain new corporate clients and expand new markets for existing clients.
  • Develop winning value propositions for clients as part of the qualification process.
  • Being involved in the regional strategic and operations sales planning initiatives.
  • Represent CTM in the marketplace on a professional basis to increase market and brand awareness.
  • And most importantly achieve your annual sales target.


Requirements


  • A minimum of 5+ years in a sales/ business partnership position in the travel industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to align and tailor your “sell” to match the client’s requirements.
  • Previous experience in building pipelines, segmentation, overseeing tenders, reporting to sales.
  • Prompt status updates on CRM.
  • Outstanding communication and negotiation skills.
  • Acute business analytic acumens.
  • Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Effective time management is a must have.
  • Ability to connect with audience during presentation skills to articulate value propositions of CTM.
